**Are you an ambitious sales leader passionate to make life easier for people with healthcare needs? Are you looking for a workplace that provides a great purpose, collaborative colleagues and empowerement to make a difference? Then this can be an exciting role for you**
Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 17,000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.
  
  
**The Role**
Responsible for recruiting, coaching, developing and managing a sales team for effective regional coverage and to optimize sales execution to attain sales targets. Also responsible for developing and communicating sales plans/strategies/objectives as well as identifying and building rapport with key customers and the dealer network.
  
  
**Areas of Accountability**

* Repsonsible for building the annual business plan for the region and ensure achievement of assigned sales targets
* Provides direction, coaches and develops sales team to maximize effectiveness and is open and honest with feedback
* Ensures that sales team follows pre-defined call plan based on Segmentation and Targeting and reviews activity to ensure appropriate coverage of key accounts.Develops and drives Account Specific Action Plans (ASAP) together with the sales team for their respective high priority accounts
* Drives execution of portfolio and pricing strategy as defined by country management
* Ensures 100% execution of all annual business plan activities during the business year
* Acts as liaison between sales team and other functions in the organization to ensure appropriate problem solving and support
* Drives tender mapping and bidding process in the region.
* Ensure 100% compliance on dealer management, daily sales outstanding
* Develops own relationships with KOL and high priority accounts to augment selling effort and negotiates contracts with customers at highest level as needed
* Recruits and effectively onboard new team members.
* Effective coordination of roles and responsibilities in the sales team to ensure optimal utilization of different sales profiles.
* Drive in-market sales effectively as per the assigned budget
* Ensures compliance with the Coloplast code of conduct at all times.
* Promote a culture in your region that reflects the company’s values, encourages high performance, and reward results of the sales team.
* Continuously gather Market Intelligence and develop reaction plans accordingly

**Education & Experience**

* Science or Pharmacy graduate preferably Masters in Management
* Over 10-15 years Sales Experience – ideally medical product company
* Min. 5 years experience of leading a fast pace growth oriented medical sales organization
* Proficient computer skills including MS Office Suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and SFDC
* Intelligent demonstrated in test and business case understanding
* Proven Track record in growth/showing results
* Excellent analytical and presentation skills
* Experience in coaching a sales force
* Experience in working with Sales Management tools like S&T and ASAP plans

**Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Should be passionate about taking ownership and delivering on commitments
* Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems with minimal direction and make decisions with confidence
* Demonstrated results in executing strategic plans, and actions to achieve the company´s objectives
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with executive presence
* Strong belief in alignment with Coloplast Mission, Vision, Values and Leadership Promise
* Open to travel extensively when required

*Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.*

title: Sr Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Sr Account Manager here at Honeywell, you will play a crucial role in driving the company's strategic growth and success. Your leadership and expertise in managing key accounts will enable you to build strong relationships with customers and provide innovative solutions to meet their evolving needs. By guiding and mentoring your team, you will foster a culture of excellence and drive revenue growth, positioning the company as a market leader in strategic account management.
   

  

 In this role, your impact on the company will be transformative. Your strategic vision and leadership will drive revenue growth, expand market presence, and strengthen customer relationships. By effectively managing key accounts and guiding your team, you will position the company for long\-term success and establish it as a leader in the industry.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This exciting position will be focused on developing strong pipeline of Gas Metering ,Regulating and analysis (M\&C) business which includes Ultrasonic Meters, Flow Computers, Gas Chromatographs, Turbine Meters, RPD meters, Gas Renewable Solutions for Bio Gas and H2 etc., Regulators in growing vertical like Natural Gas, Bio Gas, Hydrogen, Oil and Gas, City Gas Distribution etc . You will develop customer relationships through coordinating and/or attending trade shows, seminar, and similar events. You will provide education of Honeywell product through technical presentations. You will maintain and provide reports and opportunity status using our customer relationship management system. You will provide competitive intelligence and market trends. You will provide forecast/demand input to Sales Inventory Operations Planning (SIOP).
   

  

 The role will coordinate and integrate an aligned customer strategy, defines product and solution scope across businesses and sets out a supporting decarbonization and growth roadmap.
   

  

 The role collaborates with sales and channel partner teams, who drive contracts, transacts, and operationally delivers with customers on the ground.
   

  

 The candidate will utilize knowledge of Gas Chromatography, Gas Renewable Market and applications, market/customer Insights, value chain understanding and risk management to develop credible and sustainable relationships At Senior Levels with Key Customers.
   

  

 The role will focus on developing multi\-year strategic customer plans and delivery roadmap, building India’s corporate customer headquarters\-level relationships, supporting annual planning cycle, leading multi\-functional and cross line of business core teams across Honeywell.
   

  

 Engage C\-suite and key decision makers at customers’ Americas headquarters during all critical stages of the strategic customer sales cycle.
   

  

 You have a deep knowledge of and passion for the energy Midstream Natural Gas Transmission market, including experience designing, structuring and selling Gas Quality and Gas Renewable projects, or other related products.
   

  

 Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop pipeline of opportunity and sales in respective assigned region
* Track the Government policy changes in renewable energy.
* Develop the strategy for H2 and Bio gas
* Attend (trade shows, seminars, events)
* Visit existing customers
* Search for new customers
* Campaign management
* Customer reporting
* Gas quality product knowledge
* Automation and remote solutions
* Customer account management
* Specification driving with consultants and EPC contractors.
* Chanel Partners handling


**Qualifications**
**Must Haves:**
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent in Instrumentation / Mechanical
* 7\+ years of experience on selling gas measurement and quality for transmission, natural gas distributions projects
* 2\+ years of experience in Bio gas and Hydrogen market development.
* Candidate with gas solution selling in process and petrochemical industry for selling Natural gas products.


**We Value**
* MBA in business development


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Deputy Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Kolkata - Salt Lake
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Acquire and convert eligible Education Loan customers through compliant counselling, disciplined funnel management, complete documentation, coordinated fulfilment and active ownership of portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Generate and manage leads from direct, referral, consultant, institution and partner channels.
* Counsel students and co-applicants on course, country, institution, funding requirement, repayment construct and documentation.
* Capture complete application data, customer consent and source attribution in approved systems.
* Collect and validate admission, academic, KYC, income, banking and collateral documents before login.
* Coordinate with Credit, Operations, Verification and partners to resolve queries and progress files within agreed service levels.
* Track the lead-to-login, login-to-sanction and sanction-to-disbursement funnel and record lost reasons and corrective actions.
* Communicate sanction terms, conditions and pending requirements accurately to customers.
* Maintain compliant selling, customer confidentiality, audit trails and approved communication standards.
* Support portfolio quality through appropriate sourcing, fraud vigilance and early issue escalation.
* Support portfolio quality and X-bucket management through pre-due and pre-bounce customer engagement, timely repayment reminders, follow-up on assigned overdue cases and escalation to the Sales Manager and Collections team.
* Execute assigned activities directly and maintain accurate system records.
* Escalate customer, documentation, fraud or repayment concerns promptly.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**
Decision rights
  
  

* Make day-to-day sales and customer-management decisions within approved policy, process, pricing and delegated authority.
* Prioritise and allocate customer follow-ups, including portfolio-quality and X-bucket actions, within the assigned scope.
* Escalate policy deviations, material customer impact, fraud indicators, persistent overdue cases and unresolved dependencies.
* Commercial, hiring and budget authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Credit/Underwriting, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Compliance, Finance, Technology, HR and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, universities, education consultants, DSAs, referral partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent customer, academic and financial information.
* Driving timely customer engagement for pre-due, pre-bounce and overdue cases while following approved conduct standards.
* Coordinating Sales, Collections, Credit, Risk and Operations to address X-bucket and early-delinquency issues.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate. Relevant customer-facing, lending or financial-services experience preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Education Loan customer counselling
* Sales execution and relationship management
* Portfolio-quality and X-bucket management awareness
* Customer repayment engagement and early-delinquency follow-up
* Understanding of academic, income and KYC documents
* CRM/LOS usage and MIS discipline
* Communication, negotiation and customer orientation
* Compliance, fraud and customer-conduct awareness
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity and customer confidentiality

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.

* Develop and Build new application Integration, Account and Entitlement Connectors and perform periodic certification reviews in the Saviynt Platform.
* Experience in development phase for Saviynt components - Build Warehouse, Access Request System (ARS), Rule Management, User Provisioning, Access Certification, Identity analytics, Segregation of Duties
* Good knowledge in the configuring of workflows in Saviynt IGA tool. Good knowledge of configuring birthright rules for the user onboarding workflows. Have involved in creation of XML jobs in Saviynt IGA tool.
* Experience in implementation process, built and deployment in Saviynt process.
* Should have good understanding of RDMS and SQL queries.
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Airlock SSO/CIAM or similar product to join our operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Airlock SSO and CIAM solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, provide expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Airlock SSO/CIAM-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Configure and troubleshoot access issues, MFA methods, risk-based authentication rules, and user-profile issues.
* Diagnose complex authentication failures, service degradation, and system outages.
* Perform technical and change-impact analysis for platform, policy, and application changes.
* Maintain installation, configuration, deployment, patching, upgrades, and post-change validation.
* Maintain incident remediation, root-cause, prevention, and operational documentation.
* Monitor platform, directory infrastructure, backups, and integrations for potential issues.
* Develop and maintain SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Coordinate with technical teams, security leads, stakeholders, and product vendors.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to knowledge-management activities.
* Produce service-level reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for service improvement.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, ITIL processes, change controls, and documentation standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of overall Identity and Access Management experience, including strong hands-on experience with Airlock Access Management or similar.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* Advanced experience in Airlock SSO operations, configuration and troubleshooting,
* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience with one or more enterprise Access Management products such as Airlock, Okta, PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, Azure MFA, or RSA.
* Ability to manage authentication policies, selectors, sessions, identity profiles, protocol endpoints, OAuth scopes, client registration policies, grant mappings, token mappings, and OIDC policies.
* Experience with application onboarding, IdP configuration, patch/version upgrades, and production rollout.
* Good knowledge of authentication, authorization, provisioning, IAM, and core security concepts.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, or Unix operating-system internals and monitoring tools.
* Experience in ITIL-based service management and supporting sglobal or remote teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL or equivalent certification is preferred.
* CIAM, Microsoft Azure, or AWS certification or similar sssssis an advantage.

We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**
We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
  
  
We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.

While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

title: Founder's office- Marketing and Communication
description:

Amwoodo Eco Products Private Limited

**Job role:**
Founder’s office- Marketing and Communication

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal

**About the Role**

Amwoodo Eco Products Private Limited is looking for a dynamic, creative and strategically driven professional to join the Founder's Office as Founder's Office – Marketing & Communication.

The individual will work closely with the Founder and senior leadership team to drive the company's marketing vision, brand positioning, communication strategy and overall business growth, with a strong focus on the D2C and E-commerce ecosystem.

The role will involve developing marketing strategies, strengthening brand communication, identifying growth opportunities, driving digital marketing initiatives and ensuring consistent brand messaging across platforms. The candidate will also be responsible for translating the Founder's vision and business objectives into impactful marketing and communication initiatives.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of D2C marketing, brand building, digital growth strategies and corporate communication, along with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Work closely with the Founder to conceptualise and implement strategic marketing initiatives.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, consumer trends and emerging channels to strengthen brand presence.
* Drive integrated marketing campaigns to improve brand awareness, customer acquisition and revenue growth.
* Evaluate marketing performance and recommend strategies to improve overall effectiveness and ROI.

* Identify opportunities for customer engagement, brand visibility, repeat purchases and revenue enhancement.

* Ensure consistency in brand messaging across digital platforms, marketing collaterals and external communication.

* Drive social media communication, content calendars and brand engagement initiatives.
* Develop compelling communication strategies for product launches, brand campaigns and business announcements.
* Ensure that all marketing communication reflects the company's vision, values and brand positioning.

**4. Founder's Communication & Corporate Communication**

* Work closely with the Founder in developing communication strategies and leadership narratives.
* Manage and enhance the Founder's professional presence across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn and other digital channels.
* Draft and review leadership communications, business announcements, presentations, speeches and corporate messaging.
* Develop thought leadership content, articles, interviews and other communication initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless communication and timely execution of key initiatives.
* Support PR activities, media interactions, press releases and external brand communication.

**5. Content, PR & Marketing Campaigns**

* Conceptualise and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline platforms.
* Identify opportunities for influencer marketing, collaborations, strategic partnerships and brand associations.
* Coordinate with creative agencies, designers, content creators and other external partners.
* Oversee the creation of marketing assets, promotional content, videos and campaign communication.
* Identify relevant media opportunities to enhance brand visibility and corporate reputation.
* Track campaign effectiveness and ensure marketing initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

**6. Strategic Projects & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Support the Founder in executing high-priority marketing and business growth initiatives.
* Work closely with E-commerce, Sales, Product, Finance and Operations teams to ensure alignment of marketing objectives.
* Conduct competitor analysis, market research and consumer behaviour studies.
* Prepare marketing performance reports, business presentations and strategic recommendations for leadership reviews.
* Take ownership of key marketing projects and ensure timely execution against defined objectives.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Digital Marketing, Corporate Communication, PR or Founder's Office roles.
* Prior experience in FMCG, D2C, E-commerce, Retail or Consumer Products organisations will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing strategies and brand growth initiatives.
* Good knowledge of performance marketing, social media marketing, content strategy, influencer marketing and brand positioning.
* Understanding of digital marketing metrics, customer acquisition and retention strategies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong content drafting and presentation abilities.

**Job Purpose:**
This role is responsible to manage and enhance the plant's greenbelt and landscape areas through regular maintenance. Lead effective measures for managing in-house nursery operations, and maintaining horticulture equipment. Engage and develop the horticulture team, while coordinating with various departments to fulfil the plant's horticulture requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Associate Manager - Horticulture**
**Greenbelt And Landscape Management**
Oversee the maintenance of greenbelt areas in the plant and township area including removal of wild growth and ensure regular maintenance of plants.
  
  
Manage the maintenance of lawns through grass cutting, watering, and maintenance of existing hedges and shrubs by trimming.
  
  
Manage the maintenance of landscape areas by pruning, lawn mowing, hedge cutting, unwanted weeding, pesticide and weedicide spray.
  
  
Arrange plantation events as required and support other zones of the plant with their horticulture needs.
  
  
Ensure removal of unwanted grass and vegetation in fire-restricted areas and address concerns raised on GENSUITE, as they arise.
  
  
Conduct regular meetings with horticulture agencies to ensure the progressive increase and development of green zone areas as per CPCB and State PCB norms.
  
  
Coordinate with Corporate affairs for liasoning with contractors for Greenbelt development
  
  
**Horticulture Production And Equipment**
Lead in-house production and utilization of vermicompost.
  
  
Optimize growing conditions and apply advanced horticultural techniques to enhance plant quality and productivity in the nursery.
  
  
Lead nursery staff, manage vendor coordination, and ensure compliance with horticultural standards and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Manage the maintenance and repair of horticulture equipment, including the issuance of diesel and monitoring equipment running.
  
  
Ensure to follow procedures as per the manufacturer guide lines and proper documentation of activities through checklists.

Maintain the water distribution system, sprinklers, and related fittings for efficient irrigation.
  
  
Ensure regular application of fertilizers and medicines to plants as required.
  
  
Monitor all green zone areas to receive regular water as per requirement and establish new green zones.
  
  
Maintain fruit-bearing trees and ensure they receive appropriate care.

Prepare and manage the budget for horticulture jobs within the plant.
  
  
Raise purchase requisitions (PR) for procurement of materials.
  
  
Process service entry sheets, inward/outward material gate passes, and material reservations in SAP.
  
  
Verify monthly bills from contracting agencies and scrutinize for accuracy.
  
  
Preparation of weekly and daily work programs as per approved schedules and action plans to complete work within the timeframe.

Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
  
  
Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment by guiding workmen on safe working practices, providing proper training, and supporting safety audits to address and close audit findings.
  
  
Enforce adherence to safety norms and integrate safety measures to maintain a secure work environment within department operations.

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency.
  
  
Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
  
  
Coordinate with different departments for the integration of advanced technology and digitization.

Admin
  
  
Civil
  
  
Operations & Maintenance
  
  
HR
  
  
Stores
  
  
Environment and Sustainability
  
  
Corporate Affairs
  
  
Techno Commercial

Horticulture Agencies
  
  
Nurseries
  
  
Vendors
  
  
Contractors

Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Agriculture, Forestry or a related field.

8+ years of experience in horticulture management or a similar field.

title: Cargo Export Control Manager, Ahmedabad (India)
description:
General Information
  
  
**Ref #**
260000ET
  
  
**Location:**
India-Ahmedabad
  
  
**Job family:**
Corporate & Commercial
  
  
**Closing Date:**
2026-11-02
  
  
**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of
**Cargo Export Control Manager**
based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The Cargo Export Control Manager will lead and manage the day-to-day implementation, oversight and continuous improvement of Qatar Airways Cargo’s export controls and sanctions compliance programme across the global cargo network. The role will ensure that requirements relating to dual-use, military and strategic goods, controlled technology, restricted end-use and end-users, destination controls and sanctions screening are embedded within cargo booking, acceptance, documentation, escalation and shipment-handling processes. The successful candidate will provide practical specialist guidance to the Cargo Compliance Support Center (CCSC), Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, Ground Handling Agents and outstations, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed consistently and effectively.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the implementation and maintenance of export-control and sanctions policies, procedures, screening rules, commodity controls and escalation workflows across Qatar Airways Cargo operations globally.
* Assess high-risk shipments involving dual-use, military, strategic or otherwise controlled goods and recommend appropriate operational, legal or compliance action.
* Manage sanctions-screening governance, including list matching, false-positive resolution, potential-match escalation and the implementation of applicable regulatory controls.
* Conduct and oversee end-user, end-use, consignee, intermediate-consignee and destination-risk assessments, ensuring decisions are supported by clear and complete records
* Interpret regulatory requirements and provide commercially practical guidance to Cargo Operations, Commercial teams, outstations, Ground Handling Agents and other relevant stakeholders.
* Review export-control and sanctions incidents, exceptions and investigations; identify root causes; and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented and closed effectively.
* Govern screening criteria, system rules and enhancements, and drive automation and continuous improvement of export-control and sanctions processes.
* Monitor compliance performance through quality reviews, audits, KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis and management reporting, escalating material risks in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with the Cargo Sanctions and Crisis Manager, Legal, Security, Customs and other stakeholders on complex or sensitive matters.
* Provide functional leadership, coaching and operational direction to assigned resources; allocate work, monitor quality and progress, manage time-sensitive escalations and support capability development.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 5 years of job-related experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 4 years of job-related experience.
* Relevant experience should be in air cargo operations, international trade compliance, export controls, sanctions compliance, customs, logistics compliance or a related regulatory environment.
* A strong candidate will have at least six years of relevant experience, including supervisory, specialist or compliance-advisory responsibility.
* Professional certification in cargo systems, sanctions compliance and/or export controls is preferred

**Job Specific Skills**

* Strong knowledge of export-control regulations, dual-use, military and strategic goods, restricted commodities, end-use and end-user controls, and sanctions-related trade restrictions.
* Practical experience in restricted-party screening, false-positive resolution, potential-match escalation, due diligence and documented risk assessment.
* Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, workable operational controls and escalation procedures.
* Experience in compliance investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective-action management, audits, KPIs and management reporting.
* Demonstrated leadership, work-allocation, coaching, stakeholder-influencing and decision-making capability in a compliance or operational environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English, strong analytical and presentation skills, and proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of business-intelligence or data-analysis tools is preferred.

**About Qatar Airways Group**
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

title: Group Secretarial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**AEL Corporate Services (AEL CS):**
AEL Corporate Services plays a pivotal role in managing essential corporate functions such as finance, insurance, and secretarial services at a group level for all Adani business units. By centralizing these critical operations, AEL CS ensures efficiency, standardization, and strategic alignment across the conglomerate. Its expertise in risk management, governance, and financial stewardship supports the Group's dynamic growth while maintaining compliance with global standards. Through innovation and a commitment to excellence, AEL CS underpins the Adani Group’s vision of sustainable value creation and nation-building. 
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role is responsible for ensuring that unlisted companies within the business unit comply with all relevant corporate governance and regulatory requirements. This includes monitoring compliance thresholds, handling routine documentation, overseeing the statutory filings, and managing internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Compliance Monitoring for Unlisted Companies**

* Monitor unlisted entities within the company’s portfolio to ensure they comply with regulatory thresholds, such as the appointment of independent directors, if the company’s capital exceeds specific limits.
* Regularly review the Articles of Association (AOA) and Memorandum of Association (MOA) of unlisted subsidiaries to ensure they are up-to-date and in line with regulatory changes.
* Support in the development of governance frameworks for unlisted entities, ensuring that appropriate corporate governance measures are in place, including the establishment of key committees.

**Subsidiary Governance and Committees**

* Ensure subsidiaries have the required governance committees in place, such as the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee, and monitor their compliance with governance standards.
* Oversee the appointment of members to key committees such as the Audit Committee and ensure adherence to corporate governance standards across unlisted entities.

**Internal Audit and Compliance**

* Oversee the appointment of internal auditors, ensuring proper approvals are obtained and the correct internal audit processes are in place.
* Respond to queries related to the requirement for an internal auditor, ensuring compliance with corporate governance practices.
* Conduct regular compliance checks and audits to ensure that all legal and regulatory filings for unlisted companies are accurate and timely.

**Appointment and CSR Compliance**

* Monitor the company’s capital and profits to assess whether it meets the criteria requiring the appointment of a Managing Director (MD) or full-time executive director, and handle any exceptions as per legal provisions.
* Work with senior leadership to ensure any necessary appointments are made in compliance with the Companies Act and other regulatory requirements.
* Track compliance with regulations concerning the appointment of women directors, ensuring companies that meet the capital or profit thresholds appoint a woman director to their board.
* Coordinate with the Adani Foundation and other CSR partners to confirm contributions, ensuring they are in line with statutory obligations.
* Ensure CSR contributions are accurately reflected in the Directors' Report.
* Prepare and file the necessary CSR forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), ensuring timely and accurate submissions.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure all company filings are publicly available and accessible to shareholders, ensuring transparency and proper communication in line with regulatory requirements.
* Manage statutory reporting requirements for unlisted entities, including the preparation and submission of annual returns and financial statements.
* Coordinate with legal teams to ensure all subsidiary entities comply with relevant laws, including the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other statutory bodies.
* Provide guidance to the Board of Directors and senior management on matters related to corporate governance, legal compliance, and corporate strategy.
* Advise on changes in governance and compliance regulations, ensuring the company's processes are updated in line with legal and regulatory developments.
* Ensure that the unlisted companies have the balances in place, supporting their long-term sustainability and compliance with all relevant laws.

**Routine Documentation and Administrative Tasks**

* Accurately record and maintain minutes of board meetings, shareholders' meetings, and business meetings, ensuring that all decisions are properly documented and communicated.
* Ensure the timely update of statutory registers, including the Register of Directors and Register of Members, ensuring proper maintenance and accuracy.
* Provide Know Your Customer (KYC) documents when required, such as for the opening of bank accounts, and maintain records as needed for statutory purposes.
* File necessary forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), ensuring compliance with both event-based and periodic filing requirements.
* Manage shareholding changes, ensuring all necessary documentation, such as share transfer forms, is in place and all changes are communicated to the relevant stakeholders.
* Provide periodic information to statutory auditors to support their reviews and ensure proper compliance with corporate governance standards.
* Manage time and attendance signatures for directors and key personnel during board meetings or when required for statutory purposes.
* Respond to emails and inquiries promptly, ensuring effective and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate with practicing company secretaries for tasks that require collaboration and ensure efficient handling of all secretarial duties.
* Handle director payments, ensuring timely and accurate processing, particularly for the second phase of the payment cycle.
* Process payments for consultants, ensuring timely submission of invoices and proper approvals.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
**Internal Stakeholders**

* CSR Team
* Finance & Accounts (F&A) Team
* Legal Team
* Internal Audit Team
* Senior Management
* Adani Foundation

**External Stakeholders**

* Statutory Auditors
* Practicing Company Secretaries
* Regulatory Bodies (Registrar of Companies, SEBI, etc.)

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
Qualified Company Secretary (Associate or Fellow Member)
  
  
**Experience**
Minimum 2 years in handling secretarial and governance responsibilities for unlisted entities.
  
  
**Industry Preferred**
Background in the power and energy sector with strong knowledge of corporate law, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements for unlisted companies.

title: Deputy Manager - Risk & Compliance

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. Test and monitor operational controls.

Risk register management

title: Senior Client General Ledger Accountant
description:
**Job Title: Senior Client General Ledger Accountant - Financial Reporting**

**Experience:**
5-9 years

**Shift:**
Night Shift / US Time Zone

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Coimbatore

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior General Ledger Accountant with hands-on experience in preparing complete financial statements. The role will be responsible for end-to-end GL accounting, month-end and year-end closing, reconciliations, reporting, and audit support within a shared services environment.
 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Prepare monthly financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement.
* Perform month-end and year-end close activities within defined timelines.
* Prepare, review, and post journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and reclassifications.
* Maintain General Ledger accounts and ensure accurate period-end closing.
* Prepare account reconciliations, balance sheet schedules, and supporting documentation.
* Handle fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, and reconciliation.
* Perform intercompany accounting, confirmation, reconciliation, and elimination support.
* Conduct variance analysis and prepare management reports.
* Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, open items, and reconciliation issues.
* Support internal and external audits by providing schedules, reports, and required documentation.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, and audit requirements.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams and US finance stakeholders during close and reporting cycles.

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 5-9 years of experience in General Ledger accounting and financial reporting.
* Hands-on experience in preparing P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement.
* Strong knowledge of month-end/year-end close, journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and intercompany accounting.
* Experience with ERP systems and Advanced Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced night-shift environment.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - AXIS-ALFA - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, ALFA / INTEGRATE Modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff to join our Life Insurance actuarial Practice delivering AXI modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
As a Staff within the ALFA / INTEGRATE modelling Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  

* Good understanding of basics of US/Canada life product lines and regulatory standards; IFRS17/LDTI implementation experience would be ideal (optional)
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the liability cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Experience of working on a project that involves range of stakeholders.
* Hands-on or advance experience in actuarial ALFA / INTEGRATE valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 0-3 years of experience in ALFA / INTEGRATE modelling team or ALFA / INTEGRATE valuation / reporting / pricing experience in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to work in a systematic manner and produce accurate as well as review friendly work
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

• You are curious about how people think, how businesses work and how organisations evolve.

• You enjoy exploring questions rather than rushing towards easy answers.

•

• Use AI as an intelligent working partner for exploring ideas, interpreting information and developing insights.

• Strategic thinking and its practical application.

• Brand-centric thinking and Brand Constitution.

We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Airlock SSO/CIAM or similar product to join our operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Airlock SSO and CIAM solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, provide expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Airlock SSO/CIAM-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Configure and troubleshoot access issues, MFA methods, risk-based authentication rules, and user-profile issues.
* Diagnose complex authentication failures, service degradation, and system outages.
* Perform technical and change-impact analysis for platform, policy, and application changes.
* Maintain installation, configuration, deployment, patching, upgrades, and post-change validation.
* Maintain incident remediation, root-cause, prevention, and operational documentation.
* Monitor platform, directory infrastructure, backups, and integrations for potential issues.
* Develop and maintain SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Coordinate with technical teams, security leads, stakeholders, and product vendors.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to knowledge-management activities.
* Produce service-level reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for service improvement.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, ITIL processes, change controls, and documentation standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of overall Identity and Access Management experience, including strong hands-on experience with Airlock Access Management or similar.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* Advanced experience in Airlock SSO operations, configuration and troubleshooting,
* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience with one or more enterprise Access Management products such as Airlock, Okta, PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, Azure MFA, or RSA.
* Ability to manage authentication policies, selectors, sessions, identity profiles, protocol endpoints, OAuth scopes, client registration policies, grant mappings, token mappings, and OIDC policies.
* Experience with application onboarding, IdP configuration, patch/version upgrades, and production rollout.
* Good knowledge of authentication, authorization, provisioning, IAM, and core security concepts.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, or Unix operating-system internals and monitoring tools.
* Experience in ITIL-based service management and supporting sglobal or remote teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL or equivalent certification is preferred.
* CIAM, Microsoft Azure, or AWS certification or similar sssssis an advantage.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in shifts and provide on-call support as required.

title: Senior Manager-Finance Analytics/Corporate Finance- AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Wellness Consultant – International Client Relations & Bookings
description:
Wellness Consultant – International Client Relations & Bookings

**Company:** Cure & Wellness (A Datameris Venture)  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** Freshers to 1 year  
**Qualification:** MBA – Sales & Marketing (Preferred)  
**Industry:** Wellness Tourism | Healthcare | Medical Tourism | International Client Services

About Cure & Wellness

Cure & Wellness is an emerging global wellness platform connecting international and domestic clients with carefully selected Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy and holistic wellness centres.

Our mission is to make authentic, doctor-guided wellness experiences accessible, transparent, personalised and convenient for clients around the world.

We help clients discover suitable wellness programmes, connect with qualified doctors, explore wellness destinations and plan their wellness journeys with confidence.

We are building a customer-focused organisation that combines healthcare expertise, technology, exceptional service and international hospitality standards.

About the Role

We are looking for enthusiastic, articulate, confident and result-oriented MBA graduates specialising in Sales & Marketing to join our International Client Relations & Bookings team.

This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates and early-career professionals who aspire to build a career in international sales, customer relationship management and consultative selling.

As a Wellness Consultant, you will be responsible for engaging with prospective domestic and international clients, understanding their wellness requirements, coordinating consultations with doctors and converting qualified enquiries into confirmed wellness bookings.

We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls or follows scripts. We need individuals with strong English communication skills, a proactive mindset, a willingness to learn and the confidence to engage with customers from different countries and cultures.

Key Responsibilities1. International Client Engagement & Lead Qualification

* Respond professionally to customer enquiries received through websites, WhatsApp, email, phone calls and marketing campaigns.
* Communicate confidently with prospective clients from Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia and other international markets.
* Understand customer requirements, wellness interests, budget preferences and travel expectations.
* Identify potential customers and qualify enquiries based on their booking intent.
* Build trust and maintain positive customer relationships from the first interaction.
* Communicate effectively across different cultures and international time zones.

2. Doctor Consultation Coordination

* Explain the company's doctor-guided wellness consultation process.
* Encourage qualified prospects to schedule consultations with our doctors.
* Coordinate doctor availability and schedule appointments.
* Send appointment confirmations, reminders and pre-consultation instructions.
* Follow up with clients regarding scheduled consultations and missed appointments.
* Coordinate customer information and requirements with the medical team.

3. Customer Engagement & Sales Conversion

* Follow up with prospective clients after doctor consultations.
* Present doctor-approved wellness programmes and suitable wellness centres.
* Explain programme inclusions, duration, pricing, accommodation and booking procedures.
* Address customer questions and concerns relating to pricing, travel, trust and programme suitability.
* Develop professional sales conversations and handle objections effectively.
* Assist customers through booking confirmation and payment procedures.
* Work towards achieving individual sales and booking conversion targets.

4. CRM Management & Follow-up

* Maintain accurate customer records in Zoho CRM.
* Record customer interactions, preferences, enquiries and follow-up activities.
* Follow structured follow-up schedules through calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Ensure every qualified lead has a defined next action.
* Re-engage interested customers who have not yet confirmed their bookings.
* Maintain proper sales pipeline records and share regular updates with the reporting manager.

5. International Customer Experience

* Deliver a professional and personalised customer experience.
* Communicate politely and confidently with international customers.
* Coordinate with doctors, wellness centres and internal operations teams.
* Assist customers with general enquiries relating to accommodation, travel, airport transfers and other approved services.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the customer enquiry and booking journey.

Candidate RequirementsEssential Qualifications & Skills

* MBA graduates specialising in **Sales & Marketing** are preferred.
* Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of experience can apply.
* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills are mandatory.
* Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in handling customer conversations.
* Interest in international sales, customer relationship management and business development.
* Basic understanding of sales, marketing, lead generation and customer conversion.
* Good listening, presentation and persuasion skills.
* Strong follow-up discipline and organisational abilities.
* Willingness to learn about wellness tourism, Ayurveda and international customer services.
* Ability to work with targets and performance-based responsibilities.
* Willingness to work flexible schedules to accommodate international time zones.

Highly Preferred

* MBA in Sales & Marketing or related specialisation.
* Internship or academic project experience in sales, marketing, business development or customer relationship management.
* Familiarity with Zoho CRM, MS Excel, WhatsApp Business and email communication.
* Exposure to international customers through internships, projects or previous employment.
* Additional language proficiency, particularly German or French, will be an advantage.
* Interest in healthcare, wellness tourism, hospitality or international travel.

What We Value Most

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

* **Communication Excellence:** Confidence in speaking and writing professional English.
* **Sales Mindset:** Genuine interest in converting customer enquiries into successful bookings.
* **Learning Agility:** Willingness to understand our services, products and international markets.
* **Customer Empathy:** Ability to understand customer needs and build lasting relationships.
* **Ownership:** Taking responsibility for every assigned enquiry and follow-up.
* **Persuasion Skills:** Ability to communicate value and handle customer objections professionally.
* **Execution Discipline:** Maintaining accurate CRM records and completing assigned activities.

Important Role Boundaries

The Wellness Consultant will handle customer engagement, commercial discussions, consultation coordination and booking conversion.

Medical assessments, diagnoses, treatment recommendations and clinical decisions will remain exclusively with qualified doctors.

The consultant must communicate only doctor-approved recommendations and must never independently provide medical advice, promise treatment outcomes or pressure customers into unsuitable programmes.

Customer privacy and responsible handling of personal and medical information are essential.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to build a career in international sales and wellness tourism.
* Direct exposure to international customers and premium wellness brands.
* Structured learning and on-the-job training.
* Exposure to consultative selling, international customer relationship management and booking operations.
* A collaborative working environment with doctors, marketing professionals and wellness industry experts.
* Career growth opportunities in International Sales, Business Development and Customer Relationship Management.
* Competitive fixed compensation with performance-linked incentives.

Who Should Apply?

We welcome MBA graduates specialising in Sales & Marketing who have excellent English communication skills, a confident personality and a genuine interest in building a career in international sales.

If you enjoy interacting with people, are comfortable communicating with international customers and have the ambition to develop into a successful sales professional, this opportunity is for you.

**Join Cure & Wellness and help people around the world discover personalised, authentic wellness experiences.**

**Application Requirements:**

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with a brief introduction highlighting their communication skills, academic projects, internships or any relevant sales and customer engagement experience.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
