title: EYP-Senior-Business Valuations
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY- Strategy and Transactions (SaT) – Valuation, Modelling & Economics (VME) – Business Valuations – Senior**
**Role Overview**
The Senior – Business Valuation role sits within EY’s Strategy and Transactions (SaT) – Valuation, Modelling & Economics (VME) practice. The role is execution‑focused, with primary responsibility for hands‑on valuation of complex financial instruments and portfolio investments, in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
  
  
The Senior will support financial reporting, portfolio valuation, transaction‑related, and audit‑assist engagements, while also contributing to team development, internal reviews, and delivery quality. The role involves technical client interaction and close collaboration with Managers and Senior Managers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands**
**‑**
**on Valuation Execution**

* Independently perform fair value measurement of complex financial instruments and portfolio investments, primarily for IFRS financial reporting purposes.
* Develop, review, and maintain detailed valuation models using advanced quantitative techniques, including:
* Option pricing models (Black‑Scholes, binomial / lattice models)
* Monte Carlo simulation techniques
* Discounted cash flow and scenario‑based models, apply advanced financial engineering, econometric, and statistical techniques to address complex valuation challenges.

**Execute valuations for a broad range of complex securities, including:**

* Share‑based payment awards (equity‑settled and cash‑settled awards, market and non‑market vesting conditions) under IFRS 2.
* Convertible instruments, SAFEs, and preferred equity with complex rights.
* Derivatives (equity, interest rate, commodity, credit), warrants, and embedded derivatives
* Contingent consideration, structured and hybrid instruments.
* Structured and hybrid instruments with multiple valuation components.
* Apply appropriate valuation methodologies in line with IFRS 13 – Fair Value Measurement, including assessment of the fair value hierarchy and use of observable and unobservable inputs.

**Perform portfolio valuations for private equity, venture capital, and asset management clients, including:**

* Equity investments across complex capital structures
* Private debt and structured credit portfolio
* Hybrid instruments and multi‑layer capital structures
* Apply appropriate valuation methodologies including DCF, market approach, OPM, PWERM, and scenario-based models in line with IFRS 13 – Fair Value Measurement.

**Financial Reporting & IFRS Compliance**

* Support valuation engagements for statutory and financial reporting purposes, ensuring compliance with relevant IFRS standards (including IFRS 2, IFRS 9 / IAS 32, IFRS 13, and IFRS 3, as applicable).
* Prepare clear, well‑structured valuation reports, working papers, and technical memoranda suitable for audit review.
* Ensure valuation assumptions, methodologies, and conclusions are robust, internally consistent, and aligned with EY quality standards and professional valuation practices.
* Stay current on updates to IFRS guidance, valuation methodologies, and market practices relevant to complex securities.

**Audit Support & Valuation Review**

* Act as a key audit‑assist resource, supporting EY Assurance teams and external auditors by explaining valuation methodologies, assumptions, and conclusions.
* Respond effectively to audit and internal review comments, updating models or documentation where required.
* Participate in internal valuation reviews, assessing work prepared by junior team members to ensure accuracy, robustness, and IFRS compliance.
* Support Managers and Senior Managers in ensuring valuation conclusions are defensible and audit‑ready.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Supervise, coach, and mentor junior team members, providing guidance on valuation concepts, modelling techniques, and IFRS requirements.
* Review work prepared by analysts and seniors‑in‑training, providing clear and constructive feedback.

title: US Senior Accountant
description:
**Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Accountant with strong US accounting expertise to join our growing team in Kochi. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the complete accounting cycle, ensuring accurate financial records, timely reporting, and effective financial controls.

This role is ideal for a professional who can independently handle accounting operations from transaction recording through month-end and year-end closing and finalization of accounts. The candidate should have a strong understanding of US accounting practices, excellent analytical abilities, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving accounting discrepancies.

**2. Financial Reporting and Account Finalization**

* Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.

**3. US Accounting and Compliance**

* Apply knowledge of US accounting principles and applicable financial reporting requirements.
* Ensure accounting records are maintained in accordance with relevant accounting standards and internal policies.
* Support audit requirements by maintaining organized financial documentation and providing necessary schedules.

* Experience with month-end and year-end closing, general ledger management, and account reconciliations.

* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, including financial data analysis and reconciliation.

title: Growth Manager
description:
As the
**Growth Manager**
, your mission is to drive measurable business growth by turning SEO opportunities, product features, market gaps, customer pain points, and conversion insights into clear growth initiatives for MENU TIGER, our QR-powered digital menu and online ordering software for restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels, and other food and beverage businesses. Your work will increase qualified traffic, signups, activations, conversions, and revenue.

You will be responsible for planning and executing growth initiatives across SEO, product-led marketing, landing pages, conversion optimization, content strategy, AI search visibility, partnerships, and growth experiments. This role requires someone who is both strategic and highly execution-driven, with strong expertise in digital growth, user journeys, search intent, conversion funnels, analytics, and the evolving landscape of AI-driven search. While this role is focused on MENU TIGER, you may also support growth initiatives for other QRTiger Pte. Ltd. products as business needs evolve.

You will collaborate with SEO, content, design, development, product, sales, and customer-facing teams to develop, improve, and implement growth initiatives that are practical, measurable, and scalable. Your ability to move quickly, prioritize high-impact opportunities, and turn ideas into results will play an important role in supporting long-term business growth.

**What You’ll Do:**

**1. Growth Strategy & Execution**

* Build and execute growth strategies across SEO, AI search, content, landing pages, free tools, product-led marketing, email, partnerships, and conversion funnels.
* Turn business goals into clear growth roadmaps with weekly, monthly, and quarterly priorities.
* Identify the strongest opportunities to increase qualified traffic, signups, activations, conversions, and revenue.
* Prioritize growth projects based on impact, effort, speed, and business value.
* Create structured systems for tracking campaigns, experiments, deadlines, performance, and learnings.
* Use AI tools to speed up research, content production, experimentation, analysis, and reporting.

**2. Product-Led Growth & Landing Pages**

* Create and launch product-led growth pages such as free tools, QR menu generators, menu templates, calculators, comparison pages, restaurant industry pages (cafés, bars, hotels, food trucks, cloud kitchens), and feature landing pages.
* Build landing pages that solve specific search intent and move users toward signup, trial, activation, or purchase.
* Identify high-intent use cases where users want to take action immediately, not just consume information.
* Improve user journeys from first visit to signup, trial, activation, and paid conversion.
* Review landing page structure, messaging, CTAs, trust signals, pricing sections, FAQs, and conversion paths.
* Work with designers and developers to launch pages and tools that are clear, persuasive, technically sound, and conversion-focused.
* Ensure every important landing page has a clear business goal and measurable outcome.

**3. SEO, Organic Growth & AI Search Visibility**

* Work with the SEO team to identify keyword opportunities that can drive qualified business growth.
* Recommend SEO priorities based on commercial value, search intent, conversion potential, and ranking difficulty.
* Support the creation and improvement of high-intent SEO pages such as tool pages, industry pages, comparison pages, template pages, and how-to guides.
* Analyze competitors to understand what pages, keywords, offers, and content formats are driving their growth.
* Improve existing pages for stronger rankings, CTR, conversion, internal linking, and topical authority.
* Build strategies that improve visibility across AI search engines and answer platforms.
* Identify which pages and content formats are most likely to be cited by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Bing Copilot, and other AI platforms.
* Work with SEO and content teams to improve brand authority, entity clarity, trust signals, and citation potential.
* Track how the brand appears across AI search results and competitor comparisons, and recommend ways to improve visibility.

**4. Conversion Optimization & Growth Experiments**

* Build and manage a pipeline of growth experiments across landing pages, free tools, pricing angles, content formats, email flows, onboarding paths, and acquisition channels.
* Define the hypothesis, expected impact, required effort, success metric, responsible team, deadline, and next action for each experiment.
* Run structured tests on headlines, CTAs, page layouts, forms, tool flows, signup funnels, and conversion journeys.
* Analyze experiment results and decide whether to scale, refine, or stop each initiative.
* Use real data such as conversion rate, scroll depth, bounce rate, CTA clicks, signups, activation, and revenue to improve performance.
* Document learnings clearly so the company can improve faster over time.
* Move quickly while maintaining quality, user trust, and brand consistency.

**5. Content & Campaign Development**

* Work with content teams to create growth-focused content calendars and campaigns.
* Identify topics that support SEO performance, AI visibility, product adoption, and conversion.
* Develop or contribute to content briefs for high-impact content such as guides, comparison pages, tool pages, industry pages, templates, and case studies.
* Ensure content is not only informative, but also connected to product use cases, user intent, and business goals.
* Turn product features, customer pain points, and use cases into campaigns that generate awareness, traffic, leads, and signups.
* Repurpose strong content into emails, sales materials, landing pages, social content, and outreach assets where relevant.

**6. Analytics, Reporting & Growth Decisions**

* Track key growth metrics across acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue.
* Build dashboards and reports that clearly show what is working, what is not, and what should happen next.
* Analyze traffic, rankings, signups, conversion rates, activation rates, customer acquisition cost, revenue impact, and campaign ROI.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks and prioritize the highest-impact opportunities for improvement.
* Report growth progress clearly to leadership and relevant teams.
* Turn complex data into practical decisions, action points, and next steps.

**7. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution**

* Work closely with SEO specialists to execute keyword and organic growth opportunities.
* Work with content teams to create pages and assets that support both traffic and conversions.
* Work with developers to build free tools, landing pages, tracking systems, and product-led growth features.
* Work with designers to improve page clarity, trust, user experience, and conversion flow.
* Work with sales, customer support, and product teams to understand restaurant owners' objections, use cases, buying triggers, onboarding gaps, and retention opportunities.
* Provide growth guidance throughout execution to keep initiatives on track and aligned with business goals.

**8. Compliance, Messaging & Trust Positioning**

* Ensure growth messaging is accurate, trustworthy, and aligned with platform rules and industry expectations.
* Avoid exaggerated claims, misleading wording, risky promises, or tactics that could damage long-term trust.
* Review landing page copy, product claims, and campaign messaging for clarity, credibility, and safety.
* Build growth campaigns around authentic value, real customer use cases, and sustainable positioning.
* Ensure acquisition strategies support long-term brand authority, not just short-term traffic gains.

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years in growth, SEO, product, or performance marketing
* Proven landing page, funnel, and experimentation results
* Strong grasp of SEO, GEO, AEO, and analytics
* SaaS, restaurant tech, or F&B experience preferred

**Nice to Have**

* AI tools in marketing workflows and AI citation tracking
* Launching free tools, generators, or templates
* GA, Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, Hotjar/Clarity
* A/B testing, email, paid ads, or partnerships

**What You’ll Get:**

* Competitive salary and opportunities for professional growth.
* A collaborative work environment where your input shapes the future of a growing company.
* Individualized employee experience with regular feedback meetings.
* A supportive team culture with short decision-making processes.
* Join an international team passionate about their work.

**Who We Are**

MENU TIGER is a product of QRTiger Pte. Ltd., the company behind QR TIGER, the most advanced yet most affordable online QR code generator for businesses of all sizes. MENU TIGER helps restaurants and food businesses go digital with interactive QR menus, online ordering, and a customizable restaurant website. Our software enhances products and services with a digital dimension, offering a customizable and user-friendly platform.

**Interested in joining our team?**

Send your CV to kate.pmqrtiger@gmail.com

title: Organic Growth Lead (SEO & AI Search)
description:
**Organic Growth Lead**

Multipolitan is hiring an Organic Growth Lead to turn our website into a consistent source of qualified client inquiries. Your primary goal is to help individuals and families exploring residency or citizenship find Multipolitan Private, understand their options, and book a consultation with the right adviser.

You’ll own the journey from the first question someone asks on Google, an AI assistant, or Reddit to the action they take on our website. You’ll also help grow the Multipolitan App by turning interest in practical travel tools, such as a calculator for tracking days spent abroad, into sign-ups.

**What you’ll own**

* **Website conversion.**
  Find out which pages generate qualified inquiries and where prospective clients drop off. Test landing pages, calls to action, and inquiry forms. Work with our advisers to understand which inquiries become consultations and paying clients, then use that feedback to improve the website.
* **Organic search and AI visibility.**
  Identify the questions people ask when they’re seriously considering a move. Build pages that answer those questions and offer a relevant next step. A founder researching a move to Singapore should be able to understand the available pathways and reach an adviser directly from that page.
* **Content that supports decisions.**
  Work with our advisers and researchers to publish country guides, side-by-side comparisons, and answers to recurring client questions. Prioritize the topics that bring prospective clients into conversations with our team, and keep those pages current as rules change.
* **Local search and communities.**
  Improve how eligible Multipolitan offices appear on Google Maps and Search. Participate openly as Multipolitan in relevant Reddit and relocation communities, and use the questions people raise to identify gaps on our website.
* **App sign-ups.**
  Give visitors who come to the website for an everyday travel need a clear reason to try the app. Test tools such as a free days-abroad calculator and measure how many users go on to sign up.

**How we’ll measure success**

Your main measure of success is
**the number of qualified consultations the website generates for Multipolitan Private**
. You’ll track which channels and pages bring those clients in, what share of inquiries become consultations, and how many consultations become paying engagements. For the app, you’ll track sign-ups from organic channels and the share of tool users who sign up.

title: Performance Marketing Lead
description:
**Job Description – Performance Marketing Lead**

**Company:**
BrandStory Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Position:**
Performance Marketing Lead / Head of Performance Marketing

**Experience:**
10–12 Years

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Reporting To:**
CEO

**Role Overview**

BrandStory is looking for a highly experienced, commercially driven
**Performance Marketing Lead**
to own and scale paid media operations across Meta, Google, YouTube, ChatGPT Ads, and emerging AI-powered advertising platforms.

The ideal candidate is a performance marketing specialist who combines deep platform expertise, analytical thinking, campaign execution, team leadership, and strong business acumen.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring ownership of campaign strategy, media budgets, client performance, team productivity, revenue growth, and profitability.

The candidate must be capable of managing large advertising budgets, driving measurable business outcomes, and building a high-performing paid media practice within the agency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Performance Marketing Strategy & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end performance marketing strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, and emerging AI advertising ecosystems, including ChatGPT Ads where available.
* Develop full-funnel advertising strategies covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, customer acquisition, and retention.
* Manage campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, Demand Gen, Video, and Paid Social.
* Build audience segmentation, retargeting, remarketing, and lookalike strategies.
* Drive campaign experimentation through creative testing, landing page optimization, audience testing, and bidding strategies.
* Develop scalable acquisition frameworks for B2B, B2C, D2C, e-commerce, real estate, and enterprise clients.

**2. Platform Expertise & Emerging Advertising Channels**

**Meta Ads**

* Advanced expertise in Facebook and Instagram advertising, Advantage+ campaigns, Conversions API, catalog ads, and automated campaign optimization.
* Strong understanding of creative fatigue, audience saturation, attribution, and scaling strategies.

**Google Ads**

* Expert-level knowledge of Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, and Demand Gen.
* Strong understanding of bidding algorithms, Quality Score, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center.

**YouTube Ads**

* Develop YouTube performance strategies covering video action campaigns, demand generation, audience targeting, and video-led conversions.
* Optimize video advertising for view-through conversions, qualified traffic, and acquisition efficiency.

**ChatGPT Ads & AI Advertising**

* Track and evaluate advertising opportunities across ChatGPT and emerging conversational AI platforms.
* Build testing and measurement frameworks for new AI-native advertising formats as they become available.
* Understand how AI-assisted discovery and conversational search influence paid acquisition.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI into campaign planning, creative experimentation, reporting, and optimization.

**3. Business Performance & Revenue Accountability**

* Own campaign performance against client-defined business objectives.
* Drive improvements in ROAS, ROI, CAC, CPL, CPA, conversion rates, and lead quality.
* Establish forecasting models for advertising spends, conversions, and acquisition costs.
* Work closely with client sales teams to connect marketing performance with actual revenue outcomes.
* Develop budget allocation strategies across channels based on incremental business contribution.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and performance marketing retainers.

**4. Team Leadership & Agency Operations**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of performance marketing managers, media buyers, analysts, and campaign executives.
* Establish campaign planning, launch, monitoring, optimization, and reporting SOPs.
* Build standardized account audit frameworks, quality checks, and escalation mechanisms.
* Manage team utilization, resource allocation, delivery timelines, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure campaigns are executed accurately, with strong budget controls and platform compliance.
* Build internal capabilities through training, certifications, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

**5. Analytics, Attribution & Marketing Technology**

* Demonstrate advanced working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.
* Implement robust campaign measurement frameworks across platforms.
* Understand CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, and server-side tracking.
* Build dashboards that connect advertising expenditure to qualified leads, pipeline, and revenue.
* Use attribution models and incrementality testing to evaluate channel contribution.
* Identify tracking discrepancies and resolve measurement issues proactively.

**6. Client Leadership & Strategic Consulting**

* Act as a senior performance marketing advisor to CMOs, marketing heads, founders, and business leaders.
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with clear insights, recommendations, and growth opportunities.
* Translate campaign data into actionable commercial decisions.
* Participate in new business pitches, account audits, and performance marketing proposals.
* Collaborate with creative, content, SEO, technology, and strategy teams to deliver integrated marketing outcomes.
* Take ownership of client satisfaction, account retention, and performance delivery.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in performance marketing, preferably with significant experience in a digital marketing agency.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience leading teams and managing multiple client accounts.
* Demonstrated experience managing substantial monthly advertising budgets across multiple industries.
* Expert-level knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube advertising, and Google Analytics.
* Strong understanding of paid media attribution, conversion optimization, and marketing automation.
* Experience with AI-enabled campaign management and emerging advertising technologies.
* Proven ability to scale campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency.
* Strong financial understanding of media budgets, campaign profitability, and agency commercials.
* Excellent presentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and client communication skills.
* Google Ads and Meta certifications preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Campaign Performance**

* Achievement of client-specific ROAS, CAC, CPL, CPA, and conversion targets.
* Month-on-month improvement in campaign efficiency and qualified lead generation.
* Budget pacing accuracy and minimization of wasted advertising spend.
* Improvement in landing page conversion rates and funnel performance.

**Client & Business Growth**

* Client retention and satisfaction across performance marketing accounts.
* Revenue growth from existing performance marketing clients.
* Contribution to new client acquisition through pitches and strategic proposals.
* Achievement of agreed performance marketing practice revenue and gross margin targets.

**Operational Excellence**

* 100% campaign tracking and measurement readiness before launch.
* Timely campaign launches, optimizations, and client reporting.
* Adherence to campaign QA standards and budget governance.
* Team utilization, productivity, and delivery profitability.
* Reduction in recurring campaign errors and operational escalations.

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Regular implementation of AI-powered optimization and automation workflows.
* Development of new advertising capabilities, including conversational AI advertising.
* Continuous testing of emerging channels and advertising formats.
* Team certifications, training, and capability development.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who only manages advertising campaigns.

We are looking for a
**performance marketing leader who understands business growth, owns outcomes, and can build a scalable, profitable performance marketing practice.**

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable:

* Optimizing a high-spend Google or Meta campaign.
* Diagnosing why leads are not converting into sales.
* Presenting growth strategies to a CEO or CMO.
* Leading and mentoring a team of media specialists.
* Building new revenue opportunities for the agency.
* Experimenting with AI-led advertising and next-generation acquisition channels.

**The ultimate expectation:**
Build BrandStory's performance marketing practice into a high-performing, commercially accountable growth engine that delivers measurable results for clients and sustainable revenue for the agency.

title: Associate Director – Performance Marketing
description:

Bengaluru

title: SEO Content Strategist – On-Page SEO & AEO
description:
Hashtag Socials is an SEO-focused digital marketing agency specializing in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), website optimization and organic growth strategies.

We work with businesses across industries to improve their online visibility, organic search rankings, website traffic and lead generation.

We are looking for a highly skilled
**SEO Content Strategist**
who understands the relationship between content, search intent, website structure and organic rankings.

This is not a conventional content writing role. We need someone who can independently plan, strategize and execute SEO-driven content initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. On-Page SEO**

* Conduct keyword research and identify primary, secondary and semantic keywords.
* Optimize website pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs and internal linking.
* Understand search intent and create content structures that align with Google's ranking requirements.
* Perform content audits and identify optimization opportunities.
* Optimize existing website content to improve organic rankings.

**2. SEO Blog Writing & Content Strategy**

* Research, plan and write high-quality, SEO-optimized blogs and articles.
* Develop monthly content calendars and blog strategies.
* Create content briefs based on keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Ensure content is informative, engaging, original and aligned with SEO best practices.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve topical authority.

**3. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & AI Search**

* Develop content strategies for AI-driven search platforms and answer engines.
* Optimize website content for featured snippets, People Also Ask and conversational search queries.
* Understand structured content, FAQs, entity optimization and topical relevance.
* Stay updated with developments in AI search, Google AI Overviews and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

**4. Website Content Planning & Wireframing**

* Plan website page structures and SEO-focused content wireframes.
* Develop page layouts and content hierarchies based on keyword intent and conversion goals.
* Prepare website content briefs for designers and developers.
* Understand how content placement, headings, CTAs and internal links influence SEO and user experience.

**5. SEO Research & Analysis**

* Conduct competitor content analysis.
* Work with tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs and other SEO tools.
* Monitor keyword performance and identify content improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with SEO strategists, designers and developers to execute content recommendations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in SEO content writing and on-page SEO.
* Strong understanding of Google's ranking factors and SEO best practices.
* Excellent English writing, editing and proofreading skills.
* Practical experience in keyword research and content optimization.
* Strong understanding of AEO, AI search and evolving SEO trends.
* Ability to plan website content structures and SEO wireframes.
* Familiarity with WordPress and SEO plugins such as Rank Math or Yoast.
* Experience using SEMrush, Ahrefs and Google Search Console.
* Ability to independently manage multiple client projects and content deliverables.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have a strong SEO mindset rather than just writing skills.
* Can think strategically about how content contributes to rankings and leads.
* Understand the difference between writing content and writing content that ranks.
* Can independently plan website pages, blogs and content strategies.
* Are proactive, detail-oriented and eager to learn emerging SEO practices.

Job Details

* **Position:**
  SEO Content Strategist – On-Page SEO & AEO
* **Experience:**
  2–4 Years
* **Salary:**
  ₹5–6 LPA (depending on skills and experience)
* **Location:**
  Rajajinagar, Bengaluru
* **Work Mode:**
  Full-time, Work from Office
* **Employment Type:**
  Permanent

**Important:**
Candidates should be comfortable commuting to our office in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Content Specialist – Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, with regular availability during Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$12,000 annually
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to create and publish marketing content for residential properties.
  
  
You will turn property details, photographs, and video clips into attractive online listings, edited images, virtually furnished rooms, and short property videos.
  
  
This is a hands-on content-production role—not a senior marketing-strategy or paid-advertising position. You must be creative, organized, comfortable using AI tools, and able to manage multiple properties without allowing information to become inaccurate or outdated.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Identify the strongest selling points of each property.
* Write clear and engaging property titles and descriptions.
* Create and publish listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
* Adapt content to meet each platform’s format and requirements.
* Select and organize the strongest property photographs.
* Complete light photo editing, including cropping, lighting improvements, resizing, and appropriate AI-assisted cleanup.
* Use AI tools to remove temporary clutter from property photographs when appropriate.
* Virtually furnish or stage photographs of empty rooms using AI tools.
* Create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
* Create AI-assisted videos using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers when required.
* Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, HeyGen, and comparable AI image or video platforms.
* Review AI-generated content and correct visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors.
* Update prices, availability, photographs, and property information promptly.
* Remove or update listings when properties are no longer available.
* Keep an accurate record of every active listing and its current status.
* Manage competing deadlines and prioritize urgent corrections.
* Respond professionally to creative feedback and complete revisions promptly.
* Coordinate with the leasing team when information or materials are missing.

AI and editing tools may be used to improve presentation, but content must remain accurate. Permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities must never be changed or misrepresented.
  
  
What You’ll Need
  
  

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable role.
* Candidates with less experience may be considered if they provide a strong portfolio.
* Experience creating online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s most attractive selling points.
* Experience using Canva, CapCut, or comparable design and video-editing tools.
* Experience using AI tools for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging.
* Experience using HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool.
* Good creative and visual judgment.
* Strong attention to detail and information accuracy.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, and deadline management.
* Ability to manage several properties and content requests at the same time.
* Ability to receive feedback without becoming defensive and revise work promptly.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment.
* Availability to work full-time with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours.

Experience with residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not mandatory.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is preferred but, not required. Demonstrated skill, relevant experience, and the quality of your portfolio are more important.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is both creative and highly organized.
  
  
You should be comfortable improving imperfect source material, choosing the best way to present a property, learning new AI tools, and managing repetitive work without sacrificing quality.
  
  
You must know the difference between improving the presentation of a property and creating content that could mislead a renter.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of at least two of the following:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

Ensure the portfolio link does not require a password or access request.
  
  
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

title: Senior SEO Strategist
description:
**Experience:**
4+ years |
**Location:**
Remote (India) | Reports to: Founder & CEO

**About The Dare Network**

A growth marketing agency working with D2C and B2B brands across India, the GCC, the UK and the US. We run performance marketing, SEO, web development and content. We're a fully remote team of about 23 people.

**About the role**

You'll lead our SEO team (2 strategists, 2 content writers) and personally own 3 to 4 client accounts end to end: strategy, execution, client conversations, reporting and results. You already know what good SEO looks like and can run it without supervision. If you need someone to tell you whether to prioritise a technical fix or a content gap, this role isn't for you.

**What you'll own**

***Your accounts***

* Build a rolling 3-month SEO plan for each account, updated monthly
* Set keyword, content, technical and link-building priorities
* Set realistic KPIs and timelines. No inflated promises to clients.
* Run technical audits (Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs or SEMrush)
* On-page optimisation, internal linking, schema
* Work with our dev team on technical fixes (WordPress, Shopify)
* Plan and run AEO/GEO work so clients get cited in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
* Set up and maintain tracking: GA4, GSC, dashboards

***The team***

* Review strategists' plans and reports before they go to clients
* Brief content writers and QA everything before it's published
* Own the SEO process: SOPs, report templates, QA checklists
* Find ways to automate repetitive SEO work with AI, and get the team using them

***Clients***

* Lead bi-weekly client calls for your accounts
* Monthly reports delivered by the 3rd: what happened, work done, blockers, learnings, next month's plan
* Handle questions, escalations and slow results honestly, without pulling in the founder for routine issues

**Must-haves**

* 4+ years in SEO, ideally at an agency managing several clients at once
* Hands-on across technical, on-page, content and off-page SEO
* Experience with both D2C and B2B clients
* Strong with Ahrefs or SEMrush, GSC, GA4 and Screaming Frog
* Comfortable with SEO on both WordPress and Shopify
* Real AEO/GEO work you can show us, not just theory
* Uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) in research, briefs and audits, and can show how
* Proof of results: rankings, traffic, leads or revenue, with your specific role made clear
* Strong written English and confident on calls. Our clients are founders and CMOs.

**Nice-to-haves**

* B2B manufacturing or industrial SEO
* International SEO (GCC, UK, US)
* Digital PR or link-building partnerships
* Has led or mentored junior SEOs

**What success looks like**

* **30 days:**
  Onboarded on your accounts, audited each one, flagged the real gaps, met every client
* **60 days:**
  Plans in place for every account, team reports standardised and going out on time
* **90 days:**
  Visible movement on at least 2 accounts. Founder no longer involved in day-to-day SEO.

**How we work**

* You own the account. If something slips, we hear it from you before the client does.
* Reports tell the truth. No hiding behind impressions or vanity rankings.

**How to apply**

Email your CV and 2 to 3 short case studies (one page each is fine) to
***careers@thedarenetwork.com***
. Subject line:
**"SEO Lead, [Your Name]"**

In your email, pick one website you've worked on and tell us the single highest-impact SEO change you'd make to it next, and why. 3 to 4 lines. Applications without this won't be reviewed.

title: Marketing Operations Analyst
description:
**Role Description**
**Why Join 7-Eleven Global Solution Center?**
When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end-to-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.
  
  
**Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?**
7-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.
  
  
At 7-Eleven we are guided by our
**Leadership Principles**
. Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.
  
  

* Be Customer Obsessed
* Be Courageous with Your Point of View
* Challenge the Status Quo
* Act Like an Entrepreneur

title: Senior AEO & SEO Strategist
description:
Role: Senior AEO & SEO Strategist

Location: Pan India

Experience:
**5 to 9 years**

Immediate Joiners Only

JD:

**Senior AEO & SEO Strategist**

**Job Description & Required Skills**

**ROLE LEVEL**

**PRIMARY DISCIPLINES**

**OPERATING SCOPE**

**Senior Individual Contributor**

**AEO, SEO, Content, Technical**

**Global / Enterprise**

**Position Summary**

**The Senior AEO & SEO Strategist is responsible for improving how brands are discovered, understood, cited, and recommended across traditional search engines and AI-powered answer platforms.**

**This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, structured data, analytics, and AI visibility optimization. The ideal candidate understands that AEO and SEO are not separate disciplines, but interconnected parts of a single search and discovery ecosystem.**

**The strategist will use the AEO Intelligence Platform to measure demand, evaluate brand visibility, identify content and technical gaps, generate prioritized recommendations, and support deployment. They must also understand the broader AEO and SEO platform landscape and be able to validate findings through analytics, crawling, keyword research, and AI visibility tools.**

**This person will work across global markets, websites, content teams, developers, UX teams, analytics teams, and client stakeholders to create scalable AEO and SEO programs.**

**Core Responsibilities**

**AEO Strategy and Intelligence**

**Use the AEO Intelligence Platform to measure AI demand, brand mentions, citations, recommendation frequency, competitive visibility, and query-level performance.**

**Build query frameworks across research, problem-solution, purchase-intent, service, expertise, value, and location-based search behaviors.**

**Identify why brands, products, services, or locations are not being surfaced by ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Claude, and other AI platforms.**

**Translate platform findings into clear content, technical, data, and authority-building recommendations.**

**Evaluate how AI engines understand a brand’s products, services, differentiators, expertise, pricing, availability, and trust signals.**

**Monitor changes in AI discovery, answer-engine behavior, agentic commerce, AI shopping, and emerging search experiences.**

**Technical AEO and SEO**

**Conduct technical audits across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, canonicalization, redirects, metadata, page templates, JavaScript, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.**

**Evaluate whether important content is accessible and understandable to both search crawlers and AI systems.**

**Develop structured-data strategies using Organization, Product, Offer, Service, LocalBusiness, Article, FAQ, Review, Breadcrumb, and other relevant schema types.**

**Review JSON-LD implementation, entity relationships, product attributes, taxonomy, and machine-readable content.**

**Identify technical issues that limit AI retrieval, citation eligibility, search visibility, or content comprehension.**

**Partner with developers to define implementation requirements, acceptance criteria, quality-assurance processes, and validation plans.**

**Support migrations, redesigns, platform changes, and website launches while protecting both SEO equity and AI visibility.**

**Content AEO and SEO**

**Develop content strategies that directly answer customer questions throughout the discovery and decision journey.**

**Identify gaps in comparison content, buying guides, educational resources, product information, service expertise, local content, and problem-solution content.**

**Improve answer readiness by strengthening headings, summaries, definitions, supporting evidence, product details, trust signals, and contextual internal links.**

**Create content briefs that combine search demand, AI query behavior, customer intent, competitive gaps, and business priorities.**

**Ensure content clearly communicates brand differentiators, product benefits, materials, specifications, pricing, availability, warranties, expertise, and proof points.**

**Balance content designed for AI retrieval with user experience, brand voice, conversion performance, and traditional organic search requirements.**

**Establish scalable content standards across markets, languages, business units, categories, and website templates.**

**Integrated AEO and SEO Planning**

**Create unified AEO and SEO roadmaps rather than treating the disciplines as separate workstreams.**

**Identify shared deliverables across technical optimization, content development, structured data, authority, internal linking, analytics, and website architecture.**

**Prioritize opportunities based on visibility impact, customer demand, implementation effort, business value, and technical feasibility.**

**Build phased programs covering discovery, measurement, gap analysis, fix planning, content and technical creation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.**

**Ensure recommendations support organic rankings, AI mentions, citations, recommendations, traffic, engagement, and conversion performance.**

**Connect AEO and SEO initiatives with CRO, UX, merchandising, product data, paid media, and broader digital-commerce strategies.**

**Measurement and Reporting**

**Define KPIs for AI visibility, mention rate, citation rate, share of voice, query coverage, answer accuracy, organic visibility, traffic, engagement, and conversion.**

**Analyze performance using the AEO Intelligence Platform alongside GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.**

**Compare visibility across AI engines, search engines, competitors, markets, categories, and customer-intent groups.**

**Build executive-level reporting that explains current performance, key gaps, recommended actions, expected value, and implementation priorities.**

**Establish testing and monitoring frameworks to evaluate the impact of content and technical changes.**

**Connect AEO and SEO performance to commercial outcomes such as qualified traffic, leads, revenue, product discovery, store visits, and assisted conversions.**

**Global Program Delivery**

**Adapt AEO and SEO strategies for different countries, languages, search behaviors, regulations, market conditions, and technical environments.**

**Establish global standards while allowing for appropriate regional and local-market execution.**

**Collaborate with regional SEO teams, content specialists, developers, analysts, product owners, UX designers, merchandisers, and business leaders.**

**Educate internal teams and clients on the relationship between SEO, AEO, generative search, AI visibility, and agentic commerce.**

**Present complex technical and analytical findings in language appropriate for executive, marketing, content, and engineering audiences.**

**Help define best practices, operating models, governance processes, and quality standards for global AEO and SEO delivery.**

**Required Skills**

**AEO and AI Search**

**Strong understanding of answer engine optimization, generative search, retrieval systems, citations, AI recommendations, and large language model behavior.**

**Ability to analyze how AI engines discover, interpret, summarize, compare, and recommend brands.**

**Experience creating AI-focused query sets and evaluating results by intent, engine, topic, product, and competitor.**

**Understanding of entity optimization, semantic relationships, knowledge graphs, information retrieval, and machine-readable content.**

**Familiarity with AI visibility platforms and the broader AEO technology landscape.**

**Understanding of agentic commerce, AI shopping experiences, product feeds, and machine-readable product information.**

**SEO**

**Advanced technical SEO knowledge.**

**Strong understanding of on-page SEO, content optimization, keyword research, internal linking, site architecture, and search intent.**

**Experience with enterprise websites, ecommerce platforms, international SEO, and large-scale website programs.**

**Knowledge of JavaScript SEO, rendering, crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirects, and website migrations.**

**Experience developing integrated SEO strategies that connect technical, content, authority, analytics, and user experience.**

**Content Strategy**

**Ability to convert customer questions and search behaviors into structured content plans.**

**Experience creating briefs for category pages, product pages, service pages, comparison pages, buying guides, FAQs, educational content, and local landing pages.**

**Strong understanding of content hierarchy, answer-first writing, topical authority, brand differentiation, and evidence-based content.**

**Ability to balance search visibility, AI visibility, customer experience, conversion, and brand voice.**

**Experience building scalable content standards across templates, markets, and teams.**

**Structured Data and Technical Implementation**

**Working knowledge of Schema.org, JSON-LD, structured data validation, and entity relationships.**

**Ability to define technical requirements for developers and review implementations for quality and accuracy.**

**Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, content-management systems, ecommerce platforms, APIs, data feeds, and website architecture.**

**Ability to distinguish among content, rendering, semantic, data-quality, and platform-level issues.**

**Familiarity with technical auditing and crawling platforms.**

**Analytics and Platforms**

**Experience with AEO intelligence and AI visibility platforms.**

**Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics, and BigQuery or another data warehouse.**

**Familiarity with Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, Botify, Conductor, Profound, or comparable tools.**

**Experience with Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, schema validation tools, and page-performance tools.**

**Familiarity with enterprise content-management and ecommerce platforms.**

**Consulting and Communication**

**Ability to translate complex AEO, SEO, technical, and analytical findings into clear business recommendations.**

**Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills.**

**Ability to create roadmaps, scopes, implementation plans, technical requirements, and measurement frameworks.**

**Comfort working with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.**

**Strong prioritization, project-management, and cross-functional leadership skills.**

**Ability to explain both what needs to change and why the change creates business value.**

**Preferred Experience**

**5–8+ years of experience in SEO, digital strategy, content strategy, ecommerce, analytics, or a related discipline.**

**Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise or global SEO programs.**

**Hands-on experience evaluating brand visibility across AI answer engines.**

**Experience supporting website redesigns, migrations, platform changes, or international expansion.**

**Experience working with ecommerce brands, retailers, service organizations, or complex multi-market businesses.**

**Experience partnering with engineering, UX, CRO, analytics, merchandising, and content teams.**

**Experience developing client-facing strategies, proposals, executive presentations, and business cases.**

**Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, conversion optimization, and measurement design.**

**Key Competencies**

**• Global AEO and SEO strategy**

**• Technical SEO and AI accessibility**

**• Content gap analysis**

**• Structured data and entity optimization**

**• AI demand and visibility measurement**

**• Competitive intelligence**

**• Query and intent modeling**

**• Ecommerce and product-data optimization**

**• Analytics and performance measurement**

**• Website migration and redesign support**

**• Cross-functional program delivery**

**• Executive communication**

**• Strategic prioritization**

**• Technical requirements development**

**• Quality assurance and implementation validation**

**Measures of Success**

**Increase brand visibility, mentions, citations, and recommendations across AI platforms.**

**Improve organic search visibility and qualified traffic.**

**Expand the percentage of strategically important queries where the brand is represented.**

**Improve how accurately AI engines understand the brand, its offerings, and its differentiators.**

**Reduce technical, content, semantic, and product-data gaps.**

**Move recommendations from analysis into implemented, measurable improvements.**

**Create scalable AEO and SEO standards across global markets.**

**Connect visibility improvements to customer engagement, conversions, leads, and revenue.**

**Help establish the organization as a leader in integrated AEO and SEO strategy.**

**Role Focus: This is a senior strategy and execution role for a practitioner who can connect AEO intelligence, technical SEO, content optimization, analytics, and global program delivery within one integrated operating model.**

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰

description:

**Location:**
Bangalore (In-office)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2-4 Years

**About Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI-first upskilling platform for working professionals. Our programs are designed around real-world use cases, AI tools, and hands-on learning, delivered by industry leaders from companies like Uber, Google, and Microsoft.

We are a profitable business backed by strong investors, focused on
*sustainable growth, strong unit economics, and long-term value creation*
.

**The Context**

Growth at Airtribe is not just about increasing leads. It is about improving
*quality, efficiency, and predictability*
.

As we scale, running paid campaigns is not enough. The real challenge lies in optimizing CAC, improving funnel conversion, and ensuring that growth efforts translate into actual business outcomes.

This role exists to build and scale a
*high-performance growth engine*
that is data-driven, efficient, and outcome-focused.

**The Role**

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you will own paid acquisition and lead generation end-to-end.

You will be responsible for driving high-quality leads, improving conversion efficiency, and building scalable growth systems.

This is a
*high-ownership role*
that combines performance marketing, analytical thinking, and experimentation.

**What You’ll Own**

• End-to-end paid acquisition across platforms, including Google, YouTube, Instagram, and LinkedIn

• Lead generation strategy with a focus on quality and conversion

• Campaign setup, optimization, and scaling across channels

• Funnel performance, including lead quality, conversion rates, and CAC

• Data tracking, reporting, and performance analysis

• Collaboration with sales, program, and leadership teams to align on outcomes

• Continuous experimentation with new channels, creatives, and strategies

**What Problems You’ll Solve**

• Improving lead quality while maintaining scale

• Reducing CAC and improving overall growth efficiency

• Bridging the gap between marketing leads and actual conversions

• Identifying and fixing bottlenecks across the acquisition funnel

• Building a predictable and scalable growth engine

**How This Role Evolves**

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding current campaigns, improving performance, and driving consistent lead flow.

Over time, you will build scalable systems, improve efficiency across channels, and contribute to a long-term growth strategy.

Based on your trajectory, this role can evolve into owning the growth function or leading a larger performance marketing team.

**What We’re Looking For**

• Strong understanding of performance marketing, growth strategies, and lead generation

• Experience in running and optimizing paid campaigns across major platforms

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work with data and metrics

• Good intuition for audience targeting, messaging, and positioning

• High ownership mindset with a bias for execution

• Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment

**Nice to have:**

• Experience in edtech, upskilling, or similar domains

• Exposure to AI tools or automation in marketing workflows

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a campaign execution-only role.

We are not looking for someone who only runs ads. We are looking for someone who
*owns growth outcomes, improves systems, and drives efficiency across the funnel*
.

**Why Join Airtribe**

• High-impact role with direct ownership of growth and revenue drivers

• Opportunity to work closely with founders and leadership

• Strong focus on learning, experimentation, and execution

• A fast-paced environment with real visibility of impact

• Opportunity to build and scale a critical business function

If you enjoy solving growth problems, working with data, and building systems that scale, this role gives you the ownership to do it.

title: AI Commercial and Adoption Manager - AI Hub
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
As AI Commercial & Adoption Manager, you will play a key role in turning AI opportunities into solutions that create measurable and sustainable value for Linde. Depending on the product or initiative, you may act as the Commercial Lead, focusing on business opportunity, value proposition, product definition and scaling, and/ or act as the Adoption Manager, focusing on user readiness, change, adoption and value realization. Your overall objective is to ensure that AI products are not only valuable and commercially sound, but also adopted by their intended users and able to deliver sustainable business impact
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role you will identify, explore and qualify promising AI opportunities together with businesses, functions and end users.
* Further you will have to understand the underlying business problem, user needs and Jobs-to-be-Done and translate these into a compelling product vision and value proposition
* Furthermore, you will develop and validate commercial hypotheses, including expected business impact, value potential, target users and success KPIs
* Further you will lead or co-lead AI product initiatives through the relevant stages of the product lifecycle, working closely with Technical Leads, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business stakeholders
* Moreover, you will build stakeholder alignment and secure business sponsorship for selected use cases
* Additionally, you will validate value during pilots and use the results to inform investment and scaling decisions
* Further you will assess global demand and replication potential and develop appropriate scaling approaches
* Furthermore, you will assess the expected adoption effort and identify potential user, organizational and workflow barriers early in the product lifecycle
* In this role you will Develop a fit-for-purpose adoption approach based on the product's user scale, business impact and degree of behavioral change required
* Further you will define adoption objectives, KPIs and measures of success together with Commercial Leads and business stakeholders
* Moreover, you will engage relevant user groups, sponsors, champions and other stakeholders throughout pilots and implementation
* Further you will design and coordinate communication, enablement, training and change activities that support successful product adoption
* Additionally, you will develop repeatable adoption approaches that enable successful products to scale across functions, regions and business units

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**
For this role you have a Bachelor or Master's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or related field
  
  
Further you have 3+ years of experience in project management, business analysis, or digital transformation roles, preferably in a tech or industrial setting
  
  
Furthermore, you should have experience in working with GenAI products and AI Agents
  
  
Moreover, you should be able to demonstrate successful track record of executing international projects (all phases) independently, from concept to sign-off
  
  
Further you have strong financial background, analytical, due diligent with business and financial modelling skills, consulting background is a plus
  
  
Furthermore, you show ability to start & execute projects independently
  
  
Moreover, to be successful in your role you are a strong communicator
  
  
You should have willingness to take over the leadership for multiple projects with own budget and schedule responsibility
  
  
For this role you possess a deep understanding of Linde business, Linde core value, and operating model
  
  
Further you should be strong knowhow in one or two business areas of Linde is preferred
  
  
Furthermore, you should be practical experience with change management, adoption, enablement or organizational transformation, including working directly with users and business stakeholders
  
  
For this role you be strong user orientation and the ability to translate between business needs, user needs and technical teams.
  
  
Additionally, you should be able to connect people and ideas, deduct value, convince and motivate stakeholders in matrix organization and build synergies
  
  

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Praxair India Private Limited acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.
