title: Business Head - Navi UPI
description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

title: General Manager, India
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
  
  
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
  
  
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
  
  
Read our blog to learn more.
  
  
**About The Role...**
India is one of Duolingo's most important growth markets. We've operated there for a while, but believe it has much more potential than we've realized so far. We're looking for a seasoned leader to own Duolingo's trajectory in India and build our business in the market. In addition to being a strategic, resourceful, high-influence generalist, we want someone with excellent product sense, built through leading or partnering closely with product teams at global consumer tech companies. You'll set the strategy, build and rally our team on the ground, and serve as India's bridge to our global teams and leaders.
  
  
Your success will be measured on Duolingo's core metrics: user growth and monetization. Like most leaders at Duolingo, you'll work in a matrix. Team members report into their functions, and you'll lead them as one cross-functional team focused on India. Instead of managing a market P&L, you'll spend your time on things that move these core metrics.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore office and reports to the Asia Business Lead. We welcome candidates already in India as well as those willing to relocate.
  
  
**🧠 You will...**

* Be responsible for India's strategy and priorities, and accountable for results
* Build and lead an India-based cross-functional team, as well as the culture and operating cadence that hold it together
* Be the voice of India: bridge what's actually true in market and what our global leadership and teams understand about it, and translate company priorities into work that makes sense locally
* Work closely with product teams to shape India-specific product and course improvements
* Influence and align global, cross-functional teams to support the needs of India

title: Lead of process excellence
description:
Styli is a tech-first fashion & home marketplace for the GCC. Launched in 2019 by Landmark Group, we connect

customers to hundreds of thousands of products through an open seller ecosystem. We obsess over customer

experience- fast delivery, seamless payments and delightful service while building the region’s most efficient, data-

driven marketplace.

Styli, known for delighting customers in the GCC and India with fashion-driven products at value prices, is now

expanding its private label offerings beyond fashion to include Luggage, Home Fashion, Personal Care, Electronics,

Artificial Jewelry, Nutraceuticals, Home Essentials, and more.

As the Head of Planning, you will be responsible for end-to-end business planning and merchandising, including

setting GMV, net sales and margin targets, managing inventory, providing buy budgets and designing a robust

markdown, promotion and pricing strategy to drive both revenue and profitability. Your key objective will be to ensure

the right product is available on the right channels at the right time, using a deep understanding of web funnel,

customer behavior, product performance & channel dynamics. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and

ability to leverage data for agile decision-making. The role will collaborate closely with channel, buying & finance to

deliver on business objectives - This is a high-impact role that combines strategic thinking with execution rigor in one

of GCC’s most dynamic and rapidly growing channels.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Demand Forecasting

➢ Develop Annual and Quarterly Sales Plan (in conjunction with Finance team) and targets along with

detailed weekly/ daily phasing by channel and merchandise source.

➢ Identify the inventory required to meet these targets and implement effective strategies to ensure

timely availability of merchandise by different category hierarchies and mix of freshness and aged.

2. Sales Achievement

➢ Monitor progress against sales targets and proactively adjust merchandising or promotional

strategies as needed.

➢ Collaborate closely with the Buyers and Channel teams to identify funnel/ merchandising gaps and

take corrective actions.

3. Inventory Management

➢ Driving rigor of weekly trade review meetings between Planners, buyers and channel teams to ensure

inventory movement and taking actions (visibility/ pricing and promotion) on slow movers.

➢ Dashboarding the inventory health by geography/ category/ ageing and presenting to stakeholders to take

timely actions to ensure the different buckets of ageing are as per the annual plan.

➢ Active management (Identification to availability to sunset) of rebuy (NOOS) options and by different

geographies/ categories.

4. Markdown Management

➢ Design innovative, data-backed promotional offers (in conjunction with channel teams) that balance

revenue, profitability, and inventory turnover objectives.

➢ Partner with the channel teams to execute in-channel promotions, customize offers by country, and align

visual communication (including website banners and end customer messaging) with ongoing campaigns.

5. Purchase Budget Planning

➢ Define the Open-to-Buy (OTB) requirements necessary to support the planned sales trajectory.

➢ Provide strategic direction to the buying team on product selection, key price points, and high-potential

styles—guided by current performance trends and assortment gaps within the channel.

6. Channel Efficiency

➢ Continuously monitor channel performance and diagnose underlying issues impacting sales.

➢ Collaborate with the channel teams to improve execution and overall funnel efficiency.

7. Team Leadership & Development

➢ Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to team members, empowering them to implement best

practices both within the channel and across the organization in their respective regions.

➢ Foster continuous learning by supporting their upskilling and professional growth, ensuring they are

equipped to deliver high-impact results.

8. Partnering with Product/ Technology

➢ Working with product and technology teams on existing roadmaps w.r.t planning tools and PLM and other

technologies (AI adoption etc). Actively testing the tools to ensure adherence to the roadmap and adoption

of the tools.

Qualification & Experience:

• 12+ years’ experience of E-commerce marketplace fashion planning/ Retail planning (Minimum 3 years in E-

commerce). Planning for multiple different E-com channels will be a plus.

• Experience of trade management on online marketplaces – Solid understanding of web funnel, channel

promotion practices

• Strong analytical skills and excellent hold on excel (Google sheets and MS Excel)

• Must have strong stakeholder management skills, good commercial awareness and the ability to make quick

decisions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Comfort and ability to work with cross-cultural teams across time-zones (GCC/ China and India)

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
**Key Requirement for the Position**

3–5 years of hands-on experience in SEO, digital marketing, or organic search optimization.

Practical experience with GEO and/or AEO is a key requirement; traditional SEO experience alone is not sufficient.

Understanding of how generative AI platforms and AI-powered search experiences retrieve, synthesize, and cite information.

Experience monitoring AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, or share of voice using specialized tools or equivalent methodologies.

Familiarity with platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other AI-powered search experiences.

Strong knowledge of keyword research, search intent, on-page SEO, content optimization, and technical SEO fundamentals.

Experience with SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar platforms.

Strong analytical skills, competitor research capabilities, and reporting skills.

Excellent written communication skills and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

Develop and implement GEO/AEO strategies to improve brand visibility and representation across AI-powered search engines and generative answer platforms.

Monitor brand mentions, citations, recommendations, and share of voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Analyze how AI platforms discover, interpret, and reference website content and identify opportunities to improve visibility in AI-generated responses.

Optimize website content to improve the likelihood of being referenced, cited, or recommended by AI-powered search and answer engines.

Track AI search performance, identify visibility gaps, and recommend actionable optimization strategies.

Stay updated on evolving AI search algorithms, generative search experiences, and emerging GEO/AEO best practices.

2. AI Search Visibility Monitoring & Analytics

Use tools such as Peec AI, Profound, Semrush AEO, or equivalent platforms to monitor AI search visibility and brand performance.

Analyze AI-generated responses, competitor mentions, citation sources, and relevant search prompts.

Conduct competitor benchmarking to identify opportunities to improve brand presence in AI-generated answers.

Prepare regular performance reports covering AI visibility, brand mentions, citations, share of voice, and optimization progress.

Translate insights and analytics into actionable recommendations for content, technical SEO, and digital marketing teams.

3. Traditional SEO & Content Optimization

Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitor research.

Optimize website pages, metadata, headings, internal linking, and content structure.

Develop content optimization strategies aligned with user intent and search engine requirements.

Collaborate with content writers to create clear, authoritative, factually accurate, and answer-focused content.

Identify opportunities for featured snippets, People Also Ask results, structured answers, and other search visibility features.

Support technical SEO initiatives, including crawlability, indexability, site structure, and page performance.

4. Structured Data & Content Authority

Understand and implement relevant structured data and schema markup to help search engines interpret website content.

Optimize content using clear headings, concise answers, FAQs, supporting evidence, and authoritative references where appropriate.

Identify opportunities to strengthen topical authority, entity recognition, and brand information consistency across relevant online sources.

Work with web development and content teams to address technical and content-related optimization opportunities.

5. Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Define relevant KPIs for traditional SEO and AI search visibility.

Track organic search performance, AI-generated citations, brand mentions, referral traffic, and other measurable outcomes.

Conduct regular audits to identify performance gaps and prioritize optimization initiatives.

Present findings, recommendations, and progress updates to stakeholders.

Test new optimization approaches and continuously refine strategies based on observed results.

* Define Superleap’s brand positioning and differentiation in the AI-native CRM market.

**Content Strategy & Creation**

* Own content strategy across LinkedIn, blogs, website, newsletters, and digital platforms.

**Brand Storytelling & Category Building**

* Build narratives that challenge legacy CRM platforms and establish Superleap as a next-generation AI CRM.
* Develop thought leadership content around AI, SaaS, and sales productivity.

**Founder-Led Content**

* Build founder-led content and personal branding initiatives.

**Brand Communications & Campaigns**

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

Superleap has been growing at over 25% month-on-month for the last six months.

Competitive base Salary +

title: Copywriter
description:
We are looking for someone with 3–4 years of experience, including hands-on experience writing performance marketing creatives for D2C brands across both static ads and video formats.

The ideal candidate should know how to turn consumer insights into compelling hooks, persuasive ad copy, and engaging video scripts. More importantly, they should understand what makes an ad perform and use performance data to continuously improve their writing.

This is not a traditional content writing role. We are looking for someone who combines creative storytelling with performance marketing understanding — someone who can write, analyse, experiment, and optimise.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Performance Creative Writing**

* Write compelling ad copy for Meta, Google, YouTube, and other paid digital platforms.
* Develop strong hooks, headlines, primary text, CTAs, and messaging for static and video ads.
* Create short-form video scripts (15–60 seconds) for performance ads, UGC, influencer content, product demonstrations, and founder-led creatives.
* Experiment with different consumer pain points, storytelling formats, emotional triggers, and product benefit-led messaging.
* Develop multiple creative variations for A/B testing across audiences and funnel stages.

**2. Creative Strategy & Consumer Insights**

* Research consumer behaviour, customer reviews, pain points, objections, and purchase motivations to identify compelling communication angles.
* Analyse competitor ads, D2C campaigns, and emerging creative trends using Meta Ad Library and other research tools.
* Develop creative concepts, campaign ideas, and communication frameworks for new and existing products.
* Translate product features and technical information into simple, relatable, benefit-led communication.
* Collaborate with the creative team to convert concepts into effective static and video advertisements.

**3. Creative Performance Analysis & Optimisation**

* Use Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Suite to review and analyse ad creative performance.
* Understand key performance metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, and video retention.
* Identify winning hooks, messaging angles, creative formats, and underperforming advertisements.
* Work closely with the performance marketing team to understand why certain creatives work and others don't.
* Maintain a structured repository of creative learnings, winning formats, and experiments.

**4. Campaign Ideation & Creative Execution**

* Develop creative briefs and campaign concepts for product launches, promotional campaigns, and always-on performance marketing.
* Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and performance marketers.
* Contribute to brainstorming sessions with original, consumer-focused creative ideas.
* Review creative outputs to ensure messaging clarity, brand consistency, and effective communication.
* Take ownership of creative concepts from ideation to final execution.

**5. Brand & Product Communication**

* Write persuasive product communication for landing pages, product pages, website banners, and campaign assets.
* Develop clear product positioning, USPs, benefit-led messaging, and communication angles.
* Ensure consistency in brand tone while adapting communication for different audiences and platforms.
* Collaborate with product and clinical experts to ensure pain-care and recovery claims are accurate and evidence-based.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience in creative copywriting, performance marketing content, or advertising communications.
* Mandatory experience writing performance marketing creatives for D2C brands, including both static advertisements and video scripts.
* Prior experience working with a D2C startup, consumer brand, or creative/performance marketing agency handling D2C clients.
* Hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager or Meta Business Suite to analyse ad performance.

**Essential Skills**

* **Performance Copywriting:**
  Excellent ability to write scroll-stopping hooks, persuasive headlines, compelling scripts, and conversion-focused CTAs.
* **Creative Storytelling:**
  Strong understanding of consumer psychology, emotional triggers, humour, relatable situations, and product-led storytelling.
* **Meta Ads Analytics:**
  Ability to interpret creative performance through CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, hook rates, and engagement metrics.
* **Video Scriptwriting:**
  Strong understanding of short-form video structure, opening hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, and conversion messaging.
* **D2C Marketing Understanding:**
  Familiarity with acquisition funnels, audience segments, paid social campaigns, and conversion-focused communication.
* **AI & Creative Tools:**
  Comfortable using AI tools for research, brainstorming, copy experimentation, and creative development.

**About the job** 
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
   

  

 Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito\-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end\-to\-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical\-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
   

  

 As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito\-borne disease. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector\-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.
* Structure and negotiate operational models with partners by working with internal science and program manager teams to formulate field requirements with technical capabilities and program timelines.
* Evaluate opportunities, conduct due diligence, negotiating agreement terms, and working with cross\-functional teams to prepare and present recommendations to senior leadership. Ensure the consistent exercise of appropriate judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Identify, establish, and grow relationships with existing and new partners. Act as the central point of contact and maintain comprehensive account knowledge.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a results-driven
**Key Account Manager – IT Staffing**
to manage strategic client relationships, drive revenue growth, and expand our staffing business across enterprise accounts.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in IT staffing, client relationship management, account growth, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be capable of managing existing enterprise clients, identifying new business opportunities within accounts, and ensuring consistent revenue generation through contract staffing and permanent hiring services.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Key Account Management**

* Manage and develop long-term relationships with existing enterprise clients.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, including HR leaders, Talent Acquisition Heads, Procurement teams, and business leaders.
* Understand client hiring requirements, workforce plans, and business priorities.
* Conduct regular client meetings, business reviews, and performance discussions.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and strengthen long-term partnerships.

**2. Revenue Growth & Account Expansion**

* Drive revenue growth from existing accounts through account penetration and service expansion.
* Identify opportunities to expand staffing services across new business units, departments, and locations.
* Develop account growth strategies and execute plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
* Identify opportunities for contract staffing, permanent recruitment, and specialised technology hiring.
* Build and maintain account plans, revenue forecasts, and business development pipelines.

**3. IT Staffing & Recruitment Coordination**

* Work closely with recruitment and delivery teams to fulfil client hiring requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely submission of qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, including submission ratios, interview conversion rates, offer-to-join ratios, and fulfilment timelines.
* Ensure effective communication between clients, recruiters, and delivery managers.
* Resolve escalations related to candidate quality, fulfilment delays, and service delivery.

**4. Commercial & Contract Management**

* Manage commercial discussions, staffing margins, billing rates, and service agreements.
* Negotiate pricing and contractual terms to maintain account profitability.
* Coordinate with finance and operations teams to ensure timely invoicing and payment collection.
* Monitor outstanding payments and support the resolution of billing disputes.
* Ensure compliance with client contracts, SLAs, and vendor management processes.

**5. Client Retention & Relationship Building**

* Proactively identify client concerns and address service delivery issues.
* Develop strategies to improve client retention and increase account wallet share.
* Build relationships with multiple stakeholders to reduce dependency on individual contacts.
* Track client satisfaction and identify opportunities for service improvement.
* Stay informed about client expansion plans, technology initiatives, and workforce requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in IT staffing, recruitment services, or workforce solutions.
* Proven experience managing enterprise accounts and driving revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of contract staffing, permanent recruitment, and technology hiring.
* Experience working with enterprise clients, HR leaders, Talent Acquisition teams, and procurement stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating staffing rates and margins.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and prioritise business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Experience with CRM systems, account planning, and revenue forecasting.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage client escalations effectively.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience managing large enterprise accounts in IT staffing or recruitment consulting.
* Existing relationships with enterprise Talent Acquisition, HR, procurement, or workforce management teams.
* Experience working with clients in SaaS, product engineering, fintech, semiconductor, BFSI, or other technology-driven industries.
* Exposure to MSP/VMS hiring models and vendor empanelment processes.
* Experience managing multi-location staffing engagements and large-volume hiring requirements.
* A track record of growing existing accounts and converting client relationships into long-term revenue opportunities.

title: Corporate Relations Executive ( 1-4 years )
description:
**Career Services Lead**

**Location:**

Bengaluru (On-site)

**Type:**

Full-time

**Experience:**

2–3 years

**Joining:**

Immediate or within 15 days

**About Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI-first upskilling platform for working professionals. Our programs are designed and delivered by industry leaders, with a strong focus on real-world application, outcomes, and learner success.

As we scale, career outcomes are becoming a core part of how we create value for our learners and differentiate ourselves in the market.

**The Context**

At Airtribe, learning does not end with sessions. It ends with
*real career outcomes*

.

As our learner base grows, ensuring consistent, high-quality placement outcomes and strong hiring partnerships becomes increasingly complex. This requires structured systems, strong company relationships, and tight alignment between learners and opportunities.

This role exists to build and scale a
*career services engine*

that drives learner success and strengthens our hiring ecosystem.

**The Role**

As a Career Services Lead, you will own the end-to-end career outcomes function at Airtribe.

You will work at the intersection of learners, hiring partners, and internal teams, ensuring that opportunities are created, learners are prepared, and outcomes are consistently delivered.

This is a
*high-ownership role*

with both execution and strategic responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* End-to-end career services function including partnerships, learner readiness, and placements
* Outreach and relationship management with product-based startups and tech companies
* Hiring pipeline management from JD discovery to final placement
* Career readiness initiatives including resume reviews, mock interviews, and coaching
* Internal coordination across teams to ensure learner-job fit
* Tracking systems, dashboards, and reporting for placements and partner performance
* Defining and improving processes across the career services journey
* Contributing to the long-term roadmap and strategy for this function

**What Problems You’ll Solve**

* Creating consistent placement outcomes as the learner base scales
* Building and maintaining strong hiring partner relationships
* Reducing gaps between learner readiness and job expectations
* Bringing structure and visibility to career outcomes and reporting
* Ensuring career services remains learner-first and outcome-driven
  ﻿

**How This Role Evolves**

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the current ecosystem, building partnerships, and driving placements.

Over time, you will build systems, improve efficiency, and define scalable processes for the function.

As Airtribe grows, this role can evolve into leading the entire career services vertical and building a team under it.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–3 years of experience in career services, recruitment, placements, B2B partnerships, or related roles
* Experience working with hiring partners, preferably product-based companies
* Strong stakeholder management and outreach skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* High ownership mindset with a bias for execution
* Ability to think strategically while executing hands-on
* Comfort working in a fast-paced and evolving environment

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in edtech, HR-tech, or employability-focused startups
* Exposure to learner-facing or outcome-driven roles

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a coordination or support role.

We are not looking for someone who only manages processes. We are looking for someone who
*builds the function, drives outcomes, and takes ownership end-to-end*

.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* Opportunity to build and scale a core business function
* High ownership and autonomy in decision-making
* Direct impact on learner careers and company growth
* Close collaboration with founders and leadership
* Space to build systems, experiment, and scale responsibly

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Title - HR Manager

Location - Bangalore, India

Company - King Rose Construction & Services

**About Us**

King Rose Construction & Services is a leading general contractor and outsourced services provider headquartered in New York City, recognized for delivering complex, high profile projects with excellence and precision. As we enter a significant phase of growth — expanding operations across the U.S. and building out our Bangalore team —we are seeking a seasoned HR leader to architect and lead our people strategy at scale.

**Position Overview**

The HR Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing King Rose’s people strategy across our U.S. and India operations. We are looking for a strategic partner to the executive team who can build scalable HR infrastructure, lead high volume international recruiting, and foster a performance-driven, inclusive culture across geographies. You will be based in our Bangalore office and work during evening shift hours (4:30 PM – 1:00 AM IST), aligning closely with our New York headquarters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition & Recruiting**

* Lead end-to-end recruiting operations for both U.S. and India-based roles, managing high volume pipelines across technical, operational, and leadership positions.
* Build and manage sourcing strategies for the Indian market, including partnerships with Universities, recruitment agencies, and digital platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Shine.
* Own U.S. hiring operations, including managing job board presence, and ensuring compliance requirements.
* Develop employer branding initiatives to position King Rose as an employer of choice in both markets.
* Establish structured interview frameworks, offer management processes, and onboarding programs that create a consistent and high-quality candidate experience.
* Build workforce planning models in partnership with department heads to anticipate headcount needs 3–6 months ahead.

**HR Strategy & Organizational Development**

* Partner with the leadership team to design and execute a people strategy that supports aggressive scaling across both geographies.
* Lead organizational design efforts including role clarity, reporting structures, and team architecture as the company grows.
* Build and institutionalize performance management frameworks, including goal-setting, quarterly reviews, and annual appraisal cycles.
* Drive succession planning and internal talent mobility to develop a strong leadership pipeline.
* Establish compensation benchmarking and pay equity practices for U.S. and Indian markets, ensuring competitiveness and compliance.

**Branding**

* HR manager will be responsible to be the voice and architect of our talent identity.
* Responsible to influence top talent discover us, create great experience during hiring, ensure employees are connected with King Rose mission every single day.
* Design and execute a comprehensive employer branding strategy that reflects our culture, values, and growth vision.
* Partner with leadership and marketing to craft compelling narratives for careers pages, social media, and recruitment campaigns.
* Build employee advocacy programs that turn our people into brand ambassadors.
* Curate impactful candidate experiences—from the first touchpoint to onboarding—ensuring every interaction reflects our values.
* Use data and analytics to measure brand perception and continuously refine our approach.

**HR Operations & Compliance**

* Maintain and continuously improve HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs in compliance with U.S. federal/state labor laws and Indian labor regulations.
* Own the HRIS ecosystem — select, implement, and optimize tools that enable data-driven decision-making across the HR function.
* Lead grievance resolution, disciplinary proceedings, and workplace investigations with professionalism, sensitivity, and legal compliance.
* Manage all offboarding and exit interview processes, deriving insights that inform retention and culture strategies.

**Culture & Employee Experience**

* Champion a high-performance, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture across both the U.S. and India offices.
* Design and lead company-wide onboarding, orientation, and culture-building programs that embed King Rose’s values from day one.
* Build and execute employee engagement strategies — pulse surveys, recognition programs, team events — with measurable outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for employees across all levels on culture, conduct, and career development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA or Master’s in HR strongly preferred.
* HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent is a significant advantage.
* Minimum 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or head-of-HR capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading HR operations across India and the U.S. in a multinational or cross-border organization.
* Deep expertise in Indian talent markets — Bangalore/metro sourcing, compensation benchmarking, and labor law compliance (Shops & Establishments Act, PF, ESIC, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. employment law, benefits administration
* Proven track record of building HR functions and people infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* High proficiency in MS Office Suite and data analysis for HR reporting and workforce planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the construction, interior fit-out, or professional services industry.
* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company from an India delivery center.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience, with annual performance bonuses and hikes.
* Comprehensive health insurance and benefits package.
* Opportunity to build and lead the HR function from the ground up during an exciting growth phase.
* A smart, collaborative, and mission-driven team that values people as the core of the business.
* Work in a dynamic international environment bridging the best of NYC and Bangalore.

title: Global Process Owner - Payroll & Absence
description:

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Team**
People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.
  
  
We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.
  
  
Our Global Process Owners (GPOs) in our Global Process Solutions team are critical to helping us deliver this ambition; ensuring business need is translated into clear, standardised and scalable process solutions, enabling consistent ways of working and driving improved service outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
As
**GPO for Payroll, Time & Attendance**
you will be responsible for partnering closely with the Payroll team to design, govern and continuously improve our payroll processes across the globe and ensure we have cost effective, automated and easy to use time & attendance solutions.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end global Payroll, Time & Attendance process framework, driving standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across all markets.
* Define, maintain and optimise global Payroll and Time & Attendance processes, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, compliant and aligned with Haleon’s operating model.
* Act as subject matter expert for Payroll and Time & Attendance processes, providing guidance and decision-making support to People Solutions, HR teams, Digital & Technology teams and business stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, People Solutions, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Digital & Technology teams to drive process simplification, automation and service excellence.
* Establish and maintain global process standards, controls, policies, Knowledge contents and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring consistency while balancing local regulatory and legislative requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging process analytics, automation opportunities and industry best practices to improve employee experience, payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with payroll legislation, labour laws, tax regulations, statutory obligations and Haleon policies across all relevant jurisdictions.
* Partner with the Quality & Effectiveness team to define and monitor key process performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality metrics and payroll accuracy measures, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead process governance forums and stakeholder engagement activities, ensuring alignment of process priorities, change initiatives and business requirements.
* Partner with Digital & Technology teams to help shape the payroll and workforce management systems roadmap.
* Provide process leadership for technology enhancements, integrations and digital transformation initiatives.
* Ensure robust governance and integrity of Payroll and Time & Attendance data across HR, payroll and workforce management platforms.
* Support acquisitions, divestitures, organisational redesigns and transformation programs impacting Payroll and Time & Attendance processes.
* Collaborate with vendors, consultants and implementation partners to evaluate and adopt best-in-class solutions and practices.

**About You**
Technical and functional expertise:
  
  

* 8-10 years of experience in Payroll, Time & Attendance, HR Operations, Shared Services, Process Ownership or related disciplines.
* Strong expertise in global payroll operations, workforce management processes, payroll controls and employee lifecycle impacts on payroll.
* Deep understanding of payroll legislation, labour regulations, tax compliance requirements and workforce management practices across multiple countries.
* Experience operating within complex global organisations, ideally using multiple payroll vendors and service delivery models.
* Proven experience leading global process ownership, governance and standardisation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Workday and payroll-related integrations, with the ability to assess process, data and system impacts.
* Experience working with global payroll providers such as ADP, CloudPay, Workday Payroll or similar solutions is preferred.
* Demonstrable experience leveraging data analytics and process insights to drive business performance improvements.
* Knowledge of automation, digital transformation and emerging technologies impacting HR Operations and Shared Services.
* Certification in Payroll (e.g. CIPP) and/or process improvement methodology (e.g. Lean Six Sigma) is advantageous.

Leadership and behavioural capabilities:
  
  

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate competing priorities effectively.
* Curious, proactive and solutions-focused, with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Resilient and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and changing business needs.
* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for delivering results.
* Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail with a focus on compliance, governance and operational excellence.
* Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-17
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

Our approach to R&D

Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.

title: Growth and Engagement Marketing Lead - Mobile App
description:
**Role description**

The Growth and Engagement Marketing Lead – Mobile App is a full-time hybrid role based in Bengaluru, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for defining and executing growth strategies to increase app installs, activation, retention, and user engagement across key segments, and is accountable for agreed targets on users returning to the app across different time frames (day 1, day 7, day 30, and monthly). Day-to-day tasks include analyzing user behavior and funnels, planning and running growth experiments, optimizing onboarding and lifecycle campaigns, and collaborating with product and design teams to improve in-app experiences. The role also involves managing performance marketing and referral programs, coordinating cross-functional projects, and partnering with sales or business development to convert and retain high-value users. The Lead is expected to bring original, testable ideas that create buzz around the app, test them quickly, and scale what works. The Lead will track key metrics, prepare reports, stand by their targets and results, and continuously refine strategies based on data-driven insights.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to interpret data, optimize funnels, and drive data-informed decisions on growth and engagement.
* Demonstrated experience in growth hacking, experimentation, and mobile app user acquisition and retention strategies.
* A track record of creative, original campaign ideas backed by measurable results.
* Strong ownership: comfortable committing to targets and reporting honestly on progress.
* Effective communication skills for clear storytelling, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder alignment.
* Sales and business development orientation to support user conversion, monetization, and partnership-driven growth.
* Solid project management skills to plan initiatives, coordinate teams, and deliver campaigns and experiments on time.
* Background in digital/performance marketing for mobile apps, including ASO, paid campaigns, and lifecycle marketing.
* Experience with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Firebase, or similar) and A/B testing platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field; prior experience in consumer tech or travel is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, experimental environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

title: Web Content Writer - On-Page SEO, Blogs & AEO
description:
**Company Description**

Hashtag Socials is a full-service digital marketing agency based in Bangalore, focused on driving measurable business growth and profitability for its clients. The team emphasizes long-term partnerships built on trust, collaboration, and a deep understanding of each client’s unique business needs. By following a 360° approach to online success, Hashtag Socials provides end-to-end solutions that integrate strategy, creativity, and performance. Core services include website design, SEO, social media marketing, pay-per-click advertising, and email and display advertising, offering talent a dynamic environment to work across diverse digital channels.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Web Content Writer role located in Bengaluru North, focused on On-Page SEO, blogs, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). The Web Content Writer will research topics and keywords, write and optimize website copy, landing pages, and blog posts aligned with SEO and AEO best practices, and ensure content supports overall digital marketing objectives. The role involves collaborating with SEO specialists, designers, and campaign managers to maintain consistent brand messaging and improve search visibility, featured snippets, and user engagement. The candidate will manage content updates within CMS platforms, follow content calendars, and monitor performance metrics to refine and improve content over time.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills, with the ability to create clear, engaging, and SEO-friendly copy for websites and blogs.
* Candidates should possess Content Strategy and Content Management skills to plan, structure, and maintain content aligned with marketing goals and brand guidelines.
* Candidates should possess solid Research skills to understand audiences, identify relevant topics and keywords, and incorporate data-driven insights into content.
* Candidates should have a good understanding of On-Page SEO techniques, AEO principles (including featured snippets and conversational search), and basic awareness of broader digital marketing practices.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong grammar, editing, and attention to detail, along with the ability to meet deadlines and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* A bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, English, or a related field is preferred, and prior experience in digital marketing agencies or similar environments is an advantage.

title: Senior Manager, Search, GOC
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Manager - Search who will:
  
  

* Interact effectively with regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) and be a strong communicator.
* Support Google Ads, GDN, Bing Ads, Amazon Search campaign launches and setup according to established processes.
* Ensure ongoing campaign compliance to WPP-GOC established guidelines.
* Monitor and report on campaign checks across channels/platforms.
* Ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP-GOC campaign management software.
* Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting and providing commentary to regional Search teams.
* Line manages 2 – 5 direct
* Support in the work QA of junior team members as team grows.

****Skills And Experience****

* 6-8 years’ experience of planning and managing Google Ads/ Search campaigns
* Proficient in English
* You have experience with SA360 (or other bid management platforms e.g. Marin, Kenshoo)
* Experience with Facebook Business Manager and DV360 (a bonus)
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets You possess strong analytical skills and a natural affinity for numbers.
* You can analyse raw data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations as needed.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Employer Branding Associate
description:
Are you passionate about storytelling, social media, and creating meaningful connections with future talent? Do you enjoy working in a global environment where you can help shape how Grundfos engages with potential candidates? We are looking for an Employer Branding Associate to join our Global Employer Branding team on a
**one-year fixed-term contract based in Chennai.**
As our new colleague, you will support bringing our employer brand to life across your local market and all candidate touchpoints. You’ll play a hands-on part in executing our global employer branding strategy at a local level by creating engaging content, strengthening local talent pipelines, ensuring candidate experience, and building authentic connections with future candidates.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
You’ll join a collaborative team with employer branding colleagues across Denmark, USA, Hungary, and Philippines. In addition, you will partner with key local stakeholders, including HR and Marketing, combining creativity with data-driven insights to ensure our messaging resonates with priority audiences.
  
  
Your main responsibilities include:
  
  

* Adapt and activate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) in your local market.
* Plan, produce, and publish organic and paid content across relevant social media platforms, aligned with global frameworks but tailored to local talent segments.
* Organize and participate in career events, university collaborations, and community initiatives to strengthen our visibility and talent pipelines.
* Support and execute local projects such as employer certifications ensuring alignment with global strategies and timelines.
* Contribute to employee advocacy programs and initiatives that amplify authentic employee stories.
* Act as a trusted advisor on local talent trends, channels, and candidate expectations to continuously improve outreach and recruitment efforts.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in marketing, communications, HR with atleast 1-3 years of experience in employer branding, recruitment marketing, content marketing.
* Strong written and visual storytelling skills with the ability to adapt tones for different audiences and channels.
* Hands-on experience with social media platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, etc.) and content management tools like Sprinklr.
* Event management and planning experience.

It is a plus if you also have:
  
  

* Familiarity with graphic design or video editing tools (e.g. Adobe Creative Suite).

**Why you will love working here**
Day to day, you can look forward to:
  
  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, and home working opportunities.
* Six days' additional paid leave as common closure and for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programs to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  
**Apply today!**
