title: Content Creator Intern
description:
About us

HEPZ Content House is a social media and personal branding agency based in Chennai. We build and manage content for creators and brands across Instagram, and We're looking for a fun, outgoing, Instagram-savvy person who LOVES being in front of the camera!

If you're someone who can talk to a camera like you're FaceTiming your best friend, has a naturally fun and edgy personality, and enjoys creating content, we might be looking for YOU.

**What you'll do:**

* Shoot short form videos per day from your own space (reels, talking head content, trend based videos, product or brand integrations)
* Deliver raw footage on time as per the daily content calendar
* Follow scripts and creative briefs shared by the content team
* Reshoot or adjust takes based on feedback
* Showing up with your personality and making videos feel natural, engaging, and relatable.
* Stay updated on Instagram trends, audio, and formats

Here's the best part:

You don't have to worry about coming up with content ideas, writing scripts, or editing videos.

**What you need:**

* A professional camera or an iPhone model with good video quality
* A well lit shooting space and a clean, presentable background
* Previous experience shooting content in front of the camera
* Someone who's EXTREMELY comfortable in front of the camera. (A fun, outgoing, and slightly edgy personality - Someone who can speak naturally on camera without sounding like they're reading a script)
* An Instagram-savvy person who understands trends, reels, and internet culture.
* Someone who's enthusiastic about content creation and willing to learn.
* Someone who can bring their own personality and energy into videos.
* Reliable internet connection for uploading footage daily
* Ability to work independently and stick to deadlines

**Preferred:**

Do you need prior experience?

Absolutely not!

Freshers are welcome. Even if you've never worked as a content creator before, you can apply.

If you have the personality, confidence, and willingness to learn, we'll personally help you understand everything that goes into creating great content.

**Details**

Location: Remote

Stipend: ₹7,000/month

Duration: 2 Months with an Opportunity to transition into a full-time role after the internship, depending on your performance, potential, and mutual interest.

**Growth**

This is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to learn content creation hands-on and understand how a brand builds its presence on Instagram.

Bonus points if you share a video of yourself talking to the camera. We want to see your personality, not just your resume!

This internship is designed as a pathway into a full time role with us. Interns who consistently deliver quality content and meet deadlines through the 2 months will be offered a full time position on the content team.

title: Talent Vendor Management Strategy Lead – Vice President
description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we shape it. Embark on a transformative journey as Talent Vendor Mgmt Strategy Lead – Vice President, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our Talent function. As a member of the Talent Vendor Mgmt team, you will lead the build-out of strategic vendors to deliver Talent products and services. You will identify and drive opportunities to enhance vendor experience, effectiveness, efficiency and control. Additionally, you will assist in supporting colleagues with understanding and navigating and E2E vendor processes.
  
  
**To be successful as a Talent Vendor Management Strategy Lead – Vice President, you should have experience with:**

* Team player with demonstrable people leadership skills and able to work collaboratively and partner with multiple stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Prior experience in working with RPOs.
* Excellent problem-solving skills: demonstrated ability to analyse data, structure complex problems, develop solutions.
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work proactively in ambiguous environments and ability to manage multiple tasks/projects and a diverse set of stakeholders across different levels and parts of the business.
* Strong ability to work in a global and highly matrixed organization.
* Business and commercial acumen.
* 3rd party management skills.

**Additional Skills**

* Strong ability to work in a global and highly matrixed organization.
* Business and commercial acumen.
* Extensive Procurement/ Sourcing experience as well as experience of the HR Function.
* Third party management skills.
* Experience in managing RPO vendors
* Experience in Prof Hiring/ Exec Recruitment/Campus or Early Careers.
* Working knowledge of Workday.
* Adaptable and fast learner

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
Any UG/PG Degree.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role will be based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To monitor existing Barclays supplier relationships and operations to mitigate risk to the Bank and our customers.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of existing Barclays suppliers relationships by developing Management Information (MI) that meets the needs of the bank and complies with quality and control standards.
* Development of service level agreements to guide service delivery aligned to time efficiency and support the monitoring of service performance.
* Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to align services to the clients’ needs and the banks objectives.
* Development and execution of service improvement initiatives that improve service efficiency and competitive advantage in the marketplace.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: On-site Technology Support Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**On\-site Technology Support Specialist**
**(Associate)**
**Enterprise Technology (ET)**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
   

  

 The On\-site Technology Support Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing multiple technology support activities. This professional demonstrates ability to prioritize tasks, working with multiple software and hardware technologies, in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Facilitate and support the provisioning and deprovisioning processing, including setting up of hardware/software for new hires, and receiving hardware from separating employees.
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Under minimal supervision, provide after\-hours service for escalated issues and tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Assist with off\-site technology support for firm sponsored functions/meetings.
* Assist with IT tasks related to office moves, buildouts and relocations.
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* The role receives direct oversight from a supervisor with regular contact to assign and monitor activities
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Effective analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.
* Experience in Service Now such as Incident Management, Change Management, etc
* Experience in NexThink Tool
* Decision making responsibilities are generally limited to addressing a single end\-user issue; ability to be able to prioritize incidents being worked on and communicate those priorities to end users as necessary.
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 2\-4 years of experience in end user technology support


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GMS-Senior-SSO-CIAM-Airlock
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cyber Managed Services – Identity and access Management – Airlock SSO/CIAM Senior**
We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Airlock SSO/CIAM or similar product to join our operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Airlock SSO and CIAM solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, provide expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Airlock SSO/CIAM-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Configure and troubleshoot access issues, MFA methods, risk-based authentication rules, and user-profile issues.
* Diagnose complex authentication failures, service degradation, and system outages.
* Perform technical and change-impact analysis for platform, policy, and application changes.
* Maintain installation, configuration, deployment, patching, upgrades, and post-change validation.
* Maintain incident remediation, root-cause, prevention, and operational documentation.
* Monitor platform, directory infrastructure, backups, and integrations for potential issues.
* Develop and maintain SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Coordinate with technical teams, security leads, stakeholders, and product vendors.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to knowledge-management activities.
* Produce service-level reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for service improvement.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, ITIL processes, change controls, and documentation standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of overall Identity and Access Management experience, including strong hands-on experience with Airlock Access Management or similar.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* Advanced experience in Airlock SSO operations, configuration and troubleshooting,
* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience with one or more enterprise Access Management products such as Airlock, Okta, PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, Azure MFA, or RSA.
* Ability to manage authentication policies, selectors, sessions, identity profiles, protocol endpoints, OAuth scopes, client registration policies, grant mappings, token mappings, and OIDC policies.
* Experience with application onboarding, IdP configuration, patch/version upgrades, and production rollout.
* Good knowledge of authentication, authorization, provisioning, IAM, and core security concepts.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, or Unix operating-system internals and monitoring tools.
* Experience in ITIL-based service management and supporting sglobal or remote teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL or equivalent certification is preferred.
* CIAM, Microsoft Azure, or AWS certification or similar sssssis an advantage.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in shifts and provide on-call support as required.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Client Support Analyst
description:
Join FE fundinfo as a Client Support Analyst and play a vital role in delivering exceptional customer experiences while supporting global clients across industry-leading investment fund data and technology solutions.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity to build your expertise within a global financial technology organisation, working closely with international clients and cross-functional teams. You will gain exposure to specialist products, develop strong product and financial market knowledge, and contribute directly to client satisfaction and business success. With opportunities to collaborate across global offices and expand your professional capabilities, this role offers both personal growth and meaningful impact in a dynamic and customer-focused environment.
  
  
FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!
  
  
**Your key responsibilities as a Client Support Analyst will include:**

* Manage customer enquiries and issues received through calls, emails, chats, and customer portals, ensuring accurate classification, prioritisation, and resolution within agreed service levels.
* Investigate and resolve client issues and requests at first level wherever possible, escalating to technical and data teams when required.
* Deliver a professional, customer-centric support experience that enhances client satisfaction and strengthens customer relationships.
* Meet defined service level agreements, resolution targets, quality standards, and first-contact resolution objectives.
* Coordinate effectively with internal resolver teams and provide timely updates and communications to customers throughout the case lifecycle.
* Continuously enhance product and market knowledge and contribute to knowledge articles and service documentation.

**You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Client Support Analyst:**

* You must have a minimum of 2 years' experience in customer support, service desk, application support, or product support environments.
* You will have excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to confidently engage with international customers.
* You will have a good understanding of MS Office tools and experience using service desk or support management systems.
* You should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within service targets.
* You will be able to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and knowledge of the financial services industry or fund data will be an advantage.

**By joining the team as a Client Support Analyst, you will be offered the following:**

* 24 days of annual leave (pre-booked)

* Enhanced paternity and maternity leave
* Statutory benefits including Provident Fund (PF) and gratuity
* Support to set up your home office

* Annual health check-up
* Meal cards
* Full access to LinkedIn Learning for continuous development and career growth

title: Associate Account Manager
description:
At Quantcast, we don't just build advertising technology, we revolutionize how it works. Our AI-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI-driven DSP. Our AI doesn't just optimize—it delivers the measurable outcomes that matter most to our clients, giving them the competitive edge they need in a crowded marketplace. Ready to join the team that's defining the future of digital advertising?
  
  
We are hiring an Associate Account Manager to join our Chennai team. In this role, you will own the success of a portfolio of SMB and long-tail customer accounts while partnering with Field Account Managers to provide operational support to strategic Tier 1 customers.
  
  
As a client-facing account manager, you will combine programmatic advertising expertise, operational excellence, analytical thinking, and strong relationship management skills to deliver measurable customer outcomes and build long-term partnerships.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own a portfolio of SMB and long-tail customer accounts, serving as the primary partner for campaign success, customer relationships and business outcomes.
* Partner with Field Account Managers to support strategic Tier 1 customers through campaign execution, operational coordination and customer success initiatives.
* Partner with cross-functional teams throughout the campaign lifecycle, supporting setup, launch and QA while owning client communication, performance reporting, optimization recommendations, troubleshooting and overall campaign success.
* Analyze campaign performance, pacing, targeting, creative and measurement insights to identify optimization opportunities.
* Translate campaign data into actionable recommendations aligned with customer goals and KPIs.
* Own customer reporting, performance insights and business reviews to drive value and transparency.
* Ensure accurate tracking and measurement through pixel, tag, attribution and conversion validation.
* Identify opportunities for account growth through optimization, product adoption, upselling/cross selling and proactive account management.
* Collaborate with Sales, Account Management and other cross functional teams to deliver strong customer outcomes.

Who You Are
  
  

* 2–4 years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic advertising, account management, customer success, campaign management with demonstrated working experience directly with Clients, Advertisers, Brands, Agencies or external stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of campaign management, optimization, reporting, and digital measurement.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with leading DSPs including DV360, The Trade Desk (TTD), Amazon DSP, Stack Adapt, Simpli.fi and other programmatic platforms. Working knowledge of Floodlight tags, tracking pixels, Google Tag Manager (GTM), conversion tracking and GA4 measurement solutions preferred.

At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. On top of a competitive salary, this position includes a performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. For more details, visit our Careers Page and see how we support our team. We are headquartered in San Francisco with offices around the world. Quantcast is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see the Applicant Privacy Notice for details on our applicant privacy policy. Join the team that unlocks potential.

title: Benefits Operation Manager
description:

Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.
  
  
**Great Place to Work**
Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards
**Click Here.**
We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com .
  
  
**Designation-Benefits Operations Manager (BOM)**
**Key Expectations**

* Own and manage overall operational performance for assigned client(s).
* Consistently meet or exceed contractual performance standards and SLAs.
* Ensure on time, high quality delivery of all ongoing work to plan sponsors and participants.
* Drive operational efficiency through process improvements and effective resource planning.
* Build strong client relationships and act as a trusted point of contact for clients and partners.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to build a high performing operations team.

**Required Skills**

* Strong domain expertise in the US Pension / 401k Benefits Administration.
* Proven ability to manage SLAs, operational metrics, and client performance measures.
* Strong stakeholder management and client communication skills.
* Ability to lead teams, manage workloads, and drive capability building.
* Analytical and critical thinking
* Accountability and ownership

**Role Description**
The
**Benefits Operations Manager (BOM)**
is accountable for managing operational performance for assigned client(s), ensuring that contractual performance standards and defined operational measures are consistently met or exceeded. The role is responsible for ensuring all ongoing work is delivered on time and with high quality to plan sponsors and plan participants.
  
  
The BOM owns operational delivery for assigned clients, ensures process integrity and governance, manages escalations, and coordinates across teams, technology, and shared services. The role requires a strong understanding of client contractual agreements, client satisfaction, operational stability, change governance, and risk management, performance measures, and plan provisions, and being recognized as a subject matter expert in the domain.
  
  
The incumbent leads and manages BOA workloads, including work allocation, SLA tracking, SOP review, and approval, identifying training and cross training opportunities, and driving transitions to Shared Services where applicable. The role also partners closely with technology teams to ensure timely project completion, quality testing, and overall project signoff.
  
  
In addition, the BOM drives continuous improvement through process optimization, capacity, and resource planning, and delivers client specific operational training while fostering a culture of trust, collaboration, and coaching within the team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Client & Operations Ownership
  
  

* Manage assigned benefits administration deliverables within defined SLAs (internal and external)
* Responsible for operations delivery for assigned clients in coordination with North America based colleagues
* Act as the client SME for complex, client‑specific requirements, processes, and interpretations
* Proactively identify operational risks and potential client‑facing issues and drive timely resolution

Escalation & Issue Management
  
  

* Act as escalation owner for client and participant issues
* Propose and take actions to resolve issues outside documented SOP scenarios
* Communicate with all stakeholders, significant risks or issues as required
* Create and ensure RCAs are completed, reviewed, and client ready
* Manage open defects in coordination with technology team members to ensure mitigation plans and impacted population cleanup are in place

SOPs & Governance
  
  

* Own and maintain SOPs for delivery processes
* Support governance for operational delivery quality

Projects
  
  

* Work with internal teams and clients to implement requirements for one‑time and ongoing projects with operational impact
* Coordinate with Technology Managers and internal teams to document requirements related to:
* Plan provisions
* Administrative events
* Data interfaces
* Delivery channels
* Partner with Client Technology Managers (CTM) for acceptance testing execution

Stakeholder Communication
  
  

* Maintain regular communication with delivery team colleagues (North America and India) and external clients to share operational insights, project progress, risks and mitigation plans
* Co-facilitate internal operational delivery discussions (North America & India) communicating status of delivery, risk, and work allocations for the team.

**Education & Experience Education:**

* Graduate

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in US Pension / 401k Benefits Administration
* Prior experience with Alight / Wipro(Alight account) is an added advantage

Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.
  
  
Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Serves as the main contact for individual contracts, providing extensive business processes, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge. Provides services, adjusting to ensure alignment, and educates customers on ways to leverage Oracle services. Reviews service requests and gathers information to determine next steps, identifies potential crises, leveraging extensive knowledge and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions, and connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions, anticipating and reporting pain points. Develops and maintains plans and ensures positive margins, seeks opportunities to review and update documentation, and leverages understanding and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals. Proactively provides ongoing maintenance, mentors team members to act as a liaison between teams, and seeks opportunities to improve customer ability to adopt product and service changes. Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways of delivering services, provides direction, experiments with new approaches, and seeks opportunities to share product/support information, and plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological business, and industry trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement:**

* Serves as the main point of contact for individual-level contracts, providing advanced business process, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge in an advisory manner.
* Provides timely services, adjusting to ensure alignment with their practices, procedures, contractual budgets, leveraging contractual agreements and identifying revisions.
* Maintains customer relations, communicating with customers and across related teams regularly to ensure satisfaction. Provides updates on customer status to leadership.
* Educates customers on the most effective and efficient way to leverage Oracle services, products, and tools, experimenting with new approaches and providing feedback on customer organization performance.

**Issue Resolution:**

* Reviews service requests and gathers information from appropriate parties to determine next steps.
* Identifies potential crises or concerns and works to resolve customer issues and incidents in a timely manner, leveraging advanced knowledge of appropriate resources and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions.
* Connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions and minimize impact on the business, anticipating and reporting pain points to minimize impact on the business.

**Account Management and Governance:**

* Develops and maintains service delivery and/or project plans throughout their lifecycle and ensures positive margins according to governance and account management expectations and contracted terms.
* Proactively updates and maintains accurate customer account, contract, and service history information, identifying and addressing areas missing information.
* Independently and proactively conducts account planning and account reviews, tracking and communicating status on a wide range of projects including risk identification and mitigation recommendations.
* Seeks opportunities to review and update documentation and collaborates with peers to maintain contract cost, resources and scheduling, and scope, working to meet contract revenue and margin objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business needs and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for custom new opportunities and contract renewals.

**Technical Delivery Management:**

* Proactively advises customers on optimal use and health or their Oracle product/service investment, proactively providing ongoing maintenance to optimize and ensure effectiveness and performance of the product and/or service.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams, driving the execution and development of technical delivery plans.
* Mentors more junior team members to act as a liaison between customers, internal, and external teams.
* Seeks opportunities to increase customer understanding and improve their ability to adopt product and service changes according to policies and best practices.

**Innovation and Continuous Improvement:**

* Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways to deliver service and improve overall product and service utilization to achieve ROI goals.
* Contributes to the team by providing guidance, experimenting with new approaches, and seeking opportunities to share knowledge of product, service, and/or support information or issues.
* Identifies and recommends opportunities for enhanced value for services.
* Plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological, business, and industry trends.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

description:
**Program Head - Enterprise Product Services (EPS)-TAC Experience is must**

**Location:**
Chennai

**Why join Movate?**

At Movate, you are joining a fast-growing, innovative force redefining the digital services

landscape. In an era shaped by AI and services-as-software, Movate stands out as a nimble,

disruptive player that has doubled in size over the past four years. You will work with cuttingedge

technologies and a dynamic leadership team driving meaningful digital transformation. Our

culture is defined by DREAM: Dare to excel, Respect people, Emulate integrity, Act with agility,

and Make customer success the top priority. Movate fosters continuous learning and growth

through strong development programs, contributes to communities through impactful CSR

initiatives, and celebrates a fun, vibrant culture that blends passion, purpose, and innovation,

making it more than a workplace, but a thriving community shaping the digital future.

**About Movate:**

Movate is a digital technology and customer experience services company committed to

disrupting the industry with boundless agility, human-centered innovation, and an unwavering

focus on client outcomes. We partner with ambitious, growth-oriented enterprises across

industries, helping them stay ahead of the curve through our diverse workforce of over 12,000

full-time Movators across 20 global locations, and a gig network of thousands of technology

experts in 60 countries, speaking more than 100 languages. With this scale and expertise,

Movate has emerged as one of the most awarded and analyst-recognized companies in its

revenue range.

Through our W(AI)VE™ framework, we help enterprises amplify growth with AI, driving

engineering excellence, operational efficiency, and measurable business impact. We enable

organizations to adopt AI-first strategies, challenge the ordinary, and become truly outcome driven.

Our enterprise AI suite – MOVA iO, establishes a strong AI foundation for modern businesses,

powering human-AI collaboration across functions. Adaptive, modular, and scalable, it

integrates with existing architectures to deliver tailored results and lasting advantage.

**Role Overview**

The TAC Program Head, Enterprise Product Services (EPS), leads a large-scale global portfolio spanning Technical Assistance Center (TAC) and Enterprise Product Support, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Managed Services.

The role combines delivery leadership, P&L ownership, executive customer governance, AI-led service transformation, and people leadership across complex enterprise and XaaS environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Profitable Growth**

* Grow the portfolio profitably by transforming services with AI.
* Own the portfolio P&L and deliver results by influencing internal and external stakeholders.

**Global TAC & Enterprise Product Support Delivery**

* Lead 24x7 global TAC and enterprise product support operations across L1, L2, and L3.
* Own delivery performance across SLAs, CSAT, quality, productivity, case resolution, backlog, aging, and escalations.
* Lead support across enterprise software cybersecurity TAC.
* Establish operating rhythms, governance, risk controls, and service improvement programs across accounts.
* Improve first-contact resolution, mean time to resolution (MTTR), knowledge reuse, engineer productivity, and customer experience.
* Ensure workforce coverage, capacity planning, technical readiness, and business continuity for high-availability operations.

**Operational Excellence & Service Transformation**

* Define and institutionalize delivery frameworks, support methodologies, governance standards, and operational playbooks.
* Lead transformation initiatives covering workflow redesign, Digital TAC, self-service, knowledge management, analytics, and automation.
* Improve operational predictability through performance dashboards, proactive risk identification, and structured root-cause elimination.
* Govern transitions for new programs, scope expansions, platform changes, and complex service migrations.
* Promote proactive and preventive support models to reduce repeat incidents and improve product experience.
* Ensure compliance with customer security, audit, and service management requirements.

**Customer Leadership & Executive Governance**

* Build trusted relationships with customers at all organizational levels.
* Act as the senior delivery sponsor for strategic enterprise and technology customers.
* Partner with customer executives, product leaders, engineering teams, support stakeholders, and customer success organizations.
* Lead executive business reviews, service governance forums, critical escalations, recovery programs, and improvement initiatives.
* Serve as the executive escalation point for mission-critical outages (Sev-1/Sev-2), leading incident response and protecting customer trust during severe disruptions.

**Financial, Commercial & Portfolio Ownership**

* Own portfolio financial outcomes, including revenue assurance, delivery margin, cost governance, utilization, productivity, and investment priorities.
* Drive workforce optimization, pyramid effectiveness, location strategy, and automation-led productivity without compromising service quality.
* Partner with Sales, Solutions, Finance, Transition, Workforce Management, and Account Teams on new-logo and account-growth pursuits.
* Identify margin-improvement and revenue-expansion opportunities across existing accounts.
* Balance customer outcomes, employee capability, delivery resilience, and commercial discipline.

**AI-Powered Support & Digital Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI copilots, intelligent automation, analytics, and digital support models across the EPS lifecycle.
* Advance use cases such as:
* Intelligent case triage
* Case summarization
* Log analytics
* Knowledge recommendation
* Agent assistance
* Next-best-action guidance
* Expand self-service, assisted support, proactive insights, and predictive operations to improve customer and engineer experiences.
* Define measurable business value for AI initiatives across productivity, quality, resolution speed, customer satisfaction, and cost-to-serve.
* Partner with Technology, Product, and Innovation teams to industrialize reusable accelerators and support solutions.

**Customer Success, Professional Services & Managed Services**

* Lead customer onboarding, adoption, engagement, technical account management, renewal support, and lifecycle services.
* Oversee professional services including product implementation, integration, deployment advisory, upgrades, and remote services.
* Ensure architectural integrity, delivery quality, knowledge transfer, and smooth handover into managed support.
* Align support, customer success, professional services, product engineering, and account teams.
* Drive consistent customer outcomes across the full enterprise product lifecycle.

**People & Organization Leadership**

* Build leaders and teams that sustain a positive, high-performance culture grounded in technical mastery and continuous upskilling.
* Lead and mentor delivery leaders, support managers, technical managers, architects, specialists, engineers, and enabling teams.
* Build leadership bench strength, succession depth, technical capability, and a culture of ownership and customer centricity.
* Establish skill frameworks, certification pathways, career development programs, leadership development initiatives, and targeted capability-building plans.
* Drive engagement, performance discipline, collaboration, innovation, and execution excellence across distributed teams.
* Create a talent strategy aligned to portfolio growth, technology evolution, and future customer requirements to recruit, retain, and develop top-tier technical support talent.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in Technical Support, TAC Operations, Enterprise Product Support, Managed Services, Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technology Service Delivery.
* Proven track record of managing large global teams (700+ headcount) across multiple time zones and regions including AMER, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.
* Experience with enterprise-grade technical environments such as Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Enterprise Software.
* Significant senior leadership experience managing large, complex, multi-client and multi-technology global delivery operations.
* Deep understanding of L1, L2, and L3 support models, escalation management, knowledge operations, service governance, and technical support metrics.
* Proven ownership of operational and financial outcomes, including service quality, CSAT, productivity, revenue, margin, and organizational scale.
* Executive customer-management experience across business reviews, critical escalations, transformation discussions, retention, and account growth.

on Instagram and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Our Vision**
To Be the Advantage That Helps Our Customers Win.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Creating packaging solutions for life’s essentials.
  
  
**Job Requisition #:**
036164 Senior Manager Global Deployment (Open)
  
  
**Job Description**
Owns everything needed to bring Greif plants and their people fully online on Greif+, across 126 plants in four regions between 2027 and 2028. The Head of Global Rollout sets the rollout strategy and launch sequence, owns plant data and process readiness, runs deployment from the first data pull through go-live and stabilization, and makes sure every plant employee who uses Greif+ is trained, set up and working on it. The role is accountable for every plant going live ready, on time and within budget, and for each plant running on the platform as intended before it is handed to the customer-facing teams for customer onboarding. It leads the deployment and data teams and is accountable for building a rollout organization that gets better with every wave, by coaching and growing its leaders and analysts and keeping enough redundancy that no launch depends on a single person. The role works closely with the Platform Delivery Manager and Platform Architect, who build and release the platform capability the rollout depends on; with Customer Success and marketing communications, who own customer onboarding and communications; and with plant, regional and business leadership across Greif.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Lead the Global Rollout organization: the Deployment Leads and, through them, the Deployment Analysts; the Project Manager; and the Data Coordinator and, through that role, the Business Data Analysts, including hiring, people management and development.
* Own the rollout strategy: the global deployment model and playbook, readiness standards, go-live criteria, and the launch sequence by region and plant, balancing business priority, plant readiness and team capacity.
* Own the integrated rollout plan across waves and plants, including schedules, dependencies, the critical path, and risks, issues and decisions.
* Own plant data readiness: extraction, cleansing, mapping, validation and load of master and transactional data, with the quality thresholds each plant must meet before go-live.
* Own plant process readiness: confirm how each plant will work on Greif+, test local requests against the global template, and route genuine platform changes through the Greif+ intake process.
* Own deployment execution from the initial data pull through system configuration, testing, cutover, go-live and post-launch stabilization, working with the Platform Delivery Manager and Platform Architect on releases, environments and integrations.
* Own onboarding and enablement for plant personnel: role-based training, user access and roles, job aids, train-the-trainer networks and local super users, so every employee who touches Greif+ can do their job on day one.
* Prepare plant and regional leadership for each launch: readiness reviews, local IT, security and legal clearance, cutover staffing and hypercare support.
* Make the go-live decision for each launch against the published criteria, and escalate any launch with an open exception or unmet criterion to the Director of Digital Products.
* Measure plant adoption after launch, including system usage, order and data accuracy, and process compliance, and close the gaps before each plant is handed to business-as-usual support.
* Hand each plant over to the customer-facing teams ready for customer onboarding, and coordinate the timing; customer activation and communications are owned by Customer Success and marketing communications.
* Report rollout progress, readiness, adoption and risk to the Director of Digital Products and the program steering committee.
* Manage the Global Rollout budget, including resource planning, contractor and vendor spend, statements of work, and capital and expense forecasting.
* Coach, mentor and grow the rollout team, and keep enough redundancy in skills, knowledge and critical roles that no launch depends on a single person.
* Run a retrospective after each wave and turn the lessons into updated standards, playbook changes and improvement items for the platform.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain or a related field; master's degree or MBA preferred. PMP, PgMP or equivalent program management certification preferred.

**Experience**

* Ten or more years in enterprise technology deployment, including leading wave-based, multi-site ERP, ecommerce or digital platform rollouts across several countries, from planning and data migration through end-user training and post-launch stabilization.
* At least five years running a program of launches end to end with budget ownership and executive reporting, and at least five years managing people, including managers of teams.
* Manufacturing or industrial B2B experience is preferred.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Deployment strategy and program management: playbooks, readiness and go-live criteria, integrated planning, and critical path and RAID management.
* Data migration and governance: master data, data quality thresholds, reconciliation and load for multi-site launches.
* Site readiness, process alignment, testing, cutover and hypercare for multi-site ERP or ecommerce launches.
* Organizational change, training design and end-user enablement in plant or operations environments.
* Leading and growing distributed teams, including leaders of teams and contract resources.
* Budget, resource and vendor management, including capital versus expense tracking.
* Working knowledge of ERP-integrated B2B ecommerce, ideally Infor LN and Optimizely.
* Clear communication with executives, plant leadership and distributed teams across cultures and time zones; additional languages relevant to Greif's regions are a plus.

**Work Environment**
Full-time Greif employee. Hybrid, working to the rollout wave calendar with distributed teams across North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia Pacific. Uses Greif-issued accounts and tools and follows Greif information security, confidentiality and acceptable-use policies. Travel up to 30%, including international travel to plants and regional offices around launches. Time is recorded in Jira against capitalizable build work and expensed run work so that eligible effort can be capitalized.

, we believe that our colleagues are the center of our success. Our Total Rewards have a comprehensive focus on well-being and offer a competitive package that enables you to thrive, be engaged, and reach your full potential.

description:
**Twin Health**
At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.
  
  
We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
  
  
**Working here**
Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
  
  
Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
  
  
With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
  
  
Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will build altdiet's online presence and turn it into sales. Half of the role is brand and social media: content, influencers and campaigns that grow our reach. The other half is revenue: driving online orders, launching our products on marketplaces like Amazon and Flipkart, and bringing in corporate orders for gifting, employee wellness and bulk purchases.
  
  
It suits someone who enjoys both creating content and closing a deal, and who wants to see the direct impact of their work on a growing brand.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Online presence and social media**

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn: plan, create, schedule and publish content.
* Create posts, reels, stories, short videos and graphics that explain our products and the science behind them in simple language.
* Build and run a monthly content calendar tied to product launches, festivals and offers.
* Grow followers and engagement and reply to comments and DMs promptly.

**Influencers and community**

* Find and onboard health, fitness, diabetes-care and food creators who fit the brand.
* Coordinate product dispatch, campaign briefs, posting timelines and performance tracking.
* Collect and share customer reviews, testimonials and recipe content.

**Campaigns and website**

* Plan and run digital campaigns, product launches, seasonal promotions and special offers.
* Support packaging design updates, website banners, landing pages and product listings on nutriaura.in.
* Set up and monitor Meta and Google ads, including retargeting, with the team.

**Marketplace launches**

* Launch and list our products on other ecommerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, BigBasket, and quick-commerce apps (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart).
* Handle seller account setup, catalogue listings, product images, descriptions, pricing and compliance details.
* Manage marketplace ads, deals and ratings, and track sales and stock on each platform.

**Sales and corporate orders**

* Research and generate leads for corporate gifting, employee wellness programs and bulk orders.
* Reach out to HR, admin and procurement teams; prepare pitches, quotes and festive gifting catalogues.
* Follow up on leads through to order and maintain a simple sales pipeline.
* Explore tie-ups with gyms, clinics, dietitians and wellness centres.

**Reporting**

* Track social, ads, marketplace and sales metrics weekly.
* Share a monthly report with what worked, what didn't, and recommendations to grow reach and conversions.

What success looks like in 90 days
  
  

* A consistent posting rhythm on all channels, run from a monthly content calendar.
* Products listed and selling on at least two new ecommerce platforms.
* A pipeline of 10+ qualified corporate leads, with the first bulk or gifting orders closed.
* A monthly performance report the team uses to decide next steps.

**Skills And Qualifications**
**Must have**

* Graduate in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, Nutrition or a related field, with 2–4 years of experience in digital marketing, ecommerce or B2B sales.
* A track record of growing social media channels or online sales, ideally for a consumer brand, and a genuine interest in health and wellness.
* Good written and spoken English; Tamil is a strong plus.
* Hands-on with Canva, CapCut or Adobe tools, and Meta Business Suite or similar schedulers.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and companies, and following up until a deal closes.
* Organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage several tasks independently.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub or quick-commerce seller panels.
* Basic knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Google Analytics.
* A personal or professional portfolio of reels, designs or pages you have grown.
* Prior experience in FMCG, food or D2C brands.

**To apply:**
send your resume and 2–3 samples of your work (reels, designs, social pages or campaigns) to [lalitha.radhakrishnan@twinhealth.com], with the subject line "Digital Marketing & Sales Executive".
  
  
We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
Unpaid Internship | Opportunity for a Paid Full-Time Role

Company: Flowzo | California Software Company Limited

Location: Chennai — Work from office

Eligibility: Students, final-year students and recent graduates

Experience: No prior professional experience required

Compensation: This is an unpaid internship. No stipend is provided.

About Flowzo

Flowzo develops business software that helps companies manage customer relationships, sales, marketing and customer engagement. Our products include CRM, WhatsApp marketing and automation, email sequencing and business calling solutions.

We are looking for enthusiastic Digital Marketing Interns who want to learn how to promote software products, create useful content, generate business enquiries and measure marketing results.

About the internship

You will work with our marketing, sales and product teams to understand customer needs and communicate how Flowzo’s products can help businesses.

This opportunity suits candidates who enjoy writing, social media, design, research or analytics and want to build practical experience in B2B digital marketing. Responsibilities will be assigned based on your skills and learning progress.

Key responsibilities

1. Social media marketing

- Assist in planning and maintaining a social media content calendar.

- Create and publish approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and other relevant channels.

- Develop ideas for educational posts, product highlights, carousels and short videos.

- Monitor engagement and identify topics that interest our target customers.

2. Content creation

- Draft social media captions, blog articles, email content and website copy.

- Explain product features through clear business use cases.

- Create marketing materials using Canva or similar tools.

- Assist with product demonstrations, video scripts and promotional content.

- Use AI tools to support research and drafting, while checking accuracy and originality.

3. Search engine optimisation

- Research keywords relevant to our products and target industries.

- Assist with page titles, descriptions, headings and internal links.

- Identify opportunities to improve existing website content.

- Track search performance and prepare basic SEO reports under guidance.

4. Campaign support

- Assist with the preparation of Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn campaigns.

- Research audiences, keywords and advertising ideas.

- Help prepare campaign copy, creatives and landing page content.

- Monitor campaign results and compile reports under supervision.

5. Email marketing, webinars and lead generation

- Assist in preparing email campaigns, newsletters and webinar invitations.

- Research relevant industries, companies and customer segments.

- Support webinar promotion, registrations and follow-up activities.

- Coordinate with the sales team to record and track marketing enquiries in CRM.

6. Marketing analytics

- Track website visits, social media engagement, enquiries and conversions.

- Maintain simple campaign reports using Excel or Google Sheets.

- Compare content and campaign performance.

- Suggest improvements based on results and team feedback.

Who can apply?

- Candidates pursuing or recently completing a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, Communications, English, Computer Science or a related discipline.

- Graduates from other disciplines with a strong interest in digital marketing are also welcome.

- Candidates available for a work-from-office internship in Chennai.

- Applicants willing to learn, meet deadlines and take ownership of assigned work.

Essential skills

- Good written English and clear communication.

- Creativity and the ability to explain ideas simply.

- Basic familiarity with social media platforms.

- Attention to detail and willingness to review work carefully.

- Basic knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to research, organise information and work collaboratively.

Skills that are an advantage

Exposure to any of the following is welcome; you are not expected to know every tool:

- Design and video: Canva, CapCut or other editing tools.

- SEO and analytics: Google Analytics, Google Search Console and keyword research tools.

- Advertising Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager or LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

- Marketing operations: Email marketing platforms, CRM systems or WhatsApp Business tools.

- AI-assisted marketing: Tools for content ideas, research and creative production.

Academic projects, personal blogs, college campaigns, social media pages and sample creatives can demonstrate your interest and ability.

What you will learn

- How B2B software products are positioned and marketed.

- How to turn product features into customer-focused content.

- How social media, SEO, advertising and email campaigns support lead generation.

- How marketing and sales teams work together through CRM.

- How to measure results and improve marketing activities.

- How to use marketing and AI tools responsibly, with human review.

Performance and full-time opportunity

Your performance will be assessed on:

- Learning progress and application of feedback.

- Quality, accuracy and creativity of work.

- Consistency, reliability and timely completion of tasks.

- Teamwork, communication and ownership.

- Ability to interpret results and suggest useful improvements.

Interns who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a paid, full-time Digital Marketing role, subject to available openings and business requirements. Full-time conversion is not guaranteed.

How to apply

Please submit your resume and include:

- A short note explaining your interest in digital marketing.

- Your earliest joining date and availability.

- Your preferred area: content, social media, SEO, advertising or analytics.

- Links or samples of any relevant work, if available.

Mail : hr@calsoftgroup.com

* Please note: This is an unpaid internship based at our Chennai office. Apply only if you are comfortable with these terms.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**About ITHI:**
ITHI is a tech platform that connects filmmakers across the

24 crafts of film, from ideation to screen, with web and iOS and Android apps. It is a small

team in Hyderabad, moving from Banjara Hills to Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills. Planned

growth includes community building, events, workshops and master classes.

**ITHI culture: what every role must fit**

ITHI hires people who treat their work as a craft, own the result and say the truth early.

These six traits are drawn from how the team works today (small team, daily stand-ups,

blunt but kind reviews, a cinematic, detail-first product).

**Role Overview.**
Marketing and sales are one of ITHI's two core pillars, alongside tech. The

platform is live and free, and the goal now is to bring filmmakers across the 24 crafts onto

it and keep them engaged. We are looking for a Marketing Head who owns the plan, the

community, the events and the numbers, and who still does the work hands-on. You will

think like a brand architect and execute like a builder, in a small team with no layers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Go-to-market and growth**

Build and run the go-to-market plan for filmmakers, crew, studios and film schools:

positioning, messaging, channels, monthly targets and a budget.

**Own sign-ups and activation:**

* Define the funnel from first visit to a completed profile
* and first collaboration, and improve each step. Run performance campaigns within budget, test channels, and cut what does not
* work.
* Community, events and partnerships
* Lead community building: filmmaker meetups, workshops, master classes and
* campus drives.
* Build partnerships with film schools, production houses, festivals and creator groups,
* and run events end to end: concept, speakers, venue, promotion, registrations and
* follow-up.

**Job Description**
:

Lead PR and creator outreach: press, film-industry influencers, ambassadors and

testimonials from active users.

**Brand, content and team**

* Set the content themes and brand voice with the design team, direct social media,
* content and email, and supervise the Social Media Manager.
* Review and elevate work before it goes out, and hire and manage freelancers and
* agencies, and later a small in-house team.

**Product partnership and reporting**

* Work with product and design: share user feedback, craft launch messaging for each
* release, and give the roadmap a market view.
* Report a small set of numbers every week: new sign-ups, activation rate, active users,
* event registrations, cost per sign-up and content reach. Present a monthly learning
* report to the founders.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3 to 6 years in marketing, with at least 1 to 2 years leading a channel, a function or a
* small team, ideally for a consumer, community, creator or media product.
* A record of growing an audience or user base from a small base, with the numbers you
* moved and how.
* Hands-on with social media, content, email and paid campaigns, able to do or review
* the work yourself .
* Experience planning and running events, workshops or communities.
* Comfortable with analytics (GA4, Meta Ads, spreadsheets) and setting targets from
* data.
* Strong written and spoken English: Telugu is a plus. Strong ownership in a small team
* with a limited budget.
* Cultural sensitivity and a genuine interest in cinema, storytelling and creative
* communities; honest, direct feedback with founders and the team.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in film, media, entertainment, OTT or creator platforms, or with the Telugu
* film community.
* Experience marketing a mobile app or a marketplace.
* Network of film schools, production houses, festivals or influencers in Hyderabad.
* Exposure to founder-led brands or early-stage platforms, and basic SEO and CRM
* tools.

**What good looks like in 90 days**

* A written 6-month marketing plan with targets, budget and owners, agreed with the
* founders.
* The weekly numbers above reported every Monday, with a baseline and a clear target
* for sign-ups.
* At least one filmmaker event or workshop run end to end, and two partnerships (film
* school, studio or creator group) signed.

**How we will assess.**
A 60-minute working session: bring or build a 90-day plan to grow

ITHI sign-ups to a target you propose, with a budget of your choice, and defend the

channels, numbers and trade-offs.

**What we offer.**
Pay discussed at interview, based on experience and results. A 3-month

probation, direct work with the founders, and the chance to build the marketing function

of a filmmaker platform from the start.

**How to apply.**
Send your resume to
**hr@ithi.world**
.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Content Specialist – Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, with regular availability during Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$12,000 annually
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to create and publish marketing content for residential properties.
  
  
You will turn property details, photographs, and video clips into attractive online listings, edited images, virtually furnished rooms, and short property videos.
  
  
This is a hands-on content-production role—not a senior marketing-strategy or paid-advertising position. You must be creative, organized, comfortable using AI tools, and able to manage multiple properties without allowing information to become inaccurate or outdated.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Identify the strongest selling points of each property.
* Write clear and engaging property titles and descriptions.
* Create and publish listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
* Adapt content to meet each platform’s format and requirements.
* Select and organize the strongest property photographs.
* Complete light photo editing, including cropping, lighting improvements, resizing, and appropriate AI-assisted cleanup.
* Use AI tools to remove temporary clutter from property photographs when appropriate.
* Virtually furnish or stage photographs of empty rooms using AI tools.
* Create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
* Create AI-assisted videos using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers when required.
* Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, HeyGen, and comparable AI image or video platforms.
* Review AI-generated content and correct visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors.
* Update prices, availability, photographs, and property information promptly.
* Remove or update listings when properties are no longer available.
* Keep an accurate record of every active listing and its current status.
* Manage competing deadlines and prioritize urgent corrections.
* Respond professionally to creative feedback and complete revisions promptly.
* Coordinate with the leasing team when information or materials are missing.

AI and editing tools may be used to improve presentation, but content must remain accurate. Permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities must never be changed or misrepresented.
  
  
What You’ll Need
  
  

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable role.
* Candidates with less experience may be considered if they provide a strong portfolio.
* Experience creating online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s most attractive selling points.
* Experience using Canva, CapCut, or comparable design and video-editing tools.
* Experience using AI tools for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging.
* Experience using HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool.
* Good creative and visual judgment.
* Strong attention to detail and information accuracy.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, and deadline management.
* Ability to manage several properties and content requests at the same time.
* Ability to receive feedback without becoming defensive and revise work promptly.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment.
* Availability to work full-time with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours.

Experience with residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not mandatory.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is preferred but, not required. Demonstrated skill, relevant experience, and the quality of your portfolio are more important.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is both creative and highly organized.
  
  
You should be comfortable improving imperfect source material, choosing the best way to present a property, learning new AI tools, and managing repetitive work without sacrificing quality.
  
  
You must know the difference between improving the presentation of a property and creating content that could mislead a renter.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of at least two of the following:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

Ensure the portfolio link does not require a password or access request.
  
  
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.
