title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
* 🌴
 **Time Off:** 
 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

description:

**Description**
The Marketing Agentic Content Engineer will build and continuously improve the AI-powered agents and workflows that move content from generation through review, translation, and publishing — connecting tools such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, and similar systems. This role owns both ends of that pipeline: the technical integrations that move content through the system, and the prompt engineering and quality practices that shape what the AI actually produces, including the brand, messaging, legal, and compliance guardrails required across Infor's specialized industry verticals (e.g., Food & Beverage, Manufacturing & Distribution). This role will partner closely with marketing content owners, creative teams, marketing operations, and process owners to ensure what gets built holds up in real production use and reflects brand and messaging guidelines, positioning, workflow requirements, approved images, and other stakeholder requirements.
  
  
This role is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building automated or agentic workflows with LLM platforms, who also know how to improve what those platforms produce — not just move it through a pipeline faster. Candidates should be able to take process direction from a review team and turn it into a working technical solution, connect their build work to broader process and strategic goals, and treat output quality as a core part of the job rather than a downstream concern. This is an individual contributor role focused on hands-on build, workflow design, and AI output quality.
  
  
**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**

* Build and maintain agentic workflows moving content from AI generation into staging and publishing systems.
* Build and maintain prompt libraries and testing practices that improve AI output quality, reduce hallucinations, and strengthen brand-voice consistency.
* Define and apply content governance guardrails — brand, messaging, legal, and compliance — particularly for Infor's specialized industry verticals, in partnership with solution marketers.
* Partner with the content process review team to translate process findings and recommendations into working agentic workflows.
* Maintain and improve integrations between systems such as Claude, Canva, ContentHub, Sitecore, ClickUp, or other similar tools.
* Set up and manage translation workflows so content can be routed and published across markets.
* Troubleshoot breakdowns in the content pipeline and fix root causes, not just symptoms — whether the issue is a broken integration or a weak prompt.
* Work with marketing content owners to understand content needs and build workflows that match real team workflows.
* Document workflows so marketing operations can run and troubleshoot them without engineering support.
* Flag scaling risks or technical debt before they block the broader content program.
* Support the ongoing build-out of the AI content program as it scales across additional teams and use cases.
* Identify where a workflow or process fix could apply beyond its original use case, and raise it as a broader opportunity to the content process review team or program leadership.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 2-3 years building automated or agentic workflows using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, including API/tool use, not just chat-based prompting.
* Hands-on prompt engineering experience: building and testing prompts, measuring content quality, and reducing errors such as hallucinations or tone drift.
* Marketing content experience: understands content types, review/approval steps, and translation/localization needs.
* Experience integrating systems via API (webhooks, REST, or similar).
* Working experience with Canva's API or Canva-based content generation workflows.
* Experience translating process requirements or recommendations from a business or operations team into a technical build.
* Strong written communication skills, able to explain technical workflows to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and design for change in an evolving program.
* Ability to see beyond a single project and connect build work to wider team or organizational initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with ContentHub, Sitecore, Claude and/or ClickUp specifically.
* Experience setting up or managing translation/localization pipelines.
* Experience working alongside a process improvement, business analysis, or process review team.

title: Manager, Go-to-Market Strategy
description:
**Manager, Go-to-Market Strategy**

Strategy | Go-to-Market | Planning and Performance

**Only Candidates from Premium Institutes & Colleges**

**Location:**
Hyderabad  |  
**Experience:**
3 to 5 years  |  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

Our Client from Hyderabad has a joint venture with a Middle East Company.

**The Middle East**
headquartered company builds Physical Intelligence: technology that lets machines and infrastructure see, understand and act in the physical world. Our client is one of India's largest infrastructure companies, with work across irrigation, power, oil and gas, roads and defence.

The two come together to deliver complete solutions in India, from digitisation to AI to Physical Intelligence, for governments and enterprises. Their Mission is to make Physical Intelligence real at scale.

**About the Role**

As Manager, Go-to-Market Strategy, you will decide which markets to enter, which customers to approach first, and how to win them. You will lead each opportunity from the first meeting to a completed pilot. After the pilot, the sales team takes over and closes the deal.

You will also run the company's planning and performance cadence: the business reviews, the pipeline and goal tracking, the management reports and the board report.

You will report to the Head of Strategy, work closely with the CEO and the sales, solutions and delivery teams, and lead one Strategy Analyst.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Market Strategy**

•  
**Market selection:**
Identify and prioritise the industries, customers and geographies fabrIQ should enter, with a business case for each.

•  
**Positioning and offer:**
Define what we offer each market, how we position it against the alternatives, and how we price it.

•  
**Financial model:**
Build the end-to-end financial model for each go-to-market plan, covering market size, revenue, cost and return.

•  
**Market intelligence:**
Track what customers, competitors and governments in India and abroad are buying and deploying, and turn it into recommendations.

**2. Enterprise Customers**

•  
**Target accounts:**
Build the list of priority customers for each product and map the decision makers in each account.

•  
**Outreach and meetings:**
Lead outreach, secure first meetings with senior decision makers, and run those meetings.

•  
**Pilot conversion:**
Move each opportunity from first meeting to an agreed pilot, and see the pilot through to completion.

•  
**Sales handover:**
Hand each completed pilot to the sales team with the results, the business case and the full account history.

**3. Government Business**

•  
**State and programme focus:**
Identify the states, departments and programmes to focus on, and the type of project we should enter with.

•  
**Pilot design:**
Define the scope, location, size and success criteria of each pilot we propose.

•  
**Proposals:**
Prepare pilot proposals and concept notes from our existing solutions, and present them to government officials.

•  
**Government relationships:**
Manage the relationship with officials through proposal, approval and pilot, then hand over to the sales team.

**4. Planning and Performance**

•  
**Funnel tracking:**
Track outreach, response rates, channel performance, meetings, pilots and the revenue the sales team closes from them.

•  
**Course correction:**
Review the funnel every month, and change the target market, message or channel where results fall short.

•  
**Business reviews:**
Run the weekly and monthly business reviews with each function, and track every action to an owner and a date.

•  
**Pipeline and goals:**
Maintain the sales pipeline, conversion rates and progress against company goals, and flag risks early.

We're hiring a writer. Above everything else, you need to be an exceptional wordsmith with first-class written and spoken English. The way we produce content has changed. Design events that are meaningful and experiential - not transactional; every event must leave IDAs feeling genuinely valued, not marketed to. Coordinate with channel partners in Nagpur, Vadodara and Coimbatore for joint activations (typically 2 per city per year), sharing costs and planning responsibilities equally. Manage all event logistics: décor, catering, photography, collaterals, attendee gifts and vendor relationships across all cities. Run bi-annual events in Indore and Ahmedabad at premium hotel venues in the absence of an EC. Plan and execute loyalty experiences across five categories — Wild (adventure), Surge (sports & entertainment), Soul (wellness retreats), Detox (digital detox camps), and Learn (masterclasses and study tours) — ensuring every experience is curated to Keus's premium standards. Manage the IDA loyalty database in coordination with the CRM team; ensure tier accuracy, eligibility tracking, and timely communications for upgrades, renewals, and invitations. Track experience satisfaction (NPS), iterate on the programme annually, and report outcomes to the National BD Head.Gifting Programme — Occasion-Based & Interest-BasedManage the year-round gifting calendar: Diwali, New Year, birthdays, project completions, milestones and spontaneous relationship moments — with tier-appropriate gift values for Platinum, Gold, Silver and Open-tier IDAs. Curate interest-based gifts for Platinum and Gold IDAs based on known preferences (travel, food, fitness, art, literature, wellness, etc.) maintained in the IDA profile; no generic gifts. Source, quality-check, and manage gifting inventory and vendors across all cities; ensure packaging, presentation, and delivery are consistent with Keus's brand standards. Maintain a budget tracker for all gifting activity and raise flags if spend trends above plan. Major Exhibitions & Industry Events Plan and execute Keus's presence at major design and architecture exhibitions: India Design ID, ACETECH, ArchXpo, FOAID and regional design festivals. Own booth design, fabrication, product shipping, staff deployment, collaterals and post-exhibition IDA follow-up in coordination with city BD teams. Track qualified interactions at exhibitions and hand them over to the relevant city BD manager with full context. Manage architect society sponsorships and chapter event participation (IIA and equivalent bodies) across Hyderabad and Bangalore. Evaluate new exhibition opportunities annually and recommend participation based on IDA footprint and brand alignment. IDA Database & Engagement Intelligence Maintain and continuously enrich the IDA database: gifting preferences, loyalty tier history, event attendance, project completions, personal milestones, and engagement scores. Work with BD teams across cities to flag IDAs due for nurturing touchpoints; ensure no Platinum or Gold IDA goes unengaged for more than 30 days. Generate and distribute monthly engagement reports to the National BD Head covering event attendance, gifting delivery, loyalty participation and exhibition outcomes. Budget Ownership & Vendor Management Own the full annual budget for all activities in scope — events, gifting, loyalty experiences, architect hosting and exhibitions. Manage vendor empanelment, rate negotiations and quality audits across all cities. Reconcile actuals versus plan monthly; flag variances proactively and propose corrective action. Key Skills and Requirements Strong event planning and execution skills — comfortable owning an event from concept and invitation through execution to post-event debrief. Genuine luxury sensibility — an intuitive understanding of what makes a gift, experience or event feel premium versus generic; deep aversion to the ordinary. Vendor management and negotiation skills across categories: catering, décor, gifting, travel, logistics and exhibition build. Attention to detail and process discipline — able to manage multiple concurrent activations across cities without a single slip. Relationship orientation — able to engage with IDAs directly with warmth, professionalism and appropriate frequency. Comfort with CRM tools and data — able to query, update and act on the IDA database independently. Excellent written communication — invitation copy, gift notes and follow-up messages must reflect Keus's voice precisely. Qualifications 4–7 years of experience in event management, luxury brand marketing, loyalty programme management or IDA /architect community relations. Background in luxury hospitality, premium interior or lifestyle brands, fine jewellery, luxury automobiles or comparable categories is strongly preferred. Understanding of the architecture and interior design ecosystem — how IDAs think, what they value, how they interact with brands — is a significant advantage. Graduate in any discipline; post-graduation in marketing, hospitality management or event management is preferred. Gifting delivery accuracy: right tier, right gift, right moment — zero misses on birthdays and key occasions for Platinum. Loyalty experience NPS from participants.Exhibition interaction quality and BD handover rate. Budget adherence - actuals within 5% of approved annual plan. Key Competencies Luxury sensibility and brand pride, Ownership and relentless follow-through, Relationship orientation - warm, professional, consistent, Detail and process discipline, Creative curation - ability to make moments memorable What Keus Offers The opportunity to build and own Keus's IDA community engagement from the ground up — a role with full creative latitude and genuine impact. High ownership and direct visibility with the National BD Head and senior leadership. Competitive salary, performance-linked incentives and benefits. Professional growth into a leadership mandate as the BD programme scales. Keus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**About the job** 
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
   

  

 Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito\-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end\-to\-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical\-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
   

  

 As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito\-borne disease. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector\-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.
* Structure and negotiate operational models with partners by working with internal science and program manager teams to formulate field requirements with technical capabilities and program timelines.
* Evaluate opportunities, conduct due diligence, negotiating agreement terms, and working with cross\-functional teams to prepare and present recommendations to senior leadership. Ensure the consistent exercise of appropriate judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Identify, establish, and grow relationships with existing and new partners. Act as the central point of contact and maintain comprehensive account knowledge.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our Cloud Customer Support organization. In this role, you will independently investigate and resolve complex cloud and infrastructure challenges, driving customer issues through timely and effective resolution. You will collaborate with Engineering and Operations, mentor fellow engineers, and drive continuous improvements that strengthen service reliability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  
  
As a Senior Support Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical interface for OCI customers, applying strong technical judgment and structured troubleshooting to challenging production issues. You will work across cloud infrastructure technologies, analyze technical evidence, identify potential causes, and engage the appropriate teams when an issue requires cross-functional expertise.
  
  
You will own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, maintaining clear and proactive communication while balancing technical depth, urgency, and customer impact. Your work may involve complex or multi-technology scenarios where the resolution path is not immediately known, requiring independent investigation, effective technical judgment, and timely collaboration with subject matter experts to drive issues toward resolution.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the broader Support organization by sharing technical knowledge, mentoring engineers, improving troubleshooting practices and documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve support processes and customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer issues involving cloud infrastructure and related technologies.
* Own customer issues throughout the support lifecycle, driving timely progress while maintaining high standards of technical quality and customer communication.
* Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies using logs, telemetry, diagnostic tools, technical documentation, runbooks, and engineering experience to isolate problems and determine appropriate next steps.
* Troubleshoot across multiple infrastructure technologies, including compute, networking, operating systems, storage, virtualization, and related cloud services.
* Work effectively with customers during complex or business-impacting incidents, providing clear technical guidance, meaningful progress updates, and well-defined next steps.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Service Operations, and other technical teams to investigate cross-service issues, identify product-related issues, and restore customer services.
* Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise is required while continuing to maintain ownership of the customer experience and support engagement.
* Identify recurring technical and operational issues and contribute recommendations that improve troubleshooting effectiveness, service reliability, support processes, and customer experience.
* Create and improve technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks that enable consistent and efficient issue resolution.
* Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting techniques, and best practices with peers and mentor less-experienced engineers.
* Contribute to team projects and initiatives that improve support quality, operational efficiency, case handling, and customer outcomes.
* Capture key technical findings and lessons learned from customer incidents to improve organizational knowledge and future troubleshooting effectiveness.
* Continuously develop expertise across OCI services, cloud infrastructure, and technologies relevant to the supported environment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or a related technical filed.
* At least 4 years of relevant technical experience and at least 6 years of overall professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience supporting, operating, administering, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing and infrastructure concepts, with demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive effective resolution.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure technologies such as compute, networking, operating systems, storage, and virtualization.
* Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, diagnostic information, and other technical evidence to isolate issues and determine appropriate actions.
* Strong customer orientation and the ability to manage technically challenging customer situations with professionalism, urgency, and empathy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Operations, and other technical teams.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, apply that knowledge to customer problems, and share technical knowledge with others.
* Atleast 2 completed cloud certifications from recognized cloud providers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in cloud technical support, infrastructure support, production operations, NOC, SRE, systems engineering, or a comparable technical environment.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), particularly Compute, Storage and Networking.
* Hands-on troubleshooting experience with Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
* Knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with virtualization, storage, and distributed cloud infrastructure.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers and managing complex or business-impacting production incidents.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks.
* Familiarity with scripting, automation, diagnostic tooling, APIs, or software development concepts.
* Understanding of cloud security, operational best practices, and relevant industry security and compliance standards.

**Location & Work Schedule:**

* This is a full-time, permanent position based in Bengaluru, India.
* The role supports a global customer environment and requires flexibility to work assigned shifts, including rotational weekend and holiday coverage, based on business needs.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead our Digital Process Automation (DPA) initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with the Product Management, Policy Operations, and Content Operations teams to drive innovative automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce manual effort. The ideal candidate will also ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into the business unit's (BU) product suite of applications.
  
  
This role requires leveraging spec-driven development (an AI-native development approach) and influencing business stakeholders to align with this approach.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team focused on developing automation solutions for manual-intensive workflows.
* Collaborate with the Product Management and Business Operations teams to identify automation opportunities.
* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of automation solutions with an AI-first strategy.
* Provide technical direction by leveraging a strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, and guide the team in implementing AI-driven automation.
* Ensure strong collaboration with application development teams to seamlessly integrate automation solutions into the BU's product suite of applications, ensuring scalability and minimal disruption.
* Drive stakeholder management, ensuring effective communication and alignment of automation goals.
* Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to address complex business challenges.
* Utilize negotiation skills to balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.
* Stay updated on the latest AI, ML, and automation trends to drive innovation and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 4 years delivering AI solutions.
* Proven experience in Business Process Automation/Digital Process Automation.
* Strong technical expertise in Python; LLM architecture (transformers, embeddings, context windows); prompt engineering; LangChain/LangGraph or equivalents (LlamaIndex, CrewAI); RAG and vector databases (Pinecone/Qdrant/Chroma/pgvector/OpenSearch); agent and tool-calling frameworks, including MCP; evaluation frameworks (Ragas); LLMOps and tracing (Langfuse/Arize); and cloud AI services (Bedrock/Vertex/Azure OpenAI).
* Strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, with the ability to provide strategic direction to the team.
* Experience in stakeholder management, working with cross-functional teams, and aligning automation initiatives with business goals.
* Strong collaboration skills to ensure automation solutions are effectively integrated into the BU's product suite of applications.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast-paced environment.

title: Manager I, Amazon Now Ops, Central Operations
description:
**Description**
Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations (GSF CO) functions as the Command-and-Control Center for Fresh, SSD operations in India, Middle East and Singapore geographies, and Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) operations in India, Middle East, and North America. We partner strategically with Operations, business teams, ACES, and S&OP teams, providing expertise in capacity management, defect reduction, holiday planning, contingency management, and automation of redundant workflows.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own operational performance metrics for your assigned geographical region, conducting regular deep dives into data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
  
  
Identify and eliminate operational defects leading to negative customer experiences through root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures
  
  
Partner with operations teams to understand daily performance challenges, diagnose bottlenecks, and develop strategies to reduce quality issues and business waste
  
  
Represent Central Operations in business stakeholder meetings, effectively communicating operational status, challenges, and proposed solutions
  
  
Transform raw data into clear documentation, requirements, and actionable insights that drive process improvements across the organization .
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day begins with an in-depth analysis of the previous day's operational defects, using data to identify patterns and root causes. You'll collaborate with operations teams to understand the current day's performance status and potential challenges. Throughout the day, you'll brainstorm strategies to reduce operational costs and business waste, represent Central Operations in business calls with various stakeholders, and coordinate with the central CO team to provide necessary support where needed. You'll balance analytical work with cross-functional collaboration, all focused on improving customer experience
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team operates with a progressive mental model: Centralize processes, Standardize across geographies, Automate to reduce manual effort, and ultimately Eliminate unnecessary processes through hands-off-the-wheel automation. This creates an innovative environment where you'll have significant impact on improving customer experiences across multiple regions.

* 1+ years of employee and performance management experience

title: Specialist Manager - Security Infrastructure Monitoring - DSOC - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Manager - Security Infrastructure Monitoring Group Lead**
Do you excel in environments that require strong judgment, coordination, and operational discipline? As a Security Infrastructure Monitoring Group Lead within the US India Deloitte Security Operations Center (DSOC), you will lead critical alarm monitoring operations with a focus on service performance, issue resolution, and process consistency. You will play a key role in overseeing queue activity, supporting escalation management, coordinating troubleshooting efforts, and ensuring monitoring changes are executed accurately and validated effectively. Your leadership will directly contribute to the reliability of security monitoring operations and the safety of our people and facilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Security Infrastructure Monitoring Group Lead, you will be responsible for the volume, prioritization, and coordination-focused task of overseeing alarm monitoring operations, response and service performance of physical security devices. This role will concentrate on managing queue activity, detecting emerging issues, and ensuring timely escalation of sensor, video management, and access control systems per governing documentation. This role will be accountable for establishing consistent operating practices across shifts, improving monitoring reliability and ensuring security technology changes are implemented and validated effectively. The Group Lead will serve as the escalation point for complex monitoring events, recurring service issues, high-impact outages, and incidents requiring cross-functional coordination or leadership intervention. You will be responsible for coordinating troubleshooting, managing tuning and planned monitoring changes, confirming restoration and post-change validation, standing up communications channels and operational updates, and tracking false alarm trends and process improvement actions.
  
  

* Oversee analyst queue management and support timely response to alarm activity across video management, access control, intrusion, panic, audio, and related monitoring systems
* Establish operating standards, performance expectations, and quality controls for alarm triage, validation, escalation, dispatch, documentation, and incident closure
* Triage and validate escalated or ambiguous alarms, determine severity, and direct the appropriate response path based on established thresholds
* Coordinate with Watch Commander, site security, security vendors, and local responders during urgent or active incidents
* Lead escalation handling for complex incidents, recurring issues, and service disruptions requiring supervisory intervention
* Approve and communicate critical incident updates, escalation notices, and source-of-truth reporting when business or safety thresholds are met
* Coordinate troubleshooting for monitoring tool issues, including sensor, video, and access control integrations, working with internal and external support teams
* Manage tuning activities, test windows, and planned monitoring changes, and confirm restoration and post-change validation
* Support analyst decision-making, reinforce adherence to SOPs, and provide real-time guidance during high-volume or high-impact events
* Compile and disseminate routine operational updates, daily summaries, incident summaries, and queue performance metrics (e.g., response times, false/true positives) to the India DSOC Leader and other Office of Security stakeholders
* Maintain clear and timely communications with US DSOC stakeholders regarding operational issues, escalations, and approval requirements
* Lead recurring reviews of false alarms, nuisance alarms, missed events, delayed responses, and other performance trends to identify corrective actions
* Establish governance frameworks and define outcome-driven metrics for alarm monitoring performance (e.g., alarm response time, escalation accuracy, false-alarm rates, system availability, service-level performance, and incident closure time), including the development of executive-level reporting dashboards

**The team**
The Office of Security team supports the protection of Deloitte people, workplaces, operations, and assets across US India offices. This team partners across physical security, security technology operations, resilience, crisis coordination, and business stakeholders to strengthen preparedness, response, and operational continuity
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: Rotational shifts in 24/7 support**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Must be fluent in English
* 10 - 12 years of related experience in alarm monitoring, GSOC/SOC operations, security systems operations, or a similar high-volume monitoring environment
* 5+ years of experience in a lead, supervisory, or escalation management capacity
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across US and India teams, vendors, and technical support groups
* Demonstrated experience managing operational queues, incident escalations, and service coordination activities
* Ability to work rotational shifts or schedules as required to support 24/7 monitoring operations

Preferred:
  
  

* Prior experience in a corporate security operations center / Global SOC (GSOC), emergency dispatch center, or similar command-center environment
* Familiarity with physical security SOC platforms such as alarm automation tools, access control systems, video monitoring platforms, and incident management systems
* Experience supervising or guiding analysts in a real-time monitoring or incident response environment

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Security Operations Lead
description:
About the job

Our team

The Cybersecurity & Operations organisation protects Opella's people, products, data and manufacturing operations worldwide. The Security Operations team sits at its core, alongside Security Architecture, Governance, Risk & Compliance, M&S Cyber and Network, and the Operations Command Center, all reporting to the Cybersecurity Strategy & Operations Head. The team owns detection, response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management and the day-to-day governance of our external SOC partner.

Why this role matters now

The threat landscape has changed in kind, not only in degree. Adversaries now use AI to run reconnaissance, craft convincing lures in any language, discover and weaponise vulnerabilities, and adapt malware faster than an analyst can read a ticket. Attacks are initiated and iterated at machine speed and at a scale that no tiered analyst model can absorb. At the same time, the technology to answer them has arrived: AI agents that triage, enrich, investigate and contain under human governance.

We are looking for a leader who runs today's SOC with discipline and, in parallel, designs and delivers the SOC of the future: an agentic, AI-augmented operation in which people set intent, policy and guardrails while software acts at the speed of the attacker. This is a hands-on leadership role with a clear mandate for transformation.

Main responsibilities

Security operations leadership

* Lead, develop and empower the Security Operations team of four experts, setting clear priorities and growing the capabilities the agentic model demands: detection engineering, automation, data and AI literacy.
* Own the relationship with the external SOC provider, including daily operational check-ins, service levels, escalation paths, quality of detections and the continuous improvement plan.
* Run security operations governance: operational KPIs, monthly and quarterly reporting to the Cybersecurity Strategy & Operations Head and Digital leadership, and budget and vendor management for the SOC tool stack.
* Ensure alignment with Security Architecture, Governance, Risk & Compliance, M&S Cyber and Network and the Operations Command Center so that detection, response and recovery work as one system.

Vision: the SOC of the future, agentic by design

This is a core requirement of the role, not an aspiration. The successful candidate will:

* Define and own a multi-year vision and roadmap for an agentic SOC in which AI agents perform alert triage, enrichment, investigation, hypothesis testing and first-line containment, supervised by analysts whose work shifts from handling tickets to supervising, tuning and designing agents.
* Build the foundations that make agents trustworthy: a unified security data layer, detection-as-code with version control and testing, an orchestration layer through which agents act on SOAR, EDR, identity and network controls, and strong identity, least-privilege access and audit trails for every agent.
* Establish the governance model for autonomous action: which decisions agents may take alone, which require a human in the loop, how actions are explained and logged, how models are evaluated and monitored for drift, and how a human can halt an agent at any time.
* Reshape the external SOC engagement around outcomes and agentic capability rather than analyst hours, and co-design the roadmap with the provider.
* Measure the transformation with outcome metrics: mean time to detect and to contain, share of alerts resolved autonomously, false-positive rate, analyst hours returned to proactive work, and detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.
* Act as Opella's thought leader on AI in security operations, bringing in external research, peer benchmarks and vendor innovation, and translating them into pragmatic steps.

Defending at machine speed and at scale

The new reality is attacks initiated by AI, at machine speed and in volume. The role is expected to think and plan at that scale:

* Plan for a step change in volume: assume alert and event volumes grow by orders of magnitude, and design detection, data and response capacity that scales through automation rather than headcount.
* Pre-authorise machine-speed containment: agree with business and IT owners, ahead of time, the automated actions the SOC may take without waiting for a call (isolating endpoints, revoking sessions and tokens, blocking indicators, disabling accounts, quarantining mail), together with the guardrails and rollback paths that make them safe.
* Make speed to contain a first-class metric for the most likely AI-driven scenarios: credential abuse and token theft, automated exploitation of newly disclosed vulnerabilities, adaptive malware, and AI-generated social engineering including voice and video impersonation of executives.
* Harden the SOC's own AI against adversarial use, including prompt injection, data poisoning, evasion and abuse of agent permissions, with testing built into the release process.
* Move validation from annual to continuous: breach-and-attack simulation, adversary emulation of AI-driven campaigns and purple-team exercises, with findings flowing straight back into detections and playbooks.
* Prepare the organisation, not only the technology: identity-first containment, deception and canary signals, verified call-back procedures for Finance, P&C and executives against deepfake fraud, and crisis exercises that rehearse an incident unfolding in minutes rather than days.

Protection and monitoring

* Drive the automation of response to recurring security events across deployed technologies, with a measurable reduction of manual effort.
* Oversee detection coverage and quality across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, SaaS and OT environments, and the generation of operational intelligence through forensics, simulation and threat hunting.
* Ensure disciplined provisioning, de-provisioning and change control for security operations platforms.

Major incident response

* Act as incident commander for major cybersecurity incidents, coordinating the technical, business, legal and communications workstreams.
* Create and maintain incident response playbooks, including emergency scenarios and business impact analysis, and convert the most frequent ones into automated runbooks.
* Coordinate red, blue and purple team exercises and crisis simulations at least every twelve months, and update response plans from the findings.

Threat intelligence

* Direct the threat intelligence function so that intelligence on adversary tooling, including AI-enabled tradecraft, drives detection priorities, threat hunting and executive risk reporting.
* Integrate strategic, operational and tactical intelligence into the SOC data layer so that agents and analysts act on current context.

Vulnerability and asset management

* Oversee continuous vulnerability scanning across the organisation and drive remediation through a centralised vulnerability management solution, prioritised by exploitability and exposure.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, workplace and manufacturing teams on the IT/OT asset inventory, its classification and the funding of protective controls, and ensure asset context is available to incident response and the SOC.

Key relationships

Internally, the role works most closely with the Security Architecture Lead, the Governance, Risk & Compliance Lead, the M&S Cyber and Network Lead and the Operations Command Center Lead, who together with this position form the core of the Cybersecurity & Operations leadership team. Beyond the function, it partners with the Digital platform and infrastructure teams, Legal and Privacy, Internal Communications, P&C and Finance, and the manufacturing and supply sites whose OT environments the SOC monitors.

Externally, the role owns the relationship with the external SOC provider and its leadership, and represents Opella towards security technology vendors, threat intelligence sharing communities, national CERTs and law enforcement where an incident requires it, and the peer network of security operations leaders in the healthcare and consumer health sector.

About you

Experience

* Ten or more years of professional experience in cybersecurity, including at least five years leading security operations, a SOC or an incident response function (an equivalent combination of experience and education is accepted).
* Proven experience managing an external SOC or managed security service provider and holding it to outcomes.
* Experience as incident commander on major incidents in a large, international organisation.
* A track record of delivering automation in security operations (SOAR, detection-as-code, AI-assisted triage or investigation), ideally including early agentic use cases.

title: Head of Procurement, Delivery & Supply Chain Operations
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Head of Procurement, Delivery & Supply Chain Operations will manage the end-to-end procurement and delivery operations for construction materials across EPC, B2B and B2C customers.

The individual will be responsible for developing a network of MSME manufacturers, procuring materials directly from them at competitive prices, coordinating material availability and managing transportation and delivery to customer locations.

The objective is to ensure timely material availability, efficient delivery, cost control and profitable supply chain operations.

**Important:**
Procurement will be exclusively from MSME manufacturers and production units, not traders, distributors or intermediaries.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Procurement & Manufacturer Management**

1. Identify, onboard and manage MSME manufacturers of construction materials such as aggregates, bricks, cement and RMC.
2. Negotiate competitive procurement prices, credit terms and supply agreements.
3. Coordinate production and material availability based on customer orders and demand.
4. Ensure manufacturers meet quality, quantity and delivery commitments.
5. Build long-term relationships with manufacturers across operating locations.
6. Manage purchase orders and procurement documentation.

**B. Delivery & Logistics Management**

1. Manage end-to-end delivery for EPC, B2B and B2C customers.
2. Build and manage a network of transporters, fleet owners and drivers.
3. Coordinate with manufacturers for timely material readiness and dispatch.
4. Manage vehicle allocation, transportation, tracking and site delivery.
5. Negotiate transportation rates and control logistics costs.
6. Verify weighbridge records, delivery quantities and proof of delivery.
7. Resolve delivery delays and customer complaints.

**C. Supply Chain & Team Management**

1. Coordinate procurement, production and delivery schedules.
2. Ensure material availability and timely order fulfilment.
3. Control procurement and transportation costs to improve order profitability.
4. Build and manage Procurement and Delivery teams across operating locations.
5. Ensure effective use of technology for procurement, fleet management and delivery tracking.
6. Work closely with Sales, Finance and Technology teams.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* MSME manufacturers onboarded and active.
* Procurement volume and cost competitiveness.
* Manufacturer supply and quality compliance.
* On-time delivery percentage.
* Order fulfilment rate.
* Transportation cost per tonne / trip.
* Vehicle utilisation.
* Delivery cancellation rate.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Overall order profitability.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Graduate / MBA in Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics or Operations.
* 8–15 years of experience in procurement, logistics or supply chain management.
* Experience in direct procurement from MSME manufacturers.
* Experience managing transporters, fleet owners and drivers.
* Construction materials experience in aggregates, cement, bricks or RMC preferred.
* Experience managing operations across multiple locations.
* Good negotiation, team management and technology adoption skills.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Build a strong MSME manufacturer and transportation network.
* Lead Procurement and Delivery teams.
* Maintain strong relationships with manufacturers and logistics partners.
* Ensure operational discipline, cost control and accountability.
* Improve procurement margins and delivery efficiency.
* Scale operations across multiple states.

**Success Definition**

Build an efficient and profitable supply chain by procuring construction materials directly from MSME manufacturers and ensuring timely delivery to EPC, B2B and B2C customers at competitive costs.

The Head will be accountable for both Procurement and Delivery operations, from manufacturer sourcing to final customer delivery.

Srikara Group of Hospitals is looking for an IT Head to lead technology operations across its hospitals. The role will keep critical hospital systems available around the clock, strengthen information security, and help clinical and administrative teams use HIMS and HRMS effectively.

description:
**Role – Director – Enterprise Application Support (Supply Chain)**

**Job Location - Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)**

**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer.Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play.We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond.Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

* Leading application support teams responsible for enterprise eCommerce platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS) and Warehouse & logistics mgmt. systems
* The team monitors production services, detects issues early, and resolves operational and functional issues.
* As the Director of Enterprise Application Support team, you will play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring the robust performance of our systems in a highly transactional, global eCommerce environment

**Impact of the Role**

* Foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring robust system performance.
* Drive production stability and reliability throughout the year to prepare for peak-volume days and key events.
* Build urgency and accountability around customer problems and solve them quickly to minimize business loss.
* Improve operational efficiencies, supportability of new features, and overall system stability.
* Create a customer-first experience while ensuring high reliability and uptime

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

* Order Management System (OMS)
* Enterprise eCommerce platforms
* Supply Chain and Logistics systems
* Inventory Promising and Inventory Sourcing
* Payment Processing, Returns, MDM
* Microservices architecture
* Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog, New Relic
* PagerDuty, Opsgenie
* Enterprise Database platforms and database monitoring tools

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage cross skilled team of Application support responsible for supporting, maintaining and scaling eCommerce platform, IBM Sterling order management(OMS) and custom built microservices.
* Provide technical and functional leadership with deep knowledge in the above areas and contribute as a Supply Chain SME in product design, solution design, deployment, business reviews and third party vendor tool assessment discussion.
* Think strategically to evaluate the current state and create and execute a roadmap to build operational efficiencies, improve supportability of new features, and ensure high stability
* Take a highly accountable, hands-on approach to coach and lead teams to actively fix issues and continuously identify patterns for larger problem-solving efforts to avoid repeat issues.
* Manage leadership communication and ensure priority issues are closed end to end, even when this requires working across teams.
* Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Business teams to enhance system performance, optimize workflows, and improve product uptime.
* Develop and enforce disaster recovery and business continuity strategies to minimize service interruptions
* Build urgency and accountability around customer problems and solve them quickly to minimize business loss
* Apply technology and automation to improve monitoring, alerting, and issue resolution.
* Build strong teams with well-defined procedures and runbooks for triage and resolution.
* Build clearly defined and communicated SLAs, issue categories, points of contact, triage and decision trees, and hold teams accountable for them
* Develop and maintain a strong, real-time feedback loop with Development, Product, and Business teams to identify and implement improvements for issues that could be avoided through better design, coding, or monitoring
* Drive production stability and reliability efforts throughout the year to prepare for peak-volume days and key events
* Plan, organize, and manage assignments and operations by prioritizing and directing team activities
* Direct cross-functional teams using interactive and motivational leadership, including hiring, mentoring, performance appraisals, and career development.
* Mentor and guide senior engineers and managers, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability
* Define team structure and recruitment strategies to build a strong, diverse team
* Remain highly attentive and responsive to communication
* Operate a computer and communicate via telephone.

**Qualifications**

* Technology delivery and production support expertise for large-scale omnichannel operations teams.
* Experience managing a 24x7 enterprise support organization with the ability to drive incident management and root cause analysis.
* Proven track record of managing and scaling high-performing Operations teams, ideally in eCommerce, supply chain applications, or an enterprise-scale environment.
* Strong expertise in eCommerce platforms, IBM Sterling Order Management System (OMS), and integrated supply chain applications, including logistics, order fulfillment, and inventory management.
* Knowledge of transaction systems, inventory management, and order fulfillment processes.
* 15+ years of total hands-on technology experience with a focus on design, development, testing, and support activities.
* 5+ years of manager-level experience in a similar function.
* Experience building, evolving, and coaching teams on technology and process improvements.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

**Scope & Learnings**

Lead enterprise-wide reliability initiatives, shape SRE strategy, drive automation and observability, mentor engineering leaders, and influence technology strategy across Williams-Sonoma's global Supply Chain ecosystem.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Procurement Manager for the life sciences and clinical research industry to join our team in Hyderabad in a hybrid capacity. As a Procurement Manager, you will lead regional and virtual procurement teams and shape the sourcing, supplier management, and cost strategies that keep our clinical development business fully supported. This position plays a key role in supplier management, cost optimization, procurement compliance, and operational support. You will collaborate with cross-functional sourcing and project teams, follow industry-standard processes, and guide procurement activities from supplier selection through contract execution and ongoing performance management.
  
  
Responsibilities include leading procurement teams, managing Request for Proposal (RFP) projects and supplier agreements, overseeing major purchases, and applying strong data and cost analysis, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence business outcomes.
  
  
Strong procurement practices help our clinical development teams access the right partners and services, so every sourcing decision supports the delivery of new therapies. You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic sourcing, supplier performance, and cost savings. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Procurement Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across procurement and clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the regional and virtual Procurement team, providing a customer-focused, effective, and responsive service that fully supports the business, and provide procurement support to other Procurement locations as required.
* Provide customer-focused assistance to internal customers on key projects and requirements, share product and service expertise with peers, and maintain regular communication to understand and facilitate customer needs.
* Lead RFP projects, particularly in Selling, General and Administrative (SG&A) categories, developing negotiation strategies that deliver business objectives and cost savings or cost avoidance while running multiple projects at the same time under short and urgent timelines.
* Manage supplier qualification and RFx processes, including RFPs, assess and validate the capabilities of potential vendors, and approve vendors as appropriate.
* Manage and determine local supplier relationships, and work with staff to develop strategic sourcing initiatives that deliver optimum benefits in pricing and service levels, including assessing the benefits of local agreements.
* Manage local supplier agreements and contracts with cross-functional stakeholders, reach agreement on contract terms and conditions, and review and approve accordingly. Oversee major purchases and coordinate associated work with Buyers and Senior Buyers.
* Monitor and analyze local expenditure and supplier performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), conduct local key supplier reviews, and identify opportunities for improved sourcing.
* Evaluate supplier core competencies and competitive positioning, consolidate the supply base using industry cost models and system-level tools, and maintain awareness of local economic and business conditions and industry knowledge for key products and services.
* Complete Return on Investment (ROI) and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, apply strong data and cost analysis, and provide Procurement metrics, including minority supplier expenditure, to senior management.
* Provide consistent and streamlined processes and systems that comply with Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corporate procedures, manage Procurement role in local audits, and provide support on legislation such as the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).
* Deploy systems and processes that streamline overall purchase operations, recommend new or alternative systems and tools as appropriate, and keep supplier databases maintained and updated.
* Promote a team-oriented, trusting environment, provide performance feedback through formal appraisals, and support training and career development to maintain a professional, skilled staff.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in procurement principles, negotiation, and data and cost analysis.
* Managerial experience within a procurement environment and a proven ability to lead, organize, influence, and motivate others.
* The ability to collaborate across cross-functional sourcing and project teams and communicate clearly.
* A service-oriented approach to both internal and external customers and a commitment to team principles.
* Comfort working with cost models, system-level tools, and Procurement processes and SOPs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree or equivalent.
* Strong experience working within a procurement environment at a managerial level.
* Strong knowledge of procurement principles, theories, and processes, including Procurement SOPs and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to meet goals and deadlines while running multiple projects at the same time.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and negotiation skills, along with strong data and cost analytical skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Procurement within the life sciences and clinical industry is desirable.
* Prior project management experience, particularly in Selling, General and Administrative (SG&A) categories.
* Exposure to global operations and/or life sciences.
* Oracle and Salesforce experience in a global environment.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

The Director – Master Data Management will lead the Finance GBS master data capability from Hyderabad. The role is accountable for setting the strategic direction, governance framework, operating model, control environment and data quality agenda for Finance GBS master data while staying aligned to overall Enterprise MDM strategy. The Director will partner with global process owners, tower leads, Finance leadership, IT, compliance and audit teams to improve master data accuracy, strengthen controls, reduce downstream process issues and enable scalable service delivery across Finance GBS.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**MDM Strategy and Governance**

* Own the Finance GBS master data strategy, roadmap and operating model, covering both in-house and outsourced delivery.
* Establish global policies, standards, controls, ownership and decision rights for Finance master data.
* Provide governance across master data domains, regions and systems, including prioritization, escalation and exception management.
* Align MDM priorities with Finance GBS objectives, global process owners and business requirements.

**Global MDM Operations and Service Delivery**

* Lead the Hyderabad MDM organization and oversee end-to-end master data operations across customer, vendor, material and other applicable Finance data domains.
* Manage both in-house and outsourced delivery through clear accountabilities, service levels, operating routines and performance expectations.
* Ensure consistent execution of master data creation, maintenance, validation and deactivation in accordance with policies, controls and service expectations.
* Build and develop the MDM team, including organization structure, role clarity, capability development, performance management and succession coverage.
* Drive standardization of request intake, approvals, documentation and exception handling across regions and systems.

**Data Quality, Controls and Technology Enablement**

* Own the Finance GBS master data quality and control agenda, including KPIs, monitoring, issue remediation and audit readiness.
* Ensure master data processes comply with internal controls, segregation of duties, regulatory requirements and data governance standards.
* Partner with process owners and IT to address root causes of data issues and strengthen ERP workflows, validation rules, integrations and system controls.
* Represent Finance GBS MDM requirements in ERP changes, system enhancements and broader technology initiatives.

**Transformation and Capability Building**

* Own the MDM improvement roadmap, including process simplification, automation, workflow enhancement, data cleansing and duplicate reduction.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve service quality, productivity and control effectiveness.
* Strengthen functional capability through training, documentation, knowledge management and adoption of consistent MDM practices.
* Partner with Finance GBS transformation teams to connect master data improvements with broader process performance and value delivery.

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience / Expertise**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field required.
* Data governance, ERP, Six Sigma, PMP or master data management certifications are preferred.
* Experience in global manufacturing, technology, services, or complex multinational environments preferred.

**MDM and Finance Expertise**

* 18+ years of experience across master data management, Finance operations, GBS/shared services or data governance.
* Deep understanding of Finance master data and its impact on PTP, OTC, RTR, financial controls and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of MDM governance, data quality, ERP-enabled workflows, internal controls and audit requirements.
