title: Support Ops Manager II, Seller Fees
description:
**Description**
Lead a 20-person investigations team that decides whether sellers across the US, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil were charged the right fulfillment, storage, shipping, and warehousing fees — and makes it right when they weren't. You'll own quality, productivity, and service levels for a high-volume operation at the center of seller trust in Amazon's fulfillment network.
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon is built around Amazon's world-class capability in ordering, fulfillment, transportation, and customer service. By leveraging our scale and supply chain, it gives third-party sellers a low-cost way to fulfill orders and rapidly grow their business. When a seller disputes a charge — a fulfillment fee based on an incorrect product weight or dimension, a storage or removal fee, a refund for a cancelled partnered-carrier shipment, a warehousing charge, or a carrier billing difference against their shipment plan — your team investigates the evidence and delivers a fair, consistent answer. We believe consistency is the foundation of world-class seller service, and this role is where it's engineered.
  
  
**As The Leader, You Will**

* Own the quality, productivity, and service-level outcomes for a production investigations operation serving sellers in the US, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil.
* Set goals and direction for multiple investigation workstreams, from automated dimension-based fee reviews to complex carrier billing disputes.
* Build the mechanisms that help your people grow: coaching, development paths, and the next generation of leaders on the team.
* Partner with product, tech, finance, and global operations teams to remove friction, automate what should be automated, and reshape how fee disputes get resolved.
* Write the documents that move decisions — business reviews, support strategies, and improvement proposals read by senior leaders.

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead a team of 20 investigation specialists to meet or exceed quality, productivity, and turnaround targets across all fee dispute workstreams
* Own day-to-day operations: capacity planning, queue health, prioritization, and service-level recovery during volume spikes
* Set goals, priorities, and roadmap for your functions, aligned to the broader organization's strategy
* Audit investigation outcomes for accuracy and consistency; drive root-cause fixes through coaching, guideline updates, or tooling
* Hire, onboard, and develop bar-raising talent with customized onboarding and individual development plans
* Run regular 1:1s, huddles, and open forums; evaluate performance, participate in calibration, and lead promotion and performance-improvement conversations with empathy.
* Identify and grow future leaders; build succession depth for key roles
* Partner with stakeholders teams across India and globally to influence priorities and reach consensus
* Write clear, high-impact documents — business reviews, support strategies, root-cause analyses — and present them to senior leadership
* Drive process improvement and automation: remove inefficiencies, enhance procedures, define new metrics, and sponsor tool development
* Foster an inclusive environment where every specialist feels valued, heard, and connected to their impact.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of team management experience
* 8+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
* Experience using data to influence business decisions
* Experience across the domain of risk management & compliance operations
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (esp. MS Excel, Word) at an advanced level

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in operational excellence using six sigma methodologies
* MBA in relevant field of operations

title: Business Development Agri MBA
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Agri-Business Development Executive & Brand Presenter

Company: PlantsShip

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Department: Business Development & Brand Development

Employment Type: Full-Time

Qualification: MBA in Agriculture / Agri-Business Management preferred

Experience: 1–4 Years (Freshers with excellent communication, presentation and business development skills may also apply)

Salary: As per experience and candidate capabilities

⸻

1. About PlantsShip

PlantsShip is an emerging landscaping and horticulture enterprise headquartered in Hyderabad, specialising in comprehensive landscaping solutions, nursery operations and plant supply.

Our expertise includes:

\* Landscape development and execution.

\* Softscape and hardscape development.

\* Indoor and outdoor landscaping.

\* Irrigation systems and automation.

\* Tree transplantation and mature tree relocation.

\* Nursery development and plant supply.

\* Palm and avenue plantation.

\* Landscape maintenance and AMC services.

\* Commercial, residential and infrastructure landscaping projects.

We work with real estate developers, architects, infrastructure companies, corporates, hospitality businesses and other institutional clients.

Our Vision

Our ambition is to establish PlantsShip as a leading integrated landscaping, horticulture and plant export enterprise, with a strong presence across India and international markets.

We believe in combining horticultural expertise, professional execution, technology and innovative business practices to build sustainable green environments.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and confident Agri-MBA professional who can contribute to business growth, represent our brand and educate customers about landscaping and horticulture.

2. Job Overview

This is a combined Business Development and Brand Presentation role.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, generating qualified landscaping leads, developing client relationships, arranging meetings and converting enquiries into projects.

Along with business development, the candidate will represent PlantsShip in front of the camera through educational videos, plant knowledge sessions, landscaping presentations, project showcases and promotional content.

The ideal candidate should have a genuine interest in agriculture, horticulture, landscaping, communication and business development.

She should be comfortable interacting with business owners, architects, builders, developers, consultants and corporate decision-makers.

3. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Business Development & Lead Generation

\* Identify and generate business opportunities for landscaping and horticulture projects.

\* Approach real estate developers, builders, architects, landscape consultants, infrastructure companies and corporate clients.

\* Develop a database of potential customers and business prospects.

\* Generate leads through LinkedIn, Instagram, Google, industry directories, networking and direct client outreach.

\* Make outbound calls, introduce PlantsShip’s services and arrange business meetings.

\* Understand client requirements and identify potential landscaping project opportunities.

\* Coordinate with the technical and estimation teams for site visits, BOQs, proposals and quotations.

\* Follow up on submitted quotations and proposals.

\* Develop long-term relationships with architects, developers, contractors and decision-makers.

\* Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed projects.

\* Maintain an updated lead tracker and CRM database.

\* Achieve monthly lead generation, meeting and business conversion targets.

B. Client Acquisition & Relationship Management

\* Conduct introductory meetings with prospective customers.

\* Present PlantsShip’s services, capabilities and completed projects.

\* Understand customer expectations, budgets and project requirements.

\* Coordinate with internal teams for technical discussions and project presentations.

\* Follow up with customers until enquiries reach closure.

\* Maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective clients.

\* Participate in exhibitions, networking events, business meetings and industry programmes.

\* Identify opportunities for repeat business and referrals.

C. Brand Presentation & Camera Handling

\* Represent PlantsShip as a presenter in front of the camera.

\* Present educational and informative videos related to plants, landscaping and horticulture.

\* Explain different plant varieties, their characteristics, benefits and applications.

\* Present landscaping concepts, softscape, hardscape and irrigation solutions.

\* Explain indoor and outdoor landscaping applications.

\* Participate in Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos and other digital content programmes.

\* Present PlantsShip’s completed projects, nursery operations and business capabilities.

\* Develop confidence in explaining technical landscaping topics to general audiences.

\* Participate in promotional videos, customer awareness programmes and brand campaigns.

\* Coordinate with the content and digital marketing team for video scripts and presentation planning.

D. Landscaping & Horticulture Knowledge Development

\* Develop practical knowledge of landscaping execution and horticultural practices.

\* Understand ornamental plants, indoor plants, outdoor plants, palms, avenue trees and flowering plants.

\* Learn plant identification, characteristics, maintenance and suitability for different locations.

\* Understand softscape, hardscape, irrigation systems and landscape maintenance.

\* Develop knowledge of nursery production, plant procurement and plantation methods.

\* Understand basic landscape drawings, BOQs, specifications and project costing.

\* Visit nurseries and landscaping project sites to improve technical knowledge.

\* Explain the benefits of professional landscaping to customers.

\* Continuously upgrade knowledge about new plant varieties, horticulture practices and landscaping trends.

E. Marketing Coordination & Lead Conversion

\* Coordinate with the digital marketing team for content planning and campaign execution.

\* Identify relevant landscaping and horticulture topics for social media content.

\* Convert social media enquiries into qualified business leads.

\* Support the marketing team with customer-focused content ideas.

\* Monitor enquiries generated through Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other platforms.

\* Coordinate with the marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.

\* Participate in promotional activities and brand-building initiatives.

Note: Video editing, social media posting, paid advertising, SEO and campaign analytics will primarily remain the responsibility of the digital marketing team. The candidate will focus on presentation, content knowledge and business development.

4. Desired Candidate Profile

Educational Qualification

\* MBA in Agriculture / Agri-Business Management preferred.

\* Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture or related disciplines.

\* Candidates with an MBA in Marketing and a strong agriculture or horticulture background may also be considered.

Experience

\* 1–4 years of experience in business development, agricultural business, horticulture, nursery operations, landscaping or related industries.

\* Freshers with excellent communication, presentation and business development aptitude can be considered.

Communication & Presentation Skills

\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

\* Good English and Telugu communication; Hindi is an added advantage.

\* Strong public-speaking and presentation abilities.

\* Confidence in facing the camera.

\* Ability to explain technical subjects in simple language.

\* Professional approach while interacting with clients.

Business Development Skills

\* Ability to identify potential customers and generate leads independently.

\* Strong follow-up and relationship-building capabilities.

\* Negotiation and client-handling skills.

\* Target-oriented and revenue-focused mindset.

\* Ability to arrange meetings and convert business opportunities.

\* Willingness to travel for client meetings and project visits.

Technical & Digital Skills

\* Basic knowledge of agriculture, horticulture and plant varieties.

\* Interest in landscaping and nursery management.

\* Basic understanding of social media platforms.

\* Familiarity with MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint and CRM software.

\* Willingness to learn AI-based productivity and marketing tools.

5. Working Requirements

\* Willingness to travel to client locations, landscaping sites and nurseries.

\* Comfortable presenting in front of a camera.

\* Willingness to participate in exhibitions and industry events.

\* Ability to work collaboratively with business development, horticulture, operations and digital marketing teams.

6. Career Growth Opportunities

Based on performance and business contribution, the candidate can grow into positions such as:

\* Senior Business Development Executive.

\* Key Account Manager.

\* Business Development Manager – Landscaping.

\* Brand & Business Development Lead.

\* Head of Business Development.

PlantsShip offers an opportunity to grow with an ambitious company and gain exposure to large-scale landscaping, horticulture, nursery and international business opportunities.

7. Why Join PlantsShip?

\* Opportunity to work in a growing landscaping and horticulture enterprise.

\* Exposure to large residential, commercial and infrastructure projects.

\* Opportunity to interact with leading developers, architects and industry professionals.

\* Opportunity to develop expertise in landscaping and horticulture.

\* Opportunity to become a recognised presenter representing the PlantsShip brand.

\* Professional growth through business development, client acquisition and brand-building responsibilities.

\* Opportunity to contribute directly to the company’s long-term growth vision.

Candidates with previous experience in public speaking, video presentation, social media content or business development are encouraged to share sample videos or presentation links.

•     Understand customer transport, freight, fleet, and logistics processes, gather requirements, and convert them into clear inputs for the product and technical teams.

**Client & Implementation Coordination**

•     Act as the single point of contact between the client and the in-house implementation team through onboarding, training, and go-live.

•     Track timelines, keep clients informed, and handle queries and escalations through to resolution.

**Account Management & Long-Term Relationships**

•     Build long-term client relationships through regular check-ins; monitor usage and satisfaction and drive renewals, upsell, and referrals.

•     Share customer feedback and market insights with the product team and provide regular reports to management.

**Requirements**

**Experience & Domain Knowledge**

•     3–5 years in software or SaaS sales, business development, or client-facing roles, preferably in logistics, transport, freight, fleet, or supply chain.

•     Good understanding of logistics operations: freight procurement, load posting, vehicle types, dispatch, proof of delivery, and freight billing.

•     Familiarity with how manufacturing and engineering companies move goods, including dispatch, stores and warehouse processes, and gate and vehicle movement.

•     Exposure to TMS, Freight/Fleet Management, or ERP software preferred; understanding of freight bidding (L1/L2/L3) is a plus.

**Working with Shippers (Manufacturing, Engineering & Other Sectors)**

•     Ability to engage plant heads, logistics and supply chain managers, stores and warehouse teams, and purchase and finance teams.

•     Skill in showing how our platform replaces phone-and-spreadsheet freight buying with transparent bidding, better rates, and an audit trail.

•     Comfort with on-site demos at plants and warehouses, and with speaking to both senior management and stores staff.

**Working with Transporters & Fleet Owners**

•     Ability to onboard transporters, fleet owners, and drivers with limited technology exposure, and explain bidding, driver assignment, e-KYC, and delivery proof simply.

•     Understanding of transporter concerns such as timely payments, load availability, and fair bidding; fluency in English, Hindi, and Telugu preferred.

**Sales & Client Handling**

•     Proven record in lead generation, demos, requirement gathering, negotiation, and closing deals.

•     Experience as the link between clients and implementation or technical teams, and in building long-term client relationships.

•     Strong communication and presentation skills; good working knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and reporting.

•     Self-driven, comfortable handling sales and client operations together, with willingness to travel locally and regionally.

**Key Skills**

Business Development | Software Sales | Logistics Domain | Freight Bidding | Shipper & Transporter Engagement | Lead Generation | Product Demos | Requirement Gathering | Client & Account Management | Implementation Coordination

title: Account Manager — Client Retention & Sales
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$35,000–C$45,000 annually, including base pay and performance bonuses
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage existing client relationships, retain dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, sell relevant services, and keep multiple active files moving from beginning to completion.
  
  
MoveSmart operates in residential leasing, but direct real-estate experience is preferred—not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
  
  
You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will coordinate the leasing process, monitor listing performance, present applications and offers, recommend changes, and keep the owner informed through tenant move-in.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service or administrative position. You will be responsible for both the client relationship and the commercial performance of your assigned files.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Manage multiple active client and leasing files
* Keep property owners informed throughout the process
* Confirm that each file is complete and ready to be listed
* Coordinate listing requirements with the partner brokerage
* Monitor inquiries, showings, feedback, applications, and offers
* Identify why a property is not attracting interest or offers
* Recommend pricing, marketing, presentation, or property-condition changes
* Persuade owners to make reasonable price adjustments
* Present qualified tenant offers and secure timely decisions
* Retain dissatisfied owners who may be considering cancellation
* Sell appropriate services that could improve a property’s leasing performance
* Handle objections while maintaining the owner’s trust
* Coordinate documents, deposits, keys, and move-in requirements
* Communicate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams
* Verify payment and payout information before providing updates
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and next steps
* Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, client success, client retention, leasing, property management, portfolio management, or a similar client-facing role
* Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales
* Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to take action
* Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering relationships
* Confidence recommending price changes, service improvements, or other actions clients may initially resist
* Ability to use evidence, customer feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions
* Experience upselling relevant services or solutions
* Ability to manage multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities simultaneously
* Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management
* Experience using a structured CRM or workflow system
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Sound judgment when handling client concerns and escalations
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours

Strong candidates may come from account management, customer success, SaaS, insurance, financial services, staffing, telecommunications, automotive sales, hospitality, property management, real estate, or another service-based industry involving ongoing client ownership.
  
  
Canadian real-estate experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live scenario-based interview.
  
  
**Compensation**
This position offers expected annual compensation of approximately
**C$35,000–C$45,000**
, consisting of base pay plus performance bonuses.
  
  
Actual earnings will depend on individual performance. Complete compensation terms will be explained during the interview process.
  
  
Remote-Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A private professional workspace
* Dual monitors
* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Reliable internet of at least 100 Mbps
* A webcam
* A noise-cancelling headset

Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person combines the organization of an experienced Account Manager with the confidence of a consultative salesperson.
  
  
You should be able to identify what is preventing a client’s file from progressing, explain the evidence, recommend a solution, overcome resistance, and obtain a clear decision.
  
  
You must be persuasive without being misleading or overly aggressive. You should be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations while maintaining the client’s trust.

title: GPM - Core Platform, Senior Manager
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**In this role you will..**

What the role is about: You will be responsible for leading and planning large, complex, strategic programs that span multiple teams, product components, or a full product theme, for near-term and future delivery of our products and services. Your daily responsibilities will be varied and influential, including directing other project and program managers, leading and collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving activities to achieve program goals, and engaging directly with Directors, VPs, and company leadership to ensure high levels of communication and awareness. The business objective is defined; the approach, sequencing, and execution mechanisms across interdependent workstreams are yours to design. This role will also determine horizontal dependency programs to ensure visibility and alignment across the Product Organization and other key stakeholders.

Global Program Managers are responsible for overseeing the entire product introduction process. This requires someone adept at integrating efforts and activities across many leadership levels and organizations, including regular engagement with managers and senior leaders from product management, product engineering, field/sales enablement, technical enablement, sales, marketing, customer success, legal, finance, IT, and more.

Impact this role has: Global Program Managers oversee the end-to-end product introduction process for their programs. At Level V, that scope extends across multiple teams, components, or a full product theme, with significant revenue, field, and customer impact. Role impact is defined by enabling day-one revenue at launch through strong stakeholder alignment on launch criteria, integration of customer feedback into the product, and delivery of high-quality assets across teams. This role delivers measurable improvements in launch quality, Go-To-Market readiness, field and support readiness, and technical enablement, and delivers the training needed to achieve full Teradata corporate-wide readiness. Level V GPMs also raise the execution capability of the GPMs they mentor. Work is guided by product-line goals and program-level success metrics; impact is bounded to your programs and product area.

What success might look like: Shape and execute program strategy by translating plans into outcomes through structured planning, agile execution, and cross-functional leadership. Lead a large program with several sub-programs, or multiple related programs at once, and direct other project and program managers to keep overall program health strong. Define program objectives, milestones, owners, and measurable success criteria, and adapt the plan as dependencies, scope, and risks change. Resolve ambiguity in approach, sequencing, and ownership, bringing options and a recommendation rather than waiting for direction. Design execution mechanisms (readiness gates, checklists, working groups, status cadences) that scale across your workstreams, and share the ones that work with peers. Identify risks, dependencies, and handoff gaps across workstreams and adjacent programs, and mitigate them before they become blockers. When a process gap extends beyond your programs, document it, quantify its impact, and recommend a fix to Directors. Communicate program status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to Directors and VPs in concise written narratives and verbal form. Manage handoffs to Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams while maintaining overall program health, and capture customer learnings and lessons learned for future programs. Mentor Level IV and newly hired GPMs by reviewing program plans and status narratives, modeling sound escalation judgment, supporting onboarding, and giving specific, constructive feedback. Participate in recruiting, interviewing, and calibration for GPM roles.

Demonstrate key leadership behaviors by focusing on the most impactful work, taking smart risks, speaking up to challenge when needed, and fostering a culture of learning, creativity, and collaboration. Act with urgency while simplifying and prioritizing efforts, making decisions that benefit the broader enterprise, leading with inclusion, strengthening the company’s reputation, and cultivating a growth mindset grounded in trust. Be recognized as a trusted ally to all stakeholders, consistently driving the highest-value work into the hands of customers with minimal friction.

Who you will work with on the team: This requires someone adept at integrating efforts and activities across many leadership levels and organizations, including regular engagement with Directors, VPs, and senior leaders from product management, product engineering, field/sales enablement, technical enablement, sales, marketing, customer success, legal, finance, IT, and more. You will also direct other project and program managers and mentor GPMs.

Who this position reports to: This position reports to the Senior Director of Core Program Management within the Product Operations, PMO and Partnerships organization.

Non-negotiable Qualifications

* This role requires someone who is: (1) an eager and quick learner; (2) enjoys dynamic responsibilities and can work fluidly across many disciplines; (3) is methodical and pragmatic as a program manager and business strategist; and (4) is a natural integrator and team leader.
* Successful candidates will have a minimum of 13 years of relevant program management of product development experience in the tech industry, including a minimum of 7 years supporting cross-functional, global teams.
* Operate effectively in situations of ambiguity and guide teams through challenges, simplifying and distilling complex issues and influencing change.
* Effective use of interpersonal skills and influence to drive optimal team performance, including with Directors and VPs.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach other GPMs.
* Bachelor’s degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree.
* Project management certification and significant relevant exposure is preferred.
* Certification and experience in agile work, skilled in implementing agile methodologies in a team setting.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
What you’ll be doing
  
  
We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Executive who likes numbers, knows their way around ad platforms, and is curious enough to ask “but why did this happen?” instead of just reporting that it happened.
  
  
You’ll work across performance campaigns for some exciting brands, helping plan, launch, optimise and scale campaigns across Google, Meta, Reddit, ChatGPT, LinkedIn, etc.
  
  
**Your Day-to-day Will Involve**

* Setting up, managing and optimising campaigns.
* Monitoring campaign performance across spend, CTR, CPC, CPA, CPL, ROAS and other key metrics.
* Digging into campaign data to identify what’s working, what isn’t, and what we should do about it.
* Conducting keyword research, audience research, and competitor analysis.
* Building and testing different audiences, creatives, ad copy, and campaign structures.
* Keeping a close eye on budgets and making sure every penny is working hard.
* Preparing regular performance reports and, more importantly, being able to explain the story behind the numbers.
* Working closely with creative, content, analytics, and account teams to improve campaign performance.
* Staying updated with platform changes, new features, targeting options, and the latest performance marketing trends.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing, preferably within an agency environment.
* Practical experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads is a must.
* A good understanding of campaign structures, bidding, targeting, optimisation, and performance metrics.
* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets and performance reports.
* Someone who can look at a dashboard and go beyond “CPA increased by 30%” to figure out why.
* Good understanding of the digital marketing funnel and how different channels contribute to business outcomes.
* Strong attention to detail because one wrong setting can sometimes make an unnecessarily expensive afternoon.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* A willingness to experiment, learn, and test rather than simply follow a checklist.

**Bonus points if…**

* You have worked on e-commerce accounts and understand metrics such as ROAS, AOV, revenue, product-level performance, and purchase funnels.
* You have experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other analytics/reporting tools.
* You’ve worked with conversion tracking, attribution, or troubleshooting tracking issues.

**Who would fit in well here?**
Someone curious, analytical, and hands-on.
  
  
You don’t need to know everything on Day 1. But you should be someone who wants to understand why a campaign is performing the way it is, enjoys solving problems, and gets a little excited when a spreadsheet starts making sense.
  
  
If you’re looking for a role where you can actually work on campaigns, learn from experienced marketers, and grow beyond just campaign execution, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Content Specialist – Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, with regular availability during Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$12,000 annually
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to create and publish marketing content for residential properties.
  
  
You will turn property details, photographs, and video clips into attractive online listings, edited images, virtually furnished rooms, and short property videos.
  
  
This is a hands-on content-production role—not a senior marketing-strategy or paid-advertising position. You must be creative, organized, comfortable using AI tools, and able to manage multiple properties without allowing information to become inaccurate or outdated.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Identify the strongest selling points of each property.
* Write clear and engaging property titles and descriptions.
* Create and publish listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
* Adapt content to meet each platform’s format and requirements.
* Select and organize the strongest property photographs.
* Complete light photo editing, including cropping, lighting improvements, resizing, and appropriate AI-assisted cleanup.
* Use AI tools to remove temporary clutter from property photographs when appropriate.
* Virtually furnish or stage photographs of empty rooms using AI tools.
* Create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
* Create AI-assisted videos using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers when required.
* Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, HeyGen, and comparable AI image or video platforms.
* Review AI-generated content and correct visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors.
* Update prices, availability, photographs, and property information promptly.
* Remove or update listings when properties are no longer available.
* Keep an accurate record of every active listing and its current status.
* Manage competing deadlines and prioritize urgent corrections.
* Respond professionally to creative feedback and complete revisions promptly.
* Coordinate with the leasing team when information or materials are missing.

AI and editing tools may be used to improve presentation, but content must remain accurate. Permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities must never be changed or misrepresented.
  
  
What You’ll Need
  
  

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable role.
* Candidates with less experience may be considered if they provide a strong portfolio.
* Experience creating online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s most attractive selling points.
* Experience using Canva, CapCut, or comparable design and video-editing tools.
* Experience using AI tools for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging.
* Experience using HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool.
* Good creative and visual judgment.
* Strong attention to detail and information accuracy.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, and deadline management.
* Ability to manage several properties and content requests at the same time.
* Ability to receive feedback without becoming defensive and revise work promptly.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment.
* Availability to work full-time with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours.

Experience with residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not mandatory.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is preferred but, not required. Demonstrated skill, relevant experience, and the quality of your portfolio are more important.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is both creative and highly organized.
  
  
You should be comfortable improving imperfect source material, choosing the best way to present a property, learning new AI tools, and managing repetitive work without sacrificing quality.
  
  
You must know the difference between improving the presentation of a property and creating content that could mislead a renter.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of at least two of the following:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

Ensure the portfolio link does not require a password or access request.
  
  
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

description:
**About Kairos Media**

We are a full-service digital agency based in Mumbai working with 8–10 clients at a time — by design.

Every client gets strategy-first thinking, a dedicated team, and founder oversight. We work across marketing strategy, social media, advertising campaigns, performance marketing, and web design. We are not a content mill.

We are growing our team to bring on an Account Manager who will lead one of our most exciting current mandates — a 360° brand and community strategy for a national B2B food ingredients brand with presence in India and the GCC.

**The Role**

This is not a coordination role. It is a thinking role with coordination responsibilities. You will be the primary point of contact for the client, the creative and strategic engine behind the content programme, and the person who ensures that what gets delivered is genuinely excellent — not just on time.

You will work directly with the founder and the internal creative team on a strategy that involves community building, chef-focused content, influencer partnerships, broadcast channel management, trade event activations, and B2B lead generation — all under a single campaign platform.

**What You Will Do**

**Client Management**

* Own the day-to-day client relationship — calls, approvals, briefs, status updates
* Build and maintain the trust of senior client stakeholders through proactive communication and strategic input
* Translate client feedback into actionable creative briefs without losing the strategy

**Content Strategy & Calendar**

* Build and manage monthly content calendars across Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp Broadcast, LinkedIn, and Instagram Broadcast Channel
* Develop content ideas rooted in the brand strategy — not templated formats
* Write or brief copy for social posts, captions, Broadcast Channel dispatches, and campaign communication
* Coordinate with the design and video team to ensure creative output matches strategic intent

**Campaign Ideation**

* Contribute original ideas to campaign development — content series, engagement mechanics, community IP
* Research chef culture, HORECA trends, regional cuisine, and ingredient stories to fuel the discovery content platform
* Identify cultural moments, culinary events, and industry news that can be activated for the brand

**Community & Influencer Management**

* Coordinate the chef influencer programme — briefing, content review, relationship management
* Manage community engagement on Instagram and WhatsApp Broadcast
* Support the identification and onboarding of new Collective members and chef partners

**Reporting & Performance**

* Track weekly and monthly performance against agreed KPIs — community growth, engagement, lead generation
* Prepare monthly performance reports with insight and recommendations, not just numbers
* Flag what is working, what isn't, and what should change — proactively

**Who You Are**

* 3–5 years of experience in a digital agency or brand marketing role, with clear account management responsibilities
* You have managed B2B or professional audience content — ideally in food, hospitality, lifestyle, or a knowledge-driven category
* You can write. Not just captions — you can write a strategy rationale, a creative brief, a campaign idea, and a client email, all in the same day
* You understand Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp Business, and LinkedIn as platforms — not just as posting tools but as community and business development channels
* You are comfortable working with a creative team and giving direction — not just passing briefs along
* You are naturally curious about food, culture, and stories. This account is built on culinary discovery. If you don't find that world interesting, this is not the right role
* You are organised enough to manage a complex content calendar but flexible enough to respond to a brief that changes on a Tuesday afternoon

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with HORECA, food service, or B2B brand accounts
* Familiarity with the Indian chef community, culinary institutes, or food trade media
* Experience managing WhatsApp Business Broadcast or Instagram Broadcast Channel
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads and Google Ads (you won't run campaigns, but you should be able to brief and review them)

**What You Will Get**

* A genuinely strategic role — not a glorified scheduler
* Direct access to the founder and senior leadership on creative decisions
* Exposure to a full-service agency working across strategy, creative, performance, and community
* A flagship account with national scope and GCC ambitions
* A team that takes its work seriously and its culture equally so

Mumbai (REMOTE)

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Reports to:**
Account Director

title: Social Media Marketing Manager
description:
MM Nova Tech is looking for an experienced and creative Social Media Marketing Manager to lead our social media team and manage digital presence across multiple brands and client accounts.

The role will involve managing social media accounts for our clients, developing engaging content strategies, leading the content team, and strengthening the online presence of MM Nova Tech and its product, Nova CRM.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in social media marketing, content planning, brand building, and team management. Experience working with a marketing agency and managing multiple client accounts will be an added advantage. Experience working with CRM platforms or SaaS products will also be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage the social media and content team, ensuring timely execution of content plans and campaigns.
* Assign tasks, review deliverables, and maintain quality across all social media accounts.
* Guide team members on content ideas, creative direction, trends, and social media strategies.
* Monitor team performance, timelines, and overall productivity.

**2. Client Account Management**

* Manage social media accounts for multiple clients, ensuring consistent branding and engagement.
* Understand each client's business, target audience, and marketing objectives to develop suitable content strategies.
* Plan and execute monthly content calendars for client accounts.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their requirements, gather feedback, and implement changes.
* Monitor account performance and provide regular updates and reports to clients.
* Ensure all client deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.

**3. Content Strategy & Creative Development**

* Develop fresh, creative, and engaging content ideas for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.
* Plan reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories, campaigns, and other engaging formats.
* Stay updated with social media trends, viral content, industry developments, and competitor activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach, followers, and brand visibility.
* Develop creative campaigns, interactive posts, contests, and other initiatives to increase audience engagement.

**4. In-House Marketing – MM Nova Tech & Nova CRM**

* Develop and execute social media strategies for MM Nova Tech and Nova CRM.
* Create engaging content to promote Nova CRM's features, product updates, benefits, and use cases.
* Work on product-focused campaigns, educational content, customer success stories, and promotional videos.
* Develop content that highlights how Nova CRM helps real estate professionals manage leads, clients, and business operations.
* Collaborate with the product, sales, and support teams to understand product updates and convert them into engaging marketing content.
* Explore new ways to build brand awareness, generate leads, and increase engagement for Nova CRM.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Track social media performance, engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, and conversions.
* Analyse campaign results and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare monthly performance reports for clients and internal management.
* Use insights and analytics to improve content strategies and campaign performance.

**Requirements**

* Minimum
  **5+ years of experience**
  in social media marketing, digital marketing, or content strategy.
* Previous experience managing multiple social media accounts and brands.
* Experience leading or managing a team of content creators, designers, or social media executives.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.
* Proven ability to develop creative content strategies that drive engagement and brand growth.
* Experience planning and managing content calendars and marketing campaigns.
* Strong communication, client management, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of social media analytics, performance tracking, and reporting.

**Good to have**

* Experience working with a digital marketing or social media marketing agency.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts across different industries.
* Experience working with CRM platforms, SaaS products, or technology companies.

* Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, and other social media management platforms.

Please share your resume along with examples of social media accounts you have managed, campaigns you have worked on, and any relevant content portfolios.

title: Regional Director – Marketing & Portfolio Strategy
description:
**About Abbott**
Abbott is one of India's most well-known and trusted healthcare companies. For more than 115 years, Abbott has helped improve healthcare outcomes through iconic pharmaceutical brands trusted by generations of physicians and patients.
  
  
Today, Abbott's Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is one of India's largest pharmaceutical businesses, with a portfolio of market-leading brands spanning multiple therapy areas. Operating through Abbott India Limited (AIL), Abbott Primary Care (APC), and Abbott Specialty Care (ASC), EPD India provides broad and differentiated coverage of the Indian pharmaceutical market and holds leadership positions across acute, chronic, primary care and specialty care segments.
  
  
As EPD India builds the next era of growth, we are seeking an exceptional healthcare marketer and business leader to shape the future of our brands, categories, portfolio and marketing organization
  
  
**Primary Job Purpose**
Reporting to the Vice President, EPD India, the Regional Director, Marketing & Portfolio Strategy is the enterprise marketing leader across all three EPD affiliates, with accountability for the marketing, portfolio performance, and growth strategy of EPD India's Top 50 brands.
  
  
This role combines ownership of EPD India's brand marketing, performance marketing, portfolio strategy, innovation, customer experience and marketing capability agenda.
  
  
The successful leader will steward some of India's most trusted healthcare brands while accelerating the development of future growth platforms, strengthening leadership in priority healthcare categories, and shaping a portfolio aligned with evolving patient and healthcare professional needs.
  
  
Beyond business results, this role will play a pivotal role in developing future marketing leaders, building world-class marketing capabilities and creating a culture of insight-led, customer-centered growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Enterprise Marketing Leadership
* Define and lead the enterprise marketing agenda across EPD India.
* Shape Abbott’s identity and leadership recognition, reputation and prominence in India to drive advocacy, build customer equity and choice, and ultimately impact business peformance
* Establish a balanced approach across brand building, portfolio growth, performance marketing and commercial delivery.
* Serve as the senior marketing advisor to the EPD India Leadership Team and affiliate General Managers.
* Drive alignment, governance and marketing excellence across all affiliates.
* Brand Marketing & Category Leadership
* Champion world-class brand building across EPD India's portfolio of leading healthcare brands.
* Shape brand purpose, positioning, franchise strategy and long-term growth plans
* Strengthen Abbott's leadership in priority healthcare categories and patient journeys
* Build enduring brand equity through deep customer and patient understanding
* Drive excellence in segmentation, targeting, content and customer engagement strategy.
* Performance Marketing & Growth Acceleration
* Build a modern, data-driven marketing organization.
* Drive marketing effectiveness and measurable business impact through analytics, performance management and ROI optimization.
* Advance omnichannel engagement, CRM, personalization and digital customer experience capabilities.
* Establish clear performance marketing frameworks and accountability measures.
* Foster a test-and-learn culture that accelerates innovation and growth.
* Portfolio Strategy & Innovation
* Shape EPD India's long-term portfolio strategy and future growth agenda.
* Identify attractive healthcare opportunities and priority growth spaces.
* Lead lifecycle management, portfolio prioritization and franchise development decisions.
* Evaluate innovation opportunities and strategic partnerships.
* Develop robust business cases and strategic growth scenarios
* Launch Excellence
* Establish and lead a best-in-class launch excellence model.
* Ensure strong cross-functional coordination and launch readiness.
* Maximize launch performance and accelerate adoption of new growth platforms.
* People & Capability Development
* Build a high-performing marketing community across EPD India.
* Develop future marketing leaders and strengthen succession pipelines.
* Elevate capabilities in strategic marketing, portfolio strategy, digital engagement, analytics and customer experience.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous learning.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Accelerating growth across EPD India's most important brands and franchises.
* Building future growth platforms and category leadership positions.
* Strengthening portfolio competitiveness and strategic focus.
* Raising the quality and consistency of marketing across all affiliates.
* Improving launch effectiveness, customer engagement and marketing ROI
* Developing the next generation of marketing leaders for Abbott

**Experience**

* Full-time MBA/PGDM from a premier business school
* Minimum 15 years of progressive commercial leadership experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, consumer healthcare, medical nutrition, med-tech or related sectors.
* Significant experience leading large brands, therapeutic areas, portfolios or business units.
* Proven success building and scaling brands in healthcare or other highly regulated industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading both brand marketing and performance marketing agendas.
* Strong understanding of healthcare ecosystems, customer engagement models and evolving patient needs.
* Proven track record in major launches, portfolio expansion, lifecycle management and innovation commercialization.
* At least five years of experience leading senior marketing teams and developing future leaders.
* Experience working in complex matrix organizations and influencing senior regional and global stakeholders.
* Degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medicine, Science or Engineering preferred.

**Critical Leadership Capabilities**

* Healthcare Market Leadership
* Strategic Brand Building
* Performance Marketing & Analytics
* Portfolio & Growth Strategy
* Commercial & Financial Acumen
* Talent & Organizational Development
* Enterprise Influence & Change Leadership.

title: Head – Revenue & Growth
description:
**About Ink In Caps:**

Ink In Caps creates immersive, technology-led experiences for leading brands. V-ESTATE is our PropTech vertical, helping real estate developers show buyers what a property will look and feel like before it is built. Our offering spans interactive digital twins, immersive walkthroughs and technology-enabled Experience Centers that bring project layouts, views, amenities and the surrounding neighbourhood to life.

The portfolio includes
**Spaci**
, our interactive digital twin software, and
**Experience Centers**
, which bring digital twins, immersive displays and interactive storytelling into physical sales galleries. We work with developers to shape the buyer journey, equip their sales teams to use the experience, and support the rollout around project launch.

**Your mandate:**

Lead the entire V-ESTATE vertical for Ink In Caps. You will own its P&L, growth strategy and sales performance across India, lead the existing team, and personally drive the most important developer relationships and deals. You will be accountable for what the business sells, the margin it earns, how reliably it forecasts, and how effectively signed work turns into launched projects, collections and repeat business.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the annual plan and develop the team while staying close to executive pitches, complex negotiations, priority launches and customer escalations. You will represent Ink In Caps with developers, promoters, CXOs and industry leaders.

**Key roles and responsibilities:**

* ***Own the P&L and commercial plan:***

Set the annual business plan and quarterly targets for bookings, revenue, profitability and collections. Own pricing, commercial terms and investment priorities.

* ***Set the go-to-market strategy and growth roadmap:***

Define positioning, priority markets and named developer accounts across residential, commercial, hospitality and township developments. Work with Marketing to build demand and equip the sales team.

* ***Lead enterprise sales and personally close strategic deals:***

Build relationships with promoters, CXOs and developer sales and marketing leaders. Personally lead discovery, demos, proposals, negotiations and closure on priority deals.

* ***Protect margins and turn signed deals into successful launches***

Validate scope, cost and delivery commitments before signing. Lead the commercial handover and work with Delivery and Finance on launch readiness, customer escalations, billing and collections.

* ***Grow accounts, build partnerships and represent V-ESTATE***

Expand existing developer relationships across projects, cities and offerings. Build referral and delivery partnerships, and represent V-ESTATE at industry forums, property expos, developer launches and award platforms.

* ***Bring market and customer feedback into the product roadmap:***

Share buyer feedback, competitive intelligence and pricing trends with Product, Creative and Technology to improve the offering, sales demos and delivery scope.

* ***Lead and develop the existing team:***

Set clear ownership and individual goals, coach the team on live opportunities, address performance gaps and hire as the business grows.

* ***Run a disciplined sales operation***

Maintain a qualified pipeline, reliable CRM records and a credible forecast. Review deal progress, flag risks early and report commercial performance to leadership.

**What you bring:**

* Extensive experience in business development, enterprise sales or commercial leadership, with several years selling PropTech, SaaS or other technology solutions, or selling directly to real estate developers.
* A track record of owning a commercial target and consistently delivering against it.
* You can explain the scale of the business you managed, your target attainment, the deals you personally closed and how your team contributed.
* Experience building and leading teams, setting individual targets, running forecasts, coaching complex deals and hiring as the business grows.
* Experience managing a business unit P&L or taking direct responsibility for pricing, gross margin, budgets and collections.
* A strong network among real estate developers, promoters, CXOs and other industry stakeholders.
* You can open senior relationships and build consensus across sales, marketing, project and procurement teams.
* A consultative sales approach. You can explain technology in terms of a customerʼs commercial goals, lead an executive presentation, and negotiate scope and terms without losing sight of delivery commitments.
* Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills, with the judgment to work across customers, internal teams and partners.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to build a business in an emerging category.

Relevant backgrounds include Prop-Tech, real estate sales or marketing, SaaS, immersive technology and enterprise solutions. Your track record and the relevance of your experience will carry the most weight.

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to AR/VR, 3D visualization, digital twins, IoT, SaaS or immersive sales environments.
* Experience selling solutions that combine software, creative production, hardware, installation and ongoing support.
* An established developer and partner network in Mumbai and Western India.
* An MBA or equivalent qualification.

**Why join us:**

Youʼll step into a senior leadership role with ownership of a growing PropTech business, an established team and a portfolio spanning digital twins and physical sales experiences. Youʼll have direct access to leadership and the scope to shape the commercial strategy, develop the team and build the sales playbook. The role offers a competitive package with performance-linked incentives.

*At Ink In Caps, we value creativity over hierarchy and pride ourselves on an employee-first work culture where a diverse, inclusive team can thrive and innovate!*

title: Senior Brand Manager (Influencer Marketing)
description:
**About Cloutflow**

Cloutflow is an influencer marketing company that partners with leading brands to create impactful, data-driven influencer campaigns. We work with enterprise and Fortune 500 brands, managing influencer marketing budgets and delivering end-to-end campaign solutions.

At Cloutflow, we combine creativity, strategic thinking, technology, and execution excellence to help brands build meaningful connections with their audiences and drive measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Brand Manager to lead strategic brand relationships, manage key client accounts, and drive the overall growth of the brand management function.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for owning client relationships, understanding brand objectives, developing influencer marketing strategies, driving campaign performance, and ensuring seamless execution across internal teams.

This role requires a strong understanding of the influencer marketing ecosystem, excellent client management skills, commercial acumen, and the ability to lead teams while managing multiple high-value brand accounts.

**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)**

**1. Brand & Client Relationship Management**

* Own and manage relationships with key brand clients, acting as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients' business objectives, marketing goals, brand positioning, and communication requirements.
* Build long-term strategic partnerships with clients by consistently delivering value, maintaining trust, and identifying growth opportunities.
* Lead client meetings, business reviews, campaign discussions, and strategic presentations.
* Proactively address client concerns, manage escalations, and ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention.

**2. Influencer Marketing Strategy & Campaign Planning**

* Develop comprehensive influencer marketing strategies aligned with brand objectives, target audiences, and campaign goals.
* Drive campaign ideation, influencer selection strategies, content direction, and platform-specific approaches across Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Work closely with Planning and Strategy teams to develop innovative campaign concepts, influencer recommendations, and strategic proposals.
* Ensure campaign strategies are aligned with brand guidelines, messaging, audience insights, and expected outcomes.
* Identify emerging influencer marketing trends, platform developments, and innovative opportunities to strengthen brand campaigns.

**3. Campaign Execution & Delivery Management**

* Oversee the end-to-end execution of influencer marketing campaigns, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to agreed campaign objectives.
* Coordinate with Planning, Pricing, Creative, and Operations teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Monitor campaign progress, content quality, creator deliverables, timelines, and client expectations.
* Ensure all campaign deliverables meet brand guidelines, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Take ownership of campaign escalations and ensure timely resolution of execution-related challenges.

**4. Revenue Growth & Business Expansion**

* Drive revenue growth across assigned brand accounts by identifying opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding existing partnerships.
* Develop account growth strategies to increase campaign spends, improve client engagement, and strengthen long-term business relationships.
* Identify additional brand requirements and proactively pitch relevant influencer marketing solutions.
* Work closely with leadership to develop account-level revenue forecasts, business plans, and growth strategies.
* Ensure strong commercial understanding of campaign budgets, profitability, margins, and overall account performance.

**5. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and manage Brand Managers and Account Managers, ensuring effective team performance and accountability.
* Establish clear ownership, priorities, and performance expectations within the team.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support the professional development of team members.
* Collaborate with Planning, Strategy, Pricing, Creative, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across campaign planning and execution.
* Build efficient workflows and processes to improve team productivity, campaign delivery, and client servicing standards.

**6. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Track campaign performance against defined KPIs, including reach, impressions, engagement, views, and other relevant brand or business metrics.
* Analyse campaign reports and derive actionable insights to improve future campaign performance.
* Present campaign outcomes, performance reviews, and strategic recommendations to clients and internal leadership.
* Maintain visibility on account-level revenue, campaign pipeline, profitability, and client retention.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in influencer marketing, digital marketing, brand management, or account management, preferably within an influencer marketing agency.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-level brand accounts and high-value client relationships.
* Strong understanding of the influencer marketing ecosystem, creator landscape, and social media platforms.
* Experience in developing influencer marketing strategies, campaign proposals, and client presentations.
* Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of campaign budgeting, negotiations, revenue growth, and profitability.
* Demonstrated experience in leading teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical abilities with the capability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, campaigns, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Brand Strategy & Growth Manager
description:
**About the Client**

Our client is a boutique creative content studio in Mumbai, working at the intersection of strategy and visual. The studio runs four verticals: branding and design, 3D and AI, shoot and production, and social media. It also has an offline events and community vertical. Their clients are upcoming lifestyle, wellness, food and beverage, and B2B brands.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strategy-led growth professional who can help the company grow, both for itself and for the brands the company works with. This is a growth and partnerships role, not a sales role. Most of the company’s leads come inbound, so the focus is on turning those leads into pitches, building the right partnerships and networks, and growing the community around the studio.

You will work closely with the Head of Growth & Business and the Founders, and take ownership of projects from idea to execution.

**What You'll Do - Responsibilities**

* Pitches and leads: take open lead calls, understand the brief, brief the team, and build and present pitches and proposals where needed.
* Growth strategy: identify new avenues for the studio to grow, including events, collaborations and partnerships, and bring fresh ideas to improve its own social presence and LinkedIn.
* Community and events: plan, coordinate and attend events for the offline vertical, make sure they run smoothly, and connect them back to the studio’s business. Help build out the community channel as a separate avenue for growth.
* Partnerships and network: build relationships with founders, brands and other stakeholders that bring in leads, collaborations and revenue.
* Brand strategy for accounts: develop strategy for client brands, stay across key accounts, and join client meetings when required. The focus is on strategy, not day-to-day execution.
* Strategic projects: lead initiatives across teams and move them smoothly from planning to delivery.

**What We're Looking For - Requirements & Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in brand strategy, creative strategy, growth, partnerships or business development, ideally in a creative or marketing agency or studio.
* Experience working directly with founders and contributing to pitches or proposals.
* Strong strategic thinking, commercial understanding and business acumen.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the maturity to deal with founders and senior clients.
* A good understanding of branding, marketing, social media and the D2C ecosystem.
* Comfort with attending and hosting events, and building a network.
* Strong ownership, organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

**Expected Impact - How Growth is Measured in this Role**

* More leads, partnerships and a stronger network for the studio.
* Pitches and strategic projects that are delivered well.
* A growing community and event presence that turns into new opportunities.
* A stronger contribution to the studio’s overall growth and internal collaboration.

**Work Details**

* Nariman Point, Mumbai (on-site).
* Monday to Friday, 10:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
* Attending events may occasionally fall outside regular working hours.

description:
Job description

About Mesmerize India

Mesmerize India is a growing spiritual and designer jewelry brand rooted in purpose, passion, and conscious living. We create jewelry that blends aesthetics with intention, designed to align with modern spiritual journeys. As we scale our digital presence, we're looking for a results-driven Performance Marketer to lead and optimize our paid marketing efforts across multiple platforms.

What You’ll Do

Campaign Strategy & Execution

Plan, execute, and manage paid ad campaigns across:

Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)

Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max)

Amazon Ads

Myntra Ads

WhatsApp Campaigns (for remarketing and retention)

Use Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads Manager to launch and monitor campaigns effectively.

Drive customer acquisition and retargeting strategies through segmented, data-driven approaches.

Performance Tracking & Optimization

Analyze daily campaign performance; track KPIs like ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversions.

A/B test creatives, ad copies, audiences, and placements to maximize efficiency.

Create regular performance reports and strategic insights for the Co-founder.

Cross-Platform Coordination

Align ad strategies with marketplace platforms like Amazon and Myntra to support seasonal or promotional campaigns.

Stay updated with algorithm changes, platform best practices, and digital trends.

Who You’ll Work With

You won’t be working alone - you’ll collaborate closely with a passionate, cross-functional marketing team:

SEM/SEO Specialist – for search optimization and aligning paid efforts with organic visibility.

Performance Marketing Intern – for support in campaign setup, research, and reporting.

Head of Content – for ad creatives, campaign messaging, and brand alignment across channels.

What You’ll Need

2–4 years of proven experience in performance marketing for D2C, lifestyle, or fashion/e-commerce brands.

Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and retargeting platforms like WhatsApp Business API or tools.

Strong understanding of funnel-based marketing, conversion tracking, and audience segmentation.

Proficiency in Excel, Google Analytics, and attribution/reporting tools.

Ability to collaborate with creative and technical teams to build compelling campaigns.

Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

Perks & Growth

Be part of a spiritually inspired, fast-growing brand with a loyal community.

Direct mentorship from the Co-founder and leadership team.

Flat structure with real ownership of your projects.

Opportunity to grow into a strategic digital marketing lead as the brand scales.

You'll spend time analyzing market trends and competitor activity across Asia, translating insights into actionable strategy shifts.
  
  
Later, you'll prepare performance reports, distilling complex data into clear recommendations for stakeholders. Throughout the day, you're constantly balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution-one moment mapping out next quarter's paid media roadmap, the next optimizing a live campaign to hit KPIs. No two days look the same, but collaboration, data, and results are always at the core.
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

* Asia market experience is essential-you understand the regional digital landscape, consumer behavior, and competitive dynamics across key Asian markets.
* Minimum 7-8 years in paid media marketing, with hands-on experience across search, social, display, programmatic, and video.
* Proven expertise in Google Ads, META Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, SA360, and DV360.
* A track record of managing substantial budgets and delivering measurable ROI.
* Strong analytical chops-you're comfortable in Google Analytics and Excel, using data to drive decisions, not just report on them.
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with brand, growth, and demand teams to build cohesive strategies.
* A self-driven, self-motivated mindset-you don't wait to be told what's next.
* The ability to balance big-picture strategic thinking with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.
* Excellent communication skills—you can turn complex data into a story stakeholders actually understand

**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCM is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 4 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people

We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family

**About the job** 
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
   

  

 Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito\-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end\-to\-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical\-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
   

  

 As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito\-borne disease. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector\-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.

* Ensure clear communication between clients and internal teams regarding deliverables, timeline and expectations.
* Track project progress, client feedback and account health.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and seamless coordination across multiple accounts.

* 4–6 years of experience in Account Management, Client Servicing or Client Relationship Management.

* Strong understanding of upselling, cross-selling and account expansion strategies.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to confidently engage senior stakeholders and CXOs.
* Strong interpersonal skills, professional presence and the ability to build lasting client relationships.

Someone who goes beyond simply managing client relationships — a professional who can build trust, anticipate client needs, identify business opportunities and grow accounts while representing BOMBAYDC with confidence and finesse.
