title: Senior Director - Entertainment Ad Sales, Digital, LCS
description:
**About The Role**
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to lead a strategically important pod within JioHotstar's LCS Branding charter, a portfolio of India's largest FMCG, F&B, and Alco-Bev advertisers. Your account book spans global CPG majors, Indian FMCG leaders. These are among the most sophisticated brand-building advertisers in India - the marketers who set the benchmark for premium pricing, always-on media commitments, and content-led brand storytelling on any premium platform.
  
  
You will be the Industry lead, the single-threaded owner of client relationships, revenue delivery, and category strategy for this pod- reporting into the SVP, LCS Branding (who is the vertical head). Your mandate is to grow JioHotstar's share of these advertisers' digital brand-building budgets year on year - moving them from reach-led buys to always-on, integrated partnerships that combine video, CTV, first-party data, impact properties, and branded content.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Revenue & Portfolio Ownership**

* Own the annual revenue charter for the CPG pod with a clear plan to grow share of wallet and expand into under-monetized categories.
* Build account-level plans for the top accounts each with a JBP-style construct combining committed spends, sponsorship anchors, branded content, CTV investment, and first-party data partnerships.
* Drive premium yield discipline, CPG is the pricing benchmark category on any media platform, and this pod must consistently price above market.

**Client & Category Strategy**

* Own CMO, Brand head, and Media head relationships across the top accounts acting as the senior strategic partner for each. Represent JHS at brand and category planning cycles, upfronts, and marketer forums.
* Drive sub-vertical depth reflecting the distinct rhythms of CPG (always-on brand-building, new product launches, seasonal category peaks), F&B (festive windows, distribution-led campaigns), and Alco-Bev (compliant-content constructs, spirits vs. beer distinctions).
* Build leadership-level agency engagement with the CPG-heavy agencies to embed JHS in annual planning cycles and upfronts.

**Category Solutioning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Content IPs leadership to unlock marquee property integrations (Bigg Boss, Koffee with Karan, Originals) for category-leading advertisers as part of JBPs, CPG brands are traditionally the largest sponsors of Indian entertainment IPs.
* Work with PRS, AdTech, and Measurement to shape brand-building solutions like reach, CTV-premium environments, first-party data, brand lift, and attention metrics.

**AI-Era Innovation**

* Partner with Product and AdTech to co-develop next-gen branding formats like interactive CTV, shoppable brand moments, and AI-personalized creatives at scale that make CPG advertising more effective on streaming.

**Team & Culture**

* Lead, coach, and scale the pod's team of Account Directors and KAMs, attracting talent that combines deep CPG category knowledge with digital-native sales fluency.
* Build a culture of client intimacy, structured account planning, disciplined pipeline hygiene, and category expertise - with sellers who can operate credibly across brand marketing, media, and procurement conversations.

**What You Bring**
Ideal Profile: A senior marketing/brand leader from a large FMCG or CPG company who has run large brands or categories - or a senior ad sales/client partnerships leader from a global digital platform or a premium media/streaming platform with a track record owning top FMCG advertiser relationships in India.
  
  

* 12+ years across brand marketing, digital ad sales, or client partnerships, with 4+ years leading teams and owning large-advertiser P&L-style accountability.
* Deep understanding of how CPG, F&B, and Alco-Bev marketers plan, measure, and optimize brand-building investments.
* Strong command of digital video, CTV, OTT, and brand-building KPIs- reach, frequency, brand lift, salience, attention.
* Demonstrated C-suite and CMO-level relationship-building with India's largest FMCG advertisers.
* Analytical fluency, comfortable with data, measurement, and using metrics to shape account strategy and category planning.
* Comfort with AI tools and enthusiasm for using technology to sharpen client engagement and sales productivity.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with competing priorities and senior stakeholders.

title: Account Manager — Client Retention & Sales
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$35,000–C$45,000 annually, including base pay and performance bonuses
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage existing client relationships, retain dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, sell relevant services, and keep multiple active files moving from beginning to completion.
  
  
MoveSmart operates in residential leasing, but direct real-estate experience is preferred—not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
  
  
You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will coordinate the leasing process, monitor listing performance, present applications and offers, recommend changes, and keep the owner informed through tenant move-in.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service or administrative position. You will be responsible for both the client relationship and the commercial performance of your assigned files.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Manage multiple active client and leasing files
* Keep property owners informed throughout the process
* Confirm that each file is complete and ready to be listed
* Coordinate listing requirements with the partner brokerage
* Monitor inquiries, showings, feedback, applications, and offers
* Identify why a property is not attracting interest or offers
* Recommend pricing, marketing, presentation, or property-condition changes
* Persuade owners to make reasonable price adjustments
* Present qualified tenant offers and secure timely decisions
* Retain dissatisfied owners who may be considering cancellation
* Sell appropriate services that could improve a property’s leasing performance
* Handle objections while maintaining the owner’s trust
* Coordinate documents, deposits, keys, and move-in requirements
* Communicate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams
* Verify payment and payout information before providing updates
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and next steps
* Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, client success, client retention, leasing, property management, portfolio management, or a similar client-facing role
* Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales
* Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to take action
* Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering relationships
* Confidence recommending price changes, service improvements, or other actions clients may initially resist
* Ability to use evidence, customer feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions
* Experience upselling relevant services or solutions
* Ability to manage multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities simultaneously
* Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management
* Experience using a structured CRM or workflow system
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Sound judgment when handling client concerns and escalations
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours

Strong candidates may come from account management, customer success, SaaS, insurance, financial services, staffing, telecommunications, automotive sales, hospitality, property management, real estate, or another service-based industry involving ongoing client ownership.
  
  
Canadian real-estate experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live scenario-based interview.
  
  
**Compensation**
This position offers expected annual compensation of approximately
**C$35,000–C$45,000**
, consisting of base pay plus performance bonuses.
  
  
Actual earnings will depend on individual performance. Complete compensation terms will be explained during the interview process.
  
  
Remote-Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A private professional workspace
* Dual monitors
* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Reliable internet of at least 100 Mbps
* A webcam
* A noise-cancelling headset

Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person combines the organization of an experienced Account Manager with the confidence of a consultative salesperson.
  
  
You should be able to identify what is preventing a client’s file from progressing, explain the evidence, recommend a solution, overcome resistance, and obtain a clear decision.
  
  
You must be persuasive without being misleading or overly aggressive. You should be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations while maintaining the client’s trust.

title: Regional Director – Marketing & Portfolio Strategy
description:
**About Abbott**

Abbott is one of India's most well-known and trusted healthcare companies. For more than 115 years, Abbott has helped improve healthcare outcomes through iconic pharmaceutical brands trusted by generations of physicians and patients.

Today, Abbott's Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is one of India's largest pharmaceutical businesses, with a portfolio of market-leading brands spanning multiple therapy areas. Operating through Abbott India Limited (AIL), Abbott Primary Care (APC), and Abbott Specialty Care (ASC), EPD India provides broad and differentiated coverage of the Indian pharmaceutical market and holds leadership positions across acute, chronic, primary care and specialty care segments.

As EPD India builds the next era of growth, we are seeking an exceptional healthcare marketer and business leader to shape the future of our brands, categories, portfolio and marketing organization

**Primary Job Purpose**

Reporting to the Vice President, EPD India, the Regional Director, Marketing & Portfolio Strategy is the enterprise marketing leader across all three EPD affiliates, with accountability for the marketing, portfolio performance, and growth strategy of EPD India's Top 50 brands.

This role combines ownership of EPD India's brand marketing, performance marketing, portfolio strategy, innovation, customer experience and marketing capability agenda.

The successful leader will steward some of India's most trusted healthcare brands while accelerating the development of future growth platforms, strengthening leadership in priority healthcare categories, and shaping a portfolio aligned with evolving patient and healthcare professional needs.

* Serve as the senior marketing advisor to the EPD India Leadership Team and affiliate General Managers.
* Drive alignment, governance and marketing excellence across all affiliates.

**2. Brand Marketing & Category Leadership**

* Build enduring brand equity through deep customer and patient understanding
* Drive excellence in segmentation, targeting, content and customer engagement strategy.

**3. Performance Marketing & Growth Acceleration**
--------------------------------------------------

* Build a modern, data-driven marketing organization.
* Drive marketing effectiveness and measurable business impact through analytics, performance management and ROI optimization.
* Advance omnichannel engagement, CRM, personalization and digital customer experience capabilities.
* Establish clear performance marketing frameworks and accountability measures.
* Foster a test-and-learn culture that accelerates innovation and growth.

--------------------------------------

* Shape EPD India's long-term portfolio strategy and future growth agenda.
* Identify attractive healthcare opportunities and priority growth spaces.

* Evaluate innovation opportunities and strategic partnerships.

------------------------

* Establish and lead a best-in-class launch excellence model.
* Ensure strong cross-functional coordination and launch readiness.
* Maximize launch performance and accelerate adoption of new growth platforms.

**6. People & Capability Development**
--------------------------------------

* Build a high-performing marketing community across EPD India.
* Develop future marketing leaders and strengthen succession pipelines.
* Elevate capabilities in strategic marketing, portfolio strategy, digital engagement, analytics and customer experience.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous learning.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Accelerating growth across EPD India's most important brands and franchises.
* Building future growth platforms and category leadership positions.
* Strengthening portfolio competitiveness and strategic focus.
* Raising the quality and consistency of marketing across all affiliates.
* Improving launch effectiveness, customer engagement and marketing ROI

title: General Manager
description:
**About Urban Company**

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -

1. Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services

2. Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners,

helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood

3. Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry

**What you’ll do:**

Independently own and build all aspects of UC’s business across your vertical in the city cluster you are responsible for -building the supply chain across selection, training and onboarding of professionals; daily operations; quality of service; user growth and expansion. This is an operations-heavy role; the leader is expected to be hands-on and on the ground.

Grow the marketplace by improving the quality of service, like service availability, on-the-job quality through training, etc.

Build, coach, and lead a high-performance team - they need to be good at hiring and grooming talent.

Be part of key projects that improve the performance of the overall category - work with category heads, product, and marketing teams.

In a nutshell, the General Manager is expected to completely own and drive the business, the team, and make all decisions for the city cluster. This is an operationally heavy role, and we expect the leader to be strong on operational excellence and leadership skills.

**What We Need:**

Experience in a high-growth operations-based Startup, E-commerce, FMCG
High sense of ownership and a penchant for excellence

Extremely strong first-principles problem solvers, who have a maker/builder within them and want to bring to life consumer insights to revolutionize the service industry.

**What can you expect:**

A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities.

Work closely with strong leaders who are amongst the best in the country when it comes to operational excellence and consumer obsession

A lot of freedom and ownership to propose and change the way we do things. We still believe it is Day 0 and are hungry to improve and change

Growth opportunities within UC via our robust internal mobility program

At Urban Company, we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Content Specialist – Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, with regular availability during Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$12,000 annually
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring a Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to create and publish marketing content for residential properties.
  
  
You will turn property details, photographs, and video clips into attractive online listings, edited images, virtually furnished rooms, and short property videos.
  
  
This is a hands-on content-production role—not a senior marketing-strategy or paid-advertising position. You must be creative, organized, comfortable using AI tools, and able to manage multiple properties without allowing information to become inaccurate or outdated.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Identify the strongest selling points of each property.
* Write clear and engaging property titles and descriptions.
* Create and publish listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
* Adapt content to meet each platform’s format and requirements.
* Select and organize the strongest property photographs.
* Complete light photo editing, including cropping, lighting improvements, resizing, and appropriate AI-assisted cleanup.
* Use AI tools to remove temporary clutter from property photographs when appropriate.
* Virtually furnish or stage photographs of empty rooms using AI tools.
* Create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
* Create AI-assisted videos using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers when required.
* Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, HeyGen, and comparable AI image or video platforms.
* Review AI-generated content and correct visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors.
* Update prices, availability, photographs, and property information promptly.
* Remove or update listings when properties are no longer available.
* Keep an accurate record of every active listing and its current status.
* Manage competing deadlines and prioritize urgent corrections.
* Respond professionally to creative feedback and complete revisions promptly.
* Coordinate with the leasing team when information or materials are missing.

AI and editing tools may be used to improve presentation, but content must remain accurate. Permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities must never be changed or misrepresented.
  
  
What You’ll Need
  
  

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable role.
* Candidates with less experience may be considered if they provide a strong portfolio.
* Experience creating online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s most attractive selling points.
* Experience using Canva, CapCut, or comparable design and video-editing tools.
* Experience using AI tools for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging.
* Experience using HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool.
* Good creative and visual judgment.
* Strong attention to detail and information accuracy.
* Excellent organization, prioritization, and deadline management.
* Ability to manage several properties and content requests at the same time.
* Ability to receive feedback without becoming defensive and revise work promptly.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment.
* Availability to work full-time with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours.

Experience with residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not mandatory.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is preferred but, not required. Demonstrated skill, relevant experience, and the quality of your portfolio are more important.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is both creative and highly organized.
  
  
You should be comfortable improving imperfect source material, choosing the best way to present a property, learning new AI tools, and managing repetitive work without sacrificing quality.
  
  
You must know the difference between improving the presentation of a property and creating content that could mislead a renter.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of at least two of the following:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

Ensure the portfolio link does not require a password or access request.
  
  
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

title: Senior Customer Success Administrator
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Customer Success Administrator, you will own the operational backbone of our global renewals and customer success processes while acting as the team lead for the Customer Success Administrator team. You will set standards, mentor and guide administrators across regions, and drive the adoption of Salesforce and AI-enabled tooling to make our customer success operations faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience:**

* 5-8 years of experience in a customer success, administrative, or operations role within a SaaS, technology, or enterprise software environment.
* Proven experience owning end-to-end contract renewals, managing customer accounts, and optimizing business processes across multiple regions.
* Decent hands-on experience handling RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs, including coordinating responses, compiling commercial and contractual information, and meeting submission deadlines.
* 1-2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team (formal people management or team lead experience preferred).

**Technical & Analytical Skills:**

* Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (reports, dashboards, opportunity and renewal management, data quality controls); experience with HubSpot or similar CRM platforms is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools and data analytics platforms.
* Strong ability to analyze data, generate reports, and translate insights into actionable recommendations for leadership.
* Experience with multi-currency data and global reporting is an advantage.

**Certifications & AI Exposure (Preferred, Not Mandatory):**

* Salesforce certification (e.g., Salesforce Certified Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Platform App Builder) is highly desirable.
* Exposure to, or certification in, AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce) and their practical application in reporting, automation, and customer success workflows.
* Curiosity and willingness to pilot new AI-enabled ways of working and help the team adopt them.

**Communication & Collaboration:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across global teams, senior leadership, and customer stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain professional relationships across different cultures and business functions.

**Problem-Solving & Decision-Making:**

* Ability to think strategically and execute solutions that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Proactive approach to identifying challenges, escalating risks early, and implementing effective resolutions.

**Dependability & Adaptability:**

* Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently and make decisions with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities, and able to keep the team focused through change.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Mentor, coach, and train administrators; support onboarding of new hires and build team capability in Salesforce and AI tools.
* Act as the first point of escalation for the team and as backup cover for critical renewal and administrative activities.
* Coordinate and manage responses to customer RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs, working with CSMs, legal, finance, product, and technical teams to deliver complete, accurate, and on-time submissions.
* Maintain a library of standard responses, company information, compliance documents, and pricing inputs to speed up future submissions.
* Track RFP/RFQ timelines, clarification questions, and outcomes, and share lessons learned to improve win rates.

**Customer Renewals & Contract Management:**

* Own and oversee the renewal process by generating, reviewing, and revising renewal quotes, ensuring alignment with contractual terms and customer needs.
* Review and approve renewal work prepared by the team to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Collaborate with legal, finance, and sales teams to manage contract amendments and term negotiations, including complex and high-value renewals.

**Data Accuracy & CRM Management:**

* Own data integrity standards in Salesforce, leading proactive data audits, validation processes, and remediation of data quality issues.
* Utilize CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) to track customer interactions, update records, and build reports and dashboards that provide data-driven insights to support decision-making.

**Cross-Regional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Serve as a strategic partner to Customer Success Managers and regional heads across different geographies, ensuring consistent service delivery and adherence to global best practices.
* Act as a liaison between regional teams and senior leadership, providing reports, team performance updates, and recommendations to enhance customer success strategies.

**Process Optimization, Automation & AI Enablement:**

* Identify inefficiencies in customer success workflows and lead process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Leverage automation and AI tools to streamline administrative tasks, including customer engagement campaigns, renewal reminders, risk flagging, and reporting dashboards.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools within the team, documenting use cases, best practices, and guardrails.

**Quarterly Business Review (QBR) Coordination:**

* Provide assistance in planning and execution of QBR meetings, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned and materials are prepared in a timely manner.
* Analyze customer data to generate insights that inform QBR discussions and strategic recommendations.

**Customer Documentation & Compliance Management:**

* Ensure timely processing and storage of key customer documents, including EULAs, invoices, and compliance certificates.
* Maintain and enforce adherence to company and industry standards for document management and confidentiality across the team.

title: Product Support Manager
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101978
  
  
**Position Overview**
Join Autodesk and be part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), a growing business focused on transforming how customers manage and operate physical assets and operations. AOS expands Autodesk’s Design and Make vision into the Operate phase, creating more connected, end-to-end solutions for customers.
  
  
You will lead our global off-hours Level 1 Product Support team across India and the Philippines. This is the group that picks up customer cases while North America is offline and sets the standard for how round-the-clock support works. You will be the person who establishes consistent operating practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build the off-hour operating process: build, implement and improve SOPs, and define what the team does when the queue is quiet. Plan to shift coverage and queue ownership, anticipate absences and capacity gaps, and maintain clear escalation coverage while protecting time for coaching and development.
* Hold the team accountable for volume and quality together: read a lot of case data quickly, decide what matters, and coach to quality rather than a metric wall.
* Own the handoffs with North America and EMEA: review cases firsthand and ensure each important handoff includes a named owner, customer/business impact, investigation already completed, next action, and next update commitment. Confirm that the receiving team accepts ownership and urgent issues reach the appropriate escalation of contact during the shift. Keep cases progressing within the team’s remit and escalate urgent issues through established coverage.
* Build relationships with account managers for our customers, keep a view of which accounts matter most among thousands, and bring them the trends you see.
* Find the patterns behind the volume and work with product and AI tooling to remove low-level cases at the source.
* Collaborate with Level 2 support, engineering, and support operations on process improvements and unlocking operational efficiencies.
* First 90 days: Understand each team member’s strengths and development needs, establish regular coaching, document coverage and handoffs, and implement an initial process of improvement.
* Within 6-12 months: The team follows documented processes without prompting, and each report has clear development and performance outcomes. Success is measured by dependable coverage, answer accuracy, appropriate prioritization, backlog aging, avoidable recontacts, and handoff reliability alongside volume, including verification of the quality of AI-assisted answers.
* During onboarding (first 3 months), you’ll work North American business hours (9am-5pm ET) for training. After onboarding, you’ll lead the off-hours team during the 11pm-7am ET shift, currently 8:30 AM-4:30 PM IST (this shifts by an hour when North America changes clocks). This coverage ensures urgent issues are escalated promptly, and European customers are supported. Hours may change with business needs, with reasonable notice.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Technical credibility: Investigate and resolve customer cases yourself, model strong troubleshooting, and coach specialists through difficult issues. Know when to involve L2 or Engineering and provide complete escalation. API fluency is strongly preferred.
* People leadership: Substantial experience managing experienced technical specialists in complex B2B software support. Run regular, tailored 1:1s with agreed actions and follow-ups, documented development goals, clear progression expectations, and timely, fair performance feedback.
* Accountability: Set clear expectations, address performance concerns promptly and fairly, and stay accountable for decisions you delegate.
* Independent judgment: Turn ambiguity into clear priorities and practical recommendations. Decide within your remit, raise risks early, and follow through without repeated direction.
* Process ownership: Spot the gap, build the fix, secure adoption, and verify that it improves the team’s experience and customer outcomes.
* Trust and influence: Earn credibility with veteran specialists and new hires, invite disagreement, and explain your decisions. Resolve competing priorities across Support, Engineering, Product, and CS using data. Give India- and Philippines-based reports equitable attention and development opportunities.
* Active use of AI and automation to improve analysis, documentation, and workflows. Be ready to show examples, how you checked quality, and the impact.
* Experience working in both large enterprises and startups is preferred.
* Experience managing a distributed technical support team, ideally approximately five to seven direct reports across countries or time zones.
* Hands-on experience building reports and working with a customer service platform, such as Zendesk
* Experience with workforce management, such as Assembled
* Experience with QA tooling, such as Intryc
* Experience with ticket escalation software, such as JIRA, Linear or Pluno AI

As a Marketing Specialist within Gartner’s Global Marketing Campaign Excellence team, you will play a pivotal role in driving demand and lead generation campaigns. **What you will do:**

**#GSSO**
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

title: Marketing Manager , AI-First (Remote)
description:
**Ready to lead Puffy’s campaigns, using AI to understand customers and create ads that win new business?**

**Total Annual Package:**
Up to USD $143,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

**Location**
: Remote (Global)

**Potential career path:**
Marketing Manager, AI-First → Senior Marketing Manager → Marketing Director / Head of Marketing.

Career progression that takes 4-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1-2 years here for high performers.

**The Opportunity:**

Puffy is a technology-driven e-commerce business with over $1 billion in lifetime sales, powered by analytics, data and artificial intelligence. Our teams bring together software development, quality assurance, machine learning and AI, marketing, design, conversion rate optimisation, talent augmentation, HR, operations, legal, finance and customer success.

As our Marketing Manager, AI-First, you’ll own consumer research and campaign strategy, turning customer motivations and market evidence into campaign ideas, creative briefs and video scripts. You’ll use AI across research and creative development, collaborate with creative and paid-channel teams, and apply performance learning to improve the next campaign. Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you’ll also develop strategic growth partnerships as a secondary focus.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

**The Problems You'll Own:**

* **Primary: Give shoppers a reason to choose Puffy.**
  Buying a mattress online means making a decision without trying it first. Which question is holding shoppers back, and what could an ad show them to answer it?
* **Secondary: Find partners who reach the right shoppers.**
  An affiliate or publisher may have a large audience without reaching people considering a mattress. Decide which opportunities to recommend and whether the results justify another project.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Consumer research:**
  Study shoppers’ buying decisions, competitor messaging and market trends. Use what you learn to recommend which customer need the next campaign should address.
* **Creative briefs and scripts:**
  Use AI to compare messages, then write briefs and ad scripts for the AI video, design and content teams. Check each claim against the product and Puffy’s brand, and link to your AI review in every creative proposal.
* **Campaign performance:**
  Work with paid-channel teams to launch the creative. Compare audience response with what you expected, then decide what to keep or change in the next brief.
* **Growth partnerships:**
  Use AI to research potential partners and verify the evidence yourself. Coordinate selected exclusive affiliate projects and review the results with marketing leadership.

Campaign strategy comes first. The paid-channel teams run the media; you own the creative recommendation and how the results inform the next campaign.

**What This Can Mean for Your Career:**

You’ll see whether the shopper question you chose, the product benefit you highlighted and the script you wrote made a difference once the ad ran. That experience can prepare you to set priorities across several campaigns, not just write the next brief.

**What You'll Need:**

* At least 5 years in marketing, including 2 or more years with direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce brands. Offline or store-only marketing experience does not meet that requirement.
* Experience turning consumer research into campaign ideas. Be ready to explain what you personally owned, how you measured the result and what you changed afterward.
* An understanding of how targeting, messaging and creative work together on Meta and Google, including Google Search and Demand Gen.
* The ability to write ad copy, video scripts and briefs a creative team can act on, and to use AI for research and drafting without relying on it to verify its own work.
* Experience supporting strategic growth partnerships, such as affiliate or publisher relationships. You don’t need to be an affiliate specialist.
* The ability to lead a project independently and coordinate work with creative teams, paid-channel teams and external partners.
* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with an online mattress brand is a plus. We also welcome applicants from other D2C e-commerce brands.

**The Resources to Build On:**

Puffy has been AI-first since December 2023. You’ll have company-provided AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, AI agents, bots, plugins, AI projects and automations through platforms such as n8n. You’ll also receive relevant department tools, data, assets and specialist support. Use them to test different ways to tell a product story; you’re responsible for making sure the final script rings true for the shopper and represents the product accurately.

**The Puffy DNA:**

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

* Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

**✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits:**

**💰 Compensation:**

* Up to USD $143,000 total annual cash compensation.
* Base salary up to USD $130,000/year plus a monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base.
* Annual salary review every January.

**🏥 Health & Protection:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

**🌴 Time Off:**

* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + US public holidays

**💼 Work Environment:**

* AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
* **Remote First:**
  Work from the comfort of your home office
* Up to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certifications
* International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

**🏆 Rewards & Recognition:**

* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

**Ready to Put Your Expertise to Work?**

Click “Apply” to submit your application. Tell us about a campaign brief or ad script you wrote: what customer insight shaped it, how you used AI and checked its suggestions, and what the campaign results taught you.

title: Director - Product Management and MarTech
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Lilly’s India Affiliate**
*Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.*
*Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.*
*Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.*
**Purpose of the Job**
The Director – Product Management and MarTech leads the digital and marketing technology agenda for the CMO organisation. The role drives digitization initiatives across Strategic Capabilities and the enterprise-wide technology transformation agenda.
  
  
Additionally, the role will also help in shaping the user personalization strategy for AFL so that it is aligned with broader brand and commercial objectives. The role impacts across multiple functions.
  
  
The incumbent also acts as strategic digital partner to the team leads across CMO organisation capabilities: designing the product vision, translating it into user experience and interface design, running digital products that attract and retain users, and building a strong digital environment that the whole organisation can use. The role combines Digital Product Management, media, ad tech, digital and retention marketing expertise with the ability to lead technology-enabled change within strict medical, ethical and regulatory guardrails.
  
  
Regular interaction with CMO organisation leaders, Medical, Business Technology, E&C, Legal, Data Privacy, and IBU / global digital counterparts, and with external agencies and technology partners.
  
  
Recognised as an expert in the area, with strong ability to influence senior leaders, internal customers and external partners on key decisions.
  
  
Anticipates, identifies and solves complex technical and business problems affecting the functional area.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Digital Vision & Product Strategy**

* Design the product vision and roadmap for MedMarTech, aligned with the CMO organisation’s brand, commercial and capability priorities.
* Translate the vision into clear product requirements, user journeys and design specifications that engineering, design and agency teams, from build and launch through adoption, so that products are delivered on time, within budget and to quality standards.
* Anticipate long- and short-term digital, customer and competitive trends and shape the strategy accordingly.

**Digitization & Technology Transformation**

* Lead digitization initiatives across Strategic Capabilities, driving the enterprise-wide technology transformation agenda for the CMO organisation.
* Partner with Business Technology, IBU and global digital teams to align local initiatives with global platforms, standards and roadmaps.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve processes, products and services through technology, and lead their delivery from concept to scale.

**Digital Media Strategy & Ad Tech**

* Shape the digital media strategy jointly with CMO Functions and Tech leadership for AFL, ensuring alignment with broader brand and commercial objectives.
* Define and govern the ad tech and media technology approach (e.g., programmatic buying, audience data, tracking and measurement), and guide agencies on channel mix, targeting and optimisation.
* Ensure media effectiveness through measurement frameworks, attribution and continuous optimisation based on performance data.

**Digital Product Management, UX & UI**

* Own digital products end to end as a digital product manager, with a focus on attracting and retaining users: discovery, design, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Set UX and UI standards and drive user research, journey mapping and usability testing so digital experiences are simple, engaging and consistent.
* Use product analytics and user feedback to prioritise the backlog and improve engagement and retention.

**Digital & Retention Marketing**

* Lead digital and retention marketing capabilities, including lifecycle journeys, personalisation and always-on engagement that bring users back and deepen their engagement.
* Enable brand teams with reusable journeys, content frameworks and campaign playbooks; track retention, engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Build capability in test-and-learn approaches to continuously improve channel and content performance.

**MedMarTech Platforms & Digital Environment**

* Build and maintain a strong, integrated digital environment: marketing technology stack, content and experience platforms, data and analytics tools that work together.
* Ensure platform architecture, data flows, integrations, security and scalability meet business needs, working with Business Technology and vendors.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools) through structured pilots and scale-up decisions.

**Strategic Digital Partner to CMO Organisation**

* Partner with team leads across CMO organisation capabilities as their trusted digital and technology partner: understand their priorities, co-create solutions and prioritise requests against organisational objectives.
* Define a clear MedMarTech offering (what is provided, how teams engage, how requests are prioritised and expected turnaround) so team leads know what to expect and can plan with confidence.
* Deliver digital solutions, tools and support that make each team more effective; track and report the value delivered and use feedback to improve the offering continuously.

**Vendor & Partner Ecosystem**

* Scout, select and manage agencies, technology vendors and ad tech partners; negotiate terms within budget and policy guidelines and hold partners accountable for performance.
* Build a scalable partner ecosystem and governance model that improves speed, quality and cost efficiency.

**Compliance, Data Privacy & Governance**

* Ensure digital products, media and marketing activities comply with Lilly policies, applicable regulations and industry codes, partnering with Medical, E&C, Legal and Data Privacy.
* Embed governance for approved content and medical-legal-regulatory review, consent and data privacy, and digital security into product and campaign workflows.
* Ensure adverse event and product complaint reporting requirements are built into digital channels and partner operations.

**Analytics, Performance & Insights**

* Define KPIs and dashboards for digital media, product and retention performance; take ownership of reporting on adoption, engagement, retention and return on investment.
* Turn data into insights and recommendations for CMO organisation leaders and use them to shape strategy and investment decisions.

**Program & Budget Management**

* Lead large-scale programs with significant risk, resource and complexity to achieve critical business objectives, including the enterprise technology transformation agenda.
* Manage resources and budgets for programs and operations, including forecasting, prioritisation and vendor spend.

**Required Qualifications**

* MBA with Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
* 13–15 years of extensive experience in digital marketing, digital product management or marketing technology, with a track record of leading large digital transformation programs.
* Specialised depth and breadth across digital media and ad tech, UX / UI and product design, and digital and retention marketing.
* Experience partnering with business leaders as an internal service provider or digital solutions partner.
* Experience managing agencies, technology vendors and budgets for large programs.

**Additional Preferences**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, including working within promotional compliance, medical-legal-regulatory review and data privacy requirements.
* Working knowledge of the marketing technology landscape: content and experience platforms, marketing automation, data and analytics tools.
* Ability to translate a product vision into clear requirements, designs and delivery plans.
* Ability to make complex technical and business decisions within functional, company and industry guidelines.
* Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI, and how they can improve customer engagement and productivity.
* Strong communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills; sensitivity towards confidential data.
* Strong people leadership: coaching and developing team members.

**Additional Information**

* Expected to be based in the office 4 days a week.
* May require domestic and international travel.
* Must be legally allowed to work in India.
* Incumbent must be based in Gurugram (Delhi NCR).

*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.*
*It is how we work.*
*We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.*
*This is not just a policy.*
*It is who we are.*

title: Manager- Brand & Communications
description:
**Brand & Communications Manager- TIRUN Travel Marketing

About TIRUN Travel Marketing

TIRUN Travel Marketing is a leading travel company with over three decades of experience in the cruise industry. We represent some of the world's leading cruise brands in India, including Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises and Silversea.

As we build the next phase of TIRUN, we are looking to strengthen our own brand- how TIRUN is perceived in the market, how we communicate our story, and how we build visibility for our people, leadership and business.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of this agenda- from defining the strategy to getting the work done.

The Role:

As Brand & Communications Manager, you will be responsible for shaping and strengthening the TIRUN brand across internal and external audiences.

This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, marketing, communications, PR, content and founder/leadership branding.

You will be expected to think about how TIRUN should be positioned, but equally importantly, you will be hands-on in bringing that strategy to life- developing content, driving campaigns, managing PR opportunities, building leadership visibility and ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

This is not a pure strategy or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can execute independently.

Key Responsibilities:

1. TIRUN Brand Strategy & Positioning

- Develop and continuously evolve TIRUN's brand positioning, narrative and messaging.

- Define how TIRUN should be perceived by key audiences- travel partners, industry stakeholders, potential talent, media and consumers.

- Build and maintain clear brand guidelines covering messaging, tone of voice, visual identity and communication standards.

- Identify opportunities to increase TIRUN's visibility and establish stronger brand equity in the travel industry.

- Translate the larger business strategy into a clear and compelling brand story.

2. Marketing & Content

- Build and execute TIRUN's content and marketing calendar across relevant channels.

- Own TIRUN's LinkedIn and other relevant brand channels.

- Develop content around TIRUN's business, people, culture, achievements, milestones, partnerships and point of view.

- Develop campaigns and initiatives that strengthen TIRUN's employer and corporate brand.

- Ensure all communication is consistent, differentiated and aligned with the overall brand positioning.

3. Founder & Leadership Branding

- Develop and execute the personal branding strategy for TIRUN's CEO and other key leaders, where relevant.

- Build leadership narratives and content pillars aligned with the company's business priorities.

- Identify opportunities for leadership visibility through LinkedIn, industry conversations, interviews, speaking opportunities, podcasts, events and relevant media.

- Draft or oversee thought-leadership content, articles, posts, presentations and other leadership communication.

- Ensure founder/leadership communication feels authentic and reflects their individual voice rather than generic corporate content.

4. PR & External Communications

- Develop and execute TIRUN's PR and media strategy.

- Build relationships with relevant journalists, publications, industry platforms and other external stakeholders.

- Identify opportunities for TIRUN, its leadership and its people to be featured in relevant media and industry forums.

- Prepare press releases, media briefs, talking points, announcements and other external communication.

- Coordinate with PR agencies/partners where required, while retaining ownership of the overall narrative and outcomes.

- Track media coverage and evaluate the impact of PR initiatives.

5. Events, Partnerships & Brand Activations

- Develop brand-led initiatives, events and campaigns that increase TIRUN's visibility.

- Support leadership and company participation in industry events, conferences and relevant forums.

- Create communication plans around major company announcements, partnerships, launches and milestones.

- Explore strategic partnerships and platforms that can strengthen TIRUN's brand presence.

6. Execution & Ownership

- Own projects end-to-end- from identifying the opportunity and developing the strategy to execution, measurement and optimisation.

- Work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, People & Culture, Technology and leadership.

- Manage external agencies, freelancers and creative partners where required.

- Build and maintain a structured brand and communications calendar.

- Track performance of key initiatives and use data and feedback to improve future activity.

What We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who combines \*\*strategic thinking with strong execution ability.

You should have:

- 4-6 years of experience across brand marketing, communications, PR, content, corporate communications or a similar role.

- Strong understanding of brand building and positioning.

- Experience developing and executing integrated marketing/communications campaigns.

- Experience with leadership/founder branding or thought leadership is highly preferred.

- Experience working with media, PR agencies or industry publications.

- Strong understanding of digital and social media, particularly LinkedIn.

- Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills.

- The ability to work independently and take ownership without needing constant direction.

- Strong commercial and business understanding- you should be able to connect brand activity to business objectives.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you will need to \*\*think, create, execute and learn quickly

What You Will Own:

At the end of the day, this role will be accountable for:

How TIRUN is positioned → How TIRUN communicates → How visible TIRUN is → How our leadership is perceived → How our stories reach the market.

If you are someone who enjoys building brands, shaping narratives and actually making things happen, we'd love to hear from you.**

description:
OAKNORTH
  
  

* JOB ADVERT

**Senior Associate – Commercial Real Estate Credit Analysis**
Credit
  
  

* Portfolio Monitoring & Credit Analytics

📍 India | 🕐 Full-time | 🏢 Hybrid | 🎯 Associate Vice President
  
  
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we’re on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we’ve lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth’s lending business, delivering rigorous financial and credit analysis across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. Our CRE specialists work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK and US to ensure every real estate lending decision is underpinned by deep sector knowledge, robust financial modelling, and a thorough understanding of the borrower’s operating environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for an Senior Associate to join our Credit Analytics team, specialising in Commercial Real Estate lending across the UK and US. You’ll conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities spanning major property types — Residential, Office, Retail, Industrial, Lodging, and Healthcare — building financial models, drafting credit reports, and engaging directly with clients and stakeholders throughout the credit process. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines deep CRE expertise with strong financial acumen and a sharp, clear communication style.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across all major CRE property types — Residential, Office, Retail, Industrial, Lodging, and Healthcare — in the UK and/or US.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Review and evaluate third-party reports including property appraisals, valuation reports, and cost budgets; interpret and analyse rent rolls, operating statements, and lease schedules.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 2–6 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, CRE finance, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Strong understanding of Commercial Real Estate, including proficiency in interpreting rent rolls, operating statements, lease schedules, and third-party valuation and appraisal reports.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience across both UK and US CRE markets.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.
* Familiarity with cost budget review and construction lending analysis.

**What we offer**

* Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth & Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Senior Manager-Finance Analytics/Corporate Finance- AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AVP/SM Operations - Alternate Investment Fund
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Manager/AVP – Operations

**Location:**
New Delhi

**Reporting To:**
Head Operations-AIF

**Industry:**
SEBI Registered Category II Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager/AVP – Operations will be responsible for overseeing AIF operations with primary ownership of documentation governance, regulatory filings, transaction documentation control for a SEBI-registered Category II AIF. The role requires strong regulatory understanding, precision in documentation management, and coordination across legal, compliance, investment, and fund administration teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Transaction & Deal Documentation (Core Responsibility)**

Coordinate documentation for investment transactions including:

Manage investor onboarding, KYC documentation, and AML processes.

Coordinate with external legal counsel for transaction documentation and closing.

Ensure documentation reflects agreed commercial terms (coupon, IRR, redemption premium, covenants, security cover, cash flow waterfall).

Oversee CP (Conditions Precedent) and CS (Conditions Subsequent) tracking and closure.

SHA / SSA / Debenture Subscription Agreements

Coordinate with Trustees including appointment, fees negotiations and scope of responsibilities.

Escrow agreements

Pledge agreements

Ensure proper execution, stamping, and safe custody.

Maintain master documentation repository (physical & digital).

Ensure proper version control and document audit trails.

Maintain transaction closing checklists and records.

Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and governance framework.

**2. Stakeholder Management**

Coordinate cross-functionally with investment, finance, compliance, and legal teams.

Liaise with debenture trustees and security trustees.

**3. Technology & Record Management**

Implement document management system (DMS).

Ensure secure digital storage and restricted access controls.

Drive automation in reporting and compliance tracking.

Implement documentation control framework as per SOP.

Ensure proper archival policy as per regulatory norms.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

Postgraduate/CS / LLB / MBA preferred.

7–10+ years of experience in Category II AIF (Private Equity / Debt Fund / Real Estate Fund).

**5. Key Competencies**

Exceptional attention to detail.

Strong drafting & documentation review skills.

Deep regulatory understanding.

Structured & process-driven approach.

Strong coordination & stakeholder management.

Ability to handle tight deadlines and prioritize tasks.

Advanced Excel
