title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
**Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Soft Home - Bedding)**
to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.
  
  
Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.

+ Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
+ Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
+ Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.

* RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.

+ Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
+ Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.

* Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.

+ Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
+ Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
+ Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
+ Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)

* Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.

+ Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.

* Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.

+ e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
* Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
* Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
* Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams
* Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks.
* Excellent negotiation skills and commercial acumen
* Experience in apparel, soft goods, or home goods strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Emergency Response Manager, APAC
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
This position is employed by Airbnb Inc., however the role will provide direct support to Airbnb.org, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit that focuses on emergency response and provides temporary housing for people in times of crisis. Airbnb.org is governed by an independent Board of Directors and its mission is to provide emergency housing in times of crisis. From Australia to France, hosts have offered to open up their homes and helped provide accommodations to over 250,000 people. Our goal is to exponentially increase Airbnb.org’s reach and impact over the next three years. Learn more at Airbnb.org.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
You will manage Airbnb.org’s emergency responses in the APAC region but will also be expected to support responses globally as required. You will monitor disasters around the world, decide with your manager when an event meets our activation criteria, stand the response up, and manage it through to close-out.
  
  
You will do this work with partners on the ground. Local nonprofits and agencies find displaced people, confirm eligibility, and provide case management. Your job is to make sure those partners are ready before an event, and that during one they have the housing supply, the guidance, and the answers they need. Speed matters, and so does the quality of the placement.
  
  
You will run several responses at the same time, in different countries and at different stages. You will keep internal teams and external partners informed before they have to ask. You will work across Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Finance, and Product to deliver one coordinated response.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Lead of Global Emergency Response, this position requires a background in humanitarian and disaster response operations, strong leadership, and expertise in building effective partnerships with nonprofits and government agencies. Experience in Social Impact for tech companies is a big plus. Much of the work is not defined in advance. You will need to set direction yourself, decide with incomplete information, and move things toward clarity and action. You must also be able to deploy to the field on short notice to manage disaster response programs on the ground if needed.
  
  
**A Typical Day**

* Monitor global disasters via news, partner alerts, government advisories, and internal signals to assess and recommend responses based on Airbnb.org criteria.
* Establish, activate, and oversee emergency housing responses in close collaboration with on-the-ground partners responsible for the intake and case management of individuals displaced by disasters.
* Oversee diverse, simultaneous disaster responses. Set priorities across them, and hold an accurate record of status, spend, and the number of people housed.
* Proactively communicate status, decisions, and next steps to internal and external cross-functional stakeholders and partners.
* Manage each response end-to-end: verify partner readiness, determine response size and stay lengths, launch operations, monitor placements, solve issues, and conclude based on clear exit criteria.
* Manage partnerships (including onboarding new partners and managing existing partners) during active emergencies, and ensuring smooth handoff to the Partnerships team at the conclusion of emergency responses.
* Promptly answer partner questions during live responses, escalating unresolved ones.
* Work closely with the Partnerships team to build and manage partnerships with organizations that vet and support guests, while working with our Operations team to optimize housing supply, reduce costs, and maximize positive impact for those affected.
* Collaborate with the Strategic Partnerships team to unify efforts and amplify our reach in response to major disasters.
* Enhance operational readiness during non-crisis periods. Sharpen activation criteria and playbooks, pre-position partner agreements, expand 24/7 global coverage, increase team capacity, and advocate for the product features the operation needs.
* Integrate best practices from experts and agencies, and cultivate relationships with government bodies and emergency management authorities in key regions before an event happens.
* Deploy to disaster zones on short notice to manage ground operations, and hand over cleanly when you leave.
* Write the after-action review for each response, and make sure the changes it calls for actually happen.

**Your Expertise**

* Min 8-16 years of experience in US / APAC or International emergency and disaster response operations, with a focus on managing large-scale programs.
* Direct experience activating and running disaster responses end to end. Experience working in Social Impact at tech companies is a big plus.
* Strong track record of building and maintaining partnerships with nonprofits, government agencies, and key stakeholders.
* Clear, timely, and proactive communication with internal and external cross-functional stakeholders and partners, in writing and in person.
* A proactive self-starter. You take initiative, move work toward clarity and action with limited direction, and you are comfortable with ambiguity.
* Proven ability to manage multiple work streams at the same time in a matrixed organization.
* Strong execution skills for delivering on organizational goals.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and teams you do not manage.
* Adaptability, and the ability to make sound decisions at speed in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
* Willingness to travel on short notice for up to 30-50% of the year, with the ability to remain flexible regarding the length of stays.

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹2,590,000—₹3,700,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

description:

* Strong Hindi and English communication skills, with an understanding of Indian digital audiences and short-form storytelling.
* Experience managing budgets and coordinating across creative, content and product teams. Experience leading a team or managing agencies is preferred.

title: Social Media & Brand Relations Manager
description:

**Job Brief**

We’re looking for a proactive and versatile professional with the ability to nurture client relationships, craft innovative social media strategies, and drive engaging digital marketing campaigns that deliver measurable results.

This role combines
**social media strategy, creative planning, and client engagement.**
You will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, understand their business objectives, translate them into actionable marketing strategies, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless execution.

The ideal candidate is someone who understands the social media landscape, has a creative mindset, communicates confidently with clients, and can manage multiple accounts while delivering measurable results.

* **Performance Analysis:**
  Track social media metrics, analyze campaign performance, prepare reports, and recommend improvements based on data and audience insights.
* **Account Growth:**
  Identify opportunities to improve client performance, introduce new marketing initiatives, and strengthen long-term client partnerships.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to interact with clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Professional Experience:**
  At least 3 years of experience in social media management, account management, digital marketing, or a similar client-facing marketing role.
* **Social Media Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, audience engagement, brand positioning, and digital marketing strategies.
* **Client Management Skills:**
  Experience handling multiple client accounts, managing expectations, coordinating feedback, and maintaining professional client relationships.
* **Creative Thinking:**
  Ability to develop engaging campaign ideas, understand brand requirements, and translate business objectives into creative marketing initiatives.
* **AI Tools Proficiency:**
  Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva AI, and other AI-powered marketing tools to improve productivity, generate creative ideas, streamline workflows, and enhance campaign performance. Ability to identify opportunities to integrate AI into everyday marketing activities is a strong advantage.
* **Analytical Approach:**
  Ability to interpret performance metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven recommendations.
* **Project Management:**
  Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple accounts, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

  Willingness and ability to work night shifts aligned with US business hours.

Ready to take ownership of client relationships and create meaningful digital impact? Apply now and let's make amazing things happen together!

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
**About Moloco:**
Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.
  
  
Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.
**Moloco Ads**
is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.
**Moloco Commerce Media**
is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by
**CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)**
, the AI system behind every Moloco product.
  
  
At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.
**Come build what's next.**
**The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:**
Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Manager and help advertisers grow their mobile businesses. Moloco Ads is an AI-native performance advertising platform that helps app marketers acquire and re-engage high-value users across the open internet, optimising campaigns towards measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You’ll build a deep understanding of each client’s business, shape their growth strategy, and work with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Product to turn insights into better performance and lasting partnerships.
  
  
This role is based in Gurgaon, with a hybrid working model.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**

* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses and marketing objectives, and show how Moloco Ads can help achieve them.
* Build a clear, data-driven strategy for each client, taking ownership of account performance and long-term growth.
* Partner with Sales, other Growth Managers, Data Science and cross-functional teams to improve campaign performance and grow client accounts.
* Lead client relationships, meetings and business reviews, building trust through clear communication and actionable recommendations.
* Analyse campaign data, translate complex findings into clear insights, and use them to guide client decisions.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to expand client investment in line with growth objectives.
* Work with GTM, Product, and Data Science to improve products and client solutions, bringing client needs and feedback into the process.
* Look beyond individual campaigns to identify recurring challenges, address root causes and develop approaches the wider team can use.
* Stay informed about developments in the mobile advertising ecosystem and translate relevant trends into practical advice for clients.

**How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?**

* 6+ years of experience in mobile advertising account management, with experience in programmatic marketing.
* A track record of managing and growing major advertiser accounts.
* Hands-on experience in day-to-day campaign management and optimisation.
* Familiarity with mobile measurement partners (MMPs), the mobile app ecosystem and advertising technology, alongside confidence working with large datasets.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into compelling stories, clear recommendations and effective client presentations.
* Sound commercial judgment: you use data and client context to recommend next steps, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills: you bring clients and cross-functional partners into the work early, communicate recommendations clearly and build alignment across different perspectives.
* A strong sense of ownership and a curious, proactive approach to solving problems.
* Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Adaptability, initiative and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Fluency in English.
* Flexibility to travel according to business needs.

**Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:**
Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.
  
  
**Moloco Values:**

* Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
* Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
* Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

**Additional Resources:**

* Moloco Company Blog
* Moloco Leadership
* Moloco Newsroom

Please review our AI Use in Interviews Policy before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Public Health or Life Sciences.
* 12 years of experience in business development, corporate development, strategic partnerships, or technology licensing in life sciences or public health in India.
* Experience structuring, negotiating, and closing commercial agreements.
* Experience building a new market, business unit, or product footprint from scratch in India.
* Experience in regulated environments, and in managing and structuring alliances in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related industries.
* Ability to travel (up to 50% depending on location).

**About the job**
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
  
  
Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end-to-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
  
  
As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito-borne disease.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go-to-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.
* Structure and negotiate operational models with partners by working with internal science and program manager teams to formulate field requirements with technical capabilities and program timelines.
* Evaluate opportunities, conduct due diligence, negotiating agreement terms, and working with cross-functional teams to prepare and present recommendations to senior leadership. Ensure the consistent exercise of appropriate judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Identify, establish, and grow relationships with existing and new partners. Act as the central point of contact and maintain comprehensive account knowledge.

title: Director, Market Reputation
description:
**DIRECTOR, MARKET REPUTATION, INDIA**

Location: Gurugram (New Delhi)

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

This role will lead the development and execution of an integrated India Market Reputation marketing strategy that strengthens Bain’s reputation, amplifies our thought leadership and supports Bain’s growth ambition in India. The strategy will align closely with Bain’s commercial priorities. It will build awareness and consideration of Bain in the highest-value business communities on topics relevant across clients, while reinforcing Bain’s perception as the leading consulting partner to boards and senior executives.

This role will add value by providing guidance to the India Office Head and the leadership team, and act as a strategic partner for senior marketing colleagues across the region. The individual will collaborate with other Marketing functions to achieve Bain firmwide marketing objectives. As part of this role, this individual will coach and develop marketing team members to build expertise and foster a culture of innovation to evolve our India marketing strategy.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

1. Lead the development and execution of the marketing strategy. Define and develop enabling initiatives aligned to firmwide and regional growth priorities, in collaboration with the India Office Head and APAC Market Reputation Lead.

* Focus initiatives on strengthening and growing Bain’s presence in priority practices and themes defined with the Office Head
* Shape a clear view of the optimal mix and sequence of PR, digital, events, and content activities to grow Bain’s commercial visibility and leadership positioning
* Curate, adapt and amplify Bain’s global campaigns for India, while developing high-impact local campaigns that respond to the priorities of the India market
* Proactively collaborate with Practice Marketing, Account Marketing, and other Marketing functions to leverage strategic IP, insights, and assets, and ensure plans are aligned/complementary to achieve firm goals
* Optimize program investment across channels and campaigns throughout the year, phasing spend and reallocating funds as priorities evolve to maximize impact

2. 

Identify, prioritize, and project manage marketing campaigns and supporting activities

* Identify and cultivate the most relevant third-party partnerships, sponsorships, and conferences and events, building a high-caliber ecosystem of relationships with business associations, conference producers and media outlets that keeps Bain at the center of India’s most important business conversations

3. Own, plan and execute Market Reputation Marketing activities to amplify Bain’s presence and client engagement efforts:

* Events: Design and run a full calendar of market reputation events, webinars, and forums, and inform and support Events team efforts in market as needed
* PR & External Communications: In partnership with the regional PR team, manage all local PR activities to establish and grow Bain’s presence in the most influential business media (traditional and digital), manage collaboration with general media, premium publications and local PR agencies as needed.
* Leader visibility: Help frontline leaders build a public profile focused on expertise.
* Editorial: Tailor global content to local community needs, distribute in local market, and manage local agencies and providers
* Alumni: Develop and oversee local alumni segmentation and engagement strategy, including communications and events that complement Market Reputation, Practice and Account efforts

4. 

Develop and execute targeted marketing campaigns linked to strategic Bain IP and growth initiatives

* Design campaign calendars integrating PR, digital and events
* Create and amplify tentpole campaigns around flagship themes and practices (e.g. Applied Tech & AI, Transformation)
* Develop proactive and reactive media strategies, work with global/regional PR team to ensure Bain is top of mind with key local and international media
* Oversee relevance and impact of all digital channels: web content, LinkedIn partner profiles, social media amplification, etc.
* Lead sponsorship and co-branding: identify and negotiate high-value opportunities, manage co-brand partner relationships, and ensure Bain’s brand is represented with impact and consistency across co-branded events, content and campaigns

5. 

Develop and manage the targeting, tracking and engagement of executives in priority accounts

* Work with account heads to map, target, and engage key C-suite executives across top clients, ensuring contact mapping is up to date and that executives are regularly engaged with relevant, value-added marketing
* Proactively manage target lists
* Ensure teams updating the client CRM keep the database up to date
* Develop and update engagement dashboards for reporting to account heads and office leadership

6. 

Manage and coach marketing team members to build capabilities and deliver impact

* Drive skills development across key marketing channels (e.g., PR, digital, campaigns, events)
* Develop and deploy in-house and external resources in support of strategy
* Foster collaboration and ensure consistent use of global systems, technologies, assets, and best practices

7. 

Drive continuous innovation and improvement by identifying new opportunities, from activations and relationships to the evolution of our processes, and by harnessing AI to raise the speed, quality and impact of our work

8. 

Manage the budget and annual planning process

9. 

Manage collection of data on local market intelligence and Market Reputation KPIs, to track impact and report to the Office Head and Market Reputation lead

  

**ABOUT YOU**

Education

* Minimum undergraduate degree, specialization in marketing

Experience

* Minimum 12 years of relevant B2B marketing experience with a good understanding of technology
* Minimum 5 years of team leadership experience, including leading a team of 3-4+ and developing talent
* Professional services marketing experience, or other sectors with technology marketing experience
* Good media relationships and experience with top-tier business and trade titles
* Relevant agency management experience, or direct experience developing impactful B2B campaigns with a focus on premium media and digital channels
* Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
* Broad expertise and experience in marketing programs and processes
* Demonstrated success in conceptualizing new approaches and solutions and influencing senior leaders on key strategic issues
* Ability to team effectively with senior stakeholders to protect and enhance Bain’s reputational, brand and PR standing, while anticipating and managing risk
* Ability to provide advice to office leadership and regional marketing leadership on programs and processes
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize as needed
* Client-centric mindset
* Ability to understand and work with consulting content and thought leadership

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Group is responsible for the overall financial management of our company. This includes accounting, financial and regulatory reporting, balance sheet management, financial planning and analysis, treasury, investor relations, corporate investments and tax
  
  
Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) , Global Markets (GM), International Finance & Corporate Treasury strives to be a valued business partner to the company's trading, corporate, institutional & banking businesses and is responsible for funding the balance sheet, maintaining strong capital and liquidity positions, managing interest rate risk and overseeing company’s relationship with external stakeholders.
  
  
Our priority is to operate a series of key control processes to ensure the integrity of the group's financial results. Then we build on these activities to offer performance insight to business leaders.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Business Support manager is responsible for supporting day-to-day operations across GM, GCIB & International Finance and Treasury and driving execution of effective governance, technology enablement, policy adherence, and continuous improvement.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Business Support Manager to support the COO organization in executing key business management and transformation priorities. The role will partner with GBS control & support functions like Finance, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to drive governance routines, technology adoption and ensure there are no KRI or KPI breaches. The role is instrumental in ensuring we remain compliant with all the policy and guidelines of GBS,
  
  
This role will also play a key role in supporting the HC forecast cycles in partnership with the LOB counterparts.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable outcomes while maintaining a strong risk and control environment.
  
  
Key responsibilities include acting as a central point of contact for senior leadership routines and activities, financial control/budgeting and consolidation, personnel processes, audit/compliance, premises, associate training, service quality, process improvements, business continuity, and communications. Job expectations include interacting with a wide variety of business partners to deliver strategic work efforts to ensure tactical priorities are met.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partners with peers and control partners to ensure strong engagement and adherence to risk management and operational risk policies and processes
* Drives successful execution of team events and routines, including logistics, communications and gathering feedback
* Develops comprehensive plans around key organizational priorities and ensures all accountable parties understand respective roles/responsibilities
* Partners with GBS reporting and analytics team to ensure accurate reporting while seeking opportunities to reduce manual processes
* Assists senior executive and team with a full range of engagements
* Provides oversight of key deliverables and validates accurate and timely completion
* Works directly with the other business management team to build deliver reports and manage other GBS wide priorities
* Interactions on a daily basis with all levels of the organization, reviewing and gaining feedback on:
* Resource changes, on-boarding, off-boarding, reporting and metrics as well as reconciliation with central GMRT team reports
* Vendor management including A/P process, invoice payment and status, and forecasting
* General ad-hoc requests as needed for executive level meetings, business presentations, corporate communications, etc.
* Resource plans (forecast vs. actual)
* Quarterly business/organizational reviews (headcount ratios, hiring status, financials, etc.)
* Resource management (hiring requests and approvals, forecasting, on-boarding, mandatory training tracking, contract/contractor management)
* Operational Risk Management – Compliance coordination (mandatory training, etc.)
* Work with the PMs on developing their forecasts (resources, budget)

**Requirements\***

* Education\*

Graduate/ Post Graduate from Tier I/II institute with at least 8 yrs
  
  
**Experience Range**
7 to 8 years with at least 5 years’ experience in COO support role.
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Hands-on experience in delivering tasks related to COO, Transformation, Business Management or related functions.
* Experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, operational risk, controls, and governance frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with proficiency in data analysis and management reporting.
* Experience supporting technology, automation, or AI-related initiatives.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong Knowledge MS Office Suit including PowerPoint & Excel skills
* Ability to write effective prompts in AI Chat applications like Copilot
* Intellectual curiosity, regularly asking questions to enable rapid learning of a complex topic.
* Self-starter with ability to be proactive and well organized.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship management skills
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Attention to detail, analytical abilities/financial acumen/problem solving skills
* Strong control mindset including ability to identify risks and build and maintain associated controls
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive environment
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure environment

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge SQL and awareness of AI tools
* Advanced experience/skills with Excel and complex spreadsheets
* Able to work both independently and as team member
* Strong problem solving and analytical abilities (Excel)
* Experience improving and automating manual processes
* Technical Business Analyst skills (SQL, VBA, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, AI/ML)Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions

12:30 PM IST to 21:30 PM IST

title: Technology Investment Banking Associate
description:
Capital Connect Advisors (CCA) is one of the most active tech-focused boutique investment banks operating in SE Asia, India and Australia. We provide private placement, M&A, and strategic advice to leading growth stage technology, AI and digital infrastructure companies.

CCA is growing rapidly and is looking to hire an Associate to support the execution of our transactions.

This India-based role covers SE Asia and India. It is for exceptionally motivated and smart individuals who want the opportunity to build a career in technology investment banking in two of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology markets of SE Asia and India.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

As an Associate, you will be a key member of the Corporate Finance team and involved in projects across the APAC region that may include, but are not limited to:

1. Support the VPs and Partners on deal execution for our private placement, M&A, and/or strategic financial advisory mandates.

2. Build Financial Models including integrated three statement model, valuation, and cash flow modeling

3. Prepare key documentation including Pitch Decks, Information Memorandums, Management Presentations, etc.

4. Manage due diligence workflows, including data-room organisation, coordination with service providers and preparation of clients for investor Q&A.

5. Drive project timelines, coordinate internal and external stakeholders and ensure deliverables align with client expectations.

6. Provide background work for research and industry analysis with a focus on technology and the internet in SE Asia and India.

7. Contribute to internal process improvements, CRM enhancement, and tech-led project management tools to scale execution efficiency.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

1. Good academic credentials from top institutions with 3-6 years of relevant work experience after an undergraduate program.

2. Strong accounting and corporate finance knowledge.

3. Methodical, meticulous and possess strong quantitative and analytical skills.

4. Excellent communication, business writing, and research skills.

5. Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines.

6. Ability to manage projects independently and be ready to assume a high level of responsibility as a member of a team.

7. Committed to excellence on assigned deliverables with high professional and ethical standards.

8. Familiarity with research databases and financial tools is a plus (e.g., Capital IQ, Tracxn, CB Insights, Crunchbase, Bloomberg, etc.).

9. Strong preference is to hire candidates with prior internship or full-time experience working in the technology sector with a mid-market investment bank, consulting firm, or technology start-up.

**CULTURE**

1. We love our work – a demonstrable passion for the technology and start-up space

2. Founders are the centre of our universe – optimize for our main client (the founder) to build long-term relationships and trust

3. We reward action and energy – progress is made by making mistakes, become excited and energized to make a few as long you are in forward momentum

4. Growth is everything, personal and as a collective group – always ask what’s next and how can we make that 1% improvement on yesterday

5. We are results-focused; we are not interested in over-engineering processes for a historical world that doesn’t exist

6. Strive to be better than the market, we are not playing catch up here our founders and investors don’t expect anything less.

7. Be nice, be genuine and care enough to stand up to values that matter, for the benefit of the clients, and motivate your colleagues so we can all exceed as a team.

title: Regulatory Affairs & Policy Specialist
description:
**About The Role:** 
 A high\-impact specialist role at the intersection of technology, telecom regulation, data privacy and business strategy. The role will translate evolving regulations into actionable guidance for Product, Engineering, Operations and business teams, ensuring regulatory readiness across Tanla’s platforms and offerings. The individual will also serve as a trusted advisor for CXOs and enterprise customers, and represent Tanla in regulatory engagements, audits, escalations and high\-stakes matters. The role will help turn regulatory compliance and trust into a business enabler and competitive differentiator.
 



  





**What You’ll be Responsible for?** 




**1\. Operationalizing Regulation** 



* **Product Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Product and Engineering teams to ensure Tanla platforms/products are compliant to regulations. Act as the bridge to help technical teams understand regulatory requirements and ensure new product features are compliant before launch.
* **SOP Development:** 
 Convert complex regulatory frameworks (such as the DPDP Act and TRAI regulations) into clear, actionable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for internal teams.



**2\. Governance \& Executive Advisory** 



* **Executive Liaison:** 
 Serve as the lead point of contact for CXOs/HoDs across Tanla group regarding telecom regulatory readiness, risk assessments, and strategic compliance updates.
* **Audit:** 
 Assist in internal and external audits on regulatory risks, ensuring the organization consistently meets and exceeds regulatory requirements.



**3\. Customer Trust \& Audit Escalation** 



* **Escalation Authority:** 
 Act as the escalation point for enterprise customers regarding regulatory inquiries and audit requests.
* **Client Confidence:** 
 Provide expert, high\-stakes responses to client queries, building long\-term trust and confidence in Tanla’s regulatory integrity.



**4\. Crisis Management \& External Representation** 



* **Regulatory Response:** 
 Lead the organization’s response to regulators and enforcement agencies during inquiries, inspections, or incidents.
* **Crisis Coordination:** 
 Manage time\-sensitive crises by coordinating with legal, marketing, operations, and technical teams to mitigate risks and safeguard the company’s reputation.



  





**5\. Commercial Enablement** 



* **Strategic Growth:** 
 Work with Sales and Marketing to position Tanla’s adherence to global and local regulations as a key competitive differentiator.
* **Value Creation:** 
 Reframe regulatory compliance from a cost center into a powerful sales enabler that helps win and retain top\-tier enterprise clients.



**What We’re Looking For in You?** 



* **Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years in Tech\-Policy, Data Privacy, or Regulatory Affairs within regulated tech or telecom ecosystem.
* **Deep Knowledge:** 
 Expert\-level understanding of the DPDP Act 2023 and technology regulations. Prior experience with TRAI regulations such as TCCCPR 2018 and MeitY guidelines is preferred.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to translate technical and legal concepts into simple, commercial language for diverse stakeholders (developers, sales/marketing, board members). Previous experience reporting to Board/CXO levels is preferred.
* **Strategic Mindset:** 
 A proven track record of handling product development requirements, high\-pressure regulatory audits and resolving complex customer escalations. Prior experience of directly engaging with regulators is highly preferred.



**Why join us?** 



* **Impactful Work:** 
 Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities** 
 : Be part of a rapidly growing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.
* **Innovative Environment:** 
 Work alongside a world\-class team in a challenging and fun environment, where innovation is celebrated.



  





 Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

My Visa Source Legal – US & Canada Immigration Lawyers is an award-winning, full-service immigration law firm with an experienced team of Canadian lawyers and licensed practitioners. The firm provides legal solutions for personal and business immigration matters across Canada and the United States, with physical offices in Toronto, Vancouver and Scottsdale, Arizona. Its mission is to offer clear, effective legal guidance that improves the likelihood of favorable outcomes for clients from diverse backgrounds. My Visa Source uses efficient, proven processes and up-to-date knowledge of immigration laws and trends, contributing to its status as one of North America’s fastest-growing immigration law firms. The firm has received multiple national and international awards recognizing excellence in corporate and personal immigration services.

**Role Description The Immigration Case Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting the preparation, organization, and tracking of immigration files for both personal and business clients. This role involves gathering and reviewing client documents, performing legal and policy research, summarizing case facts, and drafting clear, accurate case notes and supporting materials under lawyer supervision. The analyst will communicate with clients to clarify information, follow up on outstanding documentation, and ensure timelines and filing deadlines are met. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating with legal team members, updating case management systems, maintaining accurate records, and helping streamline workflows to improve efficiency and client experience. The role requires a high level of attention to detail, discretion with sensitive information, and a commitment to service excellence in a fast-paced, deadline-driven env

ironment.
**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical and research abilities, including the capacity to interpret immigration regulations, policies, and official guidance, and summarize findings clearly.
* Excellent written communication skills for drafting case summaries, correspondence, and supporting documents, with strong grammar, clarity, and precision.
* High level of organization and time management skills to handle multiple files, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate digital records in case management systems.
* Client service and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate respectfully and clearly with clients from diverse backgrounds and maintain confidentiality.
* Technical proficiency with common office software (e.g., document editors, spreadsheets, PDF tools) and comfort learning new legal or CRM platforms.
* Post-secondary education in law, paralegal studies, political science, international relations, or a related field; paralegal or legal assistant training is an asset.
* Prior experience in immigration law, legal services, or a regulated professional environment is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, collaborate effectively with a distributed team, and adapt to evolving processes and priorities.
* Strong ethical judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy when dealing with sensitive personal and corporate information.**

description:
**Job Description**
As a
**Senior Support Engineer**
, you will serve as the primary technical interface for enterprise customers, partners, and internal Oracle teams, providing expert technical support for Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) technologies. As a senior member of the Global Product Support organization, you will demonstrate deep technical expertise across Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and enterprise integration technologies. You will work independently on complex customer issues and critical customer escalations as needed.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights.As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's Sales and Services teams, which delivers approximately $5.3B in annual business and technology insights revenue. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global Sales and Services teams comprised nearly 9,000 associates and which sell to and service every major function across the enterprise.

  

**About the role:**

  

The Marketing Specialist, Campaign Excellence will join the Global Marketing team in GSSO. The Global Marketing team is focused on driving topline revenue and increasing seller productivity. The team designs marketing programs to help prospective customers understand how Gartner’s insights, advice, and tools can help them achieve the mission-critical priorities that drive organisational performance. The team accelerates sales activity by attracting, engaging and converting prospects through the delivery of compelling Gartner insights and experiences across the buyer journey.
  
  
As a Marketing Specialist within Gartner’s Global Marketing Campaign Excellence team, you will play a pivotal role in driving demand and lead generation campaigns. You will be responsible for creating and executing targeted marketing initiatives that generate high-quality leads for the Sales team, supporting pipeline growth and business objectives. This role requires a strategic thinker with hands-on experience in campaign management, content creation, and cross-functional collaboration.

  

**What you will do:**

  

* Campaign Activation:
  + Support the design and execution of integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns aligned to target audiences, and regions.
  + Activate campaigns across channels including email, web, paid media, and social to drive high-quality lead generation and pipeline contribution.
  + Translate campaign strategy into clear execution plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Content Development:
  + Create impactful content that significantly boosts lead generation across multiple channels, including website, email, and social media, ensuring alignment with strategic marketing goals.
  + Ensure all content aligns with brand standards and delivers a consistent, high-quality user experience.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  + Partner with Revenue Marketers, Sales stakeholders, and Centers of Excellence (e.g., email, digital, strategic content, analytics) to deliver integrated programs.
  + Foster strong working relationships to ensure seamless campaign delivery and alignment across teams.
* Campaign Performance & Optimization
  + Track and analyze campaign performance using dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI)
  + Monitor key metrics such as lead volume, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution
  + Identify insights and recommend data-driven optimizations to improve campaign effectiveness and ROI
* Project Management & Analytics:
  + Manage multiple campaigns concurrently with strong attention to timelines and quality.
  Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business priorities.

  

**What you will need** **:**

  

* BS/BA/BBA degree or MBA degree on marketing or related field
* 2-3 years of relevant marketing experience in a B2B environment ideally with experience in a service or solutions-oriented businesses or technology
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams
* Proven experience supporting the development of successful integrated marketing or demand generation programs.
* Strong writing and content development skills, with experience in creating campaign briefs, emails, ads, and social media posts.
* Proficiency in marketing analytics and reporting, with hands-on experience using Power BI or similar tools is preferred.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.  

  

**What you will get** **:**

  

* Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities  

**#LI-MP4 #GSSO**

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - P&L Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative tools to uncover self-governing, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets. We are seeking an analyst/Senior Analyst to join our P&L Reporting team at the firm’s office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India which is responsible for producing firm-wide reports that provide insights and analyses into key performance indicators— including profit and loss (P&L), expenses, capital, returns, and fees— for the offices of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, and portfolio managers. The group handles ad hoc requests related to P&L and capital from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, facilitating effective decision making through clear reporting, analyses, and recommendations. Another key responsibility is driving technology initiatives—leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party tools to prepare and present reports, streamline workflows, improve process controls, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns & fees is accurate, timely and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile and allocate P&L, expenses and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**

**Job Description**
Senior Finance Analyst, FX Risk Management
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Senior Finance Analyst to join Innovative Medicine Principal Operations (IMPO) as part of an international team. This opportunity is suited to experienced analysts who combine reliable execution with process ownership, a willingness to coach more junior colleagues, and the confidence to challenge how things are done. You will collaborate with colleagues around the world, build a broad international network, and gain insight into the financial flows and processes connecting R&D, Supply Chain and our commercial operating companies.
  
  
**About Innovative Medicine Principal Operations (IMPO)**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
J&J IMPO is a global organization working in close collaboration with R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, Tax and Treasury. Our greatest asset is our people, and we foster an environment where collaboration, success, passion, and diversity are celebrated. We are committed to developing the talents of our team members and providing meaningful opportunities for growth and advancement. By joining us, you become part of a community recognized for its reliability, trustworthiness, and expertise.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
As a Senior Finance Analyst, you will lead critical FX Risk Management processes for J&J’s Innovative Medicine business, with the opportunity to take ownership and apply your judgment, supported by an experienced global team. You will build deep expertise in end-to-end exposure management and hedge accounting in line with J&J's global hedging policies, a highly specialized capability with direct impact on the company's financial results. You will look beyond standard procedures to spot and solve issues, drive standardization, and become a go-to expert for the team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
*The exact process scope will be assigned based on business needs and individual strengths. Broadly, in this role you will:*

* Own the accurate and timely delivery of critical FX Risk Management processes for entities across multiple regions, including monthly forecast and balance sheet FX exposure identification, hedge accounting, hedge ineffectiveness assessments, and OCI related balance sheet reconciliations.
* Lead assigned parts of the end-to-end hedging cycle, analyzing exposures, explaining variance drivers with key stakeholders and ensuring deliverables are executed successfully.
* Be the trusted point of contact for FX Risk Management processes and systems, owning system administration and master data, aligning cross-functional stakeholders on timelines and risks, and resolving or escalating issues in a timely, solution-oriented way.
* Maintain a robust control framework, ensuring compliance with SOX and financial policies, supporting audit activities, and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen processes and mitigate risk.
* Drive operational excellence, standardization and continuous improvement across FX Risk Management processes and the wider finance organization.
* Partner closely with global FX Risk Management, Treasury, SigniFX (FX project team) and Finance Technology teams to resolve issues and ensure effective end-to-end execution.
* Provide guidance, onboarding support, and informal coaching to Analyst-level colleagues, contributing to a high-performing, learning-oriented team culture.

Core Competencies for Success
  
  
Success in this role depends on demonstrating and growing the following capabilities:
  
  

* Agility & Innovation: Takes the initiative to bring an innovative, agile mindset; seeks ways to recommend process improvements, broaden perspectives and challenge the status quo in a fast-paced environment.
* Finance Fundamentals: Applies solid financial and accounting knowledge to interpret data, understand drivers and support sound decision-making across connected processes.
* Financial Control, Compliance & Risk Management: Anticipates and manages process and data risks, strengthens controls, and safeguards compliance across the activities they own.
* Business Acumen: Researches and analyzes how internal and external factors impact the processes they support, and connects the team’s work to broader business outcomes.
* Trusted Business Partner: Builds trusted relationships across a matrixed, global environment, influences using fact-based insight, and tailors communication to different audiences.
* Digitally Enabled Finance: Leverages finance systems, data tools and automation to improve efficiency and data quality, and champions their adoption within the team.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field is required.
* A recognized professional qualification in finance or accounting, such as CA, CMA (ICWA), CFA, ACCA, CPA or ACA, or an MBA (Finance), is required.
* Approximately 6-10 years of relevant experience in operational finance, accounting, controlling or a finance-hub/shared-services environment, ideally in a multinational or complex matrix organization.
* Exposure to FX risk management, treasury or hedge accounting (Ind AS 109 / IFRS 9 / US GAAP ASC 815) is a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to understand end-to-end process flows, work independently, and translate data issues into clear business impacts and follow-up actions.
* A critical, improvement-oriented mindset with the confidence to challenge processes constructively.
* Advanced Excel skills; hands-on experience with SAP, SAP Analysis for Office (AFO), Anaplan or similar finance systems preferred; Power BI and Copilot are a plus.
* Excellent English communication and stakeholder-management skills, with experience working across global teams and time zones.

This is what awaits YOU at J&J
  
  

* Work in an international setting: Collaborate closely with EMEA and global colleagues, develop a strong international network, and learn from diverse perspectives across the organization.
* Gain end-to-end business visibility: Ownership of critical global finance processes, with genuine end-to-end visibility of how a multinational healthcare business plans and reports.
* Make an impact: Improve, standardize and automate critical finance processes.
* Grow your career through an accelerated development via the J&J Global Finance Skill Area Framework, exposure to senior stakeholders, and a clear pathway to greater responsibility.
* Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture, with competitive rewards, and flexible/hybrid working arrangements.

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
AI Judgement Integration, Analytical Reasoning, Budgeting, Business Behavior, Coaching, Communication, Consulting, Data Savvy, Econometric Models, Execution Focus, Financial Analysis, Financial Modeling, Financial Planning, Financial Reports, Financial Risk Management (FRM), Learning Agility, Microsoft Office, Operational Excellence, Problem Solving, Stakeholder Management

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Experience**

**8 – 12 years**

**Shift timing - 3pm to 12am**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Financial Analyst with a minimum of 8 years of experience in Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), and/or General Ledger (GL) accounting. The ideal candidate must possess strong accounting knowledge, excellent verbal and written communication skills, and proven stakeholder management experience. The candidate should be capable of independently managing accounting activities, building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, resolving escalations, and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of financial operations.

We are specifically looking for an accounting professional who is self-motivated, takes ownership of responsibilities, demonstrates strong problem-solving abilities, and can work effectively with minimal supervision in a fast-paced business environment.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related field

* Proficiency in accounting software (SAP preferred) and advance MS- Excel skills
* Strong hands-on expertise in AR, AP, and/or GL.
* Proven stakeholder management and escalation-handling experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated accountability, self-motivation, initiative, and end-to-end ownership.

**Key Skills and Responsibilities**

**1. Finance and Accounting Expertise**

* Strong hands-on experience in AR, AP, and/or GL accounting.
* Expertise in Intercompany account reconciliations, financial reporting, journal entries, and month-end closing activities.
* Ability to investigate discrepancies, resolve accounting issues, and ensure financial accuracy.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent platforms.

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* Proven experience managing stakeholders across finance, operations, business teams, and external customers or vendors.
* Ability to independently handle stakeholder queries, escalations, and complex accounting issues.
* Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills to ensure smooth execution of finance operations.
* Ability to communicate financial information, issues, risks, and resolutions clearly to stakeholders.
* Proactively follow up on pending actions, drive issue resolution, and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and service-level agreements.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and align stakeholders toward common business objectives.
* Experience working with international stakeholders and cross-functional teams is preferred.

**3. Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Strong presentation, email communication, and business interaction skills.
* Ability to explain financial discrepancies and accounting issues clearly and concisely.

**4. Ownership and Behavioral Competencies**

* Self-starter with a proactive, self-motivated approach.
* Strong accountability and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines.
* High attention to detail, integrity, and commitment to quality.

**Candidate Expectations**

We are looking for strong finance professionals who combine sound accounting expertise with excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to manage responsibilities independently, build productive stakeholder relationships, proactively resolve issues, and deliver results without constant follow-up or supervision.

The ISPL Financial Shared Services (FSS) Platform performs production and reporting activities delivered to onshore teams focused on fronting activities, and provides offshore support to nearshore teams, thus fostering standardization and Finance transformation. It is split into three components with the following missions: i.e. APAC Regional FSS, Global FSS and World Wide FSS.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The main responsibility of the Subject Matter Stream (SMS) is to ensure the accuracy of the production of the financial and management accounting ledgers through a new BNP Paribas tool (OFS). * Review daily transactional account activity/daily ledgers for posting errors and back-value transactions

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. We are looking for a senior, hands-on Principal Specialist, Finance to lead finance for Shiksha, which works with government schools across multiple states. The role goes well beyond accounting: budgets, reporting, spend controls, donor compliance and cash planning, with a real say in how Shiksha plans, spends and reports as it grows.
  
  
You will work closely with Shiksha leadership, state and function teams, the Finance team, donors and partners, and guide the finance support around the program.
  
  
**Experience And Skills**

* 6-8 years in finance, accounting and donor management
* Strong grasp of accounting, financial reporting
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, MIS and cash-flow management
* Not-for-profit or social sector experience, ideally with multi-state or field-based programs
* Advanced Excel and strong financial analysis
* Working knowledge of Tally or other accounting systems

Must-haves
  
  
These are non-negotiable for this role:
  
  

* Prior experience managing donor finance proposals (budgets and costing)
* Prior experience in donor reporting and allocation
* Working knowledge of Tally or other accounting systems
* Experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional role

Roles and responsibilities-
  
  
end to end ownership of Udhyam Shiksha Finance
  
  
Budgeting, forecasting and MIS
  
  

* Own the annual Shiksha budget and state-wise budgets with program and state teams
* Build simple cost models (cost per school, cost per student) and plan for scale-up
* Present monthly MIS: actuals against budget by state and function, with key variances and insights
* Forecast cash flow and flag funding gaps early
* Support the statutory audit and compliance with the Finance team and consultants

Spend controls and state finance
  
  

* Set up simple, workable processes for state-level spends, advances and approvals
* Review reconciliations and entries, and resolve finance issues quickly
* Review reconciliations, accounting entries, payables and receivables for Shiksha.
* Identify and resolve finance issues quickly.

Donor and partner finance
  
  

* Planning and coordinating project expenditure in alignment with donor budgets
