Partnership and leadership
  
  

* Serving as the primary point of contact for all finance-related matters, queries and coordination across Udhyam Shiksha
* Partner with function leads on budgets, spends and savings
* Help non-finance teams follow financial policies and donor requirements
* Coordinating with the central Finance team and vendors to ensure alignment and seamless financial operations.

Key skills and mindsets
  
  
Hands-on, analytical, collaborative, proactive, detail-oriented, a strong owner, a clear communicator, and a leader who thrives on collaboration.

title: Corporate Planning & Management-Bengaluru-Analyst-Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
**Corporate Planning & Management, Product & Reporting, Analyst**
**Goldman Sachs Overview**
Goldman Sachs aims to be the employer, advisor, and investment of choice by attracting and retaining the best and most diverse talent. Through our leadership and diversity efforts, integrated talent management processes and vibrant affinity network programs, we work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or other classification can maximize their potential.
  
  
The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and high-net-worth individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other major financial centers around the world.
  
  
**CORPORATE PLANNING & MANAGEMENT**
Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) brings together Finance & Planning, Product & Reporting, and Global Procurement to drive firmwide planning, financial governance, operational excellence, supplier management, and strategic transformation. CPM partners across the firm to deliver actionable insights, strengthen controls, optimize spend, and modernize business processes and platforms.
  
  
**CPM Operates Through The Following Core Pillars**

* Finance & Planning

Leads budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, analytics, and business insights, while partnering with divisional CFO organizations to support strategic decision-making and financial stewardship.
  
  

* Product & Reporting

Drives the evolution of finance and operational platforms, delivering business-led transformation, automation, and technology solutions that improve efficiency, controls, and user experience.
  
  

* Global Procurement

Strategically enables the firm's engagement with third parties, ensuring robust commercial and compliance controls while driving sustainability.
  
  
**CPM Product & Reporting Team**
Manages end-to-end product lifecycle and reporting capabilities for vendor-supplied and internally developed solutions. We empower CPM stakeholders with intuitive tools and actionable insights while ensuring solutions meet business needs and regulatory demands. The Product team oversees development and maintenance of a diverse portfolio of technology platforms including Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) systems, Spend Management platforms, and Third Party Risk Management tools. The team includes enhancing user experience and enabling business units to manage vendor relationships, process transactions, and monitor compliance through integrated digital workflows. The Reporting team delivers comprehensive reports, dashboards, and data analytics providing visibility into spending patterns, risk metrics, and operational performance. This enables our stakeholders to monitor KPIs, identify cost savings opportunities, and make evidence-based decisions while ensuring data accuracy and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
You will be a key member of the CPM Finance Product & Reporting organization, responsible for supporting the firm's organizational reference data platform (Organizer) and ensuring the integrity of cost center, department, and hierarchy structures used across finance, planning, reporting, and allocation processes. The role combines operational execution, governance, stakeholder management, and product ownership responsibilities to drive both business outcomes and platform enhancements. The position aligns closely with Organizer's responsibility for department setup, hierarchy maintenance, entitlement governance, reconciliations, and hierarchy oversight.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Manage monthly cost center lifecycle activities, including setup, updates, closures, and governance reviews.
* Maintain and support organizational hierarchies, ensuring alignment across planning, reporting, and finance systems.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure hierarchy integrity.
* Partner with Finance, HCM, Controllers, and business stakeholders to support organizational change initiatives.
* Act as a product owner for Organizer, gathering requirements, prioritizing engineering backlog, and driving feature delivery.
* Support testing, release management, and adoption of new platform capabilities and process automation initiatives.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or related field.
* 2-3 years of experience in Reference Data Management. Finance Transformation, Business Analysis, Product Ownership.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with financial hierarchies, cost centers, governance processes, or enterprise data platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and tools such as Anaplan, Oracle/HCM, Power BI, or workflow platforms is a plus.

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer. © The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2019. All rights reserved.

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:
**Who We Are?**
**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**
GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.
  
  
Then AI changed what
**upskilling**
even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.
  
  
So, we built
**Outskill**
, our AI education arm, to close that gap — practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today, GrowthSchool and Outskill have reached
**16M+ learners across 160+ countries**
, with programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.
  
  
**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**
**What that actually feels like day to day:**
We're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.
  
  
If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
As GrowthSchool and Outskill continue to scale, our finance operations are becoming increasingly complex across multiple group entities.
  
  
We need someone who can take ownership of
**end-to-end accounting, financial reporting, monthly book closure and statutory compliance**
, ensuring that our financial records remain accurate, transparent and audit-ready.
  
  
This role will work closely with the Finance leadership team to strengthen accounting processes, improve financial governance and build scalable systems that support business growth and future global expansion.
  
  
We're looking for someone who is hands-on, detail-oriented and capable of managing finance operations independently while bringing structure and accountability to the function.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Group Accounting & Financial Close
  
  

* Maintain accurate books of accounts on a daily basis and ensure timely financial reporting to management.
* Own the end-to-end monthly book closure across all GrowthSchool group entities.
* Ensure accurate accounting of general ledger (GL), accruals, provisions, depreciation and prepaid expenses.
* Manage inter-company transactions and reconciliations across group entities.
* Prepare schedules and supporting documentation required for consolidation and group-level reporting.
* Drive timely month-end and year-end financial closures with accuracy and minimal escalations.
* Identify discrepancies, resolve accounting issues and maintain the integrity of financial records.

Financial Reporting & Business Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with Finance leadership on financial reporting, governance and strategic finance initiatives.
* Provide accurate and timely financial information to support business decisions.
* Support new business initiatives from an accounting, taxation and compliance perspective.
* Ensure financial data is structured, reliable and accessible for management reviews.
* Help build a finance function capable of supporting business growth and global expansion.

Statutory Compliance & Audit Management
  
  

* Ensure timely completion of statutory, regulatory and tax compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Maintain audit-ready books, schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents.
* Support statutory and tax audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor compliance deadlines and ensure there are no missed filings or regulatory obligations.
* Strengthen internal financial controls and accounting governance across group entities.

Process Improvement & Financial Controls
  
  

* Establish and improve accounting processes, documentation standards and financial controls.
* Identify gaps in existing finance operations and implement corrective measures.
* Build structured workflows for accounting, reconciliations and financial reporting.
* Ensure consistency and accuracy in accounting practices across all group entities.
* Leverage technology and automation wherever possible to improve finance operations.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
  
  

* Daily accounting and financial reporting are accurate and error-free.
* Monthly books are closed accurately and on time, without escalations.
* Zero missed statutory or regulatory compliance deadlines.
* Clean statutory and tax audits with no material observations.
* Leadership has complete confidence in the accuracy of financial reporting.
* Strong internal controls and accounting processes are implemented across group entities.
* Finance operations scale seamlessly alongside business growth.

**What We're Looking For**
We're looking for a
**hands-on finance and accounting professional**
who can independently manage accounting operations, drive financial closures and ensure strong compliance and governance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines
**strong accounting fundamentals, statutory compliance knowledge, financial discipline, attention to detail and an execution-focused mindset.**
Must-Have
  
  

* CA / CMA qualification.
* 2–6 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance operations and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing end-to-end books of accounts for growing organizations.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements and general ledger management.
* Hands-on experience with monthly, quarterly and year-end book closures.
* Experience handling accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and inter-company transactions.
* Working knowledge of statutory compliance, taxation and regulatory requirements.
* Experience coordinating with statutory auditors, tax consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Ability to prepare financial schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents for audits and consolidation.
* Strong understanding of internal financial controls and accounting processes.
* High attention to detail, accuracy and ownership.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Good-to-Have
  
  

* Experience working in startups, high-growth organizations or multi-entity businesses.
* Exposure to AI, EdTech, SaaS or B2B technology companies.
* Experience handling group accounting, consolidation and inter-company reconciliations.
* Familiarity with accounting ERP systems and finance automation tools.
* Knowledge of global accounting practices and cross-border compliance.
* Technical certifications or working knowledge of SQL, Power BI or other data analytics tools.
* Experience implementing process improvements and automation within finance operations.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to own and strengthen the accounting and finance operations of a fast-growing company.
* Direct exposure to Finance leadership and strategic business initiatives.
* Opportunity to build scalable accounting processes and financial controls across multiple group entities.

title: SPE-Asset Mgmt Capital Markets
description:
**Job Summary**
This profile is requirement towards OTC brokerage fee payables function with ability to reconcile broker invoices against client internal records. Needs to be proficient with all types of OTC products and ability to calculate / validate brokerage fee calculation using standard rate agreements. Managing broker statement and their outstanding dues basis ageing is a key requirement of this role. Besides should have good communication skill and ability to resolve queries with brokers
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute daily brokerage fees reconciliation activities by validating trade data fee schedules and cash movements while ensuring accurate recording of payables and receivables across multiple capital markets products.
* Perform detailed analysis of brokerage fees discrepancies by comparing operational records with broker statements and internal systems resolving mismatches in a timely manner to minimize financial exposure.
* Develop Excel macros and VBA solutions that automate recurring reconciliation tasks streamline data consolidation and improve the accuracy of brokerage related reporting for asset management stakeholders.
* Utilize advanced MS Excel functions to maintain structured datasets perform variance analysis on fees and positions and generate insightful reports that support operational decision making in capital markets.
* Manage Outlook emails for daily coordination with internal teams and external brokers by organizing instructions confirmations and queries in a systematic way that supports clear audit trails.
* Conduct OTC operational risk management reviews by assessing process flows identifying control gaps and recommending enhancements that reduce the likelihood and impact of operational incidents.
* Monitor OTC brokerage fees payables by tracking settlements investigating aged items and collaborating with Payment teams to ensure that balances are accurate and aligned with contractual terms.
* Prepare periodic operational metrics and fee reconciliation summaries that highlight trends root cause patterns and remediation status enabling management teams to act on data driven insights.
* Support implementation of process improvements in asset management operations by documenting procedures testing enhancements in non production environments and providing feedback that refines workflows for hybrid work settings.
* Collaborate with risk finance and trading support teams to clarify complex fee structures and OTC terms so that operational records reconciliations and controls reflect the economic reality of capital markets transactions.
* Maintain high standards of data quality and operational discipline by following defined procedures logging exceptions and escalating unresolved items promptly to safeguard the organization and market participants.
* Contribute to company initiatives that promote transparency and trust in capital markets by ensuring that fee processes reconciliations and risk controls support fair outcomes for clients and counterparties.
* Adapt working practices to the hybrid work model by effectively using digital collaboration tools maintaining clear communication channels and managing day shift responsibilities without requiring travel.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong proficiency in MS Excel by confidently using formulas pivot tables and data validation to support detailed brokerage fees analysis and reconciliation work.
* Apply Excel macro and VBA programming experience to design enhance and maintain automation scripts that reduce manual effort and operational risk in reconciliation and reporting processes.
* Use Outlook email skills to organize communications manage workflow requests and document broker interactions in a structured manner that supports efficient hybrid teamwork.
* Bring practical experience in brokerage fees reconciliation by interpreting fee schedules mapping trade records and closing breaks in payables and receivables for asset management capital markets operations.
* Exhibit domain knowledge in OTC operational risk management by understanding trading lifecycles collateral flows and key risk indicators that influence control design and oversight.
* Show hands on expertise in OTC brokerage fees payables and receivables processing by tracking invoices matching to trade and fee data and supporting timely settlement within agreed timelines.
* Leverage two to four years of relevant asset management or capital markets operations experience to navigate complex fee scenarios and support continuous improvement in middle office practices.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include CIPM or FRM or recognized capital markets operations certification focused on OTC products and reconciliation practices.

title: Finance Manager, FX Risk Management
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Finance
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Financial Planning & Analysis
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Finance Manager to join Innovative Medicine Principal Operations (IMPO) as part of an international team. This role is for experienced finance leaders who will lead and develop a team of analysts, take full accountability for end-to-end process delivery and controls, and drive continuous improvement in how the team operates. You will work closely with colleagues across the globe, build a broad global network, and gain visibility across the financial flows & processes that connect R&D, Supply Chain and our commercial operating companies.
  
  
**About Innovative Medicine Principal Operations (IMPO)**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
J&J IMPO is a global organization working in close collaboration with R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, Tax and Treasury. Our greatest asset is our people, and we foster an environment where collaboration, success, passion, and diversity are celebrated. We are committed to developing the talents of our team members and providing meaningful opportunities for growth and advancement. By joining us, you become part of a community recognized for its reliability, trustworthiness, and expertise.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
As Finance Manager, you will lead critical FX Risk Management processes for J&J Innovative Medicine’s business, while managing, coaching and developing a team of FX analysts. You will own end-to-end exposure management and hedge accounting in line with J&J's global hedging policies, a highly specialized capability with direct impact on the company's financial results.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
The Exact Process Scope Will Be Assigned Based On Business Needs And Individual Strengths. Broadly, Together With Your Team, You Will
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the offshore FX Risk Management team, setting clear priorities and fostering a high-performing, learning-oriented team culture.
* Lead the monthly forecast and balance sheet hedging execution process, ensuring accurate, timely and well-controlled execution as well as hand-offs in close partnership with the onshore FX Risk Management team.
* Proactively manage cross-functional stakeholder relationships, communicating timelines, risks and required actions, and escalating issues in a timely, fact-based and solution-oriented manner.
* Oversee hedge accounting activities, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting policies and controls.
* Serve as a trusted partner in maintaining a robust control framework, ensuring compliance with SOX and financial policies, supporting audit activities, and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen processes and mitigate risk.
* Drive operational excellence, standardization and continuous improvement across FX Risk Management processes and the wider finance organization.
* Partner with global FX Risk Management, Treasury, SigniFX (FX project team) and Finance Technology teams to resolve issues and ensure effective end-to-end execution.

Core Competencies for Success
  
  
Success in this role depends on demonstrating and growing the following capabilities:
  
  

* Agility & Innovation: Takes the initiative to bring an innovative, agile mindset; seeks ways to recommend process improvements, broaden perspectives and challenge the status quo in a fast-paced environment.
* Finance Fundamentals: Applies solid financial and accounting knowledge to interpret data, understand drivers and support sound decision-making across connected processes.
* Financial Control, Compliance & Risk Management: Anticipates and manages process and data risks, strengthens controls, and safeguards compliance across the activities they own.
* Business Acumen: Researches and analyzes how internal and external factors impact the processes they support, and connects the team’s work to broader business outcomes.
* Trusted Business Partner: Builds trusted relationships across a matrixed, global environment, influences using fact-based insight, and tailors communication to different audiences.
* Digitally Enabled Finance: Leverages finance systems, data tools and automation to improve efficiency and data quality, and champions their adoption within the team.
* People Leadership: Builds, coaches and develops a high-performing team, sets clear priorities and expectations, and creates an environment of accountability and continuous learning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field is required.
* A recognized professional qualification in finance or accounting, such as CA, CMA (ICWA), CFA, ACCA, CPA or ACA, or an MBA (Finance), is required.
* A min of 10-15 years of relevant experience in operational finance, accounting, controlling or a finance-hub/shared-services environment, ideally in a multinational or complex matrix organization.
* Exposure to FX risk management, treasury or hedge accounting (Ind AS 109 / IFRS 9 / US GAAP ASC 815) is a strong advantage.
* A critical, improvement-oriented mindset with the confidence to challenge processes constructively.
* Advanced Excel skills; hands-on experience with SAP, SAP Analysis for Office (AFO), Anaplan or similar finance systems preferred; Power BI and Copilot are a plus.
* Excellent English communication and stakeholder-management skills, with experience working across global teams and time zones.
* Proven ability to lead, coach and develop a team, and to manage priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

This is what awaits YOU at J&J
  
  

* Work in an international setting: Collaborate closely with EMEA and global colleagues, develop a strong international network, and learn from diverse perspectives across the organization.
* Gain end-to-end business visibility: Ownership of critical global finance processes, with genuine end-to-end visibility of how a multinational healthcare business plans and reports.
* Make an impact: Improve, standardize and automate critical finance processes.
* Grow your career through accelerated development via the J&J Global Finance Skill Area Framework, exposure to senior stakeholders, and a clear pathway to greater responsibility.
* Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture, with competitive rewards, and flexible/hybrid working arrangements.

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
AI solution evaluation, Analytical Reasoning, Audit Management, Budgeting, Business Savvy, Consulting, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Developing Others, Econometric Models, Financial Analysis, Financial Competence, Financial Forecasting, Financial Modeling, Financial Planning, Financial Reports, Financial Risk Management (FRM), Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, Team Management

title: Senior Associate Finance
description:
**Who We Are?**
**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**
GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.
  
  
Then AI changed what
**upskilling**
even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.
  
  
So, we built
**Outskill**
, our AI education arm, to close that gap — practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today, GrowthSchool and Outskill have reached
**16M+ learners across 160+ countries**
, with programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.
  
  
**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**
**What that actually feels like day to day:**
We're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.
  
  
If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
As GrowthSchool continues to scale, our finance function needs strong execution at the operational level to ensure that everyday accounting, payments, reconciliations and compliance activities run smoothly.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Senior Associate – Finance**
who can independently manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations, maintain accurate financial records, support audits and ensure timely execution of recurring finance activities.
  
  
This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of the operational backbone of our finance function — ensuring accuracy, discipline and reliability across financial transactions and administrative processes.
  
  
You'll work closely with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to build structured processes that can support the company's growing business operations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Operations
  
  

* Record and maintain daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, including invoice processing, payment tracking and follow-ups.
* Perform regular bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Manage employee reimbursements, expense claims and related documentation.
* Support monthly and year-end book closure activities.
* Maintain organized financial records, vouchers, invoices and supporting documents.
* Identify discrepancies in financial transactions and ensure timely resolution.

Statutory Compliance & Audit Support
  
  

* Assist with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory filings and returns.
* Prepare and share financial data, reconciliations and schedules required for statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors and internal teams for audit-related requirements.
* Support the finance team in meeting regulatory and compliance deadlines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for compliance and audit purposes.
* Ensure financial information and supporting documents are readily available whenever required.

Asset Management & Administrative Operations
  
  

* Conduct periodic physical verification of company assets.
* Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
* Track asset additions, transfers, disposals and related documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for day-to-day finance and operational requirements.
* Handle documentation, filing and record-keeping for the finance function.
* Support miscellaneous administrative activities required to keep finance operations running smoothly.

Process Discipline & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Follow established accounting processes and ensure accuracy in daily execution.
* Maintain timely updates across payments, receivables and reconciliations.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements in existing finance workflows.
* Ensure recurring finance activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Maintain strong documentation and process discipline across all assigned responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)
  
  

* Daily accounting is accurate, timely and error-free.
* Payments, receivables and reconciliations are processed on schedule without backlogs.
* Statutory and compliance data is always ready ahead of deadlines.
* Audits are supported smoothly with well-organized documentation.
* Fixed asset records are accurate and physical verification is completed on time.
* Financial records, vouchers and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Finance operations run reliably with strong process discipline and accountability.

What We're Looking For
  
  
We're looking for a
**detail-oriented and execution-focused finance professional**
who takes ownership of day-to-day accounting operations and understands the importance of accuracy, consistency and timely execution.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines
**strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on experience with accounting systems, compliance knowledge and operational discipline.**
Must-Have
  
  

* B.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter qualification.
* Up to 3 years of experience in accounting and finance operations, preferably in an industry environment.
* Hands-on experience managing daily accounting transactions and maintaining books of accounts.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing and payment management.
* Experience in bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books or similar platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Experience managing employee reimbursements, expense claims and financial documentation.
* Understanding of fixed asset management and asset register maintenance.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks independently and meet deadlines.
* Strong ownership, accountability and follow-through.

Good-to-Have
  
  

* Experience working in startups or high-growth organizations.
* Exposure to AI, EdTech, SaaS or B2B technology companies.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business entities.
* Familiarity with finance automation tools and digital accounting workflows.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel functions and financial reporting.
* Experience improving accounting processes and operational workflows.
* Ability to leverage technology to improve finance operations and reporting efficiency.

What We're Evaluating
  
  
We're less interested in how many years you've worked and more interested in how much ownership you've demonstrated.
  
  
**We'll Be Looking For Evidence Of**

* Ownership of day-to-day accounting and operational accuracy.
* Strong understanding of core accounting principles and processes.
* Reliability in managing recurring tasks, reconciliations and compliance data.
* High attention to detail with strong process discipline.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues independently.
* Bias toward execution, accountability and follow-through.
* Ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving environments.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the finance foundations of one of India's fastest-growing learning companies.
* Direct exposure to Finance leadership and business operations.
* High ownership from Day 1 with real responsibility for finance operations.
* Opportunity to strengthen and improve finance systems and processes as the company scales.
* Access to India's best AI minds, premium AI courses and cutting-edge AI tools and workflows.
* Free access to GrowthSchool and Outskill programs, including AI Mastermind and fellowships.
* Opportunity to work alongside the founding team at GrowthSchool HQ.
* Competitive compensation and meaningful long-term career growth.

Work Location
  
  

* Bengaluru – On-site.

title: Application Specialist II - INDIA IMMERSE
description:
Overview:

Waters, the world's leading specialty measurement company that cares about inclusion and diversity is seeking for a **Application Specialist** to support the very successful growth of our businesses across (India MSD and IMMERSE ). Waters deliver benefits through innovation and people that enable customer success in the life, materials and food sciences. **People create the Waters difference.** By engaging with our talented and diverse workforce we continuously evolve, develop and enhance our products. We believe in delivering innovative technology and system solutions to our valued customers to enable their success. Our talented application teams have over the years delivered great and sustainable technical solution.

Immerse Research Scientist – Materials Characterization.

The position focuses on collaborative research projects and technical application support for the Waters Materials Science portfolio.

The Immerse Research Scientist will drive collaborative research projects and provide technical application support for Waters' Materials Science portfolio. The position will be split approximately 50% on customer facing collaborative research activities and 50% on pre-sales **“and post-sales”** application support for the Materials Science Division (MSD).

The scientist will leverage expertise in thermal analysis, sorption science, rheology, and biophysical characterization to help customers solve complex research challenges, develop application workflows, generate scientific data, and support commercial opportunities

  
Responsibilities:

* To lead collaborative research initiatives and provide technical application support for Waters' Materials Science portfolio, leveraging DSC, TGA, DVS, Rheometer, and Nano DSC platforms. The role is designed with an approximately 50:50 focus on customer-facing research collaborations and pre-sales/post-sales support activities, contributing to scientific innovation, application development, customer success, and business growth for the Materials Science Division (MSD).
* Work closely with Business partners and Field Sales operations to provide credible and impartial consultancy and technical sponsor in a fast paced pre- and post sales environment.
* Collaborate with the team of Account Managers in diagnosing the customer’s requirements, and design analysis that showcase the better capabilities of Waters product portfolio in line with the customers’ goals.
* Perform instrument demonstrations and provide expert advice to customers during the sales process, focusing on how Waters system solutions will address and benefit the customer’s needs.
* Ensure that the equipment, analysis and customer demonstrations are properly prepared, in order to guarantee the highest level of customer experience in a timely manner.
* Perform system and application training as well as technical sponsor to customers after the product has been installed.
* Conduct internal Waters Solutions Training to Field Sales Operations.
* Provide pre-sales “and post-sales” application support for the Materials Science Division (MSD) portfolio, including customer consultations, feasibility studies, method development, and data interpretation.
* Support MSD commercial activities by working closely with sales teams to identify opportunities, qualify customer requirements, and demonstrate the value of Waters' materials characterization solutions.
* Conduct instrument demonstrations, proof-of-concept studies, sample analysis, and customer training programs using DSC, TGA, DVS, Rheometer, and Nano DSC systems.
* Develop and validate innovative application workflows and generate high-quality scientific data to support customer success and business growth.
* Collaborate with internal application specialists, product specialists, marketing, and commercial teams to develop new applications and support strategic business initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), research scientists, professors, and industry experts to establish long-term collaborative partnerships.
* Present technical seminars, workshops, webinars, conference presentations, and scientific publications to promote Waters' Materials Science technologies and application capabilities.
* Maintain and manage Immerse laboratory instrumentation and ensure effective utilization of laboratory resources for customer projects, demonstrations, and collaborative research activities.
* Identify emerging research trends and new application opportunities relevant to thermal analysis, material characterization, pharmaceutical formulation, protein stability, and sustainability-related research.
* Prepare technical reports, application notes, white papers, and scientific publications arising from collaborative projects and customer engagements.
* Support the development of the MSD business pipeline through technical engagement with customers and provide regular updates on project status, research outcomes, and commercial opportunities.
* Uphold Waters' scientific excellence and brand integrity while delivering exceptional customer experiences and high-quality research outcomes.

**Experience:**

* 3+ years user experience with DSC,TGA ,DVS , Rheometer & NANO DSC

**Skills:**

* Action oriented and eager to achieve results
* Sound communication and presentation skills
* Highly organized / well-prepared / time management skills
* Strong interactive skills and a good listener
* Matured disposition, positive attitude and strong sense of dedication
* Adaptive to a dynamic and ever-changing environment
* Strong technical background in analytical technologies, especially DSC,TGA,DVS,Rheometer and NANO DSC

description:

Channel Manager

In this role, you will have the opportunity to enable internal sales teams, channel partners and customers to successfully use ABB Shop, EDI, Punchout and system-to-system integrations. It combines user training, implementation support, first-level operational support, master-data and portfolio coordination, customer onboarding, content syndication, campaign activation and structured feedback management. The specialist acts as the local connection between customers, sales units, divisions and global eCommerce teams to simplify digital buying journeys and accelerate sustainable eCommerce adoption.

The work model for the role is: #LI\_Onsite

This role is contributing to the Motion business for IEC Low Voltage Division based in Bangalore, India

You will be mainly accountable for:

1. Implementation and customer onboarding

* Support ABB Shop and connected solution rollouts, including user acceptance, readiness, hypercare and stabilization.
* Define onboarding roadmaps, priorities and targets with sales, account and channel managers; guide stakeholders from engagement to activation and adoption.
* Coordinate eligibility, commercial setup, access, portfolio, data and integration readiness; align valid local business, legal, tax and operational requirements with divisional and global teams.

* Provide first-level sales support for ABB Shop, order management and CQP/CPQ; triage issues, resolve standard queries and coordinate escalations.

* Present ABB Shop and eCommerce benefits, capabilities and potential to leaders, sales teams, partners and customers; develop reusable communication and adoption frameworks.
* Analyze user feedback, distinguish local issues from global product needs and channel insights to divisional and global teams to inform customer-experience improvements, roadmaps and backlog priorities.

Run regional adoption campaigns and communications with marketing, sales and divisions to build awareness, activation, repeat use and engagement.

title: Lead - Customer Success Management-Senior Manager-Bangalore
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Customer Success leader to drive strategic relationships with Vodafone Business customers across Europe, the Americas and APAC. Based in Pune, this role will lead customer success activities for Global Enterprise accounts with contract values of approximately €10–40 million.

You will develop customer success strategies focused on improving retention, reducing churn, increasing product and service adoption and strengthening customer satisfaction. You will also manage high-impact customer escalations and engage with senior customer stakeholders through face-to-face and virtual interactions.

The role requires strong knowledge of enterprise telecommunications products and services, particularly Fixed Line and Mobility, complemented by experience across areas such as SD-WAN, Cybersecurity, IoT, SaaS, Mobile Private Networks (MPN), Cloud and Unified Communications.

Commercial and financial capability is important, including P&L management, account profitability and identifying opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling. The role also involves leading and mentoring a Customer Success team of approximately 10–20 members.

Working hours will align with customer headquarters, including APAC, European and Americas schedules. Shift working is therefore required. Travel requirements are rare.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Develop and implement Customer Success strategies that improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Build sustainable relationships with Global Enterprise customers and serve as a key Vodafone representative for senior stakeholders, including operational and technology leaders.
* Lead and mentor Customer Success professionals, establishing performance goals, service standards and competitive KPIs.
* Understand customer business strategies and propose product roadmaps that support customer growth while expanding Vodafone's footprint.
* Develop bespoke customer SLAs, performance measures and scalable service propositions aligned with individual customer requirements.
* Lead weekly and monthly service reviews, providing clear insight into product and service performance.
* Manage complex customer escalations and coordinate timely resolution across operational and enabling teams.
* Oversee contractual obligations and service performance across multiple geographies.
* Manage P&L and contribute to account profitability through budgeting, forecasting and effective commercial decision-making.
* Identify revenue leakage and pursue appropriate cross-sell, up-sell and product-upgrade opportunities.
* Analyse customer feedback and operational data to identify trends and drive continuous service improvement.
* Monitor service credits and maintain accurate customer, service and bespoke product inventories.
* Support delivery teams with the progression of on-hold orders and customer commitments.
* Create and maintain consistent customer documentation, governance processes, reports and meeting records.
* Coordinate Service Operations and ITIL functions to support reliable day-to-day service delivery.
* Drive service development across Sell, Build/Delivery and Run functions.
* Work effectively with internal teams, vendors and carriers across global markets.
* Support digitalisation and automation of customer reporting using technologies such as Power BI, SQL and Python.

Key measures of success include team NPS, account profitability, P&L performance, employee retention, customer experience and development of service strategy.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential experience and capabilities**

* 8+ years' experience in Customer Success Management, including responsibility for global customers and face-to-face relationship management.
* Strong telecommunications product knowledge, with in-depth understanding of at least two areas such as Fixed Line, Mobility, Cybersecurity, IoT, SaaS, MPN, Cloud or Unified Communications.
* Experience presenting product and service performance to senior customer and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to develop trusted relationships with international customers and represent Vodafone professionally.
* Experience leading and mentoring customer-facing teams, setting objectives and establishing service standards.
* Financial acumen, including the ability to interpret P&L statements and contribute to account profitability.
* Understanding of budgeting and forecasting.
* ITIL 4 knowledge and understanding of service capability across Sales, Build/Delivery and Run.
* Understanding of transmission, LAN/WAN, MPLS Layer 2 and Layer 3, internet access, DSL, Fixed Voice and SD-WAN fundamentals.
* Strong critical-thinking and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to manage customer conflicts and de-escalate complex situations.
* Experience collaborating with vendors and carriers.
* Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management and time-management capabilities.
* Knowledge of Power BI, SQL or Python for customer dashboard automation and digitalisation.
* Understanding of Agile or Scrum ways of working.
* Bachelor of Engineering in any discipline.
* Relevant technical/product certification such as CCNA/CCNP, AWS Solution Architect or Azure Fundamentals.
* Relevant professional certification such as ITIL Intermediate, PRINCE2 Practitioner or PMP.

### **Desirable experience and capabilities**

* Sales experience and the ability to identify opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling enterprise telecommunications products.
* Experience managing Customer Success or Operations teams.
* Knowledge of SD-WAN architecture, MPN, IoT Connected Spaces, Automotive solutions and Device Management.
* Advanced ITIL Service Lifecycle or Service Capability knowledge.
* Engineering degree in Electronics and Communications or Computer Science.

**Company Description**

**Informa** is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis** is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you. Our teams are solving unique and difficult problems at scale in an energetic and hyper-growth environment. We’re growing incredibly quickly, and we need experienced technical people to help us scale.

 **Job Description**

**Job role:**

We are currently hiring for the role of **Service Analyst** to add to our **Technology team** based out of Bengaluru, India. This role will report into the Team Lead - Service Management Operations.

* Work alongside and share knowledge with other members of the Service Management team.
* Other relevant & related tasks and activities assigned by the Service Management Team Lead and/or Service Manager/Service Owners.

* Experience in an IT operations support environment supporting global users.
* Good knowledge of MS Office applications, especially the Office 365 suite of products.
* Good hands-on knowledge on ticketing tool like ServiceNow or any other similar tool.

Functional definition, governance and translation to system requirements** – Identify and document global business functionalities, information and data gaps, gap solutions and match functionality to enable market solutioning and system configuration. ### **About Niyo**

Niyo is a leading Indian consumer fintech platform transforming how millions of Indians bank, save, and spend globally. Operating in partnership with regulated banking and financial institutions, Niyo offers zero-forex-markup international travel cards, digital savings and salary accounts, remittances, and wealth solutions. We are looking for a detail-oriented, process-driven Accounts Executive to own day-to-day Accounts Payable,high-volume payment/bank reconciliations, and treasury/banking operations.

### **Role Overview**

Reporting to the Finance Manager / Finance Controller, the Accounts Executive will ensure timely and accurate vendor payouts, maintain spotless reconciliation across corporate bank accounts, nodal/escrow accounts, and payment gateways, and manage daily banking operations. This role is critical to maintaining financial accuracy, compliance hygiene, and smooth month-end book closures in a fast-paced fintech environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Accounts Payable (AP) & Expense Management**

* Verify, code, and book vendor invoices, SaaS/cloud bills, marketing invoices, and partner payouts in the ERP system in line with approved Purchase Orders (POs) and contracts.
* Ensure accurate **TDS deduction** (under relevant Income Tax sections) and **GST input tax credit (ITC)**validation before processing payments.
* Manage employee expense reimbursements, corporate credit card reconciliations, and vendor ledger scrutiny, resolving billing discrepancies promptly.
* Maintain vendor master data, track MSME payment timelines (ensuring compliance with the 45-day rule),and handle vendor balance confirmations.

#### **2. Financial & Transaction Reconciliations**

* Perform daily and monthly **Bank Reconciliations (BRS)** across multiple corporate current accounts, FD accounts, and operational accounts.
* Execute high-volume reconciliations across **Payment Gateways (PGs), Nodal/Escrow accounts, Partner Bank settlement files, and internal ledger reports**, flagging unallocated credits, failed refunds,or settlement mismatches immediately.
* Coordinate with Product Ops, Customer Support, and Partner Banks to investigate and close open reconciliation items within defined SLAs.

#### **3. Banking Operations & Treasury Support**

* Prepare and upload bulk payment batches (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/API payouts) on corporate banking portals for vendor settlements, statutory dues, and payroll runs.
* Coordinate with relationship managers at partner banks for account maintenance, mandate updates, bank guarantees, FD bookings/renewals, and audit confirmation letters.
* Assist in daily cash-position reporting and fund transfers between operational and nodal accounts to ensure optimal liquidity.

#### **4. Audit & Month-End Close Support**

* Prepare monthly schedules for prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, vendor advances, and open BRS items during period-end close.
* Support statutory, internal, and tax audits by providing timely vouchers, bank statements, reconciliation working papers, and statutory challans.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Criteria**

**Requirements**

  

**Education**

**B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance)** or **CA Inter** with solid foundational accounting knowledge.

  

**Experience**

**4–6 years** of hands-on experience in Accounts Payable, Bank Operations, and Reconciliations—preferably in **FinTech, Payments, E-commerce, or high-transaction tech companies**.

  

**Tax & Compliance**

Working knowledge of **TDS provisions, GST invoicing/ITC rules, and MSME compliance**.

  

**Technical & Excel Skills**

Proficient in **MS Excel** (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, handling large CSV settlement files) and modern accounting ERPs (NetSuite, Zoho Books, SAP, or Tally).

  

**Key Attributes**

High attention to detail, strong ownership, ability to spot anomalies in large datasets, and clear communication with internal teams and bank RMs.

title: Manager, Regulatory Operations
description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?  
  
This role is part of Alcon's Quality & Regulatory Affairs function, a team that ensures our products are in compliance with global, local, and internal regulations and meet the strictest standards of quality as we help people see brilliantly. The Manager, Regulatory Operations (Professional Path) is primarily responsible for acting as a key regulatory partner, facilitating operations to align new and existing products with global strategies, and ensuring compliance with regional regulations. You will build strong relationships with regional Regulatory Heads and manage product registrations and licenses.

  
  

### **In this role, a typical day will include:**

* Manage regulatory data activities across Veeva RIM, EUDAMED, GUDID, and eSTAR, ensuring accurate and timely regulatory information.
* Oversee Veeva RIM data stewardship, including registration, license, product, and regulatory hierarchy data.
* Ensure regulatory data quality, completeness, consistency, and traceability through validation, reconciliation, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage regulatory data required for device registrations, listings, licenses, renewals, and submissions.
* Coordinate EUDAMED and GUDID data preparation, maintenance, and updates, including device and UDI-related regulatory data.
* Support accurate and consistent regulatory data used in eSTAR submissions.
* Identify and remediate regulatory data gaps, discrepancies, and duplicate or outdated records.
* Monitor data quality KPIs and dashboards and drive improvements based on identified trends.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs and system/IT teams on data requirements and system enhancements while maintaining Regulatory Operations ownership of the regulatory business data.

### **Preferred Qualifications / Skills / Experience:**

  

* Experience with Veeva RIM regulatory data management and data stewardship.
* Working knowledge of EUDAMED, GUDID, and FDA eSTAR.
* Experience with regulatory registration, license, product, UDI, and submission data.
* Experience with data validation, reconciliation, remediation, and data-quality monitoring.
* Experience developing regulatory data KPIs, dashboards, and reporting, preferably using Power BI or Tableau.
* 6 to 8 years of experience

title: Assistant Facilities Manager - India
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Sr Facilities Project Manager - IND Summary

  

The Assistant Facilities Manager (Sr. Facilities Project Manager) is responsible for ensuring seamless day-to-day workplace operations and delivering an exceptional employee experience through effective management of facilities services, workplace operations, vendor performance, compliance programs, employee transportation, hospitality services, and office administration.

The role oversees janitorial services, asset lifecycle management, facilities and asset maintenance, employee transport, cafeteria and pantry operations, landlord and WeWork relationships, security, housekeeping, office administration, workplace events, statutory compliance, and facilities budget management. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong ownership, flexibility, customer focus, operational discipline, responsiveness, and a high sense of urgency in addressing critical workplace matters.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Facilities Operations & Maintenance**
---------------------------------------

* Manage day-to-day facilities operations to maintain a safe, reliable, efficient, and productive workplace.

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance for office infrastructure, utilities, equipment, and workplace assets.

* Manage work requests from logging through completion, ensuring timely resolution, documentation, and closure against agreed service levels.

* Conduct routine facility inspections, identify risks or service gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with vendors, landlords, and internal partners.

* Coordinate minor projects, office moves, repairs, installations, and workplace modifications while minimizing business disruption.

**Asset Lifecycle Management**
------------------------------

* Manage the asset lifecycle, including procurement coordination, tagging, inventory, allocation, transfer, maintenance, reconciliation, and disposal.

* Maintain accurate asset registers and supporting documentation, and coordinate periodic physical verification and audits.

* Monitor asset condition, utilization, and maintenance history to support reliability, replacement planning, and cost-effective lifecycle decisions.

**Housekeeping, Janitorial & Pest Control**
-------------------------------------------

* Oversee housekeeping, janitorial, waste management, washroom hygiene, and pest-control services.

* Maintain consistent workplace cleanliness and hygiene standards through scheduled audits, inspections, and corrective-action follow-up.

* Monitor vendor staffing, consumables, equipment, service quality, and performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.

**Security Operations**
-----------------------

* Oversee contract security services, access control, visitor management, key management, and incident reporting.

* Coordinate emergency response readiness and support investigations and resolution of security-related incidents.

* Ensure security operations align with company standards, landlord requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations.

**Employee Transport Services**
-------------------------------

* Manage employee transport operations, vendors, routes, rosters, service delivery, escalations, and performance reviews.

* Monitor transport safety, vehicle and driver compliance, route efficiency, service reliability, and employee experience.

* Ensure applicable employee transportation and women-safety requirements are implemented, documented, and periodically reviewed.

* Respond promptly to transport disruptions and incidents, coordinate communication, and drive preventive actions.

**Cafeteria & Pantry Operations**
---------------------------------

* Oversee cafeteria, food-service, and pantry operations, including vendor coordination, hygiene, service quality, and inventory availability.

* Monitor food safety practices, statutory documentation, employee feedback, and corrective actions.

* Support menu planning, service improvements, responsible consumption, and waste-reduction initiatives.

**Vendor, Landlord & WeWork Contract Oversight**
------------------------------------------------

* Manage day-to-day relationships with landlords, building management, WeWork representatives, and facilities service providers.

* Administer service scopes, contracts, SLAs, KPIs, purchase orders, renewals, and commercial documentation in partnership with relevant functions.

* Conduct structured vendor governance reviews, document performance gaps, and follow through on improvement plans.

* Monitor landlord and workspace-provider obligations and escalate operational, contractual, or compliance risks appropriately.

**Office Administration & Logistics**
-------------------------------------

* Oversee office administration, workplace readiness, seating support, employee onboarding setup, meeting and common-area readiness, and general office services.

* Manage stationery and office-supply procurement, stock controls, issue records, and replenishment.

* Coordinate courier, mailroom, shipment, and logistics activities, including tracking, documentation, and timely delivery.

* Maintain organized records for services, vendors, assets, incidents, invoices, permits, and audits.

**Workplace Experience & Events**
---------------------------------

* Support the Fun Committee and partner with HR and business stakeholders on employee engagement activities.

* Coordinate office celebrations, cultural events, town halls, wellness programs, and other workplace initiatives.

* Manage end-to-end logistics for events held in the office or at external venues, including vendor coordination, safety requirements, schedules, and budget controls.

**Budget & Financial Management**
---------------------------------

* Support preparation and management of the annual facilities operating budget and periodic forecasts.

* Track commitments and actual expenditure, review vendor invoices, monitor purchase orders, and support accruals and variance analysis.

* Identify cost-efficiency and process-improvement opportunities without compromising safety, compliance, service quality, or employee experience.

* Maintain financial discipline, approval documentation, and timely reporting for facilities-related expenditure.

**Compliance, Health, Safety & Risk**
-------------------------------------

* Ensure facilities operations comply with applicable Karnataka Government requirements and relevant building, fire, safety, environmental, labor, food-service, transport, security, and statutory obligations.

* Maintain current licenses, permits, certificates, inspection records, statutory registers, and compliance evidence within the role scope.

* Coordinate internal and external audits, inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and closure tracking.

* Support emergency preparedness, incident response, business continuity, and periodic drills.

* Escalate compliance gaps and critical risks promptly and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

* Minimum 6 years of progressive experience in facilities management, workplace operations, corporate services, hospitality operations, property management, or a related field.

* Hands-on experience managing multiple facilities service vendors in a corporate office environment.

* Experience in maintenance coordination, asset management, transport operations, food services, security, housekeeping, office administration, budget tracking, and statutory compliance is strongly preferred.

* Facilities Management, EHS, fire safety, food safety, project management, or related professional certification will be an advantage.

**Required Competencies**
=========================

**Technical Competencies**
--------------------------

* Integrated facilities and workplace operations

* Preventive and corrective maintenance coordination

* Asset lifecycle and inventory management

* Vendor, SLA, KPI, and contract administration

* Employee transport, security, housekeeping, cafeteria, and pantry operations

* Budget tracking, cost control, invoice review, and forecasting support

* Statutory compliance, audit coordination, risk management, and incident response

* Work-order, service-request, and facilities data management

* Workplace events, administration, logistics, and stakeholder support

**Behavioral Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong ownership, accountability, and service orientation

* High responsiveness and a strong sense of urgency for critical matters

* Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and calm decision-making under pressure

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Strong vendor and stakeholder management

* Ability to prioritize multiple operational demands and follow through to closure

* Attention to detail, documentation discipline, and continuous-improvement mindset

* Collaborative, hands-on, and willing to support both planned work and urgent operational needs

**Critical Role Expectations**
==============================

* Flexibility to work outside regular business hours when operations, events, emergencies, or business needs require support.

* Availability to respond promptly to critical facilities incidents, transport disruptions, safety concerns, and workplace escalations.

* Proactive identification and escalation of operational, compliance, service, and financial risks.

* Ability to balance hands-on service delivery with vendor governance, reporting, planning, and stakeholder communication.

* Consistent professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and customer focus.

* 10+ years of experience, with relevant OT security experience of 5 years.

* Broad global experience, especially in collaborating with distributed teams on security topics.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, possessing confidence when engaging senior stakeholders.

CEO->CIO> Regional CIO > Director Employee Experience> IT Lead IT Governance

------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.

M&A integration • IT Operations governance • Program and portfolio management • Executive stakeholder engagement • Risk and dependency management • Vendor and financial management • Change communications • Operational readiness and continuous improvement

**Success Measures**
--------------------

M&A Integration (50%): Achievement of agreed integration milestones and Day 1 readiness; effective budget, risk and dependency management; successful adoption, stabilization and operational handover.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
At Document360, we're building the world's most powerful knowledge base platform for SaaS companies and enterprises. Trusted by global brands like Puma, HP, and several Fortune 500 companies, we help organizations centralize, scale, and deliver knowledge with clarity and control.

We don't just talk about value—we deliver it. Our Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) sits well above industry benchmarks, a testament to our product's stickiness and our CS team's relentless focus on customer outcomes.

Now, we're hiring a Customer Success Manager to help take our customers—and our team—to the next level. This is a retention-focused role: you won't carry an expansion or upsell quota. Instead, you'll own customer retention end to end—reducing churn, driving deeper adoption, and turning satisfied customers into advocates.

As a CSM, you're not here to just manage relationships. You will own customer outcomes, be accountable for churn and account health, and play a critical role in how we protect and scale success across Document360's customer base.

This role will manage a US-based customer portfolio, which means your core working hours will be between 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM IST (India Standard Time).

You'll work with some of the most forward-thinking product and operations teams in the world, guiding them from adoption to real, measurable, and durable success.

**What You'll Do Day to Day**

* **Own Retention, Not Just Accounts:** Guide a portfolio of strategic customers toward achieving their business goals with Document360. Help them realize lasting value—not just features—so they renew with confidence.
* **Reduce Churn:** You'll be measured on churn and account health, and empowered with the tools, playbooks, and autonomy to protect your portfolio and get ahead of risk.
* **Build Multi-Threaded Relationships:** Go wide and deep within each account—engaging admins, end users, economic buyers, and champions—so adoption and value are anchored across the organization and never rest on a single point of contact.
* **Drive Adoption & Stickiness:** Increase the depth and breadth of product usage so Document360 becomes embedded in how your customers work day to day.
* **Educate & Enable on New Features:** Customize your pitch to each customer's use case and goals, and use Loom (or similar tools) to create tailored, on-demand walkthroughs that drive feature adoption and deepen product stickiness.
* **Lead Strategic Conversations:** From QBRs to renewals, you'll engage with decision-makers and champions to align expectations and reinforce outcomes.
* **Execute & Improve CS Playbooks:** Run our structured customer success and retention motions—and iterate where needed to drive better scale or signal.
* **Identify and Solve Risks Early:** Be the eyes and ears on account health. Surface churn risks, usage gaps, or misalignment before they become issues.
* **Champion Customer Advocacy:** Turn healthy, successful customers into references, case studies, and advocates for Document360.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** Influence our product and roadmap by synthesizing trends and relaying structured customer feedback.
* **Mentor & Model Excellence:** Be a role model to junior CSMs, helping uplevel the team's skill, judgment, and strategic posture.

**You Might Be a Fit If You...**

* Have 3–6 years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting.
* Have owned and moved the needle on churn and/or retention KPIs in a prior role—and are confident doing it again.
* Don't confuse activity for impact—you focus on outcomes, not check-ins, and know how to align usage with business value.
* Build multi-threaded relationships naturally, earning trust across every level of an organization—from end users to executives.
* Know how to educate and enable customers—customizing your message and using tools like Loom to make feature adoption easy and compelling.
* Are skilled with product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar to spot usage trends, adoption gaps, and early churn signals.
* Are AI-savvy—using Claude, ChatGPT, and similar GenAI tools to automate and streamline CS motions and customer-engagement workflows, analyze data faster, and communicate more effectively.
* Love engaging with senior stakeholders and leading value-based conversations.
* Operate well in ambiguity, and are proactive, structured, and emotionally intelligent.
* Have experience with tools like Gainsight, Catalyst, Totango, ChurnZero, SmartKarrot, or similar (nice to have).

**Why Document360?**

* Our retention metrics (including GRR) outperform industry benchmarks, driven by a product customers love and a CS team that delivers.
* We're trusted by Fortune 500 brands, fast-growing SaaS companies, and knowledge-centric organizations globally.
* Our CS org is resourced, respected, and growing—you'll have the backing you need to drive results.
* We believe in systems, not heroics—you'll scale processes, not fight fires alone.
* You'll get coaching, autonomy, and a seat at the table—because success isn't just for the customer. It's for you, too.

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity**
As a Senior Manager in FAAS Managed Services, you will lead pre-sales solutioning, large-scale pursuits, and commercial strategy, enabling successful deal closure and supporting revenue growth across markets.
  
  
You will act as a solution architect and pursuit leader, translating client requirements into scalable, outcome-driven solutions, while ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, delivery feasibility, and profitability.

+ Opportunity assessment and qualification
+ Solution structuring and proposal development

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in pre-sales solutioning, bid management, and pursuit leadership
* Deep functional knowledge across F&A processes (P2P, R2R, O2C, Treasury, Tax, Reconciliation)
* Proven ability to lead large, complex RFP and solution defence engagements
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in pricing strategy and financial modelling

**Ideally, you’ll also**

description:

**ABOUT FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT**

Flutter Entertainment is the **world’s largest sports betting and iGaming operator** with **15.9 million** Average Monthly Players worldwide and an annual revenue of **$16.4 billion** in 2025. We have a **portfolio of iconic brands** , including FanDuel, Paddy Power, Betfair, PokerStars, Sisal, and Sportsbet.
