title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About the job**

We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief —
**“Every Day is Game Day.”**

We bring our best selves to work each day to realise our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services.

**Role Overview**

* We are looking for a proactive and organized Talent Acquisition Intern to support our non-technical hiring team.
* The intern will work closely with the Talent Acquisition Partner and support the day-to-day recruitment process, including interview coordination, candidate follow-ups, documentation, recruitment trackers and post-offer engagement.

* Coordinate interviews between candidates, hiring managers and interview panels.
* Manage interview confirmations, reminders, rescheduling and candidate follow-ups.
* Follow up with interviewers for timely feedback and next steps.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment trackers and hiring reports.
* Support offer documentation, candidate documentation and onboarding coordination.
* Engage with offered candidates and maintain regular communication until joining.
* Highlight candidate concerns, delays or potential joining risks to the TA Partner.

**Recruitment Support**

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate discussions for assigned roles.
* Support the TA Partner in managing hiring requirements across different business teams.
* Independently handle selected entry-level roles or smaller hiring requirements.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and candidate expectations.

* Recruitment automation using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Power Automate or similar platforms.
* Creation of recruitment trackers, reports or dashboards using Excel, Power BI or related tools.
* Improvement of recruitment templates, candidate communication and hiring processes.
* Creation of hiring-related content for LinkedIn, Instagram and other digital platforms.
* Employer-branding campaigns, hiring announcements and recruitment communication.

**About You**

* Interested in building a career in Talent Acquisition or recruitment.
* Strong communicator with a professional and candidate-friendly approach.
* Highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable following up with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Able to manage multiple interviews, candidates and activities simultaneously.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office or Google Workspace tools.
* Willing to learn, take ownership and work in a fast-paced environment.

* ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools
* Power BI, Power Automate or advanced Excel
* Canva or other content-creation tools
* LinkedIn, Instagram or employer-branding content
* Recruitment dashboards, reporting or data analysis

Expertise across all these areas is not required. We are looking for someone who brings strength or genuine hands-on interest in at least one area.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Real-world experience in recruitment and candidate management.
* Hands-on exposure to interview coordination, sourcing and hiring operations.
* Opportunity to manage selected roles or smaller hiring requirements.
* Exposure to recruitment automation, analytics and employer branding.
* Insight into hiring processes within a fast-paced FinTech organisation.
* Mentorship from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals.
* Opportunity to work on meaningful TA projects and process improvements.
* Possibility of a full-time opportunity based on performance and business requirements.

**What we Value in Our people**

* You take the shot: You Decide Fast and You Deliver Right
* You are the CEO of what you do: you show ownership and make things happen

title: Assistant Manager - Corporate Partnerships
description:
Engridd is building an ecosystem for BIM (Building Information Modelling) skilling, talent and industry enablement. We work with organisations to bridge the gap between industry talent requirements and available capabilities through industry-ready BIM professionals and customised corporate training programmes.

We are looking for an Assistant Manager – Corporate Partnerships to build and manage relationships with corporate HR leaders, talent acquisition teams and business stakeholders across the AEC (Architecture, Engineering & Construction) ecosystem.

The role will focus on developing corporate partnerships, creating hiring opportunities for BIM-trained professionals from Engridd's talent platform, and identifying opportunities to build BIM capabilities within organisations through customised training programmes.

**Responsibilities**

 1. Corporate Outreach & Relationship Management

- Identify and connect with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition leaders, L&D Heads and business leaders across target organisations.

- Build a strong corporate network across architecture, engineering, construction, infrastructure and related industries.

- Initiate conversations with prospective organisations to introduce Engridd's talent and skilling offerings.

- Build and nurture long-term relationships with corporate stakeholders.

- Schedule meetings, presentations and discussions to explore potential business opportunities.

- Follow up with clients on candidate shortlisting, interviews, feedback and closures.

- Build a sustainable pipeline of corporate hiring partners.

**3. Corporate Training & Capability Building**

- Identify organisations looking to build or strengthen their internal BIM capabilities.

- Engage with HR and L&D leaders to understand skill gaps and training requirements.

- Present customised BIM training and upskilling programmes offered by Engridd.

- Coordinate with internal academic and training teams to develop relevant programmes and proposals.

- Drive corporate training engagements from initial discussion through closure and programme launch.

**4. Business Development & Account Management**

- Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective corporate clients and business opportunities.

- Prepare proposals, presentations and commercial offerings in coordination with internal teams.

- Drive follow-ups, negotiations and closure of business opportunities.

- Manage existing corporate relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business and expanded engagements.

- Track outreach, meetings, conversions, revenue opportunities and business development progress.

**Required Skills & Experience**

- 3–5 years of experience in Corporate Relations, B2B Sales, Business Development, Client Acquisition or Enterprise Account Management.

-Salary: 5-6 LPA

- Experience in engaging with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition leaders, L&D Heads and senior corporate stakeholders.

- Strong networking, relationship-building and business development skills.

- Ability to pitch talent acquisition, staffing, skilling or corporate training solutions.

- Good understanding of consultative selling and B2B sales cycles.

- Strong presentation, communication, negotiation and follow-up skills.

- Ability to manage multiple client conversations and maintain a structured sales pipeline.

- Proficiency in MS Office, presentations and CRM tools.

- Self-driven, target-oriented and comfortable working in a growing organisation.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Title - HR Manager

Location - Bangalore, India

Company - King Rose Construction & Services

**About Us**

King Rose Construction & Services is a leading general contractor and outsourced services provider headquartered in New York City, recognized for delivering complex, high profile projects with excellence and precision. As we enter a significant phase of growth — expanding operations across the U.S. and building out our Bangalore team —we are seeking a seasoned HR leader to architect and lead our people strategy at scale.

**Position Overview**

The HR Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing King Rose’s people strategy across our U.S. and India operations. We are looking for a strategic partner to the executive team who can build scalable HR infrastructure, lead high volume international recruiting, and foster a performance-driven, inclusive culture across geographies. You will be based in our Bangalore office and work during evening shift hours (4:30 PM – 1:00 AM IST), aligning closely with our New York headquarters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition & Recruiting**

* Lead end-to-end recruiting operations for both U.S. and India-based roles, managing high volume pipelines across technical, operational, and leadership positions.
* Build and manage sourcing strategies for the Indian market, including partnerships with Universities, recruitment agencies, and digital platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and Shine.
* Own U.S. hiring operations, including managing job board presence, and ensuring compliance requirements.
* Develop employer branding initiatives to position King Rose as an employer of choice in both markets.
* Establish structured interview frameworks, offer management processes, and onboarding programs that create a consistent and high-quality candidate experience.
* Build workforce planning models in partnership with department heads to anticipate headcount needs 3–6 months ahead.

**HR Strategy & Organizational Development**

* Partner with the leadership team to design and execute a people strategy that supports aggressive scaling across both geographies.
* Lead organizational design efforts including role clarity, reporting structures, and team architecture as the company grows.
* Build and institutionalize performance management frameworks, including goal-setting, quarterly reviews, and annual appraisal cycles.
* Drive succession planning and internal talent mobility to develop a strong leadership pipeline.
* Establish compensation benchmarking and pay equity practices for U.S. and Indian markets, ensuring competitiveness and compliance.

**Branding**

* HR manager will be responsible to be the voice and architect of our talent identity.
* Responsible to influence top talent discover us, create great experience during hiring, ensure employees are connected with King Rose mission every single day.
* Design and execute a comprehensive employer branding strategy that reflects our culture, values, and growth vision.
* Partner with leadership and marketing to craft compelling narratives for careers pages, social media, and recruitment campaigns.
* Build employee advocacy programs that turn our people into brand ambassadors.
* Curate impactful candidate experiences—from the first touchpoint to onboarding—ensuring every interaction reflects our values.
* Use data and analytics to measure brand perception and continuously refine our approach.

**HR Operations & Compliance**

* Maintain and continuously improve HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs in compliance with U.S. federal/state labor laws and Indian labor regulations.
* Own the HRIS ecosystem — select, implement, and optimize tools that enable data-driven decision-making across the HR function.
* Lead grievance resolution, disciplinary proceedings, and workplace investigations with professionalism, sensitivity, and legal compliance.
* Manage all offboarding and exit interview processes, deriving insights that inform retention and culture strategies.

**Culture & Employee Experience**

* Champion a high-performance, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture across both the U.S. and India offices.
* Design and lead company-wide onboarding, orientation, and culture-building programs that embed King Rose’s values from day one.
* Build and execute employee engagement strategies — pulse surveys, recognition programs, team events — with measurable outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for employees across all levels on culture, conduct, and career development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA or Master’s in HR strongly preferred.
* HR certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent is a significant advantage.
* Minimum 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or head-of-HR capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading HR operations across India and the U.S. in a multinational or cross-border organization.
* Deep expertise in Indian talent markets — Bangalore/metro sourcing, compensation benchmarking, and labor law compliance (Shops & Establishments Act, PF, ESIC, etc.).
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. employment law, benefits administration
* Proven track record of building HR functions and people infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* High proficiency in MS Office Suite and data analysis for HR reporting and workforce planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the construction, interior fit-out, or professional services industry.
* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company from an India delivery center.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience, with annual performance bonuses and hikes.
* Comprehensive health insurance and benefits package.
* Opportunity to build and lead the HR function from the ground up during an exciting growth phase.
* A smart, collaborative, and mission-driven team that values people as the core of the business.
* Work in a dynamic international environment bridging the best of NYC and Bangalore.

title: Talent & Operations Associate
description:
Nordavo is looking for a Talent & Operations Associate with one to three years of experience, ready to take ownership of how we find, assess and keep tech talent, and to help build the rest of the business along the way.

Nordavo connects developers and data engineers in Bangalore with mostly Dutch and international clients. We are a young company: our founders work directly with the team, very little is fixed yet, and we have built our own SaaS platform to run all of our business processes.

In this role, recruitment and our talent pool are your core responsibility, and you will be the person who makes them run. You will work from our office in Bangalore, in direct contact with the founders in India and the Netherlands.

What you will do

You will own recruitment from first search to final placement. We do not wait for a confirmed vacancy before we start looking: you will build and maintain a talent pool of strong developers and data profiles, so that we are ready before the client asks.

* Build and maintain a proactive talent pool of developers and data engineers
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals and your own network
* Assess profiles on substance, not just keywords, and learn to judge technical fit
* Manage candidates end to end: first contact, screening, interviews, offers and onboarding
* Keep our recruitment data clean and up to date in our own SaaS platform
* Use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening, outreach and reporting
* Spot what slows us down and propose, and implement, a better way of working
* Pick up operational tasks outside recruitment when the business needs it
* Report on your pipeline and talent pool, and flag risks early

Around 70 per cent of your time goes to recruitment and the talent pool. The rest is open: process improvements, operations and whatever else helps Nordavo grow. That share grows as you do.

The stack

* Nordavo's own SaaS platform for recruitment and business processes
* LinkedIn and Naukri
* Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools
* Google Workspace

What we're looking for

* One to three years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, HR or operations, ideally in tech or at a startup
* A genuine interest in technology and in how developers and data engineers work
* The ability to read a CV or GitHub profile critically and form your own view
* Daily, practical use of AI tools in your work
* Strong written and spoken English
* A structured way of working, with follow-through on what you start
* Comfort working without a fixed script or detailed instructions

When a client asks for a senior data engineer, you do not just forward the first ten CVs that mention Python and Spark. You check what someone actually built, ask the follow-up question that reveals whether they really did it, and already have three people in mind from the talent pool you built last month.

Who you are

* You take ownership and finish what you start, even when it falls outside your job description
* You say it honestly when something does not work, and you come with a suggestion
* You enjoy building something that is not finished yet
* You want to grow, both in your work and as a person
* You are curious about technology and want to understand the profiles you recruit
* You can read people well and build trust with candidates quickly

We expect you to come up with new ideas yourself, not wait to be told what to improve. If you do not use AI in your daily work, or are not open to new ways of working, this is not the right role for you.

What you get

A competitive salary in line with the market and a role with real ownership, in a company where your ideas are actually implemented.

Ownership & Impact

* Full responsibility for recruitment and the talent pool
* Direct contact with the founders
* Room to contribute and implement your own ideas
* Your work directly shapes how Nordavo grows

A Modern Way of Working

* An AI-first working environment
* Our own SaaS platform instead of spreadsheets
* Exposure to European clients and international projects

Freedom & Growth

* Personal learning and development opportunities
* The opportunity to grow into a technical recruiter
* Clear career growth opportunities as Nordavo expands

Interested?

Do you want to own recruitment at a growing company, learn to assess tech talent properly and help shape how the business is run?

Apply now and tell us about a hire you are proud of, a process you improved, and how you use AI in your work today.

Nordavo Groningen × Bangalore

title: HR Business Partner, Factories
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

This role will create a collaborative effort, through synchronization and matrix functioning, smooth and trouble-free operation in manufacturing to achieve the targeted production with specified quality standards within the decided budget by harmonizing the use of manpower, raw materials, plant, and equipment. As the factory HRBP, you will contribute to creating performance driven values lead by the organization aligning to the business goals with the factory and implementing sustainable HR initiatives with your colleagues to enhance the organization capability of your unit.

**Key Accountabilities:**

Recruitment & Selection of shopfloor employees.

* Set selection criteria based on the recruitment plans.
* Manage and improve the quality of the selection process to recruit 'right' candidates at the right time.
* Onboarding & Induction
* Ensure the required paperwork is completed by the candidates.
* Responsible in coordinating with the required parties to process and provide company properties (uniform, access card, safety vests, safety glasses, other safety wear to be handed to the new entrants).
* Design & implement probationary period development plan for new entrants.

Training and Development

* Collaborate with the process owners/department managers to identify T&D needs as per the requirements of manufacturing excellence model to enhance multiskilling.
* Design programs, measure & improve effectiveness of programs and administration.
* Implement monthly T&D plans to build right capabilities at the Plant.
* Maintain related records/documents in compliance with ISO requirements.

Attendance Management

* Controlling absenteeism & late coming for improving labor productivity.
* Maintain timesheet records of the shopfloor employees.

Performance appraisal

* Set KPI's & monitor work performance, provide feedback & appraise.
* Roll-out performance assessments, monitor progress & compliance to the process to ensure timely and transparent appraisals of engineers & staff at the plant.
* Provide feedback on concerns to Managers, design and implement employee involvement and welfare initiatives.
* To ensure facilitation of individual & group reward and recognition.

Compensation & Benefits Administration

* Administrating Salary & Wages Administration, Full & Final Settlements, Gratuity, Leave, Bonus, Loans Superannuation Settlement.
* Assure quality and timely distribution of employee benefits including canteen, address employee grievances to ensure efficient administration.

Labour relations

* Take disciplinary measures in case of misconducts.
* Responsible in handling complaints, managing grievance procedures, and facilitating counseling in conjunction with other stakeholders.
* Investigating and resolving complex or critical industrial relations issues in a timely and effective manner.
* Collating and analyzing employee feedback across all levels on a regular basis and revising people programs and policies to generate more positive outcomes.
* Study health and hygiene requirements, identify gaps, secure budgets, and close gaps.
* Communicate and organize necessary training to ensure safety of employees.
* Complete initial reporting, accident investigations, communication work restrictions.

Exit procedures

* Ensure the exiting employees return their company properties (uniform, access card, safety vests, safety glasses, other safety wear to be handed to the new entrants).

Statutory Compliance

* Ensure implementation, monitoring & control of HR Strategy in alignment with business strategy and develop / design HR Policies & process.
* Drive and implement D&I practices.
* Keeping healthy liaison with govt., semi govt. authorities like W.C. Commissioner, Gram panchayat, Insurance, Police Station, Banks, P.F. Office, Factory Inspector, Labour Inspector, Pollution Control, Police Authority, Local bodies etc.
* To monitor and comply with all statutory and regulatory compliances.
* Audits & Inspections
* Conducts audit and analyzes reports if required.
* Responsible in conducting inspections periodically if health and safety requirements are met at the plant.

**What We’re Looking For**

To thrive in this role, you should bring:

**Qualifications & Skillsets:**

* Completed full-time master’s in business administration degree specialized in Human Resources/ Industrial & labor relations or PG certificate in HRM.
* 8-10 years of experience in Plant HR in a manufacturing company.
* In-depth exposure to various functions in plant HR with some exposure to IR, PR activities.
* Great verbal and written communications skills; not afraid to speak up when required.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies & procedures.
* In depth knowledge of employment legislations.
* Strong problem solving, negotiation & influencing skills.
* Excellent team management and conflict management skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail, quality, and follow-through; strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in MS Office suite of software and general knowledge on HRIS platforms.

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Lead- HR
description:
**Overview**
This role is responsible for managing people and employee experience matters within the aligned business area, translating agreed people priorities into practical interventions and ensuring their consistent and effective implementation, while working closely with HRBPs who connect broader business priorities and challenges to the people agenda.
  
  
Your role
  
  
*Change Management*

* Lead and implement assigned change initiatives within the aligned business area.
* Develop and execute communication, stakeholder engagement and adoption plans that support successful business transformation and sustainable change outcomes.
* Ensure that adequate training sessions, workshops, support mechanisms and resources are provided to enable smooth transitions.
* Monitor the success of change initiatives, readiness, adoption levels, and business outcomes, recommending corrective actions where required.
* Contribute to or lead defined cross-business people projects aligned with organisational priorities.

*Talent Management*

* Talent management: Drive assigned talent programmes, including promotions, career development and retention initiatives, ensuring timely execution and effective follow-through within the aligned business area.
* Learning programme nominations: Partner with Learning & Talent Development (L&TD) to identify development needs and nominate key and core talent for capability-building programmes and interventions.
* High potential employees: Partner with managers and HRBPs to identify high potential talent, conduct career and development conversations, and drive completion of agreed development actions.
* Career Conversations: Drives effective career conversations and partner with managers for creating individual development plans for talent.
* Talent lists: Ensure talent lists are always updated and accessible on all platforms, while maintaining oversight of talent pools & development plans.

*Employee Engagement and Experience*

* Employee Engagement: Drive employee experience-related outcomes such as the annual employee engagement survey, Great Places to Work certification, and internal interventions while ensuring that identified action plans are implemented and progress is monitored.
* Employee Engagement survey results: Analyse engagement results and workforce sentiment trends through the survey results and support business and ambassadors in driving implementation of action plans.
* Employee Listening Sessions: Lead and conduct focus groups, employee forums, and listening sessions to understand workforce concerns and translate insights into meaningful actions.
* Employee Experience: Drive hire to retire employee experience related activities, leveraging employee feedback and workforce insights to assess effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and partner with HR Services to implement continuous enhancements that strengthen employee engagement, retention, and overall lifecycle experience.

title: Manager - Human Capital, Angsana Oasis Spa & Resort Bangalore
description:
**Overview**

Banyan Group is an independent, global hospitality company with purpose. We pride itself on its pioneering spirit, design-led experiences and commitment to responsible stewardship. Its extensive portfolio spans 100 hotels and resorts, more than 140 spas and galleries, and 20 plus branded residences in over 20 countries. Comprising 12 global brands, including the flagship brand Banyan Tree, each distinct yet united under the experiential membership programme withBanyan. The founding ethos of “Embracing the Environment, Empowering People” is embodied through the Banyan Global Foundation and Banyan Academy. We are committed to remaining the leading advocate of sustainable travel, with a focus on regenerative tourism and innovative programmes that elevate the guest experience.

Founded in 1994 on the core concept of sustainability, Banyan Tree Holdings seeks to create long-term value for all stakeholders and destinations across its network of properties, products and brands, through a purpose-driven mission.

With over 13,000 associates across 23 countries, the Group established the Banyan Academy in 2008 to support its goals by advancing people development, management excellence, and fostering learning with integrity and meaning.

Banyan Group has received over 3,000 industry awards and accolades since its inception. It has also received recognition for its commitment to environmental protection and community development through its non-profit arm, the Banyan Global Foundation, which aligns the Group’s efforts with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs).

**Position Summary**

Angsana Oasis Spa & Resort Bangalore is seeking an experienced and passionate
**Human Capital Manager**
to lead the resort's Human Capital function and support business objectives through effective people strategies, talent development, and a strong associate-focused culture.

Reporting to the General Manager, the successful candidate will oversee all aspects of Human Capital operations at the resort. You will partner closely with the General Manager and leadership team to drive associate engagement, strengthen organizational capability, and promote a positive workplace environment.

The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, luxury hospitality and wellness operations, and local talent management. Experience in the Bangalore or wider South India hospitality market is highly preferred.

**Responsibilities**

1. Lead and manage the overall Human Capital operations of the resort in line with business objectives, Banyan Group standards, and regional Human Capital strategies.
2. Partner with the General Manager and department heads to identify manpower requirements, organizational needs, and talent strategies.
3. Develop and implement Human Capital initiatives that enhance associate engagement, retention, performance, and organizational effectiveness.
4. Drive recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract, select, and retain qualified talent, including skilled spa therapists and wellness professionals.
5. Manage associate relations and engagement activities, and provide guidance on workplace matters and employment practices.
6. Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws, Karnataka state regulations, statutory contributions and filings (such as Provident Fund, ESI, and gratuity), company policies, brand standards, and Human Capital procedures.
7. Review and monitor compensation and benefits practices to ensure competitiveness within the Bangalore hospitality and wellness market.
8. Support learning and development initiatives, including technical and wellness skills training, to enhance associate capabilities and career growth opportunities.
9. Promote a high-performance culture through effective performance management, recognition programs, and engagement initiatives.
10. Monitor associate satisfaction and workplace culture, and recommend improvements to the overall associate experience.
11. Oversee Human Capital administration, including associate files, insurance, benefits, leave management, visa and work permit processes for any foreign associates, and associate movements.
12. Manage and control the annual Human Capital budget and ensure effective resource utilization.
13. Ensure that licenses, permits, and Human Capital-related documentation are maintained and renewed on time.
14. Develop and support occupational health and safety programs to ensure a safe and secure working environment.
15. Prepare regular Human Capital reports and updates for the General Manager, resort management, and regional Human Capital.

**Qualifications**

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification in HR is an advantage.
2. Minimum 5-8 years of Human Capital experience, preferably within luxury hotels, resorts, or wellness operations.
3. Previous experience as a Human Capital Manager or Assistant Human Capital Manager in a five-star hotel or resort environment.
4. Strong experience in the Bangalore or South India hospitality market is highly preferred.
5. Good knowledge of Indian labour law, statutory compliance, associate relations, and Human Capital best practices.
6. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate at all levels.
7. Experience in recruitment, talent management, organizational development, and associate engagement programs.
8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a proactive and business-oriented mindset.
9. Good command of English. Knowledge of Kannada, Hindi, or other regional languages is an advantage.
10. Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and dynamic luxury hospitality environment.

*We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.*

title: HR Generalist
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.
  
  
The HR Partner will provide end-to-end HR partnership and operational support to assigned business functions within the Global Talent Hub, collaborating closely with business leaders, People Managers, HR Business Partners, and HR Centers of Excellence to delivery consistent and effective people solutions.
  
  
This role will serve as a key point of contact for employees and managers on day-to-day people matters and will support the effective delivery of HR programs across the employee lifecycle. The HR Partner will combine strong HR fundamentals, knowledge of employment practices, HR technology capability, and program management skills to deliver consistent and positive employee and manager experience.
  
  
The role requires an individual who can work with a high degree of independence, exercise sound judgment, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across a matrixed HR organization.
  
  
**About The Job**
**Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Provide HR support across the employee lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, employee movements, performance management, engagement, and separation.
* Partner with managers and employees to ensure HR processes are understood and executed effectively and consistently.
* Support employee transitions, organizational changes, promotions, transfers, and other employee lifecycle activities.
* Ensure appropriate HR documentation and employee records are maintained accurately and in accordance with established processes and meeting the regulatory requirements.
* Manage mandatory HR audits in accordance with applicable local compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with relevant HR teams to provide employees with seamless HR experience.

**Manager & Employee Partnership**

* Serve as a primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across assigned client groups.
* Provide timely and practical guidance on HR policies, processes, and day-to-day people-management matters.
* Exercise sound judgment in resolving employee matters and escalate complex, sensitive, or higher-risk cases to the Senior HRBP, Employee Relations, or Legal teams as appropriate.
* Support managers in having effective employee conversations and applying HR policies consistently.
* Build trusted relationships with managers and employees while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and professional judgment.

**Employment Practices & Compliance**

* Support employee-relations matters and provide guidance in accordance with company policies, practices, and applicable employment legislation.
* Resolve routine employee concerns independently and escalate complex, sensitive, high-risk, or potential compliance matters to the HRBP, Employee Relations, Legal, or other appropriate HR stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of applicable employment legislation, regulatory requirements, HR policies, and company practices.
* Ensure HR processes and employee-related decisions are implemented consistently and in accordance with applicable local requirements and company policies.
* Support managers with appropriate documentation and the consistent application of HR policies and practices.
* Partner with relevant HR and Legal teams to ensure appropriate governance, documentation, and risk management.

**HR Programs, Process Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Lead the execution of annual and recurring people processes, including performance management, employee engagement surveys, compensation cycles, and learning and development initiatives.
* Coordinate and deliver assigned HR programs across client groups, ensuring consistent, timely, and high-quality execution.
* Use employee feedback, talent data, and workforce insights to identify emerging people trends and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Leverage Workday or equivalent HR platforms to support employee, organizational, and HR program processes effectively.
* Independently manage and execute HR system enhancements, testing, implementation, and adoption of new functionality and processes.
* Maintain the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of employee and organizational data.
* Prepare and analyze workforce metrics, including headcount, attrition, hiring, and employee movements, to support informed decision-making.
* Support periodic workforce and headcount-planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance HR processes to improve operational efficiency and the employee experience.
* Track program completion and proactively follow up with managers and stakeholders to address gaps or delays.
* Support implementation and tracking of engagement action plans.

**HR COE & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner closely with HR Business Partners and Centers of Excellence including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Learning & Development, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and HR Technology.
* Coordinate the local implementation of global HR programs and initiatives.
* Ensure HR programs are delivered consistently while taking into consideration relevant local business and regulatory requirements.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.
* Approximately 5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in an HR Partner, HR Generalist, or HR Business Partnering environment.
* Experience supporting a complex, matrixed, global organization, GCC, GBS, or shared-services environment is preferred.
* Experience using Workday or similar HR technology platforms.
* Experience working with senior managers and functional leaders. Works effectively across functions, geographies, and HR partners.
* Strong ability to interpret people data and translate insights into business actions.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and HR projects simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of applicable employment legislation and HR compliance requirements.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to navigate complex people and business situations.
* Strong communication, influencing, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.

**LOCATION**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**FULL TIME/PART TIME**
Full time
  
  
**Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.**

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Job Description – HR Executive**

**Company:**
Supple Pack (India) Private Limited

**Location:**
Bangalore — with periodic travel to our manufacturing plants

**Industry:**
Manufacturing – Plastic Moulding

**Reports to:**
Director

**Experience:**
1 to 2 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**About us**

Supple Pack is one of India's growing rigid plastic packaging manufacturers, with manufacturing facilities in Bangalore and Alwar. We partner with some of India's leading consumer companies including Hindustan Unilever, Dabur, UltraTech, Himalaya, Reliance, and Adani Wilmar across injection moulding, blow moulding, and printing solutions.

We are entering our next phase of growth — strengthening systems, scaling operations, and building a professionally managed organization.

**Role Overview**

**This is a hands on role and you will be the day-to-day face of HR across our office and plants.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Performance management**

* Run the PMS calendar: goal setting, periodic check-ins, annual reviews.
* Coordinate with managers for timely inputs and keep clean records for every employee.
* Prepare data and summaries for calibration discussions.
* Track that agreed development actions happen.

**2. Culture and engagement**

* Roll out the culture programme across all locations in simple language people understand.
* Run regular rituals: town halls, recognition, plant-level connects.
* Collect feedback from the floor and bring back what people are really saying.
* Plan and track training and upskilling programmes.

**3. People operations**

* Own onboarding and induction for all new joiners, including at the plants.
* Keep attendance, leave and employee records accurate and consistent across locations.
* Handle first-level employee queries and grievances; escalate where needed.
* Support hiring: coordinate interviews, offers and joining.
* Maintain HR MIS: headcount, attrition, absenteeism, PMS status, by location.
* Run exit interviews and track reasons for attrition.

**4. Compliance coordination**

* Work with the compliance head to collect plant-level data and documents on time.
* Keep an audit-ready tracker for each location.
* Flag gaps early, before they become problems.

**What we are looking for**

* Degree in HR or MSW (Master of Social Work) degree / related fields
* 1–2 years in HR. Exposure to a factory, plant or shop-floor workforce is a plus.
* Fluent in Hindi and English.
* Basic working knowledge of Indian labour laws and HR processes.
* Strong computer skills; comfortable building trackers and simple dashboards.

**Skills**

**Accuracy, discretion, good communication and comfort working with shop-floor staff.**

title: Organisational Development Consultant
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementation in Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.
  
  
Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.
  
  
The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.
  
  
The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Role Location:**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Work Hours:**
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)
  
  
**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**
**What will your day look like?**

* Supporting the delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Owning or contributing to defined project workstreams, ensuring activities are delivered to a high standard and aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Conducting organisational and workforce analysis to support insights and recommendations, including structure, spans and layers, role design, capability, governance and implementation considerations.
* Preparing high-quality project deliverables, including analysis, options, recommendations, stakeholder packs, governance materials, implementation plans and progress updates.
* Supporting the development of evidence-based recommendations that balance business outcomes, customer impacts, workforce experience, financial objectives and enterprise design principles.
* Working with business leaders, T&C Business Partners, T&C teams and cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, test insights and support delivery.
* Supporting governance activities, including project planning, status reporting, issue and risk management, dependency tracking and action management.
* Supporting the translation of organisation design recommendations into practical implementation activities, including role mapping, consultation support, transition planning or implementation tracking.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise workforce, organisational and business information.
* Strong project delivery skills, including planning, coordination, governance support, action tracking, status reporting, risk and issue management, and dependency tracking.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure issues, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity and deliver quality outcomes in a complex environment.
* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number
**128597.**

The individual manages all aspect of workplace adjustments including the development and implementation of regional processes and procedures to achieve optimal employee productivity and experience.

This individual has proven ability to communicate, analyze and critically think, along with a customer service focus that employees and program stakeholders expect from Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Pursue return-to-work management and collaboration with leave case managers and disability vendors to ensure effective administration of the program
* Provide consultation and coaching regarding accommodation matters to designated regional HR partners, managers and employees
* Provide information, referral, and support to employees with medical conditions or disabilities (both occupational and non-occupational), supervisors, Human Resources, and other partners at an escalated level to support Amazon’s employee retention efforts
* Operate as an advocate for the accommodations process by providing on-going consultative support to site stakeholders and accommodation specialists with a focus on problem solving and creative solutions
* Facilitate escalated communication between stakeholders, employees with disabilities
* Coordinate with DLS Management and Legal on escalated issues as appropriate
* Manage sensitive cases such as Behavioral Health conditions
* Assist Human Resources and department supervisors in identifying essential and marginal functions of employee positions
* Conduct job site analyses as needed

* Maintain strict confidentiality in verbal and written communications
* Maintain knowledge on legislation and national, state and local issues affecting access for employees with disabilities
* Document and maintain up-to-date case records and notes of appropriate and accurate information on the computer database
* Assess business unit’s training needs and/or group training sessions as appropriate
* Provide professional opinion and actions taken on behalf of disabled employees in formal grievances, arbitration, depositions, and other forums as requested
* Adhere to internal SLAs and quality standards
* Maintains a caseload of up to 80 cases on average. Caseload may fluctuate during periods of high volume such as peak, prime day and new site launches

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

* 4+ years of human resources functions experience

* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards

* Experience in conducting investigative work, including claimant, witness, and target employee interviews, investigative data analysis, and production of investigative documentation
* Experience developing policies and supporting documentation
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards

We are looking for a creative, driven and execution-oriented professional to strengthen Mastech's talent brand, drive corporate HR communications and manage talent and employee engagement programs.

The role will be responsible for developing and executing employer branding initiatives, supporting the articulation and promotion of Mastech's Employee Value Proposition (EVP), driving internal and external talent communications, and coordinating leadership development, early talent and employee engagement programs.

* Monitor employer brand performance, candidate perceptions and Glassdoor feedback.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to strengthen talent attraction through targeted branding and recruitment marketing initiatives.

**2. Corporate HR Communications**

* Develop and execute internal and external communication initiatives aligned with Mastech's culture, people strategy and organisational priorities.
* Create engaging content for employee communications, newsletters, leadership messages, presentations and HR campaigns.
* Translate HR initiatives, policies and organisational developments into clear and effective communication.

* Manage program calendars, communication, stakeholder coordination and execution.
* Drive employee recognition, engagement and culture-building initiatives.
* Support Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), diversity and inclusion initiatives and other people programs.

* Conduct market research and benchmarking on employer branding, talent trends and HR practices.
* Develop dashboards, scorecards and reports to track employer brand performance and talent program effectiveness.
* Analyse employee engagement, campaign performance and participation metrics to generate actionable insights.

* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and prepare meaningful reports.

* Exposure to AI-enabled tools for content creation, research and productivity.

* Effective execution of employer branding and EVP initiatives.
* Improved visibility and engagement across talent branding channels.
* Consistent and impactful corporate HR communications.

* Increased employee participation and advocacy.

Organize learning events, curate the ContiTech Campus and support the standardized rollout of learning solutions for blue-collar employees.
  
  
Systems, Tools & User Support

* Coordinate tool issue resolution together with SGS and support Business Areas, GSCFs, locations and the HR Business Partner with process and system know-how.

Process Digitalization, Automation & AI
  
  

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and digitalize People Development processes.
* Translate repetitive administrative activities into suitable automation opportunities.
* Apply approved AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and future Talent AI Hub capabilities, to improve efficiency and user experience.
* Design AI-supported templates, workflows, knowledge bases, FAQs and self-service solutions.
* Support development, testing, documentation and adoption of AI use cases in Talent Management and Learning.

Data Quality, Reporting & Governance
  
  

* Ensure data quality in Talent Management and Learning systems and support correction of inconsistencies.

* Use data to support transparent process execution and operational decision-making.

Education
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Business Informatics, Organizational Psychology, Education, Learning & Development or a in IT/Technology related field preferred.

Practical knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors / MySuccess Talent and/or Learning is required. Strong Microsoft 365 skills are required. Demonstrated ability to apply approved AI tools responsibly, identify automation use cases, critically review AI output and translate business requirements into practical digital solutions. Strong process orientation, accuracy, service mindset and fluent English are required. Power Automate, dashboarding and additional languages are advantages.

title: Senior Organisational Development Consultant
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Lead Organisation Design & Implementation in Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.
  
  
The role acts as a critical integrator across business stakeholders, T&C partners, project teams and cross-functional contributors to drive progress, manage complexity and deliver outcomes at pace. This includes leading project teams, managing risks and interdependencies, removing roadblocks, supporting governance and providing subject matter expertise across core OD&I delivery areas.
  
  
The role may lead a standalone program or manage a major stream within a broader enterprise transformation initiative, balancing strategic outcomes, stakeholder needs, total investment, delivery risk and time to benefit. The role will also provide strategic advice and challenge to business leaders on organisational effectiveness, operating model design, workforce impacts and implementation considerations.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Role Location:**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Work Hours:**
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)
  
  
**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**
**What will your day look like?**

* Leading the end-to-end delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Providing strategic advice, challenge and subject matter expertise to senior business leaders, T&C Business Partners and project stakeholders.
* Conducting organisational diagnostics and analysis to identify opportunities, risks and recommendations relating to operating model effectiveness, workforce structure, spans and layers, capability, governance and role design.
* Developing evidence-based recommendations and implementation approaches that balance business outcomes, customer impacts, workforce experience, financial objectives and enterprise design principles.
* Leading project teams and cross-functional contributors to deliver agreed outcomes, ensuring work is planned, sequenced and delivered at pace.
* Acting as the integrator across stakeholders, workstreams and delivery teams to manage interdependencies and reduce execution risk.
* Driving decision-making by bringing structure, insight and recommendations to enable timely resolution of issues, risks and roadblocks.

**Detailed Description**

* Supporting governance activities, including critical path analysis, risk and issue management, dependency management, stakeholder management, reporting, and supporting budget, resource and scope management.
* Identifying resourcing needs and recommending adjustments to ensure projects or programs are set up for successful delivery.
* Monitoring key metrics and measures of success, including progress against outcomes, delivery milestones, financial impacts and benefits realisation.
* Translating organisation design recommendations into practical implementation plans, ensuring changes are successfully embedded and benefits are realised.
* Supporting leaders and stakeholders through the people impacts of transformation, ensuring implementation activities are thoughtful, compliant and people-centred.
* Building trusted relationships with business leaders, T&C BPs, T&C teams, cross-functional partners and other key stakeholders to resolve issues and remove barriers to success.

**What will you bring?**

* 10+ years of relevant experience across Talent & Culture, organisational design, workforce transformation, consulting, or business transformation environments.
* Depth and breadth of experience in at least one of the OD&I core capabilities: organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Proven experience leading complex people, workforce or business transformation initiatives from mobilisation through to implementation.
* Strong understanding of organisation design principles, operating model design, workforce analysis, role design, governance, and implementation planning.
* Ability to engage, influence and challenge senior stakeholders, including business leaders, T&C Business Partners, and cross-functional delivery partners.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams or project teams to execute complex business change and deliver agreed outcomes.
* Strong project and program management experience, including governance, critical path analysis, dependency management, issue and risk management, stakeholder management, and support for budget, resource, and scope management.
* Ability to quickly understand complex business problems, diagnose root causes and develop practical, evidence-based solutions.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, and facilitation skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and bring stakeholders together around clear recommendations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear papers, updates, recommendations, and executive-level messaging.
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

Full-time

Immediate or within 15 days

**About Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI-first upskilling platform for working professionals. Our programs are designed and delivered by industry leaders, with a strong focus on real-world application, outcomes, and learner success.

As we scale, career outcomes are becoming a core part of how we create value for our learners and differentiate ourselves in the market.

**The Context**

At Airtribe, learning does not end with sessions. It ends with
*real career outcomes*

.

As our learner base grows, ensuring consistent, high-quality placement outcomes and strong hiring partnerships becomes increasingly complex. This requires structured systems, strong company relationships, and tight alignment between learners and opportunities.

This role exists to build and scale a
*career services engine*

that drives learner success and strengthens our hiring ecosystem.

**The Role**

As a Career Services Lead, you will own the end-to-end career outcomes function at Airtribe.

You will work at the intersection of learners, hiring partners, and internal teams, ensuring that opportunities are created, learners are prepared, and outcomes are consistently delivered.

This is a
*high-ownership role*

with both execution and strategic responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* End-to-end career services function including partnerships, learner readiness, and placements
* Outreach and relationship management with product-based startups and tech companies
* Hiring pipeline management from JD discovery to final placement
* Career readiness initiatives including resume reviews, mock interviews, and coaching
* Internal coordination across teams to ensure learner-job fit
* Tracking systems, dashboards, and reporting for placements and partner performance
* Defining and improving processes across the career services journey
* Contributing to the long-term roadmap and strategy for this function

**What Problems You’ll Solve**

* Creating consistent placement outcomes as the learner base scales
* Building and maintaining strong hiring partner relationships
* Reducing gaps between learner readiness and job expectations
* Bringing structure and visibility to career outcomes and reporting
* Ensuring career services remains learner-first and outcome-driven
  ﻿

**How This Role Evolves**

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the current ecosystem, building partnerships, and driving placements.

Over time, you will build systems, improve efficiency, and define scalable processes for the function.

As Airtribe grows, this role can evolve into leading the entire career services vertical and building a team under it.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–3 years of experience in career services, recruitment, placements, B2B partnerships, or related roles
* Experience working with hiring partners, preferably product-based companies
* Strong stakeholder management and outreach skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* High ownership mindset with a bias for execution
* Ability to think strategically while executing hands-on
* Comfort working in a fast-paced and evolving environment

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in edtech, HR-tech, or employability-focused startups
* Exposure to learner-facing or outcome-driven roles

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a coordination or support role.

We are not looking for someone who only manages processes. We are looking for someone who
*builds the function, drives outcomes, and takes ownership end-to-end*

.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* Opportunity to build and scale a core business function
* High ownership and autonomy in decision-making
* Direct impact on learner careers and company growth
* Close collaboration with founders and leadership
* Space to build systems, experiment, and scale responsibly

title: Technical Customer Success Manager - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role:**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Customer Success Manager to own and manage a portfolio of Commercial and SMB segment US/Mexico based accounts.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to IT executives (Director Security, CIOs, CISOs, VPs/Directors of IT), driving deep product adoption, customer retention, and long-term value realization. You will partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to champion customer needs, mitigate churn risks, and unlock expansion opportunities.

### **Key Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Strategic Account Management: Develop deep, multi-threaded relationships with key executive decision-makers and stakeholders across Commercial and SMB accounts. Build and execute tailored Customer Success Plans aligned with client business outcomes.
* Onboarding & Time to Value: Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to guide complex onboarding initiatives, ensuring swift time-to-value and adoption across hybrid IT environments.
* Adoption & Risk Mitigation: Proactively monitor portfolio health, user engagement, leverage AI and data to address adoption bottlenecks and potential churn risks early.
* QBRs / Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Prepare and facilitate strategic, metrics-driven quarterly and executive business reviews with key client leaders to showcase ROI, benchmark health, and align on strategic roadmaps.
* Growth & Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to co-develop joint strategic account plans, identify expansion/upsell opportunities, and drive strong Gross Retention Rates (GRR)
* Customer Advocacy & Escalation: Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic account escalations. Advocate for customer product enhancements with Product and Engineering leadership to influence product roadmap priorities.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Maintain a deep technical understanding of JumpCloud’s platform capabilities, modern IT architectures, and industry trends to advise customers on security and identity best practices.

### **How Success Will Be Measured**

* Net Retention Rate (NRR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across your assigned portfolio
* Customer Health, Platform Adoption, and Product Engagement
* Onboarding Time-to-Value (TTV) for key accounts
* Identification and pipeline contribution of qualified Expansion/Upsell opportunities
* Leading cross-functional collaboration and initiatives

### **We’re Looking For:**

* Experience: 2+ years of customer-facing experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success or Account Management, managing SMB or Commercial accounts
* Technical Acumen: Strong SaaS product industry knowledge. Preferred domain knowledge in IT infrastructure, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, SSO/MFA, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Zero Trust, and Security/System Administration.
* Executive Presence: Proven track record of building trust and commanding credibility with IT Managers and leaders, VPs, and technical stakeholders.
* Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex customer requirements, evaluate account health metrics, and construct actionable success plans.
* Communication: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
* Proactive Problem Solving: A self-starter with strong organization, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills in a high-growth, remote-first environment.

###### **#LI-YM1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

#LI-Remote #BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
