title: Customer Support Manager
description:
**Customer Support Manager – AaravPOS**

**About AaravPOS**  
AaravPOS is a cloud-based Point of Sale (POS) platform designed for salons and businesses. Our platform provides comprehensive business management solutions including appointment management, billing, inventory management, customer management, staff management, online booking, and business reporting. We focus on building scalable, reliable, and user-friendly technology solutions that help businesses streamline their daily operations and improve efficiency.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Customer Support Manager to lead our support team at AaravPOS. In this role, you will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing customer support team, establishing support processes, and ensuring every client receives a fast, helpful, and professional experience. You will serve as the voice of the customer internally, working closely with product, tech, and sales teams to resolve issues and continuously improve the customer experience. If you are a strong leader who is passionate about customer satisfaction and operational excellence, we want to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Team Leadership & Management*

* Build, lead, and mentor a team of customer support representatives
* Set clear performance expectations, KPIs, and goals for the support team
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and coaching sessions
* Monitor team workload, schedule shifts, and ensure adequate coverage
* Foster a positive, motivated, and customer-first team culture
* Identify training needs and develop ongoing learning programs for the team

*Customer Support Operations*

* Oversee day-to-day support operations across all channels including email, phone, live chat, and ticketing
* Ensure all customer inquiries, issues, and complaints are resolved promptly and professionally
* Define and maintain SLAs (Service Level Agreements) for response and resolution times
* Develop and implement support workflows, escalation procedures, and standard operating procedures
* Monitor support queues and ensure tickets are handled efficiently and within SLA
* Handle escalated customer issues personally when required

*Customer Experience & Satisfaction*

* Champion a customer-first culture across the organization
* Track and analyze customer satisfaction metrics including CSAT, NPS, and first response time
* Identify patterns in customer complaints and feedback and share insights with product and tech teams
* Drive initiatives to improve customer retention, satisfaction, and loyalty
* Ensure customers are educated on platform features and getting maximum value from AaravPOS

*Process & Systems*

* Implement and manage customer support tools such as helpdesk software, ticketing systems, and CRM
* Build and maintain a comprehensive knowledge base, FAQs, and self-service resources for customers
* Develop onboarding support materials and guides for new clients
* Continuously improve support processes to increase efficiency and reduce resolution times
* Ensure support documentation is accurate, up to date, and accessible to the team

*Cross-functional Collaboration*

* Work closely with the product team to report recurring issues, bugs, and feature requests from customers
* Collaborate with the sales and onboarding teams to ensure smooth client transitions
* Partner with the tech team to escalate and resolve technical issues affecting customers
* Provide regular reports to leadership on support performance, trends, and customer feedback
* Represent the customer's voice in internal product and strategy discussions

*Reporting & Analytics*

* Track and report on key support metrics including ticket volume, resolution time, CSAT, and team performance
* Analyze support data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement
* Present weekly and monthly support performance reports to leadership
* Use data to make informed decisions about staffing, processes, and priorities

**Mandatory Skills**

*1. Customer Support Leadership*

* Proven experience managing and leading a customer support team
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and performance management skills
* Ability to build and scale a support team in a growing company

*2. Customer Experience*

* Deep understanding of customer support best practices and customer experience principles
* Strong commitment to customer satisfaction and service excellence
* Experience tracking and improving CSAT, NPS, and other customer metrics

*3. Communication*

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

title: Campus Recruiter (Agri) – Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India’s next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the “Doctor of Soil” model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

* **Campus hiring strategy:**
  Build and run the annual campus calendar for agri universities, ICAR institutes, and agri-business management schools, covering fresher pipelines for agronomist, territory, and management trainee roles.
* **Lateral hiring:**
  Own lateral recruitment for experienced roles in sales, agronomy, and operations, especially when campus hiring is off-cycle or the business needs experienced talent quickly. This includes sourcing, screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, and closure.
* **Institution relationships:**
  Develop long-term ties with placement cells, deans, and faculty. Be the face of Paramverse Bio on campus through pre-placement talks, guest lectures, and drives.
* **End-to-end drive execution:**
  Manage the full cycle from shortlisting, assessments, and interviews to offers, joining, and onboarding, with strong offer-to-joining conversion.
* **Sourcing channels and talent mapping:**
  Build lateral pipelines through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, agri industry networks, and talent mapping of competitors and adjacent companies.
* **Employer branding:**
  Create campus and professional-market content, internships, and ambassador programs that position Paramverse Bio as the destination for biological agriculture careers.
* **Internship to full-time pipeline:**
  Design and run summer internships and convert top performers into full-time hires.
* **Hiring aligned to territory rollout:**
  Work with business and agronomy leadership to forecast requirements across our 48 territories and nine states, and plan hiring ahead of expansion.
* **Metrics and reporting:**
  Track cost per hire, time to hire, acceptance rate, and early attrition across campus and lateral channels, and report on them regularly.
* **Candidate experience:**
  Keep communication with students, candidates, and placement officers timely, transparent, and professional.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Agriculture, Agri-Business, or an allied agri discipline.
* 2 to 6 years of experience, with hands-on agri campus hiring across agri universities, ICAR institutes, or agri-business schools, preferably within agri, agrochemicals, seeds, fertilisers, or similar field-force-heavy industries.
* Proven track record of running campus drives end to end and building relationships with institutions.
* Exposure to lateral hiring, or a strong willingness to build this capability alongside campus hiring.
* Comfort with travel to campuses across India.
* Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi. Marathi or another regional language is a plus.
* Ability to assess fresher potential (learning agility, field readiness, fit with a science-led, farmer-first culture) and to evaluate experienced candidates on domain depth.
* Hands-on with ATS tools, LinkedIn Recruiter, and campus hiring platforms, and comfortable with data and dashboards.
* Based in Mumbai (Mumbai-based candidates only).

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience hiring agronomists, sales trainees, or field officers at scale.
* An existing network across agri universities, agri-business schools, and the agri industry talent community.
* Experience building internship programs, campus ambassador networks, or employer branding initiatives.
* Exposure to a startup or high-growth environment where processes are still being built.
* Interest in biological agriculture, soil health, and sustainable farming.

**Who We Are Looking For (Non-Negotiable)**

* Currently based in Mumbai. Candidates from other locations will not be considered.
* Prior experience in agri campus hiring.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Agriculture or an allied agri discipline.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
**Talent Acquisition Lead**

Location: Mumbai, in office, full-time

Experience: 7-10 years in talent acquisition in startups, fintechs, or technology companies

**About Apollo Finvest**

We are a publicly listed tech-first NBFC—think AWS, but for lending. Armed with advanced APIs and capital, we partner with the best fintechs to power digital loans across India.

We're looking for a
**Talent Acquisition Lead**
to build Apollo Finvest's team over the next few years. This is a hands-on role. You will do the hiring yourself: sourcing, screening, running interviews, and closing offers. You won't be handing it off. You will own every hiring outcome across all functions and levels, and you'll be judged on who joins and how quickly they join.

To be clear about what this involves: these first few years are about building the team. Hiring volume will be high, timelines tight, and the process will still be taking shape while you run it. Expect long days and evenings and weekends when hiring peaks. If you're looking to manage recruiters and review dashboards,

this isn't that role. If you want to build a strong team yourself and own the result, read on.

**What You'll Do**

* Own hiring end-to-end for every role, at every level, and in every function. Once a role opens, it's yours until someone joins.
* Work directly with the founders and hiring managers to sharpen each role. Push back when a brief is unclear, and hold a high bar for quality.
* Source, screen, and shortlist candidates yourself every day through LinkedIn, referrals, communities, networks, and direct outreach. You're the first recruiter on the team, not a manager of recruiters.
* Run every interview process yourself: scheduling, chasing interviewers, updating candidates, and getting quick, clear feedback.
* Close candidates: lead offer conversations and negotiations, and stay with each candidate until they join.
* Keep a warm pipeline for upcoming roles so we never start from zero.
* Build the hiring system from scratch, with processes, trackers, dashboards, automation and AI tools, while running live hiring at the same time.
* Own the numbers: time to hire, funnel conversion, offer acceptance and quality of hire. When a number slips, you fix it.
* As the company grows, hire and lead a recruiting team while still recruiting yourself.

**What You'll Need**

* 7–10 years of end-to-end recruitment experience in startups, fintechs or technology companies, including a recent record of hiring personally, not only through a team or agencies.
* Evidence of ownership: roles you closed yourself, from sourcing to joining, at junior, mid, senior and leadership levels across different functions.
* Strong hands-on sourcing across LinkedIn, referrals, communities and professional networks.
* Good judgement in assessing candidates for ownership, execution and a startup mindset.
* Strong communication skills, and comfort pushing back with founders and senior managers.
* Appetite for an intense building phase: long hours, many open roles at once, shifting priorities, working from our Mumbai office.
* Experience setting up hiring processes from scratch.
* Exposure to AI-driven sourcing, screening, or recruiting workflows.

**Why Join Us?**

Work directly with the Founders: Mikhil Innani (former co-founder of PharmEasy, ex-Product Head at Hotstar) and Diksha Nangia (former banker and CFA Charterholder)

Build Apollo's team in its early years. The people you hire will shape the company.

The stability of a listed company with the speed and intensity of a startup

High ownership and fast growth: grow into leading the talent acquisition function as it scales

Interested?

Drop us a message at anuj@apollofinvest.com / careers@apollofinvest.com

Let's build the team powering the next phase of Apollo Cash.

* Coordinate with the banquet/event team regarding event requirements, menus, timings, seating arrangements, and service flow.
* Ensure correct setup of tables, buffet counters, bars, service stations, and event areas.
* Ensure sufficient manpower and proper staff allocation for every event.
* Supervise banquet service from setup through closing and breakdown.
* Ensure smooth coordination between service and kitchen teams during events.

**5. Food & Beverage Cost Control**

* Assist the F&B Manager in controlling food, beverage, and operational costs.
* Monitor wastage, portion control, breakages, complimentary items, and staff consumption.
* Ensure proper handling and accountability of crockery, cutlery, glassware, linen, equipment, and other F&B assets.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
* Support initiatives to improve revenue, productivity, and operational profitability.

**6. Sales & Revenue Support**

* Work closely with the F&B Manager to maximize restaurant and banquet revenue.
* Ensure effective upselling and suggestive selling by the service team.
* Drive sales of beverages, premium menu items, desserts, specials, and other high-margin products.
* Monitor table turnover and service efficiency without compromising guest experience.
* Support promotional activities, special events, and revenue-generating initiatives.

**7. Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate closely with the
  **Food & Beverage Manager**
  on daily operations, staffing, guest feedback, sales, costs, and operational challenges.
* Work closely with the Executive Chef and kitchen team to ensure smooth food service.
* Coordinate with banquet/event, housekeeping, maintenance, security, and other departments as required.
* Communicate event requirements and operational priorities clearly to the service team.
* Escalate significant guest, staffing, operational, or financial issues to the F&B Manager promptly.

**8. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
* Maintain high standards of cleanliness across the restaurant, banquet areas, service stations, and back-of-house service areas.
* Ensure staff comply with grooming, hygiene, uniform, and personal cleanliness standards.
* Conduct regular checks and immediately address operational or hygiene deficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and applicable statutory requirements.



**9. SOPs & Operational Excellence**

* Implement and maintain F&B service SOPs and checklists.
* Regularly review service processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure opening, service, closing, and banquet procedures are followed consistently.

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
**Reporting To:**
=================

Senior Human Resources Business Partner

**Shift:**
==========

India Standard (India)

**About Russell Investments, Mumbai:**
======================================

Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is “Top 12 Ranked Consultant (2009-2024)” in P&I survey 2024 with $1,013 billion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2026) and $417.5 billion in assets under management (as of June 30, 2026) for clients in 30 countries. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.

Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.

For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.

**Job Description:**
====================

Russell Investments is looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition leader to manage recruitment delivery across our India business.

Our Mumbai office is Russell Investments' largest global location, supporting a diverse range of functions including Investment Division, Global Technology, Global Operations, GTM, Marketing and corporate services.

This role will lead a team of recruiters responsible for hiring across both technology and non-technology functions, with particular emphasis on specialist and technically complex roles.

We are looking for someone who combines hands-on recruitment expertise with strong business acumen, market intelligence and a data-driven approach. The successful candidate will independently manage TA operations, build a high-performing recruitment team and partner with business leaders to deliver effective hiring solutions.

The role will also work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to support the implementation of our evolving global TA strategy and operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition Delivery & Operations**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment delivery across technology and non-technology functions in India, ensuring hiring priorities are met while maintaining high standards of candidate quality.
* Independently manage recruitment operations, including recruiter allocation, hiring priorities, workload management and escalations.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR Business Partners on workforce requirements, hiring strategies, role expectations and recruitment challenges.
* Drive recruitment efficiency through effective intake discussions, proactive pipeline management, timely stakeholder communication and adherence to agreed service standards.
* Work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to implement the global TA strategy, strengthen regional collaboration and drive consistency in recruitment practices.
* Manage recruitment agencies and external partners, ensuring quality, cost effectiveness and appropriate utilisation.

**2. Specialist & Technical Recruitment**

* Personally lead recruitment for selected critical, senior and technically complex roles, particularly across Technology and Investment-related functions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical talent markets, including software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity, AI and automation.
* Develop expertise in specialist investment talent segments such as quantitative analytics, investment risk, portfolio analytics and research.
* Build sourcing strategies for niche and hard-to-fill positions through direct sourcing, talent mapping and alternative talent pools.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor activity and emerging skill requirements to support informed hiring decisions.

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of recruiters, building accountability, independence and consistency in recruitment delivery.
* Set clear expectations around recruiter productivity, hiring quality, stakeholder management and service standards.
* Conduct regular recruitment reviews, provide feedback and address performance or capability gaps within the team.
* Build functional expertise across the team and encourage knowledge-sharing between technology and non-technology recruitment verticals.
* Foster a culture of ownership, where recruiters proactively resolve challenges, manage stakeholders and make informed recommendations.

**4. Recruitment Analytics & Reporting**

* Own recruitment reporting and dashboards, providing visibility into hiring progress, pipeline health, time-to-fill, source effectiveness and recruiter productivity.
* Analyse recruitment data to identify trends, anticipate hiring challenges and recommend improvements to recruitment strategies.
* Present meaningful hiring insights and recommendations to HR and business leaders.
* Ensure data accuracy and reporting discipline across Workday and other recruitment systems.

**5. Process Improvement & Candidate Experience**

* Drive consistent adoption of recruitment processes, interview frameworks, assessment standards and hiring governance.
* Partner with hiring managers and HRBPs to improve interview effectiveness, candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify recruitment workflows, improve turnaround times and reduce unnecessary administrative activities.
* Support the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled recruitment tools, automation and sourcing technologies.
* Ensure a positive, transparent and professional experience for candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Promote fair, inclusive and evidence-based hiring practices in line with company policies and applicable regulations.

**What You'll Bring**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 3 years of direct people management experience.
* Proven experience managing recruitment delivery across both technology and non-technology functions.
* Strong hands-on technical recruitment experience, with the ability to independently manage complex and niche hiring requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop recruiters while managing multiple hiring priorities.
* Strong understanding of the Indian talent market, sourcing channels, compensation trends and specialist talent pools.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using recruitment data to influence decisions and improve hiring outcomes.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders, influencing hiring decisions and managing challenging recruitment situations.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment reporting tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of recruitment delivery.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience recruiting within BFSI, investment management, asset management, fintech or global capability centres.
* Exposure to quantitative, investment analytics, risk or other specialist financial-services hiring.
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organisation, supporting stakeholders across multiple regions.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting, talent intelligence platforms, recruitment automation or AI-enabled sourcing solutions.
* Experience implementing recruitment process improvements or TA transformation initiatives.
* Advanced Excel, Power BI or similar data-visualisation capabilities.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 3-6 months, we would expect you to:

* Establish strong ownership of day-to-day recruitment delivery, with minimal escalation required for routine hiring matters.
* Build a recruitment team that operates with greater independence, accountability and functional expertise.
* Develop credible relationships with hiring managers and HRBPs, providing proactive recruitment advice and market intelligence.
* Improve recruitment reporting, pipeline visibility and consistency in stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrate successful delivery of specialist and technically complex hiring requirements.
* Contribute to the implementation of global TA initiatives and identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.

**Why Join Russell Investments?**

At Russell Investments, you will have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of business functions within a global investment solutions organisation.

This role offers exposure to specialist talent markets, global stakeholders and ongoing TA transformation initiatives, while providing the opportunity to shape recruitment delivery and develop a high-performing team.

You will play an important role in building the talent and capabilities that support our business in India and globally.

title: Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
Your day at NTT DATA
  
As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the go-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Your main focus will be on providing first-line support by monitoring private and public cloud infrastructure, identifying problems early, and resolving technical incidents efficiently. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring we meet our service level agreements and deliver an excellent client experience.
  
  
Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. If incidents occur, you'll investigate and get to the root cause swiftly to restore services. Your tasks will also include executing approved maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes and providing telephonic or chat support to clients when needed.
  
  
Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. Whether it's updating existing knowledge articles, creating new ones, or finding ways to automate routine tasks, you'll actively contribute to enhancing service delivery. Your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and keep a positive outlook will be key to your success.
  
  
Effective communication is essential in this role. You'll collaborate across different cultures and social groups, plan activities comprehensively, and ensure smooth handovers during shift changes. Your commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions will help create a positive client experience throughout their journey with us.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**  

* Basic troubleshooting skills and knowledge in network, voice, collaboration, and contact centre services.
* The ability to triage client cases effectively, ensuring that severity and impact is accurate as well as key information is documented in the case.
* Active listening techniques to confirm understanding and gather relevant information.
* Strong communication skills, able to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Flexibility and adaptability in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and resilience under pressure.

title: Chief Operating Officer - India
description:
**Help build the platform for Buro Happold's next phase of growth in India.**

We are looking for an exceptional Chief Operating Officer for our India business to lead the operational strategy that turns ambition into lasting business performance.

**Here at Buro Happold, expect the exceptional.**

From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.

**Your next role**

This is an opportunity to take a pivotal leadership role in the continued development of Buro Happold's business in India.

As **Chief Operating Officer - India**, you will work alongside our Managing Director and senior leadership team to turn our ambitions for the region into a clear, high-performing and sustainable operating model. You will bring together strategy, commercial performance, people, governance and operational delivery, helping us make better decisions, strengthen accountability and create the platform for our continued growth.

This is much more than an operational oversight role. We are looking for a senior leader who can see the bigger picture while maintaining a firm grip on execution: someone who can bring clarity to complexity, challenge constructively and connect people and priorities across a multidisciplinary, international organisation.

You will have significant influence across our India business, working with Partners, discipline leaders and corporate functions, while building strong connections across Buro Happold globally.

**What will success look like?**

Your impact will be seen in a business that is increasingly connected, commercially focused and equipped for sustainable growth.

Success will mean:

* Turning our India strategy into a clear operating plan with measurable priorities, ownership and accountability.
* Creating greater visibility of financial and operational performance, supported by robust forecasting and meaningful KPIs.
* Ensuring emerging commercial, operational and organisational risks are identified early and addressed effectively.
* Building an operating model that supports growth while strengthening utilisation, project performance and cost discipline.
* Creating greater alignment between leadership, disciplines and functions across India and the wider firm.
* Establishing a culture of continuous improvement, where data and insight lead to better and faster decisions.

**Key duties**

As a senior member of our India leadership team, you will:

* **Shape strategy and execution:** Partner with the Managing Director and India leadership to develop regional priorities and translate them into practical, measurable plans.
* **Drive commercial performance:** Provide leadership around budgets, forecasting and business performance, with oversight of revenue, profitability, utilisation, overheads and project performance.
* **Strengthen the operating model:** Continually assess how the India business is structured and operates, ensuring it remains effective as the organisation grows and evolves.
* **Enable sustainable growth:** Connect operational planning, capability and investment decisions with our strategic markets, client priorities and longer-term growth ambitions.
* **Improve governance and decision-making:** Create clarity around accountabilities, performance and risk, ensuring leaders have the insight required to make timely decisions.
* **Build organisational capability:** Work closely with HR and business leaders on workforce planning, leadership capacity, succession and the capabilities required for the future.
* **Lead continuous improvement:** Champion simplification, standardisation and data-led working, identifying opportunities to improve productivity and effectiveness.
* **Connect India with the wider firm:** Strengthen collaboration, resource planning and knowledge sharing across India and our global business.
* **Lead through influence:** Bring together senior stakeholders across a matrix organisation, constructively challenging where necessary and creating shared ownership of outcomes.
* **Champion our culture:** Support an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing environment, ensuring that operational decisions reflect both commercial priorities and the experience of our people.

**Your skills & experience**

We are looking for an accomplished operational leader who combines commercial rigour with strategic perspective and strong people leadership.

You are likely to bring:

* Significant senior leadership experience within a complex professional services, engineering, consultancy or comparable international organisation.
* Substantial experience leading operational performance at a regional, country or significant business-unit level.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience of business planning, budgeting, forecasting and P&L/performance management.
* A track record of improving operating models, organisational effectiveness and business performance, particularly within a growing or changing organisation.
* The ability to move comfortably between strategic thinking and the detail required to ensure effective execution.
* Strong analytical capability, with the ability to turn financial and operational data into clear priorities and practical action.
* Credibility and confidence working with Partners, executives, functional leaders and other senior stakeholders in a matrix environment.
* Experience leading change and continuous improvement across multiple teams, locations or business areas.
* Excellent judgement and communication skills, combined with a collaborative leadership style and the confidence to challenge constructively.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. A relevant postgraduate business or management qualification would be beneficial but is not essential.

**What we offer you**

* Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
* Performance incentive of up to 10% of salary and eligibility to join our RSU (restricted stock unit) scheme.
* Competitive benefits package including Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme for both you and your family, Group Personal Accident Cover
* Our 5-day workweek policy supports work-life balance, ensuring you have time to relax and recharge.
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Receive entitlements to two professional memberships or subscriptions, fostering your professional network and knowledge
* Benefit from our Employee Referral Bonus, rewarding you for bringing talented candidates into our fold
* A commitment to your wellbeing through a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellness initiatives designed to support your mental and physical health
* Back to Work Program for Women - Swam Siddha - We're committed to empowering women, facilitating seamless re-entry into the workforce through our dedicated program
* Engage with our vibrant community through the Young Employees Forum, Diversity and Inclusion Forum, and BH Women's Network, fostering a supportive and diverse workplace culture
* Make a difference in the world with our Share Our Skills (SOS) program, offering opportunities to support local communities and those in need globally.
* An International Culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.

**A place for everyone**

Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of how you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.

Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.

We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment. We are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

Please let us know if there are any adjustments we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

title: Site Lead / Engineering Activity Leader – India Development Center
description:
Location: Pune, India

**Your future job**

Act as the foundational on-site leader to establish, scale, and manage Melexis' new Engineering Development Center in India. The primary objective is to build an autonomous, high-quality engineering team of 10 to 15 engineers within the first 12 months (by Q4 2027) while establishing operational excellence and strategic alignment with HQ.The position provides unified operational and technical leadership spanning both Digital IC Design (operating under the Digital Competence Center umbrella) and Embedded Software Engineering (operating with the Software Competence Center).

**More specifically, you will:**

**1. Site Establishment & Directed Talent Acquisition**

* **Team Scaling & Directed Search:**
  Lead the directed search and hiring strategy to build a high-performing team of 10 to 15 engineers by Q4 2027, prioritizing leadership onboarded in Q1 2027.
* **Local Market Dynamics:**
  Manage India-specific talent acquisition dynamics, including active candidate outreach via direct calls, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn.
* **Offer Retention & Onboarding:**
  Address standard market notice periods, execute continuous candidate warm-up strategies post-acceptance, and actively mitigate the local offer dropout rates.
* **Budget Umbrella Management:**
  Direct headcount growth under a flexible overall budget umbrella.
* **Diversity & Inclusion:**
  Drive pipeline diversity and inclusive hiring practices in full alignment with corporate culture and values.

**2. Engineering Leadership & Subsystem Ownership**

* **Subsystem Ownership:**
  Establish end-to-end ownership (requirements -> design -> code -> test -> release sign-off) within 12 to 24 months, actively preventing the site from falling into the "ticket factory" trap.
* **Multi-Disciplinary Oversight:**
  Oversee deliverables across Digital IC Design (block-level verification, RTL design, DFT, STA, synthesis/P&R) and Embedded Software (ASPICE and ISO 26262 compliance).
* **Quality & Process Alignment:**
  Enforce one unified quality bar, common toolchain, and standardized process across sites aligned with the Melexis product development process.
* **Functional Safety Compliance:**
  Coordinate functional safety (ISO 26262 Parts 5 & 11) review independence, audits, and traceability in close cooperation with HQ safety and quality leadership.

**3. Operational Infrastructure & AI-Native Workflows**

* **AI-Native Engineering Setup:**
  Set up an AI-native engineering environment from day one, integrating AI-assisted workflows (unit testing, static-analysis triage, automated test plan generation, coverage closure) to empower a senior, domain-focused team.
* **Governance & IP Compliance:**
  Ensure strict adherence to corporate IP governance, US export controls (EAR), India's DPDP Act, foundry PDK NDAs, and EDA license site geography agreements.
* **Infrastructure & Lab Access:**
  Oversee local compute grid access, remote desktop/VDI performance, and local/remote test lab infrastructure to guarantee seamless hardware access (boards, emulators, debuggers).

**4. HQ Stakeholder Alignment & Cultural Leadership**

* **Cross-Site Synchronization:**
  Serve as the primary cultural and operational bridge between the India center and European HQ hubs (Belgium, Bulgaria, France) across a 3.5 to 4.5 hour CET time zone overlap.
* **Competence Center Alignment:**
  Maintain close strategic alignment with competence center leaders.
* **Cultural Safety & Retention:**
  Foster a working culture built on psychological safety, open upward feedback, technical growth, and long-term engineer retention.

**Your profile**

**Professional Experience:**

* **Technical Leadership:**
  10+ years of technical leadership experience in semiconductor design, automotive embedded software, or mixed-signal IC development.
* **Site Scaling Track Record:**
  Proven track record of successfully starting, scaling, or managing engineering teams or competence centers in India.
* **Domain Expertise:**

title: IT Sourcing Lead, Global Procurement - IT Contingent Labor

title: Global Director of People and Culture
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
Cin7 is an inventory management company with a globally distributed team and customers around the world. People are at the heart of what we do. As we keep growing, we need a hands-on HR leader who can partner closely with our Engineering and Product teams to build a high-performing, engaged culture.
  
  
You’ll be a trusted advisor to technology leaders, bringing HR expertise and a business perspective to how we hire, develop, reward, and retain talent. You’ll work across time zones with the Global People and Culture team to share ideas, practices, and projects that support our people and our goals. You will also lead a small team, providing day-to-day guidance, development, and performance support to your direct reports.
  
  
This is a director-level role with ownership of the people agenda for your teams. This role will have one direct report at launch: the HR Business Partner (New Zealand). You will also work with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) through a matrix reporting relationship. You’ll be based in Pune or Ahmedabad and will travel approximately quarterly to visit our teams in Ahmedabad/Pune, Colombo, and Dubai.
  
  
**Applying for this role:**
Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive HR outcomes and deliverables that support the overall People and Culture vision and strategy.
* Serve as a trusted counsel to Engineering and Product leaders on people matters, including complex employee relations and performance issues.
* Lead global planning cycles such as compensation planning, goal setting, and performance reviews, coordinating closely with leaders to execute them.
* Lead HR projects such as restructuring, reorganizations, and merit cycles, guiding leaders on approach and timelines and supporting them through completion.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders to align HR initiatives with business strategy.
* Anticipate future capability needs and proactively address emerging people challenges.
* Champion Cin7’s values, culture, and employee engagement across your teams.
* Provide clear, accurate people data and analysis to inform decisions and communicate updates to leaders.
* Partner with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) and the HR Business Partner (New Zealand) to set priorities, share best practices, and support their work across the matrix.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR leader across multiple areas of HR ownership.
* Prior experience managing people leaders or HR team members, including across more than one country.
* Demonstrated expertise across HR functions, with experience practicing HR in a global or multi-region capacity.
* Experience leading through influence and working with virtual and global teams.
* Strong understanding of employment relations, performance management, and engagement practices.
* Financial acumen and strong business presentation skills.
* Ability to create frameworks for processes and best practices.
* Team mindset: you roll up your sleeves and help others.

**Tools & Technology**

* Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, including deep-dive employee data analysis and benchmarking.
* Experience with performance management systems.
* Confident, everyday use of AI tools to improve HR workflows, analysis, and communication.

**In Return, We Offer**

* Growth opportunities, a team and a support network.
* Flexible working
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* Social events and many opportunities to build your local, regional and global community
* Customer Volunteer Days
* Recruitment referral bonus
* A diverse and global team, where everyone helps solve problems.
* A culture that is owned by all of us

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Deputy Unit Manager - IA HR
description:
**Location Name:**
Pune Corporate Office - Mantri
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To design and drive contemporary people and engagement interventions that build a future ready workforce, working as an individual contributor who conceptualises, curates and delivers initiatives end to end for the assigned business.
  
  
To continuously map industry wide best practices in talent management and employee engagement, adapt them to the organisation's context and culture, and implement them seamlessly through platforms such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons and other new age interventions.
  
  
To strengthen employee experience, pride, capability and connect so that talent stays engaged, future skilled and aligned to the organisation's growth agenda.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Designing and Driving People Initiatives for a Future Ready Workforce
  
  

* Act as an individual contributor Engagement Partner who conceptualises, designs and drives the annual people engagement and talent management calendar for the assigned business.
* Build a deep understanding of the business agenda, workforce profile, capability gaps, culture priorities and employee sentiment to shape interventions that create a future ready workforce.
* Own the initiative lifecycle end to end – idea, design, stakeholder alignment, budget, communication, rollout, participation and post event impact measurement.
* Translate business and HR priorities into simple, scalable and repeatable people programs that can be run across locations and employee segments.

Industry Best Practice Mapping and Adaptation
  
  

* Continuously scan and benchmark industry wide best practices in engagement, talent management, employee experience, learning and future skilling across peer organisations, technology firms and start ups.
* Adapt and contextualise external best practices to the organisation's culture, employee demographics, business rhythm and cost discipline rather than adopting them as is.
* Pilot new ideas with defined success criteria, gather feedback, refine and scale the ones that work, while retiring interventions that do not add value.
* Ensure seamless implementation by building clear process documents, toolkits, communication assets and manager enablement material for every intervention.

Flagship Engagement Platforms – Townhalls, Summits and People Connects
  
  

* Plan and execute leadership townhalls including theme, content flow, leadership messaging, employee Q&A, logistics, attendance and post event feedback.
* Design and anchor summits and forums that showcase business achievements, innovation stories, customer impact and future roadmap for the workforce.
* Drive structured people connects such as skip level connects, new joiner connects, women connects, high potential connects, focus groups and pulse conversations to capture employee voice.
* Convert insights from connects, pulse surveys and culture surveys into clear action plans and follow through to closure with business and HR stakeholders.

Career, Capability and Innovation Interventions
  
  

* Design and run career workshops, career conversation frameworks, role based growth paths, internal mobility drives and mentoring circles that help employees see and build their future in the organisation.
* Conceptualise and deliver hackathons, ideathons, innovation challenges and learning sprints that build new age skills, encourage original thinking and create visible ownership.
* Partner with L&D and business experts to curate future skilling journeys, certification drives, tech talks, knowledge sharing sessions and communities of practice.
* Strengthen rewards and recognition, onboarding and buddy programs, milestone celebrations and other employee experience moments that matter.|Communication, Measurement and Governance
* Build the internal communication narrative for people initiatives through bulletins, mailers, digital channels, leadership messages and campaign creatives.
* Define and track measurable outcomes for every intervention – participation, reach, feedback scores, engagement and culture survey movement, capability build and retention impact.
* Publish dashboards and review decks for leadership covering engagement calendar progress, action closures, employee sentiment themes and best practice adoption.
* Manage budgets, vendors and event partners with cost discipline, timelines and quality standards.

The principal accountabilities of the role holder are expected to impact the organization from two perspectives:
  
  

* Business Indicators
* Timely and seamless execution of the annual engagement and talent management calendar
* Improvement in engagement, ESAT and culture survey scores for the assigned business
* Number of industry best practices mapped, piloted and successfully scaled within the organisation
* Participation, reach and feedback scores across townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons
* Reduction in regrettable attrition and improvement in internal mobility and future skill readiness
* Adherence to budget, timelines and closure of actions arising from employee feedback
* Employees and Stakeholders
* Stronger employee connect, voice and sense of belonging across levels and locations
* Greater clarity on career paths, growth opportunities and skills required for the future
* Visible platforms for innovation, original thinking and recognition of contribution
* Higher pride in the organisation, the work and the leadership connect
* Enabled managers who can carry engagement and career conversations forward with their teams

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**

* Design, theme, format and calendar of engagement and talent management interventions for the assigned business.
* Selection of industry best practices to be benchmarked, piloted, scaled or discontinued basis relevance and impact.
* Content flow, agenda and employee communication approach for townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons.
* Recommendation on vendors, event partners, platforms and budget utilisation within approved limits.
* Identification of engagement hotspots, employee sentiment themes and the corrective action priorities to be taken up with business leaders.
* Metrics, feedback mechanisms and closure timelines to be used for measuring the success of each intervention.

**Major Challenges**

* Establishing credibility as an individual contributor who designs and delivers large scale people initiatives without a direct team, relying purely on influence and stakeholder partnership.
* Adapting industry best practices to the organisation's context, culture and cost structure so that they land meaningfully instead of being seen as borrowed ideas.
* Keeping interventions fresh and relevant for a diverse and multi generational workforce spread across levels, locations and work models.
* Securing leadership time, manager participation and employee bandwidth for townhalls, summits, workshops and hackathons amidst demanding business timelines.
* Demonstrating measurable business and people impact of engagement interventions rather than event level participation alone.
* Balancing multiple concurrent initiatives, vendors and budgets while maintaining quality, timelines and a seamless employee experience.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Qualifications

MBA / Post Graduate qualification in HR or related discipline preferred
  
  

* Work Experience

3 – 6 years of experience in employee engagement, talent management, employee experience, internal communication or HR partnering roles, preferably with exposure to technology or digital workforces.
  
  
Demonstrated track record of independently designing and executing people initiatives such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons, recognition programs and culture campaigns.
  
  
Ability to benchmark industry best practices, contextualise them to the organisation and implement them seamlessly end to end.
  
  
Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling and communication skills with the ability to craft content for leadership and large employee audiences.
  
  
Project and event management skills covering planning, budgeting, vendor management, logistics and timelines.
  
  
Comfort with people analytics, survey data, dashboards and digital engagement platforms to measure impact and drive decisions.
  
  
High ownership, creativity, stakeholder management and the ability to deliver as an individual contributor through influence.

description:

* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity
* High energy levels, agility and adaptability
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for client projects that are approved as per EY and country specific travel advisory guidelines.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

+ Strong technical knowledge of end to end payroll process
+ Analytical abilities and knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint
+ Expertise in process mapping and documentation using Visio and other tools
+ Expertise in creating SOP, process documentation and work instructions

* Led or delivered global payroll consulting engagements at a regional or global level, including strategy, current-state assessment, process improvement, operating model design and risk mitigation

* Hands-on experience with payroll and HCM platforms such as Workday, ADP (GlobalView and Workforce Now), Dayforce, SAP and Oracle PeopleSoft

**What We Look For**

* 8–10 years of experience in payroll operations, transformation and consulting
* 5–7 years of consulting experience, including global payroll advisory, implementation or transformation engagements
* Master’s degree in Finance/HR or full time MBA
* Experience in delivering payroll implementation and transformation programs, as part of a global distributed team
* Strong functional understanding of one or more payroll technology platforms, including Workday, ADP, Dayforce, SAP or Oracle PeopleSoft

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Senior Global Mobility Specialist - Compensation Focus
description:

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About The Role**
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Global Mobility Specialist will play a key role in supporting DNV's Global Mobility Program and its stakeholders, ensuring compliant, efficient and employee-focused international assignment delivery.
  
  
This is a senior specialist position requiring strong advisory capabilities, end-to-end ownership and the ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and vendors. The role combines complex International Assignment management, understanding of assignment compensation and payroll structures, vendor coordination, continuous improvement initiatives and contribution to strategic Global Mobility projects.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to employees, managers and internal stakeholders, helping to translate complex mobility, compensation and assignment-related requirements into practical and understandable solutions while ensuring a positive assignee experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**International Assignment Management**

* Manage the full lifecycle of international assignments, from initiation and preparation through extension and repatriation.
* Advise employees, managers and HR stakeholders on mobility policies, immigration, tax, relocation, compensation, payroll and vendor-supported services.
* Manage different assignment models and related compensation structures, including allowances, benefits and home, host or split payroll arrangements.
* Own complex and non-standard mobility cases, coordinating internal stakeholders and external providers to ensure accurate and compliant delivery.
* Ensure compliance with policies and applicable regulations while providing a high-quality assignee experience through proactive communication and problem-solving. ‌

**Compensation, Payroll & Reporting**

* Review and interpret assignment-related compensation, benefits and payroll data, identifying inconsistencies and supporting issue resolution.
* Prepare and analyze Global Mobility reports, translating data into clear conclusions and recommendations.
* Explain complex assignment and compensation structures clearly to international assignees, HR, People Managers and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with payroll, compensation, tax and external mobility providers to ensure accurate and consistent assignment delivery.

**Vendor Coordination & Service Delivery**

* Coordinate service delivery across DNV's Global Mobility vendor network.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with external service providers.
* Support vendor-related initiatives, reviews and service transitions where required.
* Act as a key point of contact between vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure vendors deliver consistent, compliant and customer-focused support.
* Identify service gaps and improvement opportunities to strengthen vendor performance and employee experience.

**Projects & Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in Global Mobility projects and service development initiatives.
* Support onboarding of new vendors and implementation of new services where required.
* Identify challenges, service gaps and improvement opportunities, and proactively drive them to resolution.
* Share knowledge and contribute to the development of operational guidance and best practices.
* Support cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving compliance, efficiency and employee experience.

What we offer
  
  
At DNV, our benefits are built around the way we live our values – We Care, We Dare, We Share – and shaped together with our employee representatives, because the best solutions are the ones we design as a team.
  
  
Imagine joining a workplace where your wellbeing, growth, and everyday comfort are not just add‑ons, but part of how we work
  
  

* A wellbeing boost you choose From sports to wellness activities, you can shape your own healthy lifestyle using an annual Worksmile budget – including access to Multisport Plus.
* Health that truly supports you Enjoy private medical care with Medicover, psychological support with free sessions, 100% paid sick leave for the first days of illness, and coverage for glasses or contact lenses when needed.

* Security for your future After 6 months of continuous employment, you can join our DNV‑funded Pension Plan (PPE), adding long‑term stability to your journey with us.
* Meaningful extras that make a difference From referral bonuses and milestone vouchers to lunch cards, home‑office reimbursement, public transport support, and even the opportunity to buy back your business laptop or phone – we take care of the details so you can focus on what matters.

In DNV, benefits aren’t just a list – they’re an experience shaped by our values and by the people who work here.
  
  
**Join us and be part of creating what comes next**
!
  
  
*DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture, and we invite you to be part of this diversity.*
**About You**
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Has experience in Global Mobility, including international assignments, relocation, immigration, tax/social security or compensation.
* Understandsinternational assignment compensation, payroll and mobility models.
* Is analytical and comfortable with numbers, data and reporting, with strong attention to detail.
* Can explain complex topics clearly and provide practical advice and recommendations.
* Is proactive, solution-oriented and accountable.
* Has strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

title: Founding Member - Talent Acquisition & People
description: Reports to: Co-Founder & COOExperience: 3–7 years, most of it in hands-on hiring at a startup or high-growth companyOPNISCIENCE is building the AI-native operating network for private markets. Our platform, Opni, connects the institutions behind private investing (investors, fund managers, OCIOs and fund administrators) and puts specialist AI agents to work on the documents, data, workflows and reporting that run their operations. Every calculation is deterministic and auditable, and every decision that matters is approved by a person.Our principle is simple: AI performs the work. People govern the outcome.We are US-headquartered with our build team in Delhi NCR, and this is our founding team's second startup. Our company LinkedIn and webpage is quiet because we have been busy building. You are the person who changes that.ABOUT THE ROLEThe people we hire over the next two years will decide what this company becomes, and we want one exceptional person to own that.You will be our first dedicated talent and people hire. You will learn our business well enough to pitch it better than we do, and sit with each functional leader until you know exactly what great looks like in their team. Then you will treat every search as a problem to solve from first principles: who is this person, where are they today, what would make them move, and how do we reach them before anyone else does. You run experiments, read the results and iterate quickly.Hiring comes first, at roughly two-thirds of your time to begin with. The rest is building our people function from a blank page. For the right person, this role is designed to grow into our Chief People Officer.WHAT YOU'LL OWNTalent acquisitionHire across the company. Run full-cycle hiring for engineering (back-end, front-end, AI/ML, cloud), product and design, and fund accounting and operations.Turn needs into sharp briefs. Work with each leader to convert "we need someone good" into a role scorecard, a target talent map and an interview plan.Build each search from first principles. Design the sourcing strategy per role across outbound, referrals, campus, communities and recruiting partners. Test channels and messages, then double down on what works.Run the funnel like a product. Measure conversion at every stage, speed and quality of hire. Find the leaks and fix them.Build our employer brand. Shape the story, the LinkedIn presence and the candidate experience so that a company few people have heard of becomes one the best people want to join.Close. You are a candidate's first experience of Opniscience. Sell the opportunity honestly and land the offers that matter.Use AI in your own work. We build AI agents for a living, and we expect you to rethink how recruiting gets done with them.PeopleOnboarding. Own the journey from offer to the end of the first 90 days, so that great hires become great performers.Workforce planning and org design. Plan headcount, roles and team structure with the founders as we scale.Performance and feedback. Design a simple rhythm for goals and reviews, and use it to learn which hires succeed and why.Culture and engagement. Build the rituals, recognition and feedback loops that keep a high-output team energized, and track what drives retention.People foundations. Put the essentials in place (offer letters, HRMS, core policies), and manage specialist partners for payroll, statutory compliance and POSH so that we stay fully compliant without it consuming your week.WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FORYou have built hiring from very little. You have filled hard roles for a company without a known brand, a big budget or a team behind you, and you found your own way to do it. Tell us what you built, and what you would do differently.You can show your method. Pick any search you have run and walk us through it step by step: how you defined the profile, which companies and communities you mapped, which channels and messages you tested, your conversion numbers at each stage, and what you changed because of them.You are exact about detail. Your scorecards are specific, your tracker is always current, your interview notes are good enough for a hiring manager to decide from, and no candidate is left waiting for an answer.You hire for outcomes. You judge your work by how your hires perform six months in, and you can tell us how past hires turned out.You learn a complex business quickly. You do not need a finance background, but you will need to understand private markets and AI well enough to earn a senior candidate's respect.You communicate with presence. Excellent spoken and written English, and credibility with senior candidates and US-based founders.People remember your energy and warmth. Candidates leave a conversation with you more excited than when they arrived.Bonus: experience as an early or sole talent hire, campus hiring, fintech, SaaS or AI hiring, or a working knowledge of Indian labour law.HOW YOU WORKProactive problem solver. You treat the hiring plan as your own business. When there is no budget, tool or process, you build what you need and do not wait to be asked.Methodically. Every search starts with a written plan and a hypothesis. You question the standard playbook, test in days, measure, and keep what works.With precision. You sweat the details that candidates and hiring managers notice, and the ones they do not.With magnetism. Your enthusiasm is real, and it carries candidates and colleagues with you.With the big picture in view. You connect each hire to where the company is going, and you want to help shape that.WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKEFirst 30 days: You know the business and have met every functional leader. Scorecards are agreed for the priority roles, your first sourcing experiments are live and the pipeline is moving.First 60 days: Your first hires are closing. A funnel dashboard shows what is working, our employer brand has visibly improved and the onboarding playbook is in use.First 90 days: We have a repeatable hiring engine that our leaders trust, and you have presented the founders with a people roadmap for the next 12 months.WHY JOIN OPNISCIENCEA founding seat, with a blank page and the mandate to build talent and people your way.A path to leadership roles as the company grows.Direct partnership with the founders, who have built and successfully sold a FinTech SaaS company.Exposure to global institutional clients and to AI applied to real, high-stakes work.Competitive compensation and a meaningful growth runway.
