title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager – SIVAARA (Health & Wellness Brand)**

**Location:**
 West Delhi, New Delhi - On-site

**Experience:**
 3–5 years (preferably in telesales / call center / D2C / BPO setup)

**Employment Type:**
 Full-time

**About SIVAARA**

SIVAARA is a fast-growing health & wellness company building a strong presence in South India through performance-driven telesales and COD operations.

We run a high-intensity, metric-focused operation:

* Large volume of 
  **incoming leads**
   every day
* **Multi-language telesales team**
   (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, etc.)
* Strong focus on 
  **discipline, accountability, performance, and culture**
* Structured processes for 
  **sales, logistics, inventory, HR, and compliance**

We already have clear SOPs and systems for most departments. Now we want a dedicated 
**HR Executive**
 who can own the people side of SIVAARA and build a strong HR function end-to-end.

**Role Overview – What You’ll Own**

You will be the only
**full-time HR Manager**
 fully dedicated to SIVAARA operations.

Your job is to make sure:

* The 
  **right people**
   join us
* The 
  **right culture**
   is maintained
* The 
  **right systems**
   are followed daily

You’ll work closely with the 
**Founder**
 and handle HR across Sales, Logistics, Inventory, MIS, QA, and Support teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. 
**Hiring & Manpower Planning**

* Own end-to-end recruitment for:
* Telesales agents (multiple languages)
* Team Leaders / Managers
* NDR / Verification / Retention teams
* Logistics, Inventory, MIS, and Support roles
* Build and manage a 
  **steady hiring pipeline**
   so that:
* We never run short of agents
* Replacements are planned in advance
* Coordinate with local consultants, job portals, walk-ins, and referrals.
* Create 
  **clear JD templates, screening criteria, and selection processes**
   for each role.

2. 
**Onboarding, Training & Confirmations**

* Design and run a 
  **structured onboarding process**
  :
* Documentation, background checks (where required)
* Explaining SIVAARA’s processes, culture, and expectations
* Coordinate with Training / Operations to:
* Track agents through training, test call period, and probation
* Maintain clear records of:
* Joining dates, training status, confirmation status, and exits

3. 
**Attendance, Discipline & HR Operations**

* Own daily 
  **attendance, late-coming, and absenteeism tracking**
* Ensure all policies are actually followed:
* Shift timings
* Breaks
* Phone submission / data security norms
* Leave policies
* Prepare and share discipline reports with Operations & Management.
* Co-ordinate with accounts/finance for 
  **monthly payroll inputs**
  :
* Present days, LOP, incentives data (from MIS/Operations)

4. 
**Performance, Incentives & HR Analytics**

* Work with MIS / Operations to:
* Understand key performance metrics (DR, AOV, sales, productivity, etc.)
* Map them to incentive policies already designed
* Ensure 
  **incentive policies are communicated clearly**
   to all teams.
* Help management identify:
* Top performers for growth and promotions
* Consistently low performers for PIP or exits
* Share 
  **monthly HR dashboards**
  : headcount, hiring vs attrition, probation status, PIP list, etc.

5. 
**Policy, Compliance & Documentation**

* Implement and maintain:
* Appointment letters, NDAs, HR policies, warning letters, exit formats, etc.
* Handle:
* Confirmations, warnings, suspension letters, exits and full & final coordination
* Ensure:
* Basic compliance with labour laws, working hours, and internal policies
* Assist management in implementing:
* POSH policy
* Grievance redressal mechanisms

6. 
**Culture, Conduct & Conflict Management**

* Maintain a 
  **high-performance, respectful, and no-politics environment**
  .
* Act as a 
  **neutral point of contact**
   for:
* Employee grievances
* Escalations within teams
* Identify negative behavior patterns early (toxicity, repeated policy breaks, attitude issues) and work with Operations to address them.
* Support in 
  **recognition programs**
  :
* “Agent of the month”
* Consistency awards
* Referral incentives

**You’ll Fit Well If You:**

* Have minimum 2-3
  **years of HR experience**
  , preferably with:
* Call centers / BPOs / telesales processes
* D2C / COD-based businesses (bonus)
* Are comfortable working in a 
  **high-volume, fast-paced sales environment**
  .
* Are strong in:
* **Recruitment**
   (frontline + mid-level)
* **Attendance & discipline management**
* **Policies, letters, and documentation**
* Can speak 
  **Tamil/Hindi or English**
   fluently (other South Indian languages are a plus).
* Are assertive, fair, and consistent
* You’re friendly but firm
* You can say “no” when needed
* Are comfortable working closely with the 
  **Founder**
   and taking ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Good To Have**

* Experience using 
  **KEKA**
* Worked earlier with 
  **telesales / collections / EdTech / fintech / health / BPO teams**
* Basic understanding of:
* Incentive structures
* Performance-linked HR
* Shift and roster management

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to 
  **build the HR function**
   of a growing health & wellness brand
* Direct access to 
  **Founder & Core Leadership**
* A culture that values:
* Ownership
* Discipline
* Performance
* Long-term growth for loyal and capable people
* Competitive salary + performance-based rewards

**How to Apply**

If this sounds like the kind of responsibility you enjoy, apply by filling this form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd09SoCcYC5d9\_WzGk7ATMGI8PvA0efWpazTsl\_6kkUDoE4Gg/viewform?usp=publish-editor or send your resume at sivaaraindia@gmail.com

title: Senior Manager Business Operations
description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
The Business Operations Manager leads centralized functions under Professional Field Services. This role drives their strategic development, financials, and continuous adaptation and alignment to the strategic goals and values of the function and the wider corporate organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
In this role you will build and run the centralized processes required to deliver a modern and digitalized Professional Field Services function for SITA.
  
  
**Key Process Will Include**

* Managing the dispatch of Field Engineers to completed planned activity
* Monitoring performance of the Field Service engineers and working with the regional Field Service managers to address any performance concerns.
* Overall process ownership for spares management, assets tracking and recycling activities
* Supporting the GEO-Presales teams by creating the standard Field Service offerings
* Management and tracking of overall Field Service capacity, demand forecasting and
* H&S stewardship, ensuring our engineers are equipped to operate in a safe manner.

**Leadership & Cultural Transformation**

* Proactively drive cultural and operational changes aligned with SGS and SITA objectives, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
* Lead strategic roadmaps to align business goals with transformation initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Standardization**

* Drive product standardization across GEO sales and centralized functions to ensure consistency and alignment with customer success objectives.
* Identify and integrate new technologies to improve efficiency, competitiveness, and service quality in CSO and PFS operations.
* Implement operational improvements, best practices, and change management strategies to enhance team efficiency and standardization.

**Strategic Resource Planning**

* Develop and maintain capacity and demand models to align resources with internal and external needs, ensuring efficiency and scalability.
* Oversee transformation project budgets, identifying opportunities for cost optimization and value maximization.

**Financial Oversight & Reporting**

* Deliver proactive financial counsel and overall financial management for GEO Organizations (PFS).
* Automate and provide regular management reports to senior leadership, ensuring transparency on transformation progress and operational performance.
* Track KPIs to measure productivity, identify optimization opportunities, and align teams with customer success goals.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain cross-functional relationships with GEOs and stakeholders to deliver customer value and continuous service improvement.
* Support related bids by providing strategic input and aligning with transformation initiatives.

**Training & Knowledge Enhancement**

* Develop and implement training programs to boost skills and knowledge within central teams.
* Ensure centralized functions maintain up-to-date knowledge of SITA products and services to effectively manage internal and external customer relationships.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations Management, or a related field (required).
* Master’s degree (MBA or similar) is a plus.
* 8- 10+ years in operations management, transformation leadership, or strategic planning roles.
* Proven experience leading cultural and operational transformations in global organizations.
* Expertise in financial management, process standardization, and resource optimization.

**Technical Skills**

* Data Analytics
* Knowledge of Products / Services
* ServiceNow Administration
* Field Service Management Tools
* Customer Relationship Management Tools
* Automation & AI

**Functional Skills**

* Leadership & Talent Development
* Strategic Planning
* Problem Solving
* Communication
* Change Management
* Influence & Negotiation
* Stakeholder Management
* Performance Measurement
* Innovation
* ITIL
* Financial Management

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

HR- People Initiatives

Delhi

**About MARS Cosmetics-**

MARS Cosmetics is an affordable, trend-forward Indian colour cosmetics brand with a strong e-commerce and retail presence across India and international markets. We are a fast-growing, founder-led company building the people systems to match our scale.

* Hands-on HRMS experience (HROne or similar) and advanced Excel / Google Sheets.
* Proven experience designing and delivering training programmes.
* Ability to build processes from scratch in a fast-paced, founder-led environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to leadership.

title: Talent Senior Manager - Global Businesses & Functions

description:
**About Indus Action**
Indus Action aims to enable over 800 million vulnerable citizens in India to move irreversibly out of extreme poverty by facilitating access to critical government support to which they are entitled. You will work closely with leadership and managers to identify talent, strengthen organisational capabilities and build systems that support people’s growth across a distributed organisation.

title: Workforce Manager
description:
We are seeking a hands-on WFM Manager to establish and run an integrated workforce planning program that connects workforce supply with delivery commitments, talent movement and business growth. The role will give leadership a clear view of deployable capacity, skill gaps and staffing decisions across accounts, domains and geographies.

The manager will own the monthly planning cycle and a rolling 3–6 month demand–supply forecast, translating workforce data into recommendations on redeployment, hiring, reskilling and capacity investment.

**Key Responsibilities -**

* **Own the central WFM calendar:**
  Define deliverables, submission timelines, review forums and escalation routes, and ensure each domain meets its commitments.
* **Coordinate the Domain SPOC network:**
  Serve as the central point of contact, provide standard templates and guidance, and follow up on incomplete or inconsistent submissions.
* **Validate plans with Domain Leaders:**
  Review workforce supply, demand assumptions, allocation, bench and skill gaps, and obtain domain confirmation of the agreed plan.
* **Consolidate the enterprise workforce view:**
  Reconcile domain submissions, highlight dependencies and identify opportunities for redeployment across domains.
* **Drive decisions and follow-through:**
  Convert gaps and exceptions into actions with named owners and due dates. Coordinate with Domain Leaders, HR, Recruitment and Finance to progress them.
* **Manage governance and escalation:**
  Maintain a central action tracker, resolve coordination issues and escalate overdue deliverables or unresolved trade-offs to the appropriate decisionmaker.

**Responsibilities Details**

**1. Establish and manage the WFM program**

* Implement the workforce planning operating model, including data ownership, common definitions, reporting standards and review calendars. Integrate the inputs covering headcount, allocation, skills, attrition, internal movement, bench, hiring, deals and delivery forecasts.
* Own data reconciliation and resolve inconsistencies so stakeholders work from one agreed workforce view.

**2. Own capacity planning and resource allocation**

* Maintain visibility of deployable full-time equivalent capacity by geography, domain, account, and SLA/billing code, accounting for leave and ramp-up time.
* Identify over-allocation, under-capacity accounts, invalid allocations and critical skill dependencies. Coordinate corrective action with delivery leaders.

**3. Connect demand forecasts with staffing decisions**

* Maintain a rolling 3–6-month forecast combining contracted delivery demand with probability-weighted deal requirements. Assess supply against expected exits, confirmed joiners and ramp-up timelines.
* Translate forecast gaps into staffing recommendations, considering skill requirements, deployment dates, hiring lead times and the cost of holding capacity ahead of demand.

**4. Manage bench, redeployment and hiring alignment**

* Track bench deployability by skill and monitor ageing at 30, 60 and 90 days. Work with delivery and learning teams to identify redeployment and reskilling opportunities before recommending external hiring.
* Partner with Recruitment to align requisition priorities, offers and joining dates with forecast capacity gaps, tracking progress through to productive deployment.

**5. Manage workforce and capability risks**

* Assess attrition exposure and capability gaps by account, domain and critical skill. Coordinate mitigation plans with HR and delivery leaders, including succession coverage, retention actions and replacement planning. Assign owners and action dates to critical risks.

**6. Lead reporting and governance**

* Own the workforce dashboard and leadership decision pack covering capacity, utilisation, bench, attrition, hiring and demand. Ensure exceptions result in decisions and tracked actions.
* Run weekly operating reviews, fortnightly Delivery–HR forums and monthly executive workforce reviews. Present staffing options and their implications for service delivery, cost and growth readiness.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a
**Technical Recruiter**
who can source, screen, and qualify candidates for niche engineering roles across
**automotive, aerospace, embedded systems, EV, manufacturing, mechanical design, validation, digital transformation and product engineering**
.

The recruiter must be able to understand engineering requirements, break down technical JDs, create strong search strategies, identify the right target companies, and screen candidates beyond keyword matching.

Key Responsibilities

1. Requirement Understanding

* Understand technical requirements from hiring managers or client teams.
* Break down JDs into
  **must-have**
  ,
  **good-to-have**
  , and
  **deal-breaker**
  criteria.
* Identify whether the role is related to development, design, validation, testing, integration, manufacturing, or support.
* Ask the right clarification questions before starting the search.
* Build a clear sourcing plan for every role.

2. Candidate Sourcing

* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, internal databases, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Create Boolean search strings for niche engineering roles.
* Identify relevant target companies for each role.
* Search for candidates across automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, ER&D service companies, aerospace companies, manufacturing companies, and engineering consulting firms.
* Build talent pipelines for recurring niche engineering roles.

3. Technical Screening

* Conduct first-level screening calls with candidates.
* Validate candidate experience beyond resume keywords.
* Ask project-specific questions to understand actual hands-on exposure.
* Check domain relevance, tools used, project ownership, notice period, salary fit, location preference, and motivation.
* Identify red flags before submission.

4. Candidate Submission & Coordination

* Prepare high-quality candidate submission notes.
* Clearly explain why a candidate fits the requirement.
* Maintain accurate trackers with candidate status and next steps.
* Coordinate interviews and follow-ups with candidates and internal teams.
* Collect feedback and improve future searches based on rejection reasons.

5. Market Mapping

* Build target company lists for automotive, aerospace, embedded, EV, and engineering roles.
* Track where relevant talent is available.
* Share market feedback on salary, notice period, availability, and skill scarcity.
* Help improve search strategy for difficult or low-supply roles.

title: Senior Executive – HR Compliance
description:
**About The Role**
**Position:**
Senior Executive – HR Compliance
  
  
**Department:**
Human Resources – Compliance
  
  
**Experience:**
4–7 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Security Services / Facility Management
  
  
**Location:**
Head Office
  
  
**Reporting To:**
DGM – HR / Head – HR
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To ensure statutory and labour law compliance across all company locations, maintain accurate statutory records, coordinate with government departments, and ensure timely filing of statutory returns and deposits under applicable labour laws.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Statutory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, including:
* Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act.
* Employees' State Insurance Act.
* Payment of Wages Act / Code on Wages, as applicable.
* Minimum Wages Act and applicable wage notifications.
* Payment of Bonus Act.
* Payment of Gratuity Act.
* Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act.
* Labour Welfare Fund (LWF).
* Shops and Commercial Establishments Act.
* Applicable state-specific labour laws and rules.
* Monitor statutory applicability and compliance requirements across all operational locations.
* Ensure timely submission of monthly, half-yearly and annual statutory returns.
* Monitor changes in labour laws, minimum wages and statutory contribution rates.
* PF & ESIC Compliance
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of monthly PF and ESIC contributions.
* Verify employee UAN, Aadhaar, bank details and KYC status.
* Monitor PF ECR preparation, challan generation and payment.
* Handle PF and ESIC registration, transfer, exit, correction and claim-related matters.
* Coordinate with EPFO and ESIC offices for employee grievances and compliance issues.
* Ensure proper maintenance of PF and ESIC employee-wise records.
* Labour Law & Minimum Wages Compliance
* Verify state-wise minimum wages according to applicable government notifications.
* Ensure correct wage classification of security guards, supervisors, housekeeping staff and other categories.
* Verify salary structures, overtime, weekly offs, leave wages, bonus and other statutory payments.
* Ensure compliance with working hours, registers, wage records and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with operations and payroll teams to resolve wage-related compliance discrepancies.
* Client Audit & Documentation
* Handle client statutory compliance audits and inspections.
* Prepare and submit monthly compliance documents to clients.
* Maintain statutory registers, wage registers, attendance records and other mandatory documents.
* Coordinate with internal departments for timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance documentation is uploaded on client portals within prescribed timelines.
* Government Department Coordination
* Coordinate with Labour Department, EPFO, ESIC and other statutory authorities.
* Handle notices, inspections, queries and compliance-related correspondence.
* Prepare replies to government notices in consultation with the HR Head / Management.
* Follow up on pending applications, registrations, approvals and statutory matters.
* Internal Coordination & MIS
* Coordinate with HR, Payroll, Accounts and Operations teams for statutory compliance.
* Prepare monthly compliance MIS and pending compliance reports.
* Track location-wise compliance status and highlight non-compliance risks.
* Maintain a compliance calendar for all branches and client locations.
* Ensure timely collection of attendance, wage sheets, challans and supporting documents.

What we're looking for
  
  
**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Practical experience in PF, ESIC, minimum wages and payroll compliance.
* Knowledge of state-wise labour law requirements.
* Experience handling client audits and government inspections.
* Good drafting and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and statutory portals.
* Ability to manage multiple locations and compliance deadlines independently.
* Educational Qualification
* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA in HR / PG Diploma in HR or Labour Laws will be an added advantage.

Perks & benefits
  
  
Best in the Industry

title: Sr. HRIS Analyst – Data Governance & Change Control
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Sr. HRIS Analyst**
to join our team and lead HR data governance, data integrity, reporting, analytics, and HRIS change control initiatives.

This role will work closely with
**HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Finance, and IT**
to ensure accurate, secure, compliant, and reliable employee data across HR systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Governance & Integrity**

* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, security, and appropriate use of HR data across ADP and other HR systems.
* Conduct regular data audits, validations, reconciliations, and quality checks.
* Develop and maintain HR data governance standards, validation rules, and documentation.
* Investigate and resolve employee master data issues and discrepancies.
* Partner with Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Finance, and IT to ensure data consistency across systems.
* Support HR data privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.

**Reporting, Analytics & Data Access**

* Develop, validate, and deliver HR reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytics.
* Ensure data accuracy for operational, compliance, executive, and leadership reporting.
* Analyze HR data trends and provide insights to support business decisions and process improvements.
* Review and fulfill HR data/reporting requests while ensuring appropriate authorization, confidentiality, and privacy requirements.
* Support periodic reviews of security roles, report access, and data permissions.

**Change Control & HRIS Governance**

* Manage and administer HRIS data change control processes.
* Review enhancement requests, defects, and production issues for completeness, business impact, and prioritization.
* Coordinate requirements gathering, testing, approvals, UAT, and change documentation.
* Maintain change control logs, release documentation, and audit records.
* Facilitate change review meetings and communicate status to stakeholders.
* Conduct post-implementation validation to ensure changes achieve the intended business outcomes.
* Track and report change requests, enhancements, defects, and overall change control status to leadership.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **HR, HRIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Analytics**
  , or a related field.
* **5+ years of progressive experience**
  in HRIS, HR Operations, HR Data Management, HR Reporting, or HR Technology.
* Hands-on experience supporting and administering
  **HCM/HRIS platforms**
  .
* Experience with
  **ADP, Workday, or similar HRIS platforms**
  .
* Strong experience in HR data governance, data audits, data integrity, and data quality controls.
* Experience developing HR reports, dashboards, metrics, and analytics.
* Strong understanding of employee data management, organizational structures, data privacy, and HR compliance.
* Experience with HRIS change control, testing coordination, UAT, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Advanced
  **Microsoft Excel**
  skills, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data validation, conditional formatting, and data reconciliation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project coordination, and communication skills.

**Why This Role?**

This is an excellent opportunity for an HRIS professional who enjoys working at the intersection of
**HR technology, data governance, analytics, and process improvement**
and wants to make a meaningful impact on HR operations and business decision-making.

title: Placement Coordinator
description:
Job Description

**Position:** Placement Coordinator cum Computer Trainer  
**Department:** Training & Placement / Academics

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and skilled **Placement Coordinator cum Computer Trainer** with a background in Computer Science or IT. The candidate will be responsible for delivering computer training to students, coordinating placement activities, preparing students for employment, and building relationships with companies for placement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Computer Training & Teaching**

* Teach computer-related subjects to BCA, MCA, and B.Tech Computer Science students.
* Conduct practical and theoretical sessions on computer fundamentals, programming, and IT-related subjects.
* Train students in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc., as per the curriculum and skill requirements.
* Teach MS Office, database management, web development, and other relevant computer applications.
* Prepare lesson plans, assignments, practical exercises, and training materials.
* Evaluate students' performance through tests, assignments, and practical assessments.

**2. Placement Coordination**

* Coordinate placement activities for students and maintain placement records.
* Identify job opportunities, internships, and campus recruitment drives.
* Communicate with companies, HR professionals, and recruiters to establish placement partnerships.
* Organize campus drives, interviews, aptitude tests, and recruitment events.
* Prepare students for interviews, aptitude tests, group discussions, and communication skills.
* Track students' placement status and maintain placement reports.

**3. Student Career Development**

* Guide students in career planning and job preparation.
* Conduct resume-building, interview preparation, and employability skills sessions.
* Help students improve their technical skills and professional communication.
* Provide career guidance based on students' qualifications, interests, and industry requirements.

title: Sr Recruiter (UK - Education)
description:
**UK Education Recruitment Specialist – Ahmedabad**

Are you a driven recruitment professional with a passion for education and people-focused hiring? Join our award-winning Ahmedabad team and help connect teachers, teaching assistants, SEN specialists, cover supervisors, school support staff, and education professionals with schools, academies, colleges, and education providers across the UK.

**Who We Are**

At IMS Group, we are an engine for global talent. With over 3,000 employees and a footprint spanning 250+ global clients across the APAC, EU, US, and APAC, we connect top-tier professionals with Fortune 500 companies. We are proud to be a 5-time consecutive winner of the Great Place to Work® award because we invest heavily in our people, offering world-class mentorship, health benefits, and long-term career growth.

**The Opportunity: What You Will Do**

As a UK Education Recruitment Specialist, you will manage recruitment delivery for UK-based education roles, supporting schools and candidates across supply, temporary, long-term, and permanent staffing requirements. Your day-to-day will focus on:

* **Education Talent Sourcing:**
  Identify, approach, and engage active and passive candidates across roles such as teachers, teaching assistants, SEN staff, cover supervisors, tutors, early years practitioners, administrators, and wider school support professionals.
* **End-to-End Recruitment Delivery:**
  Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing, screening, registration, shortlisting, interview coordination, candidate follow-up, booking support, offer management, and placement delivery.
* **School Briefing & Candidate Matching:**
  Qualify candidates against school requirements by understanding key stages, subject specialisms, SEN experience, classroom exposure, safeguarding expectations, location, availability, pay expectations, and assignment preferences.
* **Candidate, School & Data Management:**
  Build strong relationships with candidates, recruiters, school contacts, hiring managers, and client stakeholders while maintaining accurate records, pipeline updates, bookings, and recruitment activity in ATS or CRM systems.

**What You Bring to the Table**

We welcome applications from recruiters with experience in education recruitment, staffing, sourcing, teacher recruitment, school support recruitment, SEN recruitment, childcare recruitment, or other fast-paced, target-driven recruitment environments. We are looking for:

* **Recruitment or Sourcing Experience:**
  Experience handling candidate sourcing, screening, registration, shortlisting, interview coordination, pipeline management, booking support, or recruitment delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* **Education Market Awareness:**
  Understanding of UK education recruitment, school staffing, teacher supply, SEN, primary, secondary, early years, academies, colleges, or willingness to quickly learn specialist education hiring markets.
* **Communication, Pace & Ownership:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent follow-up discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple vacancies, candidates, school contacts, and stakeholders against delivery targets.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  UK shift alignment with Saturday and Sunday off.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Specialist Education Recruitment Exposure:**
  Build expertise across UK teacher recruitment, SEN, primary, secondary, early years, academies, colleges, supply staffing, permanent recruitment, and wider school support markets.
* **Work-Life Balance:**
  Structured UK shift alignment and a strict 5-day work week.
* **Career Growth:**
  Receive hands-on mentorship, structured training, and clear pathways to grow into a specialist UK education recruitment professional.
* **The Culture:**
  A recognized Great Place to Work® environment that champions health benefits, dynamic energy, and long-term professional development.

**Ready to Build With Us?**

If you have the drive, communication skills, and passion to connect talented education professionals with schools and learning communities across the UK, we want to hear from you.

title: Global Director of People and Culture
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
Cin7 is an inventory management company with a globally distributed team and customers around the world. People are at the heart of what we do. As we keep growing, we need a hands-on HR leader who can partner closely with our Engineering and Product teams to build a high-performing, engaged culture.
  
  
You’ll be a trusted advisor to technology leaders, bringing HR expertise and a business perspective to how we hire, develop, reward, and retain talent. You’ll work across time zones with the Global People and Culture team to share ideas, practices, and projects that support our people and our goals. You will also lead a small team, providing day-to-day guidance, development, and performance support to your direct reports.
  
  
This is a director-level role with ownership of the people agenda for your teams. This role will have one direct report at launch: the HR Business Partner (New Zealand). You will also work with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) through a matrix reporting relationship. You’ll be based in Pune or Ahmedabad and will travel approximately quarterly to visit our teams in Ahmedabad/Pune, Colombo, and Dubai.
  
  
**This position requires that you reside in Pune, India or Ahmedabad, India.**
**Applying for this role:**
Please apply through our careers page so your application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If you have a genuine connection to someone at Cin7 and they choose to refer you, that's welcome. Please don't send unsolicited connection requests or messages to employees asking for referrals, as this creates extra work for our team and may result in your application not being considered.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive HR outcomes and deliverables that support the overall People and Culture vision and strategy.
* Serve as a trusted counsel to Engineering and Product leaders on people matters, including complex employee relations and performance issues.
* Lead global planning cycles such as compensation planning, goal setting, and performance reviews, coordinating closely with leaders to execute them.
* Lead HR projects such as restructuring, reorganizations, and merit cycles, guiding leaders on approach and timelines and supporting them through completion.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders to align HR initiatives with business strategy.
* Anticipate future capability needs and proactively address emerging people challenges.
* Champion Cin7’s values, culture, and employee engagement across your teams.
* Provide clear, accurate people data and analysis to inform decisions and communicate updates to leaders.
* Partner with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) and the HR Business Partner (New Zealand) to set priorities, share best practices, and support their work across the matrix.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR leader across multiple areas of HR ownership.
* Prior experience managing people leaders or HR team members, including across more than one country.
* Demonstrated expertise across HR functions, with experience practicing HR in a global or multi-region capacity.
* Experience leading through influence and working with virtual and global teams.
* Strong understanding of employment relations, performance management, and engagement practices.
* Financial acumen and strong business presentation skills.
* Ability to create frameworks for processes and best practices.
* Team mindset: you roll up your sleeves and help others.

**Tools & Technology**

* Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, including deep-dive employee data analysis and benchmarking.
* Experience with performance management systems.
* Confident, everyday use of AI tools to improve HR workflows, analysis, and communication.

**In Return, We Offer**

* Growth opportunities, a team and a support network.
* Flexible working
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* Social events and many opportunities to build your local, regional and global community
* Customer Volunteer Days
* Recruitment referral bonus
* A diverse and global team, where everyone helps solve problems.
* A culture that is owned by all of us

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:
**Center Manager –Sales & Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Reports To:**
Clinic Business Head

**Role Purpose**

Lead the day-to-day operations and business performance of the clinic, ensuring
**exceptional patient experience, staff discipline, revenue integrity, compliance, vendor efficiency, cost control, and optimal doctor management**
in a digitally enabled environment.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Operations Leadership**
* Oversee all clinical services (OPD, diagnostics, imaging, pharmacy) for seamless patient flow.
* Manage doctor schedules (fixed and on call) to optimize utilization, reduce cancellations, and minimize waiting times.
* Ensure predictable clinic start-times and peak-hour efficiency.
* Resolve on-ground escalations: patient complaints, service delays, or staff conflicts.
* **Doctor Hiring & Management**
* Support recruitment of specialist and general physicians for the clinic.
* Onboard and mentor doctors to align with clinic protocols, SOPs, and patient experience standards.
* Monitor doctor performance, availability, patient load, and adherence to schedules.
* Track doctor-specific patient follow-ups and ensure timely reminders.
* Address doctor-related escalations and maintain high engagement.
* **People & Team Management**
* Lead front desk, nursing, lab, radiology, pharmacy, housekeeping, and security teams.
* Conduct daily huddles, weekly performance reviews, and coaching sessions.
* Ensure adequate staffing, backup coverage, and leave/attrition planning.
* Track staff punctuality, SOP adherence, and service accountability.
* **Revenue & Cost Control**
* Maintain billing and collections hygiene; prevent leakage and discrepancies.
* Monitor daily revenue, service line mix, and key performance metrics; implement corrective actions.
* Control consumables, minimize wastage, and monitor vendor performance and reorder discipline.
* **Compliance & Quality**
* Ensure statutory compliance (licenses, biomedical waste, registers) and audit readiness.
* Enforce SOP adherence across all departments; track deviations and ensure timely corrective action.
* Promote a culture of safety, hygiene, and quality across the center.
* Monitor overall clinical quality and patient safety standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue achievement vs monthly target – on plan
* Patient satisfaction /
  **NPS**
  – above benchmark
* Average waiting time – within defined thresholds
* Billing accuracy & leakage incidents – near zero
* Staff punctuality and SOP adherence – above benchmark
* **Doctor hiring, onboarding, and schedule adherence – zero gaps**
* **Doctor follow-up tracking – 100% patients contacted on time**
* **Clinical quality standards – zero preventable incidents**
* Optimal doctor utilization – minimal cancellations and maximum patient coverage

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5–7 years in healthcare operations (clinic network, hospital OPD, diagnostics).
* Graduation with MBA, MHA, or equivalent preferred.
* Proven track record in multi-disciplinary team management and operational delivery.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong ownership and execution discipline
* People leadership with firmness and empathy
* Doctor engagement and follow-up management
* Comfort with numbers, revenue, and cost monitoring
* Quality and compliance mindset
* Problem-solving ability in fast-paced operational environments
* Digital fluency for EMR, billing, and operational dashboard

title: Product Support Manager
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101978
  
  
**Position Overview**
Join Autodesk and be part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), a growing business focused on transforming how customers manage and operate physical assets and operations. AOS expands Autodesk’s Design and Make vision into the Operate phase, creating more connected, end-to-end solutions for customers.
  
  
You will lead our global off-hours Level 1 Product Support team across India and the Philippines. This is the group that picks up customer cases while North America is offline and sets the standard for how round-the-clock support works. You will be the person who establishes consistent operating practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build the off-hour operating process: build, implement and improve SOPs, and define what the team does when the queue is quiet. Plan to shift coverage and queue ownership, anticipate absences and capacity gaps, and maintain clear escalation coverage while protecting time for coaching and development.
* Hold the team accountable for volume and quality together: read a lot of case data quickly, decide what matters, and coach to quality rather than a metric wall.
* Own the handoffs with North America and EMEA: review cases firsthand and ensure each important handoff includes a named owner, customer/business impact, investigation already completed, next action, and next update commitment. Confirm that the receiving team accepts ownership and urgent issues reach the appropriate escalation of contact during the shift. Keep cases progressing within the team’s remit and escalate urgent issues through established coverage.
* Build relationships with account managers for our customers, keep a view of which accounts matter most among thousands, and bring them the trends you see.
* Find the patterns behind the volume and work with product and AI tooling to remove low-level cases at the source.
* Collaborate with Level 2 support, engineering, and support operations on process improvements and unlocking operational efficiencies.
* First 90 days: Understand each team member’s strengths and development needs, establish regular coaching, document coverage and handoffs, and implement an initial process of improvement.
* Within 6-12 months: The team follows documented processes without prompting, and each report has clear development and performance outcomes. Success is measured by dependable coverage, answer accuracy, appropriate prioritization, backlog aging, avoidable recontacts, and handoff reliability alongside volume, including verification of the quality of AI-assisted answers.
* During onboarding (first 3 months), you’ll work North American business hours (9am-5pm ET) for training. After onboarding, you’ll lead the off-hours team during the 11pm-7am ET shift, currently 8:30 AM-4:30 PM IST (this shifts by an hour when North America changes clocks). This coverage ensures urgent issues are escalated promptly, and European customers are supported. Hours may change with business needs, with reasonable notice.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Technical credibility: Investigate and resolve customer cases yourself, model strong troubleshooting, and coach specialists through difficult issues. Know when to involve L2 or Engineering and provide complete escalation. API fluency is strongly preferred.
* People leadership: Substantial experience managing experienced technical specialists in complex B2B software support. Run regular, tailored 1:1s with agreed actions and follow-ups, documented development goals, clear progression expectations, and timely, fair performance feedback.
* Accountability: Set clear expectations, address performance concerns promptly and fairly, and stay accountable for decisions you delegate.
* Independent judgment: Turn ambiguity into clear priorities and practical recommendations. Decide within your remit, raise risks early, and follow through without repeated direction.
* Process ownership: Spot the gap, build the fix, secure adoption, and verify that it improves the team’s experience and customer outcomes.
* Trust and influence: Earn credibility with veteran specialists and new hires, invite disagreement, and explain your decisions. Resolve competing priorities across Support, Engineering, Product, and CS using data. Give India- and Philippines-based reports equitable attention and development opportunities.
* Active use of AI and automation to improve analysis, documentation, and workflows. Be ready to show examples, how you checked quality, and the impact.
* Experience working in both large enterprises and startups is preferred.
* Experience managing a distributed technical support team, ideally approximately five to seven direct reports across countries or time zones.
* Hands-on experience building reports and working with a customer service platform, such as Zendesk
* Experience with workforce management, such as Assembled
* Experience with QA tooling, such as Intryc
* Experience with ticket escalation software, such as JIRA, Linear or Pluno AI

title: Manager - Dialer & Contact Center Technology
description:
**Role Purpose & Mandate**

The incumbent will serve as the central owner of the organization’s dialer infrastructure and governance, accountable for system reliability, operational efficiency and sales productivity. The role covers end-to-end dialer strategy, configuration, administration, performance monitoring, vendor management, systems integration and optimization across all business verticals.

The incumbent will partner with business stakeholders to improve agent connectivity, calling productivity, lead engagement and overall conversion.

**Overall Mandate:**
Own the organization’s dialer ecosystem end-to-end, ensuring technology reliability, operational efficiency, agent productivity and a scalable calling infrastructure that supports revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Dialer Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the complete dialer ecosystem across the organization and all business verticals.
* Develop and implement a centralised dialer strategy aligned with business requirements and sales objectives.
* Define dialer usage policies, calling protocols, access controls and operational governance.
* Evaluate capacity requirements based on business volumes, agent strength and calling demand.
* Standardized dialer processes and configurations across teams and locations.

**2. Configuration & Administration**

* Manage end-to-end configuration, including user creation, access management, campaign setup, routing, queues and calling rules.
* Manage Predictive, Progressive, Preview and Power dialling modes, wherever supported.
* Configure lead allocation, campaign prioritization, retry logic, disposition mapping and call-back scheduling.
* Ensure optimal utilization of calling infrastructure and available channels.
* Manage number allocation, caller ID configuration and number reputation.

**3. Systems Integration & Technology Management**

* Own dialer integrations with CRM, lead management systems, telephony infrastructure and other business applications.
* Ensure seamless synchronization of lead data, call logs, dispositions, recordings and follow-up activities.
* Partner with Technology and Engineering on API integrations, automation and system enhancements.
* Automate repetitive dialer-related activities and manual processes.
* Ensure real-time data availability and reporting accuracy across systems.

**4. Campaign & Lead Management**

* Design and optimize calling campaigns across business verticals.
* Prioritize campaigns by lead source, lead age, funnel stage and business priority.
* Implement automated follow-up, retry and call-back mechanisms.
* Ensure effective utilization of fresh, ageing, dormant and recycled leads.
* Develop calling strategies for each lead category and customer engagement stage.

**5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for dialer vendors and technology partners.
* Manage vendor performance, service-level agreements (SLAs), escalations and issue resolution.
* Conduct periodic vendor reviews to ensure uptime, reliability and service quality.
* Evaluate emerging dialer technologies and recommend solutions aligned to organizational needs.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, IT, CRM, Analytics and Compliance teams.

**6. Reporting, Analytics & Governance**

* Build centralized dialer performance dashboards and MIS, with daily, weekly and monthly reporting cadences.
* Analyze trends in connectivity, agent productivity, campaign performance and system utilization.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for low connectivity, system downtime and productivity gaps.
* Present actionable insights and recommendations to senior management.
* Establish governance mechanisms to track adherence to dialer policies and utilization standards.

**7. Compliance, Security & Business Continuity**

* Ensure compliance with applicable telecom regulations, data privacy requirements and organizational policies.
* Enforce access controls and secure handling of customer information.
* Maintain call recording, retention and audit mechanisms in line with company policy.
* Establish escalation processes and business continuity plans for dialer outages.
* Ensure timely resolution of critical system issues to minimize business disruption.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in dialer management, contact centre technology, telephony operations or sales operations.
* A minimum of 3–5 years managing large-scale dialer operations across multiple teams or business units.
* Strong working knowledge of dialer platforms such as Ameyo, Exotel, Knowlarity, Ozonetel, Genesys, Five9 or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience configuring Predictive, Progressive, Preview and Power dialler modes.
* Strong understanding of CRM and telephony integrations, APIs, webhooks and data synchronisation.
* Experience managing large agent populations and high-volume outbound calling operations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret dialer data and drive business interventions.
* Experience in vendor management, SLA governance and technology evaluation.
* Sound understanding of telecom compliance, data security and operational governance.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field.
* MBA or a relevant postgraduate qualification (preferred).
* Experience in EdTech, B2C sales, BFSI, inside sales or large-scale contact centre environment.

**Key Success Expectations:**

The incumbent will be expected to:

1. Establish centralized ownership and governance of the organization’s entire dialer ecosystem.
2. Ensure high system uptime and uninterrupted calling operations across business verticals.
3. Improve agent productivity, connectivity and dialer utilization through continuous optimization.
4. Build a scalable, standardized dialer infrastructure to support business growth.
5. Drive seamless integration between the dialer, CRM and other business systems.
6. Establish robust reporting, monitoring and escalation mechanisms.
7. Optimize technology and vendor costs while improving operational efficiency.
8. Equip business leaders with actionable dialer insights to improve sales execution and outcomes.

title: Senior Manager - Process Excellence
description:
**About River**

River is a design company building personal transportation for livelihood.

We focus on creating multi-utility products for those independently carving their own path. We’re building from the ground up, bringing together design, engineering and technology to solve real, everyday problems. Our signature two-wheeler, Indie – The SUV of Scooters, is built to be a dependable companion for getting things done.

Today, we’re 1,500+ people strong, headquartered in Bengaluru, and have raised our Series C.

River is backed by leading global automotive OEMs, international tech investors, and top institutional asset managers, including Yamaha Motor, Al-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Marubeni Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, Maniv Mobility, Elev8 Venture Partners, Claypond Capital, Trucks Venture Capital, 360 ONE Asset, HDFC AMC, Singularity AMC, Anicut Capital, and JIF Capital.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Process Excellence associates to deliver measurable business outcomes
- Allocate team resources across improvement projects, auditing schedules, and process mapping initiatives
- Build internal consulting capability by training team members on Lean, Six Sigma, and Value Stream Mapping (VSM) methodologies
- Identify operational bottlenecks, waste, and variation in plant operations, supply chain, and administrative workflows
- Design and deploy Lean Six Sigma frameworks (DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S, Poka-Yoke) to optimize yield, throughput, and cycle time
- Lead change management efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and practices, minimizing resistance and maximizing engagement
- Partner with cross-functional leadership (Factory Operations, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Product Design and Engineering) to implement high-impact Process Improvement initiatives
- Develop a structured qualification program encompassing various levels (e.g., Green Belt, Black Belt) to standardize process excellence competencies across the organization
- Oversee the end-to-end documentation of core manufacturing processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Value Stream Maps (AS-IS and TO-BE models)
- Establish governance frameworks to maintain standardized operational processes across multiple facilities or departments
- Drive digital transformation by facilitating integration of process automation and digital workflow tools into traditional manufacturing environments
- Work closely with stakeholders across departments to design and implement process changes that align with organizational goals
- Establish and manage an enterprise-wide Process Compliance Audit Framework to ensure adherence to internal standards & also support certification to external standards like ISO
- Conduct periodic process compliance audits, identify non-conformance root causes, and enforce Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans
- Deliver regular audit compliance scorecards and risk reports to executive leadership

**Ideal Candidate**

- Executive stakeholder management, team mentorship, analytical problem-solving, and change management expertise
- Advanced proficiency in creating and analyzing workflow design, mapping current vs. future states process, and identifying bottlenecks, waste, and friction points
- Ability to design, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices to ensure compliance and quality control
- Deep understanding of DMAIC frameworks, waste elimination (Muda, Mura, Muri), cycle-time reduction, and root-cause analysis
- Understanding of structured audit execution, compliance monitoring, and root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, A3 problem solving.)
- Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without formal authority
- Familiarity or hands-on experience in commercial functions like Sales, Marketing, Service, Dealer Development, Customer Service, Customer Experience is highly desirable.
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related discipline
- Strong domain expertise in Manufacturing or Automotive / OEM / Auto-Ancillary environments
- Demonstrated experience within commercial functions across industries like Automotive, CPG, FMCG, High-Tech is mandatory for this role
- Certifications as a Lean Practitioner, Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or Certified ISO Internal Auditor will be an added advantage

title: Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigor and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
GSK’s Global Supply Chain D&T team is the front facing business tech group supporting GSK’s critical business of Global Manufacturing across all product portfolios. The team comprises of multiple business tech disciplines from site specific D&T partnering through to above site and global services like Data & Analytics and Global Demand & Supply Planning processes.
  
  
The Team consists of a set of portfolio and business operations manager aligned to GSC D&T Towers and VPs. The team is responsible for defining as well as ensuring portfolio delivery processes, standards, reporting and governance are adhered to and understood by product owners and VPs across GSC D&T. The team is also responsible for the PMO delivery toolset and its maintenance.
  
  
In addition the team is accountable for business operations for each of the towers, in ensuring all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and driven with the respective GSC D&T LT members, VPs.
  
  
The Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager role is a key position for to setup and execute standards and processes on business operations for each of the GSC D&T Towers, to ensure all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and controlled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy and run a robust financial management service in close collaboration with the GSC D&T Finance Business Partner for the specific function.
* Keep the Tower's financial, headcount and contract plan integrated with the delivery plan, and manage the dependencies, risks and decisions that affect budget and supplier commitments.

Ensure finance and contract decisions use the same demand route and prioritisation criteria as portfolio management, and that every funded item links to strategy and OKRs.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant discipline.

* Experience managing Capex and Opex budgets valued in the millions of pounds or equivalent currency.
* Experience managing financial planning, budget allocation and cross-charging models.
* Experience managing vendors and commercial contracts.
* Experience managing supplier commitments, vendor risks, contract records and contract governance processes.
* Experience establishing and operating business operations, financial management or governance processes.

* Finance/accounting qualification, such as CIMA, ACCA or equivalent.

title: Inventory Manager
description:
Job Description – Inventory & Procurement Manager
  

**Department:**
Operations / Supply Chain

**Role:**
Inventory & Procurement Manager

**Location:**
Bangalore (with travel to properties across Bangalore, Pune, Mysore and Goa)

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Industry Preference:**
Hospitality / Hotels / Serviced Apartments

Role Overview
  

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Inventory & Procurement Manager to oversee the sourcing, procurement, allocation, and distribution of inventory across all our properties in Bangalore, Pune, Mysore, and Goa.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring that all properties receive their required inventory on a timely monthly basis, while maintaining optimal stock levels, controlling procurement costs, and ensuring consistency in quality.

A key responsibility of this role will be to establish and implement a structured inventory management system that provides complete visibility on stock requirements, procurement, dispatches, deliveries, and inventory status across all properties.

Key Responsibilities
  

**1. Inventory Planning & Procurement**

* Oversee end-to-end procurement of inventory required across all properties.
* Coordinate with property teams to understand monthly inventory requirements and forecast demand.
* Consolidate inventory requirements across locations to enable bulk purchasing and cost efficiencies.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable vendors and suppliers.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, quality standards, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure timely ordering and replenishment of inventory to avoid stock shortages or excess inventory.

**2. Inventory Distribution & Deployment**

* Plan and manage the monthly dispatch of inventory to all properties across Bangalore, Pune, Mysore, and Goa.
* Ensure inventory is appropriately allocated to each property based on its requirements and consumption patterns.
* Coordinate with vendors, transporters, warehouse teams, and property managers to ensure timely deliveries.
* Track all dispatches and ensure confirmation of receipt from respective properties.
* Resolve discrepancies relating to short deliveries, damaged goods, incorrect quantities, or delayed shipments.

**3. Inventory Tracking & Management Systems**

* Build and implement a centralised inventory tracking system for all properties.
* Maintain updated records of inventory ordered, received, stored, dispatched, and delivered.
* Develop standardised formats and processes for monthly inventory indenting, approvals, procurement, and dispatch.
* Establish a property-wise inventory tracker to monitor stock levels, consumption, pending requirements, and replenishment status.
* Create dashboards and regular MIS reports to provide management with visibility on inventory movement and procurement costs.
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency and accountability across all locations.

**4. Stock Control & Reconciliation**

* Monitor inventory levels across properties and ensure adequate stock availability.
* Track monthly consumption patterns and identify unusual variances or wastage.
* Conduct periodic stock audits and reconcile physical inventory against system records.
* Identify slow-moving, excess, obsolete, or underutilised inventory.
* Ensure appropriate inventory storage, handling, and accountability at each property.

**5. Vendor & Cost Management**

* Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships.
* Continuously identify new sourcing opportunities to improve quality and reduce costs.
* Compare vendor quotations and ensure competitive procurement.
* Monitor price fluctuations and market trends to make informed purchasing decisions.
* Ensure vendors meet agreed quality, quantity, and delivery commitments.

**6. Coordination & Reporting**

* Act as the central point of contact between the management team, vendors, and individual property teams for all inventory-related matters.
* Establish clear timelines and accountability for monthly inventory requirements and dispatches.
* Share periodic reports on procurement, inventory movement, pending deliveries, stock availability, and cost savings.
* Proactively identify operational gaps and recommend improvements in the inventory management process.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience
  

* Graduate or diploma in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, Logistics, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in inventory management, procurement, sourcing, or supply chain operations.
* Experience in hospitality, hotels, serviced apartments, retail, or multi-location operations will be preferred.
* Proven experience in vendor sourcing, price negotiation, purchase planning, and supplier management.
* Strong understanding of inventory control, stock reconciliation, procurement cycles, and logistics coordination.
* Experience in building and maintaining inventory tracking systems, MIS reports, and dashboards.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with inventory management or ERP software will be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage operations across geographically dispersed locations.
* Willingness to travel to properties across Bangalore, Pune, Mysore, and Goa as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

The performance of this role will be measured on:

1. **Timely Procurement:**
   Ensuring all inventory is ordered within defined monthly timelines.
2. **On-Time Deployment:**
   Ensuring monthly inventory reaches all properties as per the agreed dispatch schedule.
3. **Inventory Accuracy:**
   Maintaining accurate records of stock ordered, dispatched, received, and available.
4. **Cost Optimisation:**
   Achieving procurement efficiencies through vendor negotiations and consolidated purchasing.
5. **Stock Availability:**
   Minimising stock-outs and ensuring uninterrupted property operations.
6. **System Implementation:**
   Building and maintaining a centralised inventory tracking and reporting mechanism.
7. **Vendor Performance:**
   Maintaining quality standards and ensuring vendor adherence to agreed timelines.
8. **Reporting & Accountability:**
   Ensuring timely and accurate monthly inventory reports and reconciliations.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing end-to-end inventory operations across multiple locations.

The ideal candidate should be able to independently manage the entire inventory cycle—from understanding requirements and sourcing products to placing orders, coordinating monthly dispatches, tracking deliveries, and maintaining accurate inventory records.

Most importantly, the candidate should have the ability to
**build a structured, process-driven inventory management system from the ground up**
, rather than simply managing day-to-day purchasing activities.
