title: Manager, Stores
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

The Manager, Stores is accountable for the safe custody, accurate recording and timely supply of all materials in the factory: raw materials, components, packing materials, consumables, spares, tools and, where applicable, finished goods. The role ensures that production never waits for a material that should have been available, that system stock always matches physical stock, and that inventory is stored, handled and issued safely, in the right sequence and in compliance with statutory and audit requirements

**Key Accountabilities**

**Receiving and Inbound Control**

* Receive materials against valid PO, invoice and delivery challan; verify quantity, specification, batch/lot, expiry and condition of goods.
* Coordinate with Quality for incoming inspection and ensure materials are segregated (accepted, on hold, rejected) until cleared.
* Post GRNs in the ERP promptly and accurately.
* Raise shortage, excess, damage and wrong-supply reports and coordinate with Purchase and suppliers for resolution or return.
* Schedule vehicle unloading and manage dock/gate flow to avoid detention and congestion.

**Storage, Location Control and Material Preservation**

* Define and maintain storage layout, bin and rack locations, and a location-wise record of every item.
* Apply FIFO/FEFO strictly and ensure batch, lot and expiry traceability.
* Protect materials from damage, contamination, moisture, rust, pest and pilferage; arrange special storage for hazardous, high-value, temperature-sensitive and fragile items.
* Ensure clear labelling, identification tags, colour coding and status marking.
* Optimise space utilisation through layout improvement, racking and vertical storage.

**Issue and Supply to Production**

* Issue materials against approved requisitions, work orders or BOM-based pick lists in the right quantity, at the right time and to the right location.
* Support line-side replenishment systems (kanban, two-bin, milk-run) to reduce production waiting time.
* Ensure every issue, return and transfer is booked in the ERP on the same day.
* Control issue of consumables, tools and spares through authorised indents and consumption tracking.
* Handle returns of unused, excess or rejected material with proper documentation.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control**

* Maintain min, max, reorder and safety stock levels in coordination with Planning.
* Run daily/weekly cycle counts (A-class items most frequently) and the annual physical verification; investigate every variance and correct root causes.
* Reconcile stores records with ERP and Finance records at month end.
* Maintain accurate stock status for unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked and consignment stock.
* Prevent unauthorised movement of stock through gate pass and access controls.

**Replenishment and Shortage Management**

* Review stock against reorder levels daily and raise purchase requisitions on time.
* Share a daily/weekly critical shortage list with Planning, Purchase and Production.
* Work with Planning and Purchase to track in-transit materials and expedite urgent requirements.
* Provide early warning of potential line stoppages and maintain a record of shortage incidents with root causes.

**Slow-Moving, Obsolete and Scrap Management**

* Prepare monthly ageing and non-moving stock reports and review with Planning, Purchase and Finance.
* Drive actions for slow-moving and obsolete items: reuse, substitution, return to vendor, rework or disposal.
* Segregate, store and account for scrap and surplus; support scrap sales with proper weighment, documentation and approvals.
* Support write-off proposals with complete documentation and approvals.

**Dispatch, Outbound and Documentation (where applicable)**

* Plan picking, packing, labelling and loading of finished goods against dispatch schedules.
* Prepare dispatch documents: delivery challan, invoice copy, packing list, e-way bill, gate pass and lorry receipt, with the billing/logistics team.
* Ensure right product, right quantity, right packing and right documentation on every dispatch.
* Coordinate with Logistics for vehicle placement, loading supervision and proof of delivery.
* Manage returns and customer rejections: receipt, inspection coordination and credit documentation.

**Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Enforce safe stacking, load limits, fire safety, emergency access and safe handling of hazardous material.
* Ensure material handling equipment (forklifts, pallet trucks, cranes, stackers) is maintained, inspected and operated only by authorised, trained personnel.
* Implement 5S and visual management across all stores.
* Comply with statutory and regulatory requirements (factory rules, hazardous storage rules, GST documentation, environmental and fire norms).
* Investigate incidents and near misses and close corrective actions.

**Systems, Data Integrity and Reporting**

* Ensure timely and accurate ERP transactions: GRN, issue, transfer, return, scrap, stock adjustment.
* Maintain accurate material master data in coordination with Planning and IT (description, UoM, storage location, batch management).
* Deploy and improve barcode, RFID, WMS and other digital tools for traceability and accuracy.
* Publish daily, weekly and monthly MIS: stock status, GRN pending, shortages, ageing, accuracy, issue turnaround and safety.

**Audit Readiness, Cost Control and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain audit-ready records for internal, statutory, customer and certification audits (ISO, IATF, GMP, etc.); close audit observations on time.
* Control stores operating cost (manpower, equipment, packaging, handling losses, pilferage and shrinkage).
* Reduce handling damage, search time, double handling and material losses through Kaizen and lean tools.
* Standardise SOPs, work instructions and checklists for all stores activities.

**People Leadership and Team Development**

* Plan manpower and shifts to match inbound, issue and dispatch peaks.
* Set clear goals, review performance and coach store staff and supervisors.
* Train team members on ERP, material handling, safety, FIFO/FEFO and documentation discipline.
* Build backup and succession cover for critical roles; maintain discipline, engagement and ethical conduct.

**KPIs by KRA**

* The Stores and Warehouse function will be evaluated across 11 Key Result Areas (KRAs), with KPIs and indicative targets calibrated to the industry, plant maturity, and existing performance baseline.
* Receiving and Inbound Control will focus on completing Goods Receipt Note (GRN) postings within 24 hours, unloading vehicles within 2–3 hours, maintaining receiving accuracy of at least 99%,
* Reducing vehicle detention costs to zero or by 20% year-on-year, and reporting all material discrepancies to the Purchase team within 24 hours.

**Storage, Location Control and Material Preservation**

* Focus on maintaining at least 99% location accuracy, ensuring 100% FIFO/FEFO compliance, limiting expiry, damage, and deterioration losses to less than 0.2% of inventory value, maintaining space utilisation between 75% and 85%, and ensuring 100% proper labelling and material identification.
* Issue and Supply to Production will aim to fulfil material requisitions within 30–60 minutes, maintain issue accuracy of at least 99.5%, achieve zero production line stoppages due to delays in material issuance, ensure at least 99% of material issues and returns are posted in the ERP system on the same day, and maintain line-side stock adherence of at least 95%.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control**

* Focus on achieving overall inventory record accuracy of at least 98% and 99.5% for A-class items, completing 100% of planned cycle counts, keeping physical inventory variance below 0.1% of inventory value
* Closing discrepancies within three working days, and maintaining zero unauthorised stock movements. Replenishment and Shortage Management will require at least 98% of reorder alerts to be acted upon within one day, zero stock-out incidents for A-class items against active demand, daily shortage reporting to all relevant stakeholders, and safety stock compliance of at least 95%.

**Slow-Moving, Obsolete and Scrap Management**

* Aim to limit slow-moving and obsolete inventory to less than 2%–3% of total inventory, issue monthly ageing reports by the fifth of each month, achieve at least 90% of planned slow-moving and obsolete (SLOB) stock disposal, ensure 100% reconciliation of scrap generated, recorded, and sold, and maintain complete approvals and documentation for all write-offs.
* Dispatch, Outbound and Documentation, wherever applicable, will focus on achieving dispatch accuracy of at least 99.5%, on-time dispatch performance of at least 98%, 100% accuracy in invoices, e-way bills, and delivery challans, transit damage claims below 0.5% of dispatches, and processing customer returns within three to five working days.

**Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

Will aim for zero lost-time incidents and statutory violations, 100% closure of reported near-miss corrective actions within 15 days, a minimum 5S audit score of 90%, 100% compliance with material-handling equipment fitness requirements and operator training, and completion of all planned safety training.

**Systems, Data Integrity and Reporting**

Focus on achieving at least 98% timely ERP transaction posting, eliminating pending GRNs and unbilled receipts aged beyond seven days, maintaining master data accuracy of at least 98%, ensuring 100% on-time submission of daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, and achieving digital transaction adoption of 80% or above, subject to the approved project plan.

**Audit Readiness, Cost Control and Continuous Improvement**

Require zero major audit observations, closure of minor observations within 30 days, maintenance of stores operating costs within 2% of budget, control of shrinkage and pilferage to zero or below 0.05% of inventory value, completion of at least four measurable improvement projects annually, and 100% timely review and updating of SOPs.

**People Leadership and Team Development**

Focus on completing 100% of performance reviews on time, providing at least 20 training hours per team member annually, ensuring trained backups for at least 80% of critical roles, maintaining regretted attrition below 10%, and keeping absenteeism below 3% while ensuring zero major disciplinary cases.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, diploma in Materials Management or Logistics is an added advantage.
* **Experience:**
  10 to 14 years in stores, warehousing or materials management in a manufacturing set-up, with at least 3 to 5 years leading a stores team, Hands-on experience with ERP-based inventory transactions (SAP MM/WM, Oracle or similar), Exposure to audit-driven environments (ISO, IATF, GMP, FDA or customer audits) preferred.
* **Certifications (preferred):**
  Certification in Warehouse and Inventory Management (for example CPIM or equivalent), Lean/5S/Kaizen training, and industrial safety certification.

**Skills and Competencies**

**Technical skills**

* Inventory control: ABC/XYZ analysis, min/max, reorder point, cycle counting, stock reconciliation
* Warehouse operations: FIFO/FEFO, layout and slotting, material handling equipment
* ERP proficiency and barcode/RFID/WMS usage
* Documentation and statutory knowledge: GRN, delivery challan, GST invoicing, e-way bill, gate pass
* Hazardous material storage and industrial safety standards
* 5S, lean, Kaizen and root cause analysis (5 Why, fishbone)
* Excel and MIS reporting

**Behavioural competencies**

* Integrity and strong control mindset
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Ownership, accountability and urgency in supporting production
* Cross-functional coordination and communication
* Team leadership, coaching and discipline
* Problem solving under pressure

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

* By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Manager - Trust Operations, Outreach & Partnerships
description:
**Company Description**
Manjunatha Nethralaya is a boutique ophthalmology hospital located in T. Dasarahalli, Bengaluru, serving the community with specialized eye care since 2016. The hospital focuses on providing personalized, high-quality clinical services in a close-knit, patient-centered environment. Under new leadership by a Managing Director, the organization is in a phase of growth and operational strengthening. Team members have the opportunity to contribute to building robust processes, community outreach, and long-term partnerships in the eye care sector.

**Role Description**
HITHASHI – CAREER OPPORTUNITY

Designation: Manager – Trust Operations, Outreach & Partnerships

Location: Bengaluru

Employment: Full-time

Experience: 4–7 years

Salary: ₹45,000–₹60,000 per month (negotiable based on experience and capabilities)

Reporting to: Board of Trustees / Management

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hithashi is looking for a dynamic, socially committed and result-oriented professional to coordinate its trust activities, strengthen community engagement, develop institutional partnerships and support fundraising initiatives.

The candidate will act as a bridge between the Board of Trustees, Centre Manager, marketing team, community organisations, donors and corporate partners, contributing to the growth and long-term sustainability of Hithashi.

KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Trust Administration and Documentation

• Maintain trust-related documentation and records.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual activity reports.

• Document programmes, patient beneficiaries and social impact.

• Coordinate with relevant professionals for statutory documentation and compliance requirements.

2. Strategic Planning, Camps and Networking

• Develop an annual calendar of community outreach activities.

• Strategise and coordinate healthcare camps and awareness programmes.

• Establish relationships with healthcare professionals, NGOs, Rotary Clubs, community associations and other institutions.

• Monitor the effectiveness and outcomes of outreach programmes.

• Identify new opportunities to expand the reach of Hithashi.

3. Fundraising and Donor Engagement

• Develop and implement fundraising strategies.

• Identify prospective individual and institutional donors.

• Organise fundraising campaigns and events.

• Maintain donor relationships and communicate the impact of their contributions.

• Develop sustainable funding opportunities for the trust.

4. Marketing and Promotion of Hithashi

• Work closely with the marketing team to improve the visibility of Hithashi.

• Support the development of promotional materials, patient stories and awareness campaigns, with appropriate consent.

• Identify opportunities for institutional collaborations.

• Represent Hithashi at networking meetings and public events.

• Strengthen the public image and community awareness of Hithashi.

5. Board Meeting Coordination

• Organise and facilitate Board of Trustees meetings.

• Prepare meeting agendas, presentations and activity reports.

• Record minutes of meetings and maintain relevant documentation.

• Follow up on decisions and action points arising from board meetings.

• Periodically update the Board on activities and achievements.

6. Centre Coordination and Patient Follow-ups

• Coordinate with the Centre Manager regarding patient follow-ups.

• Monitor beneficiary engagement and continuity of services.

• Identify operational gaps and bring them to the attention of management.

• Maintain periodic reports on patient outreach and follow-up outcomes while ensuring patient confidentiality.

7. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)

• Identify potential corporate CSR partners.

• Prepare CSR appeals, project proposals and funding presentations.

• Establish relationships with corporate CSR teams and foundations.

• Coordinate donor reporting, fund utilisation documentation and impact assessments.

• Explore opportunities for long-term CSR partnerships.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

• MSW – Master of Social Work

• MBA – Healthcare, Marketing or General Management

• MHA – Master of Hospital Administration

• Graduate or postgraduate in Social Sciences, Public Health or related disciplines

Candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered.

DESIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in Kannada and English.

• Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.

• Report writing and presentation skills.

• Understanding of NGO operations and CSR funding.

• Fundraising and institutional relationship management.

• Ability to independently plan and execute programmes.

• Working knowledge of digital tools and Microsoft Office.

• Willingness to travel for outreach activities and stakeholder meetings.

PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE

A professional with prior experience in charitable trusts, NGOs, healthcare organisations, CSR programmes, community development or institutional fundraising.

The candidate should demonstrate initiative, accountability, organisational capabilities and a genuine interest in contributing to social welfare.

COMPENSATION

Annual gross salary: ₹5.4–7.2 lakh.

Salary is negotiable based on qualifications, experience, professional networks and demonstrated capabilities.

Performance-linked incentives may be considered based on the achievement of agreed organisational objectives.

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates may share their updated résumé along with the following details:

• Total years of experience

• Current organisation

• Current compensation

• Expected compensation

• Notice period

* Join Hithashi in creating meaningful and sustainable social impact.

title: Distribution Planner Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: DRP Leader**
**Location : Bangalore, India**
**Role Type: Permanent**
**Join our Supply Team**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About This Role**
The
**Distribution Requirements Planner’s (DRP) Leader**
primary role is to lead a team of DRP located across APAC, enabling smooth DRP operations and the team to deliver service, cash, cost, SLOB and capability.
  
  
The role also drives a strong team culture, develops planning capabilities, and builds a high-performing planning organization.
  
  
Given the long end-to-end supply cycle, the role is critical in driving robust demand planning, market accountability and proactive risk management. The Planning Leader will establish clear ways of working across inbound and outbound planning, drive root cause analysis of demand and supply variances, challenge assumptions, and ensure risks and misses are communicated early with clear mitigation actions and ownership.
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.
* Ensure Supply Planning systems and processes in place are aligned to global supply planning standards.
* Delivery of optimal supply network plan to meet customer service OTIFNE targets and drive Diageo inventory performance to level of top 3 CPG companies.
* Own appropriate inventory policies in partnership with markets to deliver upon agreed business targets.
* Represent Supply in leading S&OP process, balancing demand and supply signals whilst ensuring strategy and annual targets can be delivered.
* Lead and embed continuous improvement agenda across wider supply planning team enabling effective delivery of performance improvement plans prioritised by business targets. Including customer service and inventory targets.
* Track progress of performance improvement plans and course correct to consistently ensure projected benefits are achieved.
* Address any supply disruption or conflict situation through consensus solution or recommendation for escalation.
* Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need**

* 5 years + Supply Chain planning experience in CPG (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, SMR, Logistics).
* Additionally, some wider cross functional experience preferable e.g. commercial, finance or supply.
* Exceptional systems experience within supply chain optimisation platforms (ERP / master data, time-phased replenishment planning systems, SAP, APO,OMP).
* Understand, implement and sustain global supply planning codification agenda.
* Detailed understanding of end-to-end supply chain operational processes e.g. DRP, MPS, inventory, conversion, logistics and customer service.
* Exceptional influencing and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to challenge senior stakeholders and manage tension in demand/supply and S&OP conversations.
* Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and presentation.
* Customer centric mind set.
* Numerate with statistical, and analytical skills and attention to detail.
* High degree of quantitative and analytical skills.
* Proficient in MS applications e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access.

**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to success in our business and many of our staff work flexibly in many ways, including part-time, compressed hours, flexible location. Please talk to us about what flexibility means to you and don’t let anything stop you from applying.
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
***Recruitment Scam Warning***
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
Mandatory Responsibilities
  
  
People Management & Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and manage engineers, technicians, contractors, and/or lab support personnel.
* Drive resource allocation across qualification and reliability activities.
* Establish clear priorities and execution ownership.
* Monitor team workload, utilization, and productivity.
* Coach, mentor, and develop technical and operational capabilities within the team.
* Conduct performance discussions, goal setting, and career development planning.

**Lab Operations & Execution**

* Own day-to-day operation of Reliability & Qualification Labs.
* Ensure uninterrupted execution of qualification, characterization, and reliability activities.
* Drive lab utilization, scheduling, and execution prioritization across programs.
* Monitor execution bottlenecks and proactively escalate risks impacting project milestones.

Qualification Planning & Tracking
  
  

* Create and maintain qualification execution plans.
* Ensure sample availability, test readiness, resource availability, and schedule adherence.
* Coordinate qualification priorities across multiple programs and stakeholders.
* Track qualification deliverables and closure.

Equipment & Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Manage lab equipment availability, uptime, and utilization.
* Own calibration planning and compliance for all reliability equipment.
* Drive preventive maintenance and service schedules.
* Ensure lab readiness for new qualification requirements.

Inventory & Asset Management
  
  

* Manage consumables, sockets, fixtures, boards, adapters, and spare parts inventory.
* Monitor inventory levels and prevent qualification delays due to shortages.
* Maintain asset records and equipment tracking.

Automation & Test Infrastructure
  
  

* Support automation execution and issue resolution.
* Coordinate automation setup, deployment, validation, and maintenance.
* Work with development teams to resolve infrastructure and automation blockers.
* Ensure test automation readiness for qualification programs.

Lab IT & System Support
  
  

* Coordinate resolution of lab network, system, server, storage, and software issues.
* Drive closure of IT tickets impacting qualification execution.
* Manage access permissions, licenses, and infrastructure dependencies.
* Maintain operational continuity of data collection and reporting systems.

Resource Allocation & Capacity Management
  
  

* Plan technician and engineer assignments.
* Optimize resource utilization across projects.
* Support capacity forecasting for upcoming qualification demand.
* Identify staffing and infrastructure gaps.

Program Risk Management
  
  

* Highlight risks that can impact qualification schedules.
* Develop mitigation plans for equipment, resource, infrastructure, or execution constraints.
* Provide regular execution health and readiness status to management.
* Escalate critical blockers with recommended actions.

Lab Compliance & Audit Readiness
  
  

* Ensure compliance with ISO/IATF, ESD, safety, and internal quality requirements.
* Maintain calibration, maintenance, and execution records.
* Support internal and external audits.

Process Standardization
  
  

* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Drive continuous improvement of lab workflows.
* Implement best practices for execution consistency.

Metrics & Reporting
  
  

* Publish lab KPIs such as:

+ Equipment utilization
+ Qualification throughput
+ On-time execution
+ Calibration compliance
+ Automation coverage
+ Resource loading

* Provide management dashboards and status reports.

Training & Team Development
  
  

* Train engineers and technicians on lab processes and equipment.
* Develop operational knowledge continuity.
* Act as technical focal point for lab operations.

Good-to-Have Responsibilities
  
  
Budget & Financial Planning
  
  

* Support annual lab budget planning.
* Track lab operational expenses.
* Forecast capital equipment requirements.
* Optimize spending through resource sharing and efficiency improvements.

Procurement & Vendor Management
  
  

* Drive procurement of equipment, spares, consumables, and software licenses.
* Coordinate with suppliers for maintenance, calibration, and repairs.
* Support vendor qualification and service agreements.

Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.
  
  
Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Head of Production
description:
**Company Description**
Panigrahana Weddings specializes in end-to-end wedding solutions, backed by over a decade of experience in the wedding industry. The team manages all key services in-house, including mehendi design, bridal makeup, hair and saree draping, photography, videography, catering, entertainment, decor, guest management, transportation, invites, and gifting. **Role Description**
The Head of Production is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for overseeing the end-to-end production of multiple wedding events. This role involves planning event schedules, managing production workflows, coordinating with in-house vendors, and ensuring timely execution of all services on the wedding day. title: Senior Manager Program Management - Audit Operations
description:
**Company Introduction**

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

**About the Team**

The Audit Intelligence organization serves as the discovery engine supporting Pricing Audit, Pricing Operations, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Business organizations. Its mission is to continuously identify where customers are underserved, where competitiveness is weakening, where growth opportunities exist, and where emerging risks require intervention. The organization combines AI agents, analytics, operational expertise, audit principles, and market intelligence to provide proactive visibility into the future rather than retrospective explanations of the past.

**Role Overview**

As Senior Manager, you will lead an elite intelligence function tasked with delivering forward-looking clarity across customer outcomes, commercial performance, and competitive strategy. You will steer cross-functional teams building AI-powered intelligence platforms, automated defect detection engines, and executive decision-support mechanisms. This role demands strategic leadership, deep technical fluency, and strong organizational influence to drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Pricing Operations, and Business leadership.

**Why This Role Matters**

* Operational teams focus on execution.
* Audit teams focus on validation.
* This organization focuses on discovery.
* Your team will identify the opportunities, risks, and blind spots that neither operations nor audits have yet recognised.
* The intelligence generated by your team will directly influence pricing strategies, audit priorities, operational investments, product roadmaps, and customer trust initiatives.

**What You Will Do**

**Lead Customer Intelligence Strategy**

You will establish a comprehensive intelligence framework that evaluates the health of customer pricing outcomes.

Examples include monitoring customer pricing trust, identifying Blue Badge Trust vulnerabilities, evaluating price sharpness opportunities, analysing customer conversion impacts, and identifying emerging customer experience risks tied to pricing decisions.

**Lead Commercial Intelligence Strategy**

You will oversee systems designed to identify business growth opportunities and selection performance improvements.

Examples include key selection opportunity detection, underserved category identification, seasonal demand opportunities, new selection prioritization, tail-of-tail performance optimization, and high-potential category expansion.

**Lead Market Intelligence Strategy**

You will establish capabilities that continuously evaluate external market dynamics and competitive positioning.

Examples include competitiveness monitoring, comparative rank competitiveness evaluations, competitor pricing analysis, market-share risk identification, promotional activity intelligence, and emerging competitor threat assessments.

**Build Human + AI Operating Models**

You will architect hybrid human-AI operating models that combine autonomous monitoring agents, LLM-powered audit workflows, automated task routing, and analyst validation.

Examples include autonomous opportunity discovery systems, AI-assisted audit workflows, automated task-room generation, GPT-enabled reporting systems, and agent-driven escalation frameworks.

**Create Decision Intelligence for Leadership**

You will ensure executives have visibility into emerging risks and opportunities through proactive intelligence products.

Examples include weekly competitiveness reviews, customer trust risk summaries, growth opportunity reports, market intelligence briefings, and strategic pricing health dashboards.

**Influence Organizational Strategy**

You will regularly engage with Directors and Vice Presidents across Pricing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Audit, Retail, Marketplace, and Business organizations.

You will help determine where resources should be allocated, which opportunities deserve prioritization, and where risks require immediate action.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in Analytics, Pricing, Strategy, Marketplace Operations, Product, Operations Excellence, Audit, Data Science, or related functions.
* 3+ years leading teams.
* Experience managing cross-functional programs.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and organizational leadership capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AI-enabled intelligence or automation experience.
* Marketplace or e-commerce domain expertise.
* Product, Engineering, or Applied Science partnership experience.
* Executive communication experience.
* Experience building new organizational capabilities.

**Type of work model**

* Hybrid

Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.

**Details to consider**

* Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.

**Privacy Notice**

* Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

title: Senior Manager - Fulfilment Planning
description:
**About Hector Beverages Pvt. Ltd.**

Established in 2010 in India, Hector Beverages rose to prominence with its signature brand, the Paper Boat, a ready-to-drink beverage that encapsulates the essence of traditional Indian flavors. The inception of Hector Beverages was driven by the founders' vision to bridge the market void for traditional Indian drinks and to present the world with a taste of India's rich cultural beverages.

**Location**

Headquartered in Whitefield, Bengaluru

**Current Standings**

Over the past decade, Hector Beverages has expanded its product line to include fruit juices, coconut water, and iconic Indian beverages such as Aam panna and Jal-jeera and foods & dry fruits which includes products such as Chikki, Aam Papad, range of raw, roasted, and flavored dry fruits that includes mix of nuts, berries & seeds. The brand is synonymous with distinctive flavors and premium ingredients. Furthermore, the firm's commitment to quality and innovation is evidenced by its extensive infrastructure of nine dedicated factories (and counting) for Paper Boat products, providing direct employment to approximately 900 individuals and indirect employment to another 2000

**Organizational Culture**

At its core, Hector Beverages thrives on a culture rooted in innovation, creativity, and collaboration. The company's flat organizational structure promotes open dialogue, empowering employees to lead their projects passionately. Hector Beverages is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. The organization is dedicated to fostering high-performing teams. Moreover, the culture of celebrating both minor and major achievements, nurture a motivated and committed workforce, driving exponential growth.

**Role purpose**

Own fulfilment planning across General Trade and Quick Commerce.

The role will be responsible for developing channel-specific fulfilment strategies, optimising service levels and cost-to-serve, and co-owning network design with Supply Planning. The role will have a special focus on building and strengthening Quick Commerce planning capabilities. It will also support the broader IBP process and drive the tech enablement and automation of fulfilment planning solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong fulfilment and network-planning fundamentals with analytical rigour, cross-functional influence and the ability to build scalable planning processes.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Channel Fulfilment Strategy and Planning**

* Own fulfilment planning across General Trade and Quick Commerce, developing differentiated strategies to address their distinct operating and service requirements.
* Build and strengthen Quick Commerce planning capabilities, including demand-to-fulfilment translation, inventory positioning, replenishment and inventory availability planning.
* Own channel service-level objectives, monitor performance and drive corrective actions.
* Optimise end-to-end cost-to-serve while balancing service, inventory availability, operational efficiency and working capital.
* Translate channel demand and business priorities into fulfilment requirements.
* Establish robust mechanisms to identify and manage fulfilment risks, inventory imbalances, supply constraints and service exceptions.

**2. Network Design and Optimisation**

* Co-own end-to-end supply chain network design with Supply Planning, ensuring alignment between channel requirements, manufacturing capabilities, capacity and distribution infrastructure.
* Evaluate factory-to-CFA allocation, distribution network configuration, fulfilment-node requirements and inventory positioning.
* Develop network scenarios and business cases to support growth, service improvement and cost optimisation.
* Evaluate network changes based on end-to-end cost, service, capacity, inventory and working capital implications.

**3. Fulfilment Tech, Automation and Transformation**

* Act as the business product owner for planning technology fulfilment solutions, both internally developed and externally procured.
* Identify opportunities to automate planning processes, improve data visibility and strengthen decision-making.
* Translate business requirements into product specifications, functional requirements and solution priorities.
* Partner with Technology, Data and external solution providers through solution design, development, testing and deployment.
* Drive user adoption, process integration and continuous improvement of planning solutions.
* Establish measurable business benefits for technology initiatives, including improvements in planning productivity, service, cost and visibility.

**4. Integrated Business Planning Support**

* Support the leadership in running the integrated planning process and associated review forums.
* Own the preparation and quality of fulfilment-related inputs for IBP, including service performance, inventory position, channel requirements, cost-to-serve and fulfilment constraints.
* Identify gaps between demand, available supply, inventory and fulfilment capacity.
* Develop scenarios and recommendations to address service, cost, capacity and inventory trade-offs.
* Coordinate with Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement and Sales/category teams to iron out gaps.
* Track fulfilment-related decisions, actions, risks and dependencies arising from IBP reviews.
* Support the development of a forward-looking view of fulfilment readiness against business growth plans.

**Candidate profile**

* Approximately 2–5 years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, fulfilment planning, inventory planning, network planning or related roles.
* Strong experience in Quick Commerce or e-commerce fulfilment and/or inventory planning environments; experience in FMCG is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in inventory deployment, replenishment, multi-node fulfilment and service-level management.
* Understanding of distribution network design, logistics economics and cost-to-serve optimisation.
* Experience in cross-functional planning processes, S&OP or IBP is desirable.
* Experience in product management of fulfilment technology solutions, planning automation or supply chain transformation is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with large datasets and translate analysis into business decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and build processes where established systems may not yet exist.

**Leadership attributes**

* Ability to handle complexity and learnability.
* Analytical rigour and fact-based decision-making.
* Collaborative approach with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Technology-first mindset.

title: Assistant Facilities Manager - India
description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.Sr Facilities Project Manager - IND SummaryThe Assistant Facilities Manager (Sr. Facilities Project Manager) is responsible for ensuring seamless day-to-day workplace operations and delivering an exceptional employee experience through effective management of facilities services, workplace operations, vendor performance, compliance programs, employee transportation, hospitality services, and office administration.The role oversees janitorial services, asset lifecycle management, facilities and asset maintenance, employee transport, cafeteria and pantry operations, landlord and WeWork relationships, security, housekeeping, office administration, workplace events, statutory compliance, and facilities budget management. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong ownership, flexibility, customer focus, operational discipline, responsiveness, and a high sense of urgency in addressing critical workplace matters.Key ResponsibilitiesFacilities Operations & Maintenance Manage day-to-day facilities operations to maintain a safe, reliable, efficient, and productive workplace. Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance for office infrastructure, utilities, equipment, and workplace assets. Manage work requests from logging through completion, ensuring timely resolution, documentation, and closure against agreed service levels. Conduct routine facility inspections, identify risks or service gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with vendors, landlords, and internal partners. Coordinate minor projects, office moves, repairs, installations, and workplace modifications while minimizing business disruption.Asset Lifecycle Management Manage the asset lifecycle, including procurement coordination, tagging, inventory, allocation, transfer, maintenance, reconciliation, and disposal. Maintain accurate asset registers and supporting documentation, and coordinate periodic physical verification and audits. Monitor asset condition, utilization, and maintenance history to support reliability, replacement planning, and cost-effective lifecycle decisions.Housekeeping, Janitorial & Pest Control Oversee housekeeping, janitorial, waste management, washroom hygiene, and pest-control services. Maintain consistent workplace cleanliness and hygiene standards through scheduled audits, inspections, and corrective-action follow-up. Monitor vendor staffing, consumables, equipment, service quality, and performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.Security Operations Oversee contract security services, access control, visitor management, key management, and incident reporting. Coordinate emergency response readiness and support investigations and resolution of security-related incidents. Ensure security operations align with company standards, landlord requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations.Employee Transport Services Manage employee transport operations, vendors, routes, rosters, service delivery, escalations, and performance reviews. Monitor transport safety, vehicle and driver compliance, route efficiency, service reliability, and employee experience. Ensure applicable employee transportation and women-safety requirements are implemented, documented, and periodically reviewed. Respond promptly to transport disruptions and incidents, coordinate communication, and drive preventive actions.Cafeteria & Pantry Operations Oversee cafeteria, food-service, and pantry operations, including vendor coordination, hygiene, service quality, and inventory availability. Monitor food safety practices, statutory documentation, employee feedback, and corrective actions. Support menu planning, service improvements, responsible consumption, and waste-reduction initiatives.Vendor, Landlord & WeWork Contract Oversight Manage day-to-day relationships with landlords, building management, WeWork representatives, and facilities service providers. Administer service scopes, contracts, SLAs, KPIs, purchase orders, renewals, and commercial documentation in partnership with relevant functions. Conduct structured vendor governance reviews, document performance gaps, and follow through on improvement plans. Monitor landlord and workspace-provider obligations and escalate operational, contractual, or compliance risks appropriately.Office Administration & Logistics Oversee office administration, workplace readiness, seating support, employee onboarding setup, meeting and common-area readiness, and general office services. Manage stationery and office-supply procurement, stock controls, issue records, and replenishment. Coordinate courier, mailroom, shipment, and logistics activities, including tracking, documentation, and timely delivery. Maintain organized records for services, vendors, assets, incidents, invoices, permits, and audits.Workplace Experience & Events Support the Fun Committee and partner with HR and business stakeholders on employee engagement activities. Coordinate office celebrations, cultural events, town halls, wellness programs, and other workplace initiatives. Manage end-to-end logistics for events held in the office or at external venues, including vendor coordination, safety requirements, schedules, and budget controls.Budget & Financial Management Support preparation and management of the annual facilities operating budget and periodic forecasts. Track commitments and actual expenditure, review vendor invoices, monitor purchase orders, and support accruals and variance analysis. Identify cost-efficiency and process-improvement opportunities without compromising safety, compliance, service quality, or employee experience. Maintain financial discipline, approval documentation, and timely reporting for facilities-related expenditure.Compliance, Health, Safety & Risk Ensure facilities operations comply with applicable Karnataka Government requirements and relevant building, fire, safety, environmental, labor, food-service, transport, security, and statutory obligations. Maintain current licenses, permits, certificates, inspection records, statutory registers, and compliance evidence within the role scope. Coordinate internal and external audits, inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and closure tracking. Support emergency preparedness, incident response, business continuity, and periodic drills. Escalate compliance gaps and critical risks promptly and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Minimum 6 years of progressive experience in facilities management, workplace operations, corporate services, hospitality operations, property management, or a related field. Hands-on experience managing multiple facilities service vendors in a corporate office environment. Experience in maintenance coordination, asset management, transport operations, food services, security, housekeeping, office administration, budget tracking, and statutory compliance is strongly preferred. Facilities Management, EHS, fire safety, food safety, project management, or related professional certification will be an advantage.Required CompetenciesTechnical Competencies Integrated facilities and workplace operations Preventive and corrective maintenance coordination Asset lifecycle and inventory management Vendor, SLA, KPI, and contract administration Employee transport, security, housekeeping, cafeteria, and pantry operations Budget tracking, cost control, invoice review, and forecasting support Statutory compliance, audit coordination, risk management, and incident response Work-order, service-request, and facilities data management Workplace events, administration, logistics, and stakeholder supportBehavioral Competencies Strong ownership, accountability, and service orientation High responsiveness and a strong sense of urgency for critical matters Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and calm decision-making under pressure Clear written and verbal communication Strong vendor and stakeholder management Ability to prioritize multiple operational demands and follow through to closure Attention to detail, documentation discipline, and continuous-improvement mindset Collaborative, hands-on, and willing to support both planned work and urgent operational needsCritical Role Expectations Flexibility to work outside regular business hours when operations, events, emergencies, or business needs require support. Availability to respond promptly to critical facilities incidents, transport disruptions, safety concerns, and workplace escalations. Proactive identification and escalation of operational, compliance, service, and financial risks. Ability to balance hands-on service delivery with vendor governance, reporting, planning, and stakeholder communication. Consistent professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and customer focus.We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. title: GCC Quality Leader
description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a diversity of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with 96,000 other curious, creative 3Mers.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
**Responsibilities**
The Quality GCC Operations Leader is responsible for leading the establishment, transition, and ongoing execution of Quality services within the India Global Capability Center. This role provides operational leadership across multiple Quality workstreams, including Supplier PPAP / SPQP support, Plant SCAR Management, DFM Quality Deliverable Approval for CBG NPIs, Statistical Support, QMS Virtual Audits, 3rd Party Manufacturing SCAR Management, and Quality Training Management. The leader will be accountable for building team capability, ensuring process discipline, driving operational performance, managing stakeholder relationships, and enabling consistent, compliant, and efficient Quality service delivery across global and regional business needs. Your key responsibilities would be:
  
  
  

* Leading the GCC Quality team across transitioned workstreams, ensuring effective execution of PPAP / SPQP, SCAR management, NPI Quality deliverable review, statistical support, virtual audits, 3rd party manufacturing quality support, and Quality training administration.
* Establishing a standardized operating model for GCC Quality services, including role clarity, work intake, prioritization, service expectations, escalation paths, governance routines, and performance reporting.
* Partnering with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Business Group, Plant, NPI, QMS, and Supplier Quality stakeholders to ensure transitioned work is performed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with 3M Quality requirements.
* Driving successful transition execution from current-state teams to the GCC, including staffing readiness, knowledge transfer coordination, capability validation, go-live readiness, stabilization, and continuous improvement.
* Ensuring GCC Quality processes remain compliant, audit-ready, and aligned with applicable Quality Management System requirements, industry standards, customer expectations, and internal procedures.
* Monitoring operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and governance reviews, while proactively addressing performance gaps, stakeholder concerns, process risks, and resourcing constraints.
* Building and developing the GCC Quality team by coaching employees, strengthening technical capability, supporting career development, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement.

**Your Skills And Expertise**
**To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Statistics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related technical field.
* Overall 12+ years of professional experience, including leadership experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, Quality Systems, New Product Introduction (NPI) Quality, Operational Excellence, or Shared Services teams.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems and quality tools, including corrective action, root cause analysis, audit practices, process capability, risk management, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working with cross-functional and global stakeholders across business groups, plants, suppliers, engineering, operations, and corporate functions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead process transitions, service delivery operations, standardization efforts, or capability buildout in a global or matrixed environment.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach teams, manage priorities, influence stakeholders, resolve escalations, and drive accountability.

**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**

* Experience with one or more of the following Quality areas: APQP, PPAP, SPQP, SCAR, supplier management, QMS auditing, ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100, NPI Quality deliverables, statistical analysis, Six Sigma, training administration, or LMS support.
* Experience standing up or leading work in a Global Capability Center, shared services organization, center of excellence, or centralized service delivery model.
* Experience managing quality operations across multiple regions, countries, business groups, or manufacturing locations.
* Experience using quality, supplier, audit, training, analytics, or reporting systems.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ, Lead Auditor, Quality Engineering, or similar certification.
* Experience creating or improving standard work, governance models, dashboards, operating rhythms, and service-level performance management.

title: Assistant Manager- Apparel Outsourcing
description:

**About Bene kleed**

Bene kleed is a fast-growing fashion and lifestyle brand creating trend-first apparel for India's next generation. We believe in speed, ownership, and execution. If you're someone who enjoys working closely with manufacturing partners and ensuring products move from factory to warehouse seamlessly, we'd love to meet you.

Follow up on fabric, trims, approvals, and production readiness with internal teams.

Coordinate with Merchandising, Quality, Warehouse, and Planning teams for smooth execution.

Ensure production quality standards are maintained and work closely with QA teams to reduce rejections.

Monitor vendor performance on quality, delivery, and compliance.

Identify production risks early and drive corrective actions to avoid delays.

Prepare daily and weekly production MIS and share updates with management.

Support vendor negotiations for better efficiency and cost optimization.

Ensure timely dispatches from factories to warehouses.

3–5 years of experience in Apparel Production or Outsourcing.

Experience handling external garment manufacturing vendors.

Strong understanding of garment manufacturing processes.

Good knowledge of production planning and T&A management.

Experience working with woven and/or knit garments.

Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

Good negotiation and vendor management abilities.

Comfortable traveling to vendor factories whenever required.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel and production reporting.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

Experience working with fashion, retail, or D2C brands.

Exposure to multiple vendor management.

Familiarity with ERP or production management systems.

Success in This Role

**You'll be successful if you can:**

Deliver production on time without compromising quality.

Build strong relationships with vendor partners.

Reduce production delays through proactive follow-ups.

Improve vendor accountability and operational efficiency.

Keep stakeholders updated with accurate production MIS.

**Why Join Bene kleed?**

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing fashion brand.

High ownership and decision-making exposure.

Collaborative and execution-driven culture.

Work closely with cross-functional teams and manufacturing partners.

Build a strong career in apparel sourcing and production.

title: Unified Support Services Functional Excellence Leader
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Functional Excellence Leader (U6. USS Functional Excellence)**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. Fueled by a US$1.5+B investment in technology and innovation, EY is primed to guide clients in their efforts to drive sustainable growth, create new value, and build new and better ways of working. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY’s global enterprise technology group provides various enabling services (ERP, infrastructure, platforms, service desk) to assist over 300K employees in creating and delivering solutions and services to Fortune 500, privately held and government like entities.
  
  
The USS Functional Excellence (FE) leader will be an experienced senior operations leader who will play a crucial role providing comprehensive operational support to the USS Global, Areas and Regional leaders to manage the delivery of the integrated Onsite Support Services (OSTS) and Service Desk (SD) services across EY. The candidate will be responsible for managing approximately 38 professionals and overseeing five distinct sub-functions within USS Functional Excellence. This pivotal role requires a strategic thinker with an operational mindset who can ensure that all the sub-functions operate cohesively and effectively support the USS objectives. The function will be responsible for a range of operational activities, including Reporting & Analytics, managing Vendor SLAs & Vendor relationships, spearheading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Product Management, administering End User IT Support Knowledge Management, overseeing Transition Management, and conducting Asset Management activities.
  
  
EY is seeking a forward-thinking IT executive to design, build and transform this newly envisioned group.
  
  
This executive must:
  
  

* Lead and create a customer-centric culture that focuses on innovative and best-in-class customer service design and execution
* Serve as an innovative inspiring leader to align technology solutions with customer needs to deliver an integrated customer experience
* Is responsible for best-in-class service solutions that exceed organization and customer needs and expectations
* Effectively operate in a complex global organization, collaborating with a global customer and partner groups
* Assemble and lead a high performing team with a laser focus on exceptional customer service and promotes an inclusive and mentoring culture

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive strategy to deliver operational support to the Unified Support Services (integrated OSTS & Service Desk) Global, Area and Regional leaders.
* Assemble, lead and mentor a team of professionals dedicated to operational excellence.
* Oversee and advise the Reporting & Analytics sub-function to ensure the provision of precise and valuable data that aids in decision-making and adheres to the needs of USS Global, Area, Regional leaders, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide guidance to the Vendor and SLA management sub-function to efficiently manage Vendor SLAs and cultivate strong Vendor relationships to ensure service quality and alignment with business objectives.
* Champion Continuous Improvement initiatives to optimize processes and enhance efficiency of operations.
* Guide the Product Management of the End User platform products, ensuring that it meets the user needs and the USS objectives.
* Direct the End User IT Support Knowledge Management team to maintain a comprehensive and accessible knowledge base.
* Oversee and direct the Transition Management efforts to ensure smooth transitions for operational changes, new product releases or integrations.
* Oversee End User IT Asset Management to ensure the effective utilization and tracking of the firm’s End User IT assets.
* Drive innovation in operational support through the adoption of new technologies and methodologies, such as AI, automation, and self-service tools.
* Uphold global IT security standards within the USS domain, ensuring compliance and protection of EY's information assets.
* Support crisis management efforts for support services, ensuring rapid response and resolution to maintain business operations.
* Support the cost-effective delivery of Unified Support Services to meet business and customer needs and respond with the agility required to address changing customer and business priorities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Customer-obsessed—passionate about customer and support services and the impact technology capabilities can have on our customers satisfaction and productivity
* Demonstrated focus on creating and sustaining exceptional customer service
* Over 17 years of experience in IT support services, with significant leadership experience in managing global, large-scale operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading large teams and managing complex operational functions.
* Proven track record in strategic planning and execution of operational initiatives.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and develop a diverse team.
* Extensive experience in Vendor Management, SLA oversight, and building vendor partnerships.
* Knowledge of Continuous Improvement methodologies and their application in a business context.
* Familiarity with Product Management for IT platforms and End User IT Support structures.
* Experience in managing transitions and asset management within a large organization.
* Strong understanding of ITIL service management frameworks with relevant certifications.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with all levels of the organization and external partners.
* Strategic and analytical thinker with robust problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
* Demonstrates an in-depth knowledge of how IT service solutions support customer fulfillment and productivity to achieve short- and long-term business goals
* Visible leadership skills and executive presence
* Extensive experience developing, managing and adjusting the P&L of the managed group
* Demonstrated ability to develop teams through functional transformations in a fast-paced environment, including improving team skills and efficiency, and applying mentoring for talent development

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
**Education:**

* Advanced college degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experience

**Certification Requirements (preferred):**

* ITIL, PMP
* Data Analytics

**What working at EY offers:**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Manager - Easy Ship Operations, IN External Fulfillment
description:
**Description**
Easy Ship is one of the largest fulfilment channels on Amazon India. Sellers pack orders at their own premises, and Amazon or 3P carrier picks them up and delivers them to customers. The channel serves well over a hundred thousand sellers and a large share of marketplace demand, and gives sellers a simple, low-cost way to grow on Amazon while giving customers tracked delivery, payment on delivery and easy returns.
  
  
We are looking for a senior operations leader to own Easy Ship seller operations end to end. You will lead a large central team, own the operating metrics that decide whether a seller's order is picked up and shipped on time, cut seller contacts and escalations, and get the channel ready for peak events. You will work in a high-volume, fast-moving environment where small process changes affect thousands of sellers every day, and you will partner across Easy Ship Business and Product, Last Mile, Middle Mile, Seller Support and Finance teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the Easy Ship operations team of up to 6 direct reports and about 40 team members, with clear goals, scorecards and development programs. Set standard work through SOPs, and improve productivity through Gemba, continuous improvement and AI.
* Own channel performance - scheduling, First Day Pickup Success (FDPS), late shipment rate and cancellations - with the Easy Ship Business team, Last Mile and 3P operations.
* Lead new seller experience charters such as First Order Pickup Success (FOPS) and first-order cancellation rate. Reduce seller contacts, improve resolution and build the escalation roadmap with Seller Partner Support.
* Run programs for priority seller cohorts such as value commerce, pilot new programs with Last Mile to improve FDPS, and get the channel ready for Prime Day and the Great Indian Festival.
* Drive network design changes such as Easy Ship topology, slot design and carrier jurisdiction. Improve seller-facing processes such as capacity setting, handling time, hazmat and weight classification so orders are processed right the first time, and automate manual work.
* Act as the single threaded leader for Easy Ship within India Operations, owning leadership updates, escalation root-cause analyses and business reviews.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of employee and performance management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
* Experience in e-commerce seller operations, pickup operations or last-mile logistics.
* Experience running a central support operation, including automation

title: Assistant Manager-Employee Relations
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Employee Relations**
**Role :**
Assistant Manager – Employee Relations
  
  
**Function Description:**
Employee Relations function is a Centre of Excellence function within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). Employee Relations CoE works in close partnership with Strategic Talent Consultant function, GDS Ethics Office as well as GDS General Counsel’s Office and is primarily responsible for managing complex/sensitive ER incidents. The function continuously monitors the ER risk profile of the Firm and develop/deploy strategies to manage the same. ER CoE is also responsible to project manage Talent special projects and is the custodian of all Talent Policies.
  
  
**Job description:**

* Conduct workplace investigations into sensitive Employee Relations matters. This involves facilitating and documenting Investigation interviews, analysing evidence and drafting investigation findings reports.
* Partner with Senior ER professionals in providing guidance to Talent Consultants and Business Leaders in managing wide range of Employee Relation issues, including Code of conduct breaches, Performance lapses, Discrimination allegations, Workplace harassment allegations, Integrity issues etc, and ensure resolution of the same with minimal risk exposure to the Firm and its professionals.
* Maintain ER Incident data base, identify trends and thereby assist Talent leadership in developing appropriate strategies and initiatives to proactively mitigate ER risk exposures.
* Actively participate in special projects undertaken by EY GDS Employee Relations Centre of Excellence

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Education: Master’s Degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration with HR specialisation or Bachelor in Legislative Law (LLB)
* Experience: 6 - 10 years of experience of Human Resources, with at least 4 years experience in Employment Law, preferably in Big Fours or Leading IT services/Consulting Firms.
* Should have strong knowledge of Indian employment law and regulations, especially related to conduct of disciplinary procedures, work-place investigations, employment litigation procedures etc
* Should possess exceptional written skills, specifically legal writing, as well as oral communication skills.
* Should have the capability to apply discretion and make sound judgement, even in highly stressful and emotional scenarios.
* Should have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
* Should be able to navigate through complex, difficult, and ambiguous situations.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, Mexico, Philippines, Poland, Spain and Sri Lanka – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines.
