title: Manager / Assistant Manager / Senior Executive – GST Advisory, Litigation & Compliance
description:
Job Description – GST Advisory, Litigation & Compliance

Position: Manager/Assistant Manager / Senior Executive

Experience: 2–5 Years

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) / CA Inter / Commerce Graduate or Postgraduate with relevant GST experience

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-Time

Organisation: KASP & Associates – Chartered Accountants

**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically competent and proactive professional to handle GST advisory, litigation, departmental assessments and compliance reviews for a diverse portfolio of clients. The role involves providing practical GST solutions, representing clients in departmental proceedings, identifying tax risks and implementing robust GST compliance policies and best practices.

The candidate should possess strong analytical skills, sound knowledge of GST laws and the ability to independently manage client assignments and coordinate with GST authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GST Advisory & Technical Research

• Provide advisory on complex GST matters, including taxability, classification, rate applicability, input tax credit (ITC), place of supply, time of supply and reverse charge mechanism.

• Analyse GST implications of business transactions, contracts, restructuring and commercial arrangements.

• Research GST provisions, notifications, circulars, advance rulings and judicial precedents.

• Prepare technical notes, opinions and advisory reports for clients.

• Identify GST exposure areas and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

2. GST Litigation & Departmental Proceedings

• Handle GST notices, show-cause notices (SCNs), audit observations, demand orders and other departmental communications.

• Draft replies to notices, submissions, representations and appeals before GST authorities.

• Assist in first appeals, appellate proceedings, rectification applications and other appropriate remedies.

• Represent clients before GST officers and coordinate with departmental authorities during proceedings.

• Analyse adjudication orders, identify legal and factual issues, and recommend suitable courses of action.

• Track litigation status, statutory deadlines, pre-deposit requirements and appeal timelines.

3. GST Assessments, Audits & Investigations

• Handle departmental GST assessments, scrutiny proceedings and audit-related matters.

• Review reconciliation of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, books of accounts and annual returns.

• Analyse ITC mismatches, tax differences, e-invoicing issues, e-way bill discrepancies and other compliance gaps.

• Assist clients during departmental audits, inspections, investigations and summons proceedings.

• Evaluate potential tax demands, interest and penalties and advise on appropriate responses.

4. GST Compliance Review & Best Practices

• Review existing GST compliance processes and identify control gaps and areas of improvement.

• Develop and implement GST compliance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and internal control checklists.

• Establish review mechanisms for ITC eligibility, vendor compliance, reconciliations, return filing and tax payments.

• Recommend preventive controls to minimise errors, interest, penalties and litigation exposure.

• Conduct periodic GST health checks and compliance risk assessments.

• Support process improvements, documentation standards and timely statutory compliance.

5. Client Management & Team Coordination

• Independently manage assigned client engagements and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

• Interact with clients to understand business transactions, obtain information and explain GST implications.

• Coordinate with internal teams handling GST return filing, accounting and other statutory compliances.

• Maintain proper documentation, case files, litigation trackers and compliance calendars.

• Keep clients and reporting partners updated on assignment progress, key risks and pending matters.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

• Strong working knowledge of the CGST Act, SGST Acts, IGST Act and applicable GST Rules.

• Practical experience in GST advisory, notice handling, assessments and litigation support.

• Good drafting, legal research, analytical and reconciliation skills.

• Ability to interpret statutory provisions, notifications, circulars and judicial decisions.

• Familiarity with GST portals, departmental procedures and relevant online legal research platforms.

• Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to independently handle assignments, prioritise deadlines and maintain high-quality documentation.

• Proficiency in MS Excel and preparation of professional reports and submissions.

Preferred Candidate Profile

• CA / CA Inter / relevant commerce professional with 2–5 years of practical GST experience.

• Experience in a Chartered Accountancy firm, tax consultancy or professional services environment.

• Candidates with hands-on exposure to GST litigation, departmental assessments and advisory assignments will be preferred.

• A proactive professional who can identify issues, develop practical solutions and improve client compliance processes.

**What We Offer**

• Exposure to diverse industries and complex GST matters.

• Opportunities to work on advisory, litigation, assessments and compliance improvement assignments.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior professionals.

Interested candidates can share their resume and current CTC at contact@kaspglobal.com.

title: Contract Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Contract Manager, you will support internal legal operations within our Internal Firm Services practice at PwC Acceleration Center India. This role focuses on contract workflows for the Australia-focused legal team, combining process improvement with legal technology, including Onit, to organize information and support decisions. You will work with internal teams and vendors, use data analytics to identify operational trends, and help manage compliance and legal risk. The role also offers opportunities to coordinate contract information that supports intellectual property portfolio management and litigation support.
  
  
As a Manager, you will own the planning, budgets, timelines, and review of contract operations work, applying sound judgment and professional skepticism to complex issues. You will coach colleagues through feedback, draw on their different strengths, and create space for learning and well-being. By listening to internal stakeholders and asking thoughtful questions, you will build productive relationships and address difficult conversations with integrity, escalating concerns when appropriate. You will guide changes to workflows, encourage the considered use of AI and digital tools with human oversight, and hold the team accountable for consistent quality and the firm’s professional and independence requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Managing the contract lifecycle for internal stakeholders, including intake, review coordination, routing, tracking, and renewal planning in collaboration with legal colleagues
* Leading legal operations projects from planning through delivery, managing timelines, resources, and budgets while addressing issues that affect contract workflows
* Improving contract processes by examining handoffs, identifying bottlenecks, and introducing changes that reduce administrative effort and support consistent service
* Using Onit and other legal technology to organize contract information, monitor workflows, and evaluate appropriate uses of AI-supported tools
* Analyzing contract and operational data to report on workload, turnaround times, costs, and opportunities to improve legal team performance
* Coordinating with legal, procurement, and other internal teams on contract requirements, vendor relationships, compliance considerations, and potential risks
* Supporting legal colleagues by maintaining contract records and providing research or documentation needed for intellectual property portfolio management and litigation matters
* Coaching team members through feedback and work review, assigning tasks based on their capabilities, and addressing stakeholder concerns with sound judgment

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Graduate or the post graduate degree
* At least 5 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Managing contract workflows using legal operations tools, including Onit Legal Software and Solutions
* Applying compliance and risk management practices when reviewing contract processes and escalating issues
* Using data analytics to identify bottlenecks and guide improvements to contract management workflows
* Leading legal technology and digital tooling initiatives, including AI-human collaboration, within internal legal operations
* Coaching team members through feedback and change while maintaining accountability for timelines and deliverables
* Coordinating contract-related projects across internal stakeholders, using research analysis and strategic questioning to clarify requirements and resolve ambiguity

title: Senior Associate-Data Privacy Assurance
description:
**About the role**
As part of the Group Privacy Team and as a Data Privacy Assurance Executive, I support the business to assess its data privacycompliance position by testing, validating and reporting on a range of data privacy controls
  
**You will be responsible for**
Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:Test (across the group) a range of data privacy controls. These controls have been established to ensure our business is operating incompliance with privacy laws (mainly GDPR). It is vital therefore Tesco's senior management understands whether the controls are inplace and effective, or not.- Regularly test and report on our 3 pillars of controls: Blueprint Controls, Operational Controls and Data Standards.-As part of my role, I am accountable for validating and challenging testing evidence submitted by stakeholders. Escalating whereneeded.- Overseeing stakeholders and building their engagement with the privacy assurance process.- Working with stakeholders to develop and implement remediation plans where testing reveals ineffective controls.- Delivering privacy assurance "deep dives" - targeting specific business units or functional areas for more thorough review of theirprivacy practices.- Over time the assurance will expand from purely data privacy testing to other compliance areas.- Understands business needs and in depth understanding of Tesco processes- Builds on Tesco processes and knowledge by applying CI tools and techniques.- Responsible for completing tasks and transactions within agreed KPI's- Solves problems by analyzing solution alternatives
  
**You will need**
 Assurance/controls testing experience.- Some understanding of data privacy principles.- Experience building credible and trusting relationships- A good understanding of how Tesco Group operates.
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles - simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Performance Bonus**
- Opportunity to earn additional compensation bonus based on performance, paid annually 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. title: NFR Senior Manager
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a meaningful difference, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. As one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations, HSBC operates across 62 countries and territories.
  
  
We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as
**NFR Senior Manager.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. This role will report to the Managing Director, RTX India Pvt Ltd and will have close working relationship with the Transformation and Global Trade team in USA. Collaborate with Supply Chain on S/4HANA, Vendor Master, and SAP‑related integrations to ensure end‑to‑end compliance.

15+yrs of experience will also be expected to have an awareness and working knowledge of adjacent digital compliance disciplines including cybersecurity, digital architecture & privacy.

GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
  
  
**Job title:**
GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
  
  
**Function:**
Ernst & Young Global Services – Supply Chain Services
  
  
**Role Summary**
The
**GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager**
is a highly responsible role who will oversee Meetings and Events related spend and support M&E program activities across GDS locations globally. The role will act as a key day-to-day point of contact for GDS stakeholders on program management, operational requirements, reporting, supplier performance, and process improvement initiatives supporting the Global M&E program.
  
  
The role will work closely with Meetings & Events colleagues, suppliers, internal business stakeholders, procurement, finance and other enabling teams to promote M&E policies, guidelines and procedures, drive compliance, improve stakeholder experience and support cost-saving opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will be expected to operate independently, influence stakeholders across levels and geographies, and contribute to the broader purpose and objectives of EY’s Travel, Meetings & Events program.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program management and stakeholder partnership**

* Be the primary point of contact for GDS stakeholders on M&E program management, operational queries, reporting requirements and policy guidance.
* Support senior stakeholders across GDS locations and provide guidance on Meetings & Events related matters, ensuring alignment with global program objectives.
* Promote the values, objectives and strategy of the Meetings & Events program and broader procurement function in all stakeholder interactions.
* Influence change and support the implementation of the Global M&E strategy across relevant GDS locations and business groups.

**Event operations, sourcing and supplier management**

* Oversee and support venue sourcing, event planning and supplier engagement for GDS meetings and events, ensuring solutions are aligned to stakeholder requirements and business needs.
* Be the escalation point for supplier-related matters and help maintain strong supplier relationships through performance monitoring, policy alignment and contractual delivery.
* Support M&E related RFPs, vendor onboarding, supplier renewals and other procurement activities as required.

**Policy, compliance and governance**

* Promote and support compliance with EY’s Meetings & Events policies, Supply Chain Services policy, corporate meetings policy, procurement policy and related procedures.
* Ensure compliance with EY standardised meeting contracts, addendums, framework agreements and relevant internal processes.
* Review business compliance with the overall M&E program, including BRIDGE, Independence, Finance and Procurement processes.
* Influence policy and standards relating to M&E spend, including venue, meals, agencies and related event categories.
* Support adoption of viable process solutions aligned with global standards, including process governance and operational controls.

**Financial management, reporting and performance**

* Help prepare initial and final event or meeting budgets and support cost management throughout the event lifecycle.
* Drive cost efficiencies and supplier negotiations, ensuring value-add opportunities are reviewed and exhausted where applicable.
* Review data reporting, identify cost-saving opportunities and present relevant insights to stakeholders.
* Manage and report key performance indicators to monitor program effectiveness, supplier performance and operational efficiency

**Process improvement and global alignment**

* Lead and support GDS M&E projects, including expansion of the M&E catalogue across GDS locations and harmonisation of processes with global teams
* Identify and recommend best practices by networking with Travel Management Company colleagues, venue sourcing teams, suppliers and industry peers.
* Contribute ideas and best practices to improve M&E processes, stakeholder experience and program efficiency.
* Support use of relevant M&E tools and intake channels, including Cvent and other internal systems, to ensure event requests are accurately assigned and managed.

**Teaming and leadership**

* Work closely with direct reports, M&E support personnel and extended support teams to deliver consistent program outcomes.
* Provide guidance to meeting requestors, meeting planners, third-party providers and internal stakeholders on program requirements and event execution
* Demonstrate strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills when working with senior leaders, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

**Supervision Responsibilities**
This role will have responsibility for M&E support personnel and will work closely with the extended M&E support team to support program delivery across GDS locations.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator, self-motivated, detail-oriented and results-driven, with the ability to work independently and engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
* The candidate should demonstrate strong organisational skills, the ability to prioritise effectively, commercial awareness, attention to detail, calmness under pressure and a passion for delivering high-quality event and program outcomes
* The role requires strong stakeholder management, supplier management, analytical thinking, process improvement orientation and the ability to support change across a complex, global and cross-cultural environment.

**Education**

* Fluent written and spoken English language skills are required
* A degree in Business, Hospitality, Travel, Procurement or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Additional Asian language skills may be beneficial for broader regional stakeholder engagement, although they are not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant corporate experience managing Meetings & Events programs or working in a senior role in the travel, hospitality, meeting planning, venue sourcing, destination management or travel management industry.
* Experience managing large, complex events or M&E programs in a multinational, service-focused or cross-cultural environment is highly beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
* Experience with Cvent, meeting intake tools, data reporting, Power BI, Power Platform, Ariba or related procurement and event technology platforms will be an added advantage.

**Job Requirements**
Due to the global nature of EY, the candidate will be expected to work flexibly with colleagues in person and virtually across multiple time zones.
  
  
A stable and reliable home internet connection is required for effective remote teaming, and the role may require working from the EY GDS office in India, based on local policies.
  
  
Some international travel may be required, and the candidate should have a valid passport or the ability to obtain one. There may also be occasions where work outside regular business hours is required due to collaboration across multiple time zones.
  
  
**What We Look For**
We are looking for a confident, collaborative and commercially minded program manager who can work with senior stakeholders, suppliers and global colleagues to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality Meetings & Events outcomes. The right candidate will bring a calm-under-pressure mindset, strong ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to influence change while continuously improving the stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Note**
This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the role. It is not an all-inclusive listing of required responsibilities, and duties may vary depending on business priorities, geographic location and management discretion.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: HR Generalist
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

The HR Partner will provide end-to-end HR partnership and operational support to assigned business functions within the Global Talent Hub, collaborating closely with business leaders, People Managers, HR Business Partners, and HR Centers of Excellence to delivery consistent and effective people solutions.

This role will serve as a key point of contact for employees and managers on day-to-day people matters and will support the effective delivery of HR programs across the employee lifecycle. The HR Partner will combine strong HR fundamentals, knowledge of employment practices, HR technology capability, and program management skills to deliver consistent and positive employee and manager experience.

The role requires an individual who can work with a high degree of independence, exercise sound judgment, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across a matrixed HR organization.

**About the Job**

**Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Provide HR support across the employee lifecycle, including hiring, onboarding, employee movements, performance management, engagement, and separation.
* Partner with managers and employees to ensure HR processes are understood and executed effectively and consistently.
* Support employee transitions, organizational changes, promotions, transfers, and other employee lifecycle activities.
* Ensure appropriate HR documentation and employee records are maintained accurately and in accordance with established processes and meeting the regulatory requirements.
* Manage mandatory HR audits in accordance with applicable local compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with relevant HR teams to provide employees with seamless HR experience.

**Manager & Employee Partnership**

* Serve as a primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across assigned client groups.
* Provide timely and practical guidance on HR policies, processes, and day-to-day people-management matters.
* Exercise sound judgment in resolving employee matters and escalate complex, sensitive, or higher-risk cases to the Senior HRBP, Employee Relations, or Legal teams as appropriate.
* Support managers in having effective employee conversations and applying HR policies consistently.
* Build trusted relationships with managers and employees while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and professional judgment.

**Employment Practices & Compliance**

* Support employee-relations matters and provide guidance in accordance with company policies, practices, and applicable employment legislation.
* Resolve routine employee concerns independently and escalate complex, sensitive, high-risk, or potential compliance matters to the HRBP, Employee Relations, Legal, or other appropriate HR stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of applicable employment legislation, regulatory requirements, HR policies, and company practices.
* Ensure HR processes and employee-related decisions are implemented consistently and in accordance with applicable local requirements and company policies.
* Support managers with appropriate documentation and the consistent application of HR policies and practices.
* Partner with relevant HR and Legal teams to ensure appropriate governance, documentation, and risk management.

**HR Programs, Process Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Lead the execution of annual and recurring people processes, including performance management, employee engagement surveys, compensation cycles, and learning and development initiatives.
* Coordinate and deliver assigned HR programs across client groups, ensuring consistent, timely, and high-quality execution.
* Use employee feedback, talent data, and workforce insights to identify emerging people trends and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Leverage Workday or equivalent HR platforms to support employee, organizational, and HR program processes effectively.
* Independently manage and execute HR system enhancements, testing, implementation, and adoption of new functionality and processes.
* Maintain the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of employee and organizational data.
* Prepare and analyze workforce metrics, including headcount, attrition, hiring, and employee movements, to support informed decision-making.
* Support periodic workforce and headcount-planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance HR processes to improve operational efficiency and the employee experience.
* Track program completion and proactively follow up with managers and stakeholders to address gaps or delays.
* Support implementation and tracking of engagement action plans.

**HR COE & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner closely with HR Business Partners and Centers of Excellence including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Learning & Development, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and HR Technology.
* Coordinate the local implementation of global HR programs and initiatives.
* Ensure HR programs are delivered consistently while taking into consideration relevant local business and regulatory requirements.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.
* **Approximately 5 years of progressive HR experience**, preferably in an HR Partner, HR Generalist, or HR Business Partnering environment.
* Experience supporting a complex, matrixed, global organization, GCC, GBS, or shared-services environment is preferred.
* Experience using Workday or similar HR technology platforms.
* Experience working with senior managers and functional leaders. Works effectively across functions, geographies, and HR partners.
* Strong ability to interpret people data and translate insights into business actions.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and HR projects simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of applicable employment legislation and HR compliance requirements.
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to navigate complex people and business situations.
* Strong communication, influencing, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.

Bengaluru, India

Full time

title: HR Manager
description:
**About SiFive**
----------------

*As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits.*

At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.

Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.

Are you ready?

To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.

**Job Description:**

**The Role**

The Manager / Senior Manager, India HR is the senior HR and compliance leader for SiFive India, based in Bangalore. You will own HR end to end for our India employees, keep us compliant with Indian labour and statutory requirements, and lead the India HR and talent acquisition support team. You will also take on a cross-regional specialty: coordinating benefits and payroll across SiFive’s regions, working with our Rewards team.

You will work closely with the HR team (Rewards, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, and our U.S., Europe, and APAC HR partners), Finance and payroll providers, benefits vendors and brokers, legal counsel, and business leaders in India. You will report to the Sr. Director of Rewards and HR Operations, with a dotted line to Talent Acquisition for recruiting support in India.

  

**Responsibilities**

**India HR and compliance**

* Own HR end to end for India employees: onboarding and Day 1 orientation, employee data changes, employment letters, leave, offboarding, background screening, and new-hire provisioning.

* Own India compliance: statutory and labour code requirements, mandatory filings and audits with vendors, and local policy updates, reviewed with legal counsel and vendors as needed.

* Manage employee relations cases, investigations, and disciplinary documentation, and coach managers on performance improvement plans.

Support local work authorization and visa needs, and provide India input into the annual focal review and compensation cycle.  

  

**Benefits and payroll**

* Administer India benefits, including enrollment, additions and deletions, insurer data feeds, and annual renewals with our global benefits partner.
Validate payroll inputs and approved compensation changes, including one-time payments, before they go to Finance and payroll providers, and resolve issues.  

  

**Team leadership and talent acquisition support**

* Lead and develop the India HR and talent acquisition support team, and set clear priorities and backup coverage.
* Oversee recruiting support in India with Talent Acquisition: interview scheduling, candidate logistics, and pre-hire to Day 1 coordination.
Use Workday to process transactions and pull reports, and partner with the HRIS team to improve data quality and automate recurring work.  

  

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including leading HR and compliance for India operations.
* In-depth knowledge of Indian labour law, statutory benefits, payroll, and compliance requirements.
* Experience managing and developing people.
* Hands-on experience with an HRIS (Workday preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have:**

* Master’s degree or HR certification.
* Experience supporting multinational teams across APAC or other regions.
* Experience managing benefits and payroll vendors and brokers.

**Additional Information:**

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

India

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Project Manager - Workday Optimization & HR Transformation
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

You will join Flix's People & Organization in the Digital Transformation team to lead our HRIS transformation programme to optimize our processes, revamp payroll ecosystem and define the target operating model for a human-led, AI-partnered and agent-operated People function.

As **Senior Project Manager (m/f/d),** you will bring structure to a large, fast-moving transformation across various workstreams. You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow.

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams.

This role is based in **Gurugram/Bangalore**, with a minimum **office presence of 3 days per week.** Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.

**About the Role**

* **Lead HRIS transformation**, owning the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and RAID log across the HRIS revamp, payroll transition and operating-model workstreams, and keeping all our functional and tech teams working as one delivery engine
* **Set up project governance and decision frameworks**, including master data ownership, DACI/RACI and decision rights, intake and prioritization, escalation paths and steering forums
* **Plan and facilitate process revamp workshops** with our process owners, People Partners and CoEs, driving as-is/to-be gap analysis, global-first standardization with justified local variants, and clear process ownership across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
* **Translate business needs into technical requirements**, working with our HRIS tech team, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing and UAT, release readiness and documentation
* **Steer a complex global payroll transformation** including middleware solutions, integrations, parallel runs, sign-offs and cut-over, and building a repeatable migration playbook
* **Manage stakeholders and drive proactive change management** with transparent reporting, risk escalation, adoption metrics and a calm, structured presence when priorities shift
  

**About You**

* **7+ years of experience** managing complex, multi-country transformation programmes in HR technology, with a track record of delivering in a global-local environment
* **Proven experience in Workday** transformation projects, such as optimization, business process redesign or platform revamps, with enough technical fluency to challenge and align with configuration, security and integration teams. Workday certifications are an advantage
* **Hands-on experience in payroll transformation**, such as vendor migrations, country roll-outs, parallel runs and cut-over planning. Experience with global payroll providers is a strong plus
* **Experience shaping target operating models and governance frameworks**, including service delivery models, master data governance, DACI/RACI and decision-rights design
* **Strong workshop and process-revamp skills,** with the ability to facilitate cross-functional groups, map as-is/to-be processes (e.g. BPMN) and reach decisions without losing momentum
* **Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills,** including influencing senior leaders, translating between business and technical teams, and staying calm and building structure in ambiguity. Familiarity with works council and multi-country compliance requirements is a plus
* **Strong hands-on knowledge of Jira and Confluence**. Certifications in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum) are a plus.
  

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

**What We Offer**

* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning & Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

**Why Join Flix?**

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Consultant, Transfer Agency
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role**

Reporting to the New Business & Fund Activity Team Manager in UKTA, this role sits within the TA Change Group within the UK Transfer Agency department.

This role is a full time permanent role Monday to Friday each week. The role is incredibly varied and fast-paced. Northern Trust support a healthy work-life balance, however it’s important to note that this work can often take place outside of core hours and weekend work is required. Where weekends are worked, TOIL (time off in lieu) will be earned.

The UK TA department provides third party fund administration services to numerous fund management companies covering the full range of shareholder servicing functions.

The UK TA New Business & Fund Activity Team is currently a team of four full time partners and two part time partners. We also use contractor support as and when required for activity. The prime responsibility of the team is leading activity relating to funds (launches, closures, mergers, etc.), onboarding new clients and offboarding clients/funds. The role requires dealing with multiple operational teams, our clients and other departments to ensure all requirements are captured and teams are fully aware of these. Ensuring the capture of all line items for requirements to be successfully implemented and active oversight of any system development, processes, set up and changes..

The Senior Consultant role will be expected to pick up a range of changes and be an active lead and subject matter expert. The team deal with complex change and even our most experienced partners are constantly learning. Be a subject matter expert across UK TA to support business queries, system set-up, key initiatives, UAT and regression testing, required project work and operational readiness. The role will also include understanding the relationship and liaising with Fund Accounting, IT, Custody, Depositary and IOO departments within Northern Trust and will be part of a team who are the first to engage with our new clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* To be a technical and subject matter expert to support and complete client requirements. This will require knowledge of TA processes and teams.
* Ability to build a strong network across all levels, teams and departments. The work is fast-paced and having an effective network will allow change to be implemented successfully.
* To be a technical and subject matter expert on new business in TA and work closely with the Operational Readiness (Business Process Management Team) group to coordinate activity.
* Oversee the completion and maintenance of client specific account set-up on all TA systems, including Icon Retail, PS Financials, Data Governance Tool, FAILS, EMX, EXP-AG, etc.
* Ensure all current and new procedures, checklists and matrices are maintained and ensure changes are shared with the wider team for awareness.
* Share ideas for improvements across processes and procedures to automate and develop where possible, always looking for opportunity to streamline and make more efficient.
* Writes proposals and business requirements for system changes/enhancements. Implements new efficiencies to improve accuracy and timeliness and reduce costs and risk.
* Regression testing for large and small change projects/changes and document changes.
* New Client / Fund activity / transition Unit Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Client Joint UAT (JUAT) Interaction with external system providers, mainly LineData Services, EMX, Calastone, and others as and where required.
* Documents high level process flows for process improvements and systems changes to assist business areas with procedure development.
* Handholds staff on new process changes and new business / fund activity. Conducts post implementation reviews to ensure desired goals are achieved.
* Minimise errors in all deliverables at all stages.
* Demonstrate learning and experience of challenging changes.

**Desired Skills / Experience**

**Personal Qualities**

  

* Ability to manage and prioritise a wide range of changes and complex projects.
* Approachable and able to gain respect especially under extreme conditions.
* Disciplined, determined and confident.
* Enthusiastic, good communicator, able to coach and mentor in a candid and respectful manner.
* Resilient and able to think and act creatively.
* Results-oriented, driven and able to both effectively engage your team to solution problems, whilst being able to act independently and escalate effectively.
* Ability to think and act quickly and creatively.
* Identifies solutions as well as issues.
* Takes initiative to propose improvements to areas outside of immediate responsibilities

**Experience**

  

* Good knowledge of Northern Trust, transfer agency, the regulatory environment and products and services offered by UKTA.
* Strong client focus gained in a financial services company.
* Process/Business analysis and improvement experience.
* Experience of coaching and development.
* Strong communication, first class presentation and internal and external client-servicing skill - both oral and written.
* Excellent Project Management skills - work in an efficient manner and able to set and work to obtainable deadlines in a challenging environment.
* Good analytical and strong time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple changing priorities and maintain a calm exterior.
* Able to document lessons learned and ensure appropriate steps are put in place to prevent any recurrence of problem items.
* Experience of project planning, delivery and project management documentation.
* Able to effectively negotiate across different groups (internal and external).
* Active engagement of multiple teams in multiple locations with strong oversight and attention to detail.

**Client Service**

  

* Demonstrate an excellent NT client service culture and ensure that all clients receive a quality service.
* Ensure accuracy and timings are consistently achieved within the team and when not achieved actively pursue a solution. Ensure ‘the team’ (to include, internal, external and offshore groups) adhere to required deadlines and project expectations.
* Collaborate and consult with managers and project/assignment stakeholders with ease. Prepare and recommend solutions to project/assignment issues and risk factors. Provide regular updates to the stakeholders on project status.
* The ability to negotiate and deliver our standard business model where possible, ensuring we do the right thing by our clients and NT.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 24 months as a Consultant to move as a Senior Consultant

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: HR Business Partner - R&D
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across the Engineering and Product functions to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes.

This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives. You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions.

This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done. The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.

**Scope of Impact**
===================

**Business Partnership**
------------------------

* Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions.
* Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness.
* Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers
* Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes.

**Manager & Leadership Capability**
-----------------------------------

* Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance.
* Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning.
* Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations.
* Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale.

**Performance, Talent Management and Compensation**
---------------------------------------------------

* Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement
* Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices.
* Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers
* Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality.

**HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes.
* Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows.
* Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and impact beyond traditional human capacity.
* Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness.

**Organizational Health, Engagement & Development**
---------------------------------------------------

* Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent.
* Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.

**Employee Relations**
----------------------

* Provide guidance and independently manage moderate to complex employee relations matters using sound judgment and risk assessment.
* Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters.

**How You Create Impact**
=========================

* Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions.
* Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving.
* Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions.
* Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement.
* Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes.
* Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment.
* Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions.
* Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations.
* Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes.
* Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

* **Required Qualifications:** Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree.
* **Preferred Qualifications:** Experience supporting R&D client group

* Address employee grievances and workplace conflicts.
* Implement employee recognition and reward programmes.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyse reasons for attrition.
* Develop strategies to retain skilled hairstylists and other key salon professionals.

**D. Attendance, Payroll & HR Administration**

* Monitor attendance, leave management and employee shifts across all outlets.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the accounts/payroll team.
* Ensure timely salary disbursement.
* Manage employee incentives, commissions, bonuses and other benefits.
* Maintain accurate employee databases and HR documentation.
* Monitor overtime, absenteeism and attendance irregularities.

**E. Training & Development**

* Coordinate with the Training Department to identify employee skill gaps.
* Organise induction and behavioural training programmes.
* Facilitate technical training for salon professionals.
* Ensure employees undergo mandatory service, grooming and customer-handling training.
* Develop career progression and internal promotion opportunities.
* Track training effectiveness and employee development.

**F. Performance Management**

* Implement a structured employee appraisal system.
* Define KRAs and KPIs for employees across different positions.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews in coordination with salon managers.
* Monitor employee productivity and individual performance.
* Identify high performers and potential future leaders.
* Recommend promotions, increments, incentives and performance improvement plans.

**G. HR Policies & Statutory Compliance**

* Develop and implement HR policies across the salon network.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and employment regulations.
* Maintain records relating to PF, ESI, Professional Tax, gratuity, bonus and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Shops and Establishments regulations.
* Handle disciplinary matters and employee misconduct.
* Manage employee separation, full and final settlements and relieving documentation.
* Ensure appropriate POSH compliance and workplace safety processes.

**H. Coordination with Salon Operations**

* Work closely with Area Managers, Cluster Managers and Salon Managers.
* Conduct regular visits to salon outlets.
* Monitor manpower availability and employee-related operational issues.
* Ensure proper implementation of HR policies at outlet level.
* Support management in resolving employee-related challenges.
* Provide regular manpower and HR performance reports to management.

**3. Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualification**

**·       MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred.**

**·       Graduate with relevant HR experience may also be considered.**

**Experience**

**·       5–8 years of overall HR experience.**

**·       Experience in retail, hospitality, beauty, wellness or salon industries preferred.**

**·       Experience handling multi-location manpower operations is highly desirable.**

**Required Skills**

**·       Strong recruitment and negotiation skills.**

**·       Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities.**

**·       Strong employee grievance-handling capabilities.**

**·       Knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.**

**·       Ability to manage large and diverse workforces.**

**·       Good analytical and reporting skills.**

**·       Willingness to travel across salon locations.**

**Language Requirements**

* Proficiency in
  **English, Hindi and Tamil**
  is preferred.
* Must possess good verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively in Hindi and Tamil with salon employees across locations.

**4. Important Expectations from the Role**

The HR Manager should be someone who:

1.    Understands the challenges of managing a people-intensive salon business.

2.    Can recruit and retain skilled hairstylists and beauty professionals.

3.    Can independently handle employee issues across multiple locations.

4.    Is proactive in identifying manpower shortages before they affect business operations.

5.    Builds a strong organisational culture and employee accountability.

6.    Works closely with Operations to ensure every salon is adequately staffed.

7.    Balances employee satisfaction with business requirements.
