title: People Consulting-Payroll Implementation and Consulting-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: EY - GDS - Consulting - People Consulting (PC),**
**Payroll Advisory - Staff / Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for experienced Staff / Consultants with expertise in Payroll to join the People Consulting team. This is an opportunity to support global payroll advisory and transformation engagements, work with distributed teams across geographies, and build strong functional knowledge across payroll processes, operating models and technology.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support delivery of global payroll advisory, transformation and implementation engagements in collaboration with GDS teams and EY member firms.
* Participate in payroll current-state assessments, discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews and documentation of findings, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Support payroll process design, operating model analysis, vendor assessment, requirements gathering and preparation of business and functional documentation.
* Develop process maps, standard operating procedures, work instructions, project trackers, status reports and client-ready presentations.
* Support data collection and analysis across payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, payroll remittances, controls, interfaces, reporting and workforce management processes.
* Assist with payroll implementation activities, including requirements traceability, test scenario preparation, data validation, defect tracking, user acceptance testing and deployment readiness.
* Work as part of a global distributed team and ensure quality, accuracy and timeliness of assigned deliverables.
* Maintain effective communication with project team members and client stakeholders, proactively highlighting risks, dependencies and issues.
* Contribute to payroll methodologies, templates, accelerators, proposals and thought leadership materials that strengthen the Payroll Advisory offering.
* Demonstrate continuous learning and develop subject-matter expertise in one or more payroll service areas or technology platforms.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* High integrity and commitment to working in a new and challenging environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, organize work independently and be proactive.
* Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity when working with global teams.
* High energy levels, agility, adaptability and willingness to learn.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet agreed timelines.
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects, in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-5 years of relevant experience in payroll operations, payroll consulting, payroll implementation, HR transformation or workforce management.
* Practical exposure to payroll advisory, payroll transformation, payroll implementation or payroll technology projects.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in commerce, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Understanding of the end-to-end payroll lifecycle and key controls, including payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, remittances, reconciliations and reporting.
* Experience in process documentation, requirements gathering, data analysis, testing or project coordination.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Experience of working in consulting, shared services, payroll provider or global delivery environment.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Exposure to one or more payroll platforms such as ADP, Dayforce, Workday, SAP, Oracle or PeopleSoft.
* Experience in payroll assessments, process improvement, vendor selection, payroll outsourcing or operating model initiatives.
* Experience in preparing process maps using Visio or similar tools and creating SOPs, work instructions or business requirements documents.
* Exposure to multi-country payroll programs and global payroll vendors.
* Awareness of payroll compliance, governance, risk and control considerations.
* Relevant payroll, project management or technology certification.

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality client service.
* Individuals with relevant payroll experience and the enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving consulting environment.
* Team players who are willing to take on new responsibilities, work across geographies and contribute to the continued growth of the Payroll Advisory practice.
* People with a genuine interest in Payroll, Workforce Management and HR Transformation.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment and support your growth through a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodation you may need.
  
  
**Our commitment**
We endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose and champion inclusiveness. Our aim is to cultivate an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and individuals can authentically be themselves and contribute their best.
  
  
**Professional development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and culture**
Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate about joining us and aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing the required application information and providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates may advance to a competency-based interview as part of the recruitment process.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior HRBP
description:
**About Poshmark**
------------------

  

**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection.** Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

  

As our Senior HRBP, you’ll be the strategic people partner to leadership across our India teams, shaping how we hire, grow, engage, and retain talent in a fast-moving, product-led organization. You’ll tackle challenges like scaling teams while preserving culture, building strong leaders in a distributed global setup, and making sure our people practices in India stay aligned with the global organization while still fitting local needs. This role is exciting because you’ll have real influence: your work will directly shape the employee experience and business outcomes of one of the leading social marketplaces.

  

**Responsibilities**:

* Partner with business leaders across engineering, product, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into people strategies covering org design, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Act as a trusted advisor to managers on performance management, coaching, employee relations, and difficult conversations, so they can lead their teams well.
* Drive the full talent lifecycle with Talent Acquisition, L&D, and Total Rewards, including hiring plans, onboarding, career frameworks, and promotion cycles.
* Use people data (attrition, engagement, performance, headcount trends) to find risks and opportunities, and turn those insights into action plans for leadership.
* Lead employee engagement and retention initiatives, including engagement surveys, action planning, and recognition programs that strengthen our culture.
* Handle employee relations matters with fairness, discretion, and sound judgment, ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws and company policies.
* Work closely with global HR counterparts in the US to bring global programs to India and represent India’s needs in global HR decisions.
* Support change management during reorganizations, policy changes, and growth phases, so transitions are clear and well communicated.

**6-Month Accomplishments:**

* Built strong, trusted relationships with business leaders and managers across your client groups, and gained a clear picture of their priorities, challenges, and team dynamics.
* Completed a people health assessment for your client groups, covering attrition, engagement, performance distribution, and talent risks, and shared clear recommendations with leadership.
* Successfully supported at least one full performance review or promotion cycle, with calibrated outcomes and well-prepared managers.
* Resolved open employee relations issues and set up a consistent, documented approach for handling future cases.
* Launched at least one targeted initiative (such as a manager effectiveness program or a retention plan for critical talent) based on your early findings.

**12+ Month Accomplishments:**

* Measurably improved engagement scores and reduced regretted attrition in your client groups.
* Put in place a workforce and succession plan for key roles, with clear development paths for high-potential employees.
* Raised manager capability across your client groups, shown through better engagement results, stronger performance conversations, and fewer escalations.
* Set up a regular people metrics dashboard and review rhythm with leadership, making data-driven people decisions part of how the business runs.
* Became a recognized voice for India in global HR forums, helping shape policies and programs that work for both the local and global organization.
* Helped the business scale smoothly through growth or org changes while keeping culture and employee experience strong.

**Requirements:**

* 8–9 years of hands-on HR Business Partner experience, ideally in technology, product, e-commerce, or high-growth companies.
* Proven experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions at the leadership level.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, and employee relations best practices.
* Solid experience across core HR areas, including performance management, org design, talent development, engagement, and compensation.
* Comfort working with HR data and analytics to diagnose issues and build a business case for action.
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organization, ideally with US-based stakeholders across time zones.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills, with high integrity and sound judgment in sensitive situations.
* A bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA or postgraduate degree in HR is preferred.

description:
**Company Profile**

Morulaa HealthTech is a fast-growing technology company building AI-driven regulatory and compliance solutions, helping over 500+ global medical device and IVD manufacturers navigate complex regulatory pathways into India, the EU, the USA, and ASEAN markets. Our platforms help organizations automate document-heavy workflows.

**Why this role exists**

As Morulaa HealthTech continues to scale its operations and expand its global client footprint, seamless internal infrastructure and day-to-day operational excellence are critical to supporting our specialized teams. We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Admin Executive with 2-3 years of experience to take ownership of office management, vendor coordination, asset tracking, and workplace logistics. Acting as the operational backbone of our Chennai office, you will ensure a smooth, compliant, and productive work environment so our regulatory and technology teams can focus on delivering high-impact solutions to global clients.

**What you'll do**

* **Office & Facility Management:** Oversee daily workplace operations, ensuring office infrastructure, utilities, housekeeping, security, and general maintenance run smoothly and meet safety and hygiene standards.
* **Vendor & Procurement Coordination:** Manage end-to-end procurement of office supplies, pantry inventory, and IT/non-IT consumables. Negotiate with vendors, evaluate service quality, track contracts, and verify invoices for timely finance processing.
* **Asset & Inventory Administration:** Maintain an accurate, up-to-date register of company assets (laptops, peripherals, office furniture, access cards) and manage issuance, returns, and routine maintenance schedules.
* **Travel, Hospitality & Event Logistics:** Coordinate end-to-end domestic and international travel arrangements, visa documentation support, hotel bookings, and local transport for leadership, employees, and visiting international clients or auditors. Organize company town halls, team-building events, and client visits.
* **HR & Compliance Support:** Partner with the HR and Finance teams on employee onboarding/offboarding logistics (workstation setup, ID cards, welcome kits), attendance/leave tracking coordination, and statutory compliance documentation.
* **Front-Office & Stakeholder Communication:** Manage reception operations, courier/dispatch logs (including confidential regulatory sample shipments), and act as the primary point of contact for internal administrative queries.

**What you bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration (BBA), Commerce (B.Com), Management, or any related discipline from a recognized institution.
* **Experience:** 2-3 years of proven experience in office administration, facility management, or general operations preferably within a fast-paced IT, SaaS, HealthTech, or consulting environment.

About the Role

Lead Weatherford’s Commercial analytics delivery team and build scalable analytics products, applications, automation and applied AI solutions. Drive Commercial analytics support for Atlas, including the transition from JD Edwards (JDE) to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and CRM modernization—from design and migration through cutover, stabilization and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead team delivery:** Provide functional supervision for the Commercial Platforms & Systems Administrator and Commercial Data & Transformation Analyst, covering prioritization, work allocation, coaching, quality reviews and delivery-risk escalation.
* **Drive ERP and CRM transformation:** Define Commercial reporting, data, integration, automation, application, AI and control requirements for Atlas and the JDE-to-Oracle Fusion transition. Address CRM modernization across customer, account, opportunity, pricing, contracts, tenders, product and activity data.
* **Own migration readiness:** Lead fit-gap assessments, source-to-target mapping, migration, interface testing, UAT, cutover rehearsals, go-live reconciliation, stabilization and approved legacy decommissioning. Establish owners, acceptance criteria, fallback procedures and support arrangements.
* **Build analytics and AI products:** Deliver dashboards, Power Apps, automated workflows, data pipelines, semantic models and decision-support tools focused on usability, reliability, reuse, responsible AI and measurable value.
* **Integrate enterprise platforms:** Design solutions across Power BI, Alteryx Designer and Server, Power Platform, SQL, Python, Azure or Fabric, SharePoint, Salesforce and other CRM platforms, approved AWS services, JDE, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, EDW and WDF.
* **Manage end-to-end delivery:** Translate business requirements into governed, production-ready solutions; oversee discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, documentation, training, adoption, enhancement and support transition.
* **Partner across functions:** Align technical and business stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, quality standards and dependencies; communicate decisions and escalate material risks promptly.
* **Uphold governance and quality:** Apply Commercial and financial business rules, master-data standards, security roles and controls. Maintain business continuity, service quality and compliance with Weatherford’s Management System, Rules to Live By, HSE, security, environmental and applicable legal requirements; drive continuous improvement and safety leadership.
* **Develop capability and manage resources:** Support coaching, performance and career development, succession planning, required training and collaboration with HR on talent attraction and retention. Manage expenses within approved budgets, timelines and financial policies.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience delivering analytics, automation, data engineering, digital products, ERP- or CRM-enabled transformation, or applied AI solutions, including leadership of complex projects or a small functional team.
* Advanced hands-on Power BI and Alteryx expertise, plus working experience with Power Platform, SQL, Python, Azure or Fabric, SharePoint, Salesforce or another CRM, AWS, JDE, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, EDW or WDF.
* Experience leading reporting, integration, data, automation, testing, cutover, stabilization or adoption within an ERP or CRM transformation.
* Ability to translate functional requirements into governed, production-ready solutions with measurable outcomes, supported by strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently, allocate work, coach technical professionals, review delivery quality, influence stakeholders and escalate risks and dependencies.

  

* Strong focus on data quality, security, controls, supportability and business continuity; ability to connect business stakeholders with technical delivery teams and work across global teams and flexible time zones.
* Experience with JDE-to-Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP transitions, Oracle Fusion data and reporting, Salesforce or CRM modernization, and cross-platform integration.
* Experience applying generative AI, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), intelligent document processing, machine learning or advanced analytics.
* Commercial, pricing, contracts, tenders, sales, finance, supply chain or operational analytics experience within a global enterprise.
* Relevant certification in Alteryx, Power Platform, Power BI, Azure, AWS, Oracle, Salesforce, business analysis or program delivery.
* Experience leading globally distributed technical teams or communities of practice.

title: Global HR Operations Associate - Contingent Workforce
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG’s central Contingent Workforce team, branded as Contingent IQ, supports the engagement and onboarding of contingent workers and client-facing contractors across BCG. Together with the Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC) function that supports the internal employee lifecycle and operations, we are enhancing every individual’s journey at BCG.

The HR Operations Associate will be supporting the back-end processing of contingent worker requests. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing operational activities across onboarding, supplier registration, system processing, renewals, and offboarding, while helping ensure that requests are handled accurately, compliantly, and in a timely manner.

Key role & responsibilities

* Daily management of operational activities supporting contingent worker and client-facing contractor onboarding
* Reviewing intake information to ensure requests are complete, accurate, and aligned to the correct process path
* Completing required activities in operational systems and tools, including supplier onboarding and requisition-related support in Coupa.
* Capturing, validating, and maintaining accurate supplier, contract, stakeholder, and service-related information across systems, trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Monitoring shared mailboxes, trackers, and operational queues to ensure timely and accurate case progression.
* Responding to operational queries from stakeholders and providing clear status updates on active requests.
* Maintaining strong data integrity across relevant systems and identifying gaps, errors, or missing information for follow-up.
* Maintaining personnel records in compliance with legal requirements and internal standards.
* Producing basic reports and responding to data or status requests from key stakeholders and supporting internal audits with required documentation and timely response.

What You'll Bring

* A Graduate degree or equivalent.
* 1-3 years of experience in HR operations, contingent workforce operations, shared services, stakeholder operations, procurement coordination, or a related operational environment.
* Ability to work flexible hours, as needed, to provide effective global coverage.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience working in a global multinational is preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and a strong service mindset.
* Desirable: Basic experience with contingent workforce processes, supplier onboarding, contractor lifecycle operations, shared mailboxes, service management, Coupa, Workday, Fieldglass, or related tools.

Additional info

This role requires someone who thrives in a structured, matrixed global organization and can manage detail-heavy operational work while collaborating across teams:

* Work effectively within a global, cross-cultural, and virtual environment.
* Demonstrate a strong customer focus and effective stakeholder management skills.
* Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to operational accuracy.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders across teams and functions.
* Thriving under pressure with exceptional attention to detail.
* Staying flexible and reliable in a dynamic and changing environment.
* Handling sensitive data with confidentiality and professionalism.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* **Operational Excellence:** Drive continuous improvement, automation, and operational efficiency across technical workflows, incident management, and infrastructure support functions.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary operational liaison between onshore/offshore teams and the pharma client leadership, managing expectations, reporting metrics, and mitigating project risks.

Project/Program Delivery Management

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of large-scale projects across diverse industries and functional areas.

* Define delivery frameworks, establish milestones, and ensure high-quality execution within time and budget constraints.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design scalable, innovative, and client-centric solutions.

* **Performance Enablement:** Guide performance management practices that balance strong role requirements with individual strengths, supporting professional growth across the region.

* Guide managers in recruiting and nurturing high-performing teams that align with organizational values and goals.

* Establish a structured framework for mentoring managers to enhance their leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

title: Canadian Immigration Case Analyst
company: My Visa Source Legal - US & Canada Immigration Lawyers
description:
**Company Description**
My Visa Source Legal - US & Canada Immigration Lawyers is an award-winning, full-service immigration law firm with experienced Canadian lawyers and licensed practitioners. The firm provides legal solutions for personal and business immigration matters across Canada, with physical offices in Toronto and Vancouver. Its mission is to deliver clear, effective legal guidance that improves the chances of favorable outcomes, supported by efficient processes refined over more than a decade. Recognized as one of Canada’s fastest growing immigration firms, My Visa Source has received multiple national awards for excellence in corporate and personal immigration law. The organization operates through several affiliated entities and serves clients from diverse backgrounds with straightforward, affordable immigration solutions.

The Canadian Immigration Case Analyst is a full-time, remote role responsible for supporting lawyers and regulated practitioners with day-to-day case preparation and management. This role involves gathering and analyzing client information, reviewing documentation for accuracy and completeness, and organizing evidence for a wide range of Canadian immigration applications. The Case Analyst will draft clear written communications, including client correspondence, case summaries, and supporting documents, in line with firm standards and immigration regulations. Daily tasks include maintaining case files, tracking deadlines, updating case management systems, and responding to client inquiries with professional, client-focused service. The role also requires monitoring immigration program updates, collaborating with team members across offices, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency and client experience.

* Post-secondary education in law, immigration, paralegal studies, international relations, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience working in an immigration, legal, or regulated professional services environment is an asset.
* Familiarity with Canadian immigration programs (e.g., economic, family, temporary residence, and business streams) is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting while collaborating effectively with a distributed team.
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and commitment to ethical standards in handling client information.

description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Associate Client Legal Administrator**
**Location: Gurugram, Haryana**
**Work schedule: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM**
**Work mode: Hybrid**
**Introduction:**
Company Secretaries should ensure the compliance of the Company and Board of Director is met with day-to-day operation under various laws and regulation.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to creating long-term relationships with our clients and business partners, and we strive to provide a personalized and practical approach to our services. We take pride in our industry-leading services and are committed to helping our clients stay compliant with national and international legislation. Does this sound like a team you want to be a part of?
  
  
Additionally, we provide training, mentorship, and opportunities for growth. If you’re ready to take on a challenge and make an impact, CSC is the place for you.
  
  
**Some of the things you’ll be doing:**

* Interact with different clients
* Knowledge/understanding of FEMA capital account transactions and of filing of FC-GPR, FC-TRS, DI, FLA, APR under FEMA
* Basic knowledge of Listed and Public Limited Companies
* Able to handle all secretarial works such as issue of shares, increase in authorised capital, transfer of shares, charge satisfaction, charge creation, modification, etc.
* Understanding of compliances under issuance of securities (rights/private placement) including obtaining ISIN, completion of corporate actions, etc.
* Handles Compliances and Advisory under the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI Regulations, Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999, Stamp Act, Stock Exchanges, IBC, and other related secretarial work
* Well versed in regular compliances such as filing of Form AOC 4, MGT 7, DIR 12, PAS 3, MGT 14, MGT 6, BEN 2, etc.
* Assisting in implementing various legal and corporate action
* Filling of forms and returns with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Stock Exchanges, and Reserve Bank of India
* Ensuring that the client company complies with standard legal practice and maintains standards of corporate governance
* Notices minutes of Annual General Meeting, Extraordinary General Meeting, Board Meetings, and Shareholder Meetings
* Maintenance of statutory registers and records of the client companies as per the requirements of Companies Act 2013
* Drafting of agreements for takeover, franchisee, and business restructuring
* Drafting of NCLT Petitions for various dispute matters under Companies Act
* Other basic works in DGFT, Taxation, GST, etc.

**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Should possess interpersonal skills
* Excellent organisation and time management skills are required
* Meticulous attention to detail
* Should possess skills pertaining to drafting different agreements or legal documents
* Knowledge of Companies Act, FEMA, Import-Export, Labour laws etc.
* Strong administrative skills and an aptitude for using IT software

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Minimum CS qualified
* Fresher to 2 years of experience
* Experience in the financial services industry would be preferred
* Excellent fluency in English, both verbal and in writing

title: Manager, Employment Tax
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Employment Tax
  
  
**Overview**
This role is responsible for supporting global employment tax compliance, advisory, risk management, and project execution activities. The role serves as a key technical resource and works closely with regional stakeholders and external advisors to ensure operational excellence and compliance across global employment tax processes.
  
  
**Role**

* Support internal stakeholders on federal, state, and local employment tax compliance activities, such as reviewing tax notices, statutory tax filings, and reconciliations
* Assist in research to support tax positions, resolve multi-state withholding issues, reciprocity agreements, nonresident allocation questions, and cross-border tax implications
* Assist in taxation and reporting of equity compensation and incentive plans (RSUs, stock options, ESPP, ISIP-type plans) across jurisdictions, including year-end true-ups, and recharge arrangement considerations.
* Provide tax guidance to cross-functional partners on the employment tax implications of compensation, benefits, travel & expense programs, and remote/flexible work arrangements globally.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop processes and procedures to ensure accurate tax reporting and withholdings on employee compensation and benefits including long-term incentives and bonus plans
* Assist with tax authority notices and audits across jurisdictions, including gathering documentation and support related worker classification and permanent establishment risk assessments.
* Partner with Payroll Operations and third-party payroll providers (e.g., ADP, Workday, and local vendors) to validate tax configurations, review payroll tax reconciliations, year-end reporting, and country-specific reporting requirements.
* Support M&A due diligence and People & Capability’s integration activities
* Monitor changes in employment tax law across regions, analyze the impact on Mastercard and communicate changes with management
* Support SOX and financial statement audit requests related to payroll tax

**All About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Law, or a related field.
* Prior experience at a Big Four firm, multinational in-house tax function, or regional shared-services organization.
* Solid working knowledge of federal and multi-state/ country payroll tax withholding, plus working knowledge of statutory employer payroll tax and social security obligations in US and other international jurisdictions
* Experience supporting tax authority audits (U.S. and/or international).
* Experience with equity compensation tax reporting and coordination with Stock Administration, and with global equity plan administration and multi-jurisdictional incentive plan tax reporting.
* Track record of identifying and driving operational improvements and adopting market-standard methodologies to improve global compliance process efficiency and effectiveness.
* Experience with payroll systems (e.g., ADP, Workday, SAP) and payroll tax engines.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and cross-cultural written/verbal communication skills; comfort working across time zones and in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in calculations, tables, and automation tools to process and analyze large volumes of payroll tax data across multiple jurisdictions.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Cinépolis India, a subsidiary of Mexico-based Cinépolis, is the first international cinema exhibitor to establish operations in India. Cinépolis India is known for introducing innovative concepts to the exhibition industry and for its customer-focused loyalty program, Club Cinépolis, which offers rewards, pre-screening invites, and celebrity interactions. title: Assistant Purchasing Manager - IT / Telecom
description:
The Assistant Manager - SCM will oversee day-to-day supply chain operations, including procurement, inventory control, logistics coordination, and vendor management. The role requires hands-on proficiency in Tally ERP for transaction and inventory records and advanced Excel skills for analysis and reporting, so that materials are available at the right time, quantity, and cost.

**Procurement and vendor management**

* Raise purchase requisitions and purchase orders, and follow up to ensure timely delivery.
* Source, evaluate, and develop vendors; negotiate prices, credit terms, and delivery schedules.
* Maintain vendor performance records (quality, delivery, pricing) and conduct periodic reviews.
* Obtain and compare quotations, and prepare comparative statements.

**Logistics and distribution**

* Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound transportation with transporters and 3PL partners.
* Track shipments, resolve delays or damages, and verify freight bills.
* Ensure compliance with e-way bill, GST, and other statutory documentation.

**Tally ERP and accounting coordination**

* Record purchase, sales, stock journal, and inventory vouchers in Tally ERP accurately and on time.
* Reconcile vendor ledgers, and coordinate with the accounts team on bill passing, payments, and GST input credit matching.
* Generate stock summary, ageing, purchase register, and outstanding reports from Tally.

**Reporting and analysis (Excel)**

* Prepare MIS reports on purchases, inventory, cost savings, lead times, and stock turnover.
* Use Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, IF logic, conditional formatting, charts) to analyse data and support decisions.
* Track KPIs such as OTIF, inventory days, stock-out rate, and procurement cost variance.

**Team and cross-functional coordination**

* Supervise and guide junior SCM, store, and dispatch staff.
* Coordinate with production, sales, finance, and quality teams to align supply with demand.
* Support process improvement and cost reduction initiatives.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or Engineering. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain or Operations is preferred.
* 4-7 years of experience in procurement, inventory, or supply chain, including at least 1-2 years in a supervisory role.

**Skills and Competencies**

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime: vouchers, inventory masters, GST, and reports.
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and data cleaning; basic MIS dashboarding is a plus.
* Understanding of GST, e-way bills, and purchase/inventory documentation.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant provides executive support in a one-on-one working relationship. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters involving the CEO. The Executive Assistant also serves as a liaison to the Core Committee and senior management teams; organizes and coordinates executive outreach and external relations efforts; and oversees special projects. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure and travel at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

**IF SELECTED WILLING TO RELOCATE TO NOIDA ONLY APPLY**

**Specific responsibilities:**

* Completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the CEO, including managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel-related meetings. Plans, coordinates, and ensures the CEO's schedule is followed and respected. Provides "gatekeeper" and "gateway" roles, creating win-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office
* Communicates directly, on behalf of the CEO, with the Core Committee, Administration, HR, Operations, Branches, Zonal managers, Processing, Accounts, legal, etc.

* Works closely and effectively with the CEO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a "barometer," having a sense of the issues taking place in the environment and keeping the CEO updated.
* Provides leadership to build relationships crucial to the success of the organization, and manages a variety of projects for the CEO, some of which may have organizational impact.
* Completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands-on approach, including drafting acknowledgement letters, personal correspondence, and other tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the company.
* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, and proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

title: Customer Success Manager, North America Region - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

About the Role:
  

We are seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager to own and manage a portfolio of key Commercial/Enterprise US based accounts.

  

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to IT executives (Director Security, CIOs, CISOs, VPs/Directors of IT), driving deep product adoption, customer retention, and long-term value realization. You will partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to champion customer needs, mitigate churn risks, and unlock expansion opportunities.

**Key Duties & Responsibilities:**
  

  
* Strategic Account Management: Develop deep, multi-threaded relationships with key executive decision-makers and stakeholders across Commercial/Enterprise accounts. Build and execute tailored Customer Success Plans aligned with client business outcomes.
  
* Onboarding & Time to Value: Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to guide complex onboarding initiatives, ensuring swift time-to-value and adoption across hybrid IT environments.
  
* Adoption & Risk Mitigation: Proactively monitor portfolio health, user engagement, leverage AI and data to address adoption bottlenecks and potential churn risks early.
  
* QBRs / Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Prepare and facilitate strategic, metrics-driven quarterly and executive business reviews with key client leaders to showcase ROI, benchmark health, and align on strategic roadmaps.
  
* Growth & Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to co-develop joint strategic account plans, identify expansion/upsell opportunities, and drive strong Gross Retention Rates (GRR)
  
* Customer Advocacy & Escalation: Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic account escalations. Advocate for customer product enhancements with Product and Engineering leadership to influence product roadmap priorities.
  
* Subject Matter Expertise: Maintain a deep technical understanding of JumpCloud’s platform capabilities, modern IT architectures, and industry trends to advise customers on security and identity best practices.
  
  

  
**How Success Will Be Measured**

  
* Net Retention Rate (NRR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across your assigned portfolio
  
* Customer Health, Platform Adoption, and Product Engagement
  
* Onboarding Time-to-Value (TTV) for key accounts
  
* Identification and pipeline contribution of qualified Expansion/Upsell opportunities
  
* Leading cross-functional collaboration and initiatives
  
  

**We’re Looking For:**

  
* Experience: 4+ years of customer-facing experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management, managing Commercial/Enterprise accounts
  
* Technical Acumen: Strong SaaS product industry knowledge. Preferred domain knowledge in IT infrastructure, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, SSO/MFA, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Zero Trust, and Security/System Administration.
  
* Executive Presence: Proven track record of building trust and commanding credibility with IT Managers, Leaders, VPs, and technical stakeholders.
  
* Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex customer requirements, evaluate account health metrics, and construct actionable success plans.
  
* Communication: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
  
* Proactive Problem Solving: A self-starter with strong organization, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills in a high-growth, remote-first environment.

  



**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  
  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  
  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  
  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

  
  

#BI-Remote

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Us**
Ctruh is a deep-tech company building the infrastructure layer for the spatial internet through a proprietary browser-native, no-code 3D engine and VersaAI, our in-house generative AI engine that transforms text, images, and video into production-ready 3D assets in minutes.
  
  
**Our Work Rhythm**
This is a 6-day working setup with Monday to Friday operating from office and Saturday as Work From Home (WFH). We believe this model enables stronger collaboration, faster learning, and better team alignment while maintaining flexibility.
  
  
**About The Role**
As our Customer Success Manager, you will be our customers' long-term partner, from their first immersive experience going live to renewal and beyond. You will make sure every enterprise customer gets from kickoff to measurable business results, such as higher conversion, fewer returns and more engagement, and that they renew and grow with us. Immersive commerce is still a new category, so you will also write the playbook. You will shape how Ctruh onboards, measures value and expands accounts, and you will be one of the strongest voices of the customer inside the company. This role reports to the Business Head and works closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and the 3D content team.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Portfolio ownership: Own a book of enterprise and mid-market accounts end to end, covering onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion.
* Onboarding and time-to-value: Run structured kickoffs and implementation plans. Coordinate asset ingestion, 3D/AR experience builds and integrations with the customer's website and e-commerce stack so customers go live fast.
* Value realisation: Work with each customer to define success metrics such as conversion uplift, time on page, return-rate reduction and content-production savings. Then track and prove them through dashboards and Quarterly/Executive Business Reviews.
* Retention and growth: Own gross and net revenue retention for your portfolio. Spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities (new SKUs, categories, geographies, new experience types) and close them with Sales.
* Account health: Build and keep up health scores, spot churn risk early and run recovery plans.
* Voice of the customer: Turn customer feedback, feature requests and usage patterns into clear, prioritised input for Product and Engineering, and close the loop with customers.
* Playbooks and process: Build Ctruh's CS foundation, including onboarding playbooks, success plans, QBR templates, help-centre content and escalation paths. Set up CS tooling in the CRM.
* Advocacy: Turn happy customers into case studies, references, testimonials and partners for marketing and new-market launches.
* Escalations: Act as the senior point of contact for critical issues. Coordinate across support, engineering and the 3D content team until they are resolved.

**What You Bring**

* 3-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management or Client Services, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS.
* A track record of managing enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders, including CMOs, e-commerce heads and digital/D2C leaders at consumer brands, retailers or OEMs.
* Proven ownership of renewals and expansion revenue, with numbers to show for it (NRR/GRR, churn reduction, upsell value).
* Hands-on experience running onboarding/implementation and executive business reviews.
* Enough technical comfort to discuss web/e-commerce platforms, APIs, embeds and analytics with a customer's tech team, and to translate between them and our engineers.
* Strong data skills: you build health scores, read usage data and make the business case in numbers.
* Excellent written and spoken communication, and confidence presenting to senior leaders.
* Fluency with CRM and CS tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Freshdesk, Intercom or a CS platform.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience in e-commerce tech, martech, retail tech or D2C enablement platforms (e.g. personalisation, product content, visual commerce, CX tools).
* Exposure to 3D, AR/VR, gaming, creative or GenAI products.
* Experience with customers in automotive, real estate, fashion/apparel, furniture/home décor, jewellery or luxury.
* Experience as an early CS hire who built the function at a seed or Series A startup.
* Experience handling international accounts, especially in the US or Middle East.
* Experience with CS platforms (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Vitally, Planhat) or product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude).

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* Builders, not maintainers. You enjoy setting up a function from scratch, and messy, undefined problems energise you.
* Outcome-obsessed. You measure success by the business results your customers get, not by how many calls you logged.
* Commercially sharp. You are comfortable with commercial conversations and see expansion as a natural result of value delivered.
* Curious about new technology. You want to deeply understand 3D, XR and GenAI, and you can explain them to a non-technical marketing head.
* High ownership with low ego. At a fast-growing team of around 50 people, you will run an EBR in the morning and write a help article in the afternoon.
* Collaborative. You work well with founders, engineers and designers, and you push back thoughtfully when the customer's interest calls for it.

title: Senior Manager - Advisory Account Management
description:
Software should help a business move as one. But too often, disconnected systems, scattered data, and fragmented workflows get in the way.
  
  
  
  
Freshworks is building a better way: AI-powered, unified service operations that turn complexity into coordinated action. Our platform brings together people, AI, data, and workflows so IT and service teams can anticipate what matters, act faster, and keep the business moving forward together. Organizations including Bridgestone, McLaren, New Balance, S&P Global, and Sony Music trust Freshworks to power the services their employees and customers depend on every day.
  
  
  
  
We bring that same belief in coordinated action to how we work by giving people the ownership to make bold moves at speed, and a team that moves with them.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a commercially driven, hands-on leader to own growth and retention across NA region. This role combines Account Management and Customer Success, with accountability for accelerating expansion, controlling churn, and achieving or exceeding net revenue targets. As a player-coach, you will lead critical customer engagements, build predictable execution, strengthen AM/CSM capabilities, and establish a culture of ownership, accountability and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
  
  
  
Drive expansion and net revenue
  
  
  
  
Own expansion and net revenue outcomes; accelerate upsell, cross-sell and whitespace opportunities through strong account planning, pipeline creation and deal execution. Identify gaps early and drive recovery plans to achieve or exceed targets.
  
  
  
  
Protect retention and prevent churn
  
  
  
  
Own renewals, gross retention and churn prevention. Proactively identify at-risk customers, establish clear mitigation plans, and personally lead critical renewal, save and escalation conversations. Strengthen adoption, customer value and executive engagement.
  
  
  
  
Build a predictable, data-driven business
  
  
  
  
Own forecasts for expansion, renewals, churn and net revenue. Establish daily execution and weekly pipeline/risk reviews, supported by clear input metrics such as customer engagement, pipeline progression, adoption and renewal readiness. Improve forecast accuracy through evidence-based reviews and timely interventions.
  
  
  
  
Lead and coach a high-performing team
  
  
  
  
Coach Account Managers and Customer Success Managers on commercial execution and customer success fundamentals. Set clear goals and productivity standards, join customer calls, model best practices, develop talent and address underperformance directly and fairly.
  
  
  
  
Raise operational discipline and team culture
  
  
  
  
Build a culture of accountability, urgency, professionalism and collaboration. Set expectations for punctuality, preparation, customer engagement and follow-through. Address behaviors that undermine morale or performance, keeping discussions constructive, fact-based and focused on outcomes.
  
  
  
  
Lead from the front and collaborate
  
  
  
  
Demonstrate strong consultative selling, account planning, negotiation, adoption, value realization and renewal skills. Stay close to portfolio execution and partner with Sales, Support, Product, Finance and other teams to resolve issues and unlock growth.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of overall experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, Account Management, Customer Success, renewals or expansion.
* A strong track record of delivering expansion, retention and net revenue results, with solid AM and CSM fundamentals.
* Commercial acumen, consultative selling, customer relationship management and complex negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical and forecasting capabilities, with experience using leading indicators and performance metrics to drive action.
* Ability to coach, manage performance, build team capability and foster an accountable, collaborative culture.
* A self-driven, hands-on mindset with urgency, ownership and the ability to balance leadership with direct customer execution.

People management experience is an added advantage; strong individual contributors with demonstrated coaching and leadership capability will also be considered.
  
  
  
  
Measures of Success
  
  
  
  
Achieve or exceed expansion and net revenue targets; improve retention and reduce preventable churn; deliver healthy pipeline and reliable forecasts; raise customer engagement and team productivity; strengthen AM/CSM capability; and build a high-performance culture grounded in ownership and accountability.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Engagement Manager, Healthcare SaaS | Enterprise Clients | EHR Implementation
description:

🕒 UK business-hours overlap

🤝 Engagement Management | Enterprise Healthcare Clients | Implementation Governance | Healthcare SaaS

**🚀 Own the relationship with UK enterprise healthcare clients, from contract to live service**

Script Assist is creating a new
**Engagement Manager**
role to own our largest UK enterprise healthcare accounts.

You will be accountable for engagement success, executive stakeholder alignment and delivery quality across two to three enterprise clients. You'll report directly to our COO.

This role is built for an
**Engagement Manager, Engagement Owner or Client Delivery Manager**
on healthcare implementations. You'll have worked on
**Oracle Health (Cerner), Epic, Innovaccer**
or another healthcare platform, and you still understand the build underneath.

**🌍 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the operating system for next-generation private healthcare in the UK. Clinics, pharmacies and patients run on one platform across onboarding, consultations, prescribing, repeats, dispensing, fulfilment, payments and follow-up.

* **500,000+ prescriptions**
  processed, with tens of thousands more every month
* Used by clinics, pharmacies and enterprise healthcare operators
* Deeply configurable, multi-tenant healthcare SaaS
* Pathways across medical cannabis, ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine
* Expanding into new healthcare markets and enterprise accounts

Every enterprise client runs its own configuration and has its own executive stakeholders, compliance demands and launch timelines. Owning all of that for each client is this role.

**🎯 The role**

As Engagement Manager, you will be the single accountable owner for each enterprise client:

* Engagement planning and mobilisation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Implementation governance
* Steering committees and QBRs
* Scope, change requests and change control
* Risk, issue and escalation management
* Go-live readiness and launch
* Live service and account health
* Client runbooks and documentation

An implementation consultant handles hands-on configuration on each account. You own the plan, the relationship and the outcome.

**📋 Implementation governance**

* Build and run enterprise implementation plans
* Set governance cadence: weekly calls, steering committees, QBRs
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks and issues
* Control scope and run change requests
* Coordinate product, engineering, clinical and pharmacy teams
* Make go / no-go decisions with clients
* Hand over cleanly into live service

**🔐 Enterprise security and compliance**

Enterprise healthcare clients run detailed vendor due diligence. You will own the process and its timeline:

* InfoSec and vendor security questionnaires
* DPIAs and data processing agreements
* ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and penetration-test evidence
* Clinical safety documentation (DCB0129 / DCB0160)
* NHS DSPT and GDPR requirements
* SLA and contract schedules

**🧩 Platform depth**

Script Assist is deeply configurable, and you'll learn it well enough to:

* Judge solutions live on client calls
* Challenge configuration decisions
* Spot workarounds within the current product
* Know when a request needs product change
* Enforce peer review of configuration changes

**🗣 Client leadership**

* Act as the senior day-to-day contact for client executives
* Push back clearly when a request is out of scope, unsafe or unrealistic
* Lead difficult conversations on timelines, scope and priorities
* Act as the first point of escalation
* Report account risk to the COO

**🔎 Relevant previous experience**

This role may particularly suit someone currently or previously working as a:

* Engagement Manager
* Senior Engagement Manager
* Engagement Owner
* Senior Engagement Owner
* Customer Engagement Manager
* Client Engagement Manager
* Client Delivery Manager
* Delivery Manager (Healthcare IT)
* Implementation Manager (Enterprise)
* Program Manager, Client Implementations
* Technical Account Manager (Enterprise Healthcare)

Your exact title matters less than your experience. You should have been personally accountable for enterprise healthcare clients through implementation and go-live.

**✅ What we're looking for**

* 7+ years in healthcare IT implementation, consulting or healthcare SaaS
* 3+ years owning client engagements as Engagement Manager, Engagement Owner, Delivery Manager or equivalent
* Hands-on build or configuration experience earlier in your career (Oracle Health / Cerner, Epic, eClinicalWorks or similar)
* Two or more enterprise go-lives owned end to end
* Steering committee and executive stakeholder experience
* Confidence pushing back on senior client stakeholders
* Onsite or direct client experience with UK, US, Middle East or other international healthcare organisations
* Clear written and spoken English

**⭐ Particularly valuable**

title: Program Manager
description:
At Verint, we’re helping shape what is next in customer experience. As a leader in CX automation, we are creating a future where people and AI-powered bots work together to help some of the world’s most iconic brands achieve real business outcomes. Powered by our next-generation Verint Open Platform, we are continuing to grow, innovate, and push the boundaries of what is possible with AI.

We are bringing together passionate people with diverse voices, perspectives, and expertise who want to push what is possible, make an impact, and help shape the future of AI-powered customer experience. If you are excited by who we are, where we are going, and what we are building together, we want to hear from you!

**About the Role:**
===================

As a key member of Professional Services, the role of the Program Manager is to serve as a customer advocate and is responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of strategic or enterprise programs requiring the implementation and enablement of Verint technology solutions across all product lines. These programs are managed within an established budget, defined scope and forecasted timeline, to consistently achieve program margin and other financial targets and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the program life cycle. Additionally, the Program Manager is responsible for building and maintaining ongoing internal and customer relationships, while developing and earning the trust of all program stakeholders. The Program Manager has an advanced understanding of the Verint product suite, of the delivery process, and can manage complex engagements with a broad range of internal and customer stakeholders, potentially including third-party providers and other vendors.

**As a Program Manager, you will:**
===================================

* Manages complex program-level engagements and implementations.
* Responsible for program objectives, defined scope and achieving the conditions of success that serve as major program milestones and require interim or final customer sign-off for approval.
* Participates in Sales-to-Services mobilization activities and/or reviews all pre-Sales documents and informs Sales and Contracts of potential technical, logistical, project scheduling or business issues, and liaisons with internal departments to ensure necessary program needs and goals are being met.
* Reviews of pre-Sales and Sales documentation to ensure the overall Professional Services effort and deliverables are accurately scoped and defined.
* At the conclusion of each critical program, creates a program summary outlining both strengths and shortcomings of the program management process and perceived customer experience.
* Leads a program team, including customer stakeholders and other potential third-party resources through either a traditional or agile program lifecycle. Trains, mentors and guides program teammates to drive successful outcomes.
* Interacts regularly with the PMO Director, keeping them informed of program progress and seeking guidance where needed to ensure overall program success and customer satisfaction.
* Completes standard and ad hoc status reporting requirements.
* Effectively coordinates the allocation of program resources with the functional managers and other Project Managers in order to maintain program deployment schedules.
* Accountable for adhering to the escalation process for installation issue resolution and managing the final “go/no-go” decision for installation deployment.
* Develops and monitors the program schedule and defines milestones to accurately know the percentage complete based on hours consumed and impact to revenue recognition.
* Updates and regularly maintains the program budget forecast and ensures timesheet adherence for timely financial reporting.
* Creates, gathers approval and executes Change Orders as required.
* Establishes and maintains client-focused professional relationships with all customers and business executives to facilitate transparent, honest and timely communication.
* Stays attuned to changes in the customer’s business and technology environment, as well as organization and culture that could adversely affect the efforts of Verint Systems, Inc.
* Attends required product and services training and related demonstrations to acquire a fundamental understanding of Verint’s product suite and business advisory services.
* Engages in special programs as assigned by PMO leadership.

**Requirements you will need to be successful:**
================================================

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
* 6+ years of experience in technical program or project management, process improvement, management consulting, and/or customer relationship management.
* Demonstrated experience in leading enterprise scale software deployments of $250K or greater.
* Past demonstrated experience in managing projects or programs in a complex environment.
* Experience leading to complex implementations that require strong integration across lifecycle components using critical thinking and problem solving.
* Program financial management experience; inclusive of developing and maintaining program level budgeting and forecasting.
* Ability to effectively lead a cross-functional team without direct reporting responsibility in a manner that achieves desired business results.
* Effectively demonstrates a leadership presence when dealing with senior leaders; can remain composed, focused and productive when confronted with escalated issues or unanticipated change.
* Must possess Executive level communication skills, determining their purpose, impact, and appropriate timing without coaching. Must be able to effectively communicate with Executive Level Clients; this includes setting client expectations, the ability to deliver sub-optimal updates, and deftly deal with escalations.
* Experience in project lifecycle activities and tasks .
* Consulting experience translating model and business process knowledge to clients.
* Ability to manage and conduct resource requirements analysis.
* Up to 25% of travel is required.
* Software specific working knowledge required of the following: Smartsheet, Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and FinancialForce.

**Requirements that will differentiate your candidacy:**
========================================================

* Contact Center industry or Back-Office Operations experience a plus
* PMP or PgMP certified.
* Experience in Process Improvement or workflow consulting a plus.
* Highly motivated individual driven to keep pace in a fast moving and dynamic environment. Ability to adapt to rapid change.
* Proven ability to influence others, demonstrated leadership and management skills.
* The ability to interface with all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrate a high level of integrity in all business dealings.

At Verint, our values are more than words. They are how we work together every day. We operate as One Team, embrace Continuous Innovation, communicate openly with Zero Daylight, bring a Bias to Action, and stay Customer Powered in the decisions we make. Together, these values guide how we collaborate, innovate, and deliver meaningful impact.

Our people are at the heart of Verint, and we are committed to supporting their well-being. We offer a variety of benefits that includes paid time off, health and wellness benefits, and retirement benefits, based on eligibility and local requirements.
