title: Account Manager — Client Retention & Sales
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$35,000–C$45,000 annually, including base pay and performance bonuses
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage existing client relationships, retain dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, sell relevant services, and keep multiple active files moving from beginning to completion.
  
  
MoveSmart operates in residential leasing, but direct real-estate experience is preferred—not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
  
  
You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will coordinate the leasing process, monitor listing performance, present applications and offers, recommend changes, and keep the owner informed through tenant move-in.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service or administrative position. You will be responsible for both the client relationship and the commercial performance of your assigned files.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Manage multiple active client and leasing files
* Keep property owners informed throughout the process
* Confirm that each file is complete and ready to be listed
* Coordinate listing requirements with the partner brokerage
* Monitor inquiries, showings, feedback, applications, and offers
* Identify why a property is not attracting interest or offers
* Recommend pricing, marketing, presentation, or property-condition changes
* Persuade owners to make reasonable price adjustments
* Present qualified tenant offers and secure timely decisions
* Retain dissatisfied owners who may be considering cancellation
* Sell appropriate services that could improve a property’s leasing performance
* Handle objections while maintaining the owner’s trust
* Coordinate documents, deposits, keys, and move-in requirements
* Communicate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams
* Verify payment and payout information before providing updates
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and next steps
* Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, client success, client retention, leasing, property management, portfolio management, or a similar client-facing role
* Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales
* Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to take action
* Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering relationships
* Confidence recommending price changes, service improvements, or other actions clients may initially resist
* Ability to use evidence, customer feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions
* Experience upselling relevant services or solutions
* Ability to manage multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities simultaneously
* Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management
* Experience using a structured CRM or workflow system
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Sound judgment when handling client concerns and escalations
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours

Strong candidates may come from account management, customer success, SaaS, insurance, financial services, staffing, telecommunications, automotive sales, hospitality, property management, real estate, or another service-based industry involving ongoing client ownership.
  
  
Canadian real-estate experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live scenario-based interview.
  
  
**Compensation**
This position offers expected annual compensation of approximately
**C$35,000–C$45,000**
, consisting of base pay plus performance bonuses.
  
  
Actual earnings will depend on individual performance. Complete compensation terms will be explained during the interview process.
  
  
Remote-Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A private professional workspace
* Dual monitors
* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Reliable internet of at least 100 Mbps
* A webcam
* A noise-cancelling headset

Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person combines the organization of an experienced Account Manager with the confidence of a consultative salesperson.
  
  
You should be able to identify what is preventing a client’s file from progressing, explain the evidence, recommend a solution, overcome resistance, and obtain a clear decision.
  
  
You must be persuasive without being misleading or overly aggressive. You should be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations while maintaining the client’s trust.

title: Service Delivery Manager – GAM & CSM
description:
**Role**

The Service Delivery Manager – GAM & CSM will oversee day-to-day operational activities and service delivery across both teams, ensuring reliable, secure and customer-focused services within their respective agreed scopes. The role combines operational leadership, capacity planning, escalation management and service governance, with accountability for service performance, process consistency and continual improvement.

GAM combines L1/L2/L3 access management support tiers with Lean ways of working and follow-the-sun delivery. CSM operates as a managed-service team. The Service Delivery Manager will maintain consistent operational oversight across both teams while preserving the responsibilities, workflows, service commitments and measures appropriate to each model.

**Role Overview**

·      Lead GAM service delivery across L1 Access Management Analysts, L2 Access Management Specialists and L3 Lead Access Management Engineers, ensuring clear ownership, effective handovers and timely escalation.

·      Oversee CSM managed-service operations against agreed service scope, service levels and customer outcomes, with clear delivery ownership, stakeholder communication and service review arrangements.

·      Drive accountability, team development and operational excellence across both teams using Lean and ITIL-aligned practices, balancing daily demand, service quality, capacity and improvement priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

·      
**Service ownership:**
Own overall operational service performance and user experience across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scope, service levels and support guidelines. Maintain clear responsibilities, workflows, priorities and escalation paths for each team.

·      
**GAM tiered operations:**
Coordinate daily activities across L1, L2 and L3. Ensure L1 handles standard access requests, identity checks and Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes; L2 resolves escalated and complex requests, supports access reviews and maintains runbooks; and L3 provides expert escalation support, root cause analysis, governance, automation definition and knowledge ownership.

·      
**CSM managed-service delivery:**
Oversee delivery against the agreed service model and customer commitments. Maintain visibility of service scope, deliverables, dependencies, risks and outstanding actions, with clear ownership and follow-through rather than assuming GAM’s tiered structure applies to CSM.

·      
**Service levels and reporting:**
Monitor SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, service consistency, workload and ageing. Use separate views for GAM and CSM so differences in demand, delivery commitments and outcomes remain visible; agree measures and targets appropriate to each service.

·      
**Escalations and service recovery:**
Lead operational escalation coordination, prioritisation and stakeholder communications. Ensure critical issues have clear resolution owners and that recurring incidents lead to root cause investigation and corrective actions.

·      
**Demand, capacity and supplier coordination:**
Oversee workload distribution, resource coverage and capacity planning with team leads and L3 engineers. Balance daily operations with improvement work and planned demand, escalating resource constraints and delivery risks. Provide resource and cost forecasts to support planning, and coordinate supplier dependencies within agreed responsibilities and delegated authority.

·      
**Process and knowledge management:**
Maintain consistent incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management practices. Ensure teams use current procedures, runbooks and knowledge articles, while preserving workflows appropriate to each service model.

·      
**Governance and compliance:**
Ensure operational activities follow access policies, controls and audit requirements. Coordinate evidence collection, access governance activities, risk assessments and remediation tracking with the responsible teams.

·      
**Stakeholder and customer engagement:**
Act as the operational point of contact for business stakeholders and service customers. Lead regular service reviews covering performance, risks, escalations, customer feedback and improvement actions for GAM and CSM.

·      
**Automation roadmap and prioritisation:**
Own the operational automation backlog across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scopes. Identify opportunities in recurring access requests, Joiner/Mover/Leaver activities, request routing, reporting and evidence collection. Prioritise opportunities using workload, manual effort, error patterns, customer impact, risk and feasibility. Define business requirements, expected benefits and acceptance criteria with service stakeholders, and coordinate delivery with L3 engineers and automation or platform owners. Lead operational acceptance and adoption, with technical design and implementation owned by the relevant technical teams.

·      
**Continual improvement:**
Drive Lean improvements, standardisation and reduction of process variability. Prioritise opportunities to reduce manual work, repeat incidents and unnecessary escalations, coordinating automation delivery with technical owners.

·      
**Team development:**
Support training, coaching, mentoring and knowledge transfer across both teams. Work with GAM L3 engineers to strengthen L1/L2 capability and ensure CSM has the knowledge and coverage needed for its managed-service commitments.

·      
**Operational handovers:**
Coordinate with application, product, project and technical teams so new or changed services have clear support ownership, documented procedures, knowledge transfer and capacity considerations before operational handover.

**Required Qualifications**

·      Experience leading service delivery, IT operations or infrastructure support, demonstrated through responsibility for service levels, incident and change coordination, and cross-functional delivery. Ability to oversee both multi-level support teams and managed-service delivery, with clear accountability for each service model.

·      Ability to lead and develop teams, coordinate workloads and capacity, and establish clear operational ownership across different service models.

·      Good understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge and continual service improvement practices.

·      Understanding of access management operations, including Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes, provisioning and deprovisioning, escalation paths, access governance and audit requirements.

·      Ability to manage service levels, analyse operational reporting and customer feedback, and translate findings into practical improvement actions.

·      Strong stakeholder communication, customer engagement and escalation management skills, including leading service reviews and coordinating issue resolution.

·      Experience with process standardisation and continuous improvement, supported by strong organisational, analytical and mentoring skills.

·      Advanced or fluent English and the ability to communicate clearly with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

·      ITIL certification and Lean certification or practical Lean improvement experience.

·      Experience leading geographically distributed support teams, coordinating cross-regional handovers and maintaining consistent processes. Experience overseeing access management within a Lean, global support structure, including follow-the-sun delivery, is an advantage.

·      Experience managing customer-facing managed services, including scope boundaries, service commitments, reporting and service improvement plans.

·      Familiarity with ServiceNow or comparable ticketing and workflow systems, reporting dashboards, knowledge management and collaboration tools.

Familiarity with SAP authorisations, identity management platforms and opportunities to automate recurring

description:
**Travel & Expense (T&E) - Manager**
**Company Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm’s employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
  
  
As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
  
  
**Division Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a worldwide leader in investment banking and is one of the top firms in mergers and acquisitions, underwriting equity and equity-related transactions, corporate debt issuance, and high-yield debt financing. With professionals in 30 countries, we are consistently recognized for our performance in both traditional and innovative financing techniques, helping a wide range of clients around the world to make and execute decisions about their business strategy and financial structure.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Investment Banking Division and Global Capital Markets (IBD/GCM) Groups provide industry, regional and product expertise to corporations, institutions, and government clients in order to develop and execute innovative and customized solutions to the most challenging strategic and financing issues faced in the global marketplace.
  
  
The Investment Banking Group is comprised of a number of industry coverage groups which work closely with Global Capital Markets teams to provide product structuring and creativity, relevant market insight, and execution expertise to clients. These solutions include initial public offerings; public and private equity and equity-linked financings; mergers, acquisitions, and restructurings; defense advisory assignments; strategic partnerships; public and private debt placements; share repurchases; and hedging, swaps and derivative transactions.
  
  
**Team Profile**
Expense Hub Team within IBD/GCM Management supports IBD/GCM bankers globally with preparing expense reports, vendor onboarding, vendor invoice processing, Travel request review and approval. Team works closely with respective core region, bankers and assistants to ensure expenses reported accurately in compliance with firm policy, Travel requests are reviewed to facilitate business requirements with regards to meetings and project executions across client locations.
  
  
**Summary: Primary Role**
The Manager – Travel & Expense will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for travel approvals, leading a team responsible for reviewing and approving travel requisitions across APAC and EMEA regions. The role requires sound judgment, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to make timely decisions while ensuring compliance with firm travel policies. The individual will provide guidance to the team, manage escalations, maintain process documentation, and partner with stakeholders to ensure seamless travel operations.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5–7+ years of experience in Travel & Expense (T&E) operations.
* Prior experience managing or supervising a team in the current or previous role.
* Strong knowledge of travel approval processes, travel policies, and expense management (Concur experience preferred).
* Good understanding of global geography and international travel itineraries.
* Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to ask relevant questions and interact professionally with stakeholders.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy and quality.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Flexible to work in rotational shifts:

+ APAC: 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM
+ EMEA: 3:30 PM – 12:30 AM

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.
* Use AI tools to re-define existing process and create efficiencies
* Willing to carry and respond to Firm-issued mobile device emails and voicemails as required.

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Travel Review & Approval**

* Review and approve travel requisitions for APAC and EMEA bankers within defined service levels.
* Validate travel itineraries, including flight and hotel bookings, ensuring compliance with company travel policies.
* Assess business justification for travel, identify cost exceptions, and determine the appropriateness of requests.
* Evaluate incomplete or ambiguous requests by asking relevant and precise questions to obtain required information before making decisions.
* Exercise sound judgment to approve, reject, or return travel requests based on policy and business requirements.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of global geography to accurately assess travel destinations and itineraries.
* Handle time-sensitive travel approvals with accuracy while maintaining composure under pressure.

**Team Leadership & SME Responsibilities**

* Act as the Travel Approval SME for the team and provide guidance on complex travel-related queries and policy interpretations.
* Support and coach team members on travel approval processes, decision-making, and quality standards.
* Handle escalations, complex travel scenarios, and priority requests with confidence and professionalism.
* Drive consistency, quality, and compliance across all travel approval activities.
* Ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge repositories are maintained and kept up to date.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Respond promptly to multiple stakeholder queries, travel-related requests, and PNR (Passenger Name Record) inquiries.
* Build effective relationships with bankers, travel coordinators, and internal stakeholders through professional and timely communication.
* Ensure clear, concise, and accurate written communication while resolving travel-related concerns.

**General Responsibilities**

* Support Concur Expense submission reviews and related queries.
* Review and process invoices while ensuring compliance with established controls.
* Support new vendor maintenance and enrolment activities.
* Ensure high levels of accuracy and compliance across all operational processes.
* Maintain operational documentation, process updates, and knowledge articles.
* Monitor workload and prioritize tasks effectively to meet turnaround times and service level agreements.
* Work collaboratively across functions and support team members as business requirements evolve.
* Demonstrate flexibility in supporting different business groups and bankers as organizational needs change.
* Carry, use, and respond to Firm-issued mobile device emails and voicemails as required.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives and operational excellence.
* Make good use of Artificial intelligence in order to make processes efficient.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: ROV Supervisor
description:
****Job Description****
**Who we are**
Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative, but work well within a team.
  
  
****Job Purpose****
Oversees remotely operated vehicle operations at the worksite, ensuring safety, efficiency and precision. Leads the offshore ROV team through planning, execution and close-out of subsea projects, drives proactive maintenance and system administration, resolves technical issues and builds collaborative relationships with the client, vessel and onshore teams to deliver seamless project execution. Is accountable for compliance with IMCA R 004 minimum shift manning and for initiating a management of change and task risk assessment whenever manning or method deviates from the approved standard Aligns daily with the party chief, project managers, survey and engineering teams and safety officers to integrate operational goals with project timelines and safety protocols.
  
  
Liaises closely with the vessel Master, particularly on DP vessels, recognising the Master's legal responsibility for overall vessel safety. Interfaces with the client representative onboard, promoting Fugro capability and flagging operational or commercial opportunities to the onshore project manager. Coordinates with technical support and procurement on spares, defects and system readiness.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Operational Oversight and Worksite Focal Point**

* Direct and supervise ROV operations to ensure adherence to project goals, work scope and safety protocols.
* Prepare for each dive with accurate knowledge of forecast weather, concurrent vessel/diving/technical operations and data acquisition requirements.
* Conduct crew pre-dive briefings covering HSE rules, risk assessment, methodology, ROV route, data protocols, contingency actions and task assignment.
* Notify the OIM, vessel Master, superintendent, party chief, diving supervisor, deck foreman and client representative before operations commence.
* Take effective control of emergency situations, managing personnel and equipment towards a satisfactory outcome.
* Provide clear, complete shift handovers and keep onshore management updated on ongoing and future developments.

**HSE Leadership**

* Organize and manage the safety of the ROV team through safety briefings, risk assessments, toolbox talks, drills, hazard and incident reporting and permit-to-work compliance.
* Drive Fugro's no-blame culture and reinforce Stop Work Authority for every crew member and third party involved.
* Verify that personnel supervised are competent for the work required and that equipment is adequate, safe, properly certified and maintained, with checks documented.
* Engage with Fugro's quarterly safety focus and ensure the crew understand the standards expected.
* Investigate and report near misses and incidents in line with the company management system.

**Team leading and mentoring**

* Manage, motivate and mentor the ROV team to optimize performance, delegating within competence while allowing development.
* Train and formally assess ROV Senior Pilot Technicians and Pilot Technicians, collecting and judging evidence fairly against agreed criteria.
* Recognize crew strengths and weaknesses, set development goals and submit accurate, detailed appraisals and end-of-trip reports.
* Maintain an open-door policy and manage conflict to mutually acceptable outcomes.
* Lead multinational crews effectively, adapting communication style across nationalities, languages, and client cultures.
* Monitor fatigue and working hours, applying the contractual shift cap and recording daily fatigue checks.

**Technical Expertise**

* Act as subject matter expert on assigned ROV technologies, providing technical guidance to internal teams and stakeholders.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of ROV mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems to troubleshooting and maintenance direction.
* Ensure the planned maintenance system is executed on schedule, that deferrals are logged and reported, and that technical bulletins are implemented.
* Propose improvements to maintenance practice and support evaluation of emerging technologies.

**Quality assurance and compliance**

* Ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to the company integrated/business management system throughout all operations. Maintain quality standards through inspections and audits, identifying and closing out deficiencies.
* Ensure the minimum documentation set is prepared, maintained and returned daily and weekly progress reports, PMS records, dive logs with pre/post-dive checklists, communication logs, risk assessments and toolbox talks, incident reports, mob/demob reports, appraisals, requisitions and the ROV daily logbook.
* Use standardised Fugro forms only; raise gaps with QHSSE rather than creating new forms.

**Client Interface and Commercial Awareness**

, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview :**
The Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager is accountable for the operational execution and performance of the regional Air Network by ensuring seamless fleet connectivity, shipment movement, and network synchronization across multiple Air Hubs and airport locations.
  
  
Owns regional fleet planning and operational execution by ensuring timely availability of vehicles for airport connections, First Mile to Middle Mile movement, Middle Mile to Last Mile connectivity, route optimization, vehicle utilization, and adherence to operational cut-offs.
  
  
Leads Air Hub operations across the region and ensures timely fleet deployment, dynamic route planning, and operational adjustments in line with changes to flight schedules, business volumes, and network priorities.
  
  
Acts as the regional owner for Air Fleet Operations, ensuring optimal coordination between Air Hubs, Surface Operations, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, and Aviation teams to achieve superior service performance, On-Time Delivery (OTD), On-Time Arrival (OTA), and cost-efficient operations.
  
  
This role operates as a regional execution and governance function, working closely with Aviation, Surface Operations, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and Network Planning teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and synchronized air logistics operations.
  
  
**Job Purpose :**
To optimize regional Air Fleet Operations by ensuring timely fleet availability, efficient route planning, seamless hub connectivity, vehicle utilization, and synchronization with flight schedules, enabling uninterrupted movement of shipments between First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile while achieving operational excellence, service quality, OTD, OTA, and cost efficiency.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**Leadership**

* Lead and manage Air Hub Managers and Fleet Coordinators across the region, ensuring alignment to operational performance, service quality, fleet utilization, and customer commitments.
* Build operational capability and standardized fleet planning practices across regional Air Operations.
* Ensure timely execution of regional fleet movement plans in alignment with operational cut-offs and network priorities.
* Drive operational discipline, governance, and continuous improvement across regional Air Fleet Operations.

**Air Fleet Operations**

* Own and govern regional fleet planning for airport connectivity, ensuring timely vehicle availability for all inbound and outbound flight movements.
* Ensure uninterrupted shipment connectivity between First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile operations through effective fleet deployment.
* Plan fleet movements based on shipment volumes, operational cut-offs, airport schedules, and business priorities.
* Optimize fleet utilization by minimizing idle time, empty runs, and operational delays.
* Ensure timely positioning of vehicles at Air Hubs for inbound and outbound flight connections.
* Drive efficient fleet allocation across Air Hubs based on daily operational requirements.
* Monitor fleet availability and proactively resolve shortages through dynamic resource planning.

**Network Synchronization & Connectivity**

* Ensure synchronization between Air Hub operations, Surface Operations, CPU Operations, and Last Mile Operations.
* Drive timely shipment connectivity across the regional network by ensuring adherence to all operational cut-offs.
* Monitor connection performance between Air Hubs and downstream facilities.
* Ensure operational readiness during peak periods, flight schedule changes, and network disruptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation teams to realign fleet deployment whenever flight timings are revised.
* Drive contingency planning to minimize operational impact arising from flight delays, cancellations, or capacity constraints.

**Route Planning & Optimization**

* Optimize regional fleet routes to improve transit time, vehicle utilization, and operating efficiency.
* Review daily movement plans and implement route changes based on operational requirements.
* Identify opportunities to reduce transportation cost while maintaining service commitments.
* Improve route productivity through continuous review of fleet deployment and operational performance.

**Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to operational cut-offs across all Air Hubs.
* Improve OTD and OTA through proactive operational planning and execution.
* Monitor turnaround time, loading efficiency, dispatch adherence, and fleet readiness.
* Standardize operating procedures across Air Fleet Operations.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

**Cost Optimization & Productivity**

* Improve fleet productivity through better vehicle utilization and route optimization.
* Reduce empty mileage and idle fleet.
* Optimize transportation cost without impacting customer service.
* Improve resource utilization across Air Operations.
* Sourcing and negotiation of large and medium service partners

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Collaborate with Aviation, Surface Operations, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and Network Planning teams.
* Ensure alignment between regional fleet execution and national Air Network strategy.
* Act as the regional SME for Air Fleet Operations and operational connectivity.

**Qualifications & Experience :**

* Education: Bachelor's degree (Engineering / Operations / Supply Chain / Logistics preferred); MBA / PG desirable.
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in logistics operations with strong exposure to Air Operations, Surface Transportation, Fleet Management, Hub Operations, and Network Coordination.
* Proven experience in managing multi-location operations and leading regional transportation or fleet operations teams.
* Strong understanding of air logistics connectivity, operational cut-offs, fleet deployment, route optimization, and hub-to-hub transportation planning.

title: Senior Manager - KYC
description: About M&G IndiaWe are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.About M&GOur purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.Overall Function / Job Purpose:Job Purpose : The Asset Management 1LoD Financial Crime Operations function identifies, assesses, mitigates and manages financial crime risks across the Asset Management business, in line with Group and M&G policies, standards and regulatory requirements. Its primary focus is the Retail and Wholesale business.The Role:The Senior Manager - KYC is responsible for executing first level Financial Crime due diligence and screening activities across the Asset Management business, with a primary focus on Retail and Wholesale. The role performs first level checks/reviews, referrals and escalates SMEs in the UK, where relevant for guidance and conclusion.The role supports the prevention and detection of financial crime by conducting processing / checking of customer risk assessments, customer due diligence reviews, ongoing monitoring activities and name screening. Working within the First Line of Defence, the role helps ensure that Financial Crime controls operate effectively, risk assessments are appropriately documented, and regulatory obligations are met. The role provides oversight of screening activities delivered by Service providers/TPAs where applicable, reviews referrals, challenges exceptions, supports issue remediation, monitors service delivery performance and maintains robust audit trails of risk-based decisions.The role is accountable for completing high‑quality first level reviews of referred matters, supporting ad-hoc and remediation activity where required, and identifying financial crime risks, while working within established clear procedures and controls. The role works closely with Financial Crime Operations colleagues globally and key stakeholders to promote consistent control execution, effective risk management, and continuous improvement across the Asset Management business.While the role/s primary requirement is carry out the operational activities set out above- Retail and Wholesale (AM business), the role would also require to cross-train on other FCO areas to support the capability build for India FCO, demonstrating adaptability, with diverse range of skills/experiences.Accountabilities/Responsibilities:Due diligence and risk assessment: Perform first level AML/KYC due diligence (CDD, SDD and EDD) and customer risk assessments for new and existing customers, primarily across Retail and Wholesale, in line with Financial Crime policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. Analyse customer information, supporting documentation and risk indicators, including complex ownership structures, and identify EDD triggers. Referral management and escalation: Review, triage and respond to daily referrals received via the team mailbox, ensuring timely allocation, progression and resolution in line with risk, priority and agreed SLAs. Escalate to the relevant secondary reviews/Level 2 SMEs in the UK, and Luxembourg where relevant, where specialist input is required. Name screening: Name Screening execution, alert handling, disposition (Sanctions, Politically Exposed Person (PEP) and Adverse Media). Support oversight of Screening CoE. Ongoing monitoring: Complete periodic reviews, trigger event reviews and ongoing monitoring activities, ensuring customer records remain accurate, current and compliant with Financial Crime standards. Transaction Monitoring, Fraud and Investigations: Provide first level support across Transaction Monitoring, Fraud and Investigations as capacity requires, moving between workstreams as volumes change (if/when needed). Oversight of TAs and service providers: Monitor service delivery performance, challenge exceptions, and coordinate and track remediation requirements across TAs, service providers and internal stakeholders, ensuring actions are completed accurately and within agreed timelines. Governance, stakeholder engagement, audit support and continuous improvement: Participate in TA governance forums and Financial Crime catch‑ups (including with UK-based colleagues), work with internal and third-party stakeholders to obtain information required to complete reviews, maintain accurate records, case files and audit trails, support internal/external audit reviews as required, and contribute to workload management, knowledge sharing and process improvements. Knowledge & Skills:Proven experience in AML, KYC, Client, distributor onboarding, due diligence, PR activities within Asset Management or Asset Servicing / Financial Services space. (Essential)Hands‑on experience in onboarding complex entity types such as funds, trusts, SPVs, regulated entities, structures (Essential)Exposure in determining risk exposure in complex ownership structures in accordance to applicable AML/KYC standards/requirements. (Essential)Strong knowledge of screening (Sanctions, PEP, Adverse Media) and due diligence reviews (Essential), Transaction monitoring activities (preferred)Comes with Checker and referral management experience delivering accurate, high‑quality outcomes. (Preferred)Strong analytical and investigative mindset with attention to detail; assess risk, review and interpret regulation (Essential). Proven ability to absorb, understand and build an understanding of complex financial crime related information and comfortable articulating to senior stakeholders across the business (Preferred)Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels. (Essential)High levels of ownership, accountability, ability to multitask. (Essential)Understanding of the Asset Management lifecycle and structures (e.g. funds, UCITS, AIFs, distributors, Fund clients, Trusts, Pvt/Public markets, Segregated Mandates etc.). (Preferred)Working knowledge of AML,KYC tools workflows (e.g., Actimize, World check, Lexis Nexis, Fenergo, AWD Fast). (Preferred)Working knowledge of UK AML/financial crime regulations and their practical application within KYC/AML in Asset Management, Asset Servicing or Investment Banking environments. Knowledge of Luxembourg, EU and other regulatory regimes would also be useful. (Preferred)Experience in producing MI, reports, or dashboards (MS Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint essential; Power BI an advantage). (Preferred)Experience:Minimum 9 - 12 years’ experience in Anti Financial Crime Operations or Controls covering Onboarding, KYC/D, Risk Assessment, Screening functions, within Asset Management, Asset Servicing, or Financial Services (Preferred: 2 to 3 years in Quality Checking/referrals)Hands-on experience in first level reviews/referrals in CDD/EDD, Transaction Monitoring alert review, fraud referral handling and financial crime investigations, including case documentation, escalation and referral management. (Preferred)Good understanding of the regulated financial services landscape and how businesses such as M&G operate within it. Self‑motivated, proactive, analytical, and resilient, with the ability to work effectively under pressure. Educational Qualification:Graduate degree in Science, Commerce, Management, Business Administration, or Law (e.g. BSc, BCom, BMS, BBA, LLB). Professional certifications such as ICA qualifications or CAMS are desirable. We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Account Manager — Client Retention & Sales
description:
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Eastern Time business hours
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$35,000–C$45,000 annually, including base pay and performance bonuses
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Account Manager to manage existing client relationships, retain dissatisfied clients, influence important decisions, sell relevant services, and keep multiple active files moving from beginning to completion.
  
  
MoveSmart operates in residential leasing, but direct real-estate experience is preferred—not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
  
  
You will become the property owner’s main point of contact after they sign with MoveSmart. You will coordinate the leasing process, monitor listing performance, present applications and offers, recommend changes, and keep the owner informed through tenant move-in.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service or administrative position. You will be responsible for both the client relationship and the commercial performance of your assigned files.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Manage multiple active client and leasing files
* Keep property owners informed throughout the process
* Confirm that each file is complete and ready to be listed
* Coordinate listing requirements with the partner brokerage
* Monitor inquiries, showings, feedback, applications, and offers
* Identify why a property is not attracting interest or offers
* Recommend pricing, marketing, presentation, or property-condition changes
* Persuade owners to make reasonable price adjustments
* Present qualified tenant offers and secure timely decisions
* Retain dissatisfied owners who may be considering cancellation
* Sell appropriate services that could improve a property’s leasing performance
* Handle objections while maintaining the owner’s trust
* Coordinate documents, deposits, keys, and move-in requirements
* Communicate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams
* Verify payment and payout information before providing updates
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and next steps
* Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, client success, client retention, leasing, property management, portfolio management, or a similar client-facing role
* Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales
* Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to take action
* Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering relationships
* Confidence recommending price changes, service improvements, or other actions clients may initially resist
* Ability to use evidence, customer feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions
* Experience upselling relevant services or solutions
* Ability to manage multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities simultaneously
* Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management
* Experience using a structured CRM or workflow system
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Sound judgment when handling client concerns and escalations
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours

Strong candidates may come from account management, customer success, SaaS, insurance, financial services, staffing, telecommunications, automotive sales, hospitality, property management, real estate, or another service-based industry involving ongoing client ownership.
  
  
Canadian real-estate experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live scenario-based interview.
  
  
**Compensation**
This position offers expected annual compensation of approximately
**C$35,000–C$45,000**
, consisting of base pay plus performance bonuses.
  
  
Actual earnings will depend on individual performance. Complete compensation terms will be explained during the interview process.
  
  
Remote-Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A private professional workspace
* Dual monitors
* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Reliable internet of at least 100 Mbps
* A webcam
* A noise-cancelling headset

Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person combines the organization of an experienced Account Manager with the confidence of a consultative salesperson.
  
  
You should be able to identify what is preventing a client’s file from progressing, explain the evidence, recommend a solution, overcome resistance, and obtain a clear decision.
  
  
You must be persuasive without being misleading or overly aggressive. You should be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations while maintaining the client’s trust.

title: Project & Service Manager – Sales Data & AI (m/f/d)
description:
**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs 🚀**
At Siemens, we build technology solutions to shape the world we live in. We transform industries and societies by combining the real and digital worlds. With over 300.000 of the world’s most forward-thinking minds and the power of a presence in more than 190 countries, we make a truly global impact.
  
  
**About Us**
Siemens Automation is at the heart of industrial digital transformation, combining leading automation technologies with software, data and AI to enable smarter and more data-driven business decisions.
  
  
Within our Sales Data Domain, we are looking for a Project & Service Manager – Sales Data & AI who combines strong project and service management capabilities with a hands-on technical mindset.
  
  
**Are you ready to be part of the change? Come join us! ⭐**
**Your mission will be…**
You will work at the intersection of Sales, Data and AI, driving initiatives that improve how sales data is structured, integrated, governed and used across Siemens Automation.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking end-to-end ownership of projects and services while staying close to the technology. You will work directly with business stakeholders, data engineers, developers, architects and AI experts to turn business challenges into scalable data products, analytics solutions and AI-enabled applications.
  
  
This is not a purely coordinative role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving between stakeholder management, project delivery, service ownership and hands-on work with data and technology.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive Sales Data & AI projects and services end-to-end, from initial idea and requirements through development, testing and rollout to productive operation and continuous improvement.
* Take ownership of scope, priorities, roadmap, dependencies, risks and stakeholder alignment, ensuring reliable delivery and measurable business value.
* Manage and continuously improve existing Sales Data services and data products, coordinating priorities, issues and dependencies across business and technical teams.
* Develop a strong understanding of the Sales Data Domain, including its business processes, data products, data models, interfaces and dependencies.
* Translate Sales business challenges into clear data requirements, technical work packages and Data, Analytics, Automation or AI use cases.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams of data engineers, developers, analysts, architects and AI experts, creating transparency on ownership, priorities and delivery.
* Understand and challenge technical solutions, working with technical experts to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and fit for purpose.
* Drive Data, Analytics and AI use cases from idea to implementation, including prototypes and proofs of concept to evaluate technical feasibility and business value before scaling.
* Act as the bridge between Sales and IT, translating business needs into technical requirements and technical complexity into clear options, decisions and business impact.
* Ensure that solutions meet requirements regarding data architecture, governance, security, data quality and compliance, working closely with the responsible experts.
* Foster an agile, pragmatic and outcome-oriented way of working, with a strong focus on ownership, continuous improvement and delivering business value.

**We are looking for someone with…**

* Professional experience in Project Management, Service Management, IT, Data & Analytics or comparable roles, ideally in a data-intensive business environment.
* Strong project and service management capabilities and an ownership mindset, with experience driving topics from requirements through implementation and rollout to productive operation.
* Solid understanding of data architectures, data products, data models, analytics and data integration.
* Hands-on experience working with data. You do not need to be a Data Engineer, but you should be able to explore data, understand data structures and models, discuss technical concepts and challenge proposed solutions.
* Good understanding of AI and Generative AI, with the ability to identify relevant use cases and work with technical experts to turn opportunities into real business solutions.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology, bringing together developers, data engineers, architects, analysts and business stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between business and technology, from detailed technical discussions to management-level communication.
* A pragmatic and hands-on mentality: you take ownership, dive into problems when necessary and actively help the team move toward solutions.
* An agile mindset and experience working in iterative development environments.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**What We Offer**

* Belong & Innovate: Work in diverse teams where every idea matters and innovation grows through collaboration and trust.
* Flexibility that Works: Hybrid model, flexible hours, and a home office budget — because balance fuels performance.
* Health & Well-being: Comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, and active sports communities to keep you feeling your best.
* Grow Without Limits: Access world-class learning platforms, mentoring, and continuous development opportunities.
* Purpose & Perks: Contribute to sustainability and volunteer initiatives, enjoy partner discounts, and take advantage of our convenient shuttle service.

**Please attach your CV in English to your application, otherwise your application will not be considered**
***#Siemens #SiemensAutomation #SalesDataDomain***
*Siemens is deeply committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourage applications from a wide array of talented individuals!*

**About Us**
**CCTech**
's mission is to transform human life by the democratization of technology. We are a well established digital transformation company building the applications in the areas of CAD, CFD, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 3D Webapps, Augmented Reality, Digital Twin, and other enterprise applications.
  
  
We have two business divisions: product and consulting.
  
  
simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.
  
  
Our consulting division, with its partners such as Autodesk Forge, AWS and Azure, is helping the world's leading engineering organizations, many of which are Fortune 500 list of companies, in achieving digital supremacy.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Sr. Sales Executive you own a significant revenue number and the strategy behind it. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise pursuits — custom engineering software programmes, digital transformation consulting, Autodesk-ecosystem engagements and AI platform subscriptions — often with long cycles and senior buyers (CXO, Plant Head, Chief Engineer, CIO, Head of Digital). Alongside your own quota, you mentor junior members of the sales team, own key partner relationships, and shape go-to-market strategy for your segment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue & Strategy Ownership
* Own and deliver an annual revenue / bookings quota for an assigned vertical, geography or strategic account portfolio.
* Build the segment go-to-market plan: target account lists, value propositions, pricing approach, campaign themes and partner plays.
* Drive new logo acquisition of marquee enterprise accounts, and build multi-year account growth plans for existing ones.
* Lead accurate forecasting and pipeline reviews; be accountable for forecast discipline at the leadership table.
* Complex Enterprise Pursuits
* Lead large and strategic pursuits end to end — qualification, solution shaping, business case, RFP/RFI response, PoC governance, commercial structuring, negotiation and closure.
* Engage CXO and senior engineering leadership; build the business case in their language (cycle time, design reuse, compliance, traceability, cost of engineering).
* Structure complex commercial models — fixed-price programmes, T&M, managed capacity, subscription and hybrid — with delivery and finance.
* Navigate procurement, legal, infosec and compliance processes in large enterprises.
* Team Leadership & Mentoring
* Mentor and coach Jr. Sales Executives and Sales Executives on prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal craft and negotiation.
* Review and raise the quality of outbound campaigns, proposals and client communication across the team.
* Help define and roll out sales process, playbooks, templates, qualification standards and CRM discipline.
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new sales team members. (Formal people-management responsibility may be added as the function scales.)
* Partner & Alliance Management
* Own and grow strategic alliance relationships — Autodesk, AWS, Azure and other technology partners.
* Drive co-selling, joint pipeline, partner-sourced opportunities, joint marketing initiatives and partner programme compliance.
* Position CCTech within partner ecosystems and competency programmes to maximise referral flow.
* International Markets & Industry Presence
* Lead business development in international markets — North America, Europe, Middle East and APAC — including regular calls across time zones and overseas travel.
* Represent CCTech at flagship industry events and conferences (e.g. industry expos, customer summits); run executive meetings on-site.
* Build CCTech's market presence through thought leadership content, webinars, customer references and case studies.
* Track competitive landscape, pricing trends and technology shifts; influence product and service roadmap with market feedback.
* Indicative Performance Measures
* Annual revenue / bookings achievement against quota
* New logo acquisition and strategic account growth
* Qualified pipeline created and partner-sourced pipeline
* Win rate on large/strategic pursuits and average deal size
* Forecast accuracy and sales cycle efficiency
* Team enablement outcomes — ramp time and performance of mentored sales team members

**Requirements**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of B2B / enterprise sales experience in engineering software, SaaS, IT services, CAD/CAE/PLM or digital transformation.
* Consistent record of carrying and achieving individual quotas, including large-ticket and multi-stakeholder deals.
* Sharp strategic and commercial thinking, strong problem-solving ability, and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience selling into engineering-led industries — Manufacturing, AEC, Energy, Infrastructure, Semiconductor or Oil & Gas.
* Credibility with senior buyers; able to run a CXO conversation on business outcomes and an engineering conversation on workflows.
* Strong solution-selling, business-case building, commercial structuring and negotiation skills.
* Experience selling custom software development and consulting engagements, not only product licences.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or leading junior sales colleagues.
* Experience with partner/alliance-led selling motions.
* Advanced CRM, forecasting and sales analytics discipline.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills in English.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally; valid passport required.
* Good to Have
* Hands-on familiarity with the Autodesk ecosystem (Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor, ACC, APS, Forma, Tandem) or with CFD/simulation, PLM/PDM and digital twin solutions.
* Experience selling AI/ML-enabled engineering products or platforms.
* Existing network within target industries or the Autodesk/AWS/Azure partner ecosystem.
* Experience building a sales function or process from an early stage.

**Required Skills**
**Required Skills & Experience**
**Educational Background**

* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, particularly Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Production, Instrumentation or a related field.
* Also Considered: Graduates from other disciplines with a proven record of success in enterprise sales, strong commercial acumen, analytical ability and the ability to understand complex technical offerings.
* An MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales or Business Development is an added advantage.

**Benefits**

* A senior, high-visibility role with direct exposure to the founding team (CEO, CBO, COO) and to delivery leadership.
* Ownership of strategy, not just execution — you shape how CCTech goes to market in your segment.
* A differentiated portfolio: 19 years of computational engineering depth, 150+ enterprise solutions, proprietary AI platforms and deep Autodesk/AWS/Azure partnerships.
* Global customer exposure and a platform at flagship industry events.
* Competitive fixed compensation with an attractive performance-linked incentive and accelerator structure.
* A path to sales leadership as the business development function scales.

r,

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

description:

Tricentis is a global leader in agentic quality engineering. More than 3,000 customers, including some of the world's most respected brands, rely on the Tricentis Agentic Quality Engineering Platform to test, govern, and release software faster and with confidence. In 2025, we were named a Leader in the first-ever Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI-Augmented Software Testing Tools and in The Forrester Wave™: Autonomous Testing Platforms, Q4 2025.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Technical Support Engineer, you're the expert our customers turn to when something isn't working. You'll analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve technical cases from customers of every size, from fast-moving product teams to Global 2000 enterprises running mission-critical SAP, Salesforce, and Oracle landscapes.
  
  
You'll work with customers through the Tricentis Support Hub, email, chat, and the occasional call or remote session. You'll also partner with Tier 2, R&D, Product, and Customer Success to get to root cause. We'll train you in depth on one or more products in our platform: Tosca, Tosca Cloud, qTest, NeoLoad, LiveCompare, SeaLights, Vera, Testim, or Data Integrity, including the agentic AI capabilities that now run across them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own cases end to end. Reproduce issues, analyze logs, HAR files, and configurations, and drive each case to resolution within SLA.
* Diagnose across the stack. Troubleshoot installation, licensing, configuration, integration, authentication, and performance issues in both on-premises and SaaS environments.
* Find the real defects. Recognize when a behavior is a product bug, build a clean reproduction, and escalate to Tier 2 and R&D with the evidence they need.
* Support AI-powered features. Help customers set up and troubleshoot agentic capabilities such as Tricentis Agentic Test Automation and our remote MCP servers.
* Communicate with clarity. Set expectations, give regular updates, and translate technical findings into plain language for both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Work smarter with AI. Use AI-assisted tools and our internal knowledge bases to research faster, while applying your own judgment to every answer you send.
* Grow our knowledge base. Write and improve knowledge articles so customers and colleagues can solve known issues themselves.
* Spot patterns. Flag recurring issues across cases and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product.

Related technologies include Distributed Execution (DEX), API testing and service virtualization (OSV), mobile testing, SAP, Salesforce, database, and mainframe engines, and Tricentis Agentic Test Automation.
* qTest: Centralized test management that unifies and scales testing across teams. Related technologies include Jira integration, CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, and Linux.

* Experience using AI or LLM tools, writing prompts, or working with agent workflows.

* Get in-depth product training and Tricentis Academy certifications.

title: Desktop SME
description:
**Job Title:**
Lead
Desktop SME

**Job Location**
: Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune (WFO)

**Experience**
: 6+Years

**Shift**
: Rotational shift 24\*7

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Desktop SME with 10+ years of experience in desktop/endpoint engineering to support an SCCM to Intune migration program covering approximately 6,000 Windows corporate devices. The role is responsible for device build, imaging, and Autopilot enrollment validation, application deployment testing, break-fix troubleshooting, and providing hands-on desktop-level support through pilot migration, mass rollout, and hypercare,ensuring a smooth transition from the current SCCM/GPO-managed environment to a cloud-only, Intune-driven model.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Device Build & Enrollment***

* Support device inventory assessment: current OS level, OEM vendor, device lifecycle, and readiness for migration.
* Configure and validate Autopilot profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), and Microsoft Entra Join enrollment for corporate and BYOD devices.
* Assist in transitioning device build from the current corporate-network-bound (PXE/OSD, domain join, GPO-driven) model to the future Autopilot-driven, cloud-managed (OOBE,Intune-driven) model.
* Perform hands-on testing of standard apps, security policies, and OS customization applied through Intune during device build.

***Application Deployment & Testing***

* Test application packaging and deployment readiness for LOB apps, Microsoft Store apps, MSI packages, and PowerShell-based installs migrated from SCCM to Intune.
* Identify, log, and help troubleshoot application incompatibilities and default app/deployment failures on migrated devices.
* Support functional,regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for applications and device configuration profiles.
* Validate device compliance, security baseline application, and drive encryption (BitLocker) on test and pilot devices.

***Pilot & Mass Migration Support***

* Provide hands-on desktop support during pilot migration, capturing feedback and lessons learned for remediation.
* Support execution of migration in planned waves during mass rollout, performing on-ground/remote device checks.
* Troubleshoot desktop-level issues arising from GPO-to-Intune policy transition, network access (Wi-Fi/VPN), and printer/file share access on Entra-joined devices.
* Escalate unresolved device, application, or connectivity issues to the Migration Lead / MEM SME with clear diagnostic details.

***Break-Fix, Hypercare & Support Desk Coordination***

* Act as a point of technical escalation for the support/helpdesk team on desktop-related migration issues.
* Provide floor-walking or remote hands-on support and hypercare coverage during and immediately after migration waves.
* Perform post-migration validation checks on individual devices (connectivity, app availability, compliance status, data integrity) prior to sign-off.
* Contribute to knowledge transfer sessions, troubleshooting guides, and SOP documentation for the support desk team.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years of experience in desktop engineering/support, with hands-on exposure to both SCCM (Configuration Manager) and Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager.
* Practical experience with Windows OS deployment/imaging, Autopilot enrollment, and Enrollment Status Page (ESP) configuration.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra Join, hybrid identity, and device compliance/configuration profiles.
* Experience troubleshooting application deployment issues (Win32, MSI, LOB, Microsoft Store apps) on Windows devices.
* Familiarity with GPO-based management and understanding of common issues when transitioning devices to Intune-managed policies.
* Hands-on experience with device security features: BitLocker, endpoint protection (EDR), LAPS, and Conditional Access impact on devices.
* Good troubleshooting skills for network access issues (Wi-Fi/VPN, certificate-based authentication) and file share/printer access on migrated devices.
* Strong communication skills to work with end users, support desk teams, and technical leads during pilot and rollout phases.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience supporting large-scale device migration or refresh programs (5,000+ endpoints).
* Exposure to third-party SCCM-to-Intune migration tools.
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for troubleshooting and automation of routine desktop tasks.
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator Associate) or equivalent.
