description:
**Job Description – Program Manager**

  

**ABOUT TENNECO**

At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best-in-class because we hustle to be *better than* best-in-class. Whether it’s our Core Values–radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win–or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.

  

How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It’s what keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven, and unapologetically focused on pushing past limits and redefining success.

  

Here, you’ll work alongside a team of relentless problem-solvers who are committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results, and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.

  

Want to learn more about who we are? Check out our website to discover the Tenneco Way.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Ensures problem identification and resolution.
* Ensures a high level of integration and collaboration with the plants and Launch Managers in their program, as well as alignment with the program team members in Engineering, Sales, Finance, Quality and Purchasing.
* Takes an active “go and verify” approach to program by personally visiting the plants and suppliers at appropriate intervals.
* Ensures the effectiveness of program team meetings and customer review meetings.
* Ensures effective communication with program team. Acts as the central communication point for their programs.
* Manages the program team from Gate 1 (Stage 2) through Gate 7.
* Manages the quoting team during Stage 2.Ensures effective and timely scope management with emphasis on customer scope changes and executes the Scope Change process and approval.
* Ensures program trade off analysis – balancing cost, time, product and resource.
* Identifies program risks early, develops and executes mitigation strategies and executes the Red Flag process.
* Escalates risk with mitigation strategies to the leadership team in a timely fashion.
* Creates high quality timing plans that are developed with the program team with effective buy in from all functional areas.
* Meets 0 days late for all Gates.
* Meets all customer MRDs on time with high quality products.
* Ensures all program financial targets and budgets are met.
* Verifies the CARs and Business Cases are reasonable and achievable.
* Ensures effective and logical financial roadmaps are executed.
* Ensures quality objectives and roadmaps are developed, executed and met via their program teams.
* Ensures sourcing on time with high quality suppliers.
* Ensures appropriate completion of Make versus Buy decisions.
* Ensures on time PPAP of purchased components.
* Visits critical suppliers at appropriate points in the program with the members of their Program Teams.
Other duties as assigned.  

**We don’t want average. We want exceptional. We want someone who’s hungry to build, unafraid to challenge, and bold enough to lead with empathy, speed, and precision. Sound like you? Let us know.**

title: Product Manager I
description:
Responsibilities:

Are you a driven and ambitious individual looking to make an impact in the world of Information Technology? Principal is seeking a Product Manager I to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India. This is a unique opportunity to work with a world-class team and be part of exciting and innovative projects that shape the future of our technology landscape!

Job Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Execution

* Partner with Product Management and Engineering leadership to understand PDIO strategy and drive execution within agreed priorities.
* Convert the PDIO vision into well-defined product outcomes, roadmap priorities, and quantifiable opportunities.
* Develop a solid grasp of the developer journey, engineering workflows, SDLC methods, and challenges faced by product delivery teams.
* Ensure relationships and dependencies across developer platforms, engineering methods, tooling, data, and delivery processes are understood and reflected in product decisions.
* Integrate developer, engineering, product, and collaborator insights to build a shared understanding of the highest-value problems to solve.

Product Discovery & Developer Experience

* Recognize and assess opportunities to advance Developer Experience (DX), engineering productivity, software delivery flow, quality, and reliability.
* Partner with engineers, delivery managers, product managers, and other collaborators to understand workflow friction and determine root causes.
* Develop hypotheses and collaborate with engineering teams on experiments and solutions.
* Use quantitative DX signals alongside qualitative team feedback to distinguish symptoms from meaningful problems worth solving.
* Assess experiment results and use findings to inform backlog and roadmap prioritization.
* Help establish an effective parallel discovery and delivery model for PDIO.

Product Delivery

* Take responsibility for the successful delivery of measurable, goal-aligned PDIO outcomes in collaboration with engineering and other technology teams.
* Own and refine the product roadmap and prioritized backlog for assigned PDIO capabilities.
* Transform validated opportunities into well-defined product requirements, outcomes, success measures, stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work together with the team to divide tasks into smaller parts that allow for regular delivery and learning.
* Identify and help resolve dependencies and impediments affecting product outcomes.
* Engage fully in Agile ceremonies and join the team in ongoing efforts to refine delivery approaches.
* Communicate product releases, changes, and resulting value to collaborators and partners.

Product Measurement, DX & Engineering Intelligence

* Use DX, DORA, and SDLC metrics to understand product health, developer friction, delivery performance, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review dashboards weekly or per sprint to identify hotspots, trends, rework, lead-time indicators, blocked work, and cross-team handoff delays.
* Bring relevant signals into retrospectives, planning, and team reflection conversations.
* Use team health, snapshot results, negative themes, and satisfaction trends in combination with workflow measures to form a balanced understanding of developer experience.
* Partner with teams to co-create measurable improvement goals and promote experimentation and small changes.
* Evaluate whether PDIO capabilities produce measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness and developer experience.
* Use data to guide discovery, prioritization, investment decisions, and roadmap adjustments.

Collaborator Management & Communication

* Develop solid connections with Product Management, Engineering, Delivery Management, Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, and other technology collaborators.
* Communicate PDIO strategy, priorities, roadmap, experiments, product performance, and outcomes clearly to collaborators.
* Develop shared understanding between engineering teams and supporting enterprise functions.
* Balance competing needs and prioritize opportunities based on expected developer and business value.
* Help collaborators understand and prepare product and process changes.

Qualifications:

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent professional experience (B.E. / B.Tech / M.S. / M.Tech / MCA).
* Total Experience: 8-10 Years with more than 3 years of background in Product Management, technical product management, software ecosystems, engineering efficiency, or similar roles preferred.

Must Have

* Strong product discovery, roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, and Agile delivery skills.
* Strong collaborator management and communication skills, particularly when working across technical, product development, and engineering teams.
* Ability to convert complex technical concepts and engineering data into clear product opportunities, priorities, outcomes, and value.
* Analytical problem-solving skills and a committed, ownership approach.
* High agency and initiative: ability to translate agreed strategy and direction into action, proactively advance progress, and take ownership of outcomes without close supervision or daily prompting.

Preferred to Have

* Product Management experience working with Developer Platforms, Developer Experience (DX), Engineering Productivity, Platform Engineering, or similar technical products.
* Deep knowledge of Developer Experience concepts and DORA metrics, combined with the skill to convert engineering indicators into product insights and possibilities for improvement.
* Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and SDLC governance sufficient to product-manage capabilities across the engineering lifecycle.
* Experience using ServiceNow in the context of Agile delivery, process improvements, and incident management.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and experience interpreting data to guide product decisions, prioritization, and evaluation.

Additional Information:

Join us at Principal and contribute to our mission of achieving world-class excellence in product delivery and innovation!

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. Position Overview:
  
  
The Assistant Manager – Operations (Area Operations) is responsible for managing the end-to-end operations of a designated city comprising multiple Service Centres and Customer Service Counters, ensuring consistent delivery of Blue Dart's service commitments through operational excellence, customer focus and effective people leadership.
  
  
The role is accountable for driving operational performance across approximately 8–12 Service Centres and Counters by ensuring safe, timely and cost-effective pickup and delivery operations, superior customer experience, adherence to service quality standards, productivity improvement, operational governance and regulatory compliance. Working closely with the Area Head and cross-functional stakeholders, the incumbent is responsible for building a high-performing operations team, strengthening operational discipline, enhancing network capability and delivering sustainable business performance while supporting Blue Dart's growth objectives. Job Purpose:
  
  
To lead and manage the operational performance of multiple Service Centres and Counters within the assigned city by delivering industry-leading service quality, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction and cost optimization through effective leadership, operational governance, workforce management, continuous improvement and adherence to Blue Dart's operational standards and values.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Operational Leadership & Service Centre Governance
  
  
Lead the overall operations of multiple Service Centres and Customer Service Counters within the assigned city, ensuring seamless day-to-day execution of pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
  
  
Drive operational excellence by ensuring consistent adherence to Blue Dart's operational standards, policies and Standard Operating Procedures across all assigned locations.
  
  
Establish strong operational governance through structured daily, weekly and monthly business reviews with Service Centre teams.
  
  
Monitor operational performance through dashboards, MIS reports and operational scorecards, taking timely corrective actions wherever required.

Ensure effective utilization of operational assets, equipment and infrastructure across all assigned locations.

Support implementation of new operational initiatives, customer solutions and service enhancements within the assigned geography.

Drive implementation of 5S and workplace improvement initiatives across all operational locations.
  
  
Ensure business continuity through contingency planning, backup arrangements and operational preparedness.
  
  
Vendor & Channel Partner Operations

Ensure vendor operations comply with Blue Dart's operational standards, customer commitments and safety requirements.
  
  
Monitor productivity, service quality, attendance, compliance and performance of outsourced resources.

Ensure contractual obligations, service level commitments and operational deliverables are consistently achieved.
  
  
Work closely with Procurement, HR and other support functions to address vendor-related operational challenges.
  
  
Safety, Security & Compliance

Ensure safe handling, storage and movement of customer shipments while minimizing operational risk.
  
  
Drive awareness and compliance relating to workplace safety, security procedures and emergency response protocols.

Promote ethical conduct, integrity and zero tolerance towards fraud, theft, shipment pilferage, operational malpractice and policy violations.

People Leadership & Capability Development

title: Team Leader | Service | Pune
description:
Your role

Mission
  
  
Lead service operations, workshop activities, fleet management, and field service execution to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient rental operations. Drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, fleet performance, and team development while supporting business growth.

title: Product Support Manager
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101978
  
  
**Position Overview**
Join Autodesk and be part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), a growing business focused on transforming how customers manage and operate physical assets and operations. AOS expands Autodesk’s Design and Make vision into the Operate phase, creating more connected, end-to-end solutions for customers.
  
  
You will lead our global off-hours Level 1 Product Support team across India and the Philippines. This is the group that picks up customer cases while North America is offline and sets the standard for how round-the-clock support works. You will be the person who establishes consistent operating practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build the off-hour operating process: build, implement and improve SOPs, and define what the team does when the queue is quiet. Plan to shift coverage and queue ownership, anticipate absences and capacity gaps, and maintain clear escalation coverage while protecting time for coaching and development.
* Hold the team accountable for volume and quality together: read a lot of case data quickly, decide what matters, and coach to quality rather than a metric wall.
* Own the handoffs with North America and EMEA: review cases firsthand and ensure each important handoff includes a named owner, customer/business impact, investigation already completed, next action, and next update commitment. Confirm that the receiving team accepts ownership and urgent issues reach the appropriate escalation of contact during the shift. Keep cases progressing within the team’s remit and escalate urgent issues through established coverage.
* Build relationships with account managers for our customers, keep a view of which accounts matter most among thousands, and bring them the trends you see.
* Find the patterns behind the volume and work with product and AI tooling to remove low-level cases at the source.
* Collaborate with Level 2 support, engineering, and support operations on process improvements and unlocking operational efficiencies.
* First 90 days: Understand each team member’s strengths and development needs, establish regular coaching, document coverage and handoffs, and implement an initial process of improvement.
* Within 6-12 months: The team follows documented processes without prompting, and each report has clear development and performance outcomes. Success is measured by dependable coverage, answer accuracy, appropriate prioritization, backlog aging, avoidable recontacts, and handoff reliability alongside volume, including verification of the quality of AI-assisted answers.
* During onboarding (first 3 months), you’ll work North American business hours (9am-5pm ET) for training. After onboarding, you’ll lead the off-hours team during the 11pm-7am ET shift, currently 8:30 AM-4:30 PM IST (this shifts by an hour when North America changes clocks). This coverage ensures urgent issues are escalated promptly, and European customers are supported. Hours may change with business needs, with reasonable notice.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Technical credibility: Investigate and resolve customer cases yourself, model strong troubleshooting, and coach specialists through difficult issues. Know when to involve L2 or Engineering and provide complete escalation. API fluency is strongly preferred.
* People leadership: Substantial experience managing experienced technical specialists in complex B2B software support. Run regular, tailored 1:1s with agreed actions and follow-ups, documented development goals, clear progression expectations, and timely, fair performance feedback.
* Accountability: Set clear expectations, address performance concerns promptly and fairly, and stay accountable for decisions you delegate.
* Independent judgment: Turn ambiguity into clear priorities and practical recommendations. Decide within your remit, raise risks early, and follow through without repeated direction.
* Process ownership: Spot the gap, build the fix, secure adoption, and verify that it improves the team’s experience and customer outcomes.
* Trust and influence: Earn credibility with veteran specialists and new hires, invite disagreement, and explain your decisions. Resolve competing priorities across Support, Engineering, Product, and CS using data. Give India- and Philippines-based reports equitable attention and development opportunities.
* Active use of AI and automation to improve analysis, documentation, and workflows. Be ready to show examples, how you checked quality, and the impact.
* Experience working in both large enterprises and startups is preferred.
* Experience managing a distributed technical support team, ideally approximately five to seven direct reports across countries or time zones.
* Hands-on experience building reports and working with a customer service platform, such as Zendesk
* Experience with workforce management, such as Assembled
* Experience with QA tooling, such as Intryc
* Experience with ticket escalation software, such as JIRA, Linear or Pluno AI

title: Production Support Lead Analyst
description:
Unlike other organisations, FNZ encourages employees to explore internal career opportunities across the organisation. An FNZer's career pathway isn't restricted to linear progression and often our top talent have worked across a multitude of business functions. As such, we don't restrict applications based on tenure however you mustn't have any performance issues and you must inform your current Line Manager before applying.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Production Support Lead Analyst**
is the
**operational leader and primary accountability owner for platform stability**
across one or more FNZ platforms. This role provides day‑to‑day leadership for the Production Support team, ensures consistent operational standards, and leads incident response and stability improvements.
  
  
This is a
**player‑coach role**
: the Lead Analyst is expected to provide strong people leadership and operational governance, while remaining hands‑on during major incidents, complex investigations, and critical decision points.
  
  
The role works closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts, Developers, and global operational teams to ensure high‑quality service outcomes, effective incident management, and continuous improvement of platform reliability.
  
  
**Team Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily checks, recoveries, and platform reliability activities, ensuring consistency and quality across the Analyst team.
* Lead and coordinate incident response, ensuring correct triage, timely escalations, and alignment with operational playbooks.
* Ensure SOPs, runbooks, monitoring rules, and KB articles across all supported platforms remain current and high‑quality.
* Review and validate RCAs, ensuring they are accurate, complete, and delivered within required timelines.
* Drive preventive actions, stability improvements, and operational maturity uplift across supported platforms.
* Act as the primary liaison between Analysts, Senior Analysts, Developers, and global operational teams.
* Lead operational reporting, SLA/KPI tracking, and present key insights in operational reviews.
* Coach Analysts and Senior Analysts, building investigation discipline, platform knowledge, and operational excellence.

**Specific Role Responsibilities**

* Proven experience managing and leading teams of 8–10+ members, including workload planning, performance oversight, coaching, and capability development.
* Provide day‑to‑day leadership to Analysts and Senior Analysts, managing task allocation, priority handling, and operational workload.
* Oversee all daily platform checks, validations, and recovery tasks performed by the team, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Lead incident bridges when required, ensuring structured investigation, evidence capture, technical analysis, and clear communication.
* Validate and sign off RCAs for assigned platforms, ensuring actionable follow‑ups, accuracy, and alignment with Problem Management standards.
* Proactively identify patterns, recurring incidents, and operational inefficiencies; drive corrective actions with Developers and platform owners.
* Maintain high‑quality SOPs, runbooks, and operational artifacts, ensuring consistency across regions and teams.
* Provide escalation support to Analysts during complex investigations and decision‑making scenarios.
* Support client‑facing communications by reviewing technical details and ensuring accuracy and clarity.
* Represent Production Support in cross‑functional forums, including change reviews, operational meetings, and platform discussions.
* Maintain strong oversight of SLAs, KPIs, and risk controls, ensuring timely reporting and highlighting risks proactively.
* Facilitate continuous learning and capability uplift within the team through structured coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

**Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and guide a dedicated application support team.
* Monitor team performance and continuously seek improvement opportunities for skills and processes.
* Develop, maintain, and ensure adherence to comprehensive documentation on team activities.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure that business objectives and needs are met.
* Contribute to audit and effectiveness requests.

**Experience Required**
**What we are looking for:**

* 8+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Platform Operations, or similar roles.
* Strong leadership experience in coordinating investigations, task allocation, and operational workflows.
* Excellent SQL and diagnostic capability with hands‑on experience analyzing logs, workflows, and platform behavior.
* Proven track record of managing major incidents, leading bridges, and driving structured investigations.
* Strong grounding in ITIL practices, especially Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering or overseeing platform checks, recoveries, and reliability governance.
* Ability to mentor Analysts/Senior Analysts and lead team capability uplift.
* Strong communication skills for stakeholder coordination, documentation, RCA review, and operational reporting.
* Experience with monitoring and operational tooling (Splunk, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, New Relic, etc.).
* Experience in driving automation initiatives and operational efficiency programs.

title: Supply Planning Manager ANZ
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
We are seeking a commercially minded, detail-oriented and proactive Supply Planning Manager to lead the planning of purchased finished goods across the regional supply network. The portfolio includes Inter Unit Supply (IUS) products sourced from other Castrol entities and finished goods purchased from third-party (3P) manufacturers or suppliers. The role ensures the right products are available in the right place and at the right time to meet customer demand, while balancing service, inventory, cost and supply-chain resilience.
  
  
Using Castrol’s global digital planning platform, Kinaxis Maestro, the Supply Planning Manager owns the medium-to-long-term purchased-products supply plan across warehouses, source locations and external suppliers for the assigned portfolio. The role converts demand into planned purchase and transfer requirements, identifies network, supplier, logistics and inventory constraints, and leads cross-functional mitigation through the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes.
  
  
The role also provides day-to-day leadership to the supply planning team, setting priorities, building capability, ensuring consistent planning standards and creating a collaborative, accountable and customer-focused team culture across locations and time zones.
  
  
**Shift Timing: 3am to 12p IST**
**Key tasks**

* Purchased Products Supply Planning: Manage medium-to-long-term supply plans for IUS and third-party finished goods, translating demand into purchase/transfer requirements while balancing inventory, service levels, lead times, and supply constraints.
* IUS & Third-Party Planning: Coordinate with Castrol source units, suppliers, Procurement, Logistics, and market teams to manage replenishment, shipment priorities, supplier capacity, constraints, and supply risks.
* Inventory Management: Maintain product availability while minimizing excess, ageing, and obsolete inventory; manage stock allocation and improve inventory health and turns.
* S&OP / S&OE: Identify supply risks and opportunities, recommend mitigation scenarios, and drive cross-functional resolution of shortages, delays, allocation issues, and other supply constraints.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the supply planning team, strengthening capability across IUS, third-party planning, inventory management, scenario planning, and Kinaxis Maestro.
* Systems & Continuous Improvement: Use Kinaxis Maestro and ERP systems for planning and exception management, monitor key supply and inventory KPIs, maintain planning master data, and drive process and digital improvements.

**Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8–12 years of experience in supply planning, replenishment, purchased-products planning, inventory management or related supply-chain roles within FMCG, food and beverage, lubricants, chemicals or manufacturing environments.
* Proven experience planning imported or transferred finished goods and/or products sourced from third-party manufacturers or suppliers.
* Demonstrated people-management experience, including coaching, capability building, priority setting and managing performance across a planning team.
* Proven experience using an advanced planning system, ideally Kinaxis Maestro, for supply planning, exception management and scenario analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex supply information into clear decisions and actions.
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as JDE, together with strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and relevant reporting tools.
* Good understanding of S&OP, S&OE, DRP, inventory management, purchase planning, international supply flows and third-party supplier management.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions, cultures, countries and organisational levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead through ambiguity in a dynamic, global and fast-paced environment.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*
*If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.*

Manage the flow of demand into IT and the controlled introduction of change into the production environment, and ensure that internal and external service providers deliver reliably against agreed contracts, capacity and quality standards.

Demand & Capacity Management
  
  

* Operate the demand process in ServiceNow, from intake and qualification to prioritization and hand-over.

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose:**
Lead the end-to-end Production & Supply organisation for India, ensuring safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective product availability that enables customer service and profitable growth.
  
  
As the most senior P&S representative in India and a member of the Country Leadership Team, shape and deliver the country business agenda. Integrate planning, sourcing and production interfaces, logistics, import and customs, customer fulfilment, inventory and working capital to deliver a resilient, efficient and scalable supply chain.
  
  
Act as the strategic P&S partner to India Commercial Units, AMEA P&S and enterprise functions - bringing the voice of the country and customer into the wider function, while aligning supply priorities with India’s growth ambition.
  
  
Continue to drive the multi-year P&S transformation agenda across process, systems, data, people capability, organization design and governance. Elevate digital supply-chain solutions, including TMS, WMS, AI-enabled planning, automation and data-driven performance management, to improve visibility, service, decision quality and productivity.
  
  
**Dimensions**
**Financial**
- P&S operating budget, inventory and cost-of-supply accountability. Supports $400m in sales.
  
  
**People**
- 6 direct reports; 40+ indirect reports
  
  
**Geographic scope**
- India
  
  
**Key interfaces**
- Country Leadership Team; Commercial Units; AMEA P&S; Finance; Regulatory; Quality; HSE; Digital/GCC; and external partners
  
  
**Business complexity**
- Complex product portfolio and seasonal demand profile
  
  
**Transformation scope**
-Multi-year supply-chain, capability, systems and data transformation roadmap
  
  
**Core Accountabilities**

* Enterprise leadership and country strategy
* Represent P&S on the Country Leadership Team and contribute actively to country strategy, business policy, financial plans and operational priorities
* Member of the Board of Directors of Syngenta India Private Limited and accountable for its respective statutory accountabilities
* Own the India P&S strategy and translate business ambition into an integrated supply-chain roadmap, aligned with AMEA and global functional strategies
* Advise senior leaders on the supply, customer, cost, risk and capability implications of strategic and day-to-day business decisions; resolve cross-functional issues in the best interest of country priorities
* Benchmark P&S performance and capability against industry standards, with the ambition to build a leading supply-chain organization in India
* Supply reliability, customer service and integrated planning
* Ensure safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective product availability across India, delivering agreed customer-service, availability and OTIF outcomes through seasonal peaks for the CP business.
* Accountable of the logistics, import/export, customs operations for Field Crops in India.
* Lead the P&S contribution to S&OP/IBP and the commercial review process, translating demand into feasible supply, inventory, production and distribution plans for the CP business.
* Identify for the CP business the constraints early and lead fact-based trade-off, escalation and mitigation decisions across demand, supply, inventory and customer priorities and at the same time leverage synergies between the Supply operations of the CP and Field Crop business.
* Strengthen customer touchpoints and fulfilment processes to improve customer experience, responsiveness and confidence
* Financial performance, assets and working capital
* Deliver P&S contribution to India EBITDA through cost-of-supply, logistics, warehousing, sourcing and productivity improvements for the CP business
* Coordinate robust CP P&S inputs to budget and financial planning, grounded in forecast, product economics, opportunities, capacity and resource requirements for operations
* Optimise within the CP business inventory and working capital while protecting service and growth; build sound investment cases for strategic CapEx and OpEx decisions
* Safeguard business assets through effective delegation-of-authority, procedural controls, financial discipline and governance
* HSE, quality, compliance, risk and sustainability
* Maintain Syngenta Standards in HSE, quality, product stewardship, ethics, security and legal compliance
* Ensure country assets for CP operations, operations and partners meet applicable Syngenta standards, statutory requirements and regulatory obligations
* Represent CP P&S in the country risk-management forum; maintain robust business-continuity plans and mitigation actions for supply, logistics, trade and operational disruptions
* Define and deliver the CP supply-chain sustainability roadmap in support of country and organisational objectives
* Operations and external partner management
* Govern strategic suppliers, contract manufacturers, logistics providers, warehouse partners and customs/import interfaces to deliver agreed service, capability, cost, quality and compliance performance
* Represent the business on supply matters with external bodies, auditors, authorities, contractors, customers and other stakeholders as required
* Monitor, challenge and improve performance against country, regional and global KPIs
* Digital innovation and transformation
* Own and execute for CP operations the 12–24 month transformation plan and longer-term roadmap across physical supply chain and network, processes and governance, organisation and people capability, systems and data
* Scale the solutions including TMS, WMS, AI-enabled planning, automation and analytics - to improve visibility, productivity, decision quality and scalability for CP operations and drive any appropriate synergies with Field Crop operations
* Provide program leadership for strategic initiatives: align projects, resources, dependencies, governance, budgets and benefits realization
* People and enterprise leadership
* Build a future-ready, high-performing CP P&S organization; develop talent, succession and leaders aligned with country and functional strategic requirements
* Create an inclusive One Team culture across India, AMEA, GCC and Commercial Unit interfaces; inspire teams around shared priorities and disciplined execution
* Lead through change with clarity, resilience and accountability, while constructively managing resistance and complex stakeholder relationships

**Qualifications**
**Critical knowledge, experience and capabilities:**
**Critical knowledge**
Expert knowledge of end-to-end supply chain management, including S&OP/IBP, strategic product planning, demand forecasting, sourcing, manufacturing interfaces, logistics, warehousing, import and customs, inventory, cost and working capital. Sound understanding of India agribusiness, HSE, quality, product stewardship, regulatory requirements, financial business cases and digital supply-chain solutions. Experience of procurement and manufacturing is a plus.
  
  
**Critical Experience**
15+ years of progressive leadership experience across supply chain, operations, manufacturing, logistics or planning in a complex, regulated and preferably seasonal environment. Proven record of leading teams and external partners delivering customer service, EBITDA, cash, risk-management and transformation outcomes in a multinational or matrix context.
  
  
**Critical Capabilities**
Strategic, commercially astute and data-led leader who converts business ambition into executable supply plans. Able to influence across functions, translate customer needs into business solutions, govern partners, make sound trade-off decisions and lead large-scale innovation and change. Strong financial, analytical, project/program management and stakeholder-management capability.
  
  
**Critical Leadership Capabilities**
Sets direction and ambitious goals, communicates with impact, makes sound decisions amid uncertainty, leads change and performance, develops people, and collaborates across boundaries to build an inclusive One Team culture.
  
  
**Value Contribution And Measures Of Success**

* Understand big P/L impact items between production (make in India, value stream mapping, AMEA/country specific formulation technologies, etc.) and supply (EXIM, logistic, Warehouse, etc) – prioritize them and deliver the saving/productivity
* Protect revenue, gross margin and customer confidence through reliable product availability, customer service and OTIF performance - especially during seasonal peaks and disruptions
* Release cash and improve return on capital through disciplined inventory management and optimised working capital
* Create measurable value from transformation, TMS, WMS, AI-enabled planning and automation, reflected in improved service, cost, inventory, productivity and decision quality
* Maintain zero-compromise performance in HSE, quality, compliance, product stewardship, risk management and sustainability while delivering growth and value targets.

description:

Full time

General Equivalency Diploma
  
  
**Service Desk Analyst – Product Technical Support (24/7 Rotational Shift)**
**Job Location~ Chennai**
**The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.**
**About The Role**
As a Technician I, Product Technical Support, you’ll be part of a 24/7 Service Desk team supporting banking and financial-services applications and operational requests. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for technical issues, helping clients with incidents, service requests, access issues and application-related support. You’ll also help ensure high-priority incidents are escalated quickly and support requests are routed to the right teams. This role primarily supports U.S. business hours and includes rotational weekend and after-hours coverage.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Service Desk support for application, platform, access, connectivity and system-related issues, including user access, account unlock and password reset requests
* Triage incidents and service requests, assess business impact and priority, and route issues to the appropriate technical teams
* Create and maintain accurate ServiceNow tickets, including clear work notes, prioritization, assignment, follow-up and client updates
* Support high-priority incident escalation and coordinate after-hours or on-call support when required
* Monitor support queues, meet agreed service levels and identify recurring issues that can improve support efficiency and the client experience

**What You Bring**
*Required qualifications*

* 1-2 years of experience in banking operations, financial services, a Service Desk, customer service and/or technical support
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including creating, documenting, prioritizing, assigning and tracking incidents and service requests
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess business impact, determine issue priority and follow the appropriate escalation path
* Strong client-service and communication skills, including the ability to manage customer calls, follow-ups, escalations, ticket notes and client updates professionally
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a 24/7 support environment, including U.S. shifts, rotational weekends and after-hours or on-call coverage as required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting banking, payments or financial-services applications in a production environment
* Familiarity with IT service management practices, including incident, request, problem and escalation management
* Experience working in a global support environment with service-level commitments and rotational shift coverage

**The impact you’ll make**
As a Technician I, Product Technical Support, you’ll help keep business-critical support services running by responding to client issues, coordinating resolution and maintaining clear communication. Your work will help reduce disruption, improve response times and provide a consistent support experience. By identifying recurring issues and following effective support practices, you’ll also contribute to continuous service improvement.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Internal career growth opportunities
* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development
* Resources to contribute to your community

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

Radware is a global leader in cybersecurity and application delivery solutions, protecting applications and digital experiences against cyber threats while ensuring availability, performance, and reliability. Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment supporting global customers and critical network infrastructure.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a technically skilled and motivated Associate NOC Engineer to join our Network Operations Center team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of networking concepts, network monitoring, troubleshooting, and data center operations.
  
  
The role involves monitoring network infrastructure, identifying and resolving network incidents, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and ensuring high availability of critical network services in a 24/7 operational environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor network infrastructure, systems, and services using monitoring tools.
* Identify, investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve network-related incidents.
* Perform network troubleshooting and provide timely incident resolution.
* Monitor network performance, availability, and connectivity across data centers.
* Work with internal teams and international customers to resolve technical issues.
* Perform network analysis using packet capture and tracing tools.
* Handle incident escalation, documentation, and reporting.
* Ensure SLA compliance and maintain high availability of network services.
* Work in a rotational shift environment, including weekends and holidays, as required.

* Strong networking fundamentals equivalent to CCNA level.

* Experience working with Data Center environments.
* Ability to work under pressure in a high-availability operational environment.
* Good understanding of network troubleshooting and incident management.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to communicate effectively with international customers.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
* Knowledge of Load Balancers and Application Delivery Controllers (ADC).
* Experience with network packet analysis tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and Sniffer.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

* Willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

* Work with experienced technical teams in a global environment.

title: Senior SecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior SecOps Engineer**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Security & Infra Director
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Senior SecOps Engineer to implement, operate, maintain, and continuously improve security infrastructure and tools across cloud and on-premises environments. This role is focused on day-to-day security operations, including monitoring, incident response, vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and ongoing hardening of operating systems, servers, endpoints, networks, and security platforms. The engineer will be expected to perform most technical changes and remediation activities directly, while coordinating with IT, Infrastructure, SOC, Cloud, DevOps, R&D, and application owners where alignment, approvals, dependencies, or ownership boundaries are required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Security Infrastructure Operations
* Implement, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot security infrastructure and tools across cloud and on-premises environments, including SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability scanners, DLP, CASB, identity security, remote access, and monitoring platforms.
* Perform hands-on configuration, administration, upgrades, tuning, rule management, policy changes, and health monitoring of security systems and supporting infrastructure.
* Maintain secure configurations and hardening baselines for Windows, Linux servers, cloud workloads, network devices, endpoints, and security appliances.
* Support deployment and lifecycle management of security tools for data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, R&D environments, and corporate infrastructure.
* Investigate operational issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement the required technical fixes to improve stability, visibility, performance, and security coverage.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, procedures, configuration standards, and implementation guides for security systems.
* Ensure security infrastructure operates reliably and supports compliance, audit, risk management, and business continuity requirements.
* Security Monitoring & Incident Response
* Investigate threats, respond to incidents, and perform the required technical containment, recovery, and corrective actions, while coordinating with SOC, IT, Infrastructure, and Cloud teams as needed.
* Support threat hunting, security investigations, and operational reporting based on logs, telemetry, and security tool outputs.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Vulnerability Management & Security Assessments
* Conduct regular security assessments across servers, operating systems, cloud workloads, endpoints, network devices, applications, and security platforms.
* Operate and improve the vulnerability management program, including scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Analyze vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, exposed services, weak controls, and security gaps, and recommend practical remediation actions.
* Perform hands-on remediation of security findings, including configuration changes, hardening, patching coordination/execution, tool policy updates, and infrastructure fixes, while coordinating with IT, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and application owners where needed.
* Validate remediation effectiveness through rescans, configuration reviews, control testing, and follow-up assessments.
* Automation, Improvement & Collaboration
* Develop scripts, automation, queries, dashboards, and workflows to improve monitoring, investigations, reporting, remediation tracking, and operational efficiency.
* Implement security controls and technical improvements directly across cloud and infrastructure environments, while collaborating with cross-functional teams on dependencies, approvals, and ownership boundaries.
* Continuously improve security operations processes, tooling, documentation, and metrics based on incidents, assessments, audit findings, and operational lessons learned.

**Qualifications**

* Experience:
* 6+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, infrastructure security, system administration, network security, cloud security, or enterprise IT security.
* Proven experience implementing, operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting security tools and infrastructure in cloud and on-premises environments.
* Deep technical knowledge of Windows, Linux, servers, virtualization, networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoints, SIEM, XDR/EDR, vulnerability scanners, monitoring tools, and patch management.
* Strong experience analyzing security logs, alerts, events, and telemetry from multiple sources to identify and respond to security incidents.
* Hands-on experience with incident response, threat investigation, containment actions, root-cause analysis, and post-incident remediation.
* Experience conducting security assessments, vulnerability scans, configuration reviews, hardening checks, and remediation validation.
* Experience executing hands-on remediation activities, driving findings to closure, and coordinating with technical owners when dependencies or approvals are required.
* Strong understanding of network security, firewall policies, VPN/ZTNA, segmentation, IAM, privileged access, endpoint protection, cloud security controls, and infrastructure hardening.
* Ability to write clear operational procedures, incident response playbooks, security reports, technical documentation, and implementation guidance.
* Hands-on experience with Linux and Windows based platforms.
* Hands-on experience with firewalls, SIEM, XDR, CASB, DLP, EDR, vulnerability scanners, patch management, backup security, and configuration management tools.
* Experience with monitoring, automation and orchestration systems.
* Experience with securing R&D environments.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SSCP, Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, GCED, CCNA/CCNP Security, Microsoft/Azure Security, AWS Security, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Skills:
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills in complex technical environments.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize operational tasks, and personally drive incidents, investigations, implementations, and remediation activities to closure.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings, risks, and remediation steps to IT, infrastructure, cloud, and security stakeholders.

Need to Have

title: IT Technician
description:
**About the Role**
The IT Technician provides hands-on technical support across Microsoft 365, Intune, Windows, macOS, Linux, and security tools such as Microsoft Defender. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, a customer-first attitude, and the ability to communicate clearly with end users.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the M365 Suite (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint), Windows 10/11, macOS, and Linux.
  
• Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and networking/VPN connectivity issues.
  
• Apply in-depth understanding of networking concepts, including firewalls, switches, and routers.
  
• Handle remote troubleshooting using tools such as TeamViewer.
  
• Administer and troubleshoot Active Directory (AD), Entra ID, meeting room hardware, AV equipment, and printers.
  
• Ensure timely issue resolution within SLA/SLO, escalating appropriately when needed.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on escalations and documentation.
  
• Maintain clear, professional communication with end users, including a neutral, fluent English accent.

• 5-7 years of relevant experience, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), Intune, Defender, Windows OS, macOS, and Linux.
  
• Experience with Active Directory, Entra ID, JIRA, Confluence, and TeamViewer.
  
• Ability to troubleshoot M365 app errors, Outlook sync issues, and networking/connectivity issues.
  
• Ability to support meeting room technology and peripherals, including AV equipment and printers.
  
  
**Good to Have**
• Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft/Azure, or firewall vendor certifications.

title: [India] Infrastructure Engineer / System Administrator
description:
**Introduction:**

Edgecortix Inc. is seeking a strong system administrator to work as part of our Infrastructure team. If you have a strong desire to build next-generation AI chips and systems, join us and let's reshape the future of AI at the edge.

**About Edgecortix:**

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high-efficiency silicon-on-chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-exploration engine and Dynamic Neural Accelerator ™ AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bringing the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices.

As a team, we are working to define and solve the hardest problems in AI including computer vision, speech, and natural language, geared towards real-time capabilities on small to medium form factor devices. We originated out of multiple years of research, as such at our core we value learning, intellectual curiosity, and self-starters. **Your Role and Responsibilities:**

In this role you will mainly be responsible for setting up and maintaining our computer server infrastructure and networks.

We expect you to set up and maintain our servers, company computers and network. This includes Linux servers, Virtualized infrastructure, enterprise level switching hardware, Windows Active directory user management, network file storage, and back up solutions. * Backup and disaster recovery solutions

* VPN setup and management experience
* Familiarity with securely handling user credentials and login information
* Experience providing internal end-user support in general IT issues
* Knowledge of Docker, including networking, YAML configuration, and container management

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Red Hat Enterprise Linux ( RHCSA)
* Experience providing specifications of servers for specific tasks and requirements
* Able to provide recommendations of hardware and software based on needs that arise
* Internal DNS, DHCP, IP, and route management
* Firewall and WAN management (CCNA)

* Automatic failover management for internal services( Pacemaker, Heartbeat, MS Failover Cluster, etc)
* Managing and planning of Multi-site networking and S2S VPN services
* Keeping up-to-date documentation of server and network infrastructure
* Able to rack/stack and set up a server from scratch, including networking and documentation

* Top-tier employee benefits

title: RMA & Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Join Us as an RMA & Technical Support Engineer!**

Are you passionate about solving technical challenges, improving product reliability, and ensuring operational continuity? ORBCOMM is seeking an RMA & Technical Support Engineer to support our growing Evergreen fleet operations by managing return material authorizations (RMAs), coordinating service pool assets, and helping drive continuous improvements in product performance and customer support outcomes.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

At ORBCOMM, you'll play a key role in supporting mission-critical IoT and telematics solutions that keep global operations connected and efficient. As part of our Manufacturing organization, you'll work closely with engineering, operations, service teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify product issues, manage repair and replacement processes, and maintain fleet readiness.

This position is based in Hyderabad, India and is a full-time employee role. You will have the opportunity to contribute directly to product quality, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction while collaborating with teams across the organization.

**What You'll Do**

**RMA Management & Product Reliability**

* Proactively identify defective units and initiate the RMA process.
* Investigate product failures and collect relevant technical information to support root cause analysis.
* Coordinate the return, repair, replacement, and tracking of hardware assets.
* Maintain accurate records and reporting for all RMA activities.
* Support efforts to improve overall product reliability and reduce repeat failures.

**Service Pool Operations**

* Manage service pool inventory to ensure availability of replacement units.
* Coordinate movement of devices between the service pool and operational fleet.
* Monitor inventory levels and recommend replenishment actions as needed.
* Ensure timely processing of repaired and replacement units.

**Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide technical support for hardware-related issues affecting deployed assets.
* Diagnose and document technical problems using established processes and tools.
* Escalate complex issues to engineering and manufacturing teams when required.
* Assist in validating corrective actions and resolution effectiveness.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Customer Support teams to resolve product issues.
* Communicate status updates and findings to stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to product quality, repair processes, and operational efficiency.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Track key operational metrics related to RMAs, service pool readiness, and product performance.
* Develop and maintain reports that improve visibility into RMA activity and operational health.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve operational control.
* Support documentation updates and process standardization efforts.

**Who You Are**

You are a detail-oriented technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting hardware issues, managing operational processes, and collaborating across teams to deliver reliable outcomes. You are comfortable balancing technical investigation with administrative accuracy and process discipline.

**If you have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4-6 years experience supporting hardware products, electronics, telecommunications equipment, IoT devices, or related technologies.

* Experience managing RMAs, repair operations, technical support activities, or product lifecycle processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, test results, and diagnostic information.
* Experience using inventory management, ticketing, ERP, CRM, or related operational systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Experience working effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting IoT, telematics, satellite communications, fleet technology, or connected device solutions.
* Experience in manufacturing, quality, repair depot, or service operations environments.
* Familiarity with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies.
* Experience developing operational reports and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of hardware failure analysis and product reliability concepts.
* Experience working in global or geographically distributed teams.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

**The Benefits of Working Here**  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

**About Us**

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

**Ready to Join Us?**

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Senior Advanced Technical Support Specialist - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Senior Advanced Technical Support Specialist - India**
========================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Senior Advanced Product Support Specialist |Hyderabad OR Pune|Hybrid**

  

**About Cornerstone**

Cornerstone believes human potential grows exponentially when AI works in service of people. Global Customer Support is where that promise is kept — one customer, one case, one conversation at a time.
  
At Cornerstone, we're passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their people. Our customers rely on our technology to develop talent, build skills, and drive business success. Delivering exceptional customer experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  
Our Global Customer Support team plays a critical role in bringing that commitment to life. We are relentlessly customer-obsessed, focused not only on resolving issues but also on building trust, driving engagement, and ensuring customers realize the full value of their Cornerstone solutions. We believe every customer interaction is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference, strengthen relationships, and help our customers succeed.
  
We're looking for individuals who share our passion for delivering exceptional service, embrace innovation and AI-powered technology, and take pride in making every customer interaction count.

Working in a collaborative, AI-enabled support environment, you will leverage advanced troubleshooting capabilities, AI-powered insights, and strong partnerships with Engineering and Product teams to identify root causes, resolve critical issues, and proactively address emerging customer challenges. Rather than managing a traditional case queue, you will focus on the most complex, high-risk, and aging cases where your expertise can make the greatest impact.

Partner directly with the Pod Director to identify technical risks, improve support processes, and strengthen overall pod performance, including case aging, backlog health, defect quality, and customer satisfaction.

**You've Got What It Takes If You...**

  

Have 5+ years of experience in advanced technical support, SaaS product support, or a similar technical role, with deep expertise in complex enterprise software environments.
  
Possess advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with demonstrated experience resolving complex product, integration, configuration, and data-related challenges.
  
Are recognized as a trusted technical expert who can confidently diagnose complex issues, validate solutions, and guide others through challenging technical situations.
  
Have experience collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to investigate defects, document technical findings, and drive effective issue resolution.
  
Are comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools, support analytics, and customer sentiment data to identify trends, improve technical support quality, and drive operational improvements.
  
Demonstrate strong mentoring, communication, and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to develop technical capabilities across a team and influence others without direct authority.
  
Are proactive, collaborative, and customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of accountability and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.
  
Are committed to completing required Expert-tier certification within your first 90 days, maintaining deep expertise in your primary product area, and expanding your knowledge across related Cornerstone solutions.

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. title: Assistant Manager - FirstLine Support (French Language Expert)
description:

* Document each request precisely in the ticketing system.
* Analysis and understanding of requests:

* Categorization and prioritization:

* Apply the appropriate level of impact in accordance with incident management processes.
* Transfer and collaboration with Level 2 teams:
* Escalate requests to the appropriate teams.
* Collaborate with Level 2 Support Agents to improve the quality of transfers and enrich their knowledge.
* User monitoring and information:
* Keep users informed of the progress of their requests.
* In the event of a critical incident, communicate promptly with the appropriate team.
* Contribution to the knowledge base:
* Maintain knowledge base information.
* Propose improvements or additions to optimize the service.

* Understanding of OVH products desirable but not essential

* Good communication skills within a team

title: Application Support Engineer and API Monitor
description:
**About Servify:**

Servify is a global product lifecycle management platform transforming the after-sales service experience. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in India, Servify connects leading OEM brands with their sales and service ecosystems to deliver seamless customer support and service operations. Servify partners with leading brands, retailers, distributors, insurers, service providers, and carriers across Asia, North America, Europe, and the MENA region.

Servify embraces and values diversity and is committed to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all members and will give equal consideration to all irrespective of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief.

**Why Join Servify?**

At Servify, you'll be part of a fast-growing global technology company that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, ESOPs, employee-friendly policies, modern collaboration tools, professional development opportunities, and benefits that help you do your best work.

**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a Senior Application Support Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in technical/application support, API monitoring, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for providing technical support to customers and internal teams while proactively monitoring API health, performance, and error rates using tools such as Kibana, Databricks, Coralogix, and Grafana. The role involves investigating API failures, identifying root causes, configuring alerts, and managing incidents end to end while ensuring adherence to SLAs. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Postman, and command-line tools, along with the ability to leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot to automate repetitive tasks, streamline troubleshooting, and improve support efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* API Monitoring & Dashboard Management: Monitor API endpoints, logs, performance, and error rates using tools such as Kibana, Databricks, Coralogix, and Grafana. Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations to track API health and identify recurring issues.
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate API failures, including 4xx/5xx errors, timeouts, and rate-limit issues. Perform log correlation and use SQL queries, Postman, curl, and API documentation to identify root causes and implement appropriate resolutions.
* Alerting & Proactive Issue Detection: Configure, maintain, and optimize alerting rules and thresholds using Kibana/Elastic Alerting, Databricks, and related monitoring tools to detect potential issues proactively and minimize customer impact.
* Automation & AI-Enabled Support: Use Python to develop scripts for log parsing, data analysis, and repetitive task automation. Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot to streamline troubleshooting, generate incident summaries, draft resolutions, and improve support productivity.
* Incident & Ticket Management: Prioritize, track, and resolve technical support tickets while managing incidents end to end. Classify incidents based on severity levels (P1–P4), ensure adherence to response and resolution SLAs, coordinate with relevant stakeholders, and provide timely updates during service disruptions.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in technical/application support, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Strong hands-on skills in SQL (writing queries to investigate, join, and analyze data across tables) and Python (scripting for log analysis, automation, and API testing). Both are mandatory.
* Solid understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, HTTP status codes, JSON/XML, and API authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWT), with working knowledge of Postman, curl, or similar API testing tools.
* Hands-on experience with Kibana/ELK, Databricks, Coralogix, and Grafana (Discover, dashboards, alerting), along with log query languages such as Lucene/KQL and DataPrime.
* Working knowledge of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) for support and troubleshooting productivity, and familiarity with ticketing systems such as Jira and Freshdesk.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, good written and verbal communication for customer-facing interactions, ownership mindset, calm under pressure, and flexibility to work rotational shifts.
* Good to have: experience building AI-based internal automations or bots, cloud platform exposure, ITIL knowledge, on-call/incident management experience, and prior experience in the extended warranty or device protection industry.
