title: Field Service Engineer I
description:
The Field Service Engineer (FSE) is responsible for installing, maintaining, and servicing Repligen systems; ATF, TFF and Chromatography systems throughout the country, but occasionally also internationally.
  
  
The FSE is to provide remote and onsite support and work closely with the local sales team and product managers / project managers / support teams (customer service, complaints, service support) located in the USA and in Europe in order to meet and troubleshooting the customer needs.
  
  
The FSE shall maintain accurate documentation of all service activities and escalating issues as needed.
  
  
Occasional out of office hours support is required to communicate with colleagues in the USA and Europe.
  
  

* Provide service support, including repair and preventive maintenance, for equipment and document all service activities. Service will be executed at customer sites.
* Perform installation and training on equipment, software, and other accessories; report back on issues, orders and parts needed.
* Perform Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and IOQ on Repligen products at customer sites globally
* Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) performed in the USA or in Europe remotely (or occasionally in person) during the matching time zone of the FAT location.
* Work in accordance with company’s SOP’s and according to Repligen’s quality system.
* Complete product and SOP training on a regular basis and in a timely manner.
* Schedule and perform preventative maintenance on equipment as required. The local manager may oversee and dictate the scheduling.
* Problem-solving tasks may include resolving mechanical/electrical/software issues; resolving operating system bugs; and reinstalling software or hardware
* Enhance the customer’s positive experience by recognizing their needs and providing solutions that meet and often surpass those needs
* Communicate effectively both internally and externally, to document actions and item performed, schedule future preventive maintenance needs, and other engineering functions.
* Provide technical support to colleagues from other departments globally.
* Increase service sales and provide support to colleagues from other departments in order to increase service sales.
* Promote new Repligen products with customers and provide leads to the sales team.
* Provide phone support to customers and service group personnel related to equipment hardware and software performance and service part ordering.
* Document and distribute technical information regarding resolutions to field problems, hardware and software changes, and product quality improvements
* Review service manual documentation to ensure accuracy and current revision levels
* Determine appropriate preventive maintenance procedures, service parts kits, and schedules to ensure effective on-going equipment maintenance
* Keep the workplace clean and tidy, both at customer site and in office.
* Involve or lead projects and assignments as part of the professional development opportunity.

**Qualifications**
**Education, Training & Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electronics or Instrumentation or related discipline.
* At least 6 years’ experience in the repair, maintenance, and installation of equipment used in a scientific instrument, laboratory, or bioprocess setting or in the biotechnology sector, ideally experienced with filtration equipment
* Strong knowledge of cGMP and GDP
* Good knowledge in understanding Industrial Instruments for basic parameters like Pressure, flow,Temperature,Volume, pH,conductivity etc..
* Dood knowledge in UV-Spectroscopy is an added advantage
* Electronic and mechanical aptitude required
* Basic knowledge in Siemens automation
* Basic knowledge in Allen Bradley automation
* Basic knowledge in iFix software knowledge
* Basic knowledge in Wonderware / Intouch software
* Understanding of GAMP regulations and US FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
* Ability to understand automation architecture, IO List, electrical schematics, SDS, HDS and FDS documents
* Experience with Salesforce Lightning is an added value.
* Software and Automation knowledge:
* Aveva Wonderware
* Allen Bradely Studio 5000
* Siemens TIA Portal
* iFix

**Knowledge, Skill, and Ability**

* Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal/written communications skills.
* Great attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Ability to prioritize and work independently to achieve defined goals
* Ability to work well within a global, cross functional team
* Must be willing and able to work flexible hours to accommodate client schedules even outside of office hours.
* Ability to draft and execute SOPs and work instructions.
* Self-learning ability and resourceful and creativity to resolve complex problems in the field
* Able to make up to 90% domestic travel and occasionally internationally
* Be able to travel in a cost effective and time efficient manner to and from customer sites in own/public transport.
* Able to lift and carry weights (including equipment and toolbox) individually of up to 25kg.

As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the go-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Your main focus will be on providing first-line support by monitoring private and public cloud infrastructure, identifying problems early, and resolving technical incidents efficiently. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring we meet our service level agreements and deliver an excellent client experience.
  
  
Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. If incidents occur, you'll investigate and get to the root cause swiftly to restore services. Your tasks will also include executing approved maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes and providing telephonic or chat support to clients when needed.
  
  
Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. We are seeking a highly skilled

Our firm primarily invests in commercial retail real estate, meaning our operations require a deep understanding of complex retail leasing structures, intricate CAM reconciliations, and variable sales tracking.
  
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between our technology stack and our business operations. You will be responsible for system configuration, user permissions, database health, custom reporting, and onboarding new retail assets. The ideal candidate doesn't just know how to configure Yardi—they understand the underlying financial and operational mechanics of commercial retail real estate.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* System Administration & Optimization

+ Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert (SME) for all things related to Yardi Voyager (Commercial/Retail module) and integrated applications (e.g., CommercialCafe, Yardi Advanced Budgeting & Forecasting)
+ Manage user provisioning, custom security roles, workflow approvals, and system menus to ensure data security and compliance
+ Lead the technical onboarding, data migration, and setup of newly acquired commercial retail assets into the Yardi database
+ Monitor, test, and implement Yardi system updates, plug-ins, and new module rollouts, ensuring zero disruption to daily business operations

* Retail Operations & Financial Support

+ Support the property management and accounting teams with complex, retail-specific configurations, including Common Area Maintenance (CAM) setups, tax/insurance reconciliations, and recovery configurations
+ Oversee the technical setup and execution of Percentage Rent parameters, gross sales tracking, and variable retail leasing structures
+ Troubleshoot system errors related to retail lease administration, tenant billings, and recurring charge schedules

* Reporting & Business Intelligence

+ Design, develop, and maintain custom reports and dashboards using Yardi Spreadsheet Reporting (YSR), Yardi Correspondence, or SQL/SSRS to support executive decision-making
+ Collaborate with asset management and finance teams to optimize data flow, automate manual workarounds, and ensure data integrity across all portfolios

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, Real Estate, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Yardi Expertise: Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on administration experience specifically within Yardi Voyager Commercial/Retail. (Applications with purely residential or multifamily experience will not be considered)
* Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of commercial real estate accounting principles, commercial lease logic, and retail recovery mechanics (CAM, recurring charges, overage rent)
* Technical Skills: Proficiency with Yardi database structures, database mapping, and writing custom reports (YSR, Yardi Script, or basic SQL query writing)
* Preferred/Nice-to-Have:

+ Experience with Yardi Advanced Budgeting & Forecasting (ABF)
+ Experience implementing or managing CommercialCafe or tenant portals
+ Prior experience working at a commercial real estate investment, asset management, or development firm

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong analytical troubleshooting skills—someone who loves solving complex data puzzles
+ Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business insights for non-technical team members
+ Self-motivated and comfortable acting as the sole, go-to Yardi expert in the organization

**Working Requirements**

* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Will work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (EST)

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a global investment bank with expertise in mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Houlihan Lokey serves corporations, institutions, and governments worldwide with offices in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region.   Champion the adoption of ERP enhancements, automation tools, and data analytics to streamline manual workflows and improve reporting accuracy.

  **4-6 years**
  of hands-on experience in a multinational corporate or manufacturing setup in the FMCG sector.

  A self-starter comfortable owning end-to-end execution as well as strategic advisory without direct reportees, while effectively influencing cross-functional teams.
* **Technical Expertise:**
  Deep working knowledge of Indian accounting standards, direct/indirect tax laws, statutory audits, and commercial finance analysis.
* **Systems & Agility:**
  Strong proficiency in major ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel/financial modeling; prior exposure to finance digitization projects is a strong plus.
* **Communication:**
  Sharp analytical skills paired with the ability to present complex financial insights clearly to global matrixed stakeholders.

We are looking for an experienced Banking Operations professional with hands-on knowledge of payment gateway operations, transaction reconciliation, merchant settlements, TID/MID configuration, risk rule mapping, vendor onboarding and RBI regulatory reporting support.

title: Operations Manager
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER

Employment Type: Operations & Client Coordination

We are looking for an Operations Manager who will be responsible for managing day-to-day operations, coordinating with clients, and ensuring that every order is executed smoothly from order confirmation to final delivery.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, responsive, and capable of coordinating between clients, production, design, purchase, quality control, dispatch, and management.

The person will act as a key point of contact for clients and ensure that every client receives proper updates, timely replies, and professional communication throughout the order cycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Relationship Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.

* Maintain strong and professional relationships with existing clients.

* Understand client requirements, specifications, timelines, and expectations.

* Respond to client calls and messages promptly and professionally.

* Ensure no client query or request remains unanswered.

* Keep clients updated regarding order status, production progress, dispatch, and delivery.

* Handle client concerns and coordinate internally to resolve issues quickly.

* Follow up with clients for approvals, artwork, specifications, purchase orders, and other required information.

2. Order Management & Execution

* Receive and understand confirmed orders from clients.

* Prepare and maintain proper order details and execution schedules.

* Coordinate with the production team to ensure orders are executed as per approved specifications.

* Track every order from PO → Artwork/Approval → Production → QC → Packing → Dispatch → Delivery.

* Ensure production timelines are aligned with committed client delivery dates.

* Identify delays or operational issues in advance and immediately escalate them to management.

* Ensure that the final product matches the approved specifications and client requirements.

3. Internal Coordination

Coordinate closely with:

* Sales / Client Team — for order details and client requirements

* Design Team — for artwork and approvals

* Production Team — for manufacturing schedules and execution

* Quality Control — for quality checks and approvals

* Purchase / Stores — for raw materials and stock availability

* Dispatch / Logistics — for timely delivery

* Management — for escalations and important client matters

4. Client Communication

The Operations Manager must ensure that communication with clients is:

* Clear

* Professional

* Timely

* Accurate

* Solution-oriented

Before communicating timelines, quantities, pricing-related information, production status, or delivery commitments, the candidate must verify the information internally.

5. Order Tracking & Reporting

* Maintain an updated order tracking system.

* Track pending approvals, production status, pending materials, QC status, and dispatch status.

* Prepare daily/weekly operational updates for management.

* Maintain records of client communication and important commitments.

* Highlight delayed, urgent, or high-priority orders to management.

6. Problem Solving & Escalation

* Identify operational bottlenecks before they affect clients.

* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve production or delivery issues.

* Communicate delays honestly and professionally to clients after confirming the revised timeline.

* Escalate major quality, production, commercial, or client issues to management promptly.

Key Performance Expectations

The Operations Manager will be expected to ensure:

Client Query → Quick ResponseOrder → Proper PlanningProduction → Regular Follow-UpQuality → Proper VerificationDispatch → On-Time CoordinationClient → Regular & Accurate Updates

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and client-handling skills.

* Strong follow-up and coordination abilities.

* Good understanding of manufacturing/order-execution processes.

* Ability to manage multiple orders simultaneously.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good problem-solving ability.

* Ability to work under deadlines.

* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets and basic office tools.

* Professional WhatsApp and email communication.

* Ability to coordinate effectively with factory and office teams.

Preferred Experience

* 3–7 years of experience in operations, production coordination, client servicing, order management, or a similar role.

title: Commercial Operations Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced professional with strong expertise in Taxation, Company Law, Statutory Compliance, Commercial Management, Logistics, Purchase, and Import–Export operations.

The candidate should have comprehensive business and commercial understanding, with experience across multiple industries. The role requires the ability to independently manage taxation and regulatory matters, ensure corporate and statutory compliance, oversee commercial and procurement activities, and coordinate logistics and international trade operations.

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on professional with strong leadership, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Taxation & Financial Compliance**

* Manage direct and indirect taxation matters, including Income Tax, GST, TDS, and other applicable taxes.
* Ensure timely filing of GST returns, TDS returns, income tax returns, and other statutory submissions.
* Handle GST reconciliations, tax assessments, audits, notices, and departmental queries.
* Coordinate with tax consultants, auditors, and financial institutions.
* Ensure tax planning, compliance, and effective management of tax liabilities.

**2. Company Law & Corporate Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with the Companies Act and applicable corporate laws.
* Handle ROC filings, annual returns, statutory registers, and other corporate documentation.
* Coordinate with Company Secretaries, legal advisors, and regulatory authorities.
* Manage Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), resolutions, and related documentation.
* Ensure adherence to corporate governance policies and statutory requirements.

**3. Commercial Management**

* Oversee commercial operations, contract management, and business agreements.
* Review and negotiate commercial terms, vendor agreements, purchase contracts, and service-level agreements.
* Manage pricing, costing, payment terms, credit control, and commercial negotiations.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities and improve commercial efficiency.
* Ensure proper documentation and risk management across commercial transactions.

**4. Purchase & Procurement**

* Manage end-to-end procurement and purchasing activities.
* Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and vendors.
* Monitor purchase orders, pricing, delivery schedules, and vendor performance.
* Ensure cost-effective procurement while maintaining quality standards.
* Develop vendor management policies and procurement processes.

**5. Logistics & Supply Chain Management**

* Oversee domestic and international logistics operations.
* Coordinate transportation, warehousing, inventory movement, and delivery schedules.
* Manage freight forwarding, customs clearance, and logistics documentation.
* Optimize logistics costs and ensure timely movement of goods.
* Coordinate with transporters, shipping agents, customs brokers, and other stakeholders.

**6. Import–Export Operations**

* Manage end-to-end import and export documentation and processes.
* Ensure compliance with DGFT, Customs, GST, FEMA, and other applicable regulations.
* Handle shipping bills, bills of entry, commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificates of origin.
* Coordinate with customs authorities, freight forwarders, banks, and international clients/vendors.
* Monitor export incentives, duty benefits, and applicable foreign trade policies.
* Ensure smooth execution of international trade transactions.

**7. Leadership & Strategic Management**

* Independently manage and oversee multiple functional areas.
* Establish internal control systems, SOPs, and compliance frameworks.
* Lead cross-functional teams and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide strategic inputs to senior management on taxation, compliance, procurement, and commercial matters.
* Identify business risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of taxation, GST, TDS, and Income Tax.
* Sound understanding of Company Law and ROC compliances.
* Expertise in statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Strong commercial acumen and business understanding.
* Knowledge of purchase, procurement, logistics, and supply chain operations.
* Hands-on experience in import–export procedures and documentation.
* Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong vendor, stakeholder, and team management capabilities.
* Ability to handle multiple functions independently.

Educational Qualifications

* CA / CMA / CS / MBA Finance / M.Com / LLB or equivalent qualification.
* Relevant professional certifications in taxation, corporate compliance, or international trade will be an added advantage.

Experience & Industry Exposure

* 10–15+ years of overall experience in taxation, company law, compliance, and commercial operations.
* Experience working across multiple industries such as Manufacturing, Engineering, Trading, Infrastructure, FMCG, Automotive, or other diversified business sectors.
* Prior experience in independently handling multiple functions and reporting directly to senior management will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* A well-rounded professional with exposure to both financial and operational functions.
* Strong understanding of business operations beyond finance and compliance.
* Ability to manage taxation, legal compliance, commercial, purchase, logistics, and international trade activities.
* A strategic yet hands-on individual capable of taking ownership of cross-functional responsibilities

- Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support via phone, email and the Service Desk ticketing system.
  
- Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network and access-related issues, escalating more complex incidents where required.
  
- Accurately log, manage and close incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
  
- Provide remote user support, including account management, password resets, hardware configuration and Microsoft 365 applications.
  
- Support new starter onboarding, including account setup, hardware configuration and guidance on IT tools and processes.
  
- Work collaboratively with 3rd line, network and infrastructure teams while contributing to processes, procedures and the IT knowledge base.

  

**About You**

You will be a customer-focused IT support professional with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to confidently diagnose and resolve technical issues. Comfortable working in a busy Service Desk environment, you will combine technical knowledge with clear communication and a professional approach to user support.
  
  
- Experience working within an IT Service Desk or similar technical support environment.
  
- Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows desktop operating systems, PCs, laptops and network printing, with Mac and iOS -knowledge advantageous.
  
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a focus on first-time resolution wherever possible.
  
- Experience working to SLAs and KPIs, managing your own workload and accurately recording incidents and resolutions.
  
- Knowledge of ITIL methodologies, particularly Service Desk and Incident Management.
  
- Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to remain organised and effective when working under pressure.

description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are seeking a motivated and skilled Technical Analyst - SaaS Applications to join our team. This role focuses on administering, supporting, enhancing, and continuously improving enterprise SaaS applications. The successful candidate will ensure that business applications remain secure, reliable, and aligned with organisational objectives while supporting digital transformation initiatives and the adoption of new technologies
  
  
**What You'll Do**




+ SaaS Application Administration and Management

You will support the implementation, administration, and ongoing management of enterprise SaaS applications, ensuring seamless integration with existing business systems. You will contribute to product roadmaps, platform enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining high levels of system performance and user satisfaction.
  
  

* User Access and Configuration Management

You will manage users, roles, permissions, workflows, business rules, and platform configurations, ensuring secure and efficient operation of business applications. You will administer access controls in line with company policies and compliance requirements.
  
  

* Data Management and Integrations

You will perform data uploads, extracts, validation, reconciliation, and support integrations between SaaS applications and enterprise platforms. You will ensure data accuracy, consistency, and seamless information flow across systems.
  
  

* Production Support and Issue Resolution

You will provide L2/L3 production support, troubleshooting application, workflow, data, integration, and access-related issues while ensuring incidents and service requests are resolved within agreed service levels.
  
  

* Testing, Releases and Deployments

You will support SIT, UAT, regression testing, releases, patches, upgrades, and deployments across Development, Test, and Production environments. You will assist in delivering enhancements and business requirements while maintaining application stability and quality.
  
  

* Root Cause Analysis and Documentation

You will perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and maintain technical and functional documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
  
  

* Platform Governance and Continuous Improvement

You will monitor platform health, identify optimisation opportunities, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, user experience, security, and operational effectiveness.
  
  

* Strategic Support and Execution

You will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to support strategy development, identify process improvement opportunities, and help deliver initiatives that drive operational excellence and digital transformation.
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

You will act as a key point of contact for application-related initiatives, communicating progress, risks, and solutions to stakeholders. You will also support user training, adoption activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  

* Technical Expertise and Support

You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across SaaS platforms and interfaces, maintain application documentation, and support integrations and automation initiatives to improve interoperability between systems.
  
  

* Business Process Support

You will support business processes enabled through SaaS applications, ensuring systems remain aligned with operational requirements, regulatory obligations, and organisational objectives.
  
  

* Implementation of New Solutions and Digitalisation

You will participate in the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of new SaaS solutions and digital capabilities. You will work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment, change management, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Usage Analytics and Reporting

You will analyse platform utilisation, user adoption, and consumption trends to identify optimisation opportunities. You will develop reports, dashboards, and recommendations that support informed business decisions and maximise value from SaaS investments.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, Data Science, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 3 years' experience administering, supporting, or implementing enterprise SaaS applications.
* Experience managing cloud-based applications throughout their lifecycle, including implementation, support, upgrades, and optimisation.

**SaaS Platforms Experience**
Hands-on experience administering and supporting one or more enterprise SaaS platforms, including: SAP Fieldglass, Ivalua, and other enterprise SaaS applications.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Experience with user and access management, role-based security, workflow administration, and application configuration.
* Experience with system integrations, APIs, data imports/exports, and middleware platforms.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with cloud-based integration technologies and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting application releases, upgrades, testing cycles, and production environments.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices, incident management, problem management, and change management processes.

**Methodologies and Tools**

* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and experience using Azure DevOps or similar tools for project and backlog management.
* Experience working within IT governance, security, audit, and compliance frameworks.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive issues to resolution.
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and knowledge-sharing skills.
* Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives and driving continuous improvement.

**Desirable**

* Professional certifications relevant to SaaS platforms, cloud technologies, IT service management, or project delivery.
* Experience working within global, cross-functional environments.
* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled solutions, and data analytics platforms.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
Role Purpose

To lead the end-to-end Supply Chain function, ensuring seamless integration of strategic sourcing, procurement, material planning, inventory management, logistics, warehousing and supplier development. The role will focus on optimizing supply chain costs, improving operational efficiency, ensuring uninterrupted material availability and strengthening supplier partnerships to support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Lead direct and indirect procurement, vendor selection, negotiations and contract management.
* Drive cost optimization through localization, alternate sourcing, VA/VE and strategic negotiations.
* Develop a competitive and reliable supplier base.
* Establish long-term strategic partnerships with key suppliers.

**2. Supply Planning & Production Control**

* Lead demand planning, material planning and production scheduling in coordination with Sales, Manufacturing and Finance.
* Ensure timely material availability to meet production plans.
* Drive S&OP processes and improve planning accuracy.
* Monitor critical components, capacity constraints and supply risks.
* Ensure effective coordination between manufacturing plants and suppliers.

**3. Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Develop strategies to optimize raw material, WIP and finished goods inventory.
* Improve inventory turnover and reduce excess, obsolete and non-moving inventory.
* Ensure inventory accuracy and effective warehouse management.
* Drive lean inventory management and working capital improvement.

**4. Supplier Development & Performance Management**

* Identify, evaluate and develop suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery and capability.
* Establish supplier performance metrics covering OTD, PPM, lead time and cost.
* Drive supplier audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop alternate sources for critical components.
* Collaborate with Quality and Engineering teams to improve supplier performance.

**5. Logistics & Distribution**

* Lead inbound and outbound logistics, transportation and freight management.
* Optimize logistics costs and transportation efficiency.
* Ensure timely movement of materials across plants and warehouses.
* Improve supply chain responsiveness and delivery performance.

**6. Cost Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive cost reduction and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Implement Lean, Kaizen, 5S and process improvement practices.
* Leverage ERP/SAP and digital tools to improve supply chain visibility.
* Identify supply chain risks and develop business continuity plans.

**7. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Supply Chain team.
* Establish clear KPIs and performance accountability.
* Work closely with Manufacturing, R&D, Quality, Sales and Finance.
* Drive cross-functional initiatives to improve business performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Procurement cost reduction and annual savings.
* Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD).
* Supplier quality and rejection levels (PPM).
* Inventory turnover and inventory holding costs.
* Material availability and production adherence.
* Logistics cost optimization.
* Supplier lead-time reduction.
* Working capital improvement.
* Reduction in excess and obsolete inventory.

Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Industrial, Production or Automobile Engineering.
* MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Materials Management preferred.

Experience & Competencies

* 18–25 years of overall experience in Supply Chain / Procurement / Materials Management.
* Strong leadership experience in Automotive, Tractor, Farm Equipment or Engineering Manufacturing.
* Proven exposure to end-to-end supply chain operations.
* Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, production planning, inventory management, logistics and supplier development.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation and cost optimization capabilities.
* Experience in SAP/ERP systems and supply chain analytics.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

**About Flashoot**

Flashoot is a technology-driven content creation platform that connects customers with skilled creators for professional short-form video content, reels, weddings, events, brand campaigns, and other creative requirements.

As we expand our presence in Bangalore, we are looking for a highly responsible, self-motivated, and target-driven individual who can independently manage our city operations and contribute to business growth.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**City Lead – Sales & Operations**
who will take complete ownership of Flashoot's Bangalore operations.

This is a combination of sales, customer relationship management, creator coordination, and end-to-end operational execution.

The ideal candidate should be someone who doesn't wait for instructions, takes initiative, solves problems independently, and ensures every customer has an exceptional experience with Flashoot.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales & Revenue Generation**

* Handle inbound enquiries, customer calls, and booking requests.
* Understand client requirements, explain Flashoot's services and packages, and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Conduct timely follow-ups with potential customers and close deals.
* Achieve assigned monthly revenue, booking, and conversion targets.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, referrals, and local business development.
* Meet potential clients in person whenever required.

**2. End-to-End Booking & Operations Management**

* Take complete ownership of every booking, from confirmation to successful completion.
* Understand client expectations, shoot requirements, timings, locations, and deliverables.
* Assign suitable creators based on availability, skill, and client requirements.
* Brief creators clearly about the shoot, client expectations, references, and deliverables.
* Ensure creators reach the shoot location on time and are fully prepared.
* Coordinate with clients and creators to ensure smooth execution.

**3. Deliverables & Client Experience**

* Track every shoot until all committed deliverables are completed and shared with the client.
* Ensure quality standards and delivery timelines are maintained.
* Proactively resolve client concerns, shoot-related issues, and operational challenges.
* Collect customer feedback and reviews after every completed booking.
* Maintain strong customer relationships and encourage repeat bookings.

**4. City Operations Ownership**

* Act as the primary point of contact for Flashoot's Bangalore operations.
* Maintain creator availability and operational readiness across the city.
* Coordinate with the central operations team whenever required.
* Ensure all leads, bookings, creator assignments, and customer interactions are updated in the CRM.
* Monitor daily bookings, revenue, pending deliverables, and customer issues.
* Identify operational gaps, take corrective action, and continuously improve processes.
* Support Flashoot's business expansion across Bangalore.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

* 2–5 years of experience in sales, operations, customer relationship management, or business development.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple bookings, customers, and creators.
* Highly responsible, proactive, self-motivated, and solution-oriented.
* Comfortable working with revenue targets and performance expectations.
* Strong multitasking, time management, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.
* Good knowledge of Bangalore's geography and local market.
* Proficiency in English and Kannada preferred; Hindi or Telugu is an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel locally and be available during important shoots, weekends, or peak business periods when required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Monthly revenue and booking target achievement.
* Lead-to-booking conversion rate.
* Lead response time and follow-up effectiveness.
* On-time creator assignment and shoot execution.
* Timely completion and delivery of committed deliverables.
* Client satisfaction, feedback, and repeat business.
* CRM accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency.

**What Makes This Role Different?**

This is not a traditional desk-based operations role. We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, takes complete responsibility for outcomes, and is motivated to grow Flashoot in Bangalore. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of a growing city operation, make independent decisions, build customer relationships, and play a key role in Flashoot's expansion.

**If you are someone who takes ownership, loves closing deals, enjoys solving real-world challenges, and can manage operations independently, we would love to hear from you.**

**Apply at:**
hr@flashoot.com

title: Finance Team Lead
description:
**Why CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO)**
When you join CBRE Business services Organization (BSO), you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive.
  
  
At CBRE- Business services Organization (BSO), We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact.
  
  
CBRE Business Services Organization (BSO), Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people and you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.
  
  
**Job Title**
– Finance Team Lead
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Cash Management (Team) Lead to help deliver accurate day-to-day processing of payments, invoices, vendor information, and related reporting across all levels of complexity. You will handle complex and non-routine cases, review and approve payments, guide analysts, and coordinate daily work and/or assigned projects.
  
  
Working with internal stakeholders, you will resolve exceptions, support operational controls, and identify opportunities to improve processes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Daily operations and payment controls
  
  

* Manage shared mailboxes, prioritize incoming requests, and allocate work to analysts.
* Review and release straight-through processing (STP) payment batches in Kyriba and CT.
* Review and release manual payments across banking and payment platforms; prepare manual payments as a backup when required.
* Approve vendors and act as a backup for the four-eye payment check.
* Process complex payment requests, investigate exceptions, and respond to complex vendor and client enquiries.
* Support bank reconciliations involving complex transactions and act as the first escalation point for individual transactions when assigned.

**Reporting, audit, and process improvement**

* Run invoice status reports for clients and support accurate operational reporting.
* Coordinate audit support, collect evidence, and respond to audit queries.
* Identify process improvement opportunities while troubleshooting operational exceptions.
* Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) for system implementations and upgrades, report defects, and retest fixes.

**Team guidance and stakeholder coordination**

* Provide ongoing training, technical guidance, and functional support to new and existing team members.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders and facilitate meetings to resolve issues and coordinate delivery.
* Take responsibility for daily team delivery and/or assigned projects, including coordinating and assigning tasks as appropriate.
* Carry out other duties relevant to the role as assigned.

**What You'll Need**

* Relevant experience in cash management or payment operations, including complex transactions, payment reviews, and exception resolution.
* Experience working with banking platforms across the EMEA region. Ability to work with banking and payment platforms; familiarity with Kyriba and CT is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and an understanding of payment controls, vendor approvals, bank reconciliations, and audit evidence.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to handle vendor/client enquiries and coordinate with internal stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize workloads, guide colleagues, and coordinate operational tasks or projects.
* A practical approach to process improvement, system testing, defect reporting, and retesting.

**Company Perks And Benefits**

* Health Care: Health Insurance to Self, Immediate family & Parents/In-laws
* Accident & Term life Insurance for all employees Accident & Term life Insurance for all employees.
* Food & Snacks: Free Meals & snacks are provided in all shifts.
* Mental Wellbeing: A confidential service that provides facility of counselling to keep you emotionally & mentally well while dealing with the challenges.
* Child Care: We partner with Klay day care and CBRE employees get 100% waiver on admission fee. This Day school is in our HYD campus.
* Entertainment: On floor - Chess, Carrom board, Table tennis, Foosball.

**Our Values In Hiring**
At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong.
  
  
We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.
  
  
**CBRE Business Services Organisation (BSO) is a part of CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE):**
CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2023 revenue). The company has more than 130,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction, and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services. Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. We intend to use our website as a means of disclosing material, non-public information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Such disclosures will be included in the Investor Relations section of our website at https://ir.cbre.com. Accordingly, investors should monitor such portion of our website, in addition to following our press releases, Securities and Exchange Commission filings and public conference calls and webcasts.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Customer Service Finance
description:
**Description**
Senior Finance Analyst — Customer Service Finance (CSF) — Hyderabad work from office
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
Function: Finance
  
  
Team: Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF)
  
  
Role: Senior Finance Analyst
  
  
Reports to: Finance Manager, Customer Service Finance
  
  
Experience: 3+ years of relevant business finance, accounting, FP&A, controllership and analytical experience
  
  
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory
  
  
**About Amazon Finance**
Finance at Amazon is about much more than numbers. It is about understanding the story behind the data, challenging assumptions, identifying risks and opportunities, and partnering with business leaders to make informed, timely decisions.
  
  
Our Finance teams work closely with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and other cross-functional organizations. Finance professionals serve as trusted business advisors, combining financial expertise, data-driven analysis, business judgment, and strong communication skills to influence decisions and improve business outcomes.
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded, and proactive Chartered Accountant to join the Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF) team. The ideal candidate will bring strong controllership fundamentals along with experience in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, process improvement, automation, and stakeholder management.
  
  
**About Customer Service Finance**
Customer Service Finance (CSF) is a strategic finance partner to one of the world's largest Customer Service organizations. The team supports business leaders through financial analysis, controllership, planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Working across geographies and functions, CSF partners with Customer Service Operations, Retail, Technology, HR, and other Finance teams to optimize costs while maintaining and improving customer experience.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a Chartered Accountant who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment and wants to operate as a strategic finance partner rather than focus solely on traditional accounting activities.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Finance Analyst will support the Customer Service organization across financial controllership, planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis.
  
  
The role will serve as the financial owner and trusted advisor for assigned sites or business areas. This includes partnering closely with operational leadership to understand business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive actions that improve financial outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate will go beyond reporting historical results to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken.
  
  
**Key Areas Of Responsibility Include**
Financial controllership
  
  
Month-end close and reporting
  
  
Forecasting and financial planning
  
  
Variance and root-cause analysis
  
  
Financial modeling
  
  
KPI and metrics analysis
  
  
Business partnering
  
  
Cost optimization and productivity
  
  
Process improvement and automation
  
  
Data analytics and reporting
  
  
Risk and opportunity management
  
  
Management reporting
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Financial Controllership

Own controllership activities for assigned Customer Service sites or business areas.
  
  
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.
  
  
Prepare and review monthly financial metrics and management reports.
  
  
Ensure financial information is accurate, complete, timely, and aligned with accounting and controllership standards.
  
  
Analyze performance against plan, forecast, and prior periods.
  
  
Identify financial risks, anomalies, and control gaps and drive corrective actions.
  
  
Partner with Accounting and business teams to resolve discrepancies.
  
  
Establish and maintain effective financial controls and mechanisms.
  
  

* Financial Planning & Forecasting

Support annual operating plans, budgets, and periodic forecasting cycles.
  
  
Develop financial models for business planning and investment decisions.
  
  
Analyze actuals against budget, forecast, and prior-year performance.
  
  
Identify key drivers of financial movements and communicate them clearly to leadership.
  
  
Develop forward-looking views of business performance.
  
  
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
  
  
Assess the financial impact of operational initiatives, investments, and cost-saving opportunities.
  
  

* Variance Analysis & Business Insights

Conduct detailed variance analysis across costs, headcount, productivity, and other financial and operational KPIs.
  
  
Identify the underlying business drivers behind financial performance.
  
  
Perform deep dives to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes.
  
  
Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights.
  
  
Present findings and recommendations to senior management.
  
  
Challenge assumptions and proactively highlight areas requiring management attention.
  
  

* Business Partnering

Act as a trusted financial advisor to Customer Service Operations and site leadership.
  
  
Partner with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and Finance teams.
  
  
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decisions through data and financial insights.
  
  
Understand operational processes and connect business drivers with financial outcomes.
  
  
Provide timely financial guidance to business leaders.
  
  
Help stakeholders understand the financial implications of their decisions.
  
  
Constructively challenge assumptions and recommend alternative solutions where appropriate.
  
  

* "CFO of Your Sites" Ownership

For assigned sites or business areas, operate as the CFO of the site, taking end-to-end ownership of financial performance.
  
  
**This Includes**
Owning the financial performance narrative.
  
  
Partnering directly with site leadership.
  
  
Understanding the operational drivers of financial performance.
  
  
Identifying and quantifying risks and opportunities.
  
  
Tracking financial actions through completion.
  
  
Establishing effective finance mechanisms.
  
  
Driving accountability for financial performance.
  
  
Ensuring leadership has timely and accurate financial information.
  
  
Recommending actions that improve both cost efficiency and customer experience.
  
  

* Cost Optimization & Productivity

Identify opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining or improving customer experience.
  
  
Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers and productivity metrics.
  
  
Evaluate the financial impact of operational and process changes.
  
  
Develop business cases for cost-reduction and productivity initiatives.
  
  
Track benefits realization and ensure savings are measurable.
  
  
Benchmark performance and identify opportunities for standardization and scalability.
  
  

* Data Analytics & Reporting

Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data.
  
  
Build recurring reports, dashboards, and financial metrics.
  
  
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities through data analysis.
  
  
Develop automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort.
  
  
Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract and transform data.
  
  
Partner with Data and Technology teams to improve data quality and accessibility.
  
  
Ensure reporting is consistent, scalable, and aligned with stakeholder needs.
  
  

* Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve Finance processes.
  
  
Eliminate unnecessary manual activities and reduce reporting complexity.
  
  
Design scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple sites or businesses.
  
  
Lead automation initiatives that improve accuracy, efficiency, and controllership.
  
  
Standardize financial reporting and business mechanisms where appropriate.
  
  
Measure and communicate the impact of process improvements.
  
  
Challenge existing mechanisms and develop better solutions as business needs evolve.
  
  

* Reconciliation & Financial Systems

Reconcile financial reports across businesses, systems, and reporting sources.
  
  
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial and operational data.
  
  
Work with financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards, Essbase, Cognos, or similar platforms.
  
  
Maintain data integrity across reporting mechanisms.
  
  
Identify recurring reconciliation issues and implement sustainable solutions.
  
  
Support system and process changes that affect financial reporting.
  
  

* Management Reporting & Communication

Prepare regular financial reviews and business performance updates.
  
  
Present results, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Communicate financial concepts clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
Develop concise narratives explaining key financial and business movements.
  
  
Ensure leaders understand both the numbers and the underlying business drivers.
  
  
Influence decisions through fact-based analysis and strong financial judgment.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
  
The role may involve analyzing and reporting on metrics such as:
  
  
Actual vs. Budget and Actual vs. Forecast
  
  
Month-over-month and year-over-year performance
  
  
Operating expenses and cost per contact/transaction
  
  
Cost per customer interaction
  
  
Headcount and labor costs
  
  
Productivity and capacity utilization
  
  
Staffing efficiency
  
  
Forecast accuracy
  
  
Financial controllership metrics
  
  
Cost savings and productivity benefits
  
  
Process efficiency
  
  
Customer-experience-related financial metrics
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — mandatory.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
  
  
3+ years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, financial analysis, FP&A, business finance, or a related analytical role.
  
  
Strong understanding of accounting and financial principles.
  
  
Proven experience in financial analysis, variance analysis, forecasting, and management reporting.
  
  
Experience working with financial KPIs and business performance metrics.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, financial modeling, and data analysis.
  
  
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA, Master's degree in Finance, or equivalent advanced qualification.
  
  
Experience in a multinational, technology, e-commerce, shared-services, or high-growth environment.
  
  
Experience with SQL and large-scale data analysis.
  
  
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools.
  
  
Experience with Oracle, SAP, Essbase, Cognos, JD Edwards, Lawson, MS Access, or other financial/reporting systems.
  
  
Experience in financial controllership and month-end close.
  
  
Experience in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning.
  
  
Experience leading process improvement or Finance automation initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with large datasets and developing automated reporting solutions.
  
  
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or process re-engineering.
  
  
CPA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification in addition to CA is an advantage.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Financial Acumen
  
  
Strong accounting and finance fundamentals.
  
  
Ability to understand financial statements and business drivers.
  
  
Strong financial modeling and forecasting capabilities.
  
  
Analytical Thinking
  
  
Ability to analyze complex datasets.
  
  
Strong root-cause analysis skills.
  
  
Ability to distinguish meaningful insights from low-value details.
  
  
Business Judgment
  
  
Understands the commercial and operational implications of financial decisions.
  
  
Balances cost, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  
  
Stakeholder Management
  
  
Comfortable working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  
  
Able to influence without direct authority.
  
  
Builds credibility as a trusted Finance partner.
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Takes ownership of ambiguous and complex problems.
  
  
Uses data to identify root causes.
  
  
Develops practical, scalable solutions.
  
  
Process Improvement
  
  
Continuously seeks opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, and scale.
  
  
Demonstrates measurable impact from improvement initiatives.
  
  
Communication
  
  
Converts complex financial analysis into clear and compelling business narratives.
  
  
Confidently presents findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant who combines strong accounting fundamentals with commercial awareness and analytical thinking.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**
Thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Independently owns financial deliverables from data gathering through executive communication.
  
  
Has strong controllership and financial analysis experience.
  
  
Understands how operational decisions translate into financial outcomes.
  
  
Is comfortable working with large datasets and financial systems.
  
  
Uses data to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
  
  
Demonstrates strong ownership and a bias for action.
  
  
Can simplify complex financial problems.
  
  
Enjoys collaborating across functions and geographies.
  
  
Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
  
  
Has a continuous-improvement mindset.
  
  
Communicates effectively with both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
  
  
Wants to grow into a strategic business partner rather than remain focused solely on traditional accounting.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Success In This Role Means**
Financial reporting is accurate, timely, and well controlled.
  
  
Forecasts and financial plans are reliable and supported by clear assumptions.
  
  
Leadership has clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities.
  
  
Variances are understood at their root cause rather than simply reported.
  
  
Finance insights translate into measurable business decisions and outcomes.
  
  
Cost-reduction and productivity opportunities are proactively identified and delivered.
  
  
Finance processes become increasingly automated, scalable, and efficient.
  
  
Manual reporting and reconciliation activities are reduced.
  
  
Site and business leaders view Finance as a trusted strategic partner.
  
  
Financial risks and opportunities are identified early and driven through to closure.
  
  
Why Join Customer Service Finance?
  
  
**Role**
This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Operations, Technology, Data, and Customer Experience. As a Finance Analyst and qualified Chartered Accountant, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  
Serve as a trusted Finance advisor to a global Customer Service organization.
  
  
Work directly with senior business and operational leaders.
  
  
Influence significant business and investment decisions.
  
  
Analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets.
  
  
Build and automate Finance mechanisms.
  
  
Drive measurable cost and productivity improvements.
  
  
Gain exposure to a highly international and cross-functional environment.
  
  
Develop from a Finance specialist into a broader business leader.
  
  
Make a measurable impact on both customer experience and business performance.
  
  
Ideal Candidate at a Glance
  
  
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory

With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an FP&A - Senior Associate you will support financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and analysis that inform decision-making across the business. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex issues, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful stakeholder connections, and guide junior team members while developing your own technical skills and business context within our Internal Firm Services practice. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will support finance leaders with P&L analysis, performance reporting, revenue and cost forecasting, and interpretation of monthly results to identify risks and opportunities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Finance Senior Associate within the Business Partnering Team is a key support for general Finance and business decision support. Working closely with the Finance Managers to produce the financial insights needed by our business, and taking increased leadership over work with experience, this is a collaborative, diverse and engaging role, and a vital function to the firm.
  
  
Our Finance teams are an integral part of each area of the business, working closely with leaders to help drive business performance, identify and drive financial improvements, prepare plans and budgets, and report on the performance of the business - commercially, and functionally. PwC takes a people-first approach to Finance, and empowers its Business Partnering teams to be collaborative and value-adding.
  
  
The Individual In This Role Can Expect To Be Exposed To a Variety Of Critical Finance Functions, Depending On Their Skills And Aspirations. They Will Also Build Working Relationships With Other Business Partnering Teams, The Directors Of Finance, Business Leaders, And PwC’s Centres Of Excellence. The Primary Responsibilities And Areas The Finance Management Team Operates Across, Which The Candidate May Gain Experience In And Choose To Further Develop, Include:
  
  
Business strategy and planning
  
  

* Use business insights and detailed analysis to provide the Business and Finance Leads with support and guidance on P&L management
* Provide ad hoc support to the Finance Leader, responsible for sourcing information and providing quality analysis of information
* Assist and provide depth of insight to the Leadership team enabling key strategic decision making
* Assist with Business revenue & cost forecasting
* Demonstrating an understanding of the business issues and applying market, industry and firm knowledge

Budgeting and forecasting
  
  

* Working with the Finance Leaders in assisting to prepare budgets, plans and forecasts.
* Assisting with the production of forward looking and insight driven reporting for the business to help the business plan, prepare and manage future performance.

Performance management and commercial oriented solutions
  
  

* Assistance in interpretation of the monthly financial results and preparation of commentary to the Finance Leader
* Monitoring areas of financial performance against Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) held in the financial scorecard, escalating issues where management action is required, with supporting analysis
* Work closely with the wider business support teams to develop relationships and understand the strategic imperatives of the business

Financial control and compliance
  
  

* Assistance with providing Partners with relevant accounting advice from the bid stage to through the life of engagements
* Spreading local financial risk knowledge to the Financial Control centre of excellence and supporting the central team with complex queries that require local business insight
* Providing local intelligence to the Financial Control centre of excellence in line with agreed guidelines

Complex Engagement Support
  
  

* Undertake revenue recognition, forecasting, performance variance activities as required by engagements.
* Proactively highlight risks and opportunities to financial performance and develop actions to mitigate, correct or exploit as appropriate with senior decision makers
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with good attention to detail
* Action orientated and a self-starter
* Focused on continuous improvement in all areas of their work
* A strong relationship builder who builds trust in their key stakeholders

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least 4-9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for a Bachelor's degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Finance, Economics

* Interpreting monthly results and KPI trends for decision making
* Supporting P&L management, budgeting, and variance analysis
* Building relationships with senior stakeholders across finance

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant with 5+ years’ post-qualification experience to join our India Controllership team as a Sr. Financial Accountant. This role will be based in AMD’s India offices in Bengaluru or Hyderabad, with broad exposure across fixed asset accounting, month-end close, audit support, regulatory compliance, and treasury operations. The successful candidate will ensure accurate financial reporting, strengthen internal controls, and support continuous improvement and automation initiatives across the region.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**FIXED ASSET & MONTH-END ACCOUNTING**

* Maintain the integrity and accuracy of the fixed asset register, including timely capitalization, classification and reconciliation of assets, with appropriate tracking against applicable accounting and tax thresholds.
* Execute month-end close activities, including preparation and review of accruals, trial balance variance analysis and balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Prepare and finalize monthly service commission costs and common cost allocations in accordance with the applicable GAAP, and facilitate the required SAP review and approval workflows.

**BALANCE SHEET REVIEW & AUDIT SUPPORT**

* Coordinate monthly balance sheet review meetings, monitor account ageing and drive the timely resolution of identified reconciling items and action points.
* Support statutory audits by reviewing accruals, preparing and updating profit and loss and balance sheet schedules, providing audit evidence and resolving auditor queries within agreed timelines.

**COMPLIANCE & INTERNAL CONTROLS**

* Perform ongoing reviews of the Internal Financial Controls Risk and Control Matrix, assess control effectiveness and support the timely remediation of identified control gaps.
* Oversee MSME compliance by monitoring invoice ageing against statutory payment timelines, coordinating invoice posting and payment release, maintaining credit note and issue trackers, and supporting process simplification initiatives.

**TREASURY & CASH MANAGEMENT**

* Manage cash forecasting, funding requirements, payment operations, banking activities and short-term investments while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and regulatory requirements.

**PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & SYSTEMS**

* Identify and implement opportunities to strengthen finance processes through standardisation, automation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5+ years' post-qualification experience in a multinational or audit environment (Big 4 or international public accounting firm trained).
* Working knowledge of applicable accounting standards (local GAAP/Ind AS/US GAAP exposure) and hands-on exposure to month-end close, fixed asset accounting, and audit support.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize and interpret large data sets and translate them into clear, actionable insights.
* Ability to work and adapt in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.
* Flexibility to meet reporting deadlines and deal with priority requests.
* Proficiency with ERP/finance systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or similar) for GL postings, capitalisation, and reporting workflows.
* Advanced Excel skills; working knowledge of PowerPoint and reporting/dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI) is an advantage.
* Exposure to automation or AI-enabled productivity tools, and an interest in process-improvement initiatives, is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coordinate across cross-functional teams, auditors, and global/offshore stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with a proactive and solution-focused mindset.

Bengaluru / Hyderabad, India

title: Senior Analyst – Global Enterprise Portfolio Management
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Senior Analyst – Global Enterprise Portfolio Management
  
  
The Global Enterprise Portfolio Management (GEPM) team is seeking a Senior Analyst based in Hyderabad to collaborate with colleagues across Deloitte’s global network. The role will support targeted research, due diligence, data analysis, reporting, planning, and operational activities related to cross-border considerations associated with Deloitte’s multidisciplinary model (MDM).
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring experience in market research, benchmarking, data analytics, database-driven research, and reporting. They will be able to synthesize complex information, develop clear and actionable insights, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders in a global, virtual team environment.
  
  
Work you’ll do
  
  
As a Senior Analyst on the GEPM team, you will:
  
  

* Partner with member firm EPM teams to conduct due diligence, including company research, development of entity diagrams, and completion of designation and Tendering Preferred Advisory Clients (TPAC) templates.
* Use Deloitte systems and processes, including CIR, Jupiter, DESC, Vision360, and Tableau to identify MDM-related considerations, synthesize due diligence findings, prepare concise summaries for senior leadership review, and support GEPM case-management workflows.
* Respond to ad hoc leadership requests with timely, tailored analyses, insights, and reports.
* Support GEPM team members across priority initiatives, recurring processes, and operational activities.
* Communicate research, analysis, and reporting results through clear, concise PowerPoint presentations and Excel summaries.
* Strengthen GEPM’s data and reporting capabilities by maintaining accurate and timely data, supporting reporting and knowledge-management activities, and updating the GEPM webpage.

The team
  
  
Global Enterprise Portfolio Management proactively manages complexities of our multidisciplinary model (MDM) in support of our long-term global plan for each of our businesses by enabling our leaders to make proactive and intentional decisions, unlock the power of our firm’s MDM, and effectively navigate the challenges of our MDM in the context of evolving market dynamics and our clients’ choices
  
  
Work Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Working Timing: 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. IST
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Four or more years of professional experience, including at least three years in market research, business research, benchmarking, due diligence, data analytics, or a related field.
* Postgraduate degree or MBA in business, strategy, commerce, finance, economics, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Experience interacting with senior stakeholders and preparing materials for leadership review.

**Required Skills And Professional Experience**

* Excellent English communication skills, including written, verbal, and presentation capabilities, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Strong secondary research skills and experience using databases such as Factiva, OneSource, D&B Hoovers, Thomson Reuters, or comparable platforms.
* Strong data analysis and management capabilities, including the ability to synthesize information, identify relevant insights, and draw logical conclusions.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, including experience developing analyses and executive-ready presentations.
* Strong attention to detail, personal ownership, and commitment to accuracy across deliverables.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and demonstrated experience collaborating within global, virtual teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Understanding of professional services firms and their business models.
* Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Experience using workflow, case-management, or records-management platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to streamline and automate workflows and business operations.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
