title: Manager – Corporate Legal & Secretarial Advisory
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a senior professional who is a qualified Company Secretary and Law Graduate, with strong experience in corporate law, legal documentation, regulatory compliances and advisory services. The role will involve managing the firm's corporate secretarial and legal practice, leading a team responsible for routine corporate compliance and execution, while also independently handling and advising on complex corporate structuring, startup advisory, investment transactions, FEMA and cross-border regulatory matters.

The candidate should be comfortable working with established businesses as well as startups, founders, investors and investment funds, and should bring a strong combination of technical knowledge, practical execution capabilities and client management skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. Corporate Secretarial and Legal Support

Lead and oversee routine corporate secretarial compliances for a portfolio of companies, LLPs and other entities.

Manage incorporation, restructuring, conversion, capital restructuring, share allotments, transfers, buybacks and other corporate actions.

Spearhead the drafting and vetting of diverse legal contracts and agreements, and advise clients on navigating legal matters, dispute resolution, and drafting/responding to legal notices.

Assist clients in effectively managing ongoing legal matters, mitigating risks, and ensuring legal and regulatory compliance.

Handle ROC filings, MCA compliances, maintenance of statutory registers, minutes, resolutions and other secretarial records.

Oversee annual compliances, Board and General Meetings, and other requirements under the Companies Act, 2013 and LLP Act.

Lead and guide a team handling day-to-day secretarial assignments, ensuring quality, timelines and client deliverables.

2. Startup, Investment & Transaction Advisory

Advise startups, founders, investors and investment funds on corporate structuring, investment structures, capitalisation and governance matters.

Draft, review and negotiate Shareholders' Agreements (SHA), Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), Investment Agreements, Founders' Agreements, ESOP plans and other commercial and transaction documents.

Guide the stakeholders and assist companies in completion of CPs and CS with complete ownership for transactions.

Advise on equity investments, preferential allotments, rights issues, convertible instruments, CCPS, CCDs, warrants and other investment structures.

Assist in due diligence, transaction structuring, term sheet reviews, investment documentation and deal execution.

Advise on founder exits, secondary transactions, share buybacks, business transfers and other corporate transactions.

3. FEMA, FDI & Cross-border Advisory

Handle and advise on inbound and outbound investments, FDI, ODI, overseas investments and other FEMA-related matters.

Advise on foreign investment structures, downstream investments, overseas holding structures and cross-border transactions.

Handle RBI/FEMA reporting, including FC-GPR, FC-TRS, Form DI, LLP filings, APR and other applicable regulatory filings.

Liaise with authorised dealer banks, RBI, DPIIT and other regulatory authorities.

Advise on ECB, foreign remittances, transfer of shares, repatriation, Branch and Liaison office, and other cross-border regulatory matters.

4. Corporate Structuring & Strategic Advisory

Advise on business and investment structuring, holding company structures, subsidiary arrangements, group reorganisations and restructuring.

Advise on corporate governance, shareholder rights, promoter arrangements, related-party transactions and regulatory considerations.

Work closely with the firm's tax, accounting and transaction advisory teams to provide integrated solutions to clients.

Advise on IPO readiness, pre-IPO corporate restructuring, governance and compliance requirements.

6. Team Leadership & Client Management

Lead, mentor and develop a team of company secretarial and legal professionals.

Allocate assignments, monitor deliverables and ensure timely completion of client engagements.

Independently interact with founders, CFOs, investors, promoters, legal counsels and senior management.

Review the quality of legal documentation, regulatory filings, opinions and advisory deliverables.

Identify additional advisory opportunities within the existing client portfolio and contribute to developing the firm's corporate legal and secretarial practice.

Desired Candidate Profile

Qualified Company Secretary and Law Graduate (LL.B.).

8–10 years of relevant professional experience in a CA firm, law firm, consulting firm or corporate legal/secretarial function.

Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, LLP Act, FEMA, FDI Policy, ODI Regulations and SEBI regulations.

Hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing SHAs, SSAs, SPAs, investment agreements and other corporate transaction documents.

Good exposure to startup ecosystem, venture capital transactions, private equity investments and founder/investor advisory.

Experience in handling FEMA, FDI and ODI transactions, including regulatory reporting and liaison with AD banks.

Exposure to IPO readiness, SME/Main Board listing requirements and capital markets will be an advantage.

Ability to independently manage client engagements, lead teams and handle multiple assignments.

Strong drafting, analytical, communication and client relationship management skills.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can go beyond routine secretarial compliance and support corporate legal and transaction advisory services. The individual should be equally comfortable reviewing a routine ROC filing, leading a team handling corporate compliances, drafting a shareholders' agreement, advising a startup on its investment structure or handling a cross-border FEMA transaction.

title: Director, ETS - Global Software Asset Management
description:
Job Title: Director - Software Asset Management (SAM)
  
  
GCL: F
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you prepared to guide a global Software Asset Management capability that protects compliance, unlocks value and fuels a data-led, patient-focused enterprise? As Director, Software Asset Management, you will set the strategy and run the end-to-end software governance that keeps our business audit-ready, cost-optimized and primed to scale. Your decisions will help our scientists and teams access the right tools at the right time, so we can bring life-changing medicines to patients faster.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Service Asset and Configuration Management and lead a worldwide dispersed team. Partnering closely with sourcing, legal affairs, information security, enterprise architecture, finance and business-aligned technology groups, you will represent AstraZeneca with strategic software publishers and SAM tooling partners. Can you imagine shaping enterprise agreements and standards that save millions, reduce risk and empower thousands of colleagues—while building an energized, high-performing team?
  
  
**Accountabilities**
Strategy, Governance and Compliance: Lead the global SAM strategy, policy, processes, standards and governance to ensure consistent, enterprise-wide compliance and reporting. Serve as the named control owner for software licence compliance, maintaining a continuous state of audit readiness and leading all vendor audits and internal assessments through to successful closure. Define and govern the full software lifecycle—from request and procurement, through entitlement, deployment and usage, to true-up, reallocation and retirement—ensuring a seamless AZ Software Store experience.
  
  
Value, Optimisation and FinOps: Drive measurable cost optimization and value realization from strategic enterprise agreements. Partner with Procurement and Finance to inform renewals, true-ups and rationalization, turning insights into budget decisions. Monitor and report consumption versus entitlement, identifying gaps, surplus and reharvest opportunities, and feed data-driven recommendations into planning and investment cycles. Champion software economic decision-making across technology teams to set standards, evaluate alternatives and consolidate where it counts.
  
  
Tooling, Data and Integration: Own the SAM tooling roadmap and customer success for platforms such as Flexera FNMS, ServiceNow SAM and App Portal, ensuring tight integration with IT service management, CMDB and hardware asset management. Safeguard the integrity of entitlements, contracts, installations and usage data as a single source of truth. Advance automation and self-service for software request, fulfilment and reclamation to elevate user experience and reduce manual effort.
  
  
Collaborator Engagement and Partnership: Build positive relationships with senior collaborators across Procurement, Legal, Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Finance and business-aligned technology groups to embed SAM standards and controls. Manage strategic software publisher and SAM partner relationships to influence roadmaps, secure favorable commercial outcomes and unlock new capabilities. Promote SAM advocacy and license compliance across the enterprise to raise awareness and establish the right behaviors.
  
  
Leadership: Lead and continuously develop a strong, globally distributed team across the UK and our Global Technology Centre, strengthening capability, succession and engagement. Play an active role in the SACM leadership team to align strategies and deliver outcomes at scale. Define compelling business cases and interlock investments with medium-term planning to transform AstraZeneca’s software governance capability and sustain long-term impact.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant IT experience leading global Software Asset Management or comparable IT governance / compliance functions.
* Demonstrable track record of leading software vendor license audits and large-scale internal compliance programmes.
* Deep knowledge of enterprise software publishers and license models – e.g. Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, IBM, Salesforce, Adobe, ServiceNow, VMware.
* Hands-on experience of SAM tooling (Flexera FNMS, ServiceNow SAM, App Portal) and integration with ITSM and CMDB.
* Experience leading large global teams and multi-million dollar software portfolios and budgets.
* Experience of dealing with Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience working in the Biopharmaceutical / Life Sciences industry.
* Recognised SAM / ITAM certifications – e.g. IAITAM CSAM, CITAM, ITIL, ISO/IEC 19770.
* Experience of FinOps / IT cost optimisation disciplines applied to software.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* SDLC, Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here you will blend technology leadership with tangible patient impact, working in a modern, fast-moving environment where curiosity and high standards go hand-in-hand. We bring together diverse experts to solve complex problems, using data, analytics and AI to scale what works and reimagine what’s next. You’ll have the autonomy to take ownership, the backing to invest in bold ideas and the support of leaders who coach and recognize growth. We value kindness alongside ambition, pairing rigorous governance with a collaborative culture so you can build capabilities that shape the enterprise and leave a legacy that matters.
  
  
**Call To Action**
If you are ready to lead a global SAM capability that reduces risk, maximizes value and accelerates our impact on patients, step forward and shape what’s possible.

title: Counsel
description:
**Job Overview**
When you join ICIMS, you join the team helping global companies transform business and the world through the power of talent. Our customers do amazing things: design rocket ships, create vaccines, deliver consumer goods globally, overnight, with a smile. We empower these organizations to attract, engage, hire, and advance the right talent. We’re passionate about helping companies build a diverse, winning workforce and about building our home team. We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive, purpose-driven, and innovative work environment where everyone belongs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a member of the ICIMS legal team, you will have a direct impact by advising and supporting all areas of the organization as we continue to transform recruiting for our customers. Our team needs another creative problem-solver who’s cool under pressure and brings sound judgment and creativity to devise practical advice that appropriately weighs our legal and business objectives. You’ll independently negotiate routine to moderately complex SaaS agreements, including issues relating to artificial intelligence, data privacy, and security matters, with name brand, global organizations. This role works closely with our procurement group as well as strategic and enterprise sales organization, key stakeholders across our engineering, product, support, professional services, marketing, and talent teams to support their needs and help us develop and implement new products and business initiatives.
  
  
To succeed, you’ll need to be able to identify legal risks with an eye to our business needs, propose practical solutions, and offer a “yes, but” path for the business to forge ahead when faced with potential roadblocks. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone to join a growing, evolving technology company and help drive exciting new initiatives. If you’re an organized, self-starter who lives for closing a deal, let’s chat!
  
  
This position is based out of our Hyderabad, India office.
  
  
**Your contribution will be to:**

* Independently negotiate complex customer and vendor contracts, owning agreements from intake through resolution within established frameworks and SLAs, with minimal need for escalation on commonly negotiated issues/topics.
* Analyze common contractual risks and recommend proportionate mitigations aligned with precedent, balancing legal and business considerations, proactively advancing matters, and communicating blockers early.
* Act as an advisor to internal customers on a variety of legal matters, explaining implications, options, and tradeoffs in clear, practical terms to support informed decision-making.
* Support execution of operational initiatives by understanding and providing guidance on the relevant legal issues, including contributing to updates of templates and policies, as necessary
* Support adoption and use of artificial intelligence tools in innovative and creative ways that help the legal team and the broader organization
* Participate in annual risk management assessment and remediation plans
* Assist with litigation and dispute resolution matters, as necessary
* Collaborate proactively with team members and cross-functional partners to improve consistency and efficiency in contracting legal support
* Partner to assist the business with disruption response for issues outside of normal business expectations, including incidents related to security, privacy, disaster recovery, and data integrity, as necessary.
* Participate in other strategic projects and initiatives.
* Consistently ensure that business is conducted with integrity at all times and that behavior aligns with ICIMS policies, procedures, and core competencies, interpreting policies in context and supporting adherence across legal matters.

**Qualifications**

* A minimum of 4 years of experience negotiating complex software as a service, software licensing, professional services, and/or other technology transactions is required. 5+ years of related experience is preferred.
* Ability to handle routine to moderately complex contracting issues with minimal supervision while balancing a positive internal and external customer experience.
* Experience in researching and analyzing federal, state, local and international laws.
* Ability to work independently, while being a collaborative member of the team.
* Ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing with the management team, and company employees, explaining legal positions and trade-offs in practical, business-relevant terms.
* Ability to follow through on commitments and keep stakeholders informed of timing, status, and availability.
* Demonstrated success in displaying passion, drive, adaptability and innovation.
* Proficient in the MS Office Suite, and use of artificial intelligence and related productivity tools.
* Ability to thrive in a fast paced, growing organization.
* Strong track record of success in building solid working relationships within various areas/business functions of the company.

**Preferred**

* LLB from an accredited law school required.
* Admitted as an Advocate by the Bar Counsel of India and has a Certificate of Practice.

title: Regulatory, Compliance & Controls Testing & Validation - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Regulatory, Risk & Forensic | Testing & Validation Utility**
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders to translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that help strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Join our team and use advanced data, AI and emerging technologies with industry insights to help client service teams bring clarity from complexity and accelerate their path to value creation.
  
  
The Testing & Validation Utility delivers integrated regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation services, along with regulatory reporting, across Controls Testing, Conformance Testing, Compliance Testing, Regulatory Reporting QA & Testing, Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Post-Effectiveness Testing, Issue Management & Remediation Validation, and Regulatory Reporting for global clients across industries, with a particular focus on Banking, Capital Markets, Investment Management, and Insurance. We expect our professionals to bring exposure across the end-to-end risk management lifecycle — Transactions, Conformance, Controls, Compliance, RCSA, and Issue Management — and to apply that breadth across the components they support.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
**Regulatory, Compliance & Controls Testing & Validation | Consultant**
**Level:**
Consultant or equivalent (4-7 years of relevant experience)
  
  
As an experienced Consultant within the Testing & Validation Utility at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines across regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation activities, along with regulatory reporting, spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. As needed, you will mentor and/or direct junior team members and liaise with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after Risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
Work you’ll do:
  
  
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities — from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks — to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
  
  
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value-added outcomes.
  
  
As a Consultant within the Testing & Validation Utility, you will individually deliver regulatory, compliance, and controls testing and validation outcomes, along with regulatory reporting, across the end-to-end risk management lifecycle for global clients across industries, with a focus on banking, financial services, and insurance — owning end-to-end execution of assigned work, applying methodology with rigor, and partnering with control owners, process owners, and second-line stakeholders. You will be expected to bring breadth across multiple components and depth in at least two.
  
  
You will perform this work for first-line control owners, second-line risk and compliance functions, and internal audit, following a standard methodology and using analytics and GenAI tools. Typical activities include data sourcing and reconciliation, walkthroughs, population validation, sample selection, evidence review, root cause analysis, workpaper documentation, and reporting of results and remediation status. Specific responsibilities span the following areas:
  
  
**Controls Testing**
Perform end-to-end assessments of the design and operating effectiveness of operational and compliance controls — including walkthroughs, process documentation, test strategy, sample design, and population validation — with full traceability from risk through evidence to conclusion.
  
  

* Perform end-to-end control assessments across operational and compliance controls, including planning, walkthroughs, design and operating effectiveness testing, documentation, and issue follow-up
* Apply risk analysis principles to scope reviews; develop test strategies, sample selection methodology, sample sizing, and rationale; document process flows and key controls
* Prepare reviewer-ready workpapers and draft observations including root-cause analysis, impact assessment, and remediation tracking
* Identify control deficiencies, document them with clear rationale, recommend corrective actions, and re-test where required; track remediation to closure
* Collaborate with control owners, process owners, 2nd Line of Defense partners, and Internal Audit; build reports/dashboards (Excel, Power BI, Tableau) for testing progress and exceptions

**Conformance Testing**
Execute conformance reviews of reports, processes, and controls against published regulatory instructions, internal policies, and procedures; identify variances, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation.
  
  

* Execute conformance testing of regulatory reports and key business processes against published regulatory instructions, internal policies, procedures, and operating standards (e.g., FFIEC instructions, FR Y-9C glossary, Basel III, MiFID II, FINRA TTRO, Reg YY)
* Perform completeness, timeliness, and accuracy controls; reconcile reports against source data and prior submissions; identify variances and root causes
* Review and enhance process narratives, Operating Procedures, Checklists, and SOPs to ensure they are accurate, current, and aligned with regulator expectations
* Generate MI on conformance results, timeliness, and accuracy; escalate key issues and coordinate IT/operational fixes with business owners
* Support response to internal audit, second-line challenge, and regulatory examinations on conformance topics

**Compliance Testing**
Test the design and operating effectiveness of compliance controls across federal and state consumer protection regulations, BSA/AML, OFAC, sanctions, KYC, and fraud, delivering independent assurance outcomes for the business.
  
  

* Plan and execute compliance testing work programs across consumer and commercial regulations; assess whether controls are designed and operating effectively to comply with applicable laws, regulations, and firm policies
* Conduct routine and ad-hoc compliance testing including forensic testing, transactional testing, and surveillance testing; design test scripts and sampling approaches for high-risk processes
* Apply data analysis tools and analytics to mine populations, identify high-risk transactions, account types, activity patterns, and surface themes across business lines
* Validate Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs), business-unit control testing, and remediation actions; identify control improvement opportunities
* Communicate test results to Compliance, Operational Risk, FLU process owners, and senior stakeholders; identify themes/trends at FLU, control function, and Enterprise level

**Regulatory Reporting QA & Testing**
Perform in-line Quality Assurance and independent testing of regulatory reports to validate data lineage, conformance with reporting instructions, accuracy, completeness, and the effectiveness of report-level controls.
  
  

* Plan and execute end-to-end QA testing across regulatory reporting submissions (FR Y-9C, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, FFIEC, LCR, CCAR, PRA 110, FINREP/COREP, etc.), covering data profiling, completeness, accuracy, conformance with reporting instructions, and control evaluation
* Perform transaction-level testing from point of origin to reporting, including source-to-report data lineage, line item mapping, and validation of underlying products, accounting concepts, data elements, and data flow
* Develop, refresh, and document QA test methodologies including scoping, sample selection, sample sizing rationale, and test scripts for assigned report families
* Prepare reviewer-ready workpapers, draft observations, and conclusions; identify control gaps, document rationale, and recommend remediation
* Coordinate with Report Owners, Finance, Risk, Operations, and Data SMEs to obtain evidence, resolve interpretive questions, and validate findings
* Track issue remediation, validate evidence of closure, and re-test where required; support response to internal audit and regulatory examinations

**Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Post-Effectiveness Testing**
Facilitate and execute risk and control self-assessments — identifying inherent risks, evaluating control effectiveness, rating residual risk, and tracking action plans — and perform post-effectiveness testing of key controls, in line with the Operational Risk Management Framework.
  
  

* Facilitate RCSAs for assigned business units and processes: identify inherent risks, evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, assess residual risk, and document RCSA outputs
* Apply enterprise risk taxonomy and control taxonomy; rate risks and controls consistently; map controls to applicable regulations, policies, and standards
* Drive design and execution of post-effectiveness testing for key controls identified in RCSA; validate management's self-assessment ratings and challenge where required
* Track RCSA action plans, control enhancements, and remediation through to closure; partner with 1LoD risk officers, control owners, and 2LoD
* Configure and maintain RCSA records in the GRC platform; produce risk reporting, heat maps, and trend analyses for senior stakeholders

**Issue Management & Remediation Validation**
Validate the completeness and accuracy of issue remediation activities, perform root cause analysis, and assure the sustainability of corrective actions for self-identified, audit, and regulatory issues.
  
  

* Perform issue validation for high-complexity self-identified, audit, and regulatory issues; review and assess individual remediation artifacts for completeness and accuracy
* Partner with issue owners and Issue Execution Officers to incorporate observations into remediation scope prior to issue due date; ensure alignment to enterprise issue management standards and regulatory expectations
* Support completion of issue closure packages with rationale, evidence inventory, and validation conclusions; identify themes in remediation to feed into best practices
* Coordinate end-to-end issue management process: root cause analysis, corrective action development, sustainability testing, and risk mitigation validation
* Provide credible challenge and recommendations to issue owners and leadership; recommend updates to controls, policies, procedures, and risk/control documentation

**Regulatory Reporting**
Alongside testing and validation work, own and execute the preparation, review, and timely submission of financial and non-financial regulatory filings across Banking, Capital Markets, and Investment Management clients — including FFIEC Call Reports, FR Y-series filings, CCAR/DFAST, liquidity and capital reports (LCR, NSFR, FR 2052a), broker-dealer filings (FOCUS, FINRA), and Investment Management reports (Form PF, N-PORT, Form ADV) — with appropriate accuracy, completeness, and audit-ready documentation.
  
  

* Manage end-to-end regulatory reporting activities for assigned report families across Banking (FFIEC Call Reports, FR Y-9C/9LP/9SP, FR Y-14A/Q/M for CCAR/DFAST, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR, NSFR, capital and liquidity reports), Capital Markets (FOCUS Report, FINRA filings, Volcker Rule reporting, large trader reporting), and Investment Management (Form PF, N-PORT, N-CEN, Form ADV, CPO-PQR, 1940 Act and Private Funds, liquidity and derivatives reporting), ensuring compliance with applicable requirements and deadlines
* Prepare, review, and submit regulatory filings to the FRB, OCC, FDIC, SEC, CFTC, FINRA, and international regulators (PRA, FCA, EBA via COREP/FINREP) where applicable; ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency with established standards
* Maintain and enhance SOPs, documentation, control frameworks, and audit trails to support audit readiness and regulatory examinations
* Coordinate across Finance Controllership, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Technology, and external service providers throughout the reporting lifecycle; resolve interpretive questions and operational issues
* Support regulatory exams, internal audits, and ad-hoc data requests related to capital, liquidity, financial, and non-financial reporting
* Drive continuous improvement and change-management initiatives to strengthen reporting quality, reduce operational risk, and improve process efficiency

**Root Cause & Thematic Analysis, Testing MI, and KCI/KRI Reporting (across all components)**
Analyze why exceptions occur, surface themes across testing results, and report results and remediation status to control owners, second-line risk and compliance functions, and internal audit.
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis on test exceptions, control deficiencies, and conformance breaks; identify recurring themes across testing cycles and business units and recommend corrective actions
* Build and maintain testing MI, dashboards, and KCI/KRI views (Excel, Power BI, Tableau) covering testing progress, exceptions, and remediation status
* Communicate results and remediation status to control owners, risk and compliance functions, and internal audit; escalate key themes and trends

**Analytics-led & GenAI-enabled Testing (across all components)**

* Use approved AI / GenAI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT / Azure OpenAI, Deloitte-approved AI assistants) to accelerate test-script drafting, walkthrough narrative buildout, policy-to-control mapping, evidence review, exception triage, and report drafting, in line with firm AI usage policies
* Apply prompt-engineering skills (role, context, task, constraints, output format) to generate reliable, audit-friendly outputs; iteratively refine prompts and validate accuracy
* Use SQL, SAS, Python (pandas), Alteryx Designer, KNIME, or Power Query for population validation, sample selection, reconciliations, transaction tracing, and full-population analytical procedures
* Use Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik to build testing dashboards, KCI/KRI views, and stakeholder reporting

Required skills:
  
  

* 4-7 years of relevant experience in controls testing, regulatory reporting QA, conformance testing, compliance testing, RCSA, internal audit, operational risk, SOX, financial crimes, or business process management in a BFSI, other regulated-industry, or consulting environment
* Exposure across the end-to-end risk management lifecycle — Transactions, Conformance, Controls, Compliance, RCSA, and Issue Management — with hands-on delivery in at least two of these components
* Strong understanding of internal control concepts (manual vs. automated controls, preventive vs. detective controls, IPE, SoD, sampling fundamentals)
* Working knowledge of the COSO 2013 framework and US/UK regulatory frameworks (e.g., FR Y-9C, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR, CCAR, PRA 110, Reg YY, BSA/AML, UDAAP, Reg B/Z, FCRA)
* Exposure to regulatory reporting across Banking (FFIEC Call Reports, FR Y-9C, FR Y-14 CCAR/DFAST, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR/NSFR), Capital Markets (FOCUS Report, FINRA filings), and/or Investment Management (Form PF, N-PORT, Form ADV, 1940 Act and Private Funds, derivatives and liquidity reporting) is highly desirable
* Advanced Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, conditional logic) and strong working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Working knowledge of, and willingness to use, AI / GenAI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT / Azure OpenAI, or equivalents) for test-script generation, walkthrough narrative buildout, policy-to-control mapping, evidence review, exception triage, and report drafting
* Basic prompt-engineering skills - able to write clear, structured prompts (role, context, task, constraints, output format) and iteratively refine them for reliable, audit-friendly outputs
* Working knowledge of SQL (and exposure to SAS, Python pandas, KNIME, or Power Query) for population validation, sample selection, transaction tracing, reconciliations, and exception analysis
* Hands-on or strong working knowledge of at least one analytical / data-prep tool such as Alteryx Designer, KNIME, or Power Query
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to document observations and interact with stakeholders across levels
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines with high-quality standards

Preferred skills:
  
  

* Exposure to BFSI products and processes (banking operations, payments, lending, capital markets, insurance, or investment compliance)
* Exposure to SOX Section 404 and ITGC testing
* Experience with US/UK regulatory requirements across Banking (FR Y-9C, FR Y-14 CCAR/DFAST, FR Y-15, FR 2052a, LCR/NSFR, PRA 110, FFIEC Call Reports, FINREP/COREP), Capital Markets (FOCUS, FINRA filings), and/or Investment Management (Form PF, N-PORT, Form ADV) plus consumer compliance regulations (UDAAP, RESPA, TILA, Reg B/Z, FCRA, SCRA, FDCPA, BSA/AML, OFAC)
* Experience with reporting tools (e.g., Axiom, Vermeg, Moody's, Wolters Kluwer OneSumX) is a plus
* Exposure to GRC platforms (Archer, ServiceNow GRC / IRM, MetricStream, OpenPages, or Workiva)
* Awareness of Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) concepts and analytics-driven assurance
* Awareness of Deloitte AI policies and Trustworthy AI frameworks; certifications such as Microsoft AI-900 are a plus
* Pursuing or partially completed certifications such as CIA, CISA, CRMA, CFE, FRM, CAMS, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent
* Public accounting / Big 4 experience in audit or SOX advisory / consulting
* Basic Python or VBA for data wrangling and reconciliation tasks

Qualification:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business, Accounting, Engineering, or Computer Science, or similar 3-year graduate course
* M.Com / MBA or similar post-graduate course (Tier 2/3 colleges) preferred

Location:
  
  

* Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Chennai
* Professionals are required to work from the office all 5 days of the week.
* Based on engagement requirements, professionals will be required to work out of a secure clean room and/or an Offshore Delivery Center (ODC).

Shift Timings:
  
  

* Based on the engagement, professionals will work in one of the following shifts: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM, or 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM.
* As part of your role at Deloitte and its related entities, you may be required to work in various shift timings to support client deliverables. This could also involve working beyond standard hours, including weekends, holidays and also from Offshore Delivery Centers (ODC) or Client Location. You may be assigned to projects on different technical platforms and skills, and work at designated locations as determined by the company.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. **Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**

Qualifications:

* A minimum of 4 years of experience negotiating complex software as a service, software licensing, professional services, and/or other technology transactions is required. 5+ years of related experience is preferred.

description: Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? This is a full-time, office-based position at our Mumbai office in BKC, working closely with the India team and collaborating with colleagues across time zones.Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:Draft, negotiate and manage EPC, O&M, supply and other construction and operations contracts for wind, solar and storage projects. Support project financing and project development, including reviewing financing, security creation and perfection documents, and coordinating legal opinions and conditions precedent with external counsel. Handle general commercial contracts, including power purchase agreements, lease and land agreements, and other project agreements. Support JV management, including reviewing and administering shareholders’ and JV agreements. title: General Counsel, AI-First Legal Delivery
description:
**Ready to turn complex investment and business risks into clear legal decisions at CEO level?**

**Total annual cash compensation:**
Up to USD $242,000 + comprehensive benefits

Base salary up to USD $220,000/year + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base

**Location:**
Remote, Global

**Potential career path:**
General Counsel → Group General Counsel → Chief Legal Officer.

Career progression that takes 4-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1-2 years here for high performers.

**The Opportunity**

Puffy is a technology-driven e-commerce business with over $1 billion in lifetime sales, powered by analytics, data and artificial intelligence.

Our teams bring together software development, quality assurance, machine learning and AI, marketing, design, conversion rate optimization, talent augmentation, HR, operations, legal, finance and customer success.

Report directly to the CEO as the standalone legal owner across Puffy, RGG, the RGG Capital Family Office and the CEO’s personal matters. This permanent, full-time role has no direct reports. You’ll personally produce substantive work using AI, coordinate specialist counsel and retain professional responsibility for your advice.

**The Problems You’ll Own**

* Make investment obligations visible before commitment. The long-term priority is family-office and investment work, where fund, side-letter, custody and lending terms can shape risk for years.
* Provide broad coverage with one accountable owner. Keep commercial, investment and personal matters moving without urgent requests obscuring emerging exposure.

**What You’ll Own**

* Draft, review and negotiate commercial, vendor, retail and affiliate agreements; support transactions and due diligence, and coordinate disputes, regulatory matters and litigation with outside counsel.
* Lead legal review of fund subscriptions, side letters and limited-partner terms before capital is committed, making restrictions and obligations explicit.
* Coordinate the CEO’s personal contracts, disputes and cross-border requirements with appropriate estate, tax, asset-protection and immigration specialists.
* Use AI for document comparisons, research synthesis, drafting, risk analysis and executive reporting within approved confidentiality arrangements; verify decisive legal sources and facts.
* Produce a monthly Legal Exposure Audit across the three workstreams, identifying risks, deadlines, actions, unresolved decisions and proactive recommendations.
* Run a quarterly review of product pages, checkout, pricing, advertising and terms, and follow corrective actions through completion.
* Review portfolio covenants, custody and counterparty controls quarterly. In your first 90 days, independently surface at least five material risks or improvement areas with evidence and practical recommendations.

Set day-to-day methods and priorities within the agreed mandate, negotiate within delegated limits and direct approved counsel within budget. Escalate material risk acceptance, settlements, litigation strategy and commitments outside that mandate. Legal ownership does not provide signing, investment or funds-transfer authority; retain required CEO, signatory and control-owner approvals.

**What This Can Mean for Your Career**

* Develop direct exposure to investment decisions as well as operating-company legal work.
* Build a verified, AI-enabled legal delivery system with clear ownership across different mandates.
* Strengthen independent judgment, executive communication and specialist-counsel coordination.

**What You’ll Need**

* A recognized legal degree such as JD, LLB or equivalent, plus qualification in good standing in at least one jurisdiction. Admission to a U.S. bar is not required.
* Typically 5–10 years of relevant practice, with sufficient depth to operate without an internal legal team; additional relevant experience is welcome.
* Commercial drafting, proactive risk identification, cross-border coordination and management of several outside-counsel relationships.
* Substantive hands-on use of AI in legal delivery, supported by examples of your work, verification and outcome; familiarity or editing grammar alone is insufficient.
* Clear CEO-level communication, discretion, dependable follow-through and appropriate professional-scope judgment.
* Availability for extended hours and weekend work when required.

**Good to Have**

* U.S. legal experience.
* A combination of law-firm and in-house practice.
* Investment, family-office or consumer-protection experience.

**The Resources to Build On**

Puffy has been AI-first since December 2023. Use company-provided ChatGPT, Claude, agents, plugins and automations such as n8n, alongside relevant records and approved specialist support. Protect confidentiality, verify authorities and clauses, distinguish facts from assumptions and retain professional ownership.

Work within approved data access and confidentiality requirements, validate generated work and obtain the required approvals before consequential actions.

**The Puffy DNA**

We’re ambitious, fast-paced and focused on turning ideas into results.

* Be the Owner: Take responsibility for outcomes and follow work through completion.
* Execute with Urgency: Make thoughtful decisions quickly and act decisively.
* Demand Excellence: Solve difficult problems and keep improving your craft.
* Be AI-First: Use multi-turn AI conversations to challenge assumptions and improve your work.
* Go All-In: Work together when the mission demands it.

**✨Your Compensation & Benefits**

**💰Compensation**

* Up to USD $242,000 + comprehensive benefits
* Base salary up to USD $220,000/year + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
* Annual salary review every January.

**🏥 Health & Protection:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)

**🌴 Time Off:**

* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays

**💼 Work Environment:**

* AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning & development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

**🏆 Rewards & Recognition:**

* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

**Ready to Put Your Expertise to Work?**

Click “Apply” to submit your application. Show us examples of legal work you personally delivered, how AI supported it and how you verified the advice.

title: Chief Legal, Governance & Risk Officer
description:
**About Paramverse**

Paramverse is a diversified, founder-led enterprise with operating businesses across Biotechnology, Artificial Intelligence, and Agro-Commodities. As the Group enters its next phase of institutional scale, its roadmap spans international expansion (including operating entities in the United States), domestic and cross-border M&A, intellectual property commercialisation, strategic real asset acquisitions, and the institutionalisation of a Promoter Family Office.

**What You Will Own**

* **Corporate governance, group structuring and secretarial:**
  Design and maintain the Group’s holding architecture across holding companies, LLPs, private trusts, and subsidiaries. Structure shareholder governance, including differential voting rights, reserved matters, and board composition. Act as statutory Company Secretary across principal Group entities. Own compliance under the Companies Act, 2013, the LLP Act, 2008, and SEBI regulations, and give legal clearance on all material Group commitments.
* **International expansion, cross-border law and tax structuring:**
  Set up and govern international subsidiaries, starting with the US. Advise on FEMA, Overseas Investment Rules, 2022, and FDI. Architect tax-efficient cross-border structures (including GIFT City IFSC) with adherence to DTAA, Transfer Pricing, POEM, and GAAR. Oversee tax strategy and litigation alongside external counsel.
* **Mergers, acquisitions and strategic transactions:**
  Lead domestic and cross-border M&A, JVs, schemes of arrangement, and restructurings from term sheet to post-merger integration. Direct legal and tax due diligence, draft and negotiate SPAs, SHAs, SSAs, and BTAs, and manage approvals from CCI, NCLT, RBI, and sectoral regulators.
* **Commercial contracting and enterprise risk:**
  Build a standard contract lifecycle framework across all verticals. Draft and negotiate high-value agreements, from commodity offtake and biotech CDMO or research collaborations to enterprise AI licensing. Align contract terms with pricing, credit, currency risk, liability caps, and indemnities.
* **IP, biotech and technology protection:**
  Build, register, and defend the Group’s patents, trademarks, copyrights, software, datasets, and trade secrets. Coordinate patent prosecution and NBA clearances under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, and enforce IP ownership across employment, consultancy, and R&D agreements.
* **Family office, venture capital and investment structuring:**
  Establish the Promoter Family Office using the right vehicle (investment holding company, SEBI-registered AIF, or GIFT City Family Investment Fund). Structure and document VC and private investments (CCPS, SAFE notes, convertibles, investor rights, exit terms).
* **Real estate and strategic asset acquisitions:**
  Run 30-year title due diligence on land and commercial property. Advise on land conversion, agricultural land rules, RERA, and stamp duty, and draft sale, conveyance, lease, and development agreements.
* **Group-wide compliance and dispute resolution:**
  Implement a compliance framework covering corporate, tax, labour, environmental, DPDP Act, 2023, and sector laws such as the Fertiliser Control Order, 1985. Maintain the register of notices and contingent liabilities, and supervise litigation, IBC/NCLT matters, and arbitration, including external counsel and legal budgets.
* **CXO partnership:**
  Work as an equal peer with the Head of Finance & Business Partnering and the Head of Capital & Treasury, so that legal, financial, and treasury decisions move together on every growth initiative.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Triple-qualified:**
  Chartered Accountant (ICAI), Company Secretary (ICSI), and LL.B. All three are mandatory. State Bar Council enrolment is preferred.
* **15+ years post-qualification experience,**
  including at least 7 years leading legal, governance, and secretarial functions in a diversified group, or as a senior leader in a Tier-1 law firm or Big Four tax and regulatory practice.
* **Transaction track record:**
  Led and closed at least five M&A, private equity, VC, or restructuring transactions, including cross-border deals and overseas subsidiary setups (US experience preferred).
* **Structuring and governance expertise:**
  Promoter holding entities, private trusts, and Shareholders’ Agreements with balanced investor and governance protections.
* **Cross-border and tax command:**
  FEMA, Overseas Investment Rules, transfer pricing, DTAA planning, and direct and indirect tax controversy.
* **Real estate and title law:**
  Hands-on 30-year title due diligence, land conversion, RERA, and conveyancing (Maharashtra experience preferred).
* **Leadership qualities:**
  Commercial judgement, a builder mindset (strategic in the boardroom, hands-on from day one), fiduciary integrity and discretion, calibrated risk advice with constructive alternatives, and tight governance of external counsel and legal spend.

title: Sr. Lead LAQ
description:
Interested candidates, kindly mail to
**enpcareers.hr@ril.com**

**Main Purpose:**

The Sr. Lead – LAQ manages the end-to-end land lifecycle for CBM operations in Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh, including acquisition of private, tribal, and Government land, forest land diversion, and Right of Use (RoU) acquisition for pipelines. The role ensures legal and regulatory compliance, supports land-related litigation, maintains audit-ready records, resolves disputes within approved budgets, sustains operational land access, and develops the capability of the LAQ team.

**A. Job Accountabilities:**

**1. Land Acquisition:**

* Acquire private, tribal, and Government land for well sites, GGS, compressor stations, approach roads, and other facilities within approved budgets and project timelines.
* Conduct title due diligence, including verification of Khasra, B-1, mutation history, and encumbrances, and negotiate with landowners within approved budgets.
* Coordinate demarcation, measurements, and boundary verification with Patwari, RI, and Tehsildar offices.
* Manage Government land allotment and lease, land-use diversion, and demarcation under the MP Land Revenue Code (MPLRC), in coordination with revenue officials.

**2. Forest Land Diversion:**

* Identify forest and deemed-forest land and plan layouts and routes to minimise forest land diversion.
* Prepare and submit forest diversion proposals through the PARIVESH portal in accordance with applicable laws and track them through the DFO, CF, Nodal Officer, State Government, and MoEF&CC (Regional Office or Headquarters) for Stage-I and Stage-II approvals.
* Arrange DGPS maps, FRA and Gram Sabha certificates, and land for Compensatory Afforestation (CA). Manage payment of CA and Net Present Value (NPV) and ensure compliance with approval conditions.

**3. Right of Use (RoU):**

* Acquire RoU for infield pipelines under the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962 (PMP Act), or through mutual agreements. Coordinate with the Competent Authority for Section 3(1) and Section 6(1) notifications and Section 10 compensation.
* Obtain crossing permissions and No Objection Certificates (NOCs) from NHAI, PWD, Railways, WRD, the Forest Department, and Panchayats, and maintain chainage-wise RoU records.

**4. Support During Operations:**

* Provide land and RoU support for O&M activities, patrolling, repairs, emergencies, and expansions.
* Coordinate with the Liaison team to resolve access issues, grievances, and work stoppages in consultation with the district administration, police, and Panchayats.
* Restore and return land used temporarily and manage the surrender of land and RoU when assets are abandoned.

**5. Process and Compliance:**

* Define and update SOPs for land acquisition, forest land diversion, and RoU in line with the MPLRC, PMP Act, RFCTLARR Act, and applicable forest laws. Ensure strict compliance and maintain audit-ready records.
* Track changes in land, forest, and revenue laws and assess their impact on operations.

**6. Documentation:**

* Vet sale deeds, lease deeds, RoU deeds, consent letters, affidavits, and settlement agreements, ensuring proper stamping and registration.
* Maintain organised physical and digital land records and a land bank for easy retrieval.

**7. Legal and Litigation Support:**

* Support the Legal team in handling land, forest, and RoU cases before Revenue Courts, Civil and District Courts, the Competent Authority, the NGT, the High Court of Madhya Pradesh, and the Supreme Court.
* Draft applications, replies, rejoinders, objections, caveats, appeals, and briefs for writ petitions and Special Leave Petitions (SLPs). Collect supporting evidence and coordinate with legal counsel.
* Maintain a litigation tracker and support the preparation of legal opinions on land acquisition, RoU, stamp duty, taxation, and related civil and criminal matters.

**8. Other Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and monitor budgets for land acquisition, forest land diversion, and RoU, covering compensation, CA/NPV levies, stamp duty, and legal costs, and ensure that acquisitions remain within approved budget limits.
* Provide periodic MIS reports to management on acquisition progress, approvals, operational RoU issues, and litigation status.
* Train and mentor team members on the MPLRC, PMP Act, forest diversion procedures, documentation standards, and the Company’s LAQ processes.

**B. Skills Required:**

* Sound knowledge of applicable laws, including the MP Land Revenue Code, PMP Act, 1962, Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, 1980, Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006, and RFCTLARR Act, 2013.
* Experience in forest land diversion through PARIVESH and RoU acquisition for pipelines.
* Strong negotiation skills and experience engaging with landowners and local communities.
* Ability to draft and vet deeds, agreements, and legal pleadings, and provide litigation support up to the High Court and Supreme Court.
* Strong communication and liaison skills for effective coordination with revenue, forest, and district administration officials.
* Good documentation, MIS, and team leadership skills, with working proficiency in Hindi and English.

**C. Experience and Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law / Graduate / Postgraduate qualification from a recognised university.
* 15–20 years of relevant experience in Land Acquisition.

Interested candidates, kindly mail to
**enpcareers.hr@ril.com**

MRPL is among India’s largest and fastest-growing omnichannel food and grocery retailers. The company is on a mission to build a truly customer-obsessed business- delivering a best-in-class omnichannel experience at scale.

The Legal Manager will help ensure that employees and relevant third parties follow the Company’s Code of Conduct and policies. **labour laws and an interest in handling internal enquiries.**
Extensive investigation or ethics and compliance experience is not a prerequisite.

title: Regulatory Manager
description:
The
**Regulatory Manager**
oversees the end-to-end coordination for all required project approvals, from initiation through completion. This role ensures timely submissions, budget tracking, and efficient resource utilization to obtain necessary permissions, facilitating uninterrupted project progress.

**Key Responsibilities of Role**

**Team Leadership & Management:**

* Provide leadership and guidance to the liaising team to achieve timely approvals for projects.
* Set team goals, monitor progress, and ensure effective collaboration across departments and stakeholders.
* Establish weekly priority actions for the team, ensuring alignment with project goals and strategic timelines.
* Train and mentor team members in best practices for government liaising and documentation.

**Budget Tracking & Reporting:**

* Monitor and report all expenditures related to approval processes, providing budget forecasts and real-time expense updates to company leadership.
* Develop budget estimates for each project approval phase to facilitate cost-effective planning, ensuring that approvals align with the company’s financial expectations.

**Strategic Relationship Management:**

* Build and maintain strong, effective relationships with key officials.
* Establish rapport with officials at all levels to ensure favorable and expedited processing of approvals and permits.
* Engage with other critical government departments such as the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF), Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB), Irrigation Department, Electricity Board, Road & Building Department, Railways, ONGC/NHAI, and other relevant agencies for smooth approvals.

**Documentation & Approval Management:**

* Oversee the preparation of various applications, including Old Tenure, Section 63, Non-Agricultural (NA) permissions, and ensure all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Supervise the drafting of written correspondence, including formal letters and notices, primarily in Gujarati, for all communications with revenue offices and government authorities.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, approvals, NOCs, and sanctions are obtained in alignment with project timelines and regulatory requirements.
* Review and finalize all applications for approvals related to non-revenue and non-land activities as required for project readiness.
* Organize records and maintain a tracking system for all active applications and approvals, ensuring internal teams have updated information on the status.
* **Compliance & Policy Monitoring:**
* Ensure compliance with all conditions attached to approvals, NOCs, and sanctions obtained for projects.
* Conduct ongoing reviews of policies from relevant authorities and assess project requirements against these policies to ensure regulatory alignment.
* Timely renew and extend relevant revenue approvals and other permissions, maintaining updated records.
* Coordinate responses to notices, grievances, or queries from government agencies, ensuring prompt and accurate replies in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
* **Risk Management & Site Oversight:**
* Maintain physical oversight of all land parcels to prevent unauthorized encroachments and manage any risks related to land ownership.
* Develop risk mitigation strategies to address any potential encroachment or disputes, coordinating with the land team as necessary.
* Facilitate updates on compliance issues and manage challenges that arise on site, ensuring minimal disruption to project activities.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
* Collaborate with internal teams, including Design, Planning, and Municipal Architects, to ensure that required approvals align with project specifications.
* Support construction teams by facilitating the approvals necessary for project execution.
* Coordinate between various consultants, partners, and municipal authorities to ensure project timelines and compliance requirements are met.
* **Regulatory Intelligence & Reporting:**
* Keep abreast of changes in policies, regulations, and procedural updates from government departments, ensuring the team and internal stakeholders are informed.
* Provide weekly updates to senior management and project teams on the status of applications, issues, and actions required.
* Implement a structured tracker system to monitor and report the status of all applications and approvals, ensuring transparency across departments.

**Education Qualification:**
Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture (B.Arch.)/ Engineering (B.Tech)

**Work Experience(Range of years):**
15+ Years

**Preferred Industry:**

* Experience in real estate or infrastructure sectors, with a focus on liaising and regulatory documentation for various permits and licenses, including Old Tenure, 63, NA, and environmental NOCs.
* Skilled in document preparation for project approvals, land revenue processes, title transfers, and encroachment prevention; budget management experience to ensure cost-effective and timely application submissions.

title: Compliance Review Controller (Assistant Manager)
description:
**Job Title:**
Compliance Review Controller (Assistant Manager)
  
  
**Department**
: India CoE Compliance Hub
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Compliance Hub - India CoE is dedicated to safeguarding the Group's reputation and mitigating risk across its global businesses by supporting a broad range of Compliance functions. The Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance teams worldwide, delivering expertise in Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and AML), controls framework, conduct and professional ethics, data analytics and governance, and transformation initiatives including AI adoption. The Hub teams collaborate closely with Compliance and business stakeholders across the Group to drive efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance operational resilience.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
To provide independent 2nd Line assurance and challenge over the effectiveness of Compliance controls, identifying weaknesses and driving sustainable risk mitigation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
The person will be a part of the Transversal Risk Management (TRM) team reporting to Team Lead, Non-FS Controls.
  
  

* Perform testing and controls as defined by internal procedures independently or with limited guidance under the supervision of TRM Managers or their delegates in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and internal firm policy and procedure requirements specifically with regards to Market Integrity, Market Abuse Surveillance, Swap Dealer, Banking Structural Reforms, Client interest Protection, Client Fiscal Regulations, Professional Ethics domains
* Maintain an audit trail for all work carried out during the control testing, reporting and action plan stages
* Challenge the 1LoD control framework including control applicability, design, methodology (for sampling and rating) as well as other factors to ensure that the compliance risk articulated in the key objectives of the Generic Control library (GCL) or the Central Control Library (CCL) is appropriately mitigated.
* Escalate weaknesses identified to TRM Managers or their delegates for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.
* Draft and validate issues and recommendations with 1LoD stakeholders addressing the root cause of the issues with stakeholders.
* Ensure that all findings and recommendations are entered into the appropriate tool for tracking purposes, perform periodic follow-up with stakeholders of open issues and review/validate submitted closure evidence to ensure proper resolution.
* Ensure that all the results are reported into Digitized Control Sheets, SharePoint Workflow, CIB/TRM SharePoint Reporting tool & PowerBI dashboards. Ensure to use various tools as rolled out by CIB / TRM-E team from time to time
* Enhance, deliver, and support the annual TRM Plan, ensuring coverage for existing Firm standards, new regulations, changes to existing regulations, and any audit or exam findings.
* Achieve objectives within strict time constraints.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* In the spirit of continuous improvement, assist with the identification of potential enhancements to the TRM process, tools, reporting and analytics and provide suggestions on how to improve, add to, or streamline current practices in the firm.
* Mentor junior analysts/associate‑level testers; review their work for quality and compliance.
* Assist the team manager with tasks which may include assisting in testing reviews, preparing materials, organizing meetings, and taking minutes.
* Respond timely to internal or external requests for information and analysis.
* Assist in responding to regulatory and internal audit queries.
* Assist with related Compliance monitoring activities as needed.
* Promote a compliance culture within the firm which supposes also to update knowledge on a regular basis.
* Conduct knowledge‑sharing sessions, workshops and on‑the‑job training
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and proactive risk awareness
* Participate in piloting new technologies that increase testing efficiency and data coverage.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Excellent IT and excel skills
* Excellent communication and project management skills
* A good understanding of Financial Markets (participants, basic products and activities) and related Compliance topics including AML, Sanctions, KYC, KYI, KYS, KYX, Market Integrity, Market Abuse Surveillance, Swap Dealer, Banking Structural Reforms, Client interest Protection, Client Fiscal Regulations, Professional Ethics topics
* Team player with interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Self-confidence, ability to stand their ground when required
* Flexibility and adaptability to work on different topics

**Specific Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
* Compliance, Audit, Risk Management qualifications.

**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**

* Minimum 5 to 8 years’ experience working for a financial services firm and/or self-regulatory organization in a Compliance Monitoring/Testing, Internal Audit or regulatory related position.
* Working knowledge of capital markets and investment banking activities and regulatory requirements governing those activities.
* Strong analytical, organizational abilities, project management skills and attention to detail.
* Problem solving, critical thinking, investigative and root cause identification skills.
* Advanced computer skills including MS Excel (including macros), Word, and PowerPoint; Power BI is a plus.
* Excellent execution skills with the ability to work successfully under demanding deadlines.
* Team player with ability to work collaboratively across Compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front and back-office staff, and senior management.
* High ethical standards.
* Flexibility to adapt to a new and changing environment.

**Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge on AI and python preferred

**Behavioral Skills**

* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* Attention to detail / rigor
* Decision Making
* Communication skills - oral & written

Bachelor Degree or equivalent

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. description:
**Company Description**

Volody is a global provider of AI-powered Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) software that helps enterprises and legal professionals digitize and automate their contract processes. Its configurable, easy-to-use platform centralizes scattered contracts from multiple repositories and turns them into actionable business assets. The tool enables teams to track renewal dates, obligations, and terms, while flagging risky clauses to support better legal and business decisions. By streamlining workflows, enabling risk assessment, and supporting digital signatures, Volody’s cloud solution can expedite contracting by up to 70% and significantly reduce administrative costs. Founded by experienced finance and legal professionals who have led major global corporations, Volody is focused on transforming how organizations manage contracts.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Legal Intern role based in Goregaon, Mumbai, open only to candidates located in Mumbai. The intern will support the legal team in reviewing, drafting, and updating a variety of commercial contracts and legal documents aligned with Volody’s CLM workflows. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching legal issues related to contract management, assisting in risk assessment of clauses, and helping maintain accurate, organized records in the centralized repository. The role also involves coordinating with internal stakeholders to clarify contractual terms, preparing summaries and reports, and contributing to the continuous improvement of legal processes powered by Volody’s technology platform.

description:

* Draft, vet and negotiate lease deeds, leave and licence agreements, concession agreements and allotment-related documents with Central / State Government departments, PSUs, statutory authorities, development authorities, municipal bodies, railways, port and airport authorities and similar bodies.

* Manage stamp duty, registration and e-registration under the Registration Act, 1908 and the applicable State Stamp Act, including lease classification and adjudication.

* Coordinate with the CFO / tax team on GST on rent, TDS on rent and Ind AS 116 lease accounting inputs.

* Maintain a lease register with key dates, renewal and rent-revision schedules, and compliance milestones.

* Track covenants, approvals, licences and renewals for each property.

* Standardise templates, clause libraries and approval workflows.

**5. Disputes and litigation**

* Handle notices, eviction, arrears and breach matters; instruct and supervise external counsel in courts, tribunals, arbitration and writ matters.

* Liaise with government officials and authorities on approvals, correspondence and follow-ups.

**6. Corporate and general legal support**

* Support the group on Companies Act, 2013 compliances, board documents, and vendor, franchise, employment and other commercial agreements as needed.

* Provide legal opinions and risk notes to management.

* **Mandatory:** LL.B. (3-year or 5-year integrated) from a recognised university; enrolled with a State Bar Council (LL.M. or a real estate law specialisation is an advantage).

Skills and Competencies

* Excellent drafting, negotiation and legal research skills; precise written English (knowledge of Hindi / the local language is helpful).

* Working knowledge of property, contract, stamp, registration and arbitration law, and of government tender and allotment processes.

* Ability to deal with government departments and to manage multiple matters and deadlines independently.

* Proficiency in MS Word / Excel and legal databases; integrity and strict confidentiality.

description:

description:

* Manage IFSCA compliance, regulatory filings, compliance calendars, and regulatory reporting.

* Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and financial databases.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

* Exposure to Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), mutual funds, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), or investment compliance.
